zh_title: 动态刚性平台上四足机器人运动的稳定控制器-UMass Lowell
en_title: Stabilization Controller for Quadruped Robot Motion on Dynamic Rigid Platforms
body:
美国马萨诸塞大学，俗称麻省大学（University of Massachusetts），是美国知名的公立大学系统，该校研究人员基于宇树科技的Laikago四足机器人运动平台进行四足机器人在动态刚性平台的稳定步态控制器设计并发表论文《Provably Stabilizing Controllers for Quadrupedal Robot Locomotion on Dynamic Rigid Platforms》，该论文已入围Best Student Paper 奖，刊登在顶级学术杂志ADVANCES IN MATHEMATICS上。
Researchers at the University of Massachusetts, commonly known as the University of Massachusetts, a well-known public university system in the United States, have published a paper on "Provably Stabilizing Controllers for Quadrupedal Robot Locomotion on Dynamic Rigid Platforms" based on Yu Shu Technology's Laikago quadrupedal robot locomotion platform. Stabilizing Controllers for Quadrupedal Robot Locomotion on Dynamic Rigid Platforms", which has been shortlisted for the Best Student Paper Award and published in the top academic journal ADVANCES IN MATHEMATICS in the top academic journal ADVANCES IN MATHEMATICS.

zh_title: 使用NVIDIA Isaac SDK构建智能机器狗-NVIDIA
en_title: Building Intelligent Robotic Dogs with NVIDIA Isaac SDK
body:
美国NVIDIA英伟达公司，是GPU的发明者，也是人工智能计算的引领者，英伟达人工智能算法团队基于宇树科技的Laikago四足机器人运动平台和二次开发平台，利用NVIDA Isaac SDK开发包，搭载NVIDIA Jetson TX2 GPU处理器和Velodyne VL-16型号3D激光雷达，构建出可自主导航和运动避障的智能机器狗系统。该项名为《Building an Intelligent Robot Dog with the NVIDIA Isaac SDK》研究已经发表在NVIDIA开发者论坛。
NVIDIA Corporation, the inventor of GPU and the leader in artificial intelligence computing, NVIDIA AI algorithm team based on Yushu Technology's Laikago quadruped robot motion platform and secondary development platform, using NVIDA Isaac SDK development kit, equipped with NVIDIA Jetson TX2 GPU processor and Velodyne VL-16 3D LIDAR to build an intelligent robot dog system for autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance. The research, Building an Intelligent Robot Dog with the NVIDIA Isaac SDK, has been published in the NVIDIA Developer Forum.
使用四足机器人在城市环境中进行自治的社会隔离-南方科技大学等
Autonomous social isolation in urban environments using quadrupedal robots - Southern University of Science and Technology et al.
南方科技大学联合香港大学、香港城市大学、美国马里兰大学帕克分校（University of Maryland, College Park）、华中科技大学，为实现防止新冠肺炎传播，以宇树科技的Laikago四足机器人平台和二次开发平台为基础开发设计出一套人群密度监视和人群疏散机器人系统，并发表题为《Autonomous Social Distancing in Urban Environments using a Quadruped Robot》的论文。论文已经上传至arXiv.org平台。
该系统以Laikago作为运动平台，搭载了NVIDIA Jetson Xavier GPU处理器，通过社交距离实时探测系统感知人群密集度情况，以人群密集区作为运动目标点，通过3D激光雷达实现运动路径规划和运动避障，通过语音模块告诉人群及时疏散避免聚集。
Southern University of Science and Technology, in collaboration with the University of Hong Kong, City University of Hong Kong, University of Maryland, College Park, and Huazhong University of Science and Technology, developed and designed a crowd density monitoring and crowd evacuation robot system based on the Laikago quadruped robot platform and secondary development platform of Yushu Technology to prevent the spread of Newcastle Pneumonia. The paper entitled "Autonomous Social Distancing in Urban Environments using a Quadruped Robot" was published. The paper has been uploaded to the arXiv.org platform.
The system uses Laikago as the motion platform and is equipped with NVIDIA Jetson Xavier GPU processor. It perceives crowd density situation through social distance real-time detection system, takes crowded area as the motion target point, realizes motion path planning and motion obstacle avoidance through 3D LIDAR, and tells the crowd to evacuate in time to avoid gathering through voice module.
通过模仿动物学习敏捷的机器人运动技能-Google Brian& UC Berkeley
Learning Agile Robot Motor Skills by Imitating Animals-Google Brian & UC Berkeley
谷歌大脑（Google Brain）是谷歌深度学习研究项目，美国加利福尼亚伯克利分校（University of California, Berkeley）是世界最顶尖的公立研究型大学之一，谷歌大脑和美国加利福尼亚伯克利分校科研人员联合在宇树科技的Laikago四足机器人运动平台和二次开发平台基础上，设计开发了深度学习平台实现了四足机器人模拟四足动物的运动步态，通过采集四足动物实验对象在各种步态下关节运动轨迹信息，利用强化学习方法将实验对象运动信息生成四足机器人运动控制算法，在仿真平台上验证算法一致性后，移植到实体Laikago四足机器人进行验证。研究发表了论文《Learning Agile Robotic Locomotion Skills by Imitating Animals》，并且入选RSS 2020年Best Paper名单。
Google Brain is a Google deep learning research project, and the University of California, Berkeley is one of the world's top public research universities. Based on the Laikago quadruped robot motion platform and secondary development platform, a deep learning platform was designed and developed to simulate the motion gait of a quadruped robot by collecting information about the joint motion trajectory of the quadruped subject in various gait states, generating a quadruped robot motion control algorithm using reinforcement learning methods, verifying the consistency of the algorithm on the simulation platform, and then transplanting it to the entity After verifying the consistency of the algorithm on the simulation platform, it was transferred to the real Laikago quadruped robot for validation. The research was published in the paper "Learning Agile Robotic Locomotion Skills by Imitating Animals" and was selected for the RSS 2020 Best Paper list.
腿式机器人的通用神经运动控制框架-南京航空航天大学& University of Southern Denmark等
A Generalized Neural Motion Control Framework for Legged Robots-Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics & University of Southern Denmark et al.
南京航空航天大学和南丹麦大学（University of Southern Denmark）、德国哥廷根大学（University of Göttingen）联合在宇树科技的Laikago四足机器人运动平台和二次开发平台基础上，设计开发了一种通用的运动控制神经网络框架实现多种形态足式机器人的运动控制，并发表论文《Generic Neural Locomotion Control Framework for Legged Robots》，该论文发表在全球顶级人工智能期刊《IEEE Transaction on Neural Networks and Learning Systems》。
网络框架由一个CPG层和一个RBF层构成，通过该控制神经网络可以给足式机器人的各关节生成任意节律的轨迹控制信号。
Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, the University of Southern Denmark and the University of Göttingen jointly developed a generalized neural network framework for motion control based on Yushu's Laikago quadruped robot motion platform and secondary development platform. The paper, "Generic Neural Locomotion Control Framework for Legged Robots," was published in the IEEE Transaction on Neural Networks and Learning Systems, one of the world's top artificial intelligence journals. Learning Systems.
The network framework consists of a CPG layer and an RBF layer, through which the control neural network can generate arbitrary rhythmic trajectory control signals to each joint of the footed robot.
学习接触式自适应控制器以实现稳定有效的腿部运动-NVIDIA等
Learning Contact Adaptive Controllers for Stable and Efficient Leg Movement - NVIDIA et al.
英伟达（NVIDIA）联合不列颠哥伦比亚大学（University of British Columbia）、华盛顿大学（Univ. of Washington）、加州理工学院（California Institute of Technology）、得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校（University of Texas at Austin）、多伦多大学（University of Toronto），以宇树科技的Laikago四足机器人运动平台和二次开发平台为基础，设计出一种结合模型控制和强化学习的四足机器人分层运动控制器，控制器由高层控制器和底层控制器组成，高层控制器通过强化学习从机器人步态集合中选择出适应动态变化环境的最优步态，底层控制器通过四足机器人自身运动控制器控制四足机器人执行高层控制器输出的机器人最优步态。该模型可以自学习适应具有挑战性的环境，比如飞行过程的平台，与基线控制器相比能耗低且稳定。并发表题为《Learning a Contact-Adaptive Controller for Robust,Efficient Legged Locomotion》论文，该论文已经发表至CoRL 2020和arXiv.org平台。
NVIDIA, in collaboration with the University of British Columbia, Univ. of Washington, California Institute of Technology, University of Texas at Austin, and University of Toronto, has designed a quadruped robot based on Yushu's Laikago quadruped robot motion platform and a secondary development platform that combines model control and reinforcement learning. University of Texas at Austin, and University of Toronto, to design a hierarchical motion controller for quadruped robots that combines model control and reinforcement learning, based on the Laikago quadruped robot motion platform and a secondary development platform from Yushu Technology. The high-level controller selects the optimal gait from the set of robot gaits to adapt to the dynamically changing environment through reinforcement learning, and the bottom controller controls the quadruped robot to execute the optimal gait output from the high-level controller through the quadruped robot's own motion controller. The model can self-learn to adapt to challenging environments, such as platforms during flight, with low energy consumption and stability compared to the baseline controller. The paper entitled "Learning a Contact-Adaptive Controller for Robust, Efficient Legged Locomotion" has been published on the CoRL 2020 and arXiv.org platforms.
通过四足机器人步态控制的案例探索动态随机化方法的应用-NVIDIA等
Exploring the application of dynamic randomization methods through the case of quadruped robot gait control - NVIDIA et al.
来自英伟达、不列颠哥伦比亚大学和多伦多大学的学者通过在强化学习中（1）使用和不使用（2）什么条件下使用动态随机化方法训练出多种四足机器人步态控制策略，并将仿真策略应用到真实的四足机器人去探索使用动态随机化方法的必要性和可行性。通过实验发现即使不使用动态随机化的方法同样可以生成多种良好的运动控制策略并可以成功应用到真实的四足机器人平台，而使用动态随机性方法反而会对四足机器人运动性能产生一定影响，比如会降低步行的速度；同时通过实验发现在对某些参数使用动态随机化方法会生成良好的运动控制策略。最终得出结论以通过强化学习生成四足机器人运动控制策略为例，使用动态随机化方法有利有弊，需要具体分析造成由仿真策略转化到真实机器人策略失败的具体原因，从而去更好地选择最优的方法。
Scholars from NVIDIA, the University of British Columbia, and the University of Toronto trained multiple quadruped robot gait control strategies by using dynamic randomization methods in reinforcement learning (1) with and without (2) what conditions, and applied the simulation strategies to a real quadruped robot to explore the necessity and feasibility of using dynamic randomization methods. It is found that even without the dynamic randomization method, a variety of good motion control strategies can be generated and successfully applied to a real quadruped robot platform, while using the dynamic randomization method will instead have certain effects on the motion performance of the quadruped robot, such as reducing the walking speed; and it is also found that using the dynamic randomization method for certain parameters will generate good motion control strategy. The final conclusion is that there are advantages and disadvantages of using dynamic randomization methods to generate a quadruped robot motion control strategy through reinforcement learning, for example, and it is necessary to specifically analyze the specific reasons that cause the failure of transforming from simulation strategies to real robot strategies, so as to go for a better choice of the optimal method.

zh_title: 在习得的潜在动作空间中为广义腿部运动进行规划-Facebook& CMU等
en_title: Planning for generalized leg movements in the acquired potential movement space
body:
来自卡内基-梅隆大学机器人研究所和加利福尼亚，门洛帕克市的学者提出了一种更加全面的分层框架，它可以共同学习低级控制器和高层次的潜在行动空间。该框架可以应用在多足机器人身上，并给出在Daisy六足机器人模拟，宇树机器人A1四足机器人模拟上面的模拟结果。通过从文献中比较一系列学习的分层方法后得出：该分层框架体系在多个人物和两个模拟上优于基线。除了分层学习，在A1和Daisy机器人的模拟中该全面框架在不利环境下比IK更有优势。在硬件方面，通过展示Daisy六足机器人在完成目标点到达，轨迹速度追踪等多种位姿任务后。两千多次的硬件样本结果加强了该想法的鲁棒性和样本效率。
Scholars from the Robotics Institute at Carnegie Mellon University and Menlo Park, California, propose a more comprehensive hierarchical framework that co-learns low-level controllers and higher-level potential action spaces. The framework can be applied to multi-legged robots and simulation results are given on top of the Daisy hexapod robot simulation, and the Yuuki robot A1 quadruped robot simulation. After comparing a range of learned hierarchical approaches from the literature it is concluded that this hierarchical framework system outperforms the baseline on multiple characters and two simulations. In addition to layered learning, this comprehensive framework outperforms IK in unfavorable environments in the simulations of A1 and Daisy robots. On the hardware side, the Daisy hexapod robot was demonstrated after completing multiple positional tasks such as target point arrival, trajectory velocity tracking, etc. The results of more than two thousand hardware samples strengthen the robustness and sample efficiency of the idea.

zh_title: 腿部机器人的基于力的自适应控制-美国南加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校
en_title: Force-based Adaptive Control of Legged Robots
zh_inst: 美国南加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校
en_inst: University of Southern California, Los Angeles, USA
body:
美国南加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校，以宇树科技的A1四足机器人平台和二次开发平台为基础，开发设计出一种基于足端力的自适应控制框架。该控制框架将自适应控制融合进二次规划力控当中，自适应控制可以控制不确定的系统模型，极大的提高了四足机器人的鲁棒性。真机测试中A1四足机器人可以负重自身一半的重量的同时实现复杂地面行走运动，静止站立时可以承受自身90%的重量并保持在期望的高度误差内。并在IROS上发表题为《Adaptive Force-based Control for Legged Robots》的论文。
University of Southern California, Los Angeles, USA, developed and designed a foot-end force-based adaptive control framework based on Yushu Technology's A1 quadruped robot platform and secondary development platform. The control framework integrates adaptive control into the secondary planning force control, and the adaptive control can control the uncertain system model, which greatly improves the robustness of the quadruped robot. In real-world tests, the A1 quadruped robot can carry half of its own weight while achieving complex ground walking motion, and can bear 90% of its own weight and stay within the desired height error when standing stationary. The paper entitled "Adaptive Force-based Control for Legged Robots" was published in IROS.

zh_title: 通过学习步态变换快速有效地移动-华盛顿大学&谷歌-梁炜
en_title: Move quickly and efficiently by learning gait changes - University of Washington & Google
body:
美国华盛顿大学和谷歌研究所针对四足机器人控制问题设计了一个分层学习框架，其使用强化学习训练高层的步态策略，低层使用模型预测控制器（MPC）优化电机转矩。他们以宇树A1机器人为硬件平台测试了该分层学习框架，在该测试中机器人的步态在爬行、对角小跑、飞行小跑步态中切换，并且机器人能将其速度提高至2.5m/s(约为5个身体长度/s)。
The University of Washington and Google Research have designed a hierarchical learning framework for the quadruped robot control problem, which uses reinforcement learning to train a high-level gait strategy and a low-level model predictive controller (MPC) to optimize motor torque. They tested the hierarchical learning framework with the Yu Shu A1 robot as a hardware platform, in which the robot's gait switched between crawling, diagonal trot, and flying trot gaits, and the robot was able to increase its speed up to 2.5 m/s (about 5 body lengths/s).
基于分布式力反馈的反射与自适应四足运动控制的在线学习&南航-Poramate Manoonpong
Distributed Force Feedback Based Reflex and Adaptive Quadrupedal Motion Control for Online Learning & SAC-Poramate Manoonpong
生物运动控制机制（例如，中央模式发生器（CPG）、感觉反馈、，反射和运动学习）在动物的适应性运动中起着至关重要的作用。但是,这些机制的相互作用和整合——产生高效、适应性腿型机器人对不同地形的运动反应尚未完全实现。一个问题在于实现自适应运动控制，以便在各种地形上快速适应姿势。为了解决这个问题，该项研究提出了一种新的基于在线反馈的分布式力反馈学习（DFRL）。它集成了力觉反馈、反射和学习与CPG合作在产生自适应电机指令时。DFRL基于一个简单的神经网络，使用由快速双积分学习者在线调节的可塑性突触。该研究使用宇树Laikago机器人和Lilibot进行测试，在不同实验条件下的实验结果表明，DFRL能够自动快速地适应CPG模式命令，使机器人在移动和移动过程中实现适当的身体姿势，使机器人能够有效地适应各种斜坡地形，包括陡坡。因此，DFRL控制的机器人可以实现有效的自适应运动，以解决问题具有不同坡度的复杂地形。
Biological motor control mechanisms (e.g., central pattern generator (CPG), sensory feedback,, reflexes, and motor learning) play a crucial role in adaptive locomotion in animals. However, the interaction and integration of these mechanisms - to produce efficient, adaptive legged robots for locomotor responses to different terrain - has not yet been fully realized. One problem lies in achieving adaptive locomotion control for rapid posture adaptation over a variety of terrain. To address this problem, the study proposes a new online feedback-based distributed force feedback learning (DFRL). It integrates force feedback, reflexes and learning in cooperation with CPG when generating adaptive motor commands.DFRL is based on a simple neural network that uses plastic synapses regulated online by a fast double-integrating learner. The study was tested using the Yuuki Laikago robot and Lilibot, and experimental results under different experimental conditions showed that the DFRL was able to automatically and rapidly adapt to CPG mode commands to enable the robot to achieve proper body posture during movement and mobility, allowing the robot to effectively adapt to a variety of sloped terrain, including steep slopes. Thus, the DFRL-controlled robot can achieve effective adaptive motion to solve problems with complex terrain with different slopes.
视觉运动策略的零镜头地形泛化&Google
Zero-shot terrain generalization for visual motion strategies & Google
腿式机器人在非结构化地形上具有无与伦比的机动性，然而设计一个能在该地形上运动的机器人控制器是一个公认的巨大挑战。Alejandro Escontrela等研究员将这一挑战定义为多任务的强化学习问题，并将每个任务定义为机器人需要穿越的地形类型，同时文中还提出了一种新的程序地形生成算法，该算法能提供丰富的训练数据。在仿真环境中，研究员使用宇树Laikago四足机器人进行测试，测试表明所学习的控制器具有良好的零拍泛化能力，可以导航13个不同的目标环境，包括楼梯、崎岖的土地、杂乱的办公室、和室内空间与人类。下一步他们计划将这项研究推广到真实机器人的运动控制中。
Legged robots have unparalleled maneuverability over unstructured terrain, yet designing a robot controller that can move over that terrain is recognized as a huge challenge.Alejandro Escontrela et al. researchers define this challenge as a multi-task reinforcement learning problem, and define each task as the type of terrain the robot needs to traverse, and the paper also proposes a new algorithm for procedural terrain generation that provides rich training data. In a simulation environment, the researchers used the Yu Shu Laikago quadruped robot for testing, which showed that the learned controller had good zero-beat generalization and could navigate 13 different target environments, including stairs, rugged terrain, cluttered offices, and indoor spaces with humans. As a next step they plan to extend this research to the motion control of real robots.
NeuralSim: Augmenting Differentiable Simulators with Neural Networks-USC&Google
NeuralSim：用神经网络扩充可微分模拟器-南加利福尼亚大学&谷歌

zh_title: 南加利福尼亚大学和谷歌通过神经网络研究了一种新型可微刚体物理引擎的增强，该引擎能够学习动态量之间的非线性关系，从而可以对传统模拟器中未考虑的效应进行建模。与完全数据驱动的模型相比，这种增强需要更少的数据来更好地训练和泛化。研究人员通过在宇树Laikago模拟器和宇树A1真机上做了大量实验验证了插入神经网络不仅有利于动力学建模，还可以加速基于模型的控制架构，能够显着改善控制延迟。实验的代码、视频等公布在了项目网站上：https://sites.google.com/usc.edu/neuralsim。
en_title: NeuralSim: Expanding Differentiable Simulators with Neural Networks
body:
The University of Southern California and Google have investigated an enhancement of a new micro-rigidizable physics engine via neural networks that learns nonlinear relationships between dynamic quantities, allowing modeling of effects not considered in traditional simulators. This enhancement requires less data for better training and generalization than a fully data-driven model. The researchers verified by doing extensive experiments on the Yu Shu Laikago simulator and the Yu Shu A1 real machine that inserting neural networks not only facilitates dynamics modeling, but also accelerates model-based control architectures and can significantly improve control latency. The code and videos of the experiments are posted on the project website: https://sites.google.com/usc.edu/neuralsim.
From Pixels to Legs: Hierarchical Learning of Quadruped Locomotion-Google
从像素到腿：四足运动的分层学习-谷歌

zh_title: 来自谷歌的学者提出了让机器人通过通过分层强化学习（HRL）获得在现实世界中拥挤场景和复杂地形的运动控制，同时处理视觉输入以进行避障和路径规划的技能。他们的策略凭借其层次结构，通过同时学习高级 (HL) 和低级 (LL) 神经网络策略来隐式地分解这个联合问题，HL和LL通过一个被称为潜在命令的低维隐藏层连接，HL接收摄像机视图，而LL接收来自HL和机器人传感器的潜在命令以控制其执行器。他们通过在弯曲的悬崖和迷宫中训练宇树Laikago，验证了分层策略可以同时学习在这些环境中定位和导航，并表明它们比非分层神经网络策略更有效。该架构还允许跨任务重用知识。
en_title: From pixels to legs: hierarchical learning for quadrupedal locomotion
body:
Scholars from Google propose to allow robots to acquire the skills to control motion in real-world crowded scenes and complex terrain by means of hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL), while processing visual input for obstacle avoidance and path planning. Their strategy implicitly decomposes this joint problem by virtue of its hierarchical structure by learning both high-level (HL) and low-level (LL) neural network strategies, with HL and LL connected by a low-dimensional hidden layer called latent commands, with HL receiving camera views and LL receiving latent commands from HL and robot sensors to control its actuators. They verified that hierarchical strategies can learn to simultaneously localize and navigate in these environments by training the Yu-tree Laikago in curved cliffs and mazes, and showed that they are more effective than non-hierarchical neural network strategies. The architecture also allows for cross-task reuse of knowledge.
SimGAN: Hybrid simulator identification for domain adaptation via adversarial RL-Google
SimGAN: 通过对抗性强化学习进行域适应的混合模拟器识别-谷歌

zh_title: 本文介绍了 SimGAN，这是一种通过识别混合物理模拟器来将模拟轨迹与目标域中的轨迹相匹配来解决域适应的框架，使用学习的判别性损失来解决与手动损失设计相关的限制。文中的混合模拟器结合了神经网络和传统物理模拟，以平衡表现力和通用性，并减少了在 System ID 中精心选择参数集的需要。通过对抗性强化学习识别出混合模拟器，它就可以用于细化目标域的策略，而无需交替进行数据收集和策略细化。学者通过宇树Laikago模拟器做了大量实验，实验表明，该方法在域适应的六个机器人运动任务上优于多个参照物。
en_title: From pixels to legs: hierarchical learning for quadrupedal locomotion

zh_title: Learning 用于稳健、高效的腿式运动的接触自适应控制器-NVDIA等（狗狗滑板车）
en_title: Learning Contact Adaptive Controller for Robust, Efficient Legged Movement
body:
哥伦比亚大学、华盛顿大学、多伦多大学的学者联合NVIDIA工作者提出了一个分层框架，结合基于模型控制和强化学习为Unitree Laikago合成鲁棒控制器。该框架学习自适应地实时改变接触序列，高级控制器接受强化训练学习来指定脚的接触配置，然后由低级控制器将其作为输入，通过二次规划 (QP) 生成地面反作用力.在推理时间内,高级控制器只需要评估一个小的多层神经网络，避免了使用昂贵的模型预测控制 (MPC) 策略，否则可能需要优化长期性能. 通过Laikago 演示该框架在各种具有挑战性的场景中四足行走，例如在分带式跑步机上行走侧移或踩到“香蕉皮”上.验证了物理机器人上的控制器,从模拟到真实环境的便捷性。
Scholars at Columbia University, the University of Washington, and the University of Toronto, in conjunction with NVIDIA workers, have proposed a hierarchical framework that combines model-based control and reinforcement learning to synthesize a robust controller for Unitree Laikago. The framework learns to adaptively change the contact sequence in real time, with the high-level controller receiving reinforcement training to learn to specify the foot contact configuration, which is then used as input by the low-level controller to generate ground reaction forces via quadratic programming (QP). During the inference time, the high-level controller only needs to evaluate a small multilayer neural network, avoiding the use of expensive Model Predictive Control (MPC) strategies that might otherwise be required to optimize long-term performance. The framework was demonstrated by Laikago for quadrupedal walking in a variety of challenging scenarios, such as walking sideways on a belt-split treadmill or stepping on a "banana peel". Validated the ease of moving from simulation to real environments with controllers on physical robots.
RMA：腿式机器人的快速运动适应
RMA: Rapid Motion Adaptation for Legged Robots
卡内基·梅隆大学和伯克利大学学者提出了一种基于RMA算法来解决四足机器人的实时在线自适应问题RMA 由两个组件组成：基本策略和适配模块.这些组件的组合使机器人能够在几分之一秒内适应新情况.RMA 在不使用任何领域知识（如参考轨迹或预定义的足部轨迹生成器）的情况下完全在模拟中训练，并且部署在 A1 机器人上，无需任何微调.他们使用受生物能量学启发的奖励在各种地形生成器上训练 RMA，并将其部署在比较复杂的地形，包括岩石、湿滑、易变形的表面，在有草、长植被、混凝土、鹅卵石的环境中如楼梯、沙子等。 RMA 展示了最先进的性能 各种真实世界以及模拟实验。
Scholars at Carnegie Mellon University and Berkeley University have proposed an RMA-based algorithm to solve the real-time online adaptive problem for quadruped robots RMA consists of two components: a basic strategy and an adaptation module. The combination of these components allows the robot to adapt to new situations in fractions of a second.RMA is trained entirely in simulation without using any domain knowledge (e.g., reference trajectories or predefined foot trajectory generators) and is deployed on the A1 robot without any fine-tuning. They trained RMA on various terrain generators using bioenergetics-inspired rewards and deployed it on more complex terrain including rocky, slippery, deformable surfaces, in environments with grass, long vegetation, concrete, cobblestones such as stairs, sand, etc. RMA demonstrates state-of-the-art performance Various real-world as well as simulated experiments.
学习适用于不同环境的视觉运动策略
Learn visuomotor strategies for different environments
佐治亚理工学院以及谷歌机器人实验室的学者解决了学习运动控制器的问题，这些控制器可以推广到现实世界中常见的各种地形，并且在宇树科技的Laikago四足机器人运动平台和二次开发平台基础上提出了一种end-to-end 的视觉移动策略以实现高泛化性能表现。这种策略学习可以使腿式机器人能够在现实生活中的许多地形上进行导航，包括楼梯、崎岖的土地、障碍物、办公室等等，所有这些都不需要人工的视觉预输入。
Scholars at Georgia Tech and Google Robotics Lab have addressed the problem of learning motion controllers that can be generalized to a variety of terrains commonly found in the real world, and have proposed an end-to-end visual movement strategy for high generalization performance performance based on Yu Shu Technology's Laikago quadruped robot motion platform and secondary development platform. This strategy learning enables legged robots to navigate over many real-life terrains, including stairs, rugged terrain, obstacles, offices, etc., all without manual visual pre-input.
保护性政策转移
Protective policy transfer
来自于谷歌机器人实验室，斯坦福大学，佐治亚理工大学的学者以宇树科技的A1机器人仿真作为研究平台，通过训练，优化任务奖励的任务策略，保护机器人形成不安全状态的策略，以及用于评估安全级别的安全评估模型机器人等三个模型提出了一种用于有意识地使控制策略适应新场景的转移学习算法，同时最大限度地减少了机器人的潜在损害.他们在DART仿真环境中使用unitree提供的A1模型，通过给每个电机引入功率限制，测试在该算法下仿真和训练的差异性。
Using Google Robotics Lab, Stanford University, and Georgia Tech's A1 robot simulation as a research platform, scholars from Yushu Technology propose a transfer model for consciously adapting control policies to new scenarios by training three models: a task strategy to optimize task rewards, a strategy to protect the robot from forming unsafe states, and a safety assessment model robot to evaluate safety levels. learning algorithm while minimizing the potential damage to the robot. They use the A1 model provided by unitree in a DART simulation environment to test the difference between simulation and training under this algorithm by introducing a power limit to each motor.
使用运动匹配和基于模型的控制在四足机器人上的动物步态-ETH
Animal gait using motion matching and model-based control on a quadruped robot-ETH
ETH结合了基于模型的控制器和计算机动画中常用的数据驱动技术提出了能为腿式机器人生产类似动物行走动作的控制方法。特别的是，该方法还能自动重新动物动作的关键特征，包括特定速度的步态、非周期性运动的无脚本脚步模态，以及整体身体运动的自然微小变化。ETH使用宇树Aliengo机器人在仿真器中进行实验。同时文中提出该方法能非常有效地实时运行，并且能很好地结合MPC-WBC控制方法。
ETH combines model-based controllers and data-driven techniques commonly used in computer animation to propose control methods capable of producing animal-like walking motions for legged robots. In particular, the method is also able to automatically re-create key features of animal movements, including gait patterns for specific speeds, unscripted foot patterns for non-periodic movements, and natural small changes in overall body motion. eth uses the Yuuki Aliengo robot for experiments in a simulator. It is also proposed in the paper that the method can run very efficiently in real time and is well integrated with MPC-WBC control methods.
四足机器人的感知自主爬楼梯-南方科技大学
Perceptual Autonomous Stair Climbing for Quadrupedal Robots-University of Science and Technology South
本文研究了具有感知能力的四足机器人的自主爬楼梯。随着硬件设计技术和运动控制器的快速进步，四足机器人的运动技能得到了显着提升，在处理某些崎岖地形方面表现出令人印象深刻的能力。使四足动物能够可靠地爬楼梯，极大地扩展了其在实际场景中的适用性。学者为自主四足爬楼梯开发了一个简单而有效的感知和控制框架。该框架通过利用楼梯的结构知识，首先从感知系统的测量中提取楼梯的几何信息，然后根据楼梯的几何信息，通过简单的优化算法生成爬楼梯过程中的爬升速度和相关的立足点参考，使用基于模型预测控制的方法来生成输入关节扭矩，以控制四足动物完成整个爬楼梯任务。通过宇树Aliengo在不同的真实的楼梯上进行硬件实验，进一步验证了所提出策略的有效性。
This paper investigates autonomous stair climbing by a quadrupedal robot with sensory capabilities. With rapid advances in hardware design techniques and motion controllers, the locomotor skills of quadrupedal robots have been significantly improved, showing impressive capabilities in handling certain rugged terrains. Enabling quadrupeds to reliably climb stairs has greatly expanded their applicability in real-world scenarios. Scholars have developed a simple and effective perception and control framework for autonomous quadrupedal stair climbing. The framework uses knowledge of the structure of the stairs to first extract the geometric information of the stairs from the measurements of the perception system, then generates the climbing speed and the associated foothold reference during stair climbing by a simple optimization algorithm based on the geometric information of the stairs, and uses a model-based predictive control approach to generate the input joint torques to control the quadruped through the entire stair climbing task. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is further validated by hardware experiments on different real staircases with the Yu Shu Aliengo.
使用进化轨迹生成器进行强化学习：四足运动的一般方法-港中文，百度，南科大，港中文深圳研究院Reinforcement learning using evolutionary trajectory generators: a general approach to quadrupedal locomotion - HKCS, Baidu, SUSTech, HKCS Shenzhen Research Institute
百度强化学习团队联合小度机器人团队提出了一个全新的强化学习框架，该框架利用自进化步态生成器引导四足机器人进行强化学习训练，使其通过自主学习，最终获得了穿越各种高难度场景的能力。该框架算法的控制信号由两部分组成：一个开环的步态生成器以及基于强化学习的神经网络。步态生成器可以提供步态先验来引导强化学习进行训练，强化学习部分的策略网络需要输出合理的控制信号去结合开环的控制信号，以获得更高的奖励。最终，该团队使用宇树A1机器人验证通过了9 个实验场景，包括了上下楼梯、斜坡、穿越不规整地形、独木板、洞穴、跳跃隔板等场景。结果显示，该算法效果与经典的开环控制器、强化学习算法相比，提升相当大。
The Baidu reinforcement learning team, in conjunction with the Xiaodu robotics team, has proposed a new reinforcement learning framework that uses a self-evolving gait generator to guide a quadruped robot through reinforcement learning training, enabling it to eventually gain the ability to traverse a variety of difficult scenarios through autonomous learning. The control signal of the framework algorithm consists of two parts: an open-loop gait generator and a reinforcement learning-based neural network. The gait generator provides a gait prior to guide the reinforcement learning for training, and the reinforcement learning part of the policy network needs to output a reasonable control signal to combine with the open-loop control signal to obtain a higher reward. Finally, the team validated nine experimental scenarios using the Yu Shu A1 robot, including scenarios of going up and down stairs, slopes, traversing unruly terrain, lone planks, caves, and jumping bulkheads. The results show that the algorithm's effectiveness is quite improved compared to the classic open-loop controller and reinforcement learning algorithms.
学习在户外环境中在人行道上导航
Learning to Navigate Sidewalks in Outdoor Environments
城市环境中人行道上的户外导航是重要的人类辅助应用背后的关键技术，例如最后一英里交付或邻里巡逻。佐治亚理工学院，谷歌和斯坦福大学的研究人员设计了一个学习框架，首先在具有特征信息的抽象世界中训练教师代理，然后通过行为克隆将技能教授给可以访问真实传感器的学生代理。本文的主要研究工作集中在给现实世界中的四足机器人上部署学生策略时克服挑战。研究人员提出了用于设计传感模式、网络架构和训练程序的方法，以实现零样本策略转移到非结构化和动态的真实室外环境，并在宇树AlienGo四足机器人上应用，使其在美国亚特兰大市在人行道上在有限数量的人工干预下步行了 3.2 公里。
Outdoor navigation on sidewalks in urban environments is the key technology behind important human-assisted applications, such as last-mile delivery or neighborhood patrol. Researchers at Georgia Tech, Google and Stanford University have designed a learning framework that first trains teacher agents in an abstract world with feature information and then teaches skills to student agents with access to real sensors via behavioral cloning. The main research effort in this paper focuses on overcoming challenges when deploying student strategies on a real-world quadruped robot. The researchers propose methods for designing sensing patterns, network architectures, and training procedures to enable zero-sample strategy transfer to unstructured and dynamic real outdoor environments, and apply them on the Yu Shu AlienGo quadruped robot, enabling it to walk 3.2 km on sidewalks with a limited amount of human intervention in Atlanta, GA.

视觉运动：学习用视觉在复杂地形上行走
Visual-Locomotion Learning to Walk on Complex Terrains with Vision
视觉是有腿机器人安全有效地在不平坦地形（例如楼梯）上导航的基本感知方式之一。 然而，训练机器人有效理解运动的高维视觉输入是一个具有挑战性的问题。 在这项工作中，他们提出了一个框架来训练基于视觉的运动控制器，使四足机器人能够穿越不平坦的环境。 关键思想是引入具有高级视觉策略和低级运动控制器的层次结构。 高级视觉策略将感知到的视觉信号和机器人状态作为输入，并输出机器人所需的立足点和基本运动。 然后这些由低级运动控制器实现，该控制器由摆动腿的位置控制器和基于 MPC 的支撑腿扭矩控制器组成。使用深度强化学习训练视觉策略，并在各种不平坦的环境（例如随机放置的梅花桩、楼梯和移动平台）上展示此方法。同时还在真实的四足机器人上验证了此方法，以走过一系列间隙并爬上平台。
Vision is one of the fundamental perception modalities for legged robots to safely and efficiently navigate uneven terrain such as stairs. However, training robots to effectively understand motion from high-dimensional visual inputs is a challenging problem. In this work, they propose a framework to train vision-based motion controllers to enable quadruped robots to traverse uneven environments. The key idea is to introduce a hierarchy with a high-level vision policy and a low-level motion controller. A high-level vision policy takes as input the perceived visual signal and robot state, and outputs the robot's desired footholds and basic motions. These are then implemented by a low-level motion controller consisting of a position controller for the swing leg and an MPC-based torque controller for the support leg. We train a vision policy using deep reinforcement learning and demonstrate this approach on a variety of uneven environments such as randomly placed plum piles, stairs, and moving platforms. The method is also validated on a real quadruped robot to walk across a series of gaps and climb up platforms.
使用运动库在离散地形上进行视觉辅助动态四足运动
Vision-aided Dynamic Quadrupedal Locomotion on Discrete Terrain using Motion Libraries
对于四足机器人来说，在未知离散地形上行走是一个巨大的挑战。伯克利大学的研究员基于宇树科技A1四足机器狗利用视觉反馈方法同时结合步态运动库提出了一个应对该挑战的工程。在工程中介绍了一种生成小跑步态运动库的方法，该步态运动库可实现不同步长的足端放置。建立步态运动库后即可通过查询满足环境落足点约束来获取步态变量，进而进行下一步的优化力控。实时的落足点约束需要利用A1机器人前部的摄像头构建地图来获得。此外还需要利用EKF算法实现A1机器人在地图中的定位进而计算约束，其中算法中的二进制足端接触信息来自A1机器人的四个足端传感器。
Walking over unknown discrete terrain is a huge challenge for quadruped robots. Researchers at Berkeley have proposed a project to address this challenge based on the Unitree Technology A1 quadruped robot dog using a visual feedback approach combined with a gait motion library. The project introduces a method for generating a trotting gait-motion library that allows for the placement of foot-ends with different step lengths. Once the gait motion library is created, the gait variables can be obtained by querying the environment to satisfy the footfall point constraints, and then the next step is taken to optimize the force control. The real-time footfall constraints are obtained by constructing a map using the camera in the front of the A1 robot.

不平坦地形导航的轮腿机器人平衡控制与姿态优化
Balancing Control and Pose Optimization for Wheel-legged Robots Navigating Uneven Terrains
Scholars from the University of Southern California propose a rigid body available for real-time balancing of wheel dynamics using posture optimization for controlling wheel-legged quadruped robots, and they perform force control via quadratic programming (QP), allowing the robot to use wheel torque to maintain wheel traction while traveling over complex terrain. In addition, they introduce an effective wheel-legged robot pose optimization method to move over uneven terrain with ramps and stairs.
来自南加州大学的学者提出了一种可用于实时平衡车轮动力学的刚体，使用姿势优化来控制轮脚四足机器人，他们通过二次编程（QP）进行力控制，使机器人在复杂地形上行驶时使用车轮扭矩来保持车轮牵引力。此外，他们还介绍了一种有效的轮腿机器人姿势优化方法，以在有坡道和楼梯的不平坦地形上移动。

视障人士四足引导机器人-哈工大深圳&清华大学深圳&南方科技大学
Quadruped Guidance Robot for the Visually Impaired
Scholars from Tsinghua University, Harbin Institute of Technology and Southern University of Science and Technology conducted research on robotic guide dogs based on Unitree's Laikago hardware platform. Starting from the fact that traditional guidance systems do not sufficiently consider human response behavior and comfort, they propose a guidance robot system based on the concept of comfort. The system has been deployed on the Unitree Laikago quadruped platform and validated in real-world scenarios.
来自清华大学、哈尔滨工业大学和南方科技大学的学者们在Unitree的Laikago硬件平台上进行了机器人导盲犬的研究。从传统的导引系统没有充分考虑人类的反应行为和舒适度出发，他们提出了一个基于舒适度概念的导引机器人系统。该系统已经部署在Unitree Laikago四足平台上，并在现实世界的场景中得到验证。

对抗性运动先验可以很好地替代复杂的奖励函数-谷歌&UC伯克利
Adversarial Motion Priors Make Good Substitutes for Complex Reward Functions
Scholars from UC Berkeley have proposed a "style reward" alternative to complex reward functions, which can be extracted from the dataset of motion capture demonstrations. Style rewards can be combined with arbitrary task reward functions to train strategies for performing tasks using natural strategies. These strategies enable the transfer of the robot from simulation to the real world. They encode style rewards from a reference motion dataset - to demonstrate that adversarial methods to training strategies can produce behaviors that transfer to a real quadruped robot without the need for complex reward functions. They also demonstrate that an effective style reward can collect a few seconds of motion capture data from a German Shepherd, leading to a natural gait transition for an energy-efficient locomotor strategy.
来自加州大学伯克利分校的学者们提出了一种可替代复杂奖励函数的 "风格奖励"，它可以从运动捕捉演示的数据集中提取。风格奖励可以与任意的任务奖励函数相结合，训练使用自然策略执行任务的策略。这些策略使机器人能够从模拟中转移到现实世界中。他们对来自参考运动数据集的风格奖励进行编码--证明训练策略的对抗性方法可以产生转移到真正的四足机器人上的行为，而不需要复杂的奖励函数。他们还证明，有效的风格奖励可以从德国牧羊犬身上收集几秒钟的运动捕捉数据，从而产生一个自然的步态过渡，以达到节能的运动策略。

空想家-物理机器人学习的世界模型-UC伯克利
DayDreamer-World Models for Physical Robot Learning
Learning to walk in an hour, rolling over in 10 minutes, the World Model allows robots to quickly master multiple skills
Teaching robots to solve complex tasks in the real world has been a fundamental problem in robotics research. Deep reinforcement learning provides a popular approach to robot learning, allowing robots to improve their behavior through iterative trials. However, current algorithms require too much interaction with the environment to learn successfully, which makes them inappropriate for certain real-world tasks.

来自卡内基梅隆大学的学者们提出了 SLoMo：一个首创的框架，用于将随意捕捉的人类和动物视频片段中的熟练动作转移到有腿机器人上。 SLoMo 分三个阶段工作：1）从单目视频合成物理上合理的重建关键点轨迹； 2）离线优化机器人的动态可行参考轨迹，包括身体和足部运动，以及紧密跟踪关键点的接触序列； 3）使用机器人硬件上的通用模型预测控制器在线跟踪参考轨迹。腿部运动技能的传统动作模仿通常需要专业动画师、协作演示和/或昂贵的动作捕捉设备，所有这些都限制了可扩展性。相反，SLoMo 仅依赖于易于获取的单眼视频片段，这些视频片段可以在 YouTube 等在线存储库中轻松获得。它将视频转换为可由现实世界的机器人可靠执行的运动基元。 学者们通过将猫、狗和人类的运动转移到示例机器人来演示这个方法，包括四足动物（在硬件上）和人形机器人（在模拟中）。 这是通用运动传输框架的首次尝试，该框架直接从休闲视频中模仿有腿机器人上的动物和人类运动，无需进行人工标记。
Academics from Carnegie Mellon University present SLoMo: a first-of-its-kind framework for transferring skilled movements from randomly captured human and animal video clips to legged robots. SLoMo works in three stages: 1) physically plausible reconstruction of keypoint trajectories from monocular video synthesis; 2) offline optimization of the robot's dynamically feasible reference trajectories, including body and foot motion, and contact sequences that closely track keypoints; 3) Online tracking of reference trajectories using a generic model predictive controller on the robot hardware. Traditional motion-based imitation of leg-motor skills typically requires specialized animators, collaborative demonstrations, and/or expensive motion capture equipment, all of which limit scalability. Instead, SLoMo relies only on readily available monocular video clips, which are readily available in online repositories such as YouTube. It converts video into motion primitives that can be reliably performed by real-world robots. The academics demonstrate the method by transferring the motion of cats, dogs, and humans to example robots, including quadrupeds (in hardware) and humanoid robots (in simulation). This is the first attempt at a general motion transfer framework that imitates animal and human motion on legged robots directly from casual videos without manual labeling.
83.Learning Robust and Agile Legged Locomotion Using Adversarial Motion Priors
使用对抗性运动先验学习稳健且敏捷的腿部运动
来自上海交通大学、大连大学以及大连理工大学的学者们提出了第一个盲运动系统，为腿式机器人开发强大而敏捷的运动技能，使其能够稳健地穿越具有挑战性的地形，同时在自然地形上快速移动。他们的方法在运动策略训练中结合了对抗性运动先验（AMP），并演示了从平坦地形上的运动数据集到现实世界中具有挑战性的地形的零样本泛化。学者们在仅使用由IMU关节编码器组成的本体感觉传感器的四足机器人 Go1 上展示了这一结果。 在Go1 上的实验证明了他们所提出的方法可以生成稳健且自然的运动，可以用于穿越具有挑战性的地形，同时也可以在自然地形上快速移动。
Scholars from Shanghai Jiaotong University, Dalian University, and Dalian University of Technology proposed the first blind locomotion system to develop powerful and agile motor skills for legged robots, enabling them to robustly traverse challenging terrain while Move quickly over terrain. Their approach incorporates an adversarial motion prior (AMP) in motion policy training and demonstrates zero-shot generalization from motion datasets on flat terrain to challenging real-world terrain. Scholars demonstrated this result on a quadruped robot Go1 using only proprioceptive sensors consisting of IMU joint encoders. Experiments on Go1 demonstrate that their proposed method can generate robust and natural motion, which can be used to traverse challenging terrain, while also being fast on natural terrain.

84.Neural Volumetric Memory for Visual Locomotion Control
视觉运动控制的神经体积记忆
来自加州大学和麻省理工学院的学者们使用单个前向深度相机让有腿机器人在挑战性的地形上移动。由于问题的部分可观测性，机器人必须依靠过去的观测来推断当前下方的地形。为了解决这个问题，学者们遵循计算机视觉中的范例，对场景的3D几何进行显式建模，并提出神经体积记忆 (NVM)。这是一种显式解释 3D 世界的 SE(3) 等方差的几何记忆架构。 NVM 首先将来自多个摄像机视图的特征量带回到机器人以自我为中心的框架中，从而聚合这些特征量。他们在物理机器人上测试了学习到的视觉运动策略，并表明所提出的方法在训练期间明确引入了几何先验，能够提供更优越的性能。同时学者们还包括消融研究，并表明存储在神经体积存储器中的表示捕获足够的几何信息来重建场景。
Scholars from the University of California and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology used a single forward-depth camera to allow the legged robot to move over challenging terrain. Due to the partially observable nature of the problem, the robot must rely on past observations to infer the current terrain below. To solve this problem, the scholars followed the paradigm in computer vision of explicitly modelling the 3D geometry of a scene and proposed Neural Volume Memory (NVM). This is a geometric memory architecture that explicitly interprets the SE(3) isovariance of the 3D world. The NVM first aggregates feature volumes from multiple camera views by bringing them back into the robot's self-centred frame. They test the learned visuomotor strategies on a physical robot and show that the proposed approach provides superior performance by explicitly introducing geometric priors during training. Also the scholars include ablation studies and show that representations stored in neural volume memory capture enough geometric information to reconstruct the scene.
85.Adaptive Force-Based Control of Dynamic Legged Locomotion over Uneven Terrain
不平坦地形上动态腿式运动的自适应力控制
来自南加州大学的学者们提出了一种将自适应控制纳入基于力的控制系统的新颖方法，使得腿式机器人能够在执行高度动态运动的同时适应显着的模型不确定性。腿式机器人在复杂和具有挑战性的环境（包括灾区和工业环境）中导航和执行任务时非常有效。然而，这些应用通常需要在能够承载重负载的同时保持动态运动。
学者们的方法已经在Unitree A1机器人上成功进行了实验验证。通过这种方法，机器人可以承载重物（高达其重量的50%），同时执行动态步态，例如在不平坦的地形上快速小跑和跳跃。
Scholars from the University of Southern California have proposed a novel approach to incorporating adaptive control into force-based control systems, enabling legged robots to adapt to significant model uncertainty while executing highly dynamic motions. Legged robots are effective when navigating and performing tasks in complex and challenging environments, including disaster areas and industrial settings. However, these applications often require the ability to carry heavy loads while maintaining dynamic motion.
The academics' approach has been successfully validated experimentally on the Unitree A1 robot. With this approach, the robot can carry heavy loads (up to 50 per cent of its weight) while executing dynamic gaits such as fast trotting and jumping on uneven terrain.
86.Vision-Based Reactive Temporal Logic Motion Planning for Quadruped Robots in Unstructured Dynamic Environments
非结构化动态环境中四足机器人基于视觉的反应时间逻辑运动规划
来自中国科学技术大学、加州大学、蒙特利尔康考迪亚大学以及台州智能制造学院和的学者们提出了一个基于视觉的反应时间逻辑运动规划（V-RTLMP）框架。这个框架用于令与激光雷达传感集成的机器人在在非结构化动态环境中执行高级线性时序逻辑 (LTL) 任务。该框架由两个模块组成：离线预规划和在线反应性规划。如果给定了LTL规范，预规划阶段会生成连续的参考轨迹，使用先前的环境知识，通过基于采样的方法来确定工作空间。在线反应模块根据实时视觉感知动态调整机器人轨迹，以适应环境变化。学者们使用了四足机器人进行的广泛数值模拟和实际实验，证明了他们所提出的基于视觉的反应运动规划的有效性。
Scholars from University of Science and Technology of China, University of California, Concordia University in Montreal, and Taizhou Institute of Intelligent Manufacturing proposed a vision-based reaction-time logical motion planning (V-RTLMP) framework. This framework is used to enable robots integrated with lidar sensing to perform high-level linear temporal logic (LTL) tasks in unstructured dynamic environments. The framework consists of two modules: offline pre-planning and online reactive planning. Given an LTL specification, the pre-planning phase generates continuous reference trajectories, using prior knowledge of the environment to determine the workspace via a sampling-based approach. The online response module dynamically adjusts the trajectory of the robot based on real-time visual perception to adapt to environmental changes. The scholars demonstrate the effectiveness of their proposed vision-based reactive motion planning using extensive numerical simulations and real-world experiments using quadruped robots.
87.Performance and Usability Evaluation Scheme for Mobile Manipulator Teleoperation
移动机械臂遥操作性能及可用性评估方案
来自英国利兹大学和英国伦敦大学的学者们提出了一种用于移动机械手的标准化人机远程操作接口（HRTI）评估方案。这个方案包括一组机器人运动测试、客观测量、主观测量和预测模型，以提供综合评估的依据。运动测试包括运动、操纵和组合测试。每次试验的持续时间被收集为客观测量中的响应变量。统计工具（包括平均值、标准差和 T 检验）用于不同预测变量之间的交叉比较。该预测模型基于扩展的菲茨定律，采用时间和任务难度指数来预测未来任务中的系统性能。主观测量利用 NASA 任务负载指数和系统可用性量表来评估工作负载和可用性。最后，所提出的方案在现实世界的四足机械臂上实现，该机械臂具有两个广泛使用的 HRTI、游戏手柄和可穿戴运动捕捉系统。
Scholars from the University of Leeds and the University of London proposed a standardized human-machine teleoperation interface (HRTI) evaluation scheme for mobile manipulators. This protocol includes a battery of robot motion tests, objective measurements, subjective measurements, and predictive models to provide a basis for comprehensive evaluation. Motor testing includes locomotor, manipulation, and combination tests. The duration of each trial was collected as a response variable in the objective measure. Statistical tools, including means, standard deviations, and t-tests, are used for cross-comparisons between different predictors. The predictive model is based on an extended Fitts' law, using time and task difficulty indices to predict system performance on future tasks. Subjective measurements utilize the NASA Mission Load Index and System Availability Scale to assess workload and availability. Finally, the proposed scheme is implemented on a real-world quadruped robotic arm with two widely used HRTIs, a gamepad, and a wearable motion capture system.

四足动物运动的仿生步态转换
来自英国利兹大学和哈尔滨工业大学的学者们利用弗劳德数（表征不同体型的四足动物改变步态的速度的参数），设计了一种仿生步态转换方法。对于成功的步态转换，稳定性和合适的速度对于保持效率至关重要。学者们通过制定一组取决于弗劳德数的控制方程，生成稳定的步态转换。 同时他们进行了一系列模拟以确定各种步态的最佳弗劳德数范围，并通过将其应用于四个不同的四足动物来验证该方法的通用性。 为了评估步态转换的性能，学者们进行了一系列硬件实验，演示了各种步态转换，将所提出的转换方法与现有替代方法进行比较并测试其通用性。
Scholars from the University of Leeds and Harbin Institute of Technology designed a bionic gait conversion method using the Froude number (a parameter that characterizes the speed at which quadrupeds of different sizes change their gait). For a successful gait transition, stability and proper speed are critical to maintaining efficiency. Scholars generate stable gait transitions by formulating a set of governing equations that depend on the Froude number. At the same time, they performed a series of simulations to determine the optimal Froude number range for various gaits, and verified the generality of the method by applying it to four different quadrupeds. To evaluate the performance of gait transitions, the scholars conducted a series of hardware experiments demonstrating various gait transitions, comparing the proposed transition method with existing alternatives and testing its generalizability.
89.Recognition and Estimation of Human FingerPointing with an RGB Camera for Robot Directive
使用 RGB 摄像头进行机器人指令的人类手指点识别和估计
在人与人之间的交流中，手势通常是言语表达的首选或补充，因为前者提供了更好的空间参考。手指指向手势传达了有关环境中某些兴趣点的重要信息。 例如在搜索和救援或工厂援助的人机交互中，用户可以轻松地将机器人引导到目标位置。来自以色列特拉维夫大学的学者们探索了机器人模型的学习，以仅基于单个 RGB 摄像头来理解各种室内和室外环境中的指向指令。学者们提出了一种新颖的框架，其中包括称为 PointingNet 的指定模型。PointingNet可以识别指向的发生，近似食指的位置和方向。该模型依赖于一种新颖的分割模型来掩盖举起的手臂。 虽然最先进的人体姿势估计模型提供的指向角度估计精度很差，为 28 度，但 PointingNet 的平均精度不到 2 度。 学者们利用指向信息来计算目标，然后进行对机器人的规划和运动。学者们将框架在两个机器人系统上进行了评估，并且实现了准确的目标到达。
In human-to-human communication, gestures are often preferred or supplemented by verbal expressions, since the former provide a better spatial reference. Finger pointing gestures convey important information about certain points of interest in the environment. For example in human-robot interaction for search and rescue or factory assistance, the user can easily guide the robot to the target location. Academics from Tel Aviv University in Israel explored the learning of robotic models to understand pointing commands in a variety of indoor and outdoor environments based on only a single RGB camera. Scholars propose a novel framework that includes a specified model called PointingNet. PointingNet can recognize the occurrence of pointing, approximating the position and orientation of the index finger. The model relies on a novel segmentation model to mask raised arms. While the state-of-the-art human pose estimation model provides poor pointing angle estimation accuracy of 28 degrees, PointingNet achieves an average accuracy of less than 2 degrees. Scholars use pointing information to calculate the target, and then plan and move the robot. Scholars evaluated the framework on two robotic systems and achieved accurate goal reaching.
90.RL + Model-based Control: Using On-demand Optimal Control to Learn Versatile Legged Locomotion
RL + 基于模型的控制：使用按需最优控制来学习多功能腿式运动
来自苏黎世联邦理工学院的学者们提出了一个控制框架，它将基于模型的最优控制和强化学习（RL）相结合，以实现多功能且稳健的腿式运动。学者们的方法通过结合有限视野的最优控制生成，按需参考运动来增强强化学习训练过程，其中也涵盖了广泛的速度和步态。 这些参考动作可以作为强化学习策略模仿的目标，从而开发出可以可靠学习的鲁棒控制策略。此外，学者们通过利用捕获全身动态的真实模拟数据，有效地克服了建模简化所带来的参考运动的固有限制。在一系列实验验证中，此方法展示了其泛化参考运动并有效处理更复杂的运动任务的能力。 此外，学者们提出的这个框架可以轻而易举地支持不同维度的机器人控制策略的训练，同时也消除了奖励函数和超参数中针对机器人的调整的必要性。
Scholars from ETH Zurich have proposed a control framework that combines model-based optimal control and reinforcement learning (RL) for versatile and robust legged locomotion. The scholars' approach enhances the reinforcement learning training process by combining optimal control generation with a limited field of view, on-demand reference movements, which also cover a wide range of speeds and gaits. These reference movements can be used as targets for imitation by reinforcement learning strategies, leading to the development of robust control strategies that can be reliably learnt. In addition, the scholars have effectively overcome the inherent limitations of the reference motions imposed by the modelling simplifications by utilising realistic simulation data that captures the dynamics of the whole body. In a series of experimental validations, this approach demonstrates its ability to generalise the reference motion and effectively handle more complex motion tasks. In addition, this framework proposed by the scholars can easily support the training of robot control strategies of different dimensions, while eliminating the need for robot-specific tuning in reward functions and hyperparameters.
91.Robot Parkour Learning
机器人跑酷学习
跑酷这项运动需要机器人在复杂的环境中快速克服各种障碍。然而，自主跑酷需要机器人学习基于视觉和多样化的通用技能，以感知和应对各种场景。在这项工作中，学者们提出了一个系统，用于在没有任何参考运动数据的情况下，使用简单的奖励来学习不同跑酷技能的单一端到端基于视觉的跑酷策略。学者们开发了一种受直接搭配启发的强化学习方法，以培养跑酷技能。包括攀爬高障碍物、跳过大间隙、在低障碍物下爬行、挤过细缝和跑步。他们将这些技能提炼成了一个基于视觉的跑酷策略，并将其转移到四足机器人身上。
Parkour requires robots to quickly overcome various obstacles in complex environments. However, autonomous parkour requires robots to learn universal skills based on vision and diversity to perceive and respond to various scenarios. In this work, scholars have proposed a system for using simple rewards to learn single end to end visual parkour strategies for different parkour skills without any reference motion data. Scholars have developed a reinforcement learning method inspired by direct pairing to cultivate parkour skills. This includes climbing high obstacles, skipping large gaps, crawling under low obstacles, squeezing through small gaps, and running. They refined these skills into a visual parkour strategy and transferred them to quadruped robots.
92.Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Chance Constrained Trajectory Optimization for Mobile Robots within Uncertain Safe Corridor
不确定安全通道中移动机器人的Wasserstein分布鲁棒机会约束轨迹优化
基于安全走廊的轨迹优化（TO）为自主机器人的无碰撞路径规划提供了一种有全局最优性的方法。安全走廊是基于感知地图构建的，然而，非理想感知会产生不确定性，而这在轨迹生成中很少被考虑。来自华中科技大学和香港城市大学的学者们提出了分布式鲁棒安全走廊约束（DRSCC）来考虑安全走廊的不确定性。学者们将DRSCC集成到轨迹优化框架中。从理论上讲，学者们严格证明了包含DRSCC的轨迹优化问题等价于一个计算高效的凸二次规划。这个方法在存在不确定性的情况下显著减少了不可行的运动，从而提高了导航安全性。此外，学者们通过在四足机器人上的应用验证了所提出的方法。
Trajectory optimization (TO) based on safety corridor provides a globally optimal method for collision-free path planning of autonomous robots. Safety corridors are built on perceptual maps, however, non-ideal perception creates uncertainty, which is rarely considered in trajectory generation. Scholars from Huazhong University of Science and Technology and City University of Hong Kong have proposed Distributed Robust Safe Corridor Constraints (DRSCC) to account for the uncertainty of safe corridors. Scholars have integrated DRSCC into a trajectory optimization framework. Theoretically, scholars rigorously show that a trajectory optimization problem involving DRSCC is equivalent to a computationally efficient convex quadratic program. This method significantly reduces unfeasible movements in the presence of uncertainty, thereby improving navigation safety. In addition, scholars have verified the proposed method through the application of quadruped robots.
93.VERF: Runtime Monitoring of Pose Estimation with Neural Radiance Fields
VERF：使用神经辐射场对姿态估计进行运行时监控
来自麻省理工学院的学者们提出了 VERF，这是两种方法（VERF-PnP 和 VERF-Light）的集合，用于在不依赖直接深度测量的情况下为单目相机的相机姿态估计的正确性提供保证。只需要输入正在估计姿态的相机图像以及学者们想要监控的相机姿态的估计以及包含相机拍摄的场景的 NeRF 模型，就可以预测姿势估计是否在与地面实况的期望距离内。 VERF-Light 通过使用 NeRF 在估计姿态处渲染视点并按比例估计其与传感器图像的相对偏移来实现此目的。  VERF-PnP 采用不同的方法，通过 NeRF 渲染一对立体图像并利用 Perspective-n-Point (PnP) 算法。 学者们在 LLFF 数据集、Unitree A1 四足机器人的数据以及从 Blue Origin 的亚轨道 New Shepard 火箭收集的数据上评估了这两种方法，以证明所提出的姿态监测方法在一系列场景尺度上的有效性。他们还展示了在 3090 GPU 上可以在半秒内完成监控。
Academics from MIT propose VERF, a collection of two methods (VERF-PnP and VERF-Light) for correct camera pose estimation for monocular cameras without relying on direct depth measurements. Sex provides assurance. Simply inputting the camera image from which the pose is being estimated and the estimate of the camera pose that the academics want to monitor and a NeRF model containing the scene captured by the camera, it is possible to predict whether the pose estimate is within the desired distance from the ground truth. VERF-Light achieves this by using NeRF to render the viewpoint at the estimated pose and proportionally estimate its relative offset from the sensor image. VERF-PnP takes a different approach by rendering a pair of stereo images via NeRF and leveraging the Perspective-n-Point (PnP) algorithm. The academics evaluated both methods on the LLFF dataset, data from the Unitree A1 quadruped robot, and data collected from Blue Origin's suborbital New Shepard rocket to demonstrate the performance of the proposed attitude monitoring method at a range of scene scales. effectiveness. They also demonstrated that monitoring can be completed in half a second on a 3090 GPU.
94.Dynamic Object Tracking for Quadruped Manipulator with Spherical Image-Based Approach
基于球面图像的四足机械臂动态目标跟踪
准确估计和跟踪周围动态物体的运动是四足机械臂自主性的重要任务之一。 然而，仅使用板载 RGB 摄像头，四足机械臂跟踪以未知且变化的速度移动的动态物体的运动仍然是一项具有挑战性的工作。来自哈尔滨机械工程及其自动化学院和中国深圳工程技术学院的学者们为了解决这个问题，提出了一种新颖的基于图像的视觉伺服（IBVS）方法。此方法由三个要素组成：球形投影模型、鲁棒的超扭曲观察器和模型预测控制器（MPC）。球面投影模型将动态目标的视觉误差解耦为线性误差和角度误差。在存在视觉误差的情况下，利用观察者的鲁棒性来估计动态目标的未知和变化的速度。最后，估计的速度被输入模型预测控制器（MPC）以生成四足机械臂的关节扭矩来跟踪动态目标的运动。学者们对所提出的方法通过硬件实验进行了验证，实验结果证明了该方法在提高四足机械臂自主性方面的有效性。
Accurately estimating and tracking the motion of surrounding dynamic objects is one of the important tasks for the autonomy of quadruped manipulators. However, tracking the motion of dynamic objects moving at unknown and varying speeds with a quadruped manipulator remains a challenging task using only onboard RGB cameras. In order to solve this problem, scholars from Harbin Institute of Mechanical Engineering and Automation and China Shenzhen Institute of Engineering Technology proposed a novel image-based visual servoing (IBVS) method. This method consists of three elements: a spherical projection model, a robust hyperwarped observer, and a model predictive controller (MPC). The spherical projection model decouples the visual errors of dynamic targets into linear errors and angular errors. Exploiting observer robustness in the presence of visual errors to estimate unknown and changing speeds of dynamic targets. Finally, the estimated velocity is fed into a model predictive controller (MPC) to generate joint torques of the quadruped manipulator to track the motion of the dynamic target. Scholars verified the proposed method through hardware experiments, and the experimental results proved the effectiveness of the method in improving the autonomy of quadruped robotic arms.
95.Collaborative Navigation and Manipulation of a Cable-towed Load by Multiple Quadrupedal Robots
多个四足机器人对缆索牵引负载的协作导航和操纵
电缆的引入使机器人能够通过电缆的松弛/拉紧开关改变其固有尺寸，从而穿过狭窄的空间。 然而，由于混合模式切换以及多个机器人和负载之间的动态耦合，这是一个具有挑战性的问题。之前解决此类问题的尝试都是离线进行的，并没有考虑在线避障。在这项工作中，来自加州大学伯克利分校的学者们通过电缆协作将负载拖到指定目标位置，同时实时避免碰撞的问题。学者们引入了一种级联规划方案，具有处理混合模式切换的并行集中轨迹优化。同时，他们还为每个机器人开发了一组分散的规划器，能够解决在线协作负载操纵的问题。学者们开发并演示了第一个协作自主框架，该框架能够移动缆索牵引的负载，该负载太重而无法由单个机器人移动，通过狭窄的空间，并在实验中提供实时反馈和反应性规划。
The introduction of cables enables the robot to pass through tight spaces by changing its inherent dimensions through the cable's slack/tightening switch. However, this is a challenging problem due to mixed mode switching and dynamic coupling between multiple robots and payloads. Previous attempts to solve such problems have been conducted offline and did not consider online obstacle avoidance. In this work, academics from the University of California, Berkeley, collaborated via cables to drag a payload to a designated target location while avoiding collisions in real time. Scholars introduced a cascade planning scheme with parallel centralized trajectory optimization that handles mixed mode switching. At the same time, they also developed a set of decentralized planners for each robot, capable of solving the problem of online collaborative load manipulation. Academics have developed and demonstrated the first collaborative autonomous framework capable of moving cable-pulled loads that are too heavy to be moved by a single robot through tight spaces and providing real-time feedback and reactive planning in experiments.
96.Walking in Narrow Spaces: Safety-critical Locomotion Control for Quadrupedal Robots with Duality-based Optimization
在狭窄空间中行走：基于对偶优化的四足机器人的安全关键运动控制
为了使四足机器人能够在杂乱的环境中安全导航，来自加州大学伯克利分校的学者们将具有基于对偶性避障约束的指数离散控制障碍函数（指数 DCBF）引入具有全身控制（WBC）框架的非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）中，用于四足运动控制。因此，学者们能够在进行四足机器人的运动控制时，使用多面体来描述机器人和障碍物的形状以避免碰撞。与大多数先前的工作相比，特别是使用CBF，利用球形和保守近似来避障，这项工作展示了四足机器人能够自主、安全地在现实世界中非常狭窄的空间中导航。
In order to enable quadruped robots to safely navigate in cluttered environments, scholars from the University of California, Berkeley, introduced an exponential discrete control obstacle function (exponential DCBF) with duality-based obstacle avoidance constraints into a non-linear system with a whole-body control (WBC) framework. Linear model predictive control (NMPC) for quadruped locomotion control. Therefore, scholars can use polyhedrons to describe the shapes of robots and obstacles to avoid collisions when controlling the motion of quadruped robots. In contrast to most previous work, specifically using CBF, which utilizes spherical and conservative approximations for obstacle avoidance, this work demonstrates the ability of a quadruped robot to autonomously and safely navigate very narrow spaces in the real world.
97.GenLoco :Generalized Locomotion Controllers for Quadrupedal Robots
GenLoco：四足机器人的通用运动控制器
来自加州大学伯克利分校和香港中文大学的学者们提出了一个用于训练四足机器人广义运动（GenLoco）控制器的框架。大多数基于学习的控制器开发框架都侧重于训练特定于机器人的控制器，这个过程需要为每个新机器人重复。
所以，学者们提出了一种简单但有效的形态随机化方法，可以按程序生成一组不同的模拟机器人进行训练。这个框架综合了通用运动控制器，可以部署在各种具有相似形态的四足机器人上。实验结果表明，通过在这一大组模拟机器人上训练控制器，他们的模型获得了更通用的控制策略，这些策略可以直接转移到具有不同形态的新型模拟和现实机器人上。
Scholars from the University of California, Berkeley, and the Chinese University of Hong Kong propose a framework for training generalized locomotion (GenLoco) controllers for quadruped robots. Most learning-based controller development frameworks focus on training robot-specific controllers, a process that needs to be repeated for each new robot.
Therefore, scholars have proposed a simple but effective morphological randomization method that can programmatically generate a set of different simulated robots for training. This framework integrates a universal motion controller that can be deployed on a variety of quadruped robots with similar morphology. Experimental results show that by training the controller on this large set of simulated robots, their model acquires more general control strategies that can be directly transferred to new simulated and real-life robots with different morphologies.
98.Robust Quadrupedal Locomotion via Risk-Averse Policy Learning
通过风险规避策略学习实现稳健的四足运动
在腿式机器人运动方面，强化学习（RL）取得了可喜的成果。人们用各种方法尝试集成场景建模和外部传感器，以提高运动策略的泛化性和鲁棒性。 然而，这些方法很难处理不确定的场景，例如突然的地形变化或意外的外力。 在本文中，来自清华大学和上海交通大学以及西北工业大学的学者们考虑了一种新颖的风险敏感视角，来增强腿部运动的稳健性。具体来说，学者们采用通过分位数回归学习的分布值函数来对环境的任意不确定性进行建模，并通过风险扭曲度量优化最坏情况场景来执行风险规避策略学习 在模拟环境和真实 Aliengo 机器人中进行的大量实验表明，这个方法可以有效地处理各种外部干扰，并且由此产生的策略在腿式运动的恶劣和不确定情况下表现出更高的鲁棒性。
Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved promising results in legged robot locomotion. Various methods have been used to try to integrate scene modeling and external sensors to improve the generalization and robustness of motion strategies. However, these methods have difficulty handling uncertain scenarios, such as sudden terrain changes or unexpected external forces. In this paper, scholars from Tsinghua University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University, as well as Northwestern Polytechnical University, consider a novel risk-sensitive perspective to enhance the robustness of leg movements. Specifically, scholars adopt distribution value functions learned through quantile regression to model arbitrary uncertainty in the environment, and optimize worst-case scenarios through risk distortion metrics to perform risk avoidance strategy learning in simulated environments and real Extensive experiments conducted on the Aliengo robot show that this approach can effectively handle various external disturbances, and the resulting strategy exhibits higher robustness under harsh and uncertain situations of legged locomotion.
99.Dynamic Hybrid Locomotion and Jumping for Wheeled-Legged Quadrupeds
轮腿四足动物的动态混合运动和跳跃
轮腿四足动物有潜力在具有挑战性的地形上敏捷、快速地长距离行驶。然而，障碍物可能会阻碍它们的前进，因为这要求机器人要么放慢速度跨过障碍物，要么修改路径以绕过障碍物。来自德国波恩大学的学者们提出了一种四足机器人的运动优化框架，该框架结合了不可转向轮和动态跳跃，使它们能够执行混合轮腿运动，同时克服障碍而不会减速。学者们的方法涉及模型预测控制器，该控制器使用机器人的时变刚体动力学模型（包括腿和轮子）来跟踪跳跃等动态运动。他们还介绍了一种以最小腿部摆动的方式驾驶的方法，通过省去抬起车轮的力来减少能源消耗。 这个方法在轮式 Mini Cheetah 和 Unitree AlienGo 机器人上成功进行了实验测试。
Wheel-legged quadrupeds have the potential to travel long distances with agility and speed over challenging terrain. However, obstacles can impede their progress by requiring the robot to either slow down to cross the obstacle or modify its path to get around it. Academics from the University of Bonn in Germany have proposed a motion optimization framework for quadruped robots that combines non-steerable wheels and dynamic hopping, allowing them to perform hybrid wheel-legged motion while overcoming obstacles without slowing down. The academics' approach involves a model predictive controller that uses a time-varying rigid-body dynamics model of the robot, including legs and wheels, to track dynamic movements such as jumping. They also introduced a method of driving with minimal leg swing, reducing energy consumption by eliminating the effort to lift the wheel. This approach was successfully experimentally tested on wheeled Mini Cheetah and Unitree AlienGo robots.
100.ViT-A*: Legged Robot Path Planning using Vision Transformer A*
ViT-A*： 使用视觉转换器 A* 进行腿式机器人路径规划
腿式机器人，尤其是四足机器人，在需要穿越不同地形和避开障碍物的场景中具有良好的导航能力。本文探讨了如何通过整合数据驱动的路径规划方法，使有腿机器人能够有效地在复杂环境中导航。来自伦敦大学的学者们提出了一种利用可变规划器的方法，允许通过神经网络学习端到端的全局规划，用于指挥四足机器人。该方法利用二维地图和障碍物规格作为输入，生成全局路径。为了增强所开发的基于神经网络的路径规划器的功能，学者们使用视觉转换器（ViT）进行地图预处理，以便有效处理较大的地图。在两个真实的四足机器人（Boston Dynamics Spot 和 Unitree Go1）上进行的实验，进一步评估证明了他们所提出的方法在生成可靠路径计划方面的有效性和多功能性。
Legged robots, especially quadruped robots, have good navigation capabilities in scenarios that require traversing different terrains and avoiding obstacles. This paper explores how legged robots can effectively navigate through complex environments by integrating data-driven path planning methods. Scholars from the University of London have proposed a method utilising a variable planner that allows end-to-end global planning to be learnt via a neural network for commanding a quadrupedal robot. The method utilises 2D maps and obstacle specifications as inputs to generate global paths. To enhance the functionality of the developed neural network-based path planner, the scholars performed map preprocessing using a visual transformer (ViT) in order to efficiently handle larger maps. Experiments conducted on two real quadruped robots (Boston Dynamics Spot and Unitree Go1) were further evaluated to prove the effectiveness and versatility of their proposed approach in generating reliable path plans.
101.SYNLOCO: Synthesizing Central Pattern Generator and Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Locomotion
SYNLOCO：综合四足运动的中央模式生成器和强化学习
中央模式生成器 (CPG) 擅长生成有节奏的步态模式，其特点是一致的计时和足够的足部间隙。然而，其开环配置常常会损害系统响应环境变化的控制性能。在本文中，来自中山大学和英国曼彻斯特大学以及代尔夫特理工大学的学者们通过综合 CPG 和 RL ，提出了一种创新的四足运动框架 SYNLOCO。它可以巧妙地结合两种方法的优点，从而能够开发出既稳定又自然的运动控制器。 此外，学者们还引入了一组绩效驱动的奖励指标，以增强运动控制的学习。 为了优化 SYNLOCO 的学习轨迹，他们提出了两阶段训练策略，在不同条件下（包括不同的速度、地形和有效负载能力）对 Unitree GO1 机器人进行了实证评估，展示了 SYNLOCO 在不同场景下产生一致且清晰步态的能力。 学者们所开发的控制器表现出对大量参数变化的适应能力，强调了其强大的实际应用潜力。
The Central Pattern Generator (CPG) excels at generating rhythmic gait patterns characterized by consistent timing and adequate foot clearance. However, its open-loop configuration often compromises the system's control performance in response to environmental changes. In this paper, scholars from Sun Yat-sen University, the University of Manchester in the UK, and TU Delft propose an innovative quadrupedal locomotion framework SYNLOCO by integrating CPG and RL. It cleverly combines the advantages of both methods, enabling the development of motion controllers that are both stable and natural. In addition, scholars have introduced a set of performance-driven reward indicators to enhance motor control learning. In order to optimize the learning trajectory of SYNLOCO, they proposed a two-stage training strategy and conducted an empirical evaluation on the Unitree GO1 robot under different conditions (including different speeds, terrains, and payload capabilities), demonstrating that SYNLOCO can produce consistent and consistent results in different scenarios. Ability to articulate gait. The controller developed by the scholars shows adaptability to a large number of parameter changes, emphasizing its strong potential for practical applications.
102.DecAP: Decaying Action Priors for Accelerated Learning of Torque-Based Legged Locomotion Policies
DecAP：衰减行动先验以加速基于扭矩的腿式运动策略的学习
大多数端到端 DRL 方法仍然在位置空间中运行，主要是因为扭矩空间中的学习通常样本效率低下，并且不能始终收敛到自然步态。 为了应对这些挑战，来自卡拉格普尔理工学院和新加坡国立大学的学者们引入了Decaying Action Priors (DecAP)，这是一种新颖的三阶段框架，用于学习和部署腿部运动的扭矩策略。 在第一阶段，学者们通过训练位置策略来生成他们自己的模仿数据，从而无需设计最佳控制器时需要专业知识。 第二阶段结合了衰退的行动先验，以加强对模仿奖励辅助的基于扭矩的政策的探索。实验表明，学者们的方法始终优于单独的模仿学习，并且对于这些奖励的扩展具有显着的鲁棒性。最后，第三阶段通过直接部署他们学到的扭矩以及来自他们训练有素的位置策略的低增益 PID 控制来促进安全的模拟到真实的转换。 学者们们通过在模拟中训练两足动物、四足动物和六足机器人的基于扭矩的运动策略来证明了方法的通用性，并通过实验证明在四足机器人（Unitree Go1）上学习的策略。
Most end-to-end DRL methods still operate in the position space, mainly because learning in the torque space is usually sample inefficient and does not always converge to the natural gait. To address these challenges, scholars from IIT Kharagpur and NUS introduced Decaying Action Priors (DecAP), a novel three-stage framework for learning and deploying torque strategies for leg movements. In the first phase, the scholars generate their own mimicry data by training positional strategies, thereby eliminating the need for expertise in designing optimal controllers. The second phase incorporates a declining action prior to enhance the exploration of torque-based policies aided by imitation rewards. Experiments show that the scholars' approach consistently outperforms imitation learning alone and is significantly robust to the extension of these rewards. Finally, the third phase facilitates safe simulation-to-reality transitions by directly deploying their learned torques along with low-gain PID control from their trained positional polic  ies. The scholars demonstrate the generality of the approach by training torque-based locomotion strategies on bipedal, quadrupedal, and hexapod robots in simulation, and experimentally demonstrating the strategies learned on a quadrupedal robot (Unitree Go1).
103.Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability Analysis for Hybrid Systems with Controlled and Forced Transitions
带受控和强制转换的混合系统的Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析
来自美国洛杉矶南加州大学的学者们将经典的 Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性分析（一种在存在有界输入和扰动的情况下连续非线性动力学的形式验证方法）扩展到了混合动力系统。学者们的框架可以计算由多个离散模式组成的混合系统的可达集，每个模式都有自己的一组非线性连续动态、离散转换，可以由离散控制输入直接命令或强制，同时仍然考虑控制边界和对抗性状态演化过程中的扰动。除了可达集之外，他们所提出的框架还提供了最佳的连续和离散控制器以确保系统安全。同时，学者们在飞机防撞问题的模拟中以及在现实世界的测试台上展示了他们的框架，以解决具有多种步态的四足动物的最佳模式规划问题。
Scholars from the University of Southern California, Los Angeles, USA, have extended the classical Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis, a formal verification method for continuous nonlinear dynamics in the presence of bounded inputs and perturbations, to hybrid dynamical systems. The scholars' framework allows for the computation of the reachable set of a hybrid system consisting of multiple discrete modes, each with its own set of nonlinear continuous dynamics, discrete transitions that can be directly commanded or forced by discrete control inputs, while still accounting for perturbations during control boundaries and adversarial state evolution. In addition to reachable sets, their proposed framework provides optimal continuous and discrete controllers to ensure system safety. Meanwhile, the scholars demonstrated their framework in a simulation of an aircraft collision avoidance problem and on a real-world testbed to solve the optimal mode planning problem for quadrupeds with multiple gaits.
104.Learning Agile Locomotion and Adaptive Behaviors via RL-augmented MPC
通过 RL 增强 MPC 学习敏捷运动和自适应行为
来自南加州大学的学者们通过结合 RL 和 MPC 将自适应行为的两个方面引入四足运动，同时提高盲腿运动的鲁棒性和敏捷性。这种集成利用了 MPC 的预测能力优势和 RL 汲取过去经验的能力。与将站立脚控制和摆动脚轨迹分开的传统运动控制不同，学者们的创新方法将它们统一起来，解决了它们缺乏同步的问题。核心是将站立脚控制与摆动脚反射相结合，通过适应性行为提高运动的敏捷性和鲁棒性。这个方法的一个标志是通过摆动脚反射进行稳健的盲楼梯攀登。 此外，学者们特意将学习模块设计为不同机器人平台的通用插件。学者们在 Unitree A1 机器人上训练了该策略并实施了此方法，取得了令人印象深刻的结果：峰值转弯速率为 8.5 rad/s，峰值运行速度为 3 m/s，转向速度为 2.5 m/s。 值得注意的是，该框架还允许机器人在承受 10 公斤（即其体重的 83％）的意外负载时保持稳定的运动。 学者们进一步证明了同一策略的通用性和鲁棒性，它实现了到不同机器人平台（如 Go1 和 AlienGo 机器人）的零次转移以进行负载。
Scholars from the University of Southern California introduced two aspects of adaptive behavior into quadrupedal locomotion by combining RL and MPC, while improving the robustness and agility of blind leg locomotion. This integration takes advantage of the predictive power of MPC and the ability of RL to learn from past experience. Unlike traditional motion control that separates stance foot control and swing foot trajectories, the scholars' innovative approach unifies them and solves their lack of synchronization. The core is to combine stance foot control with swing foot reflex to improve movement agility and robustness through adaptive behavior. A hallmark of this method is robust blind stair climbing via the swing foot reflex. In addition, scholars intentionally designed the learning module as a universal plug-in for different robot platforms. The academics trained and implemented this strategy on a Unitree A1 robot, achieving impressive results: a peak turning rate of 8.5 rad/s, a peak operating speed of 3 m/s, and a steering speed of 2.5 m/s. s. Notably, the frame also allows the robot to maintain stable motion while bearing an unexpected load of 10 kilograms, or 83 percent of its body weight. The academics further demonstrated the generality and robustness of the same strategy, which achieved zero transfers to different robot platforms such as Go1 and AlienGo robots for payloads.
Learning Vision-based Pursuit-Evasion Robot Policies
学习基于视觉的追逃机器人策略
在现实世界的限制下学习战略机器人行为（如追击-躲避交互所需的行为）极具挑战性。它需要利用交互的动态性，并通过物理状态和潜在意图的不确定性进行规划。来自加州大学伯克利分校的学者们将这个棘手的问题转化为监督学习问题，其中完全可观察的机器人策略为部分可观察的机器人策略生成监督。学者们发现，部分可观察的追随者政策的监督信号质量取决于两个关键因素：逃避者行为的多样性和最优性的平衡，以及完全可观察的政策中建模假设的强度。学者们将他们的策略部署在一个带有 RGB-D 摄像头的物理四足机器人上，用于在野外进行追击-躲避交互。
Learning strategic robot behaviors, such as those required for pursuit-and-avoid interactions, is extremely challenging under real-world constraints. It requires exploiting the dynamics of interactions and planning through uncertainty in physical states and underlying intentions. Academics from the University of California, Berkeley, transformed this intractable problem into a supervised learning problem, where a fully observable robot policy generates supervision for a partially observable robot policy. Scholars have found that the quality of supervisory signals for partially observable follower policies depends on two key factors: the diversity and optimality balance of evader behavior, and the strength of the modeling assumptions in fully observable policies. The academics deployed their strategy on a physical quadruped robot with an RGB-D camera for pursuit-avoidance interactions in the wild.
ARMP: Autoregressive Motion Planning for Quadruped Locomotion and Navigation in Complex Indoor Environments
ARMP：在复杂室内环境中进行四足运动和导航的自回归运动规划
来自佐治亚理工学院的学者们介绍了一种新颖的基于学习的自回归运动规划器（ARMP）框架，用于四足动物的运动和导航。学者们的方法可以以自回归方式生成任意长度的运动计划，这与大多数固定轨迹长度的离线轨迹优化算法不同。为此，他们首先通过针对不同场景和参数设置解决一组密集的轨迹优化问题来构建运动库。然后以监督学习的方式从数据集中学习运动流形。结果表明，学者们所提出的 ARMP 可以为各种任务和情况生成物理上合理的运动。他们还展示了此方法可以作为低级控制器成功地与最新的机器人导航框架集成，并释放腿式机器人进行复杂室内导航的全部能力。
Academics from Georgia Tech introduce a novel learning-based autoregressive motion planner (ARMP) framework for quadruped locomotion and navigation. The scholars' method can generate motion plans of arbitrary length in an autoregressive manner, which is different from most offline trajectory optimization algorithms with fixed trajectory length. To do this, they first built a motion library by solving a dense set of trajectory optimization problems for different scenarios and parameter settings. The motion manifold is then learned from the dataset in a supervised learning manner. The results show that the ARMP proposed by the scholars can generate physically plausible motion for a variety of tasks and situations. They also demonstrate that this approach can be successfully integrated with state-of-the-art robot navigation frameworks as a low-level controller and unlock the full capabilities of legged robots for complex indoor navigation.
Learning a Single Policy for Diverse Behaviors on a Quadrupedal Robot using Scalable Motion Imitation
利用可扩展运动模仿为四足机器人的多种行为学习单一策略
来自佐治亚理工学院的学者们通过模仿大量参考动作（包括行走、转弯、踱步、跳跃、坐和躺），利用深度强化学习来学习单一的能力策略。在现有的动作模仿框架基础上，学者们首先精心设计了观察空间、动作空间和奖励函数，以提高学习的可扩展性和最终策略的鲁棒性。此外，他们还采用了一种新颖的自适应运动采样（AMS）方法，在成功行为和不成功行为之间保持平衡。这种技术允许学习算法专注于具有挑战性的运动技能，避免灾难性遗忘。实验证明，通过成功跟踪训练数据集和分布外轨迹，学习到的策略可以在模拟中表现出多种行为。他们还通过实验验证了所提出的学习配方和自适应运动采样方案的重要性。
Academics from Georgia Institute of Technology used deep reinforcement learning to learn a single ability policy by imitating a large number of reference actions, including walking, turning, pacing, jumping, sitting and lying down. Based on the existing action imitation framework, scholars first carefully designed the observation space, action space and reward function to improve the scalability of learning and the robustness of the final policy. In addition, they employed a novel adaptive motion sampling (AMS) method to maintain a balance between successful and unsuccessful behaviors. This technique allows learning algorithms to focus on challenging motor skills and avoid catastrophic forgetting. Experiments demonstrate that the learned policy can exhibit a variety of behaviors in simulations by successfully tracking training data sets and out-of-distribution trajectories. They also experimentally verified the importance of the proposed learning recipe and adaptive motion sampling scheme.
108.ManyQuadrupeds: Learning a Single Locomotion Policy for Diverse Quadruped Robots
ManyQuadrupeds：学习多种四足机器人的单一运动策略
来自洛桑联邦理工学院的学者们从动物运动控制中汲取了灵感，使得他们能够有效地训练能够控制各种四足机器人的单一运动策略。这些差异包括可变数量的自由度（即 12 或 16 个关节）、三种不同的形态、从 2 kg 到 200 kg 的广泛质量范围以及从 16 cm 到 100 cm 的标称站立高度。学者们的策略调制脊髓中中央模式生成器（CPG）的表示，有效协调 CPG 的频率和幅度以产生节奏输出（节奏生成），然后将其映射到模式形成（PF）层。在不同的机器人中，唯一变化的组件是 PF 层，它调整步幅高度和长度的缩放参数。并且，学者们通过在 Unitree Go1 和 A1 机器人上测试单一策略来评估模拟到真实的传输。值得注意的是，即使添加 15 公斤负载（相当于 A1 机器人标称质量的 125%），学者们也观察到了稳健的性能。
Academics from Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne drew inspiration from animal motion control, allowing them to effectively train a single motion strategy capable of controlling a variety of quadruped robots. These differences include a variable number of degrees of freedom (i.e. 12 or 16 joints), three different morphologies, a wide mass range from 2 kg to 200 kg, and a nominal standing height from 16 cm to 100 cm. The scholars' strategy modulates the representation of central pattern generators (CPGs) in the spinal cord, effectively coordinating the frequency and amplitude of CPGs to produce rhythmic output (rhythm generation), which is then mapped to the pattern-forming (PF) layer. The only component that changes across robots is the PF layer, which adjusts the scaling parameters for stride height and length. Also, the academics evaluated simulated-to-real transfer by testing a single strategy on Unitree Go1 and A1 robots. Notably, the academics observed robust performance even with the addition of a 15-kg payload (equivalent to 125% of the A1 robot's nominal mass).
109.Learning Agile Locomotion and Adaptive Behaviors via RL-augmented MPC
通过 RL 增强 MPC 学习敏捷运动和自适应行为
来自南加州大学洛杉矶分校的学者们通过结合 RL 和 MPC，设法将自适应行为的两个方面引入四足运动，同时提高了运动的鲁棒性和敏捷性。这种集成利用了 MPC 的预测能力优势和 RL 汲取过去经验的能力。与将站立脚控制和摆动脚轨迹分开的传统运动控制不同，学者们的创新方法将它们统一起来，解决了缺乏同步性的问题。他们提出的方法核心是将站立脚控制与摆动脚反射相结合，通过适应性行为提高运动的敏捷性和鲁棒性。这个方法的一个标志是通过摆动脚反射进行稳健的盲楼梯攀爬。 此外，学者们特意将学习模块设计为不同机器人平台的通用插件，在 Unitree A1 机器人上训练了该策略并实施了这个方法，取得了令人印象深刻的结果：峰值转弯速率为 8.5 rad/s，峰值运行速度为 3 m/s，转向速度为 2.5 m/s。值得注意的是，该框架还允许机器人在承受 10 公斤（即其体重的 83％）的意外负载时保持稳定的运动。 学者们进一步证明了同一策略的通用性和鲁棒性，它实现了到不同机器人平台（如 Go1 和 AlienGo 机器人）的零次转移以进行负载。
By combining RL and MPC, academics from the University of Southern California, Los Angeles, managed to introduce two aspects of adaptive behavior into quadrupedal locomotion while improving locomotion's robustness and agility. This integration takes advantage of the predictive power of MPC and the ability of RL to learn from past experience. Unlike traditional motion control that separates stance foot control and swing foot trajectories, the scholars' innovative approach unifies them and solves the problem of lack of synchronization. The core of their proposed method is to combine stance foot control with swing foot reflex to improve movement agility and robustness through adaptive behavior. A hallmark of this method is robust blind stair climbing via the swing foot reflex. In addition, the scholars deliberately designed the learning module as a universal plug-in for different robot platforms, trained the strategy on the Unitree A1 robot and implemented this method, achieving impressive results: a peak turning rate of 8.5 rad/s, The peak operating speed is 3 m/s and the steering speed is 2.5 m/s. Notably, the frame also allows the robot to maintain stable motion while bearing an unexpected load of 10 kilograms, or 83 percent of its body weight. The academics further demonstrated the generality and robustness of the same strategy, which achieved zero transfers to different robot platforms such as Go1 and AlienGo robots for payloads.
Expanding Versatility of Agile Locomotion through Policy Transitions Using Latent State Representation
使用潜在状态表示通过策略转换扩展敏捷运动的多功能性
本文提出了过渡网络，这是一种稳健的过渡策略，可以扩展机器人运动在现实世界中的多功能性。为此，学者们首先将不同步态的复杂性分配到适用于现实世界机器人的专用运动策略中。接下来，他们通过检查潜在状态表示，将具有鲁棒转换的策略统一为单个连贯元控制器，从而扩展机器人的多功能性。这个方法使机器人能够迭代扩展其技能库，并在库中的任何策略对之间稳健地转换。在学者们提出的框架中，添加新技能不会引入任何改变之前学习的技能的过程。 此外，使用单个消费级 GPU 训练运动策略只需不到一个小时。这个的方法在现实世界中是有效的，与现有方法相比，学者们的实验中最具挑战性的转换对的平均成功率提高了 19%。
This paper proposes transition networks, a robust transition strategy that can extend the versatility of robot locomotion in the real world. To this end, scholars first allocate the complexity of different gaits into specialized locomotion strategies suitable for real-world robots. Next, they extend the robot's versatility by examining latent state representations to unify strategies with robust transitions into a single coherent meta-controller. This approach enables the bot to iteratively expand its skill library and robustly switch between any pair of strategies in the library. In the framework proposed by the scholars, adding new skills does not introduce any process of changing previously learned skills. Additionally, training a motion policy takes less than an hour using a single consumer-grade GPU. This approach is effective in the real world, with the academics' experiments achieving an average success rate improvement of 19% on the most challenging pairs of transformations compared to existing methods.
112.Quadrupedal Footstep Planning using Learned Motion Models of a Black-Box Controller
使用黑盒控制器的学习运动模型进行四足足迹规划
腿式机器人越来越多地进入新的领域和应用，包括搜索救援、检查和物流。然而，要使这样的系统在现实场景中发挥价值，它们必须能够自主且稳健地导航不规则地形。在许多情况下，市场上出售的机器人不具备这种能力，只能进行盲目运动。在本文中，来自意大利理工学院和德国波恩大学的学者们提出了一种快速局部运动规划管道，它扩展了只能跟踪高级参考速度的黑盒行走控制器的功能。更准确地说，学者们学习了此类控制器的一组运动模型，将高级速度命令映射到质心（CoM）和脚步运动。然后，他们将这些模型与 A* 算法的变体集成，以根据视觉信息规划 CoM 轨迹、足迹序列和相应的高级速度命令，从而使四足动物能够根据需要安全地穿越不规则地形。
