Legged robots are increasingly finding their way into new areas and applications, including search and rescue, inspection and logistics. However, for such systems to be valuable in real-world scenarios, they must be able to autonomously and robustly navigate irregular terrains. In many cases, the robots sold on the market do not have this ability and can only perform blind movements. In this paper, academics from the Italian Institute of Technology and the University of Bonn in Germany propose a fast local motion planning pipeline that extends the capabilities of a black-box walking controller that can only track high-level reference velocities. More precisely, the academics learned a set of motion models for such controllers, mapping high-level velocity commands to center of mass (CoM) and footwork movements. They then integrated these models with variants of the A* algorithm to plan CoM trajectories, footprint sequences and corresponding high-level speed commands based on visual information, allowing the quadruped to safely traverse irregular terrain as needed.
Learning to See Physical Properties with Active Sensing Motor Policies
通过主动感应运动政策学习观察物理特性
从彩色图像推断出的地形物理特性的知识可以帮助制定有效的机器人运动计划。然而，与图像分类不同，人类用物理属性来标记图像块是不直观的。来自麻省理工学院的学者们提出了一种克服这一挑战的方法，通过对机器人在现实世界遍历期间捕获的图像进行自我监督标记，并使用经过模拟训练的物理属性估计器来克服这一挑战。 为了确保准确的标记，他们引入了主动传感运动策略（ASMP），该策略经过训练以探索运动行为，从而提高估计物理参数的准确性。 例如，四足机器人学会用脚在地面上滑动以准确估计摩擦系数。学者们的实验证明，用少量现实世界遍历数据训练的视觉系统可以准确预测物理参数。经过训练的系统非常强大，它是根据连接在地面上行走的四足机器人上的摄像机收集的数据进行训练的，即使使用无人机捕获的头顶图像也能正常工作。
Knowledge of the physical properties of the terrain inferred from colour images can aid in the development of effective robot motion plans. However, unlike image classification, it is not intuitive for humans to label blocks of images with physical properties. Scholars from MIT have proposed a way to overcome this challenge by performing self-supervised labelling of images captured by robots during real-world traversals and using simulation-trained physical property estimators. To ensure accurate labelling, they introduce an Active Sensing Motion Policy (ASMP), which is trained to explore motion behaviours in order to improve the accuracy of the estimated physical parameters. For example, quadrupedal robots learn to slide their feet on the ground to accurately estimate the coefficient of friction. Experiments by academics have demonstrated that vision systems trained with a small amount of real-world traversal data can accurately predict physical parameters. The trained system was so robust that it was trained on data collected by cameras attached to quadrupedal robots walking on the ground and worked even with overhead images captured by drones.
Generalized Animal Imitator: Agile Locomotion with Versatile Motion Prior
具有多功能运动先验的广义动物模仿器敏捷运动
动物的敏捷性，特别是在复杂的活动中（例如跑步、旋转、跳跃和后空翻）是机器人系统的典范设计。将这套行为转移到腿式机器人系统引入了基本问题：如何训练机器人学习多种知识同时运动行为？ 机器人如何平稳过渡地执行这些任务？ 哪些策略可以综合应用这些技能？
来自加州大学和卡内基梅隆大学以及南加州大学的学者们在本文中介绍了多功能可指导运动先验（VIM）—— 一种强化学习框架，旨在整合一系列适合高级机器人应用的敏捷运动任务。学者们提出的框架使腿式机器人能够通过模仿动物动作和具有功能性奖励和风格化奖励的手动设计动作来学习各种敏捷的低级技能。功能性奖励指导机器人采用各种技能的能力，而风格化奖励则确保性能与参考动作保持一致。学者们对 VIM 框架的评估涵盖了模拟环境和实际部署。据他们了解，这是第一个允许机器人使用单一控制器同时学习多种敏捷运动任务的工作。
The agility of animals, especially in complex activities (e.g., running, spinning, jumping, and backflips) is a paradigmatic design for robotic systems. Transferring this set of behaviours to legged robotic systems introduces fundamental questions: how can a robot be trained to learn multiple knowledge simultaneous locomotor behaviours? How do robots perform these tasks with smooth transitions? What strategies can be used to integrate these skills?
In this paper, scholars from the University of California and Carnegie Mellon University, as well as the University of Southern California, introduce the Versatile Instructable Motion Prior (VIM) - a reinforcement learning framework designed to integrate a range of agility locomotion tasks suitable for advanced robotics applications. The scholars' proposed framework enables legged robots to learn a variety of agility low-level skills by mimicking animal movements and manually designed movements with functional and stylised rewards. Functional rewards guide the robot's ability to adopt a variety of skills, while stylised rewards ensure that performance is consistent with reference movements. The academics' evaluation of the VIM framework covered both simulated environments and real-world deployments. To their knowledge, this is the first work that allows a robot to learn multiple agility motor tasks simultaneously using a single controller.
FT-Net: Learning Failure Recovery and Fault-Tolerant Locomotion for Quadruped Robots
FT-Net：四足机器人的学习故障恢复和容错运动
近年来，四足机器人越来越多地在极其恶劣和危险的条件下使用。 因此，在机器人的工作周期中，随时可能出现各种严重的硬件故障。 在这项工作中，来自香港大学的学者们提出了一种基于无模型强化学习的容错（FT）控制管道——FT-Net，它由可变高度的立摆模型和支撑多边形引导。 该管道允许机器人动态地、自主地适应部分和完全的电机故障。 与需要精确定位故障位置的传统 FT 控制方法不同，学者们的控制器使用基于神经网络的适配器隐式识别故障。此外，他们实现了一个统一的策略，能够在发生完全运动故障时从四足行走模式切换到三足行走模式。 大量的模拟和硬件实验表明 FT-Net 可以学习有效地执行恢复行为。 容错运动甚至可以在各种动态任务和地形中执行。
In recent years, quadrupedal robots have increasingly been used in extremely harsh and hazardous conditions. As a result, a variety of serious hardware failures can occur at any time during the robot's duty cycle. In this work, scholars from the University of Hong Kong propose a fault-tolerant (FT) control pipeline based on model-free reinforcement learning, FT-Net, which is guided by variable-height models of standing pendulums and support polygons. The pipeline allows the robot to dynamically and autonomously adapt to partial and complete motor faults. Unlike traditional FT control methods that require precise fault location, the scholars' controller implicitly identifies faults using a neural network-based adapter. In addition, they implemented a unified strategy capable of switching from quadrupedal to tripedal walking mode in the event of a full motion fault. Extensive simulations and hardware experiments show that the FT-Net can learn to perform recovery behaviour efficiently. Fault-tolerant locomotion can even be executed in a variety of dynamic tasks and terrains.
Not Only Rewards But Also Constraints: Applications on Legged Robot Locomotion
不仅有奖励还有约束： 在有腿机器人运动中的应用
在一些早期的研究中，人们通过使用神经网络设计控制器并使用无模型强化学习对其进行训练，在复杂的机器人系统中展示了令人印象深刻的控制性能。 然而，这些具有自然运动风格和高任务性能的出色控制器是通过广泛的奖励工程开发的，这是一个设计大量奖励项并确定合适的奖励系数的高度费力且耗时的过程。 来自大田韩国科学技术院的学者们提出了一种新颖的强化学习框架，用于训练由奖励和约束组成的复杂机器人系统的神经网络控制器。 为了让工程师适当地反映他们对约束的意图并以最小的计算开销来处理它们，学者们建议了两种约束类型和有效的策略优化算法。 该学习框架用于训练多个具有不同形态和物理属性的腿式机器人的运动控制器，以穿越具有挑战性的地形。 广泛的模拟和现实世界实验表明，通过仅调整单个奖励系数，可以使用显着更少的奖励工程来训练高性能控制器。 此外，由于约束的可解释性和普遍性，可以利用更直接和直观的工程过程。
In some early studies, impressive control performance has been demonstrated in complex robotic systems by designing controllers using neural networks and training them using model-free reinforcement learning. However, these excellent controllers with natural motion styles and high task performance were developed through extensive reward engineering, a highly laborious and time-consuming process of designing a large number of reward terms and determining appropriate reward coefficients. Scholars from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, Daejeon, have proposed a novel reinforcement learning framework for training neural network controllers for complex robotic systems consisting of rewards and constraints. To allow engineers to appropriately reflect their intentions for constraints and process them with minimal computational overhead, the scholars suggest two constraint types and an effective policy optimisation algorithm. The learning framework is used to train motion controllers for multiple legged robots with different morphological and physical properties to traverse challenging terrain. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments show that high-performance controllers can be trained using significantly less reward engineering by tuning only a single reward coefficient. Furthermore, due to the interpretability and generality of the constraints, a more direct and intuitive engineering process can be utilised.
Tuning Legged Locomotion Controllers via Safe Bayesian Optimization
通过安全贝叶斯优化技术调整腿部运动控制器
来自苏黎世联邦理工学院的学者们提出了一种数据驱动策略，以简化基于模型的控制器在有脚机器人硬件平台中的部署。学者们的方法利用无模型安全学习算法自动调整控制增益，解决了控制配方中使用的简化模型与真实系统之间的不匹配问题。这种方法通过在可能的安全区域内有效优化参数，大大降低了与机器人发生危险交互的风险。此外，他们还扩展了这个方法的适用范围，将不同的步态参数作为上下文纳入其中，从而产生了一种安全、样本效率高的探索算法，能够针对不同的步态模式调整运动控制器。通过仿真和硬件实验，学者们成功验证了他们的方法，结果表明该算法在安全调整基于模型的运动控制器以适应多种步态方面表现出色。
Scholars from ETH Zurich have proposed a data-driven strategy to simplify the deployment of model-based controllers in a legged robotics hardware platform. The academics' approach addresses the mismatch between simplified models used in control recipes and real systems by automatically adjusting control gains using a model-free safe learning algorithm. This approach significantly reduces the risk of dangerous interactions with the robot by efficiently optimising the parameters within the possible safety region. Furthermore, they extended the applicability of this approach to include different gait parameters as contexts, resulting in a safe, sample-efficient exploration algorithm capable of tuning the motion controller for different gait patterns. Through simulations and hardware experiments, the academics successfully validated their approach, and the results show that the algorithm performs well in safely tuning model-based motion controllers to multiple gaits.
118.Hierarchical Optimization-based Control for Whole-body Loco-manipulation of Heavy Objects
基于分层优化的重物全身运动控制
来自南加州大学工程学院的学者们提出了一种新颖的腿式机械操纵框架，该框架通过基于分层优化的控制框架考虑全身协调。首先，在线操纵规划器计算操纵力和操纵对象基于任务的参考轨迹。然后，将位姿优化将机器人的轨迹与运动学约束对齐。由此产生的机器人参考轨迹通过线性 MPC 控制器将所需的操纵力纳入其预测模型中来执行。 学者们的方法已在仿真和硬件实验中得到验证，凸显了与重物交互时与基线运动 MPC 相比进行全身优化的必要性。 学者们的实验使用了配备定制机械臂的 Unitree Aliengo，实验结果也展示了其能够成功提升和携带8公斤有效负载以及相应的操纵能力。
Scholars from the USC School of Engineering propose a novel leg-based mechanical manipulation framework that considers whole-body coordination through a hierarchical optimization-based control framework. First, the online manipulation planner calculates the manipulation force and the task-based reference trajectory of the manipulation object. Then, pose optimization aligns the robot's trajectory with the kinematic constraints. The resulting robot reference trajectory is executed by a linear MPC controller incorporating the required manipulation forces into its predictive model. The academics' approach has been validated in simulation and hardware experiments, highlighting the need for full-body optimization compared to baseline kinematic MPC when interacting with heavy objects. The scholars' experiments used Unitree Aliengo equipped with a custom-made robotic arm, and the experimental results also demonstrated its ability to successfully lift and carry an 8-kg payload and its corresponding maneuvering capabilities.
119.DiPPeR: Diffusion-based 2D Path Planner applied on Legged Robots
DiPPeR：应用于腿式机器人的基于扩散的 2D 路径规划器
在这项工作中，来自伦敦大学的学者们提出了 DiPPeR，这是一种新颖且快速的四足运动二维路径规划框架，利用了扩散驱动技术。学者们的贡献包括地图图像和相应端到端轨迹的可扩展数据集、用于移动机器人的图像条件扩散规划器以及使用 CNN 的训练/推理管道。学者们在多个迷宫以及 Boston Dynamic 的 Spot 和 Unitree 的 Go1 机器人的实际部署场景中验证了这个方法。 与基于搜索和数据驱动的路径规划算法相比，DiPPeR 的轨迹生成速度平均快 70 倍，在可变尺寸和障碍物结构的地图中生成各种长度的可行路径时平均具有 80% 的一致性。
In this work, academics from the University of London propose DiPPeR, a novel and fast 2D path planning framework for quadrupedal locomotion that leverages diffusion-driven technology. The academics' contributions include a scalable dataset of map images and corresponding end-to-end trajectories, an image conditional diffusion planner for mobile robots, and a training/inference pipeline using CNNs. The academics validated this approach in real-world deployment scenarios across multiple mazes and Boston Dynamic’s Spot and Unitree’s Go1 robots. Compared to search-based and data-driven path planning algorithms, DiPPeR generates trajectories on average 70 times faster, with an average of 80% consistency in generating feasible paths of various lengths in maps of variable size and obstacle structure.
120.Adapt On-the-Go: Behavior Modulation for Single-Life Robot Deployment
随需应变：单生命周期机器人部署的行为调控
来自斯坦福大学和加州大学伯克利分校的学者们通过利用先前学习的各种行为来研究在部署过程中动态适应新场景的问题。学者们的方法 RObust 自主调制 (ROAM) 引入了一种基于预训练行为的感知价值的机制，以选择和调整预训练行为以适应当前情况。至关重要的是，这种适应过程全部发生在测试时的一个片段内，没有任何人类监督。 学者们对他们的选择机制进行了理论分析，并证明 ROAM 使机器人能够快速适应模拟中和真实 Go1 四足动物上的动力学变化，甚至可以成功地穿着溜冰鞋向前移动。 在部署过程中面对各种分布外情况时，通过有效地选择和即时调整相关行为，他们的这个方法的适应效率比现有方法高出2倍以上。
Scholars from Stanford University and the University of California, Berkeley, studied the problem of dynamic adaptation to new scenarios during deployment by leveraging various previously learned behaviors. The scholars' approach, RObust Autonomous Modulation (ROAM), introduces a mechanism based on the perceived value of pre-trained behaviors to select and adapt pre-trained behaviors to the current situation. Crucially, this adaptation process all occurred within a single episode at test time, without any human supervision. The academics conducted a theoretical analysis of their selection mechanism and demonstrated that ROAM enables the robot to quickly adapt to dynamic changes in simulations and on a real Go1 quadruped, even successfully moving forward on skates. When faced with various out-of-distribution situations during the deployment process, by effectively selecting and adjusting relevant behaviors on the fly, their method's adaptation efficiency is more than 2 times higher than existing methods.
121.Rethinking Sim2Real: Lower Fidelity Simulation Leads to Higher Sim2Real Transfer in Navigation
重新思考 Sim2Real：降低仿真度可提高导航中的 Sim2Real 转化率
如果我们希望在将机器人部署到现实中之前先对其进行模拟训练，那么我们似乎可以自然而然地假定，要缩小模拟与现实之间的差距，就必须创建保真度越来越高的模拟器（因为现实就是这样）。
来着佐治亚理工学院的学者们对这一假设提出了质疑，并提出了相反的假设--机器人的模拟与现实之间的转换可以通过较低（而非较高）的仿真度来改善。学者们在视觉导航问题上对这一假设进行了系统的大规模评估--在现实世界中，以及在2个不同的模拟器（Habitat 和 iGibson）上使用 3 个不同的机器人（A1、AlienGo 和 Spot）。他们的结果表明，与预期相反，增加保真度无助于学习；由于模拟速度慢（妨碍大规模学习）和过度拟合模拟物理的不准确性，学习效果很差。相反，利用真实世界的数据建立简单的机器人运动模型可以提高学习和泛化能力。
If we wish to train robots in simulations before deploying them into reality, it seems natural to assume that bridging the gap between simulation and reality will require the creation of simulators of increasing fidelity (because that's what reality is).
Scholars from the Georgia Institute of Technology have challenged this assumption and proposed the opposite hypothesis - that the transition between simulation and reality for robots can be improved by lower (rather than higher) levels of simulation. The academics conducted a systematic large-scale evaluation of this hypothesis on a visual navigation problem - in the real world, and with 3 different robots (A1, AlienGo and Spot) on 2 different simulators (Habitat and iGibson). Their results show that, contrary to expectations, increasing fidelity does not help learning; learning is poor due to slow simulation speed (which hinders large-scale learning) and inaccuracies in overfitting simulated physics. Instead, modelling simple robot motion using real-world data improves learning and generalisation.
122.Adaptive Control Strategy for Quadruped Robots in Actuator Degradation Scenarios
致动器退化情况下四足机器人的自适应控制策略
四足机器人对极端环境的适应能力很强，但也可能出现故障。一旦出现这些故障，机器人就必须修复才能返回任务，降低了其实际可行性。这些故障中普遍存在的一个问题是执行器性能下降，这是由设备老化或意外操作事件等因素引起的。传统上，解决这个问题在很大程度上依赖于复杂的容错设计，这需要开发人员具有深厚的领域专业知识，并且缺乏通用性。基于学习的方法提供了减轻这些限制的有效方法，但在现实世界的四足机器人上有效部署此类方法方面存在研究空白。
来自上海交大的学者们提出了一种基于强化学习的开创性框架，名为执行器退化适应变压器（ADAPT），旨在解决这一研究空白。 该框架产生了统一的控制策略，使机器人能够在关节执行器突然出现故障的情况下，完全依靠其内部传感器来维持其运动并执行任务。 学者们在Unitree A1 平台上评估验证了 Adapt 在现实世界四足机器人上的可部署性和有效性，并肯定了这个方法的稳健性和实用性。
Quadrupedal robots are highly adaptable to extreme environments, but they can also malfunction. Once these failures occur, the robot must be repaired before it can return to the mission, reducing its practical feasibility. A common problem with these failures is degradation of actuator performance, which is caused by factors such as aging equipment or unexpected operational events. Traditionally, solving this problem has relied heavily on complex fault-tolerant designs, which require deep domain expertise on the part of the developer and lack versatility. Learning-based approaches offer effective ways to mitigate these limitations, but there is a research gap in effectively deploying such approaches on real-world quadrupedal robots.
Scholars from Shanghai Jiaotong University have proposed a groundbreaking reinforcement learning-based framework called Actuator Degradation Adaptive Transformer (ADAPT) that aims to address this research gap. The framework produces a unified control strategy that enables a robot to rely solely on its internal sensors to maintain its motion and perform tasks in the event of a sudden failure of a joint actuator. Scholars evaluated on the Unitree A1 platform to validate the deployability and effectiveness of Adapt on real-world quadrupedal robots and affirmed the robustness and utility of the approach.
123.Hybrid Internal Model: Learning Agile Legged Locomotion with Simulated Robot Response
混合内部模型：通过模拟机器人响应学习敏捷的腿部运动
大多数有腿机器人的传感器只能提供部分噪声观测数据，这使得估算尤其具有挑战性，特别是对于地形摩擦和高程图等外部状态。受经典内部模型控制原理的启发，来自上海人工智能实验室和浙江大学以及清华大学的学者们将这些外部状态视为干扰，并引入混合内部模型（HIM），根据机器人的响应对其进行估计。
学者们利用对比学习来优化内嵌，使其接近机器人的后继状态，而响应自然是内嵌在后继状态中的。HIM 有几个吸引人的优点： 它只需要机器人的本体感知，即来自关节编码器和 IMU 的观测数据。它创新性地在模拟参考和现实之间保持了一致的观察结果，避免了模仿学习中的信息丢失。它利用了批量级信息，对噪声具有更强的鲁棒性，并能保持更好的采样效率。它只需要在 RTX 4090 上进行 1 小时的训练，就能让四足机器人在任何干扰下穿越任何地形。大量的实际实验证明了它的灵活性，即使在高难度任务中也是如此。
The sensors of most legged robots provide only partially noisy observations, making estimation particularly challenging, especially for external states such as terrain friction and elevation maps. Inspired by the classic internal model control principle, scholars from the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory and Zhejiang and Tsinghua Universities treat these external states as disturbances and introduce a hybrid internal model (HIM) to estimate them based on the robot's response.
Scholars use contrastive learning to optimize embedding so that it is close to the successor state of the robot, and the response is naturally embedded in the subsequent state. HIM has several attractive advantages: It requires only the robot's proprioceptive awareness, i.e., observation data from joint encoders and IMUs. It innovatively maintains consistent observations between simulated reference and reality, avoiding information loss in imitation learning. It utilizes batch-level information, is more robust to noise, and maintains better sampling efficiency. It requires only 1 hour of training on an RTX 4090 and allows a quadruped robot to traverse any terrain with any interference. Extensive practical experiments have proven its flexibility, even in difficult tasks.
124.Agile But Safe: Learning Collision-Free High-Speed Legged Locomotion
敏捷但安全：学习无碰撞高速腿式运动
在杂乱环境中，导航的腿式机器人必须敏捷并安全地避免与障碍物或人类发生碰撞，以高效执行任务。现有的研究要么开发保守的控制器（< 1.0 m/s）以确保安全，要么专注于敏捷性而不考虑潜在的致命碰撞。
来自卡内基梅隆大学和苏黎世联邦理工学院的学者们在本文中介绍了敏捷但安全（ABS），这是一种基于学习的控制框架，可实现四足机器人敏捷且无碰撞的运动。 ABS 涉及在障碍物中执行敏捷运动技能的敏捷策略和防止故障的恢复策略，协同实现高速和无碰撞导航。 ABS 中的策略切换由学习控制理论的到达避免价值网络控制，该网络还将恢复策略作为目标函数进行指导，从而在闭环中保护机器人。 训练过程涉及学习敏捷策略、回避价值网络、恢复策略和外部感知表示网络，所有这些都是在模拟中进行的。 这些训练有素的模块可以通过机载传感和计算直接部署在现实世界中，从而在具有静态和动态障碍物的有限室内和室外空间中实现高速和无碰撞导航。
In cluttered environments, legged robots that navigate must be agile and safely avoid collisions with obstacles or humans to perform tasks efficiently. Existing research either develops conservative controllers (< 1.0 m/s) to ensure safety or focuses on agility without considering potentially fatal collisions.
In this paper, academics from Carnegie Mellon University and ETH Zurich introduce Agile But Safe (ABS), a learning-based control framework that enables agile and collision-free movement of quadruped robots. ABS involves agility strategies to perform agile motor skills in obstacles and recovery strategies to prevent failures, synergistically enabling high-speed and collision-free navigation. Strategy switching in ABS is controlled by the arrival-avoidance value network of learning control theory, which also guides the recovery strategy as an objective function to protect the robot in a closed loop. The training process involves learning agility strategies, avoidance value networks, recovery strategies, and external perceptual representation networks, all within simulations. These trained modules can be deployed directly in the real world with onboard sensing and computing, enabling high-speed and collision-free navigation in confined indoor and outdoor spaces with static and dynamic obstacles.
125.Dexterous Legged Locomotion in Confined 3D Spaces with Reinforcement Learning
通过强化学习在有限的 3D 空间中实现灵巧的腿部运动
由于具有多个自由度，腿式机器人在复杂环境中移动时可能具有非凡的多功能性。 利用深度强化学习 (RL) 的运动控制器主要考虑机器人的腿部下方的挑战，但有关于通过有限的3D空间的研究相对较少，例如狭窄的隧道或不规则的空隙，这种会对机器人施加全方位的约束的场景。
来自德克萨斯大学和乔治梅森大学的学者们提出了一种分层运动控制器，它结合了一个经典的规划器，其任务是规划路径点以到达遥远的全局目标位置，以及一个基于强化学习的策略，该策略经过训练，通过生成低级运动命令来遵循这些路径点。 这种方法保留了策略在完整解决方案空间内探索其自身运动技能的自由，并且还避免了以端到端方式跟踪遥远的全球目标位置相关的低效率。 在模拟中，学者们的分层运动控制器成功地在要求严格的 3D 受限环境中导航，超越了端到端学习和预定义运动技能的能力，而后者在这种具有挑战性的环境中举步维艰。学者们还展示了在真实机器人上模拟学习的控制器的成功部署。
With multiple degrees of freedom, legged robots may have extraordinary versatility when moving in complex environments. Motion controllers using deep reinforcement learning (RL) mainly consider the challenges under the robot's legs, but there are relatively few studies on passing through limited 3D spaces, such as narrow tunnels or irregular gaps, which will have a negative impact on the robot. Scenarios that impose a full range of constraints.
Academics from the University of Texas and George Mason University propose a hierarchical motion controller that combines a classical planner tasked with planning waypoints to reach distant global target locations, and a reinforcement-based A learned policy is trained to follow these waypoints by generating low-level movement commands. This approach preserves the policy's freedom to explore its own motor skills within the full solution space, and also avoids the inefficiencies associated with tracking distant global target locations in an end-to-end manner. In simulations, the academics' layered motion controller successfully navigated a demanding 3D constrained environment, surpassing the ability to learn end-to-end and predefined motor skills in such challenging environments. Difficulty moving. The academics also demonstrated the successful deployment of simulated learned controllers on real robots.
126.Curriculum-Based Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Jumping: A Reference-free Design
基于课程的四足跳跃强化学习：无参考设计
深度强化学习 (DRL) 已成为掌握多功能四足跳跃技能的一种有前景的解决方案。 然而，当前基于DRL 的框架通常依赖于明确定义的参考轨迹，这些轨迹是通过捕获动物运动或从现有控制器转移经验来获得的。这项工作探索了在不模仿参考轨迹的情况下学习动态跳跃的可能性。
为此，来自英国牛津大学工程科学系研究所和代尔夫特理工大学的学者们将课程设计融入到DRL中，以逐步完成具有挑战性的任务。 从垂直原地跳跃开始，然后将学习到的策略推广到向前和对角线跳跃，最后学习跨越障碍。 根据所需的着陆位置、方向和障碍物尺寸，学者们所提出的方法有助于实现广泛的跳跃运动，包括全向跳跃和鲁棒跳跃，从而减轻了提前提取参考的工作。特别是在不受参考运动限制的情况下，学者们的实验实现了90厘米的向前跳跃，超过了现有文献中报道的类似机器人的先前记录。 此外，即使在训练阶段没有遇到过，也可以在柔软的草地上连续跳跃。
Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has emerged as a promising solution for mastering versatile quadrupedal hopping skills. However, current DRL-based frameworks often rely on well-defined reference trajectories obtained by capturing animal movements or transferring experience from existing controllers. This work explores the possibility of learning dynamic jumps without imitating reference trajectories.
To this end, scholars from the Institute of Engineering Sciences of the University of Oxford in the UK and Delft University of Technology integrated course design into DRL to gradually complete challenging tasks. Start by jumping vertically in place, then generalize the learned strategy to jumping forward and diagonally, and finally learn to jump over obstacles. Depending on the required landing position, orientation, and obstacle size, the proposed method helps achieve a wide range of jumping motions, including omnidirectional jumping and robust jumping, thereby easing the work of extracting references in advance. In particular, without being restricted by reference motion, the academics' experiment achieved a forward jump of 90 centimeters, exceeding previous records for similar robots reported in the existing literature. In addition, you can continuously jump on soft grass even if you have not encountered it during the training stage.
127.DogSurf: Quadruped Robot Capable of GRU-based Surface Recognition for Blind Person Navigation
DogSurf： 能够基于 GRU 进行盲人导航表面识别的四足机器人
本文介绍了 DogSurf - 一种使用四足机器人帮助视障人士在现实世界中导航的新方法。 来自斯科尔科沃科学研究所的学者们所提出的方法允许四足机器人检测光滑的表面，并使用音频和触觉反馈来通知用户何时停止。 针对四足机器人的多类表面分类任务，学者们提出了一种最先进的基于 GRU 的神经网络架构，平均准确率为 99.925%。 并且，学者们在 Unitree Go1 Edu 机器人上做了数据集的收集。
This article describes DogSurf - a new approach to using a quadruped robot to help visually impaired people navigate the real world. The method proposed by academics from the Skolkovo Institute of Science allows a quadruped robot to detect smooth surfaces and use audio and tactile feedback to inform the user when to stop. For the multi-category surface classification task of quadruped robots, scholars have proposed a state-of-the-art GRU-based neural network architecture with an average accuracy of 99.925%. Moreover, scholars collected data sets on the Unitree Go1 Edu robot.
128.CognitiveDog: Large Multimodal Model Based System to Translate Vision and Language into Action of Quadruped Robot
CognitiveDog： 将视觉和语言转化为四足机器人行动的大型多模态模型系统
来自斯科尔科沃科学研究所的学者们介绍了 CognitiveDog，这是一款具有大型多模态模型 (LMM) 的四足机器人的开创性开发，它不仅能够与人类进行口头交流，还能够通过物体操纵与环境进行物理交互。 该系统是在配备定制夹具的 Unitree Go1 机器狗上实现的，并展示了自主决策能力，可以独立确定最合适的动作以及与各种物体的交互，以完成用户定义的任务。 这些任务不一定包括直接指令，而是要求机器人根据自然语言输入和环境线索理解和执行它们。 本文深入研究了该系统的复杂性、数据集特征和软件架构。 这一发展的关键是机器人能够熟练地使用视觉 SLAM 进行空间导航、有效地操纵和运输物体，以及在任务执行过程中提供富有洞察力的自然语言注释。 实验结果凸显了机器人先进的任务理解能力和适应性，强调了其在现实世界应用中的潜力。
Academics from the Skolkovo Institute of Science presented CognitiveDog, a pioneering development of a quadrupedal robot with a large multimodal model (LMM) that is capable of not only communicating verbally with humans, but also physically interacting with its environment through object manipulation. The system was implemented on a Unitree Go1 robot dog equipped with customised fixtures and demonstrates autonomous decision-making capabilities to independently determine the most appropriate movements and interactions with a variety of objects to complete user-defined tasks. These tasks do not necessarily include direct commands, but require the robot to understand and execute them based on natural language inputs and environmental cues. This paper delves into the complexity, dataset characteristics and software architecture of this system. Key to this development is the ability of the robot to skilfully use vision SLAM for spatial navigation, efficiently manipulate and transport objects, and provide insightful natural language annotations during task execution. The experimental results highlight the robot's advanced task understanding and adaptability, emphasising its potential for real-world applications.
129.Expressive Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots
人形机器人富有表现力的全身控制
为了能够让类人机器人在现实世界中产生丰富、多样且富有表现力的动作，人们通常会在强化学习框架中利用来自图形社区的大规模人体动作捕捉数据。 然而，考虑到自由度和物理能力的巨大差距，直接使用动作捕捉数据集进行模仿学习在真正的人形机器人上是行不通的。
来自加州大学圣地亚哥分校的学者们提出的方法表达性全身控制（ExBody），通过鼓励上半身模仿参考运动，同时放松对两条腿的模仿约束，只要求它们稳健地遵循给定的速度来解决这个问题。 通过模拟和 Sim2Real 迁移训练，学者的策略可以控制人形机器人以不同的方式行走，与人类握手，甚至与现实世界中的人类跳舞。学者们对模拟和现实世界中的各种运动进行了广泛的研究和比较，以证明了他们方法的有效性。
To enable humanoid robots to produce rich, diverse, and expressive movements in the real world, large-scale human motion capture data from the graphics community are often leveraged in reinforcement learning frameworks. However, considering the huge gap in degrees of freedom and physical capabilities, directly using motion capture datasets for imitation learning is not feasible on real humanoid robots.
Expressive Whole Body Control (ExBody), a method proposed by scholars from the University of California, San Diego, solves this problem by encouraging the upper body to imitate the reference movement while relaxing the imitation constraints on the two legs and only requiring them to robustly follow a given speed. . Trained through simulation and Sim2Real transfer, Scholar's strategy can control humanoid robots to walk in different ways, shake hands with humans, and even dance with real-world humans. Scholars have conducted extensive research and comparisons on various motions in simulations and the real world to demonstrate the effectiveness of their methods.
130.RL + Model-based Control: Using On-demand Optimal Control to Learn Versatile Legged Locomotion
RL + 基于模型的控制 ：利用按需优化控制学习多功能腿部运动
来自苏黎世联邦理工学院的学者们提出了一个控制框架，它将基于模型的最优控制和强化学习（RL）相结合，以实现多功能且稳健的腿式运动。学者们的方法通过结合通过有限视野最优控制生成的按需参考运动来增强强化学习训练过程，涵盖广泛的速度和步态。 这些参考动作可以作为强化学习策略模仿的目标，从而开发出可以可靠学习的鲁棒控制策略。 此外，通过利用捕获全身动态的真实模拟数据，强化学习有效地克服了建模简化所带来的参考运动的固有限制。 学者们通过一系列实验验证了这个框架的内强化学习训练过程的稳健性和可控性。 在这些实验中，他们的方法展示了其泛化参考运动并有效处理更复杂的运动任务的能力，这可能会给简化模型带来挑战，这要归功于强化学习的灵活性。此外，这个框架毫不费力地支持不同维度的机器人控制策略的训练，消除了奖励函数和超参数中针对机器人的调整的必要性。
Scholars from ETH Zurich have proposed a control framework that combines model-based optimal control and reinforcement learning (RL) for versatile and robust legged locomotion. The academics' approach enhances the reinforcement learning training process by combining on-demand reference movements generated via finite-horizon optimal control, covering a wide range of velocities and gaits. These reference movements can be used as targets for imitation by the reinforcement learning strategy, leading to the development of robust control strategies that can be reliably learnt. Furthermore, by exploiting realistic simulation data capturing whole-body dynamics, reinforcement learning effectively overcomes the inherent limitations of reference motions imposed by modelling simplifications. The scholars validate the robustness and controllability of this framework's within-reinforcement learning training process through a series of experiments. In these experiments, their approach demonstrates its ability to generalise the reference motion and effectively handle more complex motion tasks, which may pose challenges to simplified models, thanks to the flexibility of reinforcement learning. Furthermore, this framework effortlessly supports the training of robot control strategies of different dimensions, eliminating the need for robot-specific tuning in reward functions and hyperparameters.
131.Deep Compliant Control for Legged Robots
腿式机器人的深度兼容控制
人们使用深度强化学习训练的控制策略通常会产生僵硬的高频运动，以应对意外的干扰。 为了促进更自然、更合规的平衡恢复策略，来自瑞士苏黎世联邦理工学院的学者们对典型的强化学习训练过程提出了一个简单的修改。学者们的主要见解是，对扰动的僵硬反应是由于智能体始终有最大化任务奖励的动机，即使在施加扰动时也是如此。 作为替代方案，他们引入了一个明确的恢复阶段，无论控制策略产生的动作如何，都会给予跟踪奖励。 这使得代理有机会在尝试执行主要任务之前逐渐从干扰中恢复。 通过深入分析，学者们强调了由此产生的控制策略的合规性，以及合规性给腿式运动带来的好处。 在他们的模拟和硬件实验中，合规策略实现了与环境更稳健、更节能、更安全的交互。
Control strategies that people train using deep reinforcement learning often produce stiff, high-frequency movements in response to unexpected perturbations. To promote a more natural and compliant equilibrium recovery strategy, academics from ETH Zurich, Switzerland, proposed a simple modification to the typical reinforcement learning training process. The scholars' main insight is that the rigid response to perturbations is due to the fact that the agent always has the motivation to maximize the task reward, even when a perturbation is imposed. As an alternative, they introduced an explicit recovery phase that gives tracking rewards regardless of the actions produced by the control policy. This gives the agent a chance to gradually recover from the disturbance before attempting to perform its main task. Through in-depth analysis, the scholars highlighted the compliance of the resulting control strategy and the benefits that compliance brings to leg movements. In their simulations and hardware experiments, compliance strategies enabled more robust, energy-efficient, and secure interactions with the environment.
132.ZSL-RPPO: Zero-Shot Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion in Challenging Terrains using Recurrent Proximal Policy Optimization
ZSL-RPPO：使用循环近端策略优化在具有挑战性的地形中进行四足运动的零样本学习
来自英国伦敦大学和中国华为以及上海华东师范大学的学者们提出了 ZSL-RPPO，这是一种改进的零样本学习架构，它克服了师生神经网络的局限性，并使四足机器人在具有挑战性的地形中生成稳健、可靠和多功能的运动。 学者们提出了一种新算法 RPPO（循环近端策略优化），它直接在部分可观察的环境中训练循环神经网络，并使用域随机化产生更稳健的训练。他们的运动控制器支持内在和外在物理参数从模拟到现实传输的广泛扰动，无需进一步微调。 这可以避免学生在模拟到现实迁移过程中表现的显着下降，从而增强运动控制器的鲁棒性和泛化性。学者们在真实环境中的 Unitree A1 和 Aliengo 机器人上部署了控制器，并由固态激光雷达或深度相机提供外感知。 他们的运动控制器在各种具有挑战性的地形（例如光滑的表面、草地地形和楼梯）中进行了测试。 学者们的实验结果和比较表明，他们所提出的方法明显优于最先进的方法。
Scholars from the University of London in the UK and Huawei in China and East China Normal University in Shanghai proposed ZSL-RPPO, an improved zero-shot learning architecture that overcomes the limitations of teacher-student neural networks and enables quadruped robots with Generate robust, reliable and versatile movement in challenging terrain. Scholars propose a new algorithm, RPPO (Recurrent Proximal Policy Optimization), which directly trains recurrent neural networks in a partially observable environment and uses domain randomization to produce more robust training. Their motion controller supports a wide range of perturbations of intrinsic and extrinsic physical parameters being transferred from simulation to reality without the need for further fine-tuning. This can avoid significant drops in student performance during simulation-to-reality transfer, thereby enhancing the robustness and generalization of the motion controller. The academics deployed controllers on Unitree A1 and Aliengo robots in real-world environments, with external sensing provided by solid-state lidar or depth cameras. Their motion controllers were tested in a variety of challenging terrains such as slippery surfaces, grassy terrain, and stairs. The scholars' experimental results and comparisons show that their proposed method is significantly better than the state-of-the-art methods.
133.GAMMA: Graspability-Aware Mobile MAnipulation Policy Learning based on Online Grasping Pose Fusion
GAMMA：基于在线抓取姿势融合的抓取能力感知移动操纵策略学习
移动操纵是机器人助手的一项基本任务，并在机器人界引起了极大的关注。 移动操纵固有的一个关键挑战是在接近目标进行抓取时有效观察目标。 在这项工作中，来自北京大学和同济大学的学者们提出了一种可抓取性感知的移动操作方法，该方法由在线抓取姿势融合框架提供支持，可以实现时间一致的抓取观察。 具体来说，预测的抓取姿势是在线组织的，以消除冗余的异常抓取姿势，这些姿势可以被编码为抓取姿势观察状态以进行强化学习。 此外，动态融合抓取姿势可以直接评估可抓取性，包括抓取姿势的数量和质量。
Mobile manipulation is a fundamental task for robotic assistants and has attracted significant attention in the robotics community. A key challenge inherent in mobile manipulation is effectively observing the target while approaching it for grasping. In this work, scholars from Peking University and Tongji University propose a graspability-aware mobile manipulation method powered by an online grasping gesture fusion framework that enables time-consistent grasping observations. Specifically, the predicted grasp poses are organized online to eliminate redundant anomalous grasp poses, which can be encoded into grasp pose observation states for reinforcement learning. Furthermore, dynamic fusion of grasping poses allows for direct assessment of graspability, including the quantity and quality of grasping poses.
134.MorAL: Learning Morphologically Adaptive Locomotion Controllerfor Quadruped on Challenging Terrain
MorAL：在具有挑战性的地形上学习四足动物的形态自适应运动控制器
Analytical solution to a time-varying LIP model for quadrupedal walking on a vertically oscillating surface
垂直振荡表面四足行走时变 LIP 模型的解析解
来自马萨诸塞大学和NVIDIA 研究中心以及普渡大学的学者们，在本文中介绍了一种在动态刚性表面（DRS）上运动时，腿式机器人动力学的分析易处理且计算高效的模型，以及近似解析解和基于该模型和解合成的实时行走模式生成器。 通过放宽静态表面假设，学者们将静态表面上腿式运动的经典时不变线性倒立摆 (LIP) 模型扩展到动态表面运动，基于Floquet理论，他们得到了时变DRS-LIP模型稳定性的充分必要条件。
该模型还被转换为 Mathieu 方程，以得出近似解析解，该解以相对较低的计算成本提供合理的精度。 使用扩展模型及其解决方案，开发了行走模式生成器，以有效规划在垂直振荡表面上四足行走的物理可行轨迹。 最后，学者们通过 Laikago 四足机器人在俯仰跑步机上行走（最大垂直加速度为 1 m/s2）的仿真和硬件实验证实了，在各种表面运动和步态参数下，他们所提出的解析解的准确性和效率，以及算法的效率、可行性和鲁棒性。
In this paper, scholars from the University of Massachusetts and NVIDIA Research Center and Purdue University introduce an analytically tractable and computationally efficient model for the dynamics of legged robots when moving on dynamically rigid surfaces (DRS), as well as an approximation Analytical solution and a real-time walking pattern generator based on this model and solution synthesis. By relaxing the static surface assumption, scholars extended the classic time-invariant linear inverted pendulum (LIP) model of leg motion on a static surface to dynamic surface motion. Based on Floquet theory, they obtained sufficient stability of the time-varying DRS-LIP model. Necessary conditions.
The model is also converted into Mathieu equations to derive an approximate analytical solution that provides reasonable accuracy at a relatively low computational cost. Using the extended model and its solution, a walking pattern generator is developed to efficiently plan physically feasible trajectories for quadrupedal walking on vertical oscillating surfaces. Finally, the scholars confirmed through simulations and hardware experiments of the Laikago quadruped robot walking on a pitch treadmill (maximum vertical acceleration of 1 m/s2) that under various surface motion and gait parameters, the analytical solution they proposed is Accuracy and efficiency, as well as algorithm efficiency, feasibility and robustness.
Quadruped-Frog: Rapid Online Optimization of Continuous Quadruped Jumping
Quadruped-Frog：连续四足跳跃的快速在线优化
腿式机器人在表现出奔跑和跳跃等动态行为方面变得越来越敏捷。 通常，此类行为要么通过基于模型的轨迹优化，要么通过涉及数百万个模拟交互时间步的基于深度学习的方法进行离线优化和设计（即，在需要之前设计该行为）。 值得注意的是，这种离线设计的运动控制器无法完美地模拟系统的真实动态，例如电机动态。
来自洛桑联邦理工学院的学者们考虑了在线快速优化的四足跳跃任务。他们设计的足部受力曲线仅由几个参数参数化，并通过贝叶斯优化直接在硬件上进行优化。 在关节级别跟踪力分布，并将其添加到笛卡尔 PD 阻抗控制和虚拟模型控制中以稳定跳跃运动。 经过优化后，只需少量的跳跃，学者们表明该控制架构能够进行多样化的全向跳跃，包括向前、横向和扭转（转向）跳跃，即使在不平坦的地形上，也使 Unitree Go1 四足动物跳跃 0.5 m 高，向前 0.5 m，跳转超过 2 rad。
Legged robots are becoming increasingly agile in exhibiting dynamic behaviors such as running and jumping. Typically, such behavior is optimized and designed offline (i.e., designing the behavior before it is needed) either through model-based trajectory optimization or through deep learning-based methods involving millions of simulated interaction time steps. It is worth noting that this offline designed motion controller cannot perfectly simulate the real dynamics of the system, such as motor dynamics.
Academics from Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne considered a quadrupedal hopping task that could be rapidly optimized online. The foot force curve they designed was parameterized by only a few parameters and optimized directly on the hardware through Bayesian optimization. Force distribution is tracked at the joint level and added to Cartesian PD impedance control and virtual model control to stabilize jump motion. After being optimized to require only a small number of jumps, the academics showed that the control architecture is capable of diverse omnidirectional jumps, including forward, sideways and twisting (turning) jumps, making the Unitree Go1 Quad even on uneven terrain. The pod jumps 0.5 m high and 0.5 m forward, with a jump of more than 2 rad.
137.Barrier Functions Inspired Reward Shaping for Reinforcement Learning
障碍函数启发强化学习的奖励塑造
强化学习（RL）已经从简单的控制任务发展到具有大状态空间的复杂现实世界挑战，但训练时间仍然是一个限制。 奖励塑造是一种流行的解决方案，但现有方法通常依赖于价值函数，这面临可扩展性问题。
来自印度理工学院和印度科学研究所的学者们提出了一种新颖的、以安全为导向的奖励塑造框架，其灵感来自障碍函数，在各种环境和任务中提供简单性和易于实施性。 为了评估所提出的奖励公式的有效性，学者们进行了模拟实验，并在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上进行了实际部署。结果表明，与普通奖励相比，学者们的方法的收敛速度提高了 1.4-2.8 倍，驱动工作量低至 50-60%。并且，在 Go1 机器人的模拟真实实验中，他们通过奖励框架展示了机器人更好的控制和动态。
Reinforcement learning (RL) has evolved from simple control tasks to complex real-world challenges with large state spaces, but training time remains a limitation. Reward shaping is a popular solution, but existing methods often rely on value functions, which face scalability issues.
Academics from the Indian Institutes of Technology and the Indian Institute of Science propose a novel, safety-oriented reward shaping framework inspired by barrier functions that offers simplicity and ease of implementation in a variety of environments and tasks. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed reward formula, the academics conducted simulation experiments and actual deployment on the Unitree Go1 quadruped robot. Results show that the academics' approach converges 1.4-2.8 times faster than normal rewards, driving effort as low as 50-60%. And, in simulated real-world experiments on the Go1 robot, they demonstrated better control and dynamics of the robot through the reward framework.
138.Learning Quadrupedal Locomotion with Impaired Joints Using Random Joint Masking
利用随机关节屏蔽学习关节受损的四足运动
四足机器人凭借其灵活的运动能力，在从结构化环境到复杂恶劣地形的各种环境中发挥了至关重要的作用。 然而，如果由于外部事故或内部故障而损坏，这些机器人很容易失去运动功能。
本文中，来自卡内基梅隆大学的学者们提出了一种新颖的深度强化学习框架，使四足机器人能够在关节受损的情况下行走。 所提出的框架由三个组成部分组成：1）用于模拟受损关节场景的随机关节掩蔽策略，2）用于根据过去的观察历史预测当前关节状况的隐式状态的关节状态估计器，以及3）渐进式课程学习以允许 一个网络可以执行正常步态和各种关节受损的步态。 学者们验证了他们的框架使 Unitree 的 Go1 机器人能够在现实室内和室外环境中的各种受损关节条件下行走。
Quadruped robots play a vital role in various environments ranging from structured environments to complex and harsh terrains due to their flexible locomotion capabilities. However, these robots can easily lose their locomotor functions if damaged due to external accidents or internal malfunctions.
In this paper, scholars from Carnegie Mellon University propose a novel deep reinforcement learning framework to enable quadruped robots to walk despite damaged joints. The proposed framework consists of three components: 1) a stochastic joint masking strategy for simulating damaged joint scenarios, 2) a joint state estimator for predicting the implicit state of the current joint condition based on past observation history, and 3) Progressive course learning to allow a network that can perform both normal gait and various joint-impaired gaits. The academics demonstrated that their framework enables Unitree's Go1 robot to walk under a variety of compromised joint conditions in realistic indoor and outdoor environments.
139.Learning Generalizable Feature Fields for Mobile Manipulation
学习移动操作的可推广特征字段
移动操纵中的一个悬而未决的问题是如何以统一的方式表示对象和场景，以便机器人可以使用它在环境中导航和操纵对象。 后者需要捕获复杂的几何形状，同时理解细粒度的语义，而前者则涉及捕获继承到广泛物理尺度的复杂性。
在这项工作中，来自加州大学圣地亚哥分校和卡内基梅隆大学以及麻省理工学院的学者们提出了 GeFF（可泛化特征场），这是一种场景级可泛化神经特征场，可作为实时执行的导航和操作的统一表示。 为此，学者们将生成新颖的视图合成视为预训练任务，然后通过 CLIP 特征蒸馏将生成的丰富场景先验与自然语言对齐。 他们通过在配备机械手的四足机器人上部署 GeFF 来证明这种方法的有效性。 并且评估了 GeFF 泛化到开放集对象的能力以及在动态场景中执行开放词汇移动操作时的运行时间。
An open question in mobile manipulation is how to represent objects and scenes in a unified way so that robots can use it to navigate and manipulate objects in the environment. The latter requires capturing complex geometries while understanding fine-grained semantics, while the former involves capturing complexity inherited to broad physical scales.
In this work, scholars from UC San Diego and Carnegie Mellon University, as well as MIT, propose GeFF (Generalizable Feature Field), a scene-level generalizable neural feature field that Serves as a unified representation of navigation and operations performed in real time. To this end, scholars consider generating novel view synthesis as a pre-training task, and then align the generated rich scene priors with natural language via CLIP feature distillation. They demonstrated the effectiveness of this approach by deploying GeFF on a quadruped robot equipped with a manipulator. We evaluate GeFF's ability to generalize to open-set objects and its running time when performing open-vocabulary move operations in dynamic scenarios.
140.Perceive With Confidence ：Statistical Safety Assurances for Navigation with Learning-Based Perception
充满信心地感知：基于学习的感知的导航统计安全保证
感知领域的快速进步使得大型预训练模型能够开箱即用，将世界的高维、噪声和部分观察结果处理为丰富的几何表示（例如，占用率预测）。 然而，由于在不熟悉的环境中缺乏可靠的性能，将这些模型安全地集成到机器人上仍然具有挑战性。
在这项工作中，来自普林斯顿大学的学者们提出了一个框架，用于严格量化用于占用预测的预训练感知模型的不确定性，以便为导航提供端到端的统计安全保证。学者们以共形预测技术为基础，生成一个校准感知系统，该系统可以轻松处理预训练模型的输出，同时确保感知输出与规划器结合使用时对新环境的泛化以及对状态分布变化的鲁棒性。 校准系统可以与任何安全规划器结合使用，以用户指定的阈值 1−ϵ 为新环境中的安全性提供端到端的统计保证。 学者们通过模拟实验和硬件实验来评估由此产生的方法（他们将其称为“自信感知”（PwC）），其中四足机器人在包含训练或校准过程中看不见的物体的室内环境中导航。 这些实验证明与基线相比，经验安全率有显著改善。
Rapid advances in perception have enabled large pre-trained models to be used out of the box to process high-dimensional, noisy, and partial observations of the world into rich geometric representations (e.g., occupancy predictions). However, safely integrating these models onto robots remains challenging due to a lack of reliable performance in unfamiliar environments.
In this work, academics from Princeton University propose a framework for rigorously quantifying the uncertainty of pretrained perception models for occupancy prediction in order to provide end-to-end statistical safety guarantees for navigation. The scholars used conformal prediction techniques as a basis to generate a calibrated perception system that can easily handle the output of the pre-trained model, while ensuring that the perception output generalizes to new environments and is robust to changes in state distribution when used in conjunction with a planner. Great sex. The calibration system can be used in conjunction with any security planner to provide end-to-end statistical guarantees for security in new environments at a user-specified threshold 1−ϵ. The academics evaluated the resulting approach, which they termed Perception with Confidence (PwC), through simulation and hardware experiments in which a quadruped robot navigates an indoor environment containing objects that were unseen during training or calibration. . These experiments demonstrated significant improvements in empirical safety rates compared to baseline.
141.Learning Safer Footstep Planning Policies for Legged Robots via Model-Based Priors
通过基于模型的先验学习腿式机器人更安全的足迹规划策略
来自意大利热那亚研究所的学者们提出了一种四足运动的足迹规划策略，能够在决策中直接考虑先验安全信息。 其核心是学习过程分析地形块，根据运动学可行性、胫骨碰撞和地形粗糙度对每个着陆位置进行分类。 然后，该信息被编码为小向量表示，并作为附加状态传递给足迹规划策略，该策略还通过应用近端策略优化算法的屏蔽变体仅提出安全的足迹位置。 通过对电动四足机器人在不同崎岖地形场景中行走的比较模拟和实验证明了所提出方法的性能。实验表明，在训练和策略的连续部署过程中，违反上述安全条件的情况都大大减少，从而产生了本质上更安全的足迹规划器。 此外，学者们还展示了实验的副产品，即如何需要更少的奖励条件来塑造策略的行为，从而能够实现更好的最终性能和样本效率。
Scholars from the Institute of Genoa, Italy, proposed a footprint planning strategy for quadrupedal locomotion that can directly consider a priori safety information in decision-making. At its core is a learning process that analyzes patches of terrain, classifying each landing position based on kinematic feasibility, shin impact and terrain roughness. This information is then encoded into a small vector representation and passed as additional state to the footprint planning strategy, which also proposes only safe footprint locations by applying a masked variant of the proximal policy optimization algorithm. The performance of the proposed method is demonstrated through comparative simulations and experiments on an electric quadruped robot walking in different rough terrain scenarios. Experiments show that violations of the above security conditions are significantly reduced during both training and continuous deployment of the policy, resulting in an intrinsically safer footprint planner. Additionally, the academics show how, as a by-product of the experiments, fewer reward conditions are needed to shape the behavior of the policy, enabling better final performance and sample efficiency.
142.PA-LOCO: Learning Perturbation-Adaptive Locomotion for Quadruped Robots
PA-LOCO：四足机器人的学习扰动自适应运动
许多运动控制器都是基于强化学习（RL）设计的，以促进盲人四足运动穿越具有挑战性的地形。 然而，对于在不可预见的干扰中穿越不同地形的四足机器人来说，运动控制仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。 最近，基于师生架构，特权学习已被用来学习在各种地形上可靠且鲁棒的四足运动。 然而，其单编码器结构不足以解决外力扰动。 由于教师策略的特征编码器和学生策略的特征编码器之间的特征嵌入差异，学生策略将不可避免地出现性能下降。 因此，来自中山大学的学者们提出了一种具有多个特征编码器和残差策略网络的特权学习框架，用于在各种外部扰动下实现稳健可靠的四足动物运动。 多编码器结构可以将潜在特征与不同的特权信息解耦，最终提高学习策略的鲁棒性、稳定性和可靠性。 使用大量模拟数据深入分析所提出的特征编码模块的效率。 残差策略网络的引入有助于减轻试图克隆教师策略行为的学生策略所经历的性能下降。 学者们将所提出的框架在 Unitree GO1 机器人上进行了评估，通过在不同地形上进行的广泛实验，展示了其相对于最先进的特权学习算法的性能增强。 进行消融研究是为了说明剩余政策网络的效率。
Many motion controllers are designed based on reinforcement learning (RL) to facilitate quadrupedal locomotion for blind people across challenging terrains. However, motion control remains a challenging task for quadruped robots traversing different terrains amid unforeseen disturbances. Recently, privileged learning based on a teacher-student architecture has been used to learn reliable and robust quadrupedal locomotion on various terrains. However, its single encoder structure is not sufficient to resolve external force disturbances. Due to the feature embedding differences between the feature encoder for the teacher policy and the feature encoder for the student policy, the student policy will inevitably experience performance degradation. Therefore, scholars from Sun Yat-sen University proposed a privileged learning framework with multiple feature encoders and residual policy networks for achieving robust and reliable quadruped motion under various external perturbations. The multi-encoder structure can decouple latent features from different privileged information, ultimately improving the robustness, stability, and reliability of the learning strategy. An in-depth analysis of the efficiency of the proposed feature encoding module is conducted using extensive simulation data. The introduction of residual policy networks helps mitigate the performance degradation experienced by student policies that attempt to clone the teacher's policy behavior. The academics evaluated the proposed framework on the Unitree GO1 robot, demonstrating its performance enhancement over state-of-the-art privilege learning algorithms through extensive experiments on different terrains. Ablation studies are performed to illustrate the efficiency of the remaining policy network.
143.Learning Force Control for Legged Manipulation
学习腿部操纵的力控制
在交互过程中控制接触力是运动和操纵任务的固有要求。目前的强化学习运动和操纵方法隐含地依赖于强有力的交互来完成任务，但没有明确地对其进行调节。
本文中，来自麻省理工的学者们提出了一种强化学习任务规范，重点关注匹配了所需的接触力水平。学者们将力控制与机器人身体和手臂的协调相结合，提出了一种腿式机械臂控制的端到端策略。这个策略能够实现顺从的夹具和全身拉动运动，并且这些运动之前尚未使用学习策略进行过演示。 此外，在实验中，学者们根据在模拟和现实世界中的表现，表明了这个策略在执行关键任务方面的性能潜力。
Controlling contact forces during interactions is an inherent requirement of locomotion and manipulation tasks. Current reinforcement learning methods for motion and manipulation implicitly rely on strong interactions to complete tasks but do not explicitly regulate them.
In this paper, scholars from MIT propose a reinforcement learning task specification that focuses on matching the required contact force level. The scholars combined force control with the coordination of the robot body and arms and proposed an end-to-end strategy for legged robotic arm control. This strategy enables compliant clamp and whole-body pulling movements that have not been previously demonstrated using a learning strategy. Furthermore, in experiments, the academics demonstrated the performance potential of this strategy in performing critical tasks based on performance in simulations and the real world.
144.On the Benefits of GPU Sample-Based Stochastic Predictive
基于 GPU 样本的随机预测控制器对腿式运动的好处
四足机器人具有出色的机动性，能够灵活地在复杂的地形中导航。 然而，其复杂的控制系统带来的挑战仍远未得到完全解决。 在本文中，来自意大利理工学院和伦敦大学的学者们介绍了四足机器人基于样本的随机控制策略的使用，作为传统最优控制律的替代方案。 学者们证明了基于样本的随机方法，在 GPU 加速的支持下，可以有效地应用于真实的四足机器人。在这项工作中，他们专注于实现步态频率适应，这是基于梯度的方法的四足运动的一个显着挑战。 为了验证基于样本的随机控制器的有效性，学者们测试了四足机器人的两种不同方法，并将它们与传统的基于梯度的模型预测控制系统进行比较。研究结果在模拟和真实的 21 公斤 Aliengo 四足动物上得到了验证，表明当机器人受到零或中等干扰时，他们的方法与传统的模型预测控制策略相当，而在处理持续的干扰方面，它超越了基于梯度的方法。 由于可以在其制定中实现简单的步态适应策略，因此可以消除外部干扰。
Quadruped robots have excellent maneuverability and can flexibly navigate complex terrains. However, the challenges posed by its complex control systems are still far from being completely solved. In this paper, academics from the Italian Institute of Technology and the University of London introduce the use of sample-based stochastic control strategies for quadruped robots as an alternative to traditional optimal control laws. Scholars demonstrated that sample-based stochastic methods, with the support of GPU acceleration, can be effectively applied to real quadruped robots. In this work, they focus on achieving gait frequency adaptation, a significant challenge for quadrupedal locomotion with gradient-based methods. To verify the effectiveness of the sample-based stochastic controller, the academics tested two different methods on a quadruped robot and compared them with traditional gradient-based model predictive control systems. The results were validated on both simulated and real 21kg Aliengo quadrupeds, showing that their approach was comparable to traditional model predictive control strategies when the robot was subjected to zero or moderate disturbances, while it exceeded it in handling sustained disturbances. gradient-based method. Since simple gait adaptation strategies can be implemented in their formulation, external interference can be eliminated.
145.VBC: Visual Whole-Body Controlfor Legged Loco-Manipulation
VBC：腿部局部操纵的视觉全身控制
来自加州大学和上海交通大学以及复旦大学的学者们研究使用配备手臂的腿式机器人进行移动操纵的问题，即腿式局部操纵。 机器人的腿部虽然通常用于移动，但通过进行全身控制提供了增强操纵能力的机会。 也就是说，机器人可以同时控制腿和手臂，以扩展其工作空间。学者们提出了一个可以通过视觉观察自主进行全身控制的框架。 这个方法，即视觉全身控制（VBC），由使用所有自由度来跟踪末端执行器操纵器位置的低级策略和基于视觉输入建议末端执行器位置的高级策略组成。学者们在模拟中训练了两个级别的策略，并为真实的机器人部署执行 Sim2Real 传输。他们进行了广泛的实验，并显示在拾取不同配置（高度、位置、方向）和环境中的各种物体方面比基线有了显着改进。
Scholars from the University of California, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and Fudan University studied the problem of mobile manipulation using legged robots equipped with arms, known as legged local manipulation. Robot legs, although typically used for locomotion, offer the opportunity to enhance manipulation capabilities by enabling full-body control. That is, the robot can control both legs and arms simultaneously to expand its workspace. Scholars propose a framework that enables autonomous whole-body control through visual observation. This approach, visual whole-body control (VBC), consists of a low-level strategy that uses all degrees of freedom to track the end-effector manipulator position and a high-level strategy that suggests the end-effector position based on visual input. The academics trained two levels of policies in simulations and performed Sim2Real transfers for real robot deployments. They conducted extensive experiments and showed significant improvements over baselines in picking up a variety of objects in different configurations (height, position, orientation) and environments.
146.LocoMan: Advancing Versatile Quadrupedal Dexterity with Lightweight Loco-Manipulators
LocoMan：利用轻型机械手提高四足的多功能灵活性
四足机器人已成为能够在复杂环境中移动和操纵的多功能代理，传统设计通常依赖于机器人固有的身体部位或结合顶部安装的手臂来执行操作任务。 然而，这些配置在杂乱或受限的空间中可能会限制机器人的操作灵活性、效率和适应性。
在这项工作中，来自卡内基梅隆大学和华盛顿大学的学者们展示了 LocoMan，一种灵巧的四足机器人，具有新颖的形态，可以在各种受限环境中执行多功能操作。 通过在 Unitree Go1 机器人的前小腿上配备两个低成本、轻量级模块化 3 自由度局部机械手，LocoMan 利用腿部和夹具的综合移动性和功能性来执行需要末端执行器精确 6D 定位的复杂操纵任务。为了利用 LocoMan 的机器人操纵功能，学者们引入了一个统一的控制框架，该框架扩展了全身控制器（WBC）以集成机器人操纵器的动力学。 通过实验，他们验证了所提出的全身控制器能够准确、稳定地遵循末端执行器和躯干所需的 6D 轨迹，与设计的大工作空间相结合，可以促进各种具有挑战性的灵巧局部操纵任务，例如在密闭空间中，例如开门、插入插座、在狭窄和低洼的空间中拾取物体以及双手操作。
Quadruped robots have emerged as versatile agents capable of moving and maneuvering in complex environments, with traditional designs often relying on the robot's inherent body parts or incorporating top-mounted arms to perform manipulation tasks. However, these configurations may limit the robot's operational flexibility, efficiency, and adaptability in cluttered or confined spaces.
In this work, academics from Carnegie Mellon University and the University of Washington demonstrate LocoMan, a dexterous quadruped robot with a novel morphology that can perform multifunctional operations in a variety of constrained environments. By equipping the Unitree Go1 robot's front lower legs with two low-cost, lightweight modular 3-DOF local manipulators, LocoMan leverages the combined mobility and functionality of the legs and gripper to perform complex tasks requiring precise 6D positioning of the end-effector. Manipulation tasks. To exploit the robot manipulation capabilities of LocoMan, the scholars introduced a unified control framework that extends the whole body controller (WBC) to integrate the dynamics of the robot manipulator. Through experiments, they verified that the proposed full-body controller can accurately and stably follow the required 6D trajectories of the end-effector and torso, which, combined with the designed large workspace, can facilitate various challenging dexterous local manipulation tasks. , such as in confined spaces, such as opening doors, plugging into sockets, picking up objects in narrow and low-lying spaces, and using both hands.
147.Slip Detection and Recovery for Quadruped Robots via Hybrid Position/Force Control
通过混合位置力控制实现四足机器人的滑动检测和恢复
传统的腿式机器人的控制方法是假设脚接触期间没有滑动运动的。然而，这种假设在湿滑接触条件下不再成立，在这种情况下，由于足部牵引力的丧失，运动的稳定性将受到显着损害。
在本文中，来自中国科学技术大学的学者们设计了一个滑动检测器与用于滑动恢复的混合位置/力控制器相结合。 滑动检测器结合了末端执行器的横向速度和位移，以稳健地估计发生滑动的可能性。 然后，混合控制器将滑腿恢复任务分解为水平面的位置控制和垂直方向的力控制。 前者通过阻抗控制稳定打滑的腿，防止其偏离，后者提供垂直地面反作用力（GRF）以保持支撑机器人的躯干。 学者们还证明，所提出的混合控制器可用于测量接触表面的摩擦系数，从而允许在模型预测控制（MPC）运动中进行先发制人的参数调整，以防止潜在的滑动。 并且，学者们使用了 Unitree A1 四足机器人对他们提出的方法的性能进行了实验验证。
Traditional control methods for legged robots assume no sliding motion during foot contact. However, this assumption no longer holds true in slippery contact conditions, where stability of movement is significantly compromised due to the loss of foot traction.
In this paper, scholars from the University of Science and Technology of China design a slip detector combined with a hybrid position/force controller for slip recovery. The slip detector combines the lateral velocity and displacement of the end effector to robustly estimate the likelihood of slip. The hybrid controller then decomposes the sliding leg recovery task into position control in the horizontal plane and force control in the vertical direction. The former stabilizes the slipping leg through impedance control and prevents it from deflecting, and the latter provides vertical ground reaction force (GRF) to maintain support for the robot's torso. The academics also demonstrated that the proposed hybrid controller can be used to measure the friction coefficient of contact surfaces, allowing preemptive parameter adjustments in model predictive control (MPC) motion to prevent potential slippage. Moreover, the scholars used the Unitree A1 quadruped robot to experimentally verify the performance of their proposed method.
148.Adaptive Energy Regularization for Autonomous Gait Transition and Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion
用于自主步态转换和节能四足运动的自适应能量正则化
在腿式机器人运动的强化学习中，制定有效的奖励策略至关重要。  借鉴人类和动物的自然运动行为，调整其步态以最大限度地减少能量消耗，来自加州大学的学者们提出了一种简化的、以能量为中心的奖励策略，以促进四足机器人在不同速度下的节能运动的发展。 通过实施自适应能量奖励函数并根据速度调整权重，学者们证明了他们的方法使 ANYmal-C 和 Unitree Go1 机器人能够自主选择适当的步态，例如以较低速度四节拍行走和以较高速度小跑。与以前使用复杂奖励设计和先验步态知识的方法相比，它提高了能源效率和稳定的速度跟踪。学者们的策略的有效性通过 IsaacGym 模拟环境和真实机器人的模拟得到验证，展示了其促进稳定和自适应运动的潜力。
In reinforcement learning of legged robot locomotion, it is crucial to develop an effective reward strategy. Drawing on the natural locomotor behavior of humans and animals, which adjust their gaits to minimize energy consumption, scholars from the University of California proposed a simplified, energy-centered reward strategy to promote quadruped robots at different speeds. development of the energy-saving movement. By implementing an adaptive energy reward function and adjusting weights based on speed, the academics demonstrated that their approach enables ANYmal-C and Unitree Go1 robots to autonomously select appropriate gaits, such as four-beat walking at a lower speed and trotting at a higher speed. . Compared with previous methods using complex reward designs and prior gait knowledge, it improves energy efficiency and stable speed tracking. The effectiveness of the academics' strategy was verified through simulations of the IsaacGym simulation environment and a real robot, demonstrating its potential to promote stable and adaptive locomotion.
149.Sailing Through Point Clouds: Safe Navigation Using Point Cloud Based Control Barrier Functions
穿越点云：使用基于点云的控制屏障功能进行安全导航
在现实场景中部署机器人系统时，在非结构化环境中安全导航的能力至关重要。 最近，基于控制屏障函数（CBF）的方法在合成安全关键控制器方面非常有效。来自纽约大学和坦登工程学院的学者们提出了一种新颖的基于 CBF 的局部规划器，由两个组件组成：Vessel 和 Mariner。 Vessel 是一种基于缩放因子的新型 CBF 公式，仅使用点云数据来合成 CBF。 Mariner 是一个基于 CBF 的预览控制框架，用于缓解导航过程中陷入虚假平衡的情况。 为了证明他们提出的方法的有效性，学者们首先将提出的基于点云的 CBF 公式与其他基于点云的 CBF 公式进行比较。 然后，通过在各种环境中对 Unitree B1 和 Unitree Go2 四足机器人进行实验研究，展示了他们提出的方法的性能及其与全局规划器的集成。
When deploying robotic systems in real-world scenarios, the ability to safely navigate unstructured environments is critical. Recently, control barrier function (CBF) based methods have been very effective in synthesizing safety-critical controllers. Scholars from New York University and the Tandon School of Engineering propose a novel CBF-based local planner consisting of two components: Vessel and Mariner. Vessel is a novel CBF formulation based on scaling factors that uses only point cloud data to synthesize CBF. Mariner is a CBF-based preview control framework that is used to alleviate the situation of being stuck in false equilibrium during navigation. To prove the effectiveness of their proposed method, the scholars first compared the proposed point cloud-based CBF formula with other point cloud-based CBF formulas. Then, the performance of their proposed method and its integration with a global planner are demonstrated through experimental studies on Unitree B1 and Unitree Go2 quadruped robots in various environments.
150.Viability Leads to the Emergence of Gait Transitions in Learning Agile Quadrupedal Locomotion on Challenging Terrains
在挑战性地形上学习敏捷四足运动时，生存能力导致步态转换的出现
四足动物能够在不同步态之间无缝过渡，虽然能源效率似乎是改变步态的原因之一，但其他决定因素，包括地形特性，也可能发挥作用。
在本文中，来自洛桑联邦理工学院的学者们提出，生存能力即避免跌倒步态转换的重要标准。学者利用深度强化学习和机器人工具，通过脊髓上驱动器（大脑）、脊髓的中央模式发生器、身体和外感受传感之间的相互作用来研究步态转变的出现。 与四足动物数据一致，实验表明四足机器人在平坦地形上的步行-小跑步态过渡提高了生存能力和能源效率。 此外，学者们还研究了离散地形（即跨越连续间隙）对步态转换的影响，并发现了小跑-普朗克转换的出现，以避免不可行的状态。 生存能力是在平坦和离散间隙地形上步态转换后唯一改进的因素，这表明生存能力可能是步态转换的主要和普遍目标，而其他标准是次要目标和/或生存能力的结果。并且，他们的实验证明了四足动物在具有挑战性的场景中具有最先进的敏捷性。
Quadrupeds are able to transition seamlessly between different gaits, and while energy efficiency appears to be one of the reasons for altered gaits, other determinants, including terrain characteristics, may also play a role.
In this article, academics from Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne propose that survivability is an important criterion for gait transition in order to avoid falls. Researchers use deep reinforcement learning and robotics tools to study the emergence of gait transitions through the interaction between supraspinal drives (the brain), the spinal cord's central pattern generator, the body, and exteroceptive sensing. Consistent with the quadruped data, experiments show that the walk-to-trot gait transition of a quadruped robot on flat terrain improves survivability and energy efficiency. In addition, scholars also studied the effect of discrete terrain (i.e., spanning continuous gaps) on gait transitions and discovered the occurrence of trot-Planck transitions to avoid infeasible states. Survivability was the only factor that improved after gait transition on both flat and discrete gap terrain, suggesting that survivability may be the primary and universal goal of gait transition, whereas other criteria are secondary goals and/or the result of survivability. And, their experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art agility of quadrupeds in challenging scenarios.
Sound Matters: Auditory Detectability of Mobile Robots
声音很重要：移动机器人的听觉可探测性
在嘈杂的环境中例如在医疗保健或公共场所，移动机器人越来越多地用于对社交目的提供支持。由于这些机器人也在人类视线之外运行，因此出现了不同的机器人类型、环境噪声或认知参与如何影响机器人声音检测的问题。        为了解决这一研究空白，来自德国波恩大学和美茵茨大学的学者们进行了一项用户研究，测量轮式机器人 (Turtlebot 2i) 和四足机器人 (Unitree Go 1) 的听觉检测距离，这两种机器人在移动时会发出不同的相应声音。 此外，学者们还在研究过程中控制了背景噪音水平和参与者对次要任务的参与程度。 实验结果表明，四足机器人声音的检测效果明显优于轮式机器人（即，在更大的距离处），这表明运动机制对听觉可检测性具有有意义的影响。 随着背景噪音的增加，两个机器人的可检测性都显着下降。 但即使在高背景噪音中，参与者也能在更远的距离处检测到四足机器人。 参与次要任务几乎没有任何影响。 从本质上讲，这些发现强调了区分不同机器人的听觉特征对于改善移动机器人在嘈杂环境中以人为中心的平稳导航的关键作用。
Mobile robots are increasingly used to support social purposes in noisy environments such as healthcare or public spaces. Since these robots also operate out of human sight, the question arises of how different robot types, environmental noise, or cognitive engagement affect robot sound detection. To address this research gap, scholars from the Universities of Bonn and Mainz in Germany conducted a user study to measure the auditory detection distance of a wheeled robot (Turtlebot 2i) and a quadruped robot (Unitree Go 1), both of which The robot makes different corresponding sounds as it moves. In addition, the researchers controlled background noise levels and participants' involvement in secondary tasks during the study. Experimental results show that sound detection by a quadruped robot is significantly better than that by a wheeled robot (i.e., at greater distances), suggesting that locomotion mechanisms have a meaningful impact on auditory detectability. As background noise increases, the detectability of both robots decreases significantly. But even in high background noise, participants were able to detect the quadruped robot at greater distances. Participating in secondary missions has almost no repercussions. Essentially, these findings highlight the critical role of differentiating the auditory signatures of different robots in improving smooth human-centric navigation of mobile robots in noisy environments.
152.Simultaneous State Estimation and Contact Detection for Legged Robots by Multiple-Model Kalman Filtering
通过多模型卡尔曼滤波对腿式机器人进行同步状态估计和接触检测
来自三菱电机研究实验室的学者们提出了一种腿式机器人接触检测和状态估计相结合的算法。学者们所提出的算法将机器人的运动建模为切换系统，其中不同的模式与与地面接触的不同脚相关。 该算法的关键要素是交互的多模型卡尔曼滤波器，它可以识别定义接触的当前活动模式，同时估计状态。 学者们所提出的估计框架的基本原理是接触（和接触力）影响机器人的状态，反之亦然。 本文介绍了四足动物的验证研究，使用高保真模拟器 Gazebo 与地面真实值和基线估计器进行比较，以及用 Unitree A1 机器人进行硬件实验。 仿真研究表明，所提出的算法优于基线估计器，后者不能同时检测接触。 硬件实验展示了所提出算法的适用性，并强调了检测接触的能力。
Scholars from Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratory proposed an algorithm that combines contact detection and state estimation for legged robots. The algorithm proposed by the academics models the robot's motion as a switching system, where different modes are associated with different feet in contact with the ground. The key element of the algorithm is an interactive multi-model Kalman filter, which identifies the current activity pattern that defines the contact while estimating the state. The basic principle of the estimation framework proposed by the scholars is that contact (and contact force) affects the state of the robot and vice versa. This paper presents a validation study on quadrupeds, comparisons with ground truth and baseline estimators using the high-fidelity simulator Gazebo, and hardware experiments with the Unitree A1 robot. Simulation studies show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the baseline estimator, which cannot simultaneously detect contacts. Hardware experiments demonstrate the applicability of the proposed algorithm and highlight the ability to detect contacts.
153.Spatio-Temporal Motion Retargeting for Quadruped Robots
四足机器人的时空运动重定向
来自高丽大学和苏黎世联邦理工学院以及加州大学的学者们在这项工作中介绍了一种用于腿式机器人的运动重定向方法，旨在创建模仿动物精细行为的运动控制器。学者们的方法，即时空运动重定向（STMR），通过将运动从源转移到目标来指导模仿学习过程，通过确保在目标系统上模仿的可行性来有效地弥合形态差异。这个 STMR 方法包括两个部分：空间运动重定向（SMR）和时间运动重定向（TMR）。 一方面，SMR 通过从关键点轨迹生成运动学上可行的全身运动来解决运动学层面的运动重定向问题。 另一方面，TMR 旨在通过优化时域中的运动来重新定位动态级别的运动。 学者们通过一系列模拟和硬件实验展示了这个方法在促进复杂动物运动的模仿学习（IL）方面的有效性。 在这些实验中， STMR 方法成功地定制了来自各种媒体的复杂动物运动，包括手持式摄像机捕获的视频，以适应目标机器人的形态和物理特性。 这使得强化学习策略训练能够实现精确的运动跟踪，而基线方法则难以应对涉及飞行阶段的高度动态运动。 此外，学者们验证了控制策略可以在现实环境中成功模拟两个具有不同尺寸和物理属性的四足机器人的六种不同运动。
In this work, academics from Korea University and ETH Zurich, as well as the University of California, introduce a motion redirection method for legged robots aimed at creating motion controllers that mimic the fine behavior of animals. The scholars' method, namely spatiotemporal motion retargeting (STMR), guides the imitation learning process by transferring motion from source to target, effectively bridging morphological differences by ensuring the feasibility of imitation on the target system. This STMR method consists of two parts: spatial motion retargeting (SMR) and temporal motion retargeting (TMR). On the one hand, SMR solves the problem of motion redirection at the kinematic level by generating kinematically feasible whole-body motion from key point trajectories. TMR, on the other hand, aims to retarget motion at the dynamic level by optimizing motion in the time domain. The scholars demonstrated the effectiveness of this method in promoting imitation learning (IL) of complex animal movements through a series of simulation and hardware experiments. In these experiments, the STMR method successfully tailored complex animal movements from a variety of media, including video captured by a handheld camera, to the morphology and physical properties of the target robot. This enables reinforcement learning policy training to achieve precise motion tracking, whereas baseline methods struggle with highly dynamic motions involving flight phases. In addition, the scholars verified that the control strategy can successfully simulate six different movements of two quadruped robots with different sizes and physical properties in a real-world environment.
154.Optimization-Based Reference Generator for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control of Legged Robots
基于优化的腿式机器人非线性模型预测控制参考生成器
模型预测控制（MPC）方法广泛应用于机器人技术中，因为它们保证了可行性并允许在机器人移动时计算更新的轨迹。 它们通常需要跟踪项的启发式参考以及成本函数参数的适当调整以获得良好的性能。 例如，当腿式机器人必须对环境干扰做出反应（例如，推动后恢复）或以静态不稳定步态跟踪特定目标时，算法的有效性可能会降低。         来自意大利热那亚大学和特伦托大学的学者们提出了一种新颖的基于优化的参考生成器，它利用线性倒立摆（LIP）模型来计算质心的参考轨迹，同时考虑到步态可能的欠驱动（例如小跑）。获得的轨迹用作学者们之前工作中提出的非线性 MPC 成本函数的参考。学者们还提出了一种公式，可确保保证达到目标的响应时间，而无需调整成本项的权重。 此外，还可以使用优化的参考来校正立足点，以驱动机器人朝目标前进。 他们通过 Aliengo 机器人在不同场景的模拟和实验中证明了这个方法的有效性。
Model predictive control (MPC) methods are widely used in robotics because they guarantee feasibility and allow updated trajectories to be calculated as the robot moves. They usually require a heuristic reference to the tracking terms and appropriate tuning of the cost function parameters to achieve good performance. For example, the effectiveness of the algorithm may be reduced when a legged robot must react to environmental disturbances (e.g., recover after pushing) or track a specific target with a statically unstable gait. Academics from the Universities of Genoa and Trento, Italy, propose a novel optimization-based reference generator that utilizes the linear inverted pendulum (LIP) model to calculate the reference trajectory of the center of mass while taking into account possible underactuation of gait (e.g. trot). The obtained trajectories are used as a reference for the nonlinear MPC cost function proposed by the scholars in their previous work. Scholars also proposed a formula that ensures a guaranteed target response time without adjusting the weight of the cost term. Additionally, the optimized reference can be used to correct the footing to drive the robot toward the goal. They demonstrated the effectiveness of this method in simulations and experiments in different scenarios using the Aliengo robot.
Learning H-Infinity Locomotion Control
学习 H-Infinity 运动控制
在险峻环境中稳定运动是四足机器人的必备能力，这要求四足机器人具有抵抗各种外部干扰的能力。 然而，最近的基于学习的策略仅使用基本的域随机化来提高学习策略的鲁棒性，这不能保证机器人具有足够的抗干扰能力。
在本文中，来自上海人工智能实验室、上海交通大学 、浙江大学 以及香港中文大学的学者们提出了一个建议，将学习过程建模为行为者和新引入的干扰者之间的对抗性交互，并确保它们在 H∞ 约束下进行优化。 与最大化折扣总体奖励的参与者相反，干扰者负责产生有效的外力，并通过最大化任务奖励与其预言之间的误差（即每次迭代中的“成本”）来进行优化。 为了保持行为者和干扰者之间的联合优化稳定，学者们的 H∞ 约束规定了成本与外力强度之间的比率界限。 通过整个训练阶段的相互互动，演员可以获得应对日益复杂的身体干扰的能力。 他们使用 Unitree Aliengo 机器人验证了这个方法在四足运动任务上的稳健性，并且还使用 Unitree A1 机器人验证了更具挑战性的任务，其中四足动物预计仅用后腿执行运动，就好像它是双足机器人一样。 模拟的定量结果显示相对于基线的改进，证明了该方法和每个设计选择的有效性。 另一方面，真实的机器人实验定性地展示了该策略在各种地形（包括楼梯、高平台、斜坡和湿滑地形）上干扰各种干扰时的鲁棒性。
Stable movement in harsh environments is an essential ability for quadruped robots, which requires quadruped robots to have the ability to resist various external interferences. However, recent learning-based strategies only use basic domain randomization to improve the robustness of the learning strategy, which cannot guarantee that the robot has sufficient anti-interference ability.
In this paper, scholars from the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Zhejiang University, and the Chinese University of Hong Kong propose a proposal to model the learning process as an adversarial interaction between actors and newly introduced distractors, and ensure that they are optimized under the H∞ constraint. In contrast to actors who maximize the discounted total reward, disruptors are responsible for generating effective external forces and optimizing by maximizing the error between the task reward and its prediction (i.e., the “cost” in each iteration). To keep the joint optimization between actors and disruptors stable, the scholars’ H∞ constraint specifies a bound on the ratio between costs and external force intensity. Through mutual interaction throughout the training phase, actors gain the ability to cope with increasingly complex physical disturbances. They verified the robustness of this approach on quadrupedal locomotion tasks using the Unitree Aliengo robot, and also on a more challenging task using the Unitree A1 robot, in which a quadruped is expected to perform locomotion using only its hind legs as if it were Like a bipedal robot. Quantitative results from the simulations show improvements over the baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of the approach and each design choice. On the other hand, real robotic experiments qualitatively demonstrate the robustness of the strategy against various disturbances on various terrains, including stairs, high platforms, slopes, and slippery terrain.
Hybrid Dynamics Modeling and Trajectory Planning for a Cable-Trailer System with a Quadruped Robot四足机器人电缆拖车系统的混合动力学建模和轨迹规划
受到利用狗拉雪橇进行运输的启发，来自华中科技大学人和香港城市大学的学者们推出了带有四足机器人的电缆拖车系统。学者们所提出的机器人系统的运动规划提出了拖车的非完整约束、系统欠驱动和通过电缆的混合交互所带来的挑战。 为了应对这些挑战，他们开发了一种混合动力学模型，可以解释电缆的拉紧/松弛状态。 由于直接优化轨迹的计算量很大，因此学者们首先提出一种搜索算法来计算次优轨迹作为初始解决方案。 然后，他们又提出了一种基于物体几何形状的新型防撞约束来制定混合系统的轨迹优化问题。这个轨迹规划方法在带有定制电缆拖车的 Unitree A1 四足机器人上实现，并通过实验进行了验证。
Inspired by the use of dog sleds for transportation, academics from Huazhong University of Science and Technology and City University of Hong Kong launched a cable trailer system with a quadruped robot. The motion planning of the robot system proposed by the scholars presents challenges caused by the trailer's non-holonomic constraints, system underactuation, and hybrid interactions through cables. To address these challenges, they developed a hybrid dynamics model that can account for the tensioned/relaxed state of the cable. Since direct optimization of trajectories is computationally intensive, scholars first proposed a search algorithm to calculate suboptimal trajectories as initial solutions. Then, they proposed a new collision avoidance constraint based on object geometry to formulate the trajectory optimization problem of the hybrid system. This trajectory planning method is implemented on a Unitree A1 quadruped robot with a custom cable trailer and is verified experimentally.
157.HT-LIP Model based Robust Control of Quadrupedal Robot Locomotion under Unknown Vertical Ground Motion
未知地面垂直运动下基于HT-LIP模型的四足机器人运动鲁棒控制
来自马萨诸塞州洛厄尔大学和普渡大学的学者们出了一种分层控制框架，可在具有一般和未知垂直运动的动态刚性表面（DRS）上实现稳健的四足运动。 该框架的关键新颖之处在于其较高层，它是一个离散时间、可证明稳定的脚步控制器。 脚步控制器的基础是一种新型混合、时变、线性倒立摆 (HT-LIP) 模型，该模型是低维的，可以准确捕获 DRS 运动过程中基本的机器人动力学。 然后导出一组新的充分稳定性条件来直接指导控制器设计，以确保 HT-LIP 模型在一般、未知、垂直 DRS 运动下的渐近稳定性。 此外，脚步控制器被设计为计算高效的二次程序，其中结合了所提出的 HT-LIP 模型和稳定性条件。 中间层将高层生成的所需足迹位置作为输入，生成运动学上可行的全身参考轨迹，然后由下层扭矩控制器精确跟踪。学者们在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上的硬件实验证实了他们所提出的框架在各种未知、非周期性、垂直 DRS 运动和不确定性（例如，光滑和不平坦的表面、固体和液体负载以及突然推动）下的鲁棒性。
Academics from the University of Massachusetts Lowell and Purdue University present a hierarchical control framework that enables robust quadrupedal locomotion on dynamically rigid surfaces (DRS) with general and unknown vertical motions. The key novelty of this framework lies in its higher layer, which is a discrete-time, provably stable footstep controller. The footstep controller is based on a novel hybrid, time-varying, linear inverted pendulum (HT-LIP) model that is low-dimensional and accurately captures the fundamental robot dynamics during DRS locomotion. A new set of sufficient stability conditions is then derived to directly guide controller design to ensure the asymptotic stability of the HT-LIP model under general, unknown, vertical DRS motions. Furthermore, the footstep controller is designed as a computationally efficient quadratic program incorporating the proposed HT-LIP model and stability conditions. The middle layer takes as input the desired footprint positions generated by the higher layers to generate kinematically feasible full-body reference trajectories, which are then accurately tracked by the lower layer torque controller. The academics’ hardware experiments on the Unitree Go1 quadruped robot confirmed the performance of their proposed framework under various unknown, non-periodic, vertical DRS motions and uncertainties (e.g., smooth and uneven surfaces, solid and liquid loads, and Robustness under sudden push).
158.Learning Visual Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation from Demonstrations
从演示中学习视觉四足机器人操作
四足机器人正在逐渐融入人类环境。 尽管四足机器人的运动能力不断增强，但它们在现实场景中与物体的交互仍然有限。 虽然四足机器人上的附加机械臂可以操纵物体，但考虑到四足机器人本质上是一个配备四个肢体的移动单元，每个肢体拥有 3 个自由度 (DoF)，因此它们有时是多余的。
因此，学者们的目标是让四足机器人仅用腿执行现实世界的操纵任务。 来自香港科技大学、清华大学以及加州大学伯克利分校的学者们将局部操纵过程分解为基于低级强化学习（RL）的控制器和基于行为克隆（BC）的高级规划器。 通过参数化操纵轨迹，学者们同步上下层的工作，从而发挥 RL 和 BC 的优势。 他们的方法通过模拟和真实实验进行了验证，展示了机器人执行需要机动性和高精度的任务的能力，例如在移动时从地面提起篮子、关闭洗碗机、按下按钮和推门。
Quadruped robots are gradually integrating into the human environment. Despite the increasing locomotion capabilities of quadruped robots, their interaction with objects in real-life scenarios is still limited. While additional robotic arms on a quadruped robot can manipulate objects, they are sometimes redundant considering that a quadruped robot is essentially a mobile unit equipped with four limbs, each with 3 degrees of freedom (DoF).
The academics therefore aim to have quadrupedal robots perform real-world manipulation tasks using only their legs. Scholars from the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Tsinghua University, and the University of California, Berkeley, decomposed the local manipulation process into a low-level reinforcement learning (RL)-based controller and a high-level planner based on behavioral cloning (BC). By parametrically manipulating trajectories, scholars synchronize the work of upper and lower layers, thereby taking advantage of RL and BC. Their approach was validated through simulations and real experiments, demonstrating the robot's ability to perform tasks requiring maneuverability and high precision, such as lifting baskets from the ground, turning off dishwashers, pressing buttons and pushing doors while moving.
159.DrEureka: Language Model Guided Sim-To-Real Transfer
DrEureka：语言模型引导的模拟到真实的迁移
将模拟中学到的策略转移到现实世界是大规模获取机器人技能的一种有前景的策略。 然而，模拟到真实的方法通常依赖于手动设计和调整任务奖励函数以及模拟物理参数，导致过程缓慢且人力密集。
在本文中，来自宾夕法尼亚大学和NVIDIA以及德克萨斯大学的学者们研究使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 来自动化和加速 sim-toreal 设计。 学者们提出的模拟到真实方法只需要对目标任务进行物理模拟，并自动构建合适的奖励函数和域随机化分布以支持现实世界的转移。他们首先证明这个方法可以发现模拟到真实的配置，这些配置在四足运动和灵巧操作任务方面与现有的人类设计的配置具有竞争力。 然后，学者们展示了我们的方法能够解决新颖的机器人任务，例如四足平衡和在瑜伽球上行走，而无需迭代手动设计。
Transferring strategies learned in simulations to the real world is a promising strategy for acquiring robotic skills at scale. However, simulation-to-real methods often rely on manually designing and tuning task reward functions and simulating physical parameters, resulting in a slow and labor-intensive process.
In this paper, academics from the University of Pennsylvania and NVIDIA and the University of Texas examine the use of large language models (LLMs) to automate and accelerate sim-toreal design. The simulation-to-real method proposed by scholars only requires physical simulation of the target task and automatically constructs appropriate reward functions and domain randomization distributions to support real-world transfer. They first demonstrate that this approach can discover simulated-to-realistic configurations that are competitive with existing human-designed configurations for quadrupedal locomotion and dexterous manipulation tasks. The academics then show that our approach is able to solve novel robotic tasks, such as quadruped balancing and walking on a yoga ball, without the need for iterative manual design.
160.CrossLoco: Human Motion Driven Control of Legged Robots via Guided Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
CrossLoco ：通过引导无监督强化学习对腿式机器人进行人体运动驱动控制
人体运动驱动控制（HMDC）是一种有效的方法，可以生成自然且引人注目的机器人运动，同时保留高级语义。 然而，由于运动学和动力学特性的不匹配，建立人类和具有不同身体结构的机器人之间的对应关系并不容易，这导致了问题的内在模糊性。 许多以前的算法通过无监督学习来解决这个运动重定向问题，这需要先决条件。 然而，在不理解给定的人体动作的情况下学习所有技能的成本将极其高昂，特别是对于高维机器人而言。
