在这项工作中，来自佐治亚理工学院的学者们介绍了 CrossLoco，这是一种引导式无监督强化学习框架，可以同时学习机器人技能及其与人类动作的对应关系。学者们的关键创新是引入基于循环一致性的奖励项，旨在最大化人类运动和机器人状态之间的相互信息。他们证明，所提出的框架可以通过转换不同的人类动作（例如跑步、跳跃和跳舞）来生成引人注目的机器人动作。学者们将 CrossLoco 与手动设计和无监督的基线算法以及他们框架的消融版本进行定量比较，并证明这个方法以更好的准确性、多样性和用户偏好来转换人体动作。学者们还展示了它在其他应用中的实用性，例如根据语言输入合成机器人动作以及实现交互式机器人控制。
Human Motion Driven Control (HMDC) is an efficient method to generate natural and compelling robot motion while preserving high-level semantics. However, establishing the correspondence between humans and robots with different body structures is not easy due to the mismatch in kinematic and dynamic properties, which leads to the inherent ambiguity of the problem. Many previous algorithms solve this motion redirection problem through unsupervised learning, which requires prerequisites. However, learning all skills without understanding a given human motion would be extremely costly, especially for high-dimensional robots.
In this work, academics from Georgia Tech introduce CrossLoco, a guided unsupervised reinforcement learning framework that simultaneously learns robot skills and their correspondence to human actions. The key innovation of the scholars is the introduction of reward terms based on cycle consistency, aiming to maximize the mutual information between human motion and robot state. They demonstrated that the proposed framework can generate compelling robot motions by transforming different human motions such as running, jumping, and dancing. The academics quantitatively compare CrossLoco to manually designed and unsupervised baseline algorithms as well as ablative versions of their framework, and demonstrate that this method transforms human actions with better accuracy, diversity, and user preference. Scholars have also demonstrated its utility in other applications, such as synthesizing robot movements based on language input and enabling interactive robot control.
161.FootVision: A Vision-Based Multi-Functional Sensorized Foot for Quadruped Robots
FootVision：用于四足机器人的基于视觉的多功能传感脚
配备无传感器脚的四足机器人只能提供有关脚与周围环境交互的有限信息，这限制了它们在非结构化环境中的越野探索能力。 为了解决这个问题，来自南方科技大学和吉奥尔金理工学院的学者们推出了 Foot Vision，这是一种用于四足机器人的创新型基于视觉的传感脚。 它由一个柔韧的脚踝、一个带有视觉标记的透明脚底和一个内部摄像头组成。 这种脚的设计成本低、重量轻，并且能够适应可变形和坚硬的地形。 相机可以有效地跟踪标记位移来估计脚部姿势。学者们从足部姿势中提取足部变形特征，并开发一种基于学习的方法来利用这些特征重建 6D 接触力。 代表性负载测试验证了足部准确（R^2>0.95）和动态实时预测接触力和扭矩（100 Hz）的能力。 安装在四足机器人上的传感脚展示了其感知具有不同刚度的地形上的 6D 接触力并估计接触表面的局部倾斜度的能力。 此外，得益于透明的脚底，脚内摄像头可以直接识别地形类型并测量土壤流量分布。 实验结果证实，所提出的基于视觉的传感足可以增强腿式机器人在不同环境中的接触感知能力。
Quadruped robots equipped with sensorless feet can only provide limited information about the interaction of the feet with the surrounding environment, which limits their ability to explore off-road in unstructured environments.  To solve this problem, academics from Southern University of Science and Technology and Gyorghin Polytechnic Institute introduced Foot Vision, an innovative vision-based sensing foot for quadruped robots.  It consists of a flexible ankle, a transparent foot sole with visual markers and an internal camera.  The foot is designed to be low-cost, lightweight, and capable of adapting to deformable and rigid terrains.  The camera can effectively track marker displacement to estimate foot pose. Scholars extracted foot deformation features from foot posture and developed a learning-based method to utilize these features to reconstruct 6D contact forces. In addition, thanks to the transparent sole, the in-foot camera can directly identify terrain types and measure soil flow distribution.  Experimental results confirm that the proposed vision-based sensing can enhance the contact sensing capabilities of legged robots in different environments.

Scholars have proposed a framework for autonomous whole-body control through visual observation, namely visual whole-body control (VBC), which consists of a low-level strategy that uses all degrees of freedom to track body speed as well as end-effector position and a proposed speed and end-effector position. Advanced strategy composition. The academics train two-level policies in simulations and perform Sim2Real transfers for real robot deployments. They conducted extensive experiments and showed significant improvements over baselines in picking up a variety of objects in different configurations (height, position, orientation) and environments.

四足机器人在有限感知下穿越三维复杂环境

Traversing complex three-dimensional environments has always been a major challenge for the legged motion of quadruped robots. Existing methods usually rely on external sensors such as vision and lidar to obtain environmental information to respond to obstacles in advance. However, in scenes such as night or dense forests, external sensors often do not work properly, so robots must rely on proprioceptive sensors to perceive various obstacles in the environment and respond quickly. In this work, scholars from Tsinghua University, Xi'an University of Technology and Shanghai University proposed a quadruped robot motion controller based on end-to-end learning that relies entirely on proprioception. The controller can accurately detect, locate and flexibly respond to collisions in unknown and complex three-dimensional environments, thereby improving the robot's ability to traverse complex environments. Scholars have demonstrated in both simulation and real-world experiments that their method enables quadruped robots to successfully traverse challenging obstacles in various complex environments.

165.Fast Decentralized State Estimation for Legged Robot Locomotion via EKF and MHE
通过 EKF 和 MHE 实现腿部机器人运动的快速分散状态估计
在本文中，来自威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的学者们提出了一种用于控制腿部运动的快速分散状态估计框架。浮动基座状态的非线性估计被分散为通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器 (EKF) 进行的方向估计和通过移动水平估计 (MHE) 进行线性速度估计。EKF 将惯性传感器与视觉融合以估计浮动基座方向。MHE 使用过去一个时间窗口内所有传感器的估计方向来估计线性速度，该估计基于具有状态约束的感兴趣状态的时变线性动力学公式。更重要的是，学者们提出了一种基于全信息滤波器 (FIF) 优化结构的边缘化方法，将等式约束的 FIF 转换为等效的 MHE。状态估计的这种解耦促进了计算效率、估计准确性和状态约束纳入之间的理想平衡。结果表明，他们所提方法能够为多种足式机器人提供准确的状态估计，包括高动态跳跃机器人 PogoX、双足机器人 Cassie 和四足机器人 Unitree Go1，频率为 200 Hz，窗口间隔为 0.1 秒。
In this paper, scholars from the University of Wisconsin-Madison proposed a fast decentralized state estimation framework for controlling legged motion. The nonlinear estimation of the floating base state is decentralized into orientation estimation through an extended Kalman filter (EKF) and linear velocity estimation through a moving horizon estimation (MHE). The EKF fuses inertial sensors with vision to estimate the floating base orientation. The MHE estimates the linear velocity using the estimated orientations of all sensors within a past time window, which is based on a time-varying linear dynamics formulation of the state of interest with state constraints. More importantly, the scholars proposed a marginalization method based on the full information filter (FIF) optimization structure to convert the equality-constrained FIF into an equivalent MHE. This decoupling of state estimation promotes an ideal balance between computational efficiency, estimation accuracy, and incorporation of state constraints. The results show that their proposed method is able to provide accurate state estimation for a variety of legged robots, including the highly dynamic jumping robot PogoX, the bipedal robot Cassie, and the quadruped robot Unitree Go1, at a frequency of 200 Hz and a window interval of 0.1 seconds.
166.Robust Convex Model Predictive Control for Quadruped Locomotion under Uncertainties 不确定性条件下四足动物运动的鲁棒凸模型预测控制
本文考虑了存在不确定性的四足动物运动控制。考虑了两种类型的结构化不确定性，即不确定的摩擦约束和不确定的模型动力学。然后，基于稳健优化制定了最小-最大优化模型，并通过递归求解优化模型提出了一种稳健的最小-最大模型预测控制器。学者们通过利用不确定性的结构证明了最小-最大优化模型等同于凸二次约束二次规划 (QCQP)。此外，提出了一种两阶段优化算法来有效地解决优化问题，从而允许将控制器部署到实际机器人上。结果表明，与 Gurobi 相比，所提出的优化算法可以将求解频率提高约 11 倍。所提出的控制器能够在具有挑战性的场景中稳定四足动物的运动，在这些场景中，不确定性是由重大干扰和未知环境引起的。
This paper considers the motion control of quadrupeds in the presence of uncertainties. Two types of structured uncertainties, namely uncertain friction constraints and uncertain model dynamics, are considered. Then, a min-max optimization model is formulated based on robust optimization, and a robust min-max model predictive controller is proposed by recursively solving the optimization model. The scholars prove that the min-max optimization model is equivalent to convex quadratically constrained quadratic programming (QCQP) by exploiting the structure of uncertainty. In addition, a two-stage optimization algorithm is proposed to efficiently solve the optimization problem, allowing the controller to be deployed on a real robot. The results show that the proposed optimization algorithm can increase the solution frequency by about 11 times compared to Gurobi. The proposed controller is able to stabilize the motion of quadrupeds in challenging scenarios where uncertainties are caused by significant disturbances and unknown environments.

本文介绍了一种用于操纵缆绳牵引有效载荷的协作式四旋翼四足机器人系统。特别是，学者们的目标是解决缆绳牵引有效载荷未知动力学带来的挑战。为此，学者们们首先为四旋翼和四足机器人提出了新的动力学模型，同时考虑了非线性机器人动力学和与缆绳牵引负载相关的不确定性。此外，他们设计了用于机器人和有效载荷之间混合相互作用的观测器。
理论上，在温和的技术假设下，使用 Lyapunov 函数分析了这些观测器的收敛性。
最后，将动力学模型和观测器无缝集成到具有运动学限制和防撞约束的分布式模型预测控制 (MPC) 框架中。通过在室内和室外环境中的具有挑战性的现场实验验证了所提出的系统，涉及推力扰动、变化和未知的有效载荷、不平坦的地形等。
This paper presents a collaborative quadrotor-quadruped robot system for manipulating a cable-hauled payload. In particular, we aim to address the challenges posed by the unknown dynamics of the cable-hauled payload. To this end, we first propose new dynamic models for the quadrotor and quadruped robots, taking into account both nonlinear robot dynamics and the uncertainties associated with the cable-hauled load. In addition, we design observers for the hybrid interaction between the robot and the payload.
Theoretically, the convergence of these observers is analyzed using Lyapunov functions under mild technical assumptions.
Finally, the dynamic model and observer are seamlessly integrated into a distributed model predictive control (MPC) framework with kinematic restrictions and collision avoidance constraints. The proposed system is validated through challenging field experiments in indoor and outdoor environments involving thrust disturbances, varying and unknown payloads, uneven terrain, etc.
168.Learning Efficient and Robust Multi-Modal Quadruped Locomotion: A Hierarchical Approach 学习高效且稳健的多模态四足运动：一种分层方法

Quadrupeds are able to adaptively change their gaits to reduce energy consumption. However, designing a robust controller for robots with multimodal motion remains challenging. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical control framework that decomposes this challenge into two types of problems: high-level decision making for gait selection and robust low-level control in complex application environments. For gait transitions, we use reinforcement learning (RL) to design a gait policy to select the best gait in different environments. After determining the gait, we apply model predictive control (MPC) to achieve the desired gait. To improve the robustness of the motion, we develop a model adaptation strategy to adaptively optimize the input parameters of our MPC controller. The control framework is first trained and tested in simulation and then directly applied to an actual quadruped robot without any fine-tuning. Experiments show that compared with the baseline controller, our control framework is more energy-efficient by selecting different gaits and more robust by adjusting the model parameters.

In this paper, scholars proposed a fully distributed framework for multiple quadruped robots in obstacle-ridden environments. Their approach exploits model predictive control (MPC) and a multi-robot consensus protocol to obtain a distributed control law. It ensures that all robots are able to avoid obstacles, navigate to the desired location, and synchronize their gaits. Specifically, through MPC and consensus, the robots compute the optimal trajectory and contact profile of the legs. Then an MPC-based motion controller is implemented to achieve gait, stabilize motion, and track the desired trajectory. The scholars conducted experiments in simulation and in a static obstacle environment with three real quadruped robots.
170.Optimal Prescribed-Time Control based Reactive Planning System for Quadruped Robot Navigation 基于最优指定时间控制的四足机器人导航反应规划系统

四足机器人的导航从根本上被描述为全向运动，同时制定了反馈控制律来解决机器人可能遇到的任何偏差。特别是，他们提出的反馈控制系统在理论上被证明可以在用户指定的预定义有限时间内实现收敛。为了进一步计算最佳收敛时间和局部目标状态，他们提出了一个高级规划节点，其中包括地形感知运动搜索和时空轨迹优化，可以生成无碰撞、平滑和高效的轨迹。
通过室内和室外环境中的数值模拟和真实机器人实验验证了所提出的框架的有效性，包括杂乱障碍物、斜坡和外部干扰的场景。
In this paper, scholars proposed a reaction planning system for quadruped robots based on prescribed time control.
The navigation of quadruped robots is fundamentally described as omnidirectional motion, while feedback control laws are formulated to solve any deviations that the robot may encounter. In particular, their proposed feedback control system is theoretically proven to achieve convergence within a predefined finite time specified by the user. To further calculate the optimal convergence time and local target state, they proposed an advanced planning node, which includes terrain-aware motion search and spatiotemporal trajectory optimization, which can generate collision-free, smooth and efficient trajectories.
The effectiveness of the proposed framework is verified through numerical simulations and real robot experiments in indoor and outdoor environments, including scenes with cluttered obstacles, slopes, and external disturbances.
Learning-based legged locomotion; state of the art and future perspectives
基于学习的腿部运动；现状和未来前景
腿部运动是通用移动性的前提，这是许多现实世界机器人应用的关键能力。在过去的三十年中，基于模型和基于学习的方法都推动了腿部运动领域的发展。然而，近年来，许多因素大大加速了基于学习的方法的进步，包括深度学习的兴起、机器人系统模拟的快速发展以及高性能和价格合理的硬件的出现。
本文旨在简要介绍该领域的历史，来自佐治亚理工学院和慕尼黑工业大学以及哥伦比亚大学的学者们总结最近在学习四足动物运动技能方面的努力，并为该领域的新研究人员提供对所涉及的关键问题的理解。随着最近人形机器人的普及，学者们进一步概述了双足运动类似方法的快速兴起。最后，学者们讨论了未解决的问题以及相关的社会影响。
Legged locomotion is a prerequisite for general mobility, a key capability for many real-world robotic applications. Over the past three decades, both model-based and learning-based approaches have driven the field of legged locomotion. However, in recent years, a number of factors have greatly accelerated the progress of learning-based approaches, including the rise of deep learning, the rapid development of simulation of robotic systems, and the emergence of high-performance and affordable hardware.
This article aims to briefly introduce the history of the field, summarize recent efforts in learning quadrupedal locomotion skills, and provide new researchers in the field with an understanding of the key issues involved. With the recent popularity of humanoid robots, scholars further outline the rapid rise of similar methods for bipedal locomotion. Finally, scholars discuss unresolved issues and related social impacts.
Panoptic-SLAM: Visual SLAM in Dynamic Environments using Panoptic Segmentation
Panoptic-SLAM：使用全景分割在动态环境中进行视觉 SLAM
大多数视觉 SLAM 系统在动态场景中不够稳健。处理场景中动态物体的系统通常依赖于基于深度学习的方法来检测和过滤这些物体。然而，这些方法无法处理未知的移动物体。
来自里约热内卢天主教大学和圣保罗大学的学者们在这项工作中提出了 Panoptic-SLAM，这是一种开源视觉 SLAM 系统，即使在存在未知物体的情况下，也能对动态环境具有鲁棒性。它使用全景分割在状态估计过程中从场景中过滤动态物体。Panoptic SLAM 基于 ORB-SLAM3，这是一种用于静态环境的最先进的 SLAM 系统。学者们使用真实世界数据集对该实现进行了测试，并与文献中的几种最先进的系统进行了比较，包括 DynaSLAM、DS SLAM、SaD-SLAM、PVO 和 FusingPanoptic。例如，Panoptic-SLAM 的平均准确度是 PVO 的四倍，PVO 是最新的基于全景的视觉 SLAM 方法。此外，学者们还使用配备 RGB-D 相机的四足机器人进行了实验，以测试他们的方法在现实场景中的适用性。测试通过运动捕捉系统创建的地面实况进行了验证。
Most visual SLAM systems are not robust enough in dynamic scenes. Systems that deal with dynamic objects in a scene usually rely on deep learning-based methods to detect and filter these objects. However, these methods cannot handle unknown moving objects.
In this work, scholars from the Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro and the University of São Paulo proposed Panoptic-SLAM, an open source visual SLAM system that is robust to dynamic environments even in the presence of unknown objects. It uses panoptic segmentation to filter dynamic objects from the scene during the state estimation process. Panoptic SLAM is based on ORB-SLAM3, a state-of-the-art SLAM system for static environments. The scholars tested the implementation using real-world datasets and compared it with several state-of-the-art systems in the literature, including DynaSLAM, DS SLAM, SaD-SLAM, PVO, and FusingPanoptic. For example, Panoptic-SLAM has an average accuracy four times higher than PVO, the latest panoptic-based visual SLAM method. In addition, the researchers conducted experiments using a quadruped robot equipped with an RGB-D camera to test the applicability of their approach in real-world scenarios. The tests were validated using ground truth created by a motion capture system.
173.Learning Bipedal Walking on a Quadruped Robot via Adversarial Motion Priors
通过对抗运动先验学习四足机器人的双足行走
人们先前的研究已成功证明四足机器人能够在具有挑战性的地形中灵活而稳健地运动。然而，四足机器人的双足运动模式仍未经测试。本文探讨了最初为四足机器人设计的学习框架的适应性，来自英国利兹大学和英国伦敦大学的学者们利用结合对抗性运动先验和师生策略的框架来模仿参考轨迹并在崎岖地形上导航。学者们的工作包括将类似的学习框架转移并评估为双足模式下的四足机器人，旨在实现在平坦和复杂地形上的稳定行走。他们的模拟结果表明，训练后的策略使四足机器人能够在平坦和具有挑战性的地形上导航，包括楼梯和不平坦的表面。
Previous studies have successfully demonstrated that quadruped robots are able to move flexibly and robustly in challenging terrains. However, the bipedal movement mode of quadrupedal robots remains untested. This paper explores the adaptability of a learning framework originally designed for quadrupedal robots. Scholars from the University of Leeds and University College London in the UK use a framework that combines adversarial motion priors and teacher-student strategies to imitate reference trajectories and navigate on rough terrain. The scholars' work involves transferring and evaluating a similar learning framework to a quadrupedal robot in bipedal mode, aiming to achieve stable walking on flat and complex terrains. Their simulation results show that the trained strategy enables the quadrupedal robot to navigate on flat and challenging terrains, including stairs and uneven surfaces.
174.Learning Safe Locomotion for Quadrupedal Robots by Derived-Action Optimization

具有外部感知的深度强化学习控制器使四足机器人能够稳健地穿越地形。然而，这些控制器中的大多数严重依赖于复杂的奖励函数，并且收敛性较差。
在这项工作中，来自浙江大学的学者们提出了一种称为派生动作优化的新型学习框架。派生动作被定义为策略的高级表示，可以引入奖励函数来指导决策行为。学者们提出的派生动作优化方法用于学习更安全的四足运动，实现快速收敛更好的性能。具体而言，他们选择立足点作为派生动作，并优化立足点周围地形的肥厚程度，以减少潜在的滑动和碰撞。大量实验证明了学者们的方法具有很高的安全性和有效性。
Deep reinforcement learning controllers with external perception enable quadruped robots to traverse terrain robustly. However, most of these controllers rely heavily on complex reward functions and have poor convergence.
In this work, scholars from Zhejiang University proposed a new learning framework called derived action optimization. Derived actions are defined as high-level representations of policies, and reward functions can be introduced to guide decision-making behaviors. The derived action optimization method proposed by scholars is used to learn safer quadrupedal motion and achieve fast convergence and better performance. Specifically, they select footholds as derived actions and optimize the thickness of the terrain around the footholds to reduce potential sliding and collisions. A large number of experiments have demonstrated that the scholars' method is highly safe and effective.
175.UMI on Legs: Making Manipulation Policies Mobile with Manipulation-Centric Whole-body Controllers
腿部 UMI：利用以操作为中心的全身控制器实现操作策略的移动化
在本文中，来自斯坦福大学和哥伦比亚大学以及谷歌DeepMind的学者们引入了 UMI-on-Legs，这是一个结合了现实世界和模拟数据的四足操纵系统新框架。学者们使用手持式夹持器 (UMI) 在现实世界中扩展以任务为中心的数据收集，从而提供了一种无需机器人即可展示与任务相关的操纵技能的廉价方法。同时，他们通过训练全身控制器进行任务跟踪（无需任务模拟设置），在模拟中扩展以机器人为中心的数据。这两个策略之间的接口是任务框架中的末端执行器轨迹，由操纵策略推断并传递给全身控制器进行跟踪。学者们在抓握、非抓握和动态操纵任务上评估了 UMI-on-Legs，并报告了所有任务超过 70% 的成功率。最后，他们展示了在四足系统上对先前工作中预先训练的操纵策略检查点进行零样本跨体现部署，该检查点最初用于固定底座机器人手臂。学者们的这个框架为学习动态机器人表现的表达性操控技能提供了一条可扩展的途径。
In this paper, scholars from Stanford and Columbia universities and Google DeepMind introduce UMI-on-Legs, a new framework for quadruped manipulation systems that combines real-world and simulated data. Scholars use handheld grippers (UMIs) to expand task-centric data collection in the real world, providing an inexpensive way to demonstrate task-related manipulation skills without a robot. At the same time, they expand robot-centric data in simulation by training a full-body controller for task tracking (without the need for a task simulation setting). The interface between these two policies is the end-effector trajectory in the task framework, inferred by the manipulation policy and passed to the full-body controller for tracking. Scholars evaluate UMI-on-Legs on grasping, non-grasping, and dynamic manipulation tasks, and report success rates of over 70% for all tasks. Finally, they demonstrate zero-shot cross-body deployment of manipulation policy checkpoints pre-trained in previous work on quadruped systems, which were originally used for fixed-base robot arms. Our framework provides a scalable path to learning expressive manipulation skills for dynamic robot performance.
176.A learning-based control pipeline for generic motor skills for quadruped robots
基于学习的四足机器人通用技能控制方法
使用通用控制器执行多种运动技能一直是腿式机器人面临的长期挑战。虽然基于运动模仿的强化学习 (RL) 在重现设计的运动技能方面表现出色，但训练后的控制器仅适用于一种特定类型的运动。运动合成已经得到很好的发展，可以为角色动画生成各种不同的动作，但这些动作仅包含运动信息，不能用于控制。
在本研究中，学者们引入了一种控制管道，该管道结合了运动合成和基于运动模仿的 RL，用于通用运动技能。我们设计了一个动画状态机来合成来自各种来源的运动，并将生成的运动参考轨迹作为 RL 控制器输入的一部分提供。通过所提出的方法，他们表明单一策略能够同时学习多种运动技能。此外，学者们注意到该策略能够揭示参考运动背后隐藏的相关性，从而提高控制性能。他们从参考轨迹的可预测性方面分析了这种能力，并使用定量措施来优化控制器设计。为了证明这个方法的有效性，学者们在硬件上部署了训练有素的策略，四足机器人可以通过单一控制策略执行各种学习到的技能，包括自动步态转换、高踢和前跳。
Performing multiple motor skills with a universal controller has been a long-standing challenge for legged robots. While reinforcement learning (RL) based on motion imitation performs well in reproducing designed motor skills, the trained controller is only applicable to one specific type of motion. Motion synthesis has been well developed to generate a variety of different actions for character animation, but these actions only contain motion information and cannot be used for control.
In this study, scholars introduced a control pipeline that combines motion synthesis and RL based on motion imitation for universal motor skills. We designed an animation state machine to synthesize motions from various sources and provide the generated motion reference trajectory as part of the RL controller input. With the proposed method, they showed that a single policy is able to learn multiple motor skills simultaneously. In addition, scholars noticed that the policy is able to reveal the hidden correlations behind the reference motions, thereby improving control performance. They analyzed this ability in terms of the predictability of the reference trajectory and used quantitative measures to optimize the controller design. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the method, scholars deployed the trained policy on hardware, and a quadruped robot can perform various learned skills including automatic gait transitions, high kicks, and forward jumps with a single control policy.
VERO: A vacuum-cleaner-equipped quadruped robot for efficient litter removal
VERO：配备吸尘器的四足机器人，可高效清除垃圾
如今，垃圾对许多生态系统的平衡构成了重大威胁。海洋就是一个例子，沿海地区和城市的垃圾通过排水沟、街道和水道进入海洋，在分解过程中释放出有毒化学物质和微塑料。垃圾清理通常由人类手动完成，这必然会减少可从环境中有效收集的垃圾量。
在本文中，学者们介绍了一种新型四足机器人原型，由于其自然的移动性，它能够在轮式和履带式机器人难以到达的地形中自主收集烟头 (CB)，这是全球第二大未处理垃圾来源。方法的核心是用于垃圾检测的卷积神经网络，然后是时间最优规划器，以减少收集所有目标物体所需的时间。然后通过视觉伺服程序精确地清除垃圾，该程序驱动安装在机器人一条腿上的真空吸尘器的喷嘴，将其置于检测到的 CB 之上。由于喷嘴的这种特殊位置，甚至不需要停止机器人的运动来执行收集任务，这大大提高了整个过程的时间效率。学者们在六种不同的户外场景中进行了广泛的测试，以展示他们的原型和方法的性能。据作者所知，这是第一次提出这样的设计和方法并在有腿的机器人上成功测试。
Nowadays, garbage poses a major threat to the balance of many ecosystems. The ocean is an example, where garbage from coastal areas and cities enters the ocean through drains, streets and waterways, releasing toxic chemicals and microplastics during decomposition. Garbage removal is usually done manually by humans, which inevitably reduces the amount of garbage that can be effectively collected from the environment.
In this paper, scholars introduce a new quadruped robot prototype that, due to its natural mobility, is able to autonomously collect cigarette butts (CBs), the second largest source of untreated garbage worldwide, in terrain that is difficult for wheeled and tracked robots to reach. The core of the method is a convolutional neural network for garbage detection, followed by a time-optimal planner to reduce the time required to collect all target objects. The garbage is then removed precisely by a visual servoing program that drives the nozzle of a vacuum cleaner mounted on one of the robot's legs, placing it above the detected CB. Due to this special position of the nozzle, it is not even necessary to stop the robot's movement to perform the collection task, which greatly improves the time efficiency of the entire process. The scholars conducted extensive tests in six different outdoor scenarios to demonstrate the performance of their prototype and method. To the best of the authors’ knowledge, this is the first time such a design and approach has been proposed and successfully tested on a legged robot.
Cross Anything: General Quadruped Robot Navigation through Complex Terrains
Cross Anything：通用四足机器人在复杂地形中的导航
视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的应用在各种机器人任务中取得了令人瞩目的成功，但对于四足机器人导航中使用的基础模型的探索却很少。来自浙江大学和上海大学以及上海交大的学者们引入了 Cross Anything System (CAS)，这是一个由高级推理模块和低级控制策略组成的创新系统，使机器人能够穿越复杂的 3D 地形并到达目标位置。
对于高级推理和运动规划，学者们提出了一种利用 VLM 的新型算法系统，具有任务分解设计和闭环子任务执行机制。对于低级运动控制，他们利用概率退火选择 (PAS) 方法通过强化学习训练控制策略。
大量实验表明，学者们的整个系统可以准确而稳健地穿越复杂的 3D 地形，其强大的泛化能力确保了在各种室内和室外场景和地形中的应用。
The application of visual language models (VLMs) has achieved remarkable success in various robotic tasks, but there is little exploration of the un derlying models used in quadruped robot navigation. Scholars from Zhejiang University and Shanghai University and Shanghai Jiaotong University introduced Cross Anything System (CAS), an innovative system consisting of high-level reasoning modules and low-level control strategies that enable robots to traverse complex 3D terrains and reach target locations.
For high-level reasoning and motion planning, the scholars proposed a novel algorithmic system utilizing VLMs with task decomposition design and closed-loop subtask execution mechanism. For low-level motion control, they utilized the probabilistic annealing selection (PAS) method to train control strategies through reinforcement learning.
Extensive experiments showed that the scholars' entire system can accurately and robustly traverse complex 3D terrains, and its strong generalization ability ensures its application in various indoor and outdoor scenes and terrains.
180.Multi-Contact Inertial Estimation and Localization in Legged Robots
腿式机器人多接触惯性估计与定位
最优估计是一种有前途的多接触惯性估计和定位工具。为了充分利用它在机器人技术中的优势，有效解决这些大型且具有挑战性的优化问题至关重要。
为了解决这个问题，来自英国赫瑞瓦特大学和美国佛罗里达人类与机器认知研究所的学者们开发了一个多重射击求解器，通过参数化的 Riccati 递归利用时间和参数结构。此外，学者们还提出了一种惯性局部流形，以确保其完全的物理一致性。与无奇点的 log-Cholesky 方法相比，它还增强了收敛性。为了处理它的奇点，学者们在他们的最优估计求解器中引入了一种零空间方法，最后为两种惯性参数化开发了接触动力学的解析导数。他们的框架可以成功解决复杂动作的估计问题，例如人形机器人的摆动。学者们在各种机器人任务中展示了它的数值能力，并在 Go1 机器人的实验试验中展示了它的优势。
Optimal estimation is a promising tool for multi-contact inertial estimation and localization. To fully exploit its advantages in robotics, it is crucial to effectively solve these large and challenging optimization problems.
To solve this problem, scholars from Heriot-Watt University in the UK and the Institute for Human and Machine Cognition in Florida, USA, developed a multi-shooting solver that exploits time and parameter structure through parameterized Riccati recursion. In addition, the scholars proposed an inertial local manifold to ensure its full physical consistency. It also enhances convergence compared to the singularity-free log-Cholesky method. To deal with its singularities, the scholars introduced a null space method in their optimal estimation solver and finally developed analytical derivatives of contact dynamics for two inertial parameterizations. Their framework can successfully solve the estimation problem of complex actions, such as the swing of a humanoid robot. The scholars demonstrated its numerical capabilities in various robotic tasks and showed its advantages in experimental trials on the Go1 robot.
Commonsense Reasoning for Legged Robot Adaptation with Vision-Language Models
基于视觉语言模型的腿式机器人自适应常识推理
腿式机器人在物理上有能力在各种环境中导航并克服各种障碍。例如，在搜索和救援任务中，腿式机器人可以爬过碎石、爬过缝隙并走出死胡同。然而，机器人的控制器需要智能地应对如此多样的障碍，这需要成功处理意外和不寻常的情况。这对当前的学习方法提出了挑战，这些方法在没有大量人工监督的情况下，通常难以推广到意外情况的长尾。
为了解决这个问题，来自加州大学伯克利分校和斯坦福大学的学者们研究如何利用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 对世界结构的广泛知识和常识推理能力来帮助腿式机器人处理困难、模糊的情况。学者们提出了一个系统，即 VLM-预测控制 (VLM-PC)，它结合了两个关键组件，他们发现这两个组件对于使用 VLM 引发即时自适应行为选择至关重要：(1) 根据之前的机器人交互进行上下文自适应和 (2) 规划未来的多种技能并重新规划。学者们们在 Go1 四足机器人上对 VLM-PC 进行了评估，测试了几个具有挑战性的真实障碍赛道，包括死胡同、攀爬和爬行。他们的实验表明，通过推理交互历史和未来计划，VLM 使机器人能够在各种复杂场景中自主感知、导航和行动，而这些场景原本需要特定于环境的工程或人工指导。
Legged robots are physically capable of navigating a wide range of environments and overcoming obstacles. For example, in search and rescue missions, legged robots can crawl over rubble, crawl through gaps, and navigate dead ends. However, the robot’s controller needs to intelligently cope with such a variety of obstacles, which requires successfully handling unexpected and unusual situations. This poses a challenge to current learning methods, which often have difficulty generalizing to the long tail of unexpected situations without extensive human supervision.
To address this problem, researchers from the University of California, Berkeley and Stanford University investigated how to leverage the extensive knowledge of the world structure and commonsense reasoning capabilities of visual language models (VLMs) to help legged robots handle difficult, ambiguous situations. The researchers proposed a system, VLM-Predictive Control (VLM-PC), that combines two key components that they found to be essential for inducing immediate adaptive behavior selection using VLMs: (1) contextual adaptation based on previous robot interactions and (2) planning for multiple future skills and replanning. The researchers evaluated VLM-PC on the Go1 quadruped robot, testing several challenging real-world obstacle courses, including dead ends, climbing, and crawling. Their experiments showed that by reasoning about interaction history and future plans, VLM enables the robot to autonomously perceive, navigate, and act in a variety of complex scenarios that would otherwise require environment-specific engineering or human guidance.
Grow Your Limits: Continuous Improvement with Real-World RL for Robotic Locomotion
突破极限：利用真实世界的 RL 持续改进机器人运动
深度强化学习 (RL) 可使机器人自主获得复杂的行为，例如腿部运动。然而，现实世界中的强化学习因效率、安全性和整体训练稳定性方面的限制而变得复杂，这限制了它的实际适用性。
来自加州大学伯克利分校的学者们提出了 APRL，这是一个策略正则化框架，旨在调节机器人在训练过程中的探索，在灵活的改进潜力和专注、高效的探索之间取得平衡。学者们证明，APRL 可使四足机器人在现实世界中高效地学习行走，从而产生一种更有能力的策略，用于在具有挑战性的地形上导航，并能够适应动态变化。
Deep reinforcement learning (RL) enables robots to autonomously acquire complex behaviors, such as legged locomotion. However, reinforcement learning in the real world is complicated by limitations in efficiency, safety, and overall training stability, which limits its practical applicability.
Scholars from the University of California, Berkeley proposed APRL, a policy regularization framework designed to regulate the robot's exploration during training, striking a balance between flexible improvement potential and focused, efficient exploration. Scholars demonstrated that APRL enables quadruped robots to efficiently learn to walk in the real world, resulting in a more capable policy for navigating challenging terrains and able to adapt to dynamic changes.
Accelerating Model Predietive Control for Legged Robots through Distributed Optimization
通过分布式优化加速腿式机器人的模型预测控制
来自意大利理工学院和意大利热那亚大学的学者们在本文介绍了一种通过分布式优化增强腿式机器人模型预测控制 (MPC) 的新方法。学者们的方法侧重于将机器人动力学分解为更小的可并行子系统，并利用交替方向乘法 (ADMM) 确保它们之间的一致性。每个子系统都由其自己的最优控制问题管理，ADMM 可促进其优化之间的一致性。这种方法不仅可以减少计算时间，还可以通过更复杂的机器人配置进行有效扩展，从而促进其他子系统的集成，例如四足机器人上的关节臂。他们通过数值评估证明了我们的方法在两个复杂度不断增加的系统上的收敛性。此外，学者们展示了与最先进的集中式全身 MPC 实现相比，这个方法收敛到相同的解决方案。此外，学者们定量比较了他们的方法与集中式方法的计算效率，发现计算时间最多减少了 75%。总的来说，他们的方法为加速腿式机器人的 MPC 解决方案提供了一条有希望的途径，为更有效地利用现代硬件的计算性能铺平了道路。
In this paper, researchers from the Italian Institute of Technology and the University of Genoa, Italy, introduce a new approach to enhance model predictive control (MPC) of legged robots through distributed optimization. Their approach focuses on decomposing the robot dynamics into smaller parallelizable subsystems and ensuring consistency between them using alternating direction multiplication (ADMM). Each subsystem is governed by its own optimal control problem, and ADMM promotes consistency between their optimizations. This approach not only reduces computational time, but also scales efficiently with more complex robot configurations, facilitating the integration of additional subsystems, such as articulated arms on quadruped robots. They demonstrate the convergence of our approach on two systems of increasing complexity through numerical evaluation. Furthermore, the researchers show that this approach converges to the same solution compared to the state-of-the-art centralized full-body MPC implementation. Furthermore, the researchers quantitatively compare the computational efficiency of their approach with centralized methods, finding up to a 75% reduction in computational time. Overall, their approach provides a promising path to accelerate MPC solutions for legged robots, paving the way for more efficient use of the computational performance of modern hardware.
PACC: A Passive-Arm Approach for High-Payload Collaborative Carrying with Quadruped Robots Using Model Predictive Control
PACC： 一种利用模型预测控制实现四足机器人高负载协作搬运的被动臂方法
在本文中，来自意大利理工学院和圣保罗大学的学者们介绍了使用具有固有阻抗的被动臂结构进行四足机器人与机器人和人与机器人协作搬运的概念。该概念适用于领导者-跟随者任务，采用极简主义方法，专注于充分利用机器人的有效载荷能力并降低能耗，而不会损害机器人的运动能力。学者们介绍了初步的手臂机械设计，并描述了如何使用其关节位移来引导机器人的运动。为了控制机器人的运动，他们提出了一种分散的模型预测控制器，该控制器结合了手臂动力学的近似值和协作搬运的外力估计。学者们通过在楼梯状障碍物和崎岖地形上进行机器人与机器人和人与机器人协作搬运来实验验证整个系统。
In this paper, scholars from the Italian Institute of Technology and the University of São Paulo introduce the concept of quadruped robot-robot and human-robot collaborative handling using a passive arm structure with intrinsic impedance. The concept is suitable for leader-follower tasks and adopts a minimalist approach, focusing on fully utilizing the robot's payload capacity and reducing energy consumption without compromising the robot's motion capabilities. The scholars introduced the preliminary arm mechanical design and described how its joint displacements are used to guide the robot's motion. To control the robot's motion, they proposed a decentralized model predictive controller that combines an approximation of the arm dynamics and external force estimation for collaborative handling. The scholars experimentally verified the entire system by performing robot-robot and human-robot collaborative handling on stair-like obstacles and rough terrain.
Safety Probability Estimation in Dimension Reduction Space for Model-Free Safe-RL of Robotics
机器人无模型安全强化学习降维空间中的安全概率估计
机器人强化学习 (RL) 在训练过程中对安全性提出了重要考虑。然而，安全强化学习 (SRL) 方法的一个主要挑战是维数灾难。虽然现有的利用降维 (DR) 方法的安全强化学习方法可以根据低维安全区域提供高维状态的安全概率估计，但其核心安全估计量并不全面。
来自中国科学技术大学的学者们开发了一种新颖的纯数据驱动的安全概率估计器，它既考虑了 DR 导致的信息丢失的不确定性，也考虑了数据驱动方法导致的数据不足的不确定性。该估计器不需要手动选择参数，即使使用少量数据，估计精度也相当准确。学者们从理论上证明了该估计量收敛到真实安全概率。使用该估计器的现有 RL 算法 (PPO、SAC) 可以直接在真实物理机器人中训练控制策略，并显着提高训练安全性。通过在实际和仿真环境中对四足机器人进行实验，验证了该算法的有效性，其中实施了 34D 到 2D 的安全估计器以保证安全控制策略的成功率为 83％。
Robotic reinforcement learning (RL) raises important safety considerations during training. However, a major challenge of safe reinforcement learning (SRL) methods is the curse of dimensionality. While existing safe reinforcement learning methods that leverage dimensionality reduction (DR) methods can provide safety probability estimates for high-dimensional states based on low-dimensional safety regions, their core safety estimators are not comprehensive.
Scholars from the University of Science and Technology of China have developed a novel purely data-driven safety probability estimator that considers both the uncertainty of information loss caused by DR and the uncertainty of insufficient data caused by data-driven methods. The estimator does not require manual parameter selection, and the estimation accuracy is quite accurate even with a small amount of data. The scholars theoretically prove that the estimator converges to the true safety probability. Existing RL algorithms (PPO, SAC) using this estimator can directly train control policies in real physical robots and significantly improve training safety. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by experiments on quadruped robots in real and simulated environments, where a 34D to 2D safety estimator is implemented to guarantee a safety control policy with a success rate of 83%.
Auto-Tuning of Controller and Online Trajectory Planner for Legged Robots
腿式机器人控制器的自动调节和在线轨迹规划器
在本文中，来自三菱电机研究实验室(MERL)的学者们介绍了一种自动调节反馈控制器和在线轨迹规划器的方法，以实现腿式机器人的稳健运动。自动调节方法使用无迹卡尔曼滤波器 (UKF) 公式，使用递归实现在线调整/校准控制参数。特别是，学者们展示了如何使用自动调节方法来校准四足机器人的模型预测控制 (MPC) 姿态控制器的成本函数权重和摆动控制器的反馈增益。此外 将自动调节方法扩展到校准在线轨迹规划器的参数，其中摆动腿的高度和机器人的行走速度得到优化，同时最大限度地降低其能耗和脚部滑动。这使学者们能够在线实时生成稳定的参考轨迹。使用机器人制造商提供的 Gazebo 中的高保真 Unitree A1 机器人模拟器的结果显示了使用自动调节来校准反馈控制器和在线计算参考轨迹的优势，可以缩短开发时间并提高跟踪性能。
In this paper, researchers from Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories (MERL) present a method for automatically tuning a feedback controller and an online trajectory planner to achieve robust motion in a legged robot. The automatic tuning method uses an unscented Kalman filter (UKF) formulation to adjust/calibrate control parameters online using recursion. In particular, the researchers show how the automatic tuning method can be used to calibrate the cost function weights of the model predictive control (MPC) posture controller and the feedback gains of the swing controller of a quadruped robot. Furthermore, the automatic tuning method is extended to calibrate the parameters of an online trajectory planner, where the height of the swing leg and the walking speed of the robot are optimized while minimizing its energy consumption and foot slippage. This enables researchers to generate stable reference trajectories online in real time. Results using the high-fidelity Unitree A1 robot simulator in Gazebo provided by the robot manufacturer show the advantages of using automatic tuning to calibrate the feedback controller and calculate the reference trajectory online, which can reduce development time and improve tracking performance.
187.Robust Robot Walker: Learning Agile Locomotion over Tiny Traps
坚固的机器人步行者：学习在微小陷阱中敏捷运动
188.Agile Continuous Jumping in Discontinuous Terrains
在不连续的地形上敏捷地连续跳跃
在本文中，来自华盛顿大学和卡内基梅隆大学的学者们专注于提高四足机器人的敏捷性，使其能够在楼梯和踏脚石等不连续地形上进行连续、精确和地形自适应的跳跃。
为了完成这项任务，学者们设计了一个分层学习和控制框架，该框架由一个用于稳健地形感知的学习高度图预测器、一个用于多功能和地形自适应规划的基于强化学习的质心级运动策略和一个用于精确运动跟踪的基于低级模型的腿部控制器组成。此外，他们通过精确建模硬件特性来最大限度地缩小模拟与现实的差距。这种分层和混合框架有效地结合了无模型学习和基于模型的控制的优势，这是 Unitree Go1 机器人首次能够在人形楼梯和稀疏的踏脚石上进行敏捷和连续的跳跃。具体来说，机器人每次跳跃可以跨过两个台阶，并在 4.5 秒内完成 3.5 米长、2.8 米高、14 级台阶的台阶。此外，同样的策略在其他各种跑酷任务中的表现优于基线，例如跳过单个水平或垂直不连续点。
In this paper, scholars from the University of Washington and Carnegie Mellon University focus on improving the agility of quadruped robots to enable continuous, precise, and terrain-adaptive jumps on discontinuous terrains such as stairs and stepping stones.
To accomplish this task, the scholars designed a hierarchical learning and control framework consisting of a learned height map predictor for robust terrain perception, a center of mass-level motion policy based on reinforcement learning for versatile and terrain-adaptive planning, and a low-level model-based leg controller for precise motion tracking. In addition, they minimized the gap between simulation and reality by accurately modeling hardware characteristics. This hierarchical and hybrid framework effectively combines the advantages of model-free learning and model-based control, which is the first time that the Unitree Go1 robot is able to perform agile and continuous jumps on humanoid stairs and sparse stepping stones. Specifically, the robot can cross two steps per jump and complete a 3.5-meter-long, 2.8-meter-high, 14-step staircase in 4.5 seconds. In addition, the same strategy outperforms the baseline in various other parkour tasks, such as jumping over single horizontal or vertical discontinuities.
Full-Order Sampling-Based MPC for Torque-Level Locomotion Control via Diffusion-Style Annealing
基于全阶采样的 MPC 通过扩散式退火实现扭矩级运动控制
由于高维性和非凸性，使用全阶动力学模型对有腿机器人进行实时最优控制具有挑战性。因此，非线性模型预测控制 (NMPC) 方法通常仅限于降阶模型。基于采样的 MPC 在非凸甚至不连续问题中显示出潜力，但通常会产生方差较大的次优解，这限制了其在高维运动中的应用。
在这项工作中，来自美国卡内基梅隆大学的学者们引入了 DIAL-MPC（受扩散启发的有腿 MPC 退火），这是一种基于采样的 MPC 框架，具有新颖的扩散式退火过程。这种退火过程得到了模型预测路径积分控制 (MPPI) 的理论景观分析以及 MPPI 与单步扩散之间的联系的支持。从算法上讲，DIAL-MPC 在线迭代优化解决方案，实现全局覆盖和局部收敛。在四足动物扭矩级控制任务中，DIAL-MPC 将标准 MPPI 的跟踪误差降低了 13.4 倍，并且在无需任何训练的情况下，在具有挑战性的攀爬任务中比强化学习 (RL) 策略的表现高出 50%。特别是，DIAL-MPC 能够实现现实世界中四足动物在有效载荷下进行精确跳跃。据我们所知，DIAL-MPC 是第一个无需训练的方法，可以实时优化全阶四足动物动力学。
Real-time optimal control of legged robots using full-order dynamics models is challenging due to high dimensionality and non-convexity. Therefore, nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) methods are usually limited to reduced-order models. Sampling-based MPC shows potential in non-convex and even discontinuous problems, but usually produces suboptimal solutions with large variance, which limits its application in high-dimensional motion.
In this work, scholars from Carnegie Mellon University, USA, introduced DIAL-MPC (Diffusion-Inspired Annealing for Legged MPC), a sampling-based MPC framework with a novel diffusion-based annealing process. This annealing process is supported by theoretical landscape analysis of model-predictive path integral control (MPPI) and the connection between MPPI and single-step diffusion. Algorithmically, DIAL-MPC iteratively optimizes solutions online, achieving global coverage and local convergence. In a quadruped torque-level control task, DIAL-MPC reduces the tracking error of the standard MPPI by 13.4 times and outperforms a reinforcement learning (RL) policy by 50% in a challenging climbing task without any training. In particular, DIAL-MPC enables accurate real-world quadruped jumping with a payload. To the best of our knowledge, DIAL-MPC is the first training-free method that optimizes full-order quadruped dynamics in real time.
191.SARO: Space-Aware Robot System for Terrain Crossing via Vision-Language Model
SARO 通过视觉语言模型实现地形穿越的空间感知机器人系统
视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的应用在各种机器人任务中取得了令人瞩目的成功。然而，对于四足机器人在 3D 环境中穿越地形时使用这些基础模型的探索很少。
在这项工作中，来自清华大学、上海交通大学、浙江大学以及宾夕法尼亚大学的学者们引入了 SARO（用于穿越地形的空间感知机器人系统），这是一个由高级推理模块、闭环子任务执行模块和低级控制策略组成的创新系统。它使机器人能够穿越 3D 地形并到达目标位置。对于高级推理和执行，学者们提出了一种利用 VLM 的新型算法系统，具有任务分解设计和闭环子任务执行机制。对于低级运动控制，他们利用概率退火选择 (PAS) 方法通过强化学习有效地训练控制策略。大量实验表明，学者们的整个系统可以准确而稳健地在多个 3D 地形上导航，并且其泛化能力确保了其在各种室内和室外场景和地形中的应用。
The application of visual language models (VLMs) has achieved remarkable success in various robotic tasks. However, there is little exploration of using these basic models for quadruped robots to traverse terrain in 3D environments.
In this work, scholars from Tsinghua University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Zhejiang University, and the University of Pennsylvania introduced SARO (Spatial Awareness Robot System for Traversing Terrain), an innovative system consisting of a high-level reasoning module, a closed-loop subtask execution module, and a low-level control strategy. It enables the robot to traverse 3D terrain and reach the target location. For high-level reasoning and execution, the scholars proposed a novel algorithmic system that utilizes VLM with a task decomposition design and a closed-loop subtask execution mechanism. For low-level motion control, they utilized the probabilistic annealing selection (PAS) method to effectively train the control policy through reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments show that the scholars' entire system can accurately and robustly navigate on multiple 3D terrains, and its generalization ability ensures its application in various indoor and outdoor scenarios and terrains.
192. Stage-Wise Reward Shaping for Acrobatic Robots: A Constrained Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Approach
杂技机器人的分阶段奖励:塑造一种受约束的多目标强化学习方法
随着通过强化学习 (RL) 解决的任务的复杂性增加，奖励函数的定义也变得非常复杂。来自韩国首尔国立大学的学者们引入了一种 RL 方法，旨在通过直观的策略简化奖励塑造过程。最初，学者们不使用由各种术语组成的单个奖励函数，而是在受限多目标 RL (CMORL) 框架内定义多个奖励和成本函数。对于涉及连续复杂动作的任务。
学者们将任务分为不同的阶段，并为每个阶段定义多个奖励和成本。最后，他们引入了一种实用的 CMORL 算法，该算法根据这些奖励最大化目标，同时满足由成本定义的约束。所提出的方法已在模拟和现实环境中的各种杂技任务中得到成功演示。此外，与现有的 RL 和受限 RL 算法相比，它已被证明能够成功执行任务。
As the complexity of tasks solved by reinforcement learning (RL) increases, the definition of reward functions has become very complex. Scholars from Seoul National University, South Korea, introduced an RL method that aims to simplify the reward shaping process through intuitive strategies. Initially, instead of using a single reward function composed of various terms, the scholars defined multiple reward and cost functions within the constrained multi-objective RL (CMORL) framework. For tasks involving continuous complex actions.
The scholars divided the task into different stages and defined multiple rewards and costs for each stage. Finally, they introduced a practical CMORL algorithm that maximizes the objectives based on these rewards while satisfying the constraints defined by the costs. The proposed method has been successfully demonstrated on various acrobatic tasks in simulated and real-world environments. In addition, it has been shown to be able to successfully perform tasks compared to existing RL and constrained RL algorithms.
193.Neural Circuit Architectural Priors for Quadruped Locomotion
四足动物运动的神经回路结构先验
基于学习的四足动物运动方法通常采用通用策略架构，如全连接 MLP。由于此类架构包含的归纳偏差很少，因此在实践中通常会以奖励、训练课程、模仿数据或轨迹生成器的形式纳入先验。在自然界中，动物生来就具有神经系统架构形式的先验，这种先验经过进化而形成，赋予了它们天生的能力和高效的学习能力。例如，马在出生后数小时内就能行走，并且可以通过练习快速提高。此类架构先验在人工智能的 ANN 架构中也很有用。
在这项工作中，来自纽约大学的学者们探索了基于哺乳动物四肢和脊髓神经回路的生物启发式 ANN 架构对四足动物运动的优势。学者们的架构实现了良好的初始性能和与 MLP 相当的最终性能，同时使用的数据更少，参数也少了几个数量级。他们的架构还表现出对任务变化的更好泛化，甚至可以在不使用标准模拟到真实方法的情况下在物理机器人上部署。这项研究表明，神经回路可以为运动提供宝贵的结构先验，并有助于未来研究其他感觉运动技能。
Learning-based approaches to quadruped locomotion often employ general policy architectures such as fully connected MLPs. Because such architectures contain few inductive biases, priors are often incorporated in practice in the form of rewards, training courses, imitation data, or trajectory generators. In nature, animals are born with priors in the form of nervous system architectures that have evolved to give them innate abilities and efficient learning. For example, horses can walk within hours of birth and can improve rapidly with practice. Such architectural priors are also useful in ANN architectures for artificial intelligence.
In this work, scholars from New York University explored the advantages of biologically inspired ANN architectures based on mammalian limb and spinal neural circuits for quadruped locomotion. The scholars' architecture achieved good initial performance and comparable final performance to MLPs, while using less data and orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Their architecture also showed better generalization to task variations and could even be deployed on physical robots without using standard simulation-to-real methods. This research shows that neural circuits can provide valuable structural priors for locomotion and facilitate future research into other sensorimotor skills.
194.RobotKeyframing: Learning Locomotion with High-Level Objectives via Mixture of Dense and Sparse Rewards
RobotKeyframing：通过混合密集和稀疏奖励学习具有高级目标的运动
在本文中，来自瑞士苏黎世联邦理工学院和瑞士迪士尼研究工作室的学者们介绍了一种新颖的基于学习的控制框架，该框架使用关键帧将高级目标纳入有腿机器人的自然运动中。这些高级目标被指定为可变数量的部分或完整姿势目标，这些目标在时间上任意间隔。学者们提出的框架利用多评论家强化学习算法来有效处理密集和稀疏奖励的混合。此外，它采用基于变换器的编码器来容纳可变数量的输入目标，每个目标都与特定的到达时间相关联。在整个模拟和硬件实验中，他们证明了这个框架可以在所需的时间内有效地满足目标关键帧序列。在实验中，与标准的单评论家替代方案相比，多评论家方法显着减少了超参数调整的工作量。此外，所提出的基于变换器的架构使机器人能够预测未来的目标，从而定量提高它们实现目标的能力。
In this paper, scholars from ETH Zurich and Disney Research Switzerland introduce a novel learning-based control framework that uses keyframes to incorporate high-level goals into the natural motion of legged robots. These high-level goals are specified as a variable number of partial or full pose goals that are arbitrarily spaced in time. The framework proposed by the scholars utilizes a multi-critic reinforcement learning algorithm to effectively handle a mixture of dense and sparse rewards. In addition, it adopts a transformer-based encoder to accommodate a variable number of input goals, each of which is associated with a specific arrival time. Throughout simulation and hardware experiments, they demonstrated that this framework can effectively satisfy the target keyframe sequence within the required time. In experiments, the multi-critic approach significantly reduces the workload of hyperparameter tuning compared to the standard single-critic alternative. In addition, the proposed transformer-based architecture enables robots to predict future goals, thereby quantitatively improving their ability to achieve goals.
195.Simultaneous Ground Reaction Force and State Estimation via Constrained Moving Horizon Estimation
通过约束移动时域估计同时进行地面反作用力和状态估计
准确的地面反作用力 (GRF) 估计可以显著提高腿式机器人在各种实际应用中的适应性。例如，通过估计 GRF 和接触运动学，运动控制和规划可帮助机器人克服不确定的地形。作为非线性观测器的典型动量方法不能完全解决噪声测量以及浮动基座状态与广义动量动力学之间的依赖关系。
在本文中，来自于威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校威斯康星快速腿部运动实验室（WELL-Lab）的学者们提出了一种腿式机器人的同步地面反作用力和状态估计框架，该系统解决了传感器噪声以及状态和动力学之间的耦合问题。在单独估计浮动基座方向的情况下，实施了分散移动水平估计 (MHE) 方法，以在凸窗口优化中融合机器人动力学、本体感受传感器、外部感受传感器和确定性接触互补约束。事实证明，学者们所提出的方法能够为几种足式机器人提供准确的 GRF 和状态估计，包括开源教育平面双足机器人 STRIDE 和四足机器人 Unitree Go1，频率为 200Hz，过去时间窗口为 0.04 秒。
Accurate ground reaction force (GRF) estimation can significantly improve the adaptability of legged robots in various practical applications. For example, by estimating GRF and contact kinematics, motion control and planning can help robots overcome uncertain terrain. Typical momentum methods as nonlinear observers cannot fully address noisy measurements and the dependency between the floating base state and generalized momentum dynamics.
In this paper, scholars from the Wisconsin Rapid Legged Locomotion Laboratory (WELL-Lab) at the University of Wisconsin-Madison proposed a synchronized ground reaction force and state estimation framework for legged robots that addresses sensor noise and the coupling between state and dynamics. With the floating base orientation estimated separately, a decentralized moving level estimation (MHE) method is implemented to fuse robot dynamics, proprioceptive sensors, exteroceptive sensors, and deterministic contact complementarity constraints in convex window optimization. It turns out that the proposed method is able to provide accurate GRF and state estimates for several legged robots, including the open source educational planar bipedal robot STRIDE and the quadrupedal robot Unitree Go1, at a frequency of 200Hz and a past time window of 0.04 seconds.
196.Robust State Estimation for Legged Robots with Dual Beta Kalman Filter
采用双贝塔卡尔曼滤波器实现腿式机器人的稳健状态估计
现有的依靠本体感受传感器的有腿机器人状态估计算法经常忽略物理世界中的足部滑动和腿部变形，从而导致较大的估计误差。
为了解决这一限制，来自清华大学和北京大学的学者们提出了一个综合测量模型，通过分析足部接触点与机器人身体中心之间的相对运动，该模型既考虑了足部滑动，也考虑了可变的腿长。学者们表明，腿长是一个可观察的量，这意味着可以通过设计辅助滤波器明确推断出其值。为此，学者们引入了一个双重估计框架，该框架迭代地使用参数滤波器来估计腿长参数，使用状态滤波器来估计机器人的状态。为了防止此迭代框架中的误差累积，他们使用腿部静态方程为参数滤波器构建了一个部分测量模型。这种方法确保腿长估计仅依赖于关节扭矩和足部接触力，避免了状态估计误差对参数估计的影响。与可以直接估计的腿长不同，足部滑动不能用当前的传感器配置直接测量。但是，由于足部打滑发生的频率较低，因此可以将其视为测量数据中的异常值。为了减轻这些异常值的影响，学者们提出了 beta 卡尔曼滤波器 (beta KF)，它使用 beta 散度重新定义规范卡尔曼滤波中的估计损失。这种散度可以自适应地为异常值分配较低的权重，从而增强估计算法的稳健性。这些技术共同构成了双 beta 卡尔曼滤波器 (Dual beta KF)，这是一种用于腿式机器人稳健状态估计的新型算法。在 Unitree GO2 机器人上的实验结果表明，双 beta KF 的性能明显优于最先进的方法。
Existing state estimation algorithms for legged robots that rely on proprioceptive sensors often ignore foot sliding and leg deformation in the physical world, resulting in large estimation errors.
To address this limitation, scholars from Tsinghua University and Peking University proposed a comprehensive measurement model that considers both foot sliding and variable leg length by analyzing the relative motion between the foot contact point and the robot body center. The scholars showed that leg length is an observable quantity, which means that its value can be explicitly inferred by designing auxiliary filters. To this end, the scholars introduced a dual estimation framework that iteratively uses a parameter filter to estimate the leg length parameters and a state filter to estimate the robot's state. To prevent error accumulation in this iterative framework, they constructed a partial measurement model for the parameter filter using the leg static equation. This approach ensures that leg length estimation depends only on joint torques and foot contact forces, avoiding the influence of state estimation errors on parameter estimation. Unlike leg length, which can be directly estimated, foot sliding cannot be directly measured with the current sensor configuration. However, since foot slip occurs less frequently, it can be considered an outlier in the measurement data. To mitigate the impact of these outliers, scholars proposed the beta Kalman filter (beta KF), which redefines the estimation loss in the canonical Kalman filter using beta divergence. This divergence can adaptively assign lower weights to outliers, thereby enhancing the robustness of the estimation algorithm. Together, these techniques form the dual beta Kalman filter (Dual beta KF), a new algorithm for robust state estimation of legged robots. Experimental results on the Unitree GO2 robot show that the performance of the dual beta KF is significantly better than the state-of-the-art methods.
197.Chance-Constrained Convex MPC for Robust Quadruped Locomotion Under Parametric and Additive Uncertainties
机会约束凸 MPC 在参数和附加不确定性下实现稳健的四足运动
四足运动的最新进展集中在提高不同环境中的稳定性和性能。然而，现有的方法往往缺乏足够的安全分析，难以适应不同的有效载荷和复杂的地形，通常需要进行大量的调整。
为了克服这些挑战，来自美国马萨诸塞州波士顿东北大学的学者们提出了一个机会约束模型预测控制 (CCMPC) 框架，该框架明确地将有效载荷和地形变化建模为单刚体动力学 (SRBD) 模型中的参数和附加扰动分布。学者们的方法通过将模型摩擦锥约束（定义可行的地面反作用力集）表示为机会约束，确保在不确定的动态下安全且一致的性能。此外，学者们使用计算效率高的二次规划公式来解决由此产生的随机控制问题。对不同有效载荷和复杂地形上的四足运动进行广泛的蒙特卡罗模拟表明，CCMPC 明显优于两个竞争基准：线性 MPC (LMPC) 和手动调整安全裕度以保持稳定性、减少脚滑和跟踪重心的 MPC。 Unitree Go1 机器人上的硬件实验表明，尽管没有进行额外的参数调整，机器人仍可以在各种室内和室外地形上成功移动，且未知负载超过机器人体重的 50%。
Recent advances in quadrupedal locomotion have focused on improving stability and performance in different environments. However, existing approaches often lack adequate safety analysis, have difficulty adapting to different payloads and complex terrains, and often require extensive tuning.
To overcome these challenges, researchers from Northeastern University in Boston, Massachusetts, USA, proposed a chance-constrained model predictive control (CCMPC) framework that explicitly models payload and terrain variations as parameters and additional perturbation distributions in a single rigid body dynamics (SRBD) model. Their approach ensures safe and consistent performance under uncertain dynamics by expressing the model friction cone constraints (which define the set of feasible ground reaction forces) as chance constraints. In addition, the researchers use a computationally efficient quadratic programming formulation to solve the resulting stochastic control problem. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations of quadrupedal locomotion over different payloads and complex terrains show that CCMPC significantly outperforms two competing baselines: linear MPC (LMPC) and MPC with manually adjusted safety margins to maintain stability, reduce foot slip, and track the center of gravity. Hardware experiments on the Unitree Go1 robot show that the robot can successfully move on various indoor and outdoor terrains with unknown loads exceeding 50% of the robot's body weight, despite no additional parameter tuning.
198.ANAVI: Audio Noise Awareness using Visuals of Indoor environments for NAVIgation
ANAVI：利用室内环境视觉效果实现导航的音频噪声感知
在本文中，来自卡内基梅隆大学的学者们提出使用室内视觉效果进行导航的音频噪声感知，以实现更安静的机器人路径规划。虽然人类天生就意识到自己发出的噪音及其对周围人的影响，但机器人目前缺乏这种意识。实现机器人音频感知的一个关键挑战是估计机器人在听众位置的行为会有多大。由于声音取决于房间的几何形状和材料组成，学者们训练机器人通过对室内环境的视觉观察被动感知响度。为此，学者们生成有关模拟家庭中不同听众位置的“脉冲”声音有多大的数据，并训练他们的声学噪声预测器 (ANP)。接下来，学者们收集与不同导航动作相对应的声学曲线。将 ANP 与动作声学统一起来，他们展示了轮式（Hello Robot Stretch）和腿式（Unitree Go2）机器人的实验，以便这些机器人遵守环境的噪声限制。
In this paper, researchers from Carnegie Mellon University propose audio noise perception for navigation using indoor visuals to enable quieter robot path planning. While humans are naturally aware of the noise they make and how it affects those around them, robots currently lack this awareness. A key challenge in enabling robotic audio perception is estimating how loud the robot's behavior will be at the listener's position. Since sound depends on the geometry and material composition of the room, researchers train robots to passively perceive loudness through visual observations of the indoor environment. To do this, researchers generate data on how loud "pulses" of sound are at different listener positions in a simulated home and train their acoustic noise predictor (ANP). Next, researchers collect acoustic profiles corresponding to different navigation actions. Unifying the ANP with action acoustics, they present experiments with wheeled (Hello Robot Stretch) and legged (Unitree Go2) robots so that these robots adhere to the noise limits of the environment.
Online Optimization of Central Pattern Generators for Quadruped Locomotion
四足运动中央模式发生器的在线优化
典型的腿部运动控制器是离线设计或训练的。这与许多动物形成了鲜明对比，它们在出生时就能运动，并且几乎无需与现实世界互动就能迅速提高运动技能。这种运动控制是通过位于脊椎动物脊髓中的振荡神经网络实现的，称为中央模式生成器 (CPG)。CPG 模型已广泛用于生成机器人的运动技能，但可能需要大量手动调整或使用遗传算法离线优化相互连接的参数。
在本文中，来自洛桑联邦理工学院的学者们提出了一个通过贝叶斯优化在线优化 CPG 参数的框架。学者们表明，这个框架可以快速优化和适应不同的速度命令和地形变化，例如不同的摩擦系数、地形坡度角和放置在机器人上的额外质量有效载荷。他们研究了感官反馈对 CPG 的影响，发现相位方程中的力反馈以及姿势控制（虚拟模型控制）都有利于机器人的稳定性和能效。在 Unitree Go1 上的硬件实验中，学者们展示了快速优化（不到 3 分钟）和节能步态适应各种场景中不同的目标速度：不同的摩擦系数、高达 15 公斤的附加有效载荷和高达 10 度的可变坡度。
Typical legged motor controllers are designed or trained offline. This is in stark contrast to many animals, which are able to move at birth and rapidly improve their motor skills with little interaction with the real world. This motor control is achieved through an oscillating neural network located in the spinal cord of vertebrates, called the Central Pattern Generator (CPG). CPG models have been widely used to generate motor skills in robots, but can require extensive manual tuning or offline optimization of interconnected parameters using genetic algorithms.
In this paper, scholars from the Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne proposed a framework for optimizing CPG parameters online via Bayesian optimization. The scholars showed that this framework can quickly optimize and adapt to different speed commands and terrain changes, such as different friction coefficients, terrain slope angles, and additional mass payloads placed on the robot. They studied the impact of sensory feedback on the CPG and found that force feedback in the phase equation as well as posture control (virtual model control) are beneficial to the robot's stability and energy efficiency. In hardware experiments on Unitree Go1, the scholars demonstrated fast optimization (less than 3 minutes) and energy-efficient gait adaptation to different target speeds in a variety of scenarios: different friction coefficients, additional payloads up to 15 kg, and variable slopes up to 10 degrees.
200.Jailbreaking LLM-Controlled Robots
破解LLM控制的机器人
最近推出的大型语言模型 (LLM) 彻底改变了机器人领域，它能够在操控、运动和自动驾驶汽车等各种领域实现情境推理和直观的人机交互。当被视为一项独立技术时，LLM 很容易受到越狱攻击，恶意提示器会绕过 LLM 安全护栏来引出有害文本。
为了评估在机器人领域部署 LLM 的风险，来自宾夕法尼亚大学的学者们在本文中介绍了 RoboPAIR，这是第一个旨在越狱 LLM 控制机器人的算法。与现有的针对 LLM 聊天机器人的文本攻击不同，RoboPAIR 会引发 LLM 控制的机器人做出有害的物理动作，学者们在三种场景中通过实验证明了这一现象：(i) 白盒设置，其中攻击者可以完全访问 NVIDIA Dolphins 自动驾驶 LLM，(ii) 灰盒设置，其中攻击者可以部分访问配备 GPT-4o 规划器的 Clearpath Robotics Jackal UGV 机器人，以及 (iii) 黑盒设置，其中攻击者只能查询访问集成 GPT-3.5 的 Unitree Robotics Go2 机器狗。在每种情况下以及在三个新的有害机器人动作数据集中，学者们证明 RoboPAIR 以及几个静态基线可以快速有效地发现越狱，通常实现 100% 的攻击成功率。学者们的结果首次揭示，鉴于越狱机器人在现实世界中造成物理损坏的可能性很大，越狱 LLM 的风险远远超出了文本生成。事实上，我们在 Unitree Go2 上的结果代表了已部署的商业机器人系统首次成功越狱。解决这一新出现的漏洞对于确保 LLM 在机器人技术中的安全部署至关重要。
The recent introduction of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized the field of robotics, enabling contextual reasoning and intuitive human-robot interaction in domains as diverse as manipulation, locomotion, and self-driving cars. When viewed as a standalone technology, LLMs are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where malicious prompters circumvent LLM safety guardrails to elicit harmful text.
To assess the risk of deploying LLMs in robotics, researchers from the University of Pennsylvania present RoboPAIR, the first algorithm designed to jailbreak LLM-controlled robots. Unlike existing text attacks against LLM chatbots, RoboPAIR induces LLM-controlled robots to perform harmful physical actions, which they experimentally demonstrate in three scenarios: (i) a white-box setting where the attacker has full access to an NVIDIA Dolphins self-driving LLM, (ii) a gray-box setting where the attacker has partial access to a Clearpath Robotics Jackal UGV equipped with a GPT-4o planner, and (iii) a black-box setting where the attacker only has query access to a Unitree Robotics Go2 robot dog with GPT-3.5. In each case and across three new datasets of harmful robotic actions, we demonstrate that RoboPAIR, along with several static baselines, can quickly and effectively discover jailbreaks, often achieving 100% attack success rate. Our results reveal for the first time that the risks of jailbreaking LLM extend far beyond text generation, given the high likelihood of physical damage caused by jailbroken robots in the real world. In fact, our results on Unitree Go2 represent the first successful jailbreak of a deployed commercial robotic system. Addressing this emerging vulnerability is critical to ensuring the safe deployment of LLM in robotics.
201.Preference Aligned Diffusion Planner for Quadrupedal Locomotion Control
用于四足运动控制的偏好对齐扩散规划器
扩散模型在从大规模数据集中捕获复杂分布方面表现出色，为四足运动控制提供了一种有希望的解决方案。然而，由于数据集中的状态覆盖范围有限，离线策略对分布外 (OOD) 状态很敏感。
在本文中，来自香港科技大学和中国电信人工智能研究院（TeleAI）以及南方科技大学的学者们提出了一个结合离线学习和在线偏好对齐的两阶段学习框架，用于腿部运动控制。通过离线阶段，扩散规划器从专家数据集中学习状态-动作序列的联合分布，而无需使用奖励标签。随后，学者们基于训练后的离线规划器在模拟环境中执行在线交互，这显著解决了 OOD 问题并提高了鲁棒性。具体来说，学者们提出了一种新颖的弱偏好标记方法，没有真实奖励或人类偏好。他们所提出的方法在慢速和高速场景下的踱步、小跑和跳跃步态中表现出卓越的稳定性和速度跟踪精度，并且可以对真实的 Unitree Go1 机器人进行零样本迁移。
Diffusion models excel at capturing complex distributions from large-scale data sets, providing a promising solution for quadruped locomotion control. However, offline strategies are sensitive to out-of-distribution (OOD) states due to limited state coverage in the dataset.
In this paper, scholars from Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and China Telecom Artificial Intelligence Research Institute (TeleAI), as well as Southern University of Science and Technology, propose a two-stage learning framework that combines offline learning and online preference alignment for leg movement control. Through an offline stage, the diffusion planner learns the joint distribution of state-action sequences from expert datasets without using reward labels. Subsequently, the scholars performed online interactions in a simulated environment based on the trained offline planner, which significantly solved the OOD problem and improved robustness. Specifically, the scholars proposed a novel weak preference labeling method without real rewards or human preferences. Their proposed method demonstrates excellent stability and speed tracking accuracy in pacing, trotting, and jumping gaits in slow and high-speed scenarios, and enables zero-shot transfer to a real Unitree Go1 robot.
202.NaVILA: Legged Robot Vision-Language-Action Model for Navigation
NaVILA：用于导航的腿式机器人视觉-语言-动作模型
在本文中，来自加州大学圣地亚哥分校和南加州大学以及NVIDIA的学者们提出了用腿式机器人解决视觉和语言导航问题，这不仅为人类提供了灵活的指挥方式，还允许机器人在更具挑战性和混乱的场景中导航。然而，将人类语言指令一直翻译成低级腿部关节动作并非易事。学者们提出了 NaVILA，这是一个 2 级框架，将视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 与运动技能统一起来。NaVILA 不是直接从 VLA 预测低级动作，而是首先以语言的形式生成具有空间信息的中级动作（例如，“向前移动 75 厘米”），作为视觉运动 RL 策略的输入以供执行。NaVILA 大大改进了现有基准上的先前方法。学者们新开发的 IsaacLab 基准测试也展示了同样的优势，具有更逼真的场景、低级控制和真实世界的机器人实验。
In this paper, scholars from the University of California, San Diego and the University of Southern California, as well as NVIDIA, proposed to solve the problem of visual and language navigation with legged robots, which not only provides humans with flexible command methods, but also allows robots to navigate in more challenging and cluttered scenes. However, it is not easy to translate human language instructions all the way into low-level leg joint actions. Scholars proposed NaVILA, a 2-level framework that unifies the visual-language-action model (VLA) with motor skills. Instead of predicting low-level actions directly from VLA, NaVILA first generates mid-level actions with spatial information in the form of language (e.g., "move forward 75 cm") as input to the visual-motion RL policy for execution. NaVILA significantly improves previous methods on existing benchmarks. The same advantages are also demonstrated on the newly developed IsaacLab benchmark by scholars, with more realistic scenes, low-level control, and real-world robot experiments.
203.NVILA: Efficient Frontier Visual Language Models
NVILA：高效前沿视觉语言模型
近年来，视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在准确性方面取得了重大进步。然而，它们的效率却受到的关注较少。本文介绍了 NVILA，这是一系列旨在优化效率和准确性的开放式 VLM。
在 VILA 的基础上，来自 NVIDIA ,麻省理工学院,加州大学,华盛顿大学以及清华大学的学者们，通过首先扩大空间和时间分辨率，然后压缩视觉标记来改进其模型架构。这种“先缩放后压缩”的方法使 NVILA 能够高效处理高分辨率图像和长视频。学者们还进行了系统调查，以提高 NVILA 在其整个生命周期（从训练和微调到部署）中的效率。NVILA 在广泛的图像和视频基准测试中达到或超过了许多领先的开放和专有 VLM 的准确性。同时，它将训练成本降低了 4.5 倍，将微调内存使用量降低了 3.4 倍，预填充延迟降低了 1.6-2.2 倍，解码延迟降低了 1.2-2.8 倍。
In recent years, visual language models (VLMs) have achieved significant progress in accuracy. However, their efficiency has received less attention. This paper introduces NVILA, a family of open VLMs designed to optimize efficiency and accuracy.
Building on VILA, scholars from NVIDIA, MIT, UC, UW, and Tsinghua University improve its model architecture by first scaling up spatial and temporal resolution and then compressing visual tags. This "scaling first, then compressing" approach enables NVILA to efficiently process high-resolution images and long videos. Scholars also conducted a systematic investigation to improve the efficiency of NVILA throughout its lifecycle, from training and fine-tuning to deployment. NVILA meets or exceeds the accuracy of many leading open and proprietary VLMs on a wide range of image and video benchmarks. At the same time, it reduces training cost by 4.5 times, fine-tuning memory usage by 3.4 times, pre-population latency by 1.6-2.2 times, and decoding latency by 1.2-2.8 times.
204.Discovery of skill switching criteria for learning agile quadruped locomotion
发现学习敏捷四足运动的技能转换标准
在本文中，来自牛津大学和伦敦大学的学者们开发了一个分层学习和优化框架，可以学习并实现协调良好的多技能运动。学习到的多技能策略可以在跟踪任意定位的目标时自动自然地在技能之间切换，并迅速从失败中恢复。提出的框架由深度强化学习过程和优化过程组成。首先，将接触模式纳入奖励项中，以作为单独的策略学习不同类型的步态，而无需任何其他参考。然后，学习更高级别的策略来为各个策略生成权重，以在目标跟踪任务设置中组成多技能运动。技能会根据与目标的距离自动自然地切换。技能切换的适当距离被纳入学习高级策略的奖励计算中，并随着学习的进展由外部优化循环更新。学者们首先在模拟的 Unitree A1 四足机器人上展示了综合任务中成功的多技能运动。学者们还在现实世界中部署了学习到的策略，展示了小跑、跳跃、疾驰以及随着目标位置的变化而自然过渡的动作。此外，学习到的策略可以随时对意外故障做出反应，迅速恢复，并成功恢复运动。与现实世界中无法过渡到疾驰的单个技能之间的离散切换相比，头部们提出的方法实现了所有学习到的敏捷技能，技能过渡更顺畅、更连续。
In this paper, scholars from the University of Oxford and University College London developed a hierarchical learning and optimization framework that can learn and achieve well-coordinated multi-skill motion. The learned multi-skill policy can automatically and naturally switch between skills while tracking arbitrarily positioned targets and recover quickly from failures. The proposed framework consists of a deep reinforcement learning process and an optimization process. First, the contact pattern is incorporated into the reward term to learn different types of gaits as separate policies without any other reference. Then, a higher-level policy is learned to generate weights for individual policies to compose multi-skill motion in the target tracking task setting. Skills are automatically and naturally switched based on the distance to the target. The appropriate distance for skill switching is incorporated into the reward calculation for learning high-level policies and is updated by an external optimization loop as learning progresses. Scholars first demonstrated successful multi-skill motion in a comprehensive task on a simulated Unitree A1 quadruped robot. Scholars also deployed the learned policy in the real world, demonstrating trotting, jumping, galloping, and natural transitions as the target position changes. In addition, the learned policy can react to unexpected failures at any time, recover quickly, and successfully resume motion. Compared to discrete switching between individual skills in the real world that cannot transition to gallop, our proposed method implements all learned agility skills with smoother and more continuous skill transitions.
205.Benchmarking Model Predictive Control and Reinforcement Learning Based Control for Legged Robot Locomotion in MuJoCo Simulation
MuJoCo 模拟中基于模型预测控制和强化学习的腿部机器人运动控制基准测试
模型预测控制 (MPC) 和强化学习 (RL) 是控制腿式机器人的两种主要策略，每种策略都有独特的优势。RL 通过系统交互学习控制策略，适应各种场景，而 MPC 则依赖于预定义的数学模型来实时解决优化问题。尽管它们被广泛使用，但在标准化条件下缺乏直接的比较分析。
在本文中，来自密歇根理工大学的学者们通过在 MuJoCo 模拟环境中对 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上的 MPC 和 RL 控制器进行基准测试来解决这一差距，重点关注标准化任务——以恒定速度直线行走。性能评估基于干扰抑制、能源效率和地形适应性。结果表明，RL 在处理干扰和保持能源效率方面表现出色，但由于其依赖于针对特定环境量身定制的学习策略，因此难以推广到新的地形。相比之下，MPC 通过利用其基于优化的方法，显示出从较大扰动中增强的恢复能力，从而允许在机器人的关节之间平衡分配控制力。研究结果清晰地展现了 RL 和 MPC 的优势和局限性，为选择适合腿式机器人应用的控制策略提供了参考。
Model predictive control (MPC) and reinforcement learning (RL) are two main strategies for controlling legged robots, each with unique advantages. RL learns control policies through system interactions and adapts to various scenarios, while MPC relies on predefined mathematical models to solve optimization problems in real time. Despite their widespread use, there is a lack of direct comparative analysis under standardized conditions.
In this paper, scholars from Michigan Technological University address this gap by benchmarking MPC and RL controllers on the Unitree Go1 quadruped robot in the MuJoCo simulation environment, focusing on a standardized task - walking in a straight line at a constant speed. Performance evaluation is based on disturbance rejection, energy efficiency, and terrain adaptability. The results show that RL performs well in handling disturbances and maintaining energy efficiency, but it has difficulty generalizing to new terrains due to its reliance on learning strategies tailored to specific environments. In contrast, MPC shows enhanced recovery from large perturbations by leveraging its optimization-based approach, allowing for a balanced distribution of control forces among the robot's joints. The results clearly demonstrate the advantages and limitations of RL and MPC, providing a reference for selecting control strategies suitable for legged robot applications.
206.SLIM: Sim-to-Real Legged Instructive Manipulation via Long-Horizon Visuomotor Learning
SLIM：通过长视运动学习实现模拟真实的腿部指导操作
来自地平线机器人的学者们提出了一种低成本的腿部移动操控系统，该系统可解决现实世界中的长视程任务，通过纯模拟强化学习进行训练。该系统通过以下方式实现：1）按照任务指令进行视觉移动操控的高级策略的分层设计，以及低级四足动物运动策略；2）高级教师和学生训练管道，该管道训练教师使用特权任务分解和目标对象信息处理长视程任务，并通过由教师行为指导的强化学习进一步训练学生进行视觉移动操控；3）一套最小化模拟与现实差距的技术。与许多使用高端设备的先前研究相比，尽管模拟到现实的转移挑战越来越大，但学者们的系统仍使用更易于访问的硬件（具体来说，Unitree Go1 四足动物、WidowX-250S 手臂和单个腕戴式 RGB 摄像头）展示了有效的性能。经过完全模拟训练后，单一策略可以自主解决涉及搜索、移动、抓取、运输和放入的长距离任务，在现实世界中成功率接近 80%。在执行相同任务时，这种性能可与专家级人类远程操作相媲美，而机器人效率更高，运行速度约为远程操作的 1.5 倍。最后，学者们对高效 RL 训练和有效模拟到现实迁移的关键技术进行了广泛的改进，并展示了在各种照明条件下在各种室内和室外场景中的有效部署。
Scholars from Horizon Robotics proposed a low-cost legged mobile manipulation system that solves long-view tasks in the real world, trained by pure simulation reinforcement learning. The system is achieved through: 1) the hierarchical design of high-level policies for visual mobile manipulation following task instructions, and low-level quadruped locomotion policies; 2) a high-level teacher and student training pipeline that trains the teacher to handle long-view tasks using privileged task decomposition and target object information, and further trains the student for visual mobile manipulation through reinforcement learning guided by the teacher's behavior; 3) a set of techniques to minimize the gap between simulation and reality. Compared with many previous studies using high-end equipment, despite the increasing challenges of simulation-to-reality transfer, the scholars' system still demonstrates effective performance using more accessible hardware (specifically, Unitree Go1 quadruped, WidowX-250S arm, and a single wrist-worn RGB camera). After full simulation training, a single policy can autonomously solve long-distance tasks involving search, movement, grasping, transportation, and placement with a success rate close to 80% in the real world. This performance is comparable to expert human teleoperation when performing the same task, while the robot is more efficient, running about 1.5 times faster than the teleoperator. Finally, the scholars made extensive improvements to key techniques for efficient RL training and effective simulation-to-reality transfer, and demonstrated effective deployment in a variety of indoor and outdoor scenes under various lighting conditions.
207.One Filter to Deploy Them All: Robust Safety for Quadrupedal Navigation in Unknown Environments
一个过滤器即可部署所有功能：为未知环境中的四足导航提供强大的安全性
随着基于学习的足式机器人方法迅速普及，人们必须能够在不同的控制器和环境中有效地提供安全保障。现有的研究要么依靠对环境和安全约束的先验知识来确保系统安全，要么为特定的运动策略提供保障。为了解决这些限制，来自南加州大学和斯坦福大学的学者们提出了一种基于观察条件可达性 (OCR) 的安全过滤器框架。学者们的主要思想是使用 OCR 价值网络 (OCR-VN)，该网络可预测部署期间新故障区域和动态不确定性的最佳控制理论安全值函数。具体而言，OCR-VN 通过两个关键组件促进快速安全适应：基于 LiDAR 的输入，允许根据新障碍物动态构建安全区域，以及考虑野外动态不确定性的干扰估计模块。预测的安全值函数用于构建自适应安全过滤器，该过滤器在必要时会覆盖标称四足控制器以保持安全。通过在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上的模拟研究和硬件实验，学者们证明了所提出的框架可以自动保护各种分层四足机器人控制器，适应新环境，并且对未建模的动态具有鲁棒性，无需事先访问控制器或环境，因此，“一个过滤器即可部署所有”。
As learning-based approaches to legged robots rapidly gain popularity, it is imperative that we be able to effectively provide safety guarantees across different controllers and environments. Existing studies either rely on prior knowledge of the environment and safety constraints to ensure system safety, or provide guarantees for specific motion strategies. To address these limitations, scholars from the University of Southern California and Stanford University proposed a safety filter framework based on observation-conditioned reachability (OCR). The main idea of ​​the scholars is to use an OCR value network (OCR-VN), which predicts the optimal control-theoretic safety value function for new fault regions and dynamic uncertainties during deployment. Specifically, OCR-VN promotes fast safety adaptation through two key components: LiDAR-based input that allows the dynamic construction of safety regions based on new obstacles, and a disturbance estimation module that considers dynamic uncertainties in the wild. The predicted safety value function is used to construct an adaptive safety filter that overrides the nominal quadruped controller when necessary to maintain safety. Through simulation studies and hardware experiments on the Unitree Go1 quadruped robot, the scholars demonstrated that the proposed framework can automatically protect a variety of hierarchical quadruped robot controllers, adapt to new environments, and is robust to unmodeled dynamics without requiring prior access to the controller or the environment, thus, “one filter to deploy them all.”
208.GainAdaptor: Learning Quadrupedal Locomotion with Dual Actors for Adaptable and Energy-Efficient Walking on Various Terrains
GainAdaptor：通过双人动作学习四足运动，实现在各种地形上适应性强且节能的行走
深度强化学习 (DRL) 已成为一种创新解决方案，用于使用极简架构在具有挑战性的环境中控制腿式机器人。传统的腿式机器人控制方法（例如逆动力学）要么直接管理关节扭矩，要么使用比例微分 (PD) 控制器在更高级别调节关节位置。在 DRL 的情况下，直接扭矩控制带来了重大挑战，导致人们偏爱关节位置控制。然而，这种方法需要仔细调整关节 PD 增益，这会限制适应性和效率。
在本文中,来自首尔国立科技大学的学者们提出了 GainAdaptor，这是一种自适应增益控制框架，可自主调整关节 PD 增益以增强地形适应性和能源效率。该框架采用双参与者算法，根据不同的地面条件动态调整 PD 增益。通过利用划分的动作空间，GainAdaptor 可以有效地学习稳定且节能的运动。学者们通过在 Unitree Go1 机器人上进行的实验验证了所提出方法的有效性，证明了在不同地形上的运动性能有所提高。
Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has emerged as an innovative solution for controlling legged robots in challenging environments using minimalist architectures. Conventional legged robot control approaches, such as inverse dynamics, either directly manage joint torques or use proportional-derivative (PD) controllers to regulate joint positions at a higher level. In the case of DRL, direct torque control poses significant challenges, leading to a preference for joint position control. However, this approach requires careful tuning of joint PD gains, which limits adaptability and efficiency.
In this paper, scholars from Seoul National University of Science and Technology propose GainAdaptor, an adaptive gain control framework that autonomously adjusts joint PD gains to enhance terrain adaptability and energy efficiency. The framework adopts a dual-actor algorithm to dynamically adjust PD gains according to different ground conditions. By leveraging a partitioned action space, GainAdaptor can effectively learn stable and energy-efficient motions. The scholars validated the effectiveness of the proposed method through experiments on the Unitree Go1 robot, demonstrating improved motion performance on different terrains.
209.Ask1: Development and Reinforcement Learning-Based Control of a Custom Quadruped Robot
Ask1：定制四足机器人的开发和基于强化学习的控制
在本研究中，来自大连理工和上海交大的学者们介绍了定制四足机器人 Ask1 的设计、开发和实验验证。Ask1 机器人与 Unitree Go1 具有相似的形态，但具有定制的硬件组件和不同的控制架构。学者们将以前基于强化学习 (RL) 的控制方法转移并扩展到 Ask1 机器人，证明了他们的方法在现实场景中的适用性。通过消除对抗性运动先验 (AMP) 和参考轨迹的需求，学者们引入了一种新颖的奖励函数来指导机器人的运动方式。学者们通过在 Go1 和 Ask1 机器人上训练所提出的 RL 算法来展示其泛化能力。模拟和现实世界的实验验证了该方法的有效性，表明 Ask1 与 Go1 一样，能够在各种崎岖的地形上导航。
In this study, scholars from Dalian University of Technology and Shanghai Jiao Tong University present the design, development, and experimental validation of a custom quadruped robot, Ask1. The Ask1 robot has a similar morphology to the Unitree Go1, but has custom hardware components and a different control architecture. The scholars transfer and extend previous reinforcement learning (RL)-based control methods to the Ask1 robot, demonstrating the applicability of their approach in real-world scenarios. By eliminating the need for adversarial motion priors (AMPs) and reference trajectories, the scholars introduce a novel reward function to guide the robot's motion. The scholars demonstrate the generalization ability of the proposed RL algorithm by training it on both the Go1 and Ask1 robots. Simulation and real-world experiments validate the effectiveness of the approach, showing that Ask1, like Go1, is able to navigate a variety of rugged terrains.
210. Evaluation of the Energy Consumption of a Mobile Robotic Platform for Sustainable Wireless Networks
可持续无线网络移动机器人平台能耗评估
无线设备的扩散需要灵活的网络基础架构，以满足不断提高的服务质量（QoS）要求。充当移动通信单元的移动机器人平台（MRP）是在动态网络方案中提供按需无线连接的有前途的解决方案。但是，必须考虑MRP的能耗是一个挑战，以最大程度地提高创建的无线网络的可用性。
本文的主要贡献是对充当移动通信单元的MRP能源消耗的实验评估。该评估考虑了实际MRP执行的不同动作，表明能源消耗随执行的作用类型而有很大差异。结果为在动态网络方案中优化MRP运动的方式铺平了道路，从而最大程度地提高了无线网络的可用性，同时最大程度地减少了MRP能源消耗。
The proliferation of wireless devices requires flexible network infrastructures to meet the increasing Quality of Service (QoS) requirements. Mobile Robotic Platforms (MRPs) acting as mobile communications cells are a promising solution to provide on-demand wireless connectivity in dynamic networking scenarios. However, the energy consumption of MRPs is a challenge that must be considered to maximize the availability of the wireless networks created.
The main contribution of this paper is the experimental evaluation of the energy consumption of an MRP acting as a mobile communications cell. The evaluation considers different actions performed by a real MRP, demonstrating that energy consumption varies significantly with the type of action performed.
The results obtained pave the way for optimizing MRP movement in dynamic networking scenarios, maximizing wireless network’s availability while minimizing the MRP energy consumption.
Mobile Communications Cell Wireless devices.
211. Enabling Navigation and Mission-Based Control on a Low-Cost Unitree Go1 Air Quadrupedal Robot
在低成本宇树Go1 Air四足机器人上实现导航和基于任务的控制
四足机器人如今已不再像十年前那样仅停留在原型机阶段。该领域目前的研究重点已从解决单纯的运动控制问题，转向为机器人寻找新的应用场景。尽管在过去十年中，四足机器人的价格已显著下降，但其成本仍相对较高，这被认为是制约相关研究的因素之一，尤其是在涉及多机器人协同的多智能体场景中。本文提出了一种简单且易于复现的方法，将宇树科技 Go1 系列中成本最低的机器人与运行 ArduPilot 固件的控制器集成，且无需拆解机器人或修改其硬件结构。实验研究表明，所提出的基于 Wi-Fi 的控制方法引入的平均延迟为 206.7 毫秒，标准差低于 53 毫秒，这一性能适用于基于全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）的任务路径跟随。同时，使用以太网控制可将平均延迟降低至 78.3 毫秒，并能提供额外功能（如配置步高等）。最后，在 Go1 的标准速度范围内，所提出的基于 Wi-Fi 和以太网的两种控制接口均适用于大多数实际的室内外任务。
