Quadrupedal robots are now not just prototypes as they were a decade ago. This field now focuses on finding new application areas for robots rather than solving pure locomotion problems. Although the price of quadrupedal robots has decreased significantly during the last decade, it is still relatively high and can be considered as one of the limiting factors for research, especially for multi-agent scenarios involving multiple robots. This paper proposes a simple and easily reproducible approach to integrating the cheapest robot from the Unitree Go1 series with controllers running the ArduPilot firmware without disassembling the robot itself or modifying its hardware. Experimental studies show that the average latency introduced by the proposed control method over Wi-Fi is 206.7 ms, and its standard deviation is below 53 ms, which is suitable for following the mission route using the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS). At the same time, control using Ethernet reduces mean latency down to 78.3 ms and provides additional functionality (e.g., the ability to configure step height). Finally, in the range of standard Go1 speeds, both proposed control interfaces, based on Wi-Fi and Ethernet, are suitable for most practical indoor and outdoor tasks.
212. Soft Contact Model for Robust Locomotion of Legged Robots
腿式机器人鲁棒运动的软接触模型
我们提出了一种软接触模型来模拟不同的软地形，通过强化学习实现稳健的腿部运动。该模型扩展了具有Stribeck-Coulomb摩擦的标准弹簧阻尼器公式，并引入了随机参数，如刚度、阻尼和摩擦系数，以捕捉现实世界软表面（包括土壤和床垫）的可变性。通过用我们的公式替换模拟器中的默认接触模型，我们使用现有的学习框架训练了一种运动策略。由此产生的策略在模拟中证明了Unitree Go1机器人在平坦和倾斜的软地形上都能稳定行走。
值得注意的是，它在没有明确训练的情况下推广到刚性地面，突出了在接触条件下提高的鲁棒性。
这项工作为可扩展的运动训练提供了高保真接触建模的轻量级和灵活的替代方案
We present a soft contact model to simulate diverse soft terrains, enabling robust legged locomotion through reinforcement learning. The model extends a standard spring-damper formulation with Stribeck-Coulomb friction and introduces randomized parameters, such as stiffness, damping, and friction coefficients, to capture the variability of real-world soft surfaces, including soil and mattresses. By replacing the default contact model in the simulator with our formulation, we train a locomotion policy using an existing learning framework. The resulting policy demonstrates stable walking on both flat and inclined soft terrains with the Unitree Go1 robot in simulation.
Notably, it generalizes to rigid ground without explicit training, highlighting improved robustness across contact conditions.
This work offers a lightweight and flexible alternative to high-fidelity contact modeling for scalable locomotion training
213. Automated Tree Detection for Forest Inventory Analysis Using Low-Cost Quadrupedal Robots
使用低成本四足机器人的自动化树木检测用于森林库存分析
精确的树木检测与计数在森林资源清查管理中具有关键作用，有助于生态监测、生物量估算及可持续森林管理活动的规划。传统方法（如人工调查）往往劳动强度大、成本高且易受人为误差影响。地面激光扫描（TLS）和移动激光扫描仪（MLS）等替代方案虽已用于自动化该任务，但存在硬件昂贵、计算功耗高及依赖专业操作人员等问题，这些因素限制了其便携性及与低成本机器人平台的集成能力。
为应对上述挑战，本文提出一种自动化树木检测与森林清查管理框架，该框架利用仅配备深度相机和惯性传感器的低成本四足机器人实现。机器人通过 RGB-D 同步定位与地图构建（SLAMM）技术对森林环境进行三维建模与重建，生成的点云数据由树木检测算法离线处理，基于模型驱动技术与几何分析实现单株树木的识别与定位。我们在三种不同树木密度的模拟森林环境中对该方法进行了评估：算法整体检测精度（F1 分数）达 96%，定位误差控制在 0.2 米以内，胸径（DBH）估算误差不超过 0.13 米。这些结果表明，该方法在经济高效且可扩展的森林资源清查管理中具有可行性。
Accurate tree detection and counting play a crucial role in forest inventory management, aiding in ecological monitoring, biomass estimation, and planning sustainable forest management activities. Traditional methods such as manual surveys are often labor-intensive, expensive, and prone to human error. Other alternatives such as Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) and Mobile Laser Scanner (MLS) have been used to automate this task. However, they requires expensive hardware, high computational power as well as trained operators. These factors limit their portability and integration with low-cost robotic platforms. To address these challenges, we propose an automated tree detection and forest inventory management framework using a low-cost quadrupedal robot equipped with only depth cameras and inertial sensors. The robot performs 3D mapping and reconstruction of the forest environment using RGB-D SLAMM and the resulting point clouds are processed offline by the tree detection algorithm to identify and localize individual trees based on model-based techniques and geometric analysis. We evaluated the proposed approach in three different simulated forest environments with varying tree densities. The algorithm was able to effectively detect the trees with an overall accuracy (F1-score) of 96\% as well as achieve accurate localization up to 0.2m along with Diameter at Breast Height (DBH) estimation accuracies up to 0.13m.  These results highlight the feasibility of the approach for cost-effective and scalable forest inventory management.
214. Autonomous Navigation Of Quadrupeds Using Coverage Path Planning
使用覆盖路径规划的四足机器人自主导航
本文提出一种用于自主扫描非结构化环境的新型覆盖路径规划方法。该方法通过同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）获取的先验 2D 导航地图，利用形态学骨架生成兴趣点序列（POIs），并根据机器人当前位置对该序列排序以创建最优路径。为控制高层操作，采用有限状态机在两种模式间切换：使用Nav2导航至兴趣点，以及扫描局部环境。我们在平坦无障碍物的室内非凸环境中通过五次试验验证了该方法的时间效率和可达性。地图读取器和路径规划器可分别以 2.52 毫秒/像素和1.7毫秒/像素的速度快速处理宽高范围为[196,225]像素和[185,231]像素的地图，其计算时间分别以22.0纳秒/像素和8.17微秒/像素的速率增长。机器人在五次试验中成功到达所有航点的86.5%。该方法的局限性在于 2D 导航地图中存在的漂移问题。
This paper proposes a novel method of coverage path planning for the purpose of scanning an unstructured environment autonomously. The method uses the morphological skeleton of the prior 2D navigation map via SLAM to generate a sequence of points of interest (POIs). This sequence is then ordered to create an optimal path given the robot’s current position. To control the high-level operation, a finite state machine is used to switch between two modes: navigating towards a POI using Nav2, and scanning the local surrounding. We validate the method in a leveled indoor obstacle-free non-convex environment on time efficiency and reachability over five trials. The map reader and the path planner can quickly process maps of width and height ranging between [196,225] pixels and [185,231] pixels in 2.52 ms/pixel and 1.7 ms/pixel, respectively, where their computation time increases with 22.0 ns/pixel and 8.17 µs/pixel, respectively. The robot managed to reach 86.5% of all waypoints over all five runs. The proposed method suffers from drift occurring in the 2D navigation map.
215. MULE: Multi-terrain and Unknown Load Adaptation for Effective Quadrupedal Locomotion
MULE：有效四足运动的多地形和未知负载适应
四足机器人正越来越多地被部署于跨多样地形的负载运输任务。尽管基于模型预测控制（MPC）的方法可处理负载变化，但其常依赖预定义步态规划或轨迹生成器，这限制了在非结构化环境中的适应性。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种自适应强化学习（RL）框架，使四足机器人能够动态适应负载变化和复杂地形。该框架包含负责基础运动的标称策略，以及学习校正动作以在负载变化下维持稳定性并改善指令跟踪的自适应策略。
我们通过 Isaac Gym 中的大规模仿真实验及宇树 Go1 四足机器人的真实硬件部署对所提方法进行了验证。控制器在平地、斜坡和楼梯等场景下经受了静态及动态负载变化的测试。在所有工况中，我们的自适应控制器在跟踪机体高度和速度指令方面持续优于传统控制器，展现出无需显式步态设计或手动调参的增强鲁棒性与适应性。
Quadrupedal robots are increasingly deployed for load-carrying tasks across diverse terrains. While Model Predictive Control (MPC)-based methods can account for payload variations, they often depend on predefined gait schedules or trajectory generators, limiting their adaptability in unstructured environments. To address these limitations, we propose an Adaptive Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework that enables quadrupedal robots to dynamically adapt to both varying payloads and diverse terrains. The framework consists of a nominal policy responsible for baseline locomotion and an adaptive policy that learns corrective actions to preserve stability and improve command tracking under payload variations. We validate the proposed approach through large-scale simulation experiments in Isaac Gym and real-world hardware deployment on a Unitree Go1 quadruped. The controller was tested on flat ground, slopes, and stairs under both static and dynamic payload changes. Across all settings, our adaptive controller consistently outperformed the controller in tracking body height and velocity commands, demonstrating enhanced robustness and adaptability without requiring explicit gait design or manual tuning.
216. A2I-Calib: An Anti-noise Active Multi-IMU Spatial-temporal Calibration Framework for Legged Robots
A2I-Calib：面向腿足机器人的抗噪声主动多 IMU 时空校准框架
近年来，基于多节点惯性测量单元（IMU）的腿足机器人里程计因其成本效益、低功耗和高精度而备受关注。然而，由正向运动学推导的足端运动与足部 IMU 测量之间的时空偏差会引入不一致约束，导致里程计漂移。因此，精确的时空校准对多 IMU 系统至关重要。尽管现有多 IMU 校准方法已解决被动单刚体传感器校准问题，但对腿足系统仍显不足 —— 传统步态的校准激励不足，且运动链变换中对 IMU 噪声的敏感性显著增加。
为此，我们提出 A2I-Calib—— 一种抗噪声主动多 IMU 校准框架，支持任意足部安装 IMU 的自主时空校准。该框架包含：1）抗噪声轨迹生成器，利用提出的基函数选择定理最小化相关性分析中的条件数，从而降低噪声敏感性；2）基于强化学习（RL）的控制器，确保校准动作的稳健执行。此外，A2I-Calib 在仿真和真实四足机器人平台上通过多种多 IMU 配置验证，结果表明其显著降低了噪声敏感性和校准误差，进而提升了整体多 IMU 里程计性能。
Recently, multi-node inertial measurement unit (IMU)-based odometry for legged robots has gained attention due to its cost-effectiveness, power efficiency, and high accuracy. However, the spatial and temporal misalignment between foot-end motion derived from forward kinematics and foot IMU measurements can introduce inconsistent constraints, resulting in odometry drift. Therefore, accurate spatial-temporal calibration is crucial for the multi-IMU systems. Although existing multi-IMU calibration methods have addressed passive single-rigid-body sensor calibration, they are inadequate for legged systems. This is due to the insufficient excitation from traditional gaits for calibration, and enlarged sensitivity to IMU noise during kinematic chain transformations. To address these challenges, we propose AI-Calib, an anti-noise active multi-IMU calibration framework enabling autonomous spatial-temporal calibration for arbitrary foot-mounted IMUs. Our AI-Calib includes: 1) an anti-noise trajectory generator leveraging a proposed basis function selection theorem to minimize the condition number in correlation analysis, thus reducing noise sensitivity, and 2) a reinforcement learning (RL)-based controller that ensures robust execution of calibration motions. Furthermore, AI-Calib is validated on simulation and real-world quadruped robot platforms with various multi-IMU settings, which demonstrates a significant reduction in noise sensitivity and calibration errors, thereby improving the overall multi-IMU odometry performance.
217.SATA: Safe and Adaptive Torque-Based Locomotion Policies Inspired by Animal Learning
SATA：受动物学习启发的安全自适应扭矩运动策略
尽管基于学习的腿足机器人控制器近期取得进展，但在以人为中心的环境中部署仍受安全顾虑限制。这类方法大多采用基于位置的控制 —— 策略输出目标关节角度，需通过低级控制器（如 PD 或阻抗控制器）处理以计算关节扭矩。尽管在受控真实场景中已取得显著成果，但当遭遇训练中未见过的环境或干扰时，这些方法常因柔顺性和适应性不足而产生极端或不安全行为。
受动物通过控制肌肉伸缩实现平滑自适应运动的启发，基于扭矩的策略通过在扭矩空间中直接精确控制执行器，提供了一条有前景的路径。从原理上讲，该方法促进了与环境的更有效交互，产生更安全且适应性更强的行为。然而，高度非线性状态空间和训练中低效探索等挑战阻碍了其广泛应用。
为此，我们提出 SATA—— 一种模仿动物运动中关键生物力学原理与自适应学习机制的生物启发框架。通过显著改善早期探索效率，我们的方法有效解决了学习基于扭矩策略的固有挑战，最终获得高性能策略。值得注意的是，该方法实现了零样本仿真到真实迁移。实验结果表明，SATA 展现出卓越的柔顺性与安全性，即便在柔软 / 光滑地形、狭窄通道等复杂环境或强外部干扰下依然如此，凸显了其在以人为中心及安全关键场景中实际部署的潜力。
Despite recent advances in learning-based controllers for legged robots, deployments in human-centric environments remain limited by safety concerns. Most of these approaches use position-based control, where policies output target joint angles that must be processed by a low-level controller (e.g., PD or impedance controllers) to compute joint torques. Although impressive results have been achieved in controlled real-world scenarios, these methods often struggle with compliance and adaptability when encountering environments or disturbances unseen during training, potentially resulting in extreme or unsafe behaviors. Inspired by how animals achieve smooth and adaptive movements by controlling muscle extension and contraction, torque-based policies offer a promising alternative by enabling precise and direct control of the actuators in torque space. In principle, this approach facilitates more effective interactions with the environment, resulting in safer and more adaptable behaviors. However, challenges such as a highly nonlinear state space and inefficient exploration during training have hindered their broader adoption. To address these limitations, we propose SATA, a bio-inspired framework that mimics key biomechanical principles and adaptive learning mechanisms observed in animal locomotion. Our approach effectively addresses the inherent challenges of learning torque-based policies by significantly improving early-stage exploration, leading to high-performance final policies. Remarkably, our method achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. Our experimental results indicate that SATA demonstrates remarkable compliance and safety, even in challenging environments such as soft/slippery terrain or narrow passages, and under significant external disturbances, highlighting its potential for practical deployments in human-centric and safety-critical scenarios.
218. Jailbreaking LLM-Controlled Robots
Jailbreaking LLM-Controlled Robots
大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新引入通过在操作、移动和自动驾驶等多样领域实现上下文推理和直观的人机交互，彻底革新了机器人技术领域。当被视为独立技术时，LLM 已知易受越狱攻击，即恶意提示者通过绕过 LLM 安全防护措施来诱导产生有害文本。为评估在机器人技术中部署 LLM 的风险，本文引入 RoboPAIR—— 首个旨在对 LLM 控制的机器人进行越狱的算法。与现有的针对 LLM 聊天机器人的文本攻击不同，RoboPAIR 会从 LLM 控制的机器人中诱导出有害的物理动作，我们在三种场景中通过实验证明了这一现象：（i）白盒场景，攻击者可完全访问 NVIDIA Dolphins 自动驾驶 LLM；（ii）灰盒场景，攻击者可部分访问配备 GPT-4o 规划器的 Clearpath Robotics Jackal UGV 机器人；（iii）黑盒场景，攻击者仅能查询访问集成了 GPT-3.5 的宇树机器人 Go2 机器狗。在每种场景中，通过三个新的有害机器人动作数据集，我们证明 RoboPAIR 以及几个静态基线方法能够快速有效地找到越狱方法，通常实现 100% 的攻击成功率。我们的结果首次揭示，鉴于越狱机器人可能在现实世界中造成物理损害的明显可能性，LLM 越狱的风险远远超出了文本生成的范畴。事实上，我们在宇树 Go2 上的结果代表了首次成功越狱已部署的商用机器人系统。解决这一新兴漏洞对于确保 LLM 在机器人技术中的安全部署至关重要。
The recent introduction of large language models (LLMs) has revolutionized the field of robotics by enabling contextual reasoning and intuitive human-robot interaction in domains as varied as manipulation, locomotion, and self-driving vehicles. When viewed as a stand-alone technology, LLMs are known to be vulnerable to jailbreaking attacks, wherein malicious prompters elicit harmful text by bypassing LLM safety guardrails. To assess the risks of deploying LLMs in robotics, in this paper, we introduce RoboPAIR, the first algorithm designed to jailbreak LLM-controlled robots. Unlike existing, textual attacks on LLM chatbots, RoboPAIR elicits harmful physical actions from LLM-controlled robots, a phenomenon we experimentally demonstrate in three scenarios: (i) a white-box setting, wherein the attacker has full access to the NVIDIA Dolphins self-driving LLM, (ii) a gray-box setting, wherein the attacker has partial access to a Clear path Robotics Jackal UGV robot equipped with a GPT-4o planner, and (iii) a black-box setting, wherein the attacker has only query access to the GPT-3.5-integrated Unitree Robotics Go2 robot dog. In each scenario and across three new datasets of harmful robotic actions, we demonstrate that RoboPAIR, as well as several static baselines, finds jailbreaks quickly and effectively, often achieving 100% attack success rates. Our results reveal, for the first time, that the risks of jailbroken LLMs extend far beyond text generation, given the distinct possibility that jailbroken robots could cause physical damage in the real world. Indeed, our results on the Unitree Go2 represent the first successful jailbreak of a deployed commercial robotic system. Addressing this emerging vulnerability is critical for ensuring the safe deployment of LLMs in robotics.
219. Fast and Cost-effective Speculative Edge-Cloud Decoding with Early Exits
基于早期退出的快速经济高效推测性边缘云解码
我们提出一种快速且经济高效的推测性边缘云解码框架，其服务器端部署大型目标模型、设备端运行轻量草稿模型。通过在目标模型中引入早期退出机制，令牌可在验证中途生成，使客户端能在最终验证前抢先生成后续令牌，从而利用空闲时间并增强边缘与云端的并行处理能力。在 NVIDIA Jetson Nano（客户端）与 A100 GPU（服务器）上采用 Vicuna-68M（草稿模型）和 Llama2-7B（目标模型）的实验表明，相比基于云端的自回归解码，该方法延迟最高降低 35%，结合抢先生成策略可额外提升 11%。为验证实际应用价值，我们在宇树 Go2 四足机器人上部署基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的控制方案，较传统云端自回归解码实现 21% 的速度提升。这些结果表明，该框架在资源受限的边缘设备上运行实时 LLM 与 VLM 应用具有显著潜力。
Large Language Models (LLMs) enable various applications on edge devices such as smartphones, wearables, and embodied robots. However, their deployment often depends on expensive cloud-based APIs, creating high operational costs, which limit access for smaller organizations and raise sustainability concerns. Certain LLMs can be deployed on-device, offering a cost-effective solution with reduced latency and improved privacy. Yet, limited computing resources constrain the size and accuracy of models that can be deployed, necessitating a collaborative design between edge and cloud. We propose a fast and cost-effective speculative edge-cloud decoding framework with a large target model on the server and a small draft model on the device. By introducing early exits in the target model, tokens are generated mid-verification, allowing the client to preemptively draft subsequent tokens before final verification, thus utilizing idle time and enhancing parallelism between edge and cloud. Using an NVIDIA Jetson Nano (client) and an A100 GPU (server) with Vicuna-68M (draft) and Llama2-7B (target) models, our method achieves up to a 35% reduction in latency compared to cloud-based autoregressive decoding, with an additional 11% improvement from preemptive drafting. To demonstrate real-world applicability, we deploy our method on the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot using Vision-Language Model (VLM) based control, achieving a 21% speedup over traditional cloud-based autoregressive decoding. These results demonstrate the potential of our framework for real-time LLM and VLM applications on resource-constrained edge devices.
220. McARL:Morphology-Control-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Generalizable Quadrupedal Locomotion
McARL：面向可泛化四足运动的形态 - 控制感知强化学习
我们提出形态 - 控制感知强化学习（McARL），这是一种克服超参数调优和迁移损失挑战的新方法，可实现跨机器人形态的可泛化运动控制。通过将从指定形态范围采样的随机形态向量融入演员 - 评论家网络，我们构建了形态条件策略，使策略能够学习可泛化至相似特征机器人的参数。实验表明，使用 McARL 在宇树 Go1 机器人上训练的单一策略可迁移至不同形态（如宇树 Go2 机器人），无需重新训练或微调即可实现高达 3.5 m/s 的零样本迁移速度，在训练用 Go1 机器人上更可达 6.0 m/s，并可泛化至 A1 和 Mini Cheetah 等其他形态。我们还分析了形态差异对迁移性能的影响，结果显示 McARL 相较 PPO 变体在 Go2、Mini Cheetah 和 A1 上的迁移性能提升 44-150%，凸显了其优于现有方法的优势。
We present Morphology-Control-Aware Reinforcement Learning (McARL), a new approach to overcome challenges of hyperparameter tuning and transfer loss, enabling generalizable locomotion across robot morphologies. We use a morphology-conditioned policy by incorporating a randomized morphology vector, sampled from a defined morphology range, into both the actor and critic networks. This allows the policy to learn parameters that generalize to robots with similar characteristics. We demonstrate that a single policy trained on a Unitree Go1 robot using McARL can be transferred to a different morphology (e.g., Unitree Go2 robot) and can achieve zero-shot transfer velocity of up to 3.5 m/s without retraining or fine-tuning. Moreover, it achieves 6.0 m/s on the training Go1 robot and generalizes to other morphologies like A1 and Mini Cheetah. We also analyze the impact of morphology distance on transfer performance and highlight McARL's advantages over prior approaches. McARL achieves 44-150% higher transfer performance on Go2, Mini Cheetah, and A1 compared to PPO variants.
221. PROBE: Proprioceptive Obstacle Detection and Estimation while Navigating in Clutter
PROBE：杂乱环境导航中基于本体感受的障碍物检测与估计
在包括恶劣环境搜救在内的关键应用中，障碍物普遍存在，且会因遮挡和机载摄像头传感器的视场限制，导致某些传感方式（尤其是视觉）无法有效部署。为使机器人能够应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新方法 —— 杂乱环境导航中基于本体感受的障碍物检测与估计（PROBE）。该方法仅依靠机器人的本体感受来推断被遮挡矩形障碍物的存在与否，同时预测其在 SE (2) 空间中的尺寸和位姿。所提出的方法采用 Transformer 神经网络，接收机器人施加的力矩历史和感知到的全身运动作为输入，并返回环境中障碍物的参数化表示。我们在 Isaac Gym 仿真环境和真实的宇树 Go1 四足机器人上对 PROBE 的有效性进行了评估。
In critical applications, including search-and-rescue in degraded environments, blockages can be prevalent and prevent the effective deployment of certain sensing modalities, particularly vision, due to occlusion and the constrained range of view of onboard camera sensors. To enable robots to tackle these challenges, we propose a new approach, Proprioceptive Obstacle Detection and Estimation while navigating in clutter PROBE, which instead relies only on the robot's proprioception to infer the presence or absence of occluded rectangular obstacles while predicting their dimensions and poses in SE(2). The proposed approach is a Transformer neural network that receives as input a history of applied torques and sensed whole-body movements of the robot and returns a parameterized representation of the obstacles in the environment. The effectiveness of PROBE is evaluated on simulated environments in Isaac Gym and with a real Unitree Go1 quadruped robot.
222. Autonomous operation of a robot dog for point-cloud data acquisition
用于点云数据采集的机器狗自主作业
本文介绍了宇树Go1机器狗自主作业系统的开发，旨在实现从仿真到实际实验的建筑内部精细点云数据采集。该系统集成了3D激光雷达、RGB-D相机和迷你电脑，使Go1能够自主导航、避障并收集数据。开发流程包括在机器人操作系统（ROS）仿真环境中构建解决方案，模拟Go1在建筑模型中的移动；同时适配Real-Time Appearance-Based Mapping（RTAB-Map）算法实现机器人3D定位。此外，通过实际场景实验验证了整个数据采集流程。我们提出的框架为建筑领域提供了有价值的参考，既指出了当前技术局限，也为未来研究指明了方向。为保证研究透明性与可复现性，实验中使用和开发的代码已公开至：https://github.com/MooKol/unitree_go1。
This paper presents the development of an autonomous operation for a robot dog, the Unitree Go1, to acquire a detailed point cloud of a building’s interior, from simulation to real-world experiments. The system integrates a 3D LiDAR, an RGB D camera, and a mini-PC, enabling the Go1 to autonomously navigate, avoid obstacles, and collect data. The process includes developing the solution inside a simulation environment within the Robot Operating System (ROS) to simulate the Go1 movement in a building model. Real-Time Appearance-Based Mapping (RTAB Map) has been adapted for the robot's 3D localization. In addition, real-world experiments were conducted to validate the pipeline. Our proposed framework provides valuable insights for the construction community, outlining current limitations and suggesting directions for future work. To promote transparency and enable reproducibility, we have made the code used and developed in our experiments publicly available at: https://github.com/MooKol/unitree_go1.
223. Sim2Sim on Legged Robots
四足机器人的仿真到仿真迁移研究
在这项工作中，我们研究了机器人强化学习（RL）场景下的仿真到仿真（Sim2Sim）迁移问题。尽管仿真到真实（Sim2Real）已受到广泛关注，但Sim2Sim仍相对缺乏探索，尽管其为研究跨环境泛化能力提供了重要且可控的场景。我们聚焦于将在Isaac Gym中训练的运动策略迁移至MuJoCo——这两个模拟器具有不同的动力学和物理建模特性。我们在训练过程中应用域随机化（DR）技术，使策略接触多样化的环境配置，并评估其向目标模拟器的零样本迁移能力。此外，我们为主动域随机化（ADR）奠定了基础，该方法可在训练过程中智能选择具有挑战性的环境参数。通过宇树Go2和H1_2机器人进行的实验表明，DR显著提升了四足运动的Sim2Sim性能。我们分析了关键迁移瓶颈，确定了有效的随机化维度，并针对可扩展的模拟器无关策略学习提出了未来改进方向。
In this work, we investigate Simulation - to - Simulation (Sim2Sim) transfer in the context of robotic reinforcement learning (RL). While Sim2Real has received significant attention, Sim2Sim remains relatively under - explored despite offering an important and controlled setting to study generalization across environments. We focus on transferring locomotion policies trained in Isaac Gym to MuJoCo, two simulators with distinct dynamics and physics modeling. We apply Domain Randomization (DR) during training to expose the policy to diverse environmental configurations and assess its zero - shot transfer capability to the target simulator. Furthermore, we lay the groundwork for Active Domain Randomization (ADR), which intelligently selects challenging environment parameters during training. Our experiments with Unitree Go2 and H1_2 robots demonstrate that DR significantly enhances Sim2Sim performance for quadruped locomotion. We analyze key transfer bottlenecks, identify effective randomization dimensions, and propose future enhancements toward scalable simulator - agnostic policy learning.
224. Physics-informed Neural Motion Planning via Domain Decomposition in Large Environments
大型环境中基于域分解的物理信息神经运动规划
物理信息神经运动规划器（PiNMP）为求解程函偏微分方程（PDE）和表示运动规划的代价函数提供了一种数据高效的框架。然而，其可扩展性仍受限于频谱偏差和PDE驱动训练中复杂的损失曲面。域分解通过将环境划分为更小的子域来缓解这些问题，但现有方法仅在单个空间点上强制连续性。尽管这些方法对函数逼近有效，但无法捕捉运动规划所需的空间连通性，因为代价函数依赖于起点和终点坐标，而非单个查询点。我们提出了有限基神经时间场（FB-NTFields），这是一种用于可扩展代价估计的新型神经场表示方法。FB-NTFields不强制输出空间的连续性，而是构建潜在空间表示，将代价计算为起点和终点坐标的潜在嵌入之间的距离。这使得在集成域分解的同时实现全局空间一致性，确保高效的大规模运动规划。我们在复杂的合成和真实场景中验证了FB-NTFields，证明其相比现有PiNMP有显著改进。最后，我们将该方法部署在宇树B1四足机器人上，成功实现了室内环境导航。
Physics-informed Neural Motion Planners (PiNMPs) provide a data-efficient framework for solving the Eikonal Partial Differential Equation (PDE) and representing the cost-to-go function for motion planning. However, their scalability remains limited by spectral bias and the complex loss landscape of PDE-driven training. Domain decomposition mitigates these issues by dividing the environment into smaller subdomains, but existing methods enforce continuity only at individual spatial points. While effective for function approximation, these methods fail to capture the spatial connectivity required for motion planning, where the cost-to-go function depends on both the start and goal coordinates rather than a single query point. We propose Finite Basis Neural Time Fields (FB-NTFields), a novel neural field representation for scalable cost-to-go estimation. Instead of enforcing continuity in output space, FB-NTFields construct a latent space representation, computing the cost-to-go as a distance between the latent embeddings of start and goal coordinates. This enables global spatial coherence while integrating domain decomposition, ensuring efficient large-scale motion planning. We validate FB-NTFields in complex synthetic and real-world scenarios, demonstrating substantial improvements over existing PiNMPs. Finally, we deploy our method on a Unitree B1 quadruped robot, successfully navigating indoor environments.
225. Hybrid Mode Sample-Based Control
基于混合模式采样的控制方法
在这项工作中，我们针对操作与全身控制问题提出了一种新颖的基于采样的方法。该方法通过显式考虑控制模式（即何时应用、应用时长及选用何种模式）来缩小搜索空间。我们证明，此方法能够合成从手部操作到人形机器人 locomotion 等复杂行为，且与现有方法相比，在总成本方面表现显著更优。最后，我们在实体宇树A1平台上验证了该方法，凸显其采样效率和现实场景适用性。
In this work, we propose a novel sample-based approach for manipulation and whole body control problem. Our method reduces the search space by explicitly accounting for control modes—namely when to apply them, how long to apply them, and which mode to use. We demonstrate that our approach can synthesize complex behaviors, ranging from in-hand manipulation to humanoid locomotion, and achieves significantly better performance in terms of total cost compared to existing methods. Finally, we validate our method on a physical Unitree A1 platform, highlighting its sample efficiency and real-world applicability.
226. An Inertial Odometry and Enhanced Occupancy Grid Inertial SLAM for Legged Robots
适用于腿式机器人的惯性里程计与增强型占据栅格惯性 SLAM
精确的位姿估计对腿式机器人至关重要。基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的惯性里程计成本低且易于部署，而惯性同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）方法能在不同机器人平台及复杂环境中保持稳定性能。
本文中，我们在机器人足部安装单个IMU以构建惯性里程计，无需依赖运动学建模。通过IMU输出检测支撑相和最优零速度点（OZP），并在每个OZP处执行一次零速度更新，以修正惯性里程计的漂移。
此外，本文提出了增强型占据栅格惯性 SLAM 框架。在栅格地图更新部分，利用惯性里程计得到的运动控制向量结合布雷森汉姆算法计算栅格单元的可达概率，这解决了栅格地图离散化导致的细节丢失问题，以及重复错误地图更新造成的可达概率不平衡问题。
在宇树B1机器人上的实验测试表明，我们的系统在位姿估计方面实现了进一步提升。
Accurate position estimation is crucial for legged robots, the inertial odometry based on inertial measurement units (IMUs) is low-cost and easy to deploy, and inertial simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) methods can maintain stable performance on different robot platforms and degraded environments. In this paper, a single IMU is mounted on the robot foot to construct the inertial odometry without relying on kinematic modeling. The stance phase and optimal zero-velocity point (OZP) are detected through IMU outputs, and the once zero-velocity update is performed at each OZP to correct the drift of inertial odometry. Furthermore, the enhanced occupancy grid inertial SLAM framework is introduced. In the grid map update section, the motion control vectors derived from the inertial odometry are used with the Bresenham algorithm to calculate accessibility probabilities of grid cells, which addresses detail loss from grid map discretization and the imbalance in the accessibility probability resulting from repeated erroneous map updates. Experimental tests on the Unitree B1 robot demonstrate that our system provides further improvement in position estimation.
227. RAMBO: RL-augmented Model-based Whole-body Control for Loco-manipulation
RAMBO：用于移动 - 操作的强化学习增强型基于模型的全身控制
移动-操作（即与各类物体的物理交互与移动过程的协同配合）仍是腿式机器人面临的重大挑战，这源于其既需要精确的末端执行器控制，又需要对未建模动态具备鲁棒性。基于模型的控制器虽能通过在线优化实现精确规划，却受限于模型的不准确性；相比之下，基于学习的方法虽能提供鲁棒性，但难以对交互力进行精确调节。
为此，我们提出了RAMBO——一种混合框架，将基于模型的全身控制整合到通过强化学习训练的反馈策略中。其中，基于模型的模块通过求解二次规划生成前馈力矩，而该策略则提供反馈修正项以增强鲁棒性。我们在四足机器人上对该框架进行了验证，测试场景涵盖多种真实世界的移动-操作任务，例如推购物车、平衡托盘、握持柔软物体等，且机器人分别以四足行走和双足行走模式完成任务。实验结果表明，RAMBO在实现稳健且动态的移动性能的同时，还能赋予机器人精确的操作能力。
Loco-manipulation, physical interaction of various objects that is concurrently coordinated with locomotion, remains a major challenge for legged robots due to the need for both precise end-effector control and robustness to unmodeled dynamics. While model-based controllers provide precise planning via online optimization, they are limited by model inaccuracies. In contrast, learning-based methods offer robustness, but they struggle with precise modulation of interaction forces. We introduce RAMBO, a hybrid framework that integrates model-based whole-body control within a feedback policy trained with reinforcement learning. The model-based module generates feedforward torques by solving a quadratic program, while the policy provides feedback corrective terms to enhance robustness. We validate our framework on a quadruped robot across a diverse set of real-world loco-manipulation tasks, such as pushing a shopping cart, balancing a plate, and holding soft objects, in both quadrupedal and bipedal walking. Our experiments demonstrate that RAMBO enables precise manipulation capabilities while achieving robust and dynamic locomotion.
228. Bipedalism for Quadrupedal Robots: Versatile Loco-Manipulation through Risk-Adaptive Reinforcement Learning
四足机器人的双足行走能力：通过风险自适应强化学习实现多用途移动 - 操作
四足机器人的移动-操作能力拓展了机器人的应用场景，但以腿部作为操作器往往会影响移动性能，而额外安装机械臂又会使系统复杂化。为缓解这一问题，我们提出让四足机器人采用双足行走模式，从而释放前腿以实现与环境的多用途交互。我们设计了一种风险自适应分布式强化学习（RL）框架，专门用于四足机器人的后腿行走控制——在这一本质上不稳定的任务中，该框架能在最坏情况下的保守性与最优性能之间取得平衡。训练过程中，自适应风险偏好会根据回报的不确定性动态调整，这种不确定性通过估计回报分布的变异系数来衡量。大量仿真实验表明，我们的方法性能优于基准方法。在宇树Go2机器人上的真实环境部署进一步验证了所提策略的多用途性，该策略能实现推 cart、探测障碍物、运输负载等任务，同时展现出对复杂动态和外部干扰的鲁棒性。
Loco-manipulation of quadrupedal robots has broadened robotic applications, but using legs as manipulators often compromises locomotion, while mounting arms complicates the system. To mitigate this issue, we introduce bipedalism for quadrupedal robots, thus freeing the front legs for versatile interactions with the environment. We propose a risk-adaptive distributional Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework designed for quadrupedal robots walking on their hind legs, balancing worst-case conservativeness with optimal performance in this inherently unstable task. During training, the adaptive risk preference is dynamically adjusted based on the uncertainty of the return, measured by the coefficient of variation of the estimated return distribution. Extensive experiments in simulation show our method's superior performance over baselines. Real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2 robot further demonstrates the versatility of our policy, enabling tasks like cart pushing, obstacle probing, and payload transport, while showcasing robustness against challenging dynamics and external disturbances.
229. LNO-Driven Deep RL-MPC: Hierarchical Adaptive Control Architecture for Dynamic Legged Locomotion
LNO 驱动的深度强化学习 - 模型预测控制：面向动态腿部运动的分层自适应控制架构
敏捷四足机器人是工业场景中执行重载运输任务的理想选择，但外部扰动的不确定性和分布偏移对系统稳定性构成了重大挑战。我们提出了一种基于液态神经算子（LNO）的复杂动力学建模方法，该方法在多种未知环境中实现了超过92%的动力学预测精度。由LNO生成的高保真动力学模型通过一种新型深度模型预测控制（DMPC）方法进行控制——据我们所知，这是库普曼算子理论在真实世界腿部机器人动态控制中的首次成功应用。通过状态变量重构，该DMPC等价于一个带约束的凸二次规划问题。此外，我们设计了一种基于LNO的深度强化学习-模型预测控制（RL-MPC）分层控制架构，其中将LNO嵌入强化学习策略探索过程，通过算子理论特征学习构建了一种弥合仿真与现实差距的新范式，使机器人在负载或环境变化时展现出高适应性。所提方法将宇树A1机器人的负载重量比提升至1.25，且能在承载15千克负载的情况下承受多次冲击。实验结果表明，A1的综合承载能力显著超越了当前最先进水平。
Agile quadruped robots are ideal for performing heavy-load transportation tasks in industrial settings; however, the uncertainty of external disturbances and distribution shifts pose significant challenges to system stability. We propose a complex dynamics modeling method based on the liquid neural operator (LNO), which achieves over 92% accuracy in dynamics prediction across various unknown environments. The high-fidelity dynamics model generated by LNO is controlled by a novel deep model predictive control (DMPC) method, which–to our knowledge–represents the first successful application of Koopman operator theory to real-world dynamic control of legged robots. The DMPC is equivalent to a constrained convex quadratic programming problem through state variable reconstruction. Moreover, we design a deep reinforcement learning-MPC (RL-MPC) hierarchical control architecture based on LNO, where embedding the LNO into RL policy exploration establishes a new paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap through operator-theoretic feature learning, enabling the robot to demonstrate high adaptability under changes in load or environment. The proposed method improves the load-to-weight ratio of the Unitree A1 robot to 1.25, and it is capable of withstanding multiple impacts with a 15 kg load. Experimental results demonstrate that the comprehensive load-bearing capacity of the A1 remarkably surpasses the State-of-the-Art achievements.
230. Dynamic Proxemic Model for Human–Robot Interactions Using the Golden Ratio.
基于黄金比例的人机交互动态空间关系模型
本文提出了一种确定人机交互（HRI）中动态安全区与舒适区的新方法，重点研究在有人的动态环境中运行的服务机器人。所提出的空间关系模型利用基于黄金比例的舒适区分布和ISO安全标准，为机器人定义围绕人类的自适应空间边界。与传统的固定阈值方法不同，这种新方法能根据人的位置、朝向和相对速度，对机器人行为进行渐进式、情境敏感的调节。
该系统在NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX平台上实现，采用了美国纽约Stereolabs公司的ZED 2i立体深度相机，并在两个移动机器人平台上进行了测试：中国杭州宇树科技的Go1（四足机器人）和中国东莞敏捷科技的Scout Mini（轮式机器人）。通过两个简单的交互场景对所提空间关系模型进行了初步的舒适性验证实验，并采用改良版的Godspeed问卷系列收集了参与者的主观反馈。结果显示，参与者在与机器人的实验过程中感到舒适。这种对所提方法的接受度，为该方法的进一步研究提供了初步支持。该解决方案还有助于集成到现有的导航框架中，并为构建具有社会感知能力的机器人系统开辟了道路。
This paper presents a novel approach to determine dynamic safety and comfort zones in human–robot interactions (HRIs), with a focus on service robots operating in dynamic environments with people. The proposed proxemic model leverages the golden ratio-based comfort zone distribution and ISO safety standards to define adaptive proxemic boundaries for robots around humans. Unlike traditional fixed-threshold approaches, this novel method proposes a gradual and context-sensitive modulation of robot behaviors based on human position, orientation, and relative velocity. The system was implemented on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX platform using a ZED 2i stereo depth camera Stereo lab, New York, USA and tested on two mobile robotic platforms: Go1 Unitree, Hangzhou, China (quadruped) and Scout Mini Agilex, Dongguan, China (wheeled). The initial verification of proposed proxemic model through experimental comfort validation was conducted using two simple interaction scenarios, and subjective feedback was collected from participants using a modified Godspeed Questionnaire Series. The results show that the participants felt comfortable during the experiments with robots. This acceptance of the proposed methodology plays an initial role in supporting further research of the methodology. The proposed solution also facilitates integration into existing navigation frameworks and opens pathways towards socially aware robotic systems.
231. Refining Motion for Peak Performance: Identifying Optimal Gait Parameters for Energy-Efficient Quadrupedal Bounding
为巅峰性能优化动作：确定四足机器人高效 bounding 步态的最优参数
能量效率是影响四足机器人性能与自主性的关键因素。尽管以往研究侧重于机械设计与驱动系统的改进，但步态参数对能量消耗的影响尚未得到充分探索。本文提出假设：步态参数（具体而言是占空比、相位偏移和步长持续时间）是决定四足机器人运动能耗的关键因素。
为验证这一假设，我们对宇树 A1 四足机器人进行建模，并开发了一款能够独立调节这些步态参数的运动控制器。在 Gazebo 仿真环境中，针对低速、中速、高速三种速度，在不同步态参数范围内对 bounding 步态进行了仿真测试，同时通过实验测试验证了仿真结果。研究发现，优化步态参数可显著降低能量消耗，提升四足机器人运动的整体效率。
本研究推动了腿部机器人节能控制策略的发展，其见解可直接应用于商用机器人平台。
Energy efficiency is a critical factor in the performance and autonomy of quadrupedal robots. While previous research has focused on mechanical design and actuation improvements, the impact of gait parameters on energetics has been less explored. In this paper, we hypothesize that gait parameters, specifically duty factor, phase shift, and stride duration, are key determinants of energy consumption in quadrupedal locomotion. To test this hypothesis, we modeled the Unitree A1 quadrupedal robot and developed a locomotion controller capable of independently adjusting these gait parameters. Simulations of bounding gaits were conducted in Gazebo across a range of gait parameters at three different speeds: low, medium, and high. Experimental tests were also performed to validate the simulation results. The findings demonstrate that optimizing gait parameters can lead to significant reductions in energy consumption, enhancing the overall efficiency of quadrupedal locomotion. This work contributes to the advancement of energy-efficient control strategies for legged robots, offering insights directly applicable to commercially available platforms.
232. LOVON: Legged Open-Vocabulary Object Navigator
LOVON：腿部机器人开放式词汇物体导航系统
在开放世界环境中进行物体导航，对于机器人系统而言仍是一项艰巨且普遍存在的挑战，尤其是在执行需要同时具备开放世界物体检测和高级任务规划能力的长时程任务时。传统方法往往难以有效整合这些组件，这限制了它们处理复杂、长距离导航任务的能力。
本文提出了 LOVON —— 一种新型框架，它将用于分层任务规划的大型语言模型（LLMs）与开放式词汇视觉检测模型相结合，专为动态、非结构化环境中的高效长距离物体导航量身设计。为应对现实世界中的挑战（包括视觉抖动、盲区和目标暂时丢失），我们设计了专用解决方案，例如用于视觉稳定的拉普拉斯方差滤波。我们还为机器人开发了功能性执行逻辑，确保 LOVON 具备自主导航、任务适应和稳健完成任务的能力。
大量评估表明，该系统能够成功完成涉及实时检测、搜索和向开放式词汇动态目标导航的长序列任务。此外，在不同腿部机器人（宇树 Go2、B2 和 H1-2）上进行的真实世界实验，充分展示了 LOVON 的兼容性和极具吸引力的即插即用特性。
Object navigation in open-world environments remains a formidable and pervasive challenge for robotic systems, particularly when it comes to executing long-horizon tasks that require both open-world object detection and high-level task planning. Traditional methods often struggle to integrate these components effectively, and this limits their capability to deal with complex, long-range navigation missions. In this paper, we propose LOVON, a novel framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) for hierarchical task planning with open-vocabulary visual detection models, tailored for effective long-range object navigation in dynamic, unstructured environments. To tackle real-world challenges including visual jittering, blind zones, and temporary target loss, we design dedicated solutions such as Laplacian Variance Filtering for visual stabilization. We also develop a functional execution logic for the robot that guarantees LOVON's capabilities in autonomous navigation, task adaptation, and robust task completion. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the successful completion of long-sequence tasks involving real-time detection, search, and navigation toward open-vocabulary dynamic targets. Furthermore, real-world experiments across different legged robots (Unitree Go2, B2, and H1-2) showcase the compatibility and appealing plug-and-play feature of LOVON.
233. A Walk to Remember: MLLM Memory-Driven Visual Navigation
难忘的行走：基于多模态大语言模型记忆驱动的视觉导航 *
本文提出了一种适用于地面机器人的新型基于记忆的导航框架，该框架利用定制化的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）来解析视觉输入并生成导航指令。系统采用搭载相机的宇树 GO1 机器人采集环境图像，通过定制化的多模态大语言模型对图像进行处理以实现导航。借助基于记忆的方法，机器人能高效复用先前走过的路径，减少重复探索需求，从而提升导航效率。本研究中的混合控制器包含一个决策单元和一个反应式控制器，分别用于处理高级指令和机器人姿态调整。在类走廊环境中的实验验证表明，记忆驱动的导航方式改善了路径回溯效果，提升了整体性能。
This paper presents a novel framework for memory-based navigation for terrestrial robots, utilizing a customized multimodal large language model (MLLM) to interpret visual inputs and generate navigation commands. The system employs a Unitree GO1 robot equipped with a camera to capture environmental images, which are processed by the customized MLLM for navigation. By leveraging a memory-based approach, the robot efficiently reuses previously traversed paths, reducing the need for re-exploration and enhancing navigation efficiency. The hybrid controller in this work features a deliberation unit and a reactive controller for high-level commands and robot alignment. Experimental validation in a hallway-like environment demonstrates that memory-driven navigation improves path retracing and overall performance.
234. Hybrid ACO for Blockchain-Managed Robotic Swarms
适用于区块链管理机器人集群的混合蚁群优化算法
本文提出了一种动态多机器人测绘框架，该框架将用于集群管理的区块链技术与用于路径规划的混合蚁群优化（HACO）算法相结合。基于区块链的集群合约支持多机器人之间实现去中心化、透明且安全的任务分配、任务接收、任务跟踪及奖励分配。混合蚁群优化算法通过协同与竞争策略，助力机器人在复杂环境中实现高效路径规划。
我们部署了多台搭载激光雷达的宇树 Go2 机器狗，让它们以协同与竞争的方式对划分的子区域进行测绘，并根据实时反馈和所选策略进行任务重分配。在协同模式下，机器人共享数据以提高效率和精度；在竞争模式下，机器人独立工作以减少冗余并优化资源。集群合约还能通过合并后的地图验证子区域的完全覆盖情况。结果表明，将基于区块链的管理与混合蚁群优化算法相结合，可显著提升测绘性能，为现实世界中的多机器人系统提供了一种稳健且可扩展的解决方案。
We present a dynamic multi-robot mapping framework that combines Blockchain technology for swarm management with a Hybrid Ant Colony Optimization (HACO) algorithm for path planning. Blockchain-based swarm contracts enable decentralized, transparent, and secure task allocation, acceptance, tracking, and reward distribution among multiple robots. HACO facilitates efficient path planning in complex environments through cooperative and competitive strategies. We deploy multiple LiDAR-equipped Unitree Go2 dog robots to collaboratively and competitively map divided sub-areas, with task reassignment based on real-time feedback and the selected strategy. In cooperative mode, robots share data to boost efficiency and accuracy; in competitive mode, they work independently to reduce redundancy and optimize resources. Swarm contracts also verify full sub-area coverage via the merged map. Results show that integrating blockchain-based management with HACO significantly enhances mapping performance, delivering a robust and scalable solution for real world multi-robot systems.
235. From Walking to Running: A Comprehensive Clock Torque Actuated SLIP Framework for Trotting in Quadrupedal Locomotion
从行走到奔跑：一种适用于四足机器人快步运动的全方位时钟力矩驱动 SLIP 框架
本文提出了一种基于模板的控制方法，用于实现四足机器人系统的多种快步运动，重点解决慢步快步、常规快步与腾空（奔跑）快步之间的平稳过渡问题。首先，本文将时钟力矩驱动弹簧加载倒立摆（CT-SLIP）模板扩展至三维空间，构建了一套全方位的控制框架。随后，设计了基于模板的控制策略，用于计算实现稳定运动的关节力矩，并提出了详细的步态过渡方法。
为实现奔跑快步中的腾空阶段，本文在模板中融入了抛体运动模型。在改善转向性能方面，本文采用偏航控制方法，通过旋转摆动脚平面提高稳定性，从而在保持稳定前进运动与平衡的同时，实现更高的转向速率。为进一步提升运动稳定性与性能，本文还集成了全身控制器（WBC）。
所提方法在 MuJoCo 仿真环境中进行了实现与严格验证，通过实验测试了步态过渡与抗干扰能力；同时，通过对比研究评估了摆动脚平面旋转与全身控制器（WBC）对系统整体性能的影响。此外，该方法在宇树 GO1 四足机器人硬件平台上完成了实物实验验证，成功实现了平稳的步态过渡与稳定的运动，证明了其在实际场景中的实用性。
This paper presents a template-based control method for achieving diverse trotting motions in quadrupedal systems, with a focus on smooth transitions between walking trot, regular trot, and flying (running) trot. First, we extend the Clock Torque Actuated Spring-Loaded Inverted Pendulum (CT-SLIP) template to three dimensions, creating a comprehensive control framework. A template-based control strategy is then developed to compute joint torques for stable locomotion, along with a detailed approach for transitioning between gaits. To enable the flight phase in the running trot, a projectile motion model is incorporated into the template. For improved turning, we implement a yaw control method that rotates the swing foot plane to enhance stability, enabling higher turning rates while maintaining steady forward motion and balance. To further enhance locomotion stability and performance, a Whole-Body Controller (WBC) is integrated. The proposed method is implemented and rigorously evaluated in the MuJoCo simulator, with experiments testing gait transitions and disturbance rejection. Additionally, comparative studies assess the impacts of both swing foot plane rotation and the WBC on overall system performance. Furthermore, the approach is validated through real hardware experiments on Unitree GO1 quadrupedal robot, successfully demonstrating smooth gait transitions, stable locomotion, and practical applicability in real-world scenarios.
236. From Tabula Rasa to Emergent Abilities Discovering Robot Skills via Real-World Unsupervised Quality-Diversity
从白板到涌现能力：通过真实世界无监督质量多样性方法探索机器人技能
自主技能发现旨在让机器人在无需显式监督（即无需人工预先定义任务目标或示范动作）的情况下，自主掌握多样化行为。然而，受安全性与数据效率的限制，直接在物理硬件上学习这类行为仍面临巨大挑战。现有方法（包括质量多样性演员 - 评论员算法，QDAC）需人工定义技能空间，并依赖精心调参的启发式规则，极大限制了其在真实场景中的适用性。
本文提出无监督真实世界技能获取方法（URSA），该方法作为 QDAC 的扩展，可使机器人直接在真实环境中自主发现并掌握多样、高性能的技能。实验表明，URSA 在宇树 A1 四足机器人上，无论是仿真环境还是真实场景，均成功发现了多样化的运动技能。该方法同时支持两种场景：一是基于启发式驱动的技能发现，二是完全无监督的技能学习。
此外，研究还证实，URSA 所学习的技能库可复用于下游任务（如真实场景中的损伤适应）：在 9 个仿真损伤场景中，URSA 在 5 个场景下的性能优于所有基准方法；在 5 个真实损伤场景中，URSA 在 3 个场景下表现最优。
本文的研究成果构建了一套面向真实世界机器人学习的新框架，实现了在人工干预有限的前提下持续发现技能，为研发更具自主性与适应性的机器人系统迈出了重要一步。
Autonomous skill discovery aims to enable robots to acquire diverse behaviors without explicit supervision. Learning such behaviors directly on physical hardware remains challenging due to safety and data efficiency constraints. Existing methods, including Quality-Diversity Actor-Critic (QDAC), require manually defined skill spaces and carefully tuned heuristics, limiting real-world applicability. We propose Unsupervised Real-world Skill Acquisition (URSA), an extension of QDAC that enables robots to autonomously discover and master diverse, high-performing skills directly in the real world. We demonstrate that URSA successfully discovers diverse locomotion skills on a Unitree A1 quadruped in both simulation and the real world. Our approach supports both heuristic-driven skill discovery and fully unsupervised settings. We also show that the learned skill repertoire can be reused for downstream tasks such as real-world damage adaptation, where URSA outperforms all baselines in 5 out of 9 simulated and 3 out of 5 real-world damage scenarios. Our results establish a new framework for real-world robot learning that enables continuous skill discovery with limited human intervention, representing a significant step toward more autonomous and adaptable robotic systems.
237. Autonomous Navigation and Real-Time 3D Reconstruction of Interior Spaces Using a Quadruped Robot
基于四足机器人的室内空间自主导航与实时三维重建
本论文设计并评估了一款基于 ROS2（机器人操作系统 2）的应用程序，该程序可使宇树 Go2 四足机器人借助同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）技术，在室内环境中同时执行自主导航、实时建图与三维重建任务。搭载机载传感器的该机器人系统，目标是生成可提供详细三维扫描信息的高分辨率点云。本次评估聚焦于该平台的实际可行性、运行可靠性与精度表现。
硬件配置方面，系统以宇树 Go2 机器人为核心，整合其内置传感器、一台高分辨率三维激光雷达（3D LiDAR）及一台 RGB-D 相机（彩色深度相机）。软件组件则涵盖 ROS2、宇树 SDK（软件开发工具包）、导航框架与 SLAM 算法。该应用程序的开发，一方面采用了与 ROS 兼容的传感器及 SLAM 算法开源仓库，另一方面整合了宇树官方组件与笔者的自定义模块。
测试主要在大学走廊环境中开展，重点评估了三维重建质量、计算负载、无线控制能力与导航性能。结果表明，该系统能实时生成密集且精准的三维点云；但需注意的是，随着扫描距离增加或场景复杂度提升，建图与重建的误差会相应增大。
基于二维 SLAM 地图的自主导航在简单环境中表现有效，但对传感器质量较为敏感。若要同时运行二维与三维 SLAM 并实现实时可视化，需承担较高计算负荷 —— 若缺乏高性能外部处理设备，可能导致输出结果质量下降。在短距离、高带宽网络环境下，无线操作可顺利实现，但在网络不稳定的条件下，其性能会受到限制。
ROS2 等开源框架及成熟 SLAM 算法的应用，为该应用程序的开发提供了便利，但需针对所用机器人与传感器进行精准适配。研发的系统在室内探测、侦察等实际任务中展现出实用潜力。未来研究应重点关注以下方向：实现多传感器融合 SLAM、优化无线通信性能、集成先进导航策略；此外，通过多台移动机器人协同作业，有望进一步提升对复杂多样环境的全面建图能力。
This thesis develops and evaluates a ROS2-based application that enables the quadruped robot Unitree Go2 to simultaneously perform autonomous navigation, real-time mapping, and 3D reconstruction in indoor environments using Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). The robot system, equipped with onboard sensors, aims to generate high-resolution point clouds that provide detailed 3D scans. The assessment focuses on the platform’s practical feasibility, operational reliability, and accuracy. The hardware setup combines the Unitree Go2 robot with its built-in sensors, a high-resolution 3D LiDAR, and an RGB-D camera. Software components include ROS2, the Unitree SDK, a navigation framework, and SLAM approaches. The application was developed using ROS-compatible open-source repositories for the sensors and SLAM algorithms, as well as Unitree’s components and my customizations. Tests were conducted primarily in a university hallway and evaluated the quality of 3D reconstruction, computational load, wireless control capabilities, and navigation performance. The results show that the system generates dense, accurate 3D point clouds in real time, although mapping and reconstruction inaccuracies increase with longer or complex scans. Autonomous navigation based on 2D SLAM maps proved effective in simple environments but was sensitive to sensor quality. Running 2D and 3D SLAM simultaneously with live visualization requires high computational effort, risking degraded output without powerful external processing. Wireless operation is possible over short-range, high-bandwidth networks, but is limited under unstable conditions. The use of open source frameworks such as ROS2 and established SLAM algorithms facilitates application development but requires precise adaptation to the robot and the sensors used. The developed system demonstrates practical potential for real-world tasks such as indoor exploration and reconnaissance. Future work should focus on implementing multi-sensor fusion SLAM, enhancing wireless communication, and integrating advanced navigation strategies. Combining multiple mobile robots could further enhance comprehensive mapping across diverse environments.
238. Multiple gait locomotion generation for quadruped robots based on trajectory planning and reinforcement learning
基于轨迹规划与强化学习的四足机器人多步态运动生成
在四足机器人运动控制领域，实现类似真实四足动物的灵活多步态运动仍是一大挑战。为解决这一问题，本文提出一种基于轨迹规划与强化学习的四足机器人多步态运动生成框架，可实现多种四足步态与三足步态的运动生成。
该框架包含参考轨迹生成器与轨迹调整模块两大核心组件：
参考轨迹生成器：通过特制的参考轨迹公式，融合策略网络、步态时序信息与足部位置，生成基础参考轨迹；
轨迹调整模块：利用策略网络对参考轨迹进行实时优化，使机器人运动能够适配具体任务需求。
其中，策略网络通过仿真环境中的强化学习完成训练。该框架已在仿真环境与真实四足机器人（宇树 A1）上完成验证，仿真与实物实验结果均表明：该框架可使四足机器人实现多种类真实动物的步态，包括四足步态（行走、慢步快步、ambleamble 步态、常规快步）与三足步态（任意单腿抬起状态下的运动）。此外，该框架还能让机器人稳健地通过崎岖地形，并完成坡度最高达 30 度的爬坡运动。
Realizing flexible multiple gait locomotion like real quadrupedal animals remains a challenge in the field of quadruped robot motion control. To address this challenge, a multiple gait locomotion generation framework based on trajectory planning and reinforcement learning is proposed for quadruped robots, enabling the generation of various quadrupedal and three-legged locomotion. In this framework, a reference trajectory generator and a trajectory adjustment module are designed. The generator produces the reference trajectory by integrating the policy network, gait temporal information, and foot positions, using a specially designed reference trajectory formula. The adjustment module subsequently refines the trajectory in real time by employing the policy network to adapt the motion to the specific task requirements. The policy network is trained using reinforcement learning in simulation. The proposed framework has been verified both in the simulation environment and on an actual quadruped robot (Unitree A1). Both simulation and physical experimental results demonstrate that the framework enables the quadruped robot to perform a variety of gaits, similar to real animals, including quadrupedal (walk, walkingtrot, amble, trot) and three-legged locomotion (lift any leg). Furthermore, the framework enables the robot to traverse rough terrain and ascend slopes of up to 30 degrees with robustness.
239. Fault Joint Detection and Adaptive Fault-Tolerant Control of Legged Robots Under Joint Partial Failures
足式机器人关节部分失效下的故障关节检测与自适应容错控制
足式机器人搭载多个关节执行器，在长时间运行过程中，这些执行器易突发部分失效故障。关节失效形式多样，不仅包括现有研究主要关注的 “完全锁死失效”，还涵盖 “部分力矩跟踪失效”—— 即执行器仅能部分响应控制指令（无法输出预期力矩）。
本文针对模型预测控制（MPC）与全身控制框架下，存在关节部分失效的足式机器人，开展故障关节检测与失效率估计研究，并提出名为GRUFD-FTC的控制框架。具体研究内容如下：
数据集构建与开源：针对宇树 A1 机器人，构建了涵盖 “不同故障关节数量” 与 “不同力矩保持率” 场景的数据集，并已开源；
故障检测模块设计：提出基于步态循环单元（Gait Recurrent Unit）的故障检测器，可在机器人运动过程中同时检测多个关节的部分失效，并输出关节力矩保持率初始值；
容错控制模块设计：提出基于关节状态的容错控制器，实现对关节力矩保持率的精准估计。
最后，通过仿真实验与真实环境实验，验证了所提算法的有效性。
Legged robots employ multiple joint actuators that are susceptible to abrupt partial failures during prolonged operation. Joint failures take multiple forms. They are not limited to complete lockout failures, which are the main focus of existing literature. They also include partial torque tracking failures, where actuators only partially respond to control commands. This letter investigates fault joints detection and fault rates estimation for legged robots with partial joint failures under model predictive control (MPC) and whole-body control frameworks. To handle these problems, a control framework named GRUFD-FTC is proposed. Firstly, we have created a dataset for Unitree A1 robots under different numbers of fault joints and different torque retention rates, and have open-sourced it. In addition, a gait recurrent unit based fault detector is proposed to simultaneously detect multiple joints partial failure during robot movement and then output initial joint torque retention rates. Subsequently, a fault-tolerant controller based on joint states is proposed to accurately estimate the joint torque retention rates. Finally, simulations and real-world experiments have verified the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.
240. A control scheme for collaborative object transportation between a human and a quadruped robot using the MIGHTY suction cup
基于 MIGHTY 吸盘的人 - 四足机器人协同物体搬运控制方案
本文提出一种人 - 机器人协同物体搬运控制方案，研究对象为搭载MIGHTY 吸盘的四足机器人 —— 该吸盘兼具双重功能，既是抓取物体的夹持装置，也是采集力 / 力矩信息的传感器。
所提控制方案以导纳控制（Admittance Control） 为核心，融入可变阻尼项：一方面提升人类对机器人的可控性，另一方面降低人类在协同过程中的操作负担。此外，为确保协同搬运过程中物体不会从吸盘脱落，方案额外设计了基于障碍人工势场（Barrier Artificial Potential） 的控制信号，通过势能约束防止物体脱离吸盘。
理论分析证明，该控制方案具备无源性（Passivity）—— 这一特性可保证系统能量稳定，避免出现震荡或不稳定运动。研究人员通过实验验证了方案性能：在搭载 MIGHTY 吸盘的宇树 Go1 机器人上开展相关实验，结果充分体现了该控制方案的有效性。
In this work, a control scheme for human-robot collaborative object transportation is proposed, considering a quadruped robot equipped with the MIGHTY suction cup that serves both as a gripper for holding the object and a force/torque sensor. The proposed control scheme is based on the notion of admittance control, and incorporates a variable damping term aiming towards increasing the controllability of the human and, at the same time, decreasing her/his effort. Furthermore, to ensure that the object is not detached from the suction cup during the collaboration, an additional control signal is proposed, which is based on a barrier artificial potential. The proposed control scheme is proven to be passive and its performance is demonstrated through experimental evaluations conducted using the Unitree Go1 robot equipped with the MIGHTY suction cup.
241. A Nonlinear MPC Framework for Loco-Manipulation of Quadrupedal Robots with Non-Negligible Manipulator Dynamics
面向机械臂动力学不可忽略的四足机器人移动 - 操作任务的非线性 MPC 框架
模型预测控制（MPC）结合降阶模板模型，已成为动态足式机器人运动轨迹优化的有力工具。然而，足式机器人执行的移动 - 操作任务（loco-manipulation，即同时完成移动与机械臂操作的复合任务） 引入了额外复杂性，亟需具备计算效率的 MPC 算法，以处理高自由度（DoF）模型。
本文提出一种计算高效的非线性 MPC（NMPC）框架，专门适配搭载机械臂的四足机器人移动 - 操作任务 —— 该框架中，机械臂的动力学特性相对于四足机器人本体不可忽略（即机械臂运动对机器人整体平衡与动力学会产生显著影响，无法简化忽略）。
所提框架采用分解策略：将移动模板模型（如单刚体模型，SRB 模型）与机械臂的全阶动力学模型相结合，实现力矩级控制。这种分解方式使得 NMPC 问题能以滚动时域（receding horizon） 方式高效实时求解，求解频率可达 60Hz。
在控制执行层面：
NMPC 生成的移动最优状态与输入轨迹，由运行频率为 500Hz 的低层级非线性全身控制器（WBC）跟踪执行；
机械臂的最优力矩指令则直接施加于机械臂执行器。
研究人员通过大量数值仿真与硬件实验，对该分层控制架构进行了验证 —— 实验平台为 15 千克的宇树 Go2 四足机器人，其上搭载了 4.4 千克、4 自由度的 Kinova 机械臂。由于 Kinova 机械臂的动力学特性相对于 Go2 机器人本体不可忽略，实验结果表明，所提 NMPC 框架在执行多样移动 - 操作任务时展现出稳健的稳定性，能有效应对外部扰动、负载变化与崎岖地形。
Model predictive control (MPC) combined with reduced-order template models has emerged as a powerful tool for trajectory optimization in dynamic legged locomotion. However, loco-manipulation tasks performed by legged robots introduce additional complexity, necessitating computationally efficient MPC algorithms capable of handling high-degree-of-freedom (DoF) models. This letter presents a computationally efficient nonlinear MPC (NMPC) framework tailored for loco-manipulation tasks of quadrupedal robots equipped with robotic manipulators whose dynamics are non-negligible relative to those of the quadruped. The proposed framework adopts a decomposition strategy that couples locomotion template models -- such as the single rigid body (SRB) model -- with a full-order dynamic model of the robotic manipulator for torque-level control. This decomposition enables efficient real-time solution of the NMPC problem in a receding horizon fashion at 60 Hz. The optimal state and input trajectories generated by the NMPC for locomotion are tracked by a low-level nonlinear whole-body controller (WBC) running at 500 Hz, while the optimal torque commands for the manipulator are directly applied. The layered control architecture is validated through extensive numerical simulations and hardware experiments on a 15-kg Unitree Go2 quadrupedal robot augmented with a 4.4-kg 4-DoF Kinova arm. Given that the Kinova arm dynamics are non-negligible relative to the Go2 base, the proposed NMPC framework demonstrates robust stability in performing diverse loco-manipulation tasks, effectively handling external disturbances, payload variations, and uneven terrain.
242. ODYSSEY: Open-World Quadrupeds Exploration and Manipulation for Long-Horizon Tasks
ODYSSEY：面向长时任务的开放式四足机器人探索与操作框架
在具身语义推理、可泛化操作与自适应运动领域，语言引导的长时移动操作任务长期以来都是一项重大挑战。当前研究主要受限于三大核心问题：
第一，尽管大型语言模型（LLM）已能通过语义先验提升空间推理与任务规划能力，但现有方案仍局限于桌面场景，无法解决移动平台面临的 “感知受限” 与 “驱动范围有限” 问题；
第二，面对开放式环境中多样的物体构型，现有操作策略的泛化能力不足，难以适配不同场景下的物体交互需求；
第三，在非结构化环境中，“维持平台高机动性” 与 “实现末端执行器精准控制” 的双重需求对实际部署至关重要，但相关研究仍较为薄弱。
为解决上述问题，本文提出ODYSSEY 框架—— 这是一套面向 “搭载机械臂的敏捷四足机器人” 的统一移动操作框架，可将高层任务规划与低层全身控制无缝融合。具体设计如下：
针对 “语言条件任务中的第一视角感知” 挑战，引入由视觉 - 语言模型驱动的分层规划器，实现长时任务指令的分解与精准动作执行；
在控制层面，提出全新的全身策略，确保机器人在复杂地形中仍能实现稳健的运动与操作协同。
此外，本文还构建了首个长时移动操作基准测试集，涵盖多样的室内外场景，为该领域研究提供标准化评估依据。通过成功的 “仿真到实物” 迁移实验，本文验证了该系统在真实场景部署中的泛化性与鲁棒性，凸显了足式操作机器人在非结构化环境中的实用价值。本研究为研发 “可执行复杂动态任务的通用机器人助手” 推进了可行性。
Language-guided long-horizon mobile manipulation has long been a grand challenge in embodied semantic reasoning, generalizable manipulation, and adaptive locomotion. Three fundamental limitations hinder progress: First, although large language models have improved spatial reasoning and task planning through semantic priors, existing implementations remain confined to tabletop scenarios, failing to address the constrained perception and limited actuation ranges of mobile platforms. Second, current manipulation strategies exhibit insufficient generalization when confronted with the diverse object configurations encountered in open-world environments. Third, while crucial for practical deployment, the dual requirement of maintaining high platform maneuverability alongside precise end-effector control in unstructured settings remains understudied.
In this work, we present ODYSSEY, a unified mobile manipulation framework for agile quadruped robots equipped with manipulators, which seamlessly integrates high-level task planning with low-level whole-body control. To address the challenge of egocentric perception in language-conditioned tasks, we introduce a hierarchical planner powered by a vision-language model, enabling long-horizon instruction decomposition and precise action execution. At the control level, our novel whole-body policy achieves robust coordination across challenging terrains. We further present the first benchmark for long-horizon mobile manipulation, evaluating diverse indoor and outdoor scenarios. Through successful sim-to-real transfer, we demonstrate the system's generalization and robustness in real-world deployments, underscoring the practicality of legged manipulators in unstructured environments. Our work advances the feasibility of generalized robotic assistants capable of complex, dynamic tasks.
243. QuadWBG: Generalizable Quadrupedal Whole-Body Grasping
QuadWBG：具备泛化能力的四足机器人全身抓取系统
拥有先进操作能力的足式机器人，在改善家庭服务与城市维护工作方面具有巨大潜力。尽管目前在研发稳健的运动控制与精准的操作方法上已取得显著进展，但要将这些技术无缝整合为适用于真实场景的一体化全身控制方案，仍面临诸多挑战。
本文提出一套模块化框架，用于构建基于 “单臂载相机” 的稳健且具备泛化能力的全身移动 - 操作控制器（whole-body loco-manipulation controller）。该框架通过强化学习（RL）实现两大核心策略：
稳健的低层 5 维（5D）指令执行策略：负责精准执行运动与操作指令，保障机器人在交互过程中的动作精度与稳定性；
抓取感知型高层策略：由全新指标 ——广义定向可达性地图（Generalized Oriented Reachability Map, GORM） 引导，可结合环境感知判断抓取可行性，优化抓取决策。
实验表明，所提系统在真实场景中的一次性抓取准确率达到 89%（当前最优水平），甚至能完成抓取透明物体等具有挑战性的任务。通过大量仿真实验与真实环境测试验证：该系统可有效覆盖从地面到机器人身高以上的广阔工作空间，并能执行多样化的全身移动 - 操作任务。
Legged robots with advanced manipulation capabilities have the potential to significantly improve household duties and urban maintenance. Despite considerable progress in developing robust locomotion and precise manipulation methods, seamlessly integrating these into cohesive whole-body control for real-world applications remains challenging. In this paper, we present a modular framework for robust and generalizable whole-body loco-manipulation controller based on a single arm-mounted camera. By using reinforcement learning (RL), we enable a robust low-level policy for command execution over 5 dimensions (5D) and a grasp-aware high-level policy guided by a novel metric, Generalized Oriented Reachability Map (GORM). The proposed system achieves state-of-the-art one-time grasping accuracy of 89% in the real world, including challenging tasks such as grasping transparent objects. Through extensive simulations and real-world experiments, we demonstrate that our system can effectively manage a large workspace, from floor level to above body height, and perform diverse whole-body loco-manipulation tasks.
244.Teleoperator-Aware and Safety-Critical Adaptive Nonlinear MPC for Shared Autonomy in Obstacle Avoidance of Legged Robots
远程操作员感知和安全关键自适应非线性 MPC 用于腿式机器人避障中的共享自主性
对于在杂乱环境中导航的遥控系统而言，确保人与自主腿式机器人之间安全有效的协作是共享自主性领域的一项根本挑战。传统的共享控制方法通常依赖于固定的混合策略，但是这些策略无法捕捉腿式运动的动态特性并可能危及安全。
在本文中，来自弗吉尼亚理工大学的学者们提出了一种用于四足机器人共享自主性避障任务的遥控操作员感知、安全关键的自适应非线性模型预测控制 (ANMPC) 框架。该框架在人机动作之间采用固定的仲裁权重，但通过使用噪声理性玻尔兹曼模型对人机输入进行建模来增强该方案，该模型的参数使用基于观察到的操纵杆命令的投影梯度下降 (PGD) 定律在线调整。
通过将控制屏障函数 (CBF) 约束集成到计算高效的 NMPC 中来增强安全性，确保尽管人机行为存在不确定性，安全集仍具有前向不变性。该控制架构采用分层结构：基于 CBF 的高级 ANMPC（10 Hz）生成混合的人机速度参考；中级动态感知 NMPC（60 Hz）强制降阶单刚体 (SRB) 动力学来跟踪这些参考；低级非线性全身控制器（500 Hz）通过二次规划施加全阶动力学来跟踪中级轨迹。学者们在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上进行的大量数值和硬件实验以及用户研究验证了该框架，展示了实时避障、人类意图参数在线学习以及安全的远程操作员协作功能。
Ensuring safe and effective collaboration between humans and autonomous legged robots in teleoperated systems navigating cluttered environments is a fundamental challenge in the field of shared autonomy. Traditional shared control approaches often rely on fixed hybrid strategies, but these strategies fail to capture the dynamic characteristics of legged locomotion and can compromise safety.
In this paper, researchers from Virginia Tech propose a teleoperator-aware, safety-critical adaptive nonlinear model predictive control (ANMPC) framework for shared autonomy obstacle avoidance tasks in quadruped robots. This framework employs fixed arbitration weights between human and robot actions but enhances this scheme by modeling human and robot inputs using a noisy rational Boltzmann model, whose parameters are adjusted online using projected gradient descent (PGD) based on observed joystick commands.
Safety is enhanced by integrating control barrier function (CBF) constraints into the computationally efficient NMPC, ensuring that the safety set remains forward-invariant despite uncertainty in human and robot behavior. The control architecture employs a hierarchical structure: a high-level CBF-based ANMPC (10 Hz) generates hybrid human-robot velocity references; a mid-level dynamics-aware NMPC (60 Hz) enforces reduced-order single rigid body (SRB) dynamics to track these references; and a low-level nonlinear whole-body controller (500 Hz) tracks the mid-level trajectory by imposing full-order dynamics via quadratic programming. Extensive numerical and hardware experiments, as well as user studies, validate the framework on the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, demonstrating real-time obstacle avoidance, online learning of human intention parameters, and safe teleoperator collaboration.
245.Learning to Walk with Less: a Dyna-Style Approach to Quadrupedal Locomotion
学会用更少的力走路：一种四足运动的 Dyna 式方法
传统基于强化学习的运动控制器通常数据效率低，需要大量交互才能实现稳健的性能。
来自巴西圣保罗大学和美国伊利诺伊大学的学者们提出了一个基于模型的强化学习 (MBRL) 框架，该框架遵循 Dyna-Style 范式，通过在基于 PPO 的控制器中将合成数据附加到标准 rollout 末尾来提高四足运动的样本效率。与策略一起训练的预测模型会生成短时域合成转换，并使用基于策略更新迭代的调度策略逐步集成这些转换。通过消融研究，学者们发现样本效率与 rollout 长度之间存在很强的相关性，他们在 Unitree Go1 机器人上进行了模拟验证，结果表明，用合成步骤替换部分模拟步骤不仅可以模拟扩展 rollout，还可以提高策略回报并降低方差。最后，还证明了这种改进可以转化为使用更少的模拟步骤跟踪各种运动命令的能力。
Traditional reinforcement learning-based motion controllers are often data-inefficient and require numerous interactions to achieve robust performance.
Researchers from the University of São Paulo (Brazil) and the University of Illinois (USA) proposed a model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) framework, following the Dyna-Style paradigm, to improve sample efficiency for quadrupedal locomotion by appending synthetic data to the end of a standard rollout in a PPO-based controller. A predictive model, trained alongside the policy, generates short-term synthetic transitions, which are progressively integrated using a scheduling strategy based on policy updates. Through ablation studies, the researchers found a strong correlation between sample efficiency and rollout length. Simulations on the Unitree Go1 robot demonstrated that replacing some simulated steps with synthetic steps not only simulates extended rollouts but also improves policy returns and reduces variance. Finally, they demonstrated that this improvement translates to the ability to track a wide range of motion commands using fewer simulation steps.
246.A Geometric Method for Base Parameter Analysis in Robot Inertia Identification Based on Projective Geometric Algebra
基于射影几何代数的机器人惯性辨识基参数分析几何方法
来自上海交通大学的学者们提出了一种用于分析确定机器人系统基本惯性参数的新型几何方法。利用射影几何代数重新表述刚体动力学，从而得到一个名为“四面体点 (TP)”模型的新识别模型。基于刚体 TP 模型，识别模型的回归矩阵系数以闭式推导，并具有清晰的几何解释。基于动力学模型，提出了三个用于基础参数分析的基本原理：共享点原理、不动点原理和平面旋转原理。基于这些原理，开发了自动确定所有基础参数的算法。核心算法称为动力学回归零空间生成器 (DRNG)，在-复杂度预处理阶段后，理论上实现了-复杂度，其中 是刚体的数量。
学者们所提出的方法和算法已在四个机器人上进行了验证：Puma560、Unitree Go2、2RRU-1RRS 并联运动机构 (PKM) 和 2PRS-1PSR PKM。在所有情况下，算法均成功识别出完整的基础参数集。值得注意的是，该方法该方法表现出较高的鲁棒性和计算效率，尤其是在PKMs的情况下。通过全面的演示，证明了该方法的通用性、鲁棒性和高效性。
Researchers from Shanghai Jiao Tong University have proposed a novel geometric method for analyzing and determining the fundamental inertial parameters of robotic systems. They reformulate the dynamics of rigid bodies using projective geometric algebra, resulting in a new identification model called the "tetrahedral point (TP)" model. Based on the rigid-body TP model, the regression matrix coefficients of the identification model are derived in closed form and have a clear geometric interpretation. Based on the dynamic model, they propose three fundamental principles for fundamental parameter analysis: the shared point principle, the fixed point principle, and the planar rotation principle. Based on these principles, they develop an algorithm that automatically determines all fundamental parameters. The core algorithm, called the Dynamic Regression Null Space Generator (DRNG), achieves a theoretically low complexity after a low-complexity preprocessing stage, where is the number of rigid bodies.
The proposed method and algorithm have been validated on four robots: the Puma560, the Unitree Go2, the 2RRU-1RRS parallel kinematic mechanism (PKM), and the 2PRS-1PSR PKM. In all cases, the algorithm successfully identified the complete set of fundamental parameters. Notably, the proposed method exhibits high robustness and computational efficiency, especially in the case of PKMs. Comprehensive demonstrations demonstrate the versatility, robustness, and efficiency of the proposed method.
247.Non-conflicting Energy Minimization in Reinforcement Learning based Robot Control
基于强化学习的机器人控制中的非冲突能量最小化
高效的机器人控制通常需要在任务性能和能量消耗之间取得平衡。强化学习 (RL) 中的一种常见方法是将能量消耗直接作为奖励函数的一部分进行惩罚。这需要仔细调整权重项，以避免出现能量最小化会损害任务成功率的不良权衡。
在本文中，来自俄勒冈州立大学的学者们提出了一种无超参数梯度优化方法，用于在不影响任务性能的情况下最小化能量消耗。受近期多任务学习研究的启发，学者们的方法在任务目标和能量目标之间应用策略梯度投影，从而获得在不影响任务性能的情况下最小化能量消耗的策略更新。学者们在 DM-Control 和 HumanoidBench 的标准运动基准上评估了这项技术，结果表明，在保持同等任务性能的同时，能耗降低了 64%。此外，他们在 Unitree GO2 四足机器人上进行了实验，展示了节能策略的 Sim2Real 迁移。这个方法易于在标准 RL 流程中实现，代码改动极小，适用于任何策略梯度方法，并为节能控制策略的奖励塑造提供了一种原则性的替代方案。
Efficient robotic control often requires striking a balance between task performance and energy consumption. A common approach in reinforcement learning (RL) is to penalize energy consumption directly as part of the reward function. This requires careful tuning of weights to avoid undesirable trade-offs where minimizing energy compromises task success.
In this paper, researchers from Oregon State University propose a hyperparameter-free gradient optimization method for minimizing energy consumption without compromising task performance. Inspired by recent research in multi-task learning, their method applies policy gradient projection between task objectives and energy objectives to obtain policy updates that minimize energy consumption without compromising task performance. They evaluate this technique on standard locomotion benchmarks from DM-Control and HumanoidBench, demonstrating a 64% reduction in energy consumption while maintaining comparable task performance. Furthermore, they demonstrate Sim2Real transfer of energy-efficient policies using the Unitree GO2 quadruped robot. This method is easy to implement in standard RL pipelines with minimal code changes, is applicable to any policy gradient method, and offers a principled alternative for reward shaping in energy-efficient control strategies.
248.FR-Net: Learning Robust Quadrupedal Fall Recovery on Challenging Terrains through Mass-Contact Prediction
FR-Net：通过大规模接触预测在具有挑战性的地形上学习稳健的四足动物跌倒恢复
腿式机器人的跌倒恢复仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在复杂地形下，由于地形感知不完整和交互不确定，传统控制器会失效。
来自香港大学的学者们提出了FR-Net，这是一个基于学习的框架，使四足机器人能够在各种环境中从任意跌倒姿势中恢复。学者们方法的核心是一个质量接触预测网络，它可以根据有限的传感输入估算机器人的质量分布和接触状态，从而促进有效的恢复策略。他们精心设计的奖励函数确保即使在陡峭的楼梯上也能安全恢复，而不会出现现有方法中常见的危险滚动动作。
这个框架完全在模拟环境中使用特权学习进行训练，无需在部署期间提供明确的地形数据即可指导策略学习。学者们在模拟环境中展示了FR-Net 在不同四足平台上的泛化能力，并通过在 Go2 机器人上进行 10 个具有挑战性的场景的大量真实实验来验证其性能。结果表明，明确的质量接触预测是实现稳健跌倒恢复的关键，这为可泛化的四足技能提供了一个有希望的方向。
Fall recovery for legged robots remains challenging, especially in complex terrains, where traditional controllers fail due to incomplete terrain perception and uncertain interactions.
Researchers from the University of Hong Kong propose FR-Net, a learning-based framework that enables quadruped robots to recover from arbitrary fall postures in a variety of environments. At the core of their approach is a mass contact prediction network that estimates the robot's mass distribution and contact state based on limited sensory input, thereby promoting an effective recovery policy. Their carefully designed reward function ensures safe recovery even on steep stairs, without the dangerous rolling maneuvers common in existing methods.
This framework is trained entirely in simulation using privileged learning, eliminating the need for explicit terrain data to guide policy learning during deployment. The researchers demonstrate the generalization ability of FR-Net across different quadruped platforms in simulation and validate its performance through extensive real-world experiments on 10 challenging scenarios on a Go2 robot. Their results demonstrate that explicit mass contact prediction is key to achieving robust fall recovery, providing a promising direction for generalizable quadrupedal skills.
249.First Order Model-Based RL through Decoupled Backpropagation
通过解耦反向传播实现基于一阶模型的强化学习
人们对强化学习 (RL) 方法的兴趣日益浓厚，这些方法利用模拟器的导数来提升学习效率。虽然早期基于梯度的方法已展现出优于无导数方法的卓越性能，但由于实现成本高昂或难以获取，访问模拟器梯度通常并不切实际。基于模型的强化学习 (MBRL) 可以通过学习到的动态模型来近似这些梯度，但求解器效率会受到训练部署期间预测误差叠加的影响，从而降低策略性能。
来自美国纽约大学和法国图卢兹大学的学者们提出了一种将轨迹生成与梯度计算分离的方法：使用模拟器展开轨迹，而梯度则通过模拟器学习到的可微分模型通过反向传播计算。这种混合设计即使在模拟器梯度不可用的情况下也能实现高效一致的一阶策略优化，并能够从模拟部署中学习到更准确的评价指标。学者们的方法实现了 SHAC 等专用优化器的采样效率和速度，同时保持了 PPO 等标准方法的通用性，并避免了其他一阶 MBRL 方法中观察到的不良行为。学者们在基准控制任务上对算法进行了实证验证，并在真实的 Go2 四足机器人上证明了其在四足和双足运动任务中的有效性。
There is growing interest in reinforcement learning (RL) methods that leverage simulator derivatives to improve learning efficiency. While early gradient-based methods have demonstrated superior performance over derivative-free methods, accessing simulator gradients is often impractical due to high implementation costs or difficulty obtaining them. Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can approximate these gradients using a learned dynamics model, but solver efficiency suffers from the accumulation of prediction errors during training deployments, which can degrade policy performance.
Researchers from New York University and the University of Toulouse in France propose an approach that decouples trajectory generation from gradient computation: trajectories are unfolded using a simulator, while gradients are computed via backpropagation through a differentiable model learned in the simulator. This hybrid design enables efficient and consistent first-order policy optimization even when simulator gradients are unavailable, and enables more accurate evaluation metrics to be learned from simulated deployments. Their approach achieves the sample efficiency and speed of specialized optimizers like SHAC while maintaining the generality of standard methods like PPO and avoiding undesirable behaviors observed in other first-order MBRL methods. The scholars empirically validated the algorithm on benchmark control tasks and demonstrated its effectiveness in quadrupedal and bipedal locomotion tasks on a real Go2 quadruped robot.
250.MLM: Learning Multi-task Loco-Manipulation Whole-Body Control for Quadruped Robot with Arm
MLM：带臂四足机器人的学习多任务局部操作全身控制
在实现多任务控制方面，带机械臂的四足机器人的全身操控仍然是一个难题。
为了解决这个问题，来自上海交通大学和上海人工智能实验室的学者们提出了MLM，一个由真实世界和模拟数据驱动的强化学习框架。它使配备六自由度机械臂的四足机器人能够自主或在人类远程操作下执行多任务的全身操控。为了解决在操控学习过程中平衡多任务的问题，学者们引入了一个具有自适应、基于课程的采样机制的轨迹库。这种方法使策略能够有效地利用真实世界收集的轨迹来学习多任务操控。为了解决仅依赖历史观测的部署场景，并提高跨不同空间范围任务的策略执行性能，学者们提出了一个轨迹-速度预测策略网络。它可以预测不可观测的未来轨迹和速度。通过利用丰富的模拟数据和基于课程的奖励机制，他们的控制器在模拟中实现了全身行为，并实现了零样本迁移到现实世界部署。模拟中的消融研究验证了学者们方法的必要性和有效性，而在搭载 Airbot 机械臂的 Go2 机器人上进行的真实实验则证明了该策略在多任务执行中的良好性能。
Full-body manipulation of a quadruped robot with a robotic arm remains a challenging problem in achieving multi-task control.
To address this, researchers from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory proposed MLM, a reinforcement learning framework driven by real-world and simulated data. This framework enables a quadruped robot equipped with a six-degree-of-freedom robotic arm to perform full-body multi-task manipulation autonomously or under human teleoperation. To address the multi-task balancing issue during manipulation learning, the researchers introduced a trajectory library with an adaptive, curriculum-based sampling mechanism. This approach enables the policy to effectively leverage trajectories collected from the real world to learn multi-task manipulation. To address deployment scenarios that rely solely on historical observations and improve policy execution performance across tasks of varying spatial extents, the researchers proposed a trajectory-velocity prediction policy network. It predicts unobservable future trajectories and velocities. By leveraging abundant simulated data and a curriculum-based reward mechanism, their controller achieves full-body behavior in simulation and enables zero-shot transfer to real-world deployment. Ablation studies in simulation validate the necessity and effectiveness of their approach, while real-world experiments on a Go2 robot equipped with an Airbot robotic arm demonstrate its promising performance in multi-task execution.
251.Learning Unified Force and Position Control for Legged Loco-Manipulation
学习腿部运动的统一力与位置控制
机器人的局部操控需要对接触力和位置进行协调控制，然而许多视觉运动策略却将它们分开处理。来自北京邮电大学的学者们提出了一种针对足式机器人的统一控制策略，该策略联合建模力和位置——无需力传感器即可学习。通过模拟各种交互，该策略可以根据过去的状态估算接触力，并通过调整位置和速度进行补偿。该策略能够在不同的力和位置输入组合下实现广泛的操控行为，包括位置追踪、力施加、力追踪和机器人的柔顺行为。此外，学者们证明了学习到的策略通过其力估算模块整合必要的接触信息，从而增强了基于轨迹的模仿学习流程。与位置控制策略相比，该策略在四项具有挑战性的、接触丰富的操控任务中实现了约 39.5% 的成功率提升。在四足动物和人形机器人上进行的实验证明了这个方法在不同场景下的稳健性和多功能性。
Local manipulation of robots requires coordinated control of contact forces and positions, yet many visual motion strategies treat them separately. Scholars from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications proposed a unified control strategy for legged robots that jointly models forces and positions—learning without force sensors. By simulating various interactions, the strategy can estimate contact forces based on past states and compensate by adjusting position and velocity. The strategy is able to achieve a wide range of manipulation behaviors under different combinations of force and position inputs, including position tracking, force application, force tracking, and compliant robot behavior. In addition, the scholars demonstrated that the learned strategy integrates the necessary contact information through its force estimation module, thereby enhancing the trajectory-based imitation learning process. Compared with position control strategies, this strategy achieved a success rate improvement of approximately 39.5% in four challenging, contact-rich manipulation tasks. Experiments on quadrupeds and humanoid robots demonstrated the robustness and versatility of this approach in different scenarios.
252.LocoFormer: Generalist Locomotion via Long-Context Adaptation
LocoFormer：通过长上下文自适应实现通用移动
现代运动控制器通常针对特定实施例进行手动调校。来自Skild AI的学者们提出了 LocoFormer，一个通用的全能运动模型，即使没有精确的运动学知识，也能控制前所未见的腿式和轮式机器人。LocoFormer 能够在测试时适应形态和动力学的变化。学者们发现，实现自适应的关键在于两个关键选择。首先，他们利用程序生成的机器人，并采用积极的领域随机化策略，训练大规模强化学习。其次，与以往短视且上下文长度较短的策略不同，学者们将上下文扩展了几个数量级，以跨越事件边界。他们将同一种 LocoFormer 部署到不同的机器人上，即使在体重变化和电机故障等较大干扰的情况下，也能展现出强大的控制能力。在极端情况下，学者们观察到跨事件的自适应性，LocoFormer 能够从早期事件中的跌倒中学习，从而改进后续事件中的控制策略。学者们相信，这种简单而通用的方法可以用于训练未来其他机器人技能的基础模型。
Modern motion controllers are often hand-tuned for specific implementations. Researchers from Skild AI have proposed LocoFormer, a general, all-purpose motion model that can control unprecedented legged and wheeled robots even without precise kinematic knowledge. LocoFormer is able to adapt to changes in morphology and dynamics during testing. The researchers found that the key to achieving adaptability lies in two key choices. First, they leveraged procedurally generated robots and employed an aggressive domain randomization policy for large-scale reinforcement learning. Second, unlike previous policies that employed short-sighted contexts, they extended the context by several orders of magnitude to span event boundaries. They deployed the same LocoFormer across different robots and demonstrated robust control capabilities even under large perturbations such as weight changes and motor failures. In extreme cases, they observed cross-event adaptability, with LocoFormer able to learn from falls in earlier events to improve control policies in subsequent events. The researchers believe that this simple and general approach could serve as a foundational model for training other robotic skills in the future.
253.Gait in Eight: Efficient On-Robot Learning for Omnidirectional Quadruped Locomotion
Gait in Eight：全向四足运动的高效机器人学习
机器人强化学习是一种很有前景的方法，可用于训练腿式机器人的具身感知策略。然而，机器人实时学习的计算约束构成了重大挑战。
来自德国达姆施塔特工业和MAB机器人的学者们提出了一个框架，利用新型离线策略算法 CrossQ 的样本效率和最小计算开销，仅需 8 分钟的原始实时训练即可高效地学习四足动物的运动。学者们研究了两种控制架构：预测关节目标位置以实现敏捷、高速的运动，以及中央模式生成器以实现稳定、自然的步态。先前的研究侧重于学习简单的前向步态，而学者们的框架将机器人学习扩展到全向运动。并且，他们还展示了该方法在不同的室内和室外环境中的稳健性。
Robotic reinforcement learning is a promising approach for training embodied perception policies in legged robots. However, computational constraints in real-time robotic learning pose significant challenges.
Researchers from the Darmstadt Institute for Industrial Engineering and MAB Robotics in Germany proposed a framework that leverages the sample efficiency and minimal computational overhead of a novel offline policy algorithm, CrossQ, to efficiently learn quadruped locomotion in just 8 minutes of raw real-time training. The researchers investigated two control architectures: predicting joint target positions for agile, high-speed locomotion, and a central pattern generator for stable, natural gaits. While previous research focused on learning simple forward gaits, their framework extends robotic learning to omnidirectional locomotion. They also demonstrated the robustness of their approach in diverse indoor and outdoor environments.
254.Bridge the Gap:Enhancing Quadruped Locomotion with Vertical Ground Perturbations
弥合差距：利用垂直地面扰动增强四足动物的运动能力
腿式机器人（尤其是四足机器人）擅长在崎岖地形中穿行，但它们在垂直地面扰动（例如振动表面引起的扰动）下的性能仍未得到充分探索。
在本研究中，来自达姆施塔特工业大学的学者们提出了一种增强四足机器人运动鲁棒性的新方法，即在一座振动桥上训练Unitree Go2机器人。振动桥是一座13.24米长的钢混凝土结构，其特征频率为2.0 Hz，旨在扰动运动。学者们在MuJoCo模拟中使用强化学习(RL)和近端策略优化(PPO)算法，训练了15种不同的运动策略，将五种步态（小跑、踱步、跳跃、自由、默认）与三种训练条件相结合：刚性桥梁和两种具有不同高度调节策略（相对于桥面或地面）的振动桥梁设置。域随机化确保了模型在真实桥梁上的零样本迁移。实验结果表明，在振动桥梁上训练的策略比在刚性表面上训练的策略表现出更高的稳定性和适应性。即使之前没有接触过桥梁，学者们的框架也能实现稳健的步态模式。这些发现凸显了基于模拟的强化学习在动态地面扰动下改善四足动物运动的潜力，为设计能够穿越振动环境的机器人提供了参考。
Legged robots, particularly quadrupeds, excel at navigating rough terrain, but their performance under vertical ground perturbations, such as those caused by vibrating surfaces, remains underexplored.
In this study, researchers from the Technical University of Darmstadt proposed a novel approach to enhance the robustness of quadrupedal robot locomotion by training a Unitree Go2 robot on a vibrating bridge. The vibrating bridge is a 13.24-meter-long steel-concrete structure with a 2.0 Hz characteristic frequency designed to perturb motion.
