Using reinforcement learning (RL) and the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm in a MuJoCo simulation, the researchers trained 15 different locomotion policies, combining five gaits (trotting, pacing, hopping, free, and default) across three training conditions: a rigid bridge and two vibrating bridge settings with different height adjustments (relative to the bridge deck or the ground). Domain randomization ensured zero-shot transfer of the model to real bridges. Experimental results showed that the policies trained on the vibrating bridge exhibited greater stability and adaptability than those trained on a rigid surface. The researchers' framework achieves robust gait patterns even without previous experience with bridges. These findings highlight the potential of simulation-based reinforcement learning for improving quadruped locomotion under dynamic ground perturbations and provide insights for designing robots capable of traversing vibrating environments.
255.PGTT: Phase-Guided Terrain Traversal for Perceptive Legged Locomotion
PGTT：用于感知腿部运动的相位引导地形穿越
用于腿式机器人的最先进的感知强化学习控制器，要么是施加基于振荡器或反向运动的步态先验，从而限制动作空间，增加策略优化的偏差，并降低机器人形态的适应性；要么是盲操作，难以预测后腿地形，并且对噪声敏感。
在本文中，来自希腊帕特雷大学的学者们提出了相位引导地形遍历 (PGTT)，这是一种感知感知的深度强化学习方法，它通过纯粹的奖励塑造来强制执行步态结构，从而克服了这些限制，与振荡器/反向运动条件的动作先验相比，它减少了策略学习中的归纳偏差。PGTT 将每条腿的相位编码为三次 Hermite 样条函数，该样条函数使摆动高度适应局部高度图统计数据，并添加摆动相位接触惩罚，同时该策略直接作用于关节空间，支持形态无关的部署。 PGTT 在 MuJoCo (MJX) 中，基于程序生成的阶梯状地形进行训练，并采用课程和领域随机化，在推力扰动（中位数比次优方法高 7.5%）和离散障碍物（高 9%）下均取得了最高的成功率，且速度跟踪效果相当，并且收敛到有效策略的速度比强大的端到端基线策略快约 2 倍。学者们使用实时 LiDAR 海拔到高度图流程在 Unitree Go2 上验证了 PGTT，并报告了使用相同超参数在 ANYmal-C 上获得的初步结果。这些发现表明，地形自适应、相位引导的奖励塑造是一种简单通用的机制，可实现跨平台的稳健感知运动。
State-of-the-art perceptual reinforcement learning controllers for legged robots either impose gait priors based on oscillators or inverse kinematics, which restrict the action space, increase bias in policy optimization, and reduce adaptability to the robot's morphology; or operate blindly, making it difficult to predict the terrain behind the legs and sensitive to noise.
In this paper, researchers from the University of Patras in Greece propose Phase-Guided Terrain Traversal (PGTT), a perceptually aware deep reinforcement learning method that overcomes these limitations by enforcing gait structure through pure reward shaping. This reduces inductive bias in policy learning compared to oscillator/inverse kinematics-conditioned action priors. PGTT encodes the phase of each leg as a cubic Hermite spline function that adapts the swing height to local heightmap statistics and adds a swing phase contact penalty. The policy operates directly in joint space, enabling morphology-agnostic deployment. PGTT, trained on procedurally generated stepped terrain in MuJoCo (MJX) with curriculum and domain randomization, achieves state-of-the-art success rates under both thrust perturbations (median 7.5% higher than the next best approach) and discrete obstacles (9% higher), with comparable velocity tracking and converges to an effective policy approximately 2x faster than a strong end-to-end baseline. The researchers validated PGTT on Unitree Go2 using a real-time LiDAR altitude-to-height map pipeline and report preliminary results on ANYmal-C using the same hyperparameters. These findings demonstrate that terrain-adaptive, phase-guided reward shaping is a simple and general mechanism for robust perceptual locomotion across platforms.
256.Towards Dynamic Quadrupedal Gaits: A Symmetry-Guided RL Hierarchy Enables Free Gait Transitions at Varying Speeds
迈向动态四足步态：对称引导的强化学习层次结构可实现不同速度下的自由步态转换
四足机器人拥有丰富多样的可行步态，但生成特定的步态序列通常需要专家费力地调整众多变量，例如着陆和抬离事件以及对每条腿的完整约束。
在本研究中，由纽约雪城大学的学者们提出了一个统一的强化学习框架，利用动态腿式系统的固有对称性和速度-周期关系来生成多功能的四足步态。学者们提出了一种对称引导的奖励函数设计，该设计融合了时间、形态和时间反转对称性。通过关注保留的对称性和自然动力学，学者们的方法无需预先设定轨迹，从而实现了小跑、跳跃、半跳跃和飞奔等多种运动模式之间的平滑过渡。他们的方法已在 Unitree Go2 机器人上实现，在模拟和硬件测试中均展现出在各种速度范围内的稳健性能，显著提高了步态适应性，而无需进行大量的奖励调整或明确的足部位置控制。这项工作提供了对动态运动策略的见解，并强调了对称性在机器人步态设计中的重要作用。
Quadruped robots possess a rich variety of possible gaits, but generating specific gait sequences often requires expert manipulation of numerous variables, such as landing and lift-off events and the full set of constraints for each leg.
In this study, researchers from Syracuse University in New York proposed a unified reinforcement learning framework that leverages the inherent symmetries and velocity-period relationships of dynamic legged systems to generate versatile quadruped gaits. They proposed a symmetry-guided reward function design that incorporates temporal, morphological, and time-reversal symmetries. By focusing on preserved symmetries and natural dynamics, their approach eliminates the need for pre-defined trajectories, enabling smooth transitions between diverse locomotion modes such as trotting, jumping, half-jumping, and galloping. Their approach, implemented on the Unitree Go2 robot, demonstrated robust performance across a wide range of speeds in both simulation and hardware testing, significantly improving gait adaptability without requiring extensive reward tuning or explicit foot position control. This work provides insights into dynamic locomotion strategies and highlights the importance of symmetry in robotic gait design.
257.Real2USD: Scene Representations in Universal Scene Description Language
Real2USD：通用场景描述语言中的场景表示
大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以帮助机器人推理抽象的任务规范。这需要利用基于自然语言的先验知识来增强机器人所用环境的经典表示。目前有许多方法可以实现这一点，但它们都是针对特定任务量身定制的，例如用于导航的视觉语言模型、用于地图绘制的语言引导神经辐射场等。
在本文中，来自宾夕法尼亚大学的学者们提出，在通用场景描述 (USD) 语言是一种有效且通用的表示方法，可用于基于 LLM 的机器人任务，以表示环境中的几何、光度和语义信息。学者们的论点很简单：USD 是一种基于 XML 的场景图，LLM 和人类均可读取，并且足够丰富，可以支持几乎所有任务——皮克斯开发了这种语言来存储资源、场景甚至电影。他们演示了一个“Real to USD”系统，该系统使用搭载激光雷达和 RGB 摄像头的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人。该系统 (i) 构建了包含各种物体和大量玻璃等复杂场景的室内环境的 USD 显式表征；(ii) 使用谷歌 Gemini 解析 USD，以展示场景理解、复杂推理和规划能力。学者们还使用 Nvidia 的 Issac Sim 在模拟仓库和医院环境中研究了该系统的不同方面。
Large language models (LLMs) can help robots reason about abstract task specifications. This requires augmenting the robot's classical representation of its environment with prior knowledge based on natural language. Numerous approaches exist for achieving this, but they are all tailored to specific tasks, such as visual language models for navigation and language-guided neural radiance fields for mapping.
In this paper, researchers from the University of Pennsylvania propose that the Universal Scene Description (USD) language is an efficient and universal representation for LLM-based robotic tasks to represent the geometric, photometric, and semantic information of an environment. Their argument is simple: USD is an XML-based scene graph that is readable by both LLMs and humans and rich enough to support virtually any task—Pixar developed this language to store assets, scenes, and even movies. They demonstrate a "Real to USD" system using a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot equipped with a lidar and an RGB camera. The system (i) constructs an explicit USD representation of a complex indoor environment containing various objects and large amounts of glass; and (ii) uses Google Gemini to parse USD, demonstrating scene understanding, complex reasoning, and planning capabilities. The researchers also used Nvidia's Isaac Sim to study different aspects of the system in simulated warehouse and hospital environments.
258.Real-Time Gait Adaptation for Quadrupeds using Model Predictive Control and Reinforcement Learning
基于模型预测控制和强化学习的四足动物实时步态自适应
无模型强化学习（RL）实现了四足动物灵活敏捷的运动；然而，策略通常会收敛到单一步态，导致性能欠佳。传统上，模型预测控制（MPC）被广泛用于获取特定任务的最优策略，但缺乏适应不同环境的能力。
为了克服这些局限性，来自印度科学研究所（班加罗尔）的学者们提出了一种在连续步态空间中进行实时步态自适应的优化框架，该框架将模型预测路径积分（MPPI）算法与Dreamer模块相结合，从而生成适用于四足动物运动的自适应最优策略。在每个时间步，MPPI使用学习到的Dreamer奖励联合优化动作和步态变量，该奖励能够促进速度跟踪、能量效率、稳定性和平滑过渡，同时惩罚突变的步态变化。此外，学者们还引入了一个学习到的价值函数作为最终奖励，从而将该方法扩展为一个无限时域规划器。学者们在 Unitree Go1 上通过仿真评估了我们的框架，结果表明，在不同的目标速度下，平均能耗最多可降低 36.48%，同时保持了精确的跟踪和适应任务的自适应步态。
Model-free reinforcement learning (RL) enables agile and flexible movement in quadrupeds; however, policies often converge to a single gait, leading to poor performance. Traditionally, model predictive control (MPC) has been widely used to obtain optimal policies for specific tasks, but lacks the ability to adapt to different environments.
To overcome these limitations, researchers from the Indian Institute of Science (Bangalore) have proposed an optimization framework for real-time gait adaptation in a continuous gait space. This framework combines the Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) algorithm with a Dreamer module to generate an adaptive optimal policy suitable for quadrupedal movement. At each time step, MPPI uses a learned Dreamer reward to jointly optimize action and gait variables, which promotes velocity tracking, energy efficiency, stability, and smooth transitions while penalizing abrupt gait changes. Furthermore, the researchers introduced a learned value function as the final reward, thus extending the method to an infinite temporal planner. Researchers evaluated our framework through simulations on Unitree Go1, and the results showed that the average energy consumption could be reduced by up to 36.48% at different target speeds, while maintaining accurate tracking and adaptive gait for the task.
259.Load-bearing Assessment for Safe Locomotion of Quadruped Robots on Collapsing Terrain
四足机器人在塌陷地形上安全运动的承载能力评估
在搜救任务或行星探测中常见的塌陷地形，会对四足机器人带来巨大挑战。本文提出了一种稳健的行走框架，使机器人能够在不稳定地表上安全移动。该框架融合了地形探测、承载能力分析、运动规划与控制策略。与传统依赖专用传感器或外部地形建图的方法不同，我们的方法仅通过关节测量即可评估地形稳定性，无需对硬件进行任何改装。
在控制层面，我们采用模型预测控制（MPC）来优化机器人运动，使其在稳定性与探测约束之间取得平衡；同时，通过状态机协调地形探测动作，使机器人能够识别易塌陷区域并动态调整落脚点。基于自制的塌陷平台和岩石地形的实验结果表明，该框架能够在保持稳定与确保安全的前提下，成功穿越塌陷地形，并已在 AlienGo 四足机器人上得到验证。
Collapsing terrains, often present in search and rescue missions or planetary exploration, pose significant challenges for quadruped robots. This paper introduces a robust locomotion framework for safe navigation over unstable surfaces by integrating terrain probing, load-bearing analysis, motion planning, and control strategies. Unlike traditional methods that rely on specialized sensors or external terrain mapping alone, our approach leverages joint measurements to assess terrain stability without hardware modifications. A Model Predictive Control (MPC) system optimizes robot motion, balancing stability and probing constraints, while a state machine coordinates terrain probing actions, enabling the robot to detect collapsible regions and dynamically adjust its footholds. Experimental results on custom-made collapsing platforms and rocky terrains demonstrate the framework’s ability to traverse collapsing terrain while maintaining stability and prioritizing safety, as validated on the AlienGo quadruped robot.
Primal-Dual iLQR for GPU-Accelerated Learning and Control in Legged Robots
用于腿式机器人GPU加速学习和控制的原始对偶iLQR
本文提出了一种面向足式机器人运动控制的全新模型预测控制（MPC）实现方式，并利用 GPU 并行加速求解过程。我们的方法通过引入并行关联扫描（parallel associative scan）来求解原始-对偶 Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）系统，从而实现时间域与状态空间的双重并行化。借此，最优控制问题的求解复杂度从传统的 O(N(n+m)³) 降至 O(log²(n)·log N + log²(m))，其中 n、m 和 N 分别为系统状态维度、控制向量维度与预测时域长度。
我们将所提出的方法与两种当前最先进的求解器（acados 和 crocoddyl）进行比较：在 Whole-Body Dynamics（WB）MPC 设置下，运行时间提升最高可达 60%；在 Single Rigid Body Dynamics（SRBD）MPC 设置下，随着预测时域的变化，提速甚至达到 700%。该方法在高维状态下同样具有良好的扩展性，使得最多可对 16 台足式机器人进行集中式控制，且计算时间低于 25 ms。
此外，得益于基于 JAX 的实现，该求解器可在多个环境中进行大规模并行运算，从而支持在 GPU 上直接进行与 MPC 闭环结合的学习过程。本方法已在 AlienGo 四足机器人上得到有效验证。相关代码已在 GitHub 开源：https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/mpx
This paper introduces a novel Model Predictive Control (MPC) implementation for legged robot locomotion that leverages GPU parallelization. Our approach enables both temporal and state-space parallelization by incorporating a parallel associative scan to solve the primal-dual Karush-KuhnTucker (KKT) system. In this way, the optimal control problem is solved in O(log2 (n) log N + log2 (m)) complexity, instead of O(N(n+m) 3 ), where n, m, and N are the dimension of the system state, control vector, and the length of the prediction horizon. We demonstrate the advantages of this implementation over two state-of-the-art solvers (acados and crocoddyl), achieving up to a 60% improvement in runtime for Whole Body Dynamics (WB)- MPC and a 700% improvement for Single Rigid Body Dynamics (SRBD)-MPC when varying the prediction horizon length. The presented formulation scales efficiently with the problem state dimensions as well, enabling the definition of a centralized controller for up to 16 legged robots that can be computed in less than 25 ms. Furthermore, thanks to the JAX implementation, the solver supports large-scale parallelization across multiple environments, allowing the possibility of performing learning with the MPC in the loop directly in GPU. The effectiveness of the proposed MPC framework is validated on the AlienGo quadruped robot. The code associated with this work can be found at https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/mpx.
Whole-Body Inverse Dynamics MPC for Legged Loco-Manipulation
用于腿式运动操控的全身逆动力学模型预测控制
在 loco-manipulation（移动操作）任务中，机器人需要在保持行走稳定性的同时，通过全身协调完成有效的物体操作，这对规划与控制都带来了显著挑战。为此，本文提出了一种全身模型预测控制（MPC）框架，通过全阶逆动力学直接优化关节力矩，使运动与力的规划和执行能够在同一预测层中统一完成。该方法能够生成涌现的、物理一致的全身行为，并自然考虑系统动力学与物理约束。
我们采用开源软件框架 Pinocchio 和 CasADi，并结合最先进的内点法求解器 Fatrop 实现了所提出的 MPC 方案。在真实实验中，我们将该方法部署于一台搭载 Unitree Z1 机械臂的 Unitree B2 四足机器人上，并成功实现了 80 Hz 的实时控制频率。实验展示了多种需要末端执行器在位置与力方面进行精细控制的移动操作任务，包括拖拽重物、推动箱体以及擦拭白板等真实交互任务。
Loco-manipulation demands coordinated wholebody motion to manipulate objects effectively while maintaining locomotion stability, presenting significant challenges for both planning and control. In this work, we propose a wholebody model predictive control (MPC) framework that directly optimizes joint torques through full-order inverse dynamics, enabling unified motion and force planning and execution within a single predictive layer. This approach allows emergent, physically consistent whole-body behaviors that account for the system’s dynamics and physical constraints. We implement our MPC formulation using open software frameworks (Pinocchio and CasADi), along with the state-of-the-art interior-point solver Fatrop. In real-world experiments on a Unitree B2 quadruped equipped with a Unitree Z1 manipulator arm, our MPC formulation achieves real-time performance at 80 Hz. We demonstrate loco-manipulation tasks that demand fine control over the end-effector’s position and force to perform real-world interactions like pulling heavy loads, pushing boxes, and wiping whiteboards.
TARC: Time-Adaptive Robotic Control
TARC：时间自适应机器人控制
在机器人控制中，固定频率控制存在一个权衡问题：低频控制虽然高效，但鲁棒性不足；高频控制虽然稳健，但效率低下，而这种限制在可适应的生物系统中并不存在。为此，本文提出了一种强化学习方法，使策略能够同时选择控制动作及其作用时长，从而使机器人能够根据具体情境自主调节控制频率。
我们通过零样本仿真到真实（sim-to-real）实验验证了该方法在两种不同硬件平台上的性能：高速遥控车和四足机器人Unitree Go1。实验结果表明，该方法在奖励表现上能够匹配或超越固定频率的基线策略，同时显著降低了平均控制频率，并在真实环境中展现出自适应的频率调节能力。
Fixed-frequency control in robotics imposes a trade-off between the efficiency of low-frequency control and the robustness of high-frequency control, a limitation not seen in adaptable biological systems. We address this with a reinforcement learning approach in which policies jointly select control actions and their application durations, enabling robots to autonomously modulate their control frequency in response to situational demands. We validate our method with zero-shot sim-to-real experiments on two distinct hardware platforms: a high-speed RC car and a quadrupedal robot Unitree Go1. Our method matches or outperforms fixed-frequency baselines in terms of rewards while significantly reducing the control frequency and exhibiting adaptive frequency control under real-world conditions.
Learning a Unified Policy for Position and Force Control in Legged Loco-Manipulationl
学习腿式运动操控中位置和力控制的统一策略
机器人移动操作（loco-manipulation）常伴随与环境的高接触互动，因此需要同时建模接触力与机器人位姿。然而，近年来的视觉运动策略往往仅关注位置控制或力控制中的一项，忽略了二者的联合学习。本文提出了首个能够 同时学习力控制与位置控制的统一策略，且 无需依赖力传感器，适用于腿式机器人。
我们在仿真中构建多样化的力与位置指令组合，以及外部扰动力场，并通过强化学习训练策略，使其能够从历史机器人状态中估计接触力，并通过位置与速度调整进行补偿。该策略可在多种力与位置输入条件下实现广泛的操作行为，包括位置跟踪、施加力、力跟踪以及顺应式交互。
此外，我们展示了该策略能够增强基于轨迹的模仿学习流程：通过其力估计模块补充关键接触信息，在四项复杂的高接触操作任务中，相比传统位置控制策略使成功率提升约 39.5%。
在Unitree B2-Z1四足机器人操纵平台和Unitree G1人形机器人上的实验进一步验证了所提出策略在多样场景中的通用性与鲁棒性。
Robotic loco-manipulation often involves contact-rich interactions with the environment, requiring the joint modeling of contact force and robot position. However, recent visuomotor policies often focus solely on learning position or force control, overlooking their co-learning. We propose the first unified policy for legged robots that jointly models force and position control learned without relying on force sensors. By simulating diverse combinations of position and force commands alongside external disturbance forces, we use reinforcement learning to learn a policy that estimates forces from historical robot states and compensates for them through position and velocity adjustments. This policy enables a wide range of manipulation behaviors under varying force and position inputs, including position tracking, force application, force tracking, and compliant interactions. Moreover, we demonstrate that the learned policy enhances trajectory-based imitation learning pipelines by incorporating essential contact information through its force estimation module, achieving approximately ∼39.5% higher success rates in four challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks over position-control policies. Experiments on both a Unitree B2-Z1 quadrupedal manipulator and a Unitree G1 humanoid robot validate the versatility and robustness of the proposed policy in diverse scenarios.
Reference-Free Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
基于无参考采样模型的预测控制
我们提出了一种基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）框架，使机器人能够在 无需手工设计的步态模式或预定义接触序列 的情况下实现自发运动。该方法可以发现多样化的运动模式，包括小跑、疾驰、稳健站立、跳跃以及倒立平衡，完全通过高层目标的优化实现。
在此基础上，我们基于 模型预测路径积分（Model Predictive Path Integral, MPPI） 方法，提出了一种 双空间样条参数化（dual-space spline parameterization），同时在位置和速度控制点上进行操作。该方法能够自适应地执行接触建立与断开策略，仅需有限数量的采样轨迹即可完成任务需求。这种采样效率使得我们能够在标准 CPU 硬件上实现实时控制，无需其他 MPPI 方法通常依赖的 GPU 加速。
我们在 Go2 四足机器人 上验证了该方法，展示了多种自发步态及基本跳跃能力。在仿真环境中，我们进一步展示了更复杂的行为，例如后空翻、动态倒立平衡，以及人形机器人上的行走运动，整个过程均无需参考轨迹跟踪或离线预训练。
We present a sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) framework that enables emergent locomotion without relying on handcrafted gait patterns or predefined contact sequences. Our method discovers diverse motion patterns, ranging from trotting to galloping, robust standing policies, jumping, and handstand balancing, purely through the optimization of high-level objectives. Building on model predictive path integral (MPPI), we propose a dual-space spline parameterization that operates on position and velocity control points. Our approach enables contact-making and contact-breaking strategies that adapt automatically to task requirements, requiring only a limited number of sampled trajectories. This sample efficiency allows us to achieve realtime control on standard CPU hardware, eliminating the need for GPU acceleration typically required by other state-of-theart MPPI methods. We validate our approach on the Go2 quadrupedal robot, demonstrating various emergent gaits and basic jumping capabilities. In simulation, we further showcase more complex behaviors, such as backflips, dynamic handstand balancing and locomotion on a Humanoid, all without requiring reference tracking or offline pre-training.
Quadrupedal gait on oscillating surfaces
在振荡表面上的四足行走
足式机器人，尤其是四足机器人，正越来越多地被部署在非结构化环境中，而这些环境往往伴随地形不稳定性。尽管强化学习（RL）已使机器人在不平整地面或横向扰动下实现了稳健的行走能力，但对垂直方向地面运动的影响——这一在桥梁、平台及海事环境中常见的真实扰动源——仍缺乏深入研究。本论文通过使用一座真实建造的实验桥梁（主特征频率为 2 Hz，用于产生扰动），对四足机器人在垂直振动条件下的步态表现进行系统评估，以填补这一研究空白。
我们采用 Unitree Go2 四足机器人，并基于 Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）算法与 MuJoCo 物理引擎在仿真中训练了 18 个步态策略。这些策略覆盖六种步态模式（默认、trot、小跑、pace 侧步、bound 弹跳、pronk 跳跃、free 自由步态），并对应三种训练环境：静止地面、以及两个不同高度控制策略（相对地面或相对桥面）的振动桥梁设置。通过域随机化，我们实现了策略在真实系统上的零样本迁移（zero-shot transfer）。
实验结果表明，在振动环境中训练的策略在实际部署中表现出显著更高的稳定性与鲁棒性。此外，我们提出了一套超越传统奖励函数的评估指标体系，重点关注高度控制、步态一致性与适应性。研究结果强调了在训练过程中纳入动态地形扰动的重要性，并展示了基于强化学习的控制器在垂直不稳定环境中实现高韧性 locomotion的潜力。
Legged robots, especially quadrupeds, are increasingly deployed in unstructured environments where terrain instability is common. While reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled robust locomotion over uneven and laterally perturbed surfaces, the effects of vertical ground motion—a frequent real-world disturbance in settings such as bridges, platforms, and maritime environments—remain underexplored. This thesis addresses this gap by evaluating quadruped locomotion under vertical oscillations using a real-world experimental bridge with a dominant eigenfrequency of 2 Hz, designed to perturb locomotion. We use the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, trained in simulation with the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm and the MuJoCo physics engine, to develop 18 locomotion policies. These policies span six gait patterns (default, trot, pace, bound, pronk, free) and three training regimes: a static surface and two oscillating bridge setups differing in their height regulation strategy (relative to ground or bridge surface). Domain randomization enables zero-shot policy transfer to the physical system. Our results show that policies trained under oscillating conditions exhibit significantly improved stability and robustness during real-world deployment. Furthermore, we introduce set of evaluation metrics beyond reward functions, focusing on height control, gait consistency, and adaptability. The findings underscore the importance of including dynamic terrain perturbations during training and highlight the potential of RL-based controllers for resilient locomotion in vertically unstable environments.
X-IONet: Cross-Platform Inertial Odometry Network with Dual-Stage Attention
X-IONet：具有双阶段注意力机制的跨平台惯性里程计网络
基于学习的惯性里程计（Inertial Odometry, IO）在行人导航中已取得显著进展。然而，将这些方法扩展到四足机器人仍面临挑战，因为四足平台具有与行人截然不同且高度动态的运动模式。对行人数据表现良好的模型，在部署到足式机器人时往往会出现性能大幅退化。
为解决这一问题，我们提出 X-IONet，一种跨平台的单 IMU 惯性里程计框架。X-IONet 引入基于规则的专家选择模块，用于区分不同运动平台并将 IMU 序列路由至对应的专家网络。其位移预测网络采用双阶段注意力结构，能够同时建模长时序依赖与轴间相关性，从而实现精确的运动表征。模型输出位移及其不确定性，并通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）进行融合，以获得稳健的状态估计。
在公共行人数据集和自采四足机器人数据集上的大量实验表明，X-IONet 达到当前最先进性能：在行人数据上，将绝对轨迹误差（ATE）降低 14.3%，相对轨迹误差（RTE）降低 11.4%；在四足机器人数据上，ATE 和 RTE 分别降低 52.8% 与 41.3%。这些结果显示 X-IONet 能够在人体与足式机器人平台上实现高精度、强鲁棒性的惯性导航。
我们在 RoNIN 行人数据集与新采集的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人数据集上的广泛实验进一步验证了其卓越性能。
Learning-based inertial odometry has achieved remarkable progress in pedestrian navigation. However, extending these methods to quadruped robots remains challenging due to their distinct and highly dynamic motion patterns. Models that perform well on pedestrian data often experience severe degradation when deployed on legged platforms. To tackle this challenge, we introduce X-IONet, a cross-platform inertial odometry framework that operates solely using a single Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU). X-IONet incorporates a rulebased expert selection module to classify motion platforms and route IMU sequences to platform-specific expert networks. The displacement prediction network features a dual-stage attention architecture that jointly models long-range temporal dependencies and inter-axis correlations, enabling accurate motion representation. It outputs both displacement and associated uncertainty, which are further fused through an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) for robust state estimation. Extensive experiments on public pedestrian datasets and a self-collected quadruped robot dataset demonstrate that X-IONet achieves state-of-theart performance, reducing Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) by 14.3% and Relative Trajectory Error (RTE) by 11.4% on pedestrian data, and by 52.8% and 41.3% on quadruped robot data. These results highlight the effectiveness of X-IONet in advancing accurate and robust inertial navigation across both human and legged robot platforms. Extensive experiments on both the RoNIN pedestrian dataset and a newly collected Unitree Go2 quadruped dataset demonstrated state-of-the-art performance.
Towards Unstructured MAPF: Multi-Quadruped MAPF Demo
迈向非结构化MAPF：多四足MAPF演示
多智能体路径规划（Multi-Agent Path Finding，MAPF）在最广义的定义中旨在为共享环境中的多智能体团队寻找无碰撞路径。理论上，MAPF 方法能够解决多种多智能体协同问题。然而，现有 MAPF 研究主要集中在简化的仓储场景，例如基于网格的离散空间、离散时间步，以及无运动学约束的点质量（point-mass）智能体。因此，人们往往将 MAPF 与这些网格世界假设紧密联系，这在一定程度上限制了其在更广泛应用领域中的吸引力。
然而，MAPF 方法完全可以突破这些经典假设并应用于更复杂的系统。为此，我们的演示展示了如何将 MAPF 技术用于四足机器人团队的路径规划。我们的系统在连续空间和连续时间中规划路径，考虑机器人真实的占地空间（footprint），并融入动力学约束。相关示例视频可参见：https://youtu.be/ihVPEsN58t0。
我们还在真实环境中对 2–4 台 Unitree Go1 四足机器人团队进行了验证实验，证明了该系统在实际部署中的可行性和有效性。
Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) in its most broad perspective focuses on finding collision free paths for general teams of agents in a shared environment. Theoretically, MAPF methods could solve a variety of multi-agent problems. However, MAPF research primarily focuses on simplified warehouse domains, i.e., gridworld with discrete spaces, discrete timesteps, and point-mass agents without kinematic constraints. Thus, the perception of MAPF is tied closely to gridworld and its assumptions, which limits its attractiveness to more broad domains. However, there are several ways to extend MAPF methods past these classical assumptions. To this end, our demo shows how MAPF techniques can be used to plan for a team of quadrupeds. Our system plans in continuous space, in continuous time, with realistic footprints, and incorporates dynamics constraints. See https://youtu.be/ihVPEsN58t0 for additional details. We also verified this system on teams of 2-4 Unitree Go1s in a real-world physical set-up.
SocialNav: Training Human-Inspired Foundation Model for Socially-Aware Embodied Navigation
SocialNav：训练受人类启发的、具有社交感知能力的具身导航基础模型
具身导航在遵循社交规范方面仍是一项具有挑战性的研究课题。我们提出 SocialNav，一种具备社会认知能力的基础模型，采用分层的“认知—行动（brain–action）”架构，能够理解高层次的社交规范，并生成符合社交要求的低层次导航轨迹。为实现这两类能力，我们构建了 SocNav Dataset，一个包含 700 万样本的大规模数据集，包括：(1) Cognitive Activation Dataset，提供链式推理（chain-of-thought）解释及社交可通行性预测等社会推理信号；(2) Expert Trajectories Pyramid，整合来自互联网视频、仿真环境及真实机器人导航的多样专家示范轨迹。
我们提出多阶段训练流程，以逐步注入并强化导航智能：首先通过模仿学习向模型注入基础导航技能和社交规范理解；随后使用我们专门设计的 Socially-Aware Flow Exploration GRPO（SAFE-GRPO） 进一步精炼导航能力。SAFE-GRPO 是首个面向具身导航的基于流（flow-based）的强化学习框架，能够显式奖励社会合规行为。
与当前最先进方法相比，SocialNav 的成功率提升 38%，社交合规率提升 46%，在导航性能与社交遵从性上均取得显著提升。
我们将不同方法部署在配备 NVIDIA A10 GPU 的云服务器上，并用于指导 Unitree Go2 机器人进行导航。
项目主页：https://amap-eai.github.io/SocialNav/
Embodied navigation that adheres to social norms remains an open research challenge. Our SocialNav is a foundational model for socially-aware navigation with a hierarchical ”brain-action” architecture, capable of understanding high-level social norms and generating low-level, socially compliant trajectories. To enable such dual capabilities, we construct the SocNav Dataset, a large-scale collection of 7 million samples, comprising (1) a Cognitive Activation Dataset providing social reasoning signals such as chain-of-thought explanations and social traversability prediction, and (2) an Expert Trajectories Pyramid aggregating diverse navigation demonstrations from internet videos, simulated environments, and real-world robots. A multistage training pipeline is proposed to gradually inject and refine navigation intelligence: we first inject general navigation skills and social norms understanding into the model via imitation learning, and then refine such skills through a deliberately designed Socially-Aware Flow Exploration GRPO (SAFE-GRPO), the first flow-based reinforcement learning framework for embodied navigation that explicitly rewards socially compliant behaviors. SocialNav achieves +38% success rate and +46% social compliance rate compared to the state-of-the-art method, demonstrating strong gains in both navigation performance and social compliance. We deploy different methods on a cloud server with an NVIDIA A10 GPU to guide a Unitree Go2 robot’s navigation. Our project page: https://amap-eai.github. io/SocialNav/
Learning Robust Quadrupedal Locomotion Through Terrain Interaction via Deep Reinforcement Learning
通过深度强化学习学习地形交互中的稳健四足动物运动
四足机器人凭借其复杂的步态模式，能够在轮式机器人难以通过的复杂地形上行进。然而，为这类机器人设计控制器具有挑战性，因为控制器需要适应多样化的地形，同时还需处理步态行为本身的复杂性。近年来，通过深度强化学习（Deep Reinforcement Learning, DRL）训练的控制器取得了显著进展，其学习过程模仿了动物的经验学习机制。
以往依赖本体感知（proprioception）反馈的控制方法通常依赖预定义的运动模式或步态，其奖励机制往往也受到这些运动模式的限制。本文研究提出了一种完全依赖本体感知的学习型控制器，无需使用预定义运动模式或步态，即可在复杂环境中实现稳健的四足运动，并依靠与步态无关的奖励机制实现高效学习。
Quadrupedal robots, with their complex walking patterns, can traverse difficult terrain where wheeled robots falter. Creating a controller for these robots presents challenges due to the necessity to adapt to diverse terrains and the complexity involved in the walking behavior. Recently, controllers learned through Deep Reinforcement Learning have made significant progress by emulating the experiential learning seen in animals. Past methods relying exclusively on proprioceptive feedback often depend on predefined motion patterns or gaits, and their reward mechanisms are often influenced by these motion patterns. Our study presents a learned controller that depends uniquely on proprioception, achieving strong locomotion in tough environments without using predefined motion patterns or gaits, relying on gait-independent rewards.
Zero-Splat TeleAssist: A Zero-Shot Pose Estimation Framework for Semantic Teleoperation
Zero-Splat TeleAssist：一种用于语义遥操作的零样本姿态估计框架
我们提出 Zero-Splat TeleAssist，一个零样本（zero-shot）传感器融合管线，可将普通闭路电视（CCTV）视频流转换为多方远程操作的共享 6 自由度（6-DoF）世界模型。通过整合视觉-语言分割、单目深度估计、加权主成分分析（weighted-PCA）姿态提取以及三维高斯点云渲染（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS），TeleAssist 能够在以交互为中心的远程操作中，为每位操作者实时提供多机器人全局位置和姿态信息，而无需标志物或深度传感器。
我们在真实实验室环境中对该框架进行了验证，使用多种异构机器人进行测试，包括 Boston Dynamics Spot（黄色四足机器人）、Unitree Go2（灰色小型四足机器人）和 AgileX Hunter（轮式无人地面车），均在俯视 RGB 摄像机（1080p，15 FPS）监控下进行操作。
We introduce Zero-Splat TeleAssist, a zero-shot sensor-fusion pipeline that transforms commodity CCTV streams into a shared, 6-DoF world model for multilateral teleoperation. By integrating vision–language segmentation, monocular depth, weighted-PCA pose extraction and 3-D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), TeleAssist provides every operator with real-time global positions and orientations of multiple robots without fiducials or depth sensors in an interaction-centric teleoperation. We evaluated the proposed framework in a realworld laboratory environment using multiple heterogeneous robots—Boston Dynamics Spot (yellow quadruped), Unitree Go2 (small grey quadruped), and AgileX Hunter (wheeled UGV)—under overhead RGB camera observation (1080p, 15 FPS).
Robot Squid Game Quadrupedal Locomotion for Traversing Narrow Tunnels
机器人鱿鱼游戏：四足行走穿越狭窄隧道
四足机器人在执行关键任务（如搜救和基础设施巡检）时展现出在复杂地形中导航的巨大潜力。然而，自主穿越受限的三维环境——包括隧道、洞穴以及坍塌结构——仍然是一项重大挑战。现有方法通常受限于刚性步态模式、对多样几何结构适应性差，以及对环境的过度简化假设。
本文提出一种结合程序化环境生成与**策略蒸馏（policy distillation）**的强化学习（RL）框架，用于实现四足机器人在多种隧道配置下的稳健运动。我们的方法采用教师-学生训练范式：在程序化生成的隧道几何结构上训练的专家策略，将其知识迁移到统一的学生策略中。该策略消除了端到端 RL 训练中对复杂奖励函数设计的依赖，通过将复杂任务拆解为更小、更易学习的子任务，从而简化了训练过程。
通过在训练阶段合成多样化的隧道结构，并将导航策略蒸馏为可泛化的策略，我们的方法能够在传统方法失效的复杂空间约束下，实现一致的穿越性能。我们通过仿真和真实实验验证了该方法，使四足机器人能够成功穿越受限的复杂隧道环境。为了评估 SQUID 策略的仿真到现实迁移能力，我们将训练得到的模型部署在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上，并在受控隧道环境中进行测试。
Quadruped robots demonstrate exceptional potential for navigating complex terrain in critical applications such as search-and-rescue missions and infrastructure inspection. However, autonomous traversal of confined 3D environments—including tunnels, caves, and collapsed structures—remains a significant challenge. Existing methods often struggle with rigid gait patterns, limited adaptability to diverse geometries, and reliance on oversimplified environmental assumptions. This paper introduces a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework that combines procedural environment generation with policy distillation to enable robust locomotion across various tunnel configurations. Our approach leverages a teacher-student training paradigm, where specialized expert policies trained on procedurally generated tunnel geometries transfer their knowledge to a unified student policy. This strategy eliminates the need for complex reward shaping in end-to-end RL training, simplifying the process by breaking down complicated tasks into smaller, more manageable components that are easier for the robot to learn. By synthesizing diverse tunnel structures during training and distilling navigation strategies into a generalizable policy, our method achieves consistent traversal across complex spatial constraints where conventional approaches fail. We demonstrate, through both simulation and real-world experiments, that our method enables quadruped robots to successfully traverse challenging, confined tunnel environments. To assess the sim-to-real transferability of our SQUID policy, we deploy the trained model on a Unitree Go2 quadruped in a controlled tunnel environment.
MacroNav: Multi-Task Context Representation Learning Enables Efficient Navigation in Unknown Environments
MacroNav：多任务上下文表征学习实现未知环境中的高效导航
在未知环境中实现自主导航，需要在部分可观测条件下具备紧凑而富有表现力的空间理解，以支持高层决策。现有方法往往难以在丰富的上下文表征与导航效率之间取得平衡。
本文提出 MacroNav，一个基于学习的导航框架，包含两个关键组件：
轻量级上下文编码器：通过多任务自监督学习训练，能够捕捉多尺度、面向导航的空间表征；
强化学习策略：将上述表征与基于图的推理无缝结合，实现高效动作选择。
大量实验表明，该上下文编码器能够高效且稳健地理解环境。我们以 Unitree Go2 机器人作为实验平台，并在真实环境中进行了部署验证。结果显示，MacroNav 在成功率（Success Rate, SR）和路径加权成功率（Success weighted by Path Length, SPL）上均显著优于最先进的导航方法，同时保持了低计算成本。代码将在论文接受后开源。
Autonomous navigation in unknown environments requires compact yet expressive spatial understanding under partial observability to support high-level decision making. Existing approaches struggle to balance rich contextual representation with navigation efficiency. We present MacroNav, a learningbased navigation framework featuring two key components: (1) a lightweight context encoder trained via multi-task selfsupervised learning to capture multi-scale, navigation-centric spatial representations; and (2) a reinforcement learning policy that seamlessly integrates these representations with graph-based reasoning for efficient action selection. Extensive experiments demonstrate the context encoder’s efficient and robust environmental understanding. We utilize a Unitree Go2 robot as the experimental platform, real-world deployments further validate MacroNav’s effectiveness, yielding significant gains over stateof-the-art navigation methods in both Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL), while maintaining low computational cost. Code will be released upon acceptance.
Co-NavGPT: Multi-Robot Cooperative Visual Semantic Navigation Using Vision Language Models
Co-NavGPT：基于视觉语言模型的多机器人协作视觉语义导航
视觉目标导航（Visual Target Navigation）是自主机器人在未知环境中运行的关键能力，尤其在需要人机交互的场景下尤为重要。尽管传统方法与基于学习的方法均取得了一定成效，但多数现有方法缺乏常识理解能力，并且通常仅针对单机器人设计，导致在复杂环境中的效率与鲁棒性受限。
为克服上述局限，本文提出 Co-NavGPT，一种将视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）作为全局规划器的全新框架，实现具备常识推理能力的多机器人视觉目标导航。Co-NavGPT 将来自多个具有不同视角的机器人子地图融合为统一的全局地图，并编码机器人状态与前沿区域信息。VLM 基于这些信息为多机器人分配探索前沿，使其能够进行协调、高效的环境探索。
在 Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) 基准中的实验结果表明，Co-NavGPT 在成功率和导航效率方面均显著优于现有方法，并且无需执行任务特定训练。消融研究进一步验证了来自 VLM 的语义先验的重要性。我们还在真实场景中使用 Unitree Go2 四足机器人对该框架进行了验证。
补充视频与代码可在以下页面获取：
https://sites.google.com/view/co-navgpt2
Visual target navigation is a critical capability for autonomous robots operating in unknown environments, particularly in human-robot interaction scenarios. While classical and learning-based methods have shown promise, most existing approaches lack common-sense reasoning and are typically designed for single-robot settings, leading to reduced efficiency and robustness in complex environments. To address these limitations, we introduce Co-NavGPT, a novel framework that integrates a Vision Language Model (VLM) as a global planner to enable common-sense multi-robot visual target navigation. Co-NavGPT aggregates sub-maps from multiple robots with diverse viewpoints into a unified global map, encoding robot states and frontier regions. The VLM uses this information to assign frontiers across the robots, facilitating coordinated and efficient exploration. Experiments on the Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) demonstrate that Co-NavGPT outperforms existing baselines in terms of success rate and navigation efficiency, without requiring task-specific training. Ablation studies further confirm the importance of semantic priors from the VLM. We also validate the framework in real-world scenarios using quadrupedal robots Unitree Go2. Supplementary video and code are available at: https://sites.google.com/view/co-navgpt2.
Runtime Learning Machine
运行时学习机
本文提出了一种面向安全关键型学习增强型信息物理系统（CPS）的运行时学习机（runtime learning machine）。该学习机由三个交互式组件构成：高性能学生体（High-Performance Student, HP-Student）、高可信教师体（High-Assurance Teacher, HA-Teacher）以及协调器（Coordinator）。
HP-Student 是一种具有高性能但尚未完全验证的 Phy-DRL（physics-regulated deep reinforcement learning） 智能体，其在真实 CPS 中基于实时传感器数据执行在线学习。然而，相比之下，HA-Teacher 是一个经过形式化验证但模型更为简化的安全控制器，专注于系统中的关键安全职能。作为补充机制，HA-Teacher 的创新体现在其提供的两类实时“补丁”：
i) 纠正 HP-Student 的不安全学习行为；
ii) 作为安全兜底控制策略的实时备份。
协调器负责管理 HP-Student 与 HA-Teacher 之间的交互逻辑。凭借这三个组件的协作，运行时学习机具备如下显著特性：
i) 确保系统全生命周期安全（即在任何在线学习阶段均可提供安全保证）；
ii) 具备应对未知未知（unknown unknowns）的能力；
iii) 有效弥合 Sim2Real 差距；
iv) 实现自动化分层学习（先安全学习，再性能学习）。
我们在倒立摆系统，以及两个四足机器人平台（真实的 Unitree A1 四足机器人与 NVIDIA Isaac Gym 中的仿真四足机器人）上进行了实验，并与先进的安全强化学习方法、容错强化学习方法以及应对 Sim2Real 差距的方案进行了对比。结果表明，该运行时学习机在安全性、鲁棒性以及真实部署能力方面均展现出独特优势与显著效果。
This paper proposes the runtime learning machine for safety-critical learning-enabled cyber-physical systems (CPS). The learning machine has three interactive components: a high-performance (HP)-Student, a high-assurance (HA)-Teacher, and a Coordinator. The HP-Student is a high-performance but not fully verified Phy-DRL (physics-regulated deep reinforcement learning) agent that performs runtime learning in real CPS, using real-time sensor data from real-time physical environments. On the other hand, HA-Teacher is a verified but simplified design, focusing on safety-critical functions only. As a complementary, HA-Teacher’s novelty lies in real-time patch for two missions: i) correcting unsafe learning of HP-Student, and ii) backing up safety. The Coordinator manages the interaction between HP-Student and HA-Teacher. Powered by the three interactive components, the runtime learning machine notably features i) assuring lifetime safety (i.e., safety guarantee in any runtime learning stage), ii) tolerating unknown unknowns, iii) addressing Sim2Real gap, and iv) automatic hierarchy learning (i.e., safety-first learning, and then high-performance learning). Experiments involving a cart-pole system and two quadruped robots, a real A1 quadruped robot, and a quadruped robot in NVIDIA Isaac Gym, as well as comparisons with state-of-the-art safe DRL, fault-tolerant DRL, and approaches for addressing Sim2Real gap, demonstrate the learning machine’s effectiveness and unique features
eGAIT Multi-Skilled Policy for Energy-efficient Gait Transitions
eGAIT 多技能策略，实现节能步态转换
为实现自主四足机器人在复杂环境中的高效运行，具备自适应、多技能与节能的运动能力至关重要。本文提出 eGAIT，一种统一的多技能运动策略，能够在九种非单调、速度最优的步态之间进行节能且稳定的切换，以响应动态变化的速度指令。
该框架采用融合 模型驱动 与 学习驱动 的混合控制架构，覆盖完整的四足运动控制流程。首先，基于 MPC 的步态生成器为不同速度段生成最优步态轨迹；随后，利用带有对抗性运动先验（AMP）风格奖励的 近端策略优化（PPO） 模仿学习这些轨迹，从而获得针对不同速度区间的专用策略。
为了将这些策略整合为一个统一系统，eGAIT 引入了分层强化学习（HRL）结构，并设计了一种改进的 深度 Q 网络（eDQN），用于实时完成从速度指令到具体策略的映射。一个辅助的选择器层进一步提升了训练效率，引导速度与策略的匹配，而稀疏激活的稳定性奖励则通过几何与旋转稳定性约束确保步态切换过程平滑可靠。
eGAIT 在仿真与 Unitree Go1 实机上均进行了广泛验证，实现了速度到策略映射 100% 的成功率，能量效率提升 35%，而速度跟踪与稳定性相比当前最优方法均提升 31%。该研究推动了自主四足机器人运动控制的发展，使其在动态环境中实现更长时长、更高效率与更高稳定性的运动表现。

Achieving adaptive, multi-skilled, and energyefficient locomotion is vital for advancing the operation of autonomous quadrupedal systems. This study presents eGAIT, a unified multi-skilled policy enabling energy-efficient and stable gait transitions across nine non-monotonic, velocity-optimized gaits, in response to dynamic velocity commands. The framework leverages a hybrid control architecture that integrates modelbased and learning-based methods to address the entire locomotion pipeline. An MPC-based gait generator produces velocityoptimized trajectories, which are imitated through Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), driven by a Adversarial Motion Prior (AMP) style reward to train distinct policies for specific velocity ranges. These policies are unified through a Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) framework featuring a novel modified Deep Q-Network (eDQN) for real-time velocity-to-policy mapping. Training efficiency is enhanced by an auxiliary selector layer that guides velocity-policy mapping, while a sparsely activated stability reward mechanism ensures smooth gait transitions by incorporating geometric and rotational stability. Extensively validated in simulation and on a Unitree Go1 robot, eGAIT achieves a 100% success rate in velocity-to-policy mapping, a 35% improvement in energy efficiency, a 31% improvement in both velocity tracking and stability compared to the next best state-of-the-art method. This work advances autonomous quadrupedal locomotion, enabling longer, more efficient, and stable operations in dynamic environments. Supplementary materials and visualizations related to the paper can be found at: https://github.com/RPL-CS-UCL/egait/.
LILO: Light Detection and Ranging, Inertial and Leg Odometry Combined Simultaneous Localization and Mapping Based on Kalman Filter for Legged Robots
LILO：基于卡尔曼滤波器的腿式机器人光探测测距、惯性测距和腿部里程计组合同步定位与建图
移动机器人的同时定位与建图（SLAM）性能受多种因素影响，包括算法设计、传感器配置以及移动平台本身的特性等。与轮式机器人相比，在相同的算法与传感器条件下，腿式机器人往往表现出较弱的 SLAM 性能，其根本原因在于不稳定的腿式步态会引发机体振动，从而对传感器数据采样产生不利影响。为解决这一问题，本文提出一种改进的 激光—惯性—足端里程计（LILO） 算法，在因子图框架下紧耦合激光雷达（LiDAR）、惯性测量单元（IMU）与足端里程计预积分因子。
该算法利用 IMU 与足端里程计提供无漂移的运动先验，激光雷达则提供环境结构约束，所有测量信息通过卡尔曼滤波与 GTSAM（Georgia Tech Smoothing and Mapping） 中的非线性优化进行融合。本文的实验平台为 Unitree Go1 四足机器人，并在轮式与腿式平台上对多种激光 SLAM 与视觉 SLAM 算法进行了对比验证。
实验结果表明，所提出的 LILO 框架能够有效抑制由腿式运动带来的振动噪声，使四足机器人在复杂环境中实现稳定可靠的 SLAM 性能，其整体建图精度达到 4.6% 的平均相对绝对误差（MRAE），显著优于标准的单一传感器方法及不考虑腿式特性的融合方案。
The Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) performance of a mobile robot is affected by many factors, including the algorithm, sensor scheme and mobile platform, etc. Compared with wheeled robots, the SLAM performance of legged robots is weak with the same algorithm and sensor configurations since the unstable legged locomotion leads to the body vibration, which is unfavorable to the data sampling of sensors. To address this issue, we propose an improved LiDAR-Inertial-Leg Odometry (LILO) algorithm that tightly couples light detection and ranging (LiDAR), inertial measurement unit (IMU), and leg odometry pre-integration factors within a factor graph framework. The algorithm leverages IMU and leg odometry information for drift-free motion priors while LiDAR provides structural constraints, and all measurements are fused through Kalman filtering and nonlinear optimization in Georgia Tech Smoothing and Mapping (GTSAM). The experimental platform employed in this study is the Go1 quadruped robot. The Laser SLAM and visual SLAM with different algorithm are compared on wheeled and legged robots, and comparative experiments demonstrate that the proposed LILO framework effectively mitigates the impact of vibrational noise, enabling a legged robot to achieve reliable SLAM with an overall mapping accuracy of 4.6% mean relative absolute error in challenging environments, significantly outperforming standard single-sensor and leg-agnostic fusion approaches.
RGB-Based Staircase Detection for Quadrupedal Robots: Implementation and Analysis
基于RGB的四足机器人楼梯检测：实现与分析
在本文中，我们提出了一种适用于多种平台（包括真实四足机器人）的楼梯检测算法。该方法能够实时识别危险情况，例如靠近楼梯等，从而保证机器人能够安全移动。我们的研究基于一台运动中的四足机器人采集的数据，共包含 18 组序列、超过 26,000 张由两个不同视角摄像头采集的彩色图像。
为解决楼梯检测的挑战，我们采用了以 RGB 图像为输入的深度神经网络进行目标检测，并结合预处理和后处理步骤进行性能优化。该方法的一大特点是对不同摄像头视角具有良好的适应性，包括机器人前置与底部视角。训练过程中同时使用来自两种视角的多摄像头图像，从而增强了模型的泛化能力。
我们在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人以及其他嵌入式平台上部署并验证了该算法。使用仅基于单个序列训练的 YOLO v11n 网络，并在另外 17 个序列上进行测试，最终在仅包含楼梯的图像上获得了平均 mAP@50 为 51.30，在全部图像上的 mAP@50 为 87.56。该方法能够在机器人进行楼梯导航时实现早期危险检测。
我们设计的评估方案重点考察模型从单一训练序列向多个未见序列的适应能力，从而拓展了现有四足机器人楼梯检测方法的适用范围。由于机器人的特殊视角与有限的实时处理能力，数据集中楼梯外观变化较大，也进一步体现了模型在复杂条件下的鲁棒性。
In this paper, we present a stair detection algorithm verified on various platforms, including a real quadruped robot. The proposed approach detects dangerous situations, such as proximity to stairs, in real time, enabling the robot to move safely. In our research, we utilized data collected by a moving four-legged robot, recorded in 18 sequences containing more than 26,000 color images from two cameras positioned at different perspectives. To address the challenge, we utilize a deep neural network with RGB inputs for object detection, complemented by preprocessing, and post-processing. A key feature of this approach is its adaptability to varying camera views, including both front and bottom perspectives on the robot, with training that incorporates multi-camera images from both views. We implemented and tested this algorithm on the Unitree Go1 robot, as well as on other embedded platforms. Using the trained YOLO version 11n network on a single sequence and testing on 17 sequences, we achieved an average mAP@50 of 51.30 for images containing only stairs and 87.56 for all images. This method enables early hazard detection during stair navigation. The proposed evaluation scenario tests the model’s adaptation from a single training sequence to multiple unseen sequences, extending existing stair detection methods for quadrupedal robots. The dataset presents high variability in stair appearance due to the robot’s perspective and limited real-time processing capacity.
Learning and Reconstruction of Mobile Robot Trajectories with LSTM Autoencoders: A Data-Driven Framework for Real-World Deployment
基于LSTM自编码器的移动机器人轨迹学习与重构：面向实际部署的数据驱动框架
在移动机器人领域，准确的轨迹学习与重建始终是一项核心挑战，特别是在存在传感器噪声、漂移以及数据不完整等不确定因素的环境中。解决这一问题对于真实场景下的机器人互联网（IoRT）系统中的可靠导航与运动控制至关重要。本文提出了一种基于 LSTM 自编码器的、用于移动机器人轨迹学习与重建的数据驱动框架。
轨迹数据来自仿真环境和 Unitree GO1 四足机器人真实实验，并通过归一化、序列填充以及轨迹边界标记等步骤进行预处理，再用于训练循环神经网络模型。所提出的模型架构采用双向 LSTM 层，并设计了结合重建误差、速度约束和边界约束的自定义损失函数，以提升轨迹重建的稳定性。
实验结果表明，该方法在仿真与真实数据上的重建精度均表现稳定。在最复杂的轨迹上，位置 RMSE 从 0.92 m 降至 0.60 m，偏航角 MAE 从 0.49 rad 降至 0.17 rad。当前的评估在受控的室内环境以及离线模式下进行，这也限定了本研究的验证范围。未来工作将扩展至更大、更加多样化的环境，并探索基于注意力机制、传感器融合以及在线学习等拓展方向，以进一步提升其在真实场景中的适应性。
Accurate trajectory learning and reconstruction represent a core challenge in mobile robotics, particularly in environments affected by sensor noise, drift, and incomplete data. Addressing this challenge is essential for reliable navigation and motion control in real-world Internet of Robotic Things (IoRT) systems. This paper presents a data-driven framework for learning and reconstructing mobile robot trajectories using LSTM autoencoders. Trajectory data were collected from both simulation and real-world experiments with a Unitree GO1 quadruped robot, preprocessed through normalization, sequence padding, and trajectory boundary flags, and then used to train recurrent neural network models. The proposed architecture employs bidirectional LSTM layers and a custom loss function combining reconstruction, velocity, and boundary terms to improve trajectory stability. Experimental results show stable reconstruction accuracy across simulated and real-world datasets, with the position RMSE reduced from 0.92 m to 0.60 m and the yaw MAE improved from 0.49 rad to 0.17 rad on the most complex trajectory. The evaluation was conducted in controlled indoor conditions and offline mode, which defines the current scope of validation. Future work will extend the analysis to larger and more diverse environments and investigate extensions such as attention mechanisms, sensor fusion, and online learning to enhance adaptability in real-world deployment.
Platform-Agnostic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Safe Exploration of Cluttered Environments with Graph Attention
基于图注意力机制的平台无关强化学习框架，用于在杂乱环境中安全探索
在障碍物密集环境中实现自主探索，需要在确保效率的同时，对碰撞风险提供可靠的安全保障。本文提出了一种与平台无关的强化学习框架，将基于图神经网络的路径点选择策略与安全过滤器相结合，以实现高效且安全的自主探索。
具体而言，图神经网络策略通过近端策略优化（PPO）算法进行训练，以最大化探索效率，同时尽量减少安全过滤器的干预。当策略给出的动作不可行时，安全过滤器会将其替换为最接近的可行动作，从而保证系统行为的一致性。此外，本文设计了一种由势场引导的奖励函数，该函数综合考虑智能体与未探索区域的距离以及到达这些区域所期望获得的信息量。
所提出的框架兼具强化学习策略的自适应性与显式安全机制的可靠性，这一特性对于在真实环境中部署学习型策略具有关键意义。在仿真环境与真实实验室环境中的大量评估结果表明，该方法能够在复杂空间中实现高效且安全的探索。为了验证策略在真实场景中的性能，本文将整个框架在 ROS 2（Humble Hawksbill）中实现，并部署于 Unitree Go1 四足机器人平台。
Autonomous exploration of obstacle-rich spaces requires strategies that ensure efficiency while guaranteeing safety against collisions with obstacles. This paper investigates a novel platform-agnostic reinforcement learning framework that integrates a graph neural network-based policy for nextwaypoint selection, with a safety filter ensuring safe mobility. Specifically, the neural network is trained using reinforcement learning through the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm to maximize exploration efficiency while minimizing safety filter interventions. Henceforth, when the policy proposes an infeasible action, the safety filter overrides it with the closest feasible alternative, ensuring consistent system behavior. In addition, this paper introduces a reward function shaped by a potential field that accounts for both the agent’s proximity to unexplored regions and the expected information gain from reaching them. The proposed framework combines the adaptability of reinforcement learning-based exploration policies with the reliability provided by explicit safety mechanisms. This feature plays a key role in enabling the deployment of learningbased policies on robotic platforms operating in real-world environments. Extensive evaluations in both simulations and experiments performed in a lab environment demonstrate that the approach achieves efficient and safe exploration in cluttered spaces. To evaluate the trained policy in real environment, the proposed framework was implemented in ROS 2 (Humble Hawksbill) and deployed on a Unitree Go1 quadruped robot.
Adaptive Gait Pattern Switching under External Disturbances Using Multi-Modal MPC
基于多模态模型预测控制的外部干扰下自适应步态模式切换
本研究提出了一种能够对外部作用力作出响应的四足机器人步态选择策略。与传统控制器不同，我们的方法直接利用外部力信息，并据此自适应地调整机器人的步态模式。为同时求解并比较多种步态类型，本文提出了一种多模态模型预测控制（MPC）框架。该框架能够在实时条件下动态调整四种典型步态——小跑（trotting）、腾跃（bounding）、侧步（pacing）和行走（walking）——以及它们对应的触地时间。
我们在仿真与真实环境中（基于 Unitree Go1 机器人）进行了对比实验，结果验证了所提出的方法能够在实时条件下根据外部力变化有效调整步态模式。实验表明，该策略显著提升了机器人在与外界环境交互时的抗扰动能力，从而大幅增强其运行性能与稳定性。
This study presents the development of a gait selection strategy for quadrupedal robots capable of responding to external forces. Unlike traditional controllers, our approach directly utilizes information about external forces and introduces a strategy to adapt the robot’s gait patterns accordingly. To simultaneously solve and compare various gait types, we propose a multimodal Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework. This framework dynamically adjusts four distinct gaitstrotting, bounding, pacing, and walking—as well as the contact time with the ground in real-time. Comparative analysis is performed in simulation and realworld experiments using a Unitree Go1, and we verified that the proposed method effectively adapts the gait pattern in real time to repond to external forces. The results demonstrate that this approach improves the robot’s ability to withstand disturbances while interacting with external environments, significantly enhancing operational performance and stability.
Bootstrapped LLM Semantics for Context-Aware Path Planning
基于自举的LLM语义用于上下文感知路径规划
利用自然语言（NL）对机器人进行指令输入的研究，多集中于“执行什么任务”（如目标选择、技能序列规划），而较少关注“如何在语义丰富、以人为中心的环境中安全且高效地执行任务”。本研究填补了这一空白，提出了一个框架，将大型语言模型（LLM）转化为一种随机语义传感器，其输出能够动态调节经典规划器的行为。
在给定文本提示与语义地图的情况下，我们从 LLM 中采样多组关于“危险”程度的判断，并通过贝叶斯自助法（Bayesian bootstrap）近似各类别风险的后验分布。基于该后验统计量，我们构建一个势能代价函数，从而形成路径规划问题。通过在模拟环境与基于建筑信息模型（BIM）的数字孪生系统中的评估，我们的方法能够根据明确的语言提示以及隐含的上下文信息自适应地调整机器人的运动方式。
在真实实验中，我们使用 Unitree Go1 机器人，其会根据 BIM 提供的路径进行跟踪执行。我们给出了定性与定量的实验结果。
Prompting robots with natural language (NL) has largely been studied as what task to execute (goal selection, skill sequencing) rather than how to execute that task safely and efficiently in semantically rich, human-centric spaces. We address this gap with a framework that turns a large language model (LLM) into a stochastic semantic sensor whose outputs modulate a classical planner. Given a prompt and a semantic map, we draw multiple LLM “danger” judgments and apply a Bayesian bootstrap to approximate a posterior over per-class risk. Using statistics from the posterior, we create a potential cost to formulate a path planning problem. Across simulated environments and a BIM-backed digital twin, our method adapts how the robot moves in response to explicit prompts and implicit contextual information. We use a Unitree Go1 for the real-world experiment; the model will track its calculated path given the BIM. We present qualitative and quantitative results.
Dual-MPC Footstep Planning for Robust Quadruped Locomotion
用于稳健四足动物运动的双模型预测控制步态规划
在本文中，我们提出了一种基于模型预测控制（MPC）的足端规划策略，通过优化落脚位置，使机器人能够在存在非期望机体旋转时实现对机体姿态的稳健调节。传统的基于模型的运动控制方法通常依赖启发式策略或基于线性倒立摆模型（LIPM）的规划。这类方法在足端规划中通常仅考虑线速度，而忽略角速度，导致角动量只能通过地面反作用力（GRF）单独进行调节。
相比之下，本文提出的基于 MPC 的足端规划方法将角速度纳入优化过程，将角动量控制问题转换为一种双输入协同控制方式：即同时协调 GRF 与落脚位置，而非单独优化 GRF，从而提升跟踪性能。
我们构建了一个相互反馈的循环结构，使足端规划器与 GRF 的 MPC 互相利用对方的最优解，迭代更新落脚点与反作用力分布。借助最优解，机器人机体的振荡得以明显减少，并能够实现更长的支撑相与摆动相。
该方法在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上进行了验证，实验结果表明，所提出的规划策略可在多种地形上实现更稳健的运动性能，显著降低机体振荡，并有效延长支撑与摆动阶段。
In this paper, we propose a footstep planning strategy based on model predictive control (MPC) that enables robust regulation of body orientation against undesired body rotations by optimizing footstep placement. Model-based locomotion approaches typically adopt heuristic methods or planning based on the linear inverted pendulum model. These methods account for linear velocity in footstep planning, while excluding angular velocity, which leads to angular momentum being handled exclusively via ground reaction force (GRF). Footstep planning based on MPC that takes angular velocity into account recasts the angular momentum control problem as a dual-input approach that coordinates GRFs and footstep placement, instead of optimizing GRFs alone, thereby improving tracking performance. A mutual-feedback loop couples the footstep planner and the GRF MPC, with each using the other’s solution to iteratively update footsteps and GRFs. The use of optimal solutions reduces body oscillation and enables extended stance and swing phases. The method is validated on a Unitree Go1 quadruped robot, demonstrating robust locomotion with reduced oscillations, longer stance and swing phases across various terrains.
Virtual Traffic Lights for Multi-Robot Navigation Decentralized Planning with Centralized Conflict Resolution
用于多机器人导航的虚拟交通信号灯：分散式规划与集中式冲突解决
我们提出了一种融合分布式路径规划与集中式冲突消解的混合多机器人协作框架。在该方法中，每个机器人均可自主规划自身路径，并将规划结果共享给集中式节点。集中系统负责检测潜在冲突，并在发生冲突时仅允许其中一台机器人优先通行，同时指示其他机器人停在冲突区域之外，以避免产生死锁。
与传统的集中式规划方法不同，本系统并不直接指定机器人的行驶路径，而是通过下达“停止”指令来进行调度，功能类似于虚拟交通信号灯。在多机器人仿真实验中，我们的方法提高了机器人到达目标点的成功率，同时有效减少了死锁情况的发生。
此外，我们在真实环境中分别使用两台 Unitree Go1 四足机器人以及轮式 Duckiebots 成功验证了该系统的可行性与有效性。
We present a hybrid multi-robot coordination framework that combines decentralized path planning with centralized conflict resolution. In our approach, each robot autonomously plans its path and shares this information with a centralized node. The centralized system detects potential conflicts and allows only one of the conflicting robots to proceed at a time, instructing others to stop outside the conflicting area to avoid deadlocks. Unlike traditional centralized planning methods, our system does not dictate robot paths but instead provides stop commands, functioning as a virtual traffic light. In simulation experiments with multiple robots, our approach increased the success rate of robots reaching their goals while reducing deadlocks. Furthermore, we successfully validated the system in real-world experiments with two Unitree Go1 quadruped robots and separately with wheeled Duckiebots.
RoboAuditor-LLM: A Robotic System for Energy Auditing via a Large Language Model and an Actionable Semantic Feature Map
RoboAuditor-LLM：一种基于大型语言模型和可操作语义特征图的能源审计机器人系统
建筑物在整体电力消耗中占据重要比例，随着需求不断增长，电力系统面临着愈发严重的高成本停电风险及安全隐患。然而，由于插电负载具有高度复杂性和可变性，它们在能源审计中的研究仍然不足，这在能源管理实践中形成了关键缺口。为应对这一问题，我们提出 RoboAuditor-LLM——一个用于室内环境能源审计初始阶段自动化的机器人系统，通过将人工检查员的指令转化为可由机器人执行的动作来完成任务。
RoboAuditor-LLM 包含三个核心模块：
LLM 规划器 ——解析人类指令并生成可执行的机器人动作；
可执行语义特征地图（Actionable Semantic Feature Map） ——提供静态物体的空间信息及其对应的目标位姿；
机器人工具箱（Robot Toolbox） ——提供多种下游技能，包括导航、设备计数以及设备状态验证。
RoboAuditor-LLM 充分利用开源基础模型的推理能力，以理解复杂的自然语言指令，并借助其代码生成能力，将自然语言转化为机器人可执行的程序指令。
我们在真实的机构办公环境中使用 Unitree Go1 四足机器人对系统进行了评估。实验结果显示：RoboAuditor-LLM 的设备定位平均成功率达到 76.91%，设备状态识别的 LLM 匹配评分达到 4.01（满分 5.00）。
Buildings signiﬁcantly contribute to electricity consumption, increasing the risk of costly blackouts and safety issues due to grow-ing demand. However, plug loads remain underexplored in energy audits due to their complexity and variability, highlighting a critical gap inenergy management practices. We propose RoboAuditor-LLM, a robotic system for automating initial steps of energy audits in indoor en-vironments, by translating human inspectors’ instruction into executable robot actions. RoboAuditor-LLM consists of three modules: a largelanguage model (LLM) planner for parsing human instructions and generating executable actions for robots, an Actionable Semantic FeatureMap for providing spatial information of static objects and corresponding goal poses, and a Robot Toolbox for providing diverse downstreamskills, including navigation, device counting, and device status veriﬁcation. RoboAuditor-LLM utilizes open-source foundation models’ rea-soning capacity for understanding complex human instructions, and coding ability for translating natural language into executable code forrobots. We evaluate RoboAuditor-LLM in real-world institutional ofﬁces using a Unitree Go1 quadruped robot. We achieve a 76.91% average success ratefor device localization and LLM-matched score of 4.01 (out of 5.00) for device status recognition.
Monocular Vision-Based Obstacle Height Estimation for Mobile Robot
基于单目视觉的移动机器人障碍物高度估计
为了使机器人能够在多样化的真实环境中稳健运行，可靠的障碍物感知至关重要，而这从根本上依赖于环境的深度信息。单目深度估计通过从单张 RGB 图像预测深度，为主动式传感器提供了一种轻量级替代方案。然而，由于缺乏充分的几何与光学线索，单目深度估计存在固有的深度歧义。为了解决这一问题，我们提出 R-Depth Net，一种利用距离相关的散焦模糊变化和光流作为互补深度线索的单目绝对深度估计网络。此外，基于 R-Depth Net 生成的深度图，我们设计了一种用于障碍物高度估计与可通行性评估的算法。
在真实环境中的实验结果表明，所提出的方法在 1.0–3.0 m 的测距范围内实现了 0.30 m 的 RMSE（15.7%） 和 0.26 m 的 MAE（15.7%）。在 0.10–0.20 m 的障碍物高度估计任务中，系统达到了 0.048 m 的 RMSE（29.3%） 和 0.040 m 的 MAE（26.4%）。最后，我们在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上进行了实时部署，结果表明所估计的深度与高度精度足以支持机载障碍物跨越的决策过程。
For a robot to operate robustly in diverse real-world environments, reliable obstacle perception is essential, which fundamentally requires depth information of the surrounding scene. Monocular depth estimation provides a lightweight alternative to active sensors by predicting depth from a single RGB image. However, due to the absence of sufficient geometric and optical cues, it suffers from inherent depth ambiguity. To address this limitation, we propose R-Depth Net, a monocular absolute depth estimation network that utilizes distance-dependent defocus blur variations and optical flow as complementary depth signals. Furthermore, based on the depth maps generated by R-Depth Net, we design an algorithm for obstacle height estimation and traversability assessment. Experimental results in real-world environments show that the proposed method achieves an average RMSE of 0.30 m (15.7%) and MAE of 0.26 m (15.7%) for distance estimation within the 1.0–3.0 m range. For obstacle height estimation in the range of 0.10–0.20 m, the system achieves an average RMSE of 0.048 m (29.3%) and MAE of 0.040 m (26.4%). Finally, real-time deployment on a unitree Go1 quadruped robot demonstrates that the estimated depth and height are sufficiently accurate to support on-board obstacle traversal decision-making.
Towards Senior-Robot Interaction: Reactive Robot Dog Gestures
迈向老年人与机器人的互动：反应式机器狗手势
随着全球人口老龄化趋势的加剧，越来越多的老年人面临孤独感问题。陪伴机器人被认为是一种具有潜力的解决方案。然而，现有陪伴机器人往往功能较为有限，而以任务执行为导向的机器人又缺乏面向社会交互的设计，这在一定程度上限制了其在老年群体中的适用性与接受度。
针对上述问题，本文提出了一种面向老年用户的四足机器人系统，在输入方式与输出表现两个方面同时提升其交互直观性与社会表达能力。在用户输入方面，我们实现了一个基于 MediaPipe 的手势与头部动作识别模块，使老年用户无需遥控器即可通过自然动作完成机器人控制。在输出方面，我们在 Isaac Gym 仿真环境中采用基于课程学习的强化学习方法，对机器狗的社会性手势进行设计与训练，训练过程由基础站立动作逐步扩展至三足平衡、抬腿与肢体伸展等复杂姿态。
仿真结果显示，该系统在多种手势任务上的平均成功率超过 95%。此外，我们在 Unitree 四足机器人上对关键社会性动作（如抬爪示意）进行了真实世界验证。实际实验表明，该框架在现实环境中具备良好的可行性与社会表现力，同时也暴露出若干 sim-to-real 挑战，包括关节柔顺性、载荷分配以及平衡控制等问题。
上述研究推动了面向老年人陪伴场景的实用型四足机器人的发展，并为后续的 仿真到现实迁移 与 用户研究设计提供了重要参考与研究方向。
As the global population ages, many seniors face the problem of loneliness. Companion robots offer a potential solution. However, current companion robots often lack advanced functionality, while task-oriented robots are not designed for social interaction, limiting their suitability and acceptance by seniors. Our work introduces a senior-oriented system for quadruped robots that allows for more intuitive user input and provides more socially expressive output. For user input, we implemented a MediaPipe-based module for hand gesture and head movement recognition, enabling control without a remote. For output, we designed and trained robotic dog gestures using curriculum-based reinforcement learning in Isaac Gym, progressing from simple standing to three-legged balancing and leg extensions, and more. The final tests achieved over 95% success on average in simulation, and we validated a key social gesture (the paw-lift) on a Unitree robot. Real-world tests demonstrated the feasibility and social expressiveness of this framework, while also revealing sim-to-real challenges in joint compliance, load distribution, and balance control. These contributions advance the development of practical quadruped robots as social companions for the senior and outline pathways for sim-to-real adaptation and inform future user studies.
MS-PPO: Morphological-Symmetry-Equivariant Policy for Legged Robot Locomotion
MS-PPO：腿式机器人运动的形态对称等变策略
近年来，强化学习在足式机器人运动控制方面取得了显著进展，使机器人具备了令人印象深刻的运动能力。然而，大多数现有策略网络在设计上对机器人形态结构与对称性缺乏建模，往往忽略具体的机构特性与形态对称约束，从而导致训练效率低下、泛化能力受限。
本文提出 MS-PPO，一种形态对称等变（morphological-symmetry-equivariant）的策略学习框架，将机器人的运动学结构与形态对称性直接编码进策略网络中。我们构建了一种形态感知的图神经网络架构，在理论上可证明其对机器人的形态对称群作用具有等变性，从而保证策略在对称状态下产生一致的控制响应，同时在价值函数估计中保持不变性。
这一设计避免了传统方法中为强制对称性而引入的繁琐奖励设计或高成本数据增强过程。我们在仿真环境中对 MS-PPO 进行了系统评估，实验对象包括 Unitree Go2 与 Xiaomi CyberDog2 足式机器人，涵盖小跑（trotting）、跳跃式行走（pronking）、坡地行走以及双足转向等多种运动任务，并进一步将学习到的策略成功部署到真实硬件平台。
大量实验结果表明，与当前最先进的基线方法相比，MS-PPO 在训练稳定性、对称性泛化能力以及样本效率方面均表现出显著优势，尤其是在具有挑战性的运动任务中表现尤为突出。这些结果表明，在策略学习中显式嵌入运动学结构与形态对称性，能够为足式机器人运动控制提供一种强有力的归纳偏置。
Reinforcement learning has recently enabled impressive locomotion capabilities on legged robots; however, most policy architectures remain morphology- and symmetryagnostic, leading to inefficient training and limited generalization. This work introduces MS-PPO, a morphological-symmetryequivariant policy learning framework that encodes robot kinematic structure and morphological symmetries directly into the policy network. We construct a morphology-informed graph neural architecture that is provably equivariant with respect to the robot’s morphological symmetry group actions, ensuring consistent policy responses under symmetric states while maintaining invariance in value estimation. This design eliminates the need for tedious reward shaping or costly data augmentation, which are typically required to enforce symmetry. We evaluate MS-PPO in simulation on Unitree Go2 and Xiaomi CyberDog2 robots across diverse locomotion tasks, including trotting, pronking, slope walking, and bipedal turning, and further deploy the learned policies on hardware. Extensive experiments show that MS-PPO achieves superior training stability, symmetry generalization ability, and sample efficiency in challenging locomotion tasks, compared to state-of-the-art baselines. These findings demonstrate that embedding both kinematic structure and morphological symmetry into policy learning provides a powerful inductive bias for legged robot locomotion control. Our code will be made publicly available at https://lunarlab-gatech.github.io/MS-PPO/.
Helpful DoggyBot: Open-World Object Fetching using Legged Robots and Vision-Language Models
Helpful DoggyBot：利用腿式机器人和视觉语言模型进行开放世界物体拾取
基于学习的方法已在四足机器人运动控制中取得了优异性能。然而，在需要与环境和人类进行交互的室内技能学习方面，四足机器人仍面临多项挑战，包括：缺乏用于操作的末端执行器、仅依赖仿真数据导致语义理解能力受限，以及在室内环境中机动性与可达性不足等问题。
本文提出了一套面向室内环境的四足移动操作系统。该系统在机器人前部集成了一个夹爪，用于完成物体操作任务；其底层控制器在仿真环境中利用第一人称深度感知进行训练，能够实现攀爬、全身倾斜等高机动性技能；在高层感知与决策方面，系统结合了预训练视觉–语言模型（VLMs），并融合第三人称鱼眼相机与第一人称 RGB 相机，实现语义理解与指令生成。
实验平台采用 Unitree Go2 四足机器人，并搭载一个定制设计的 3D 打印夹爪，该夹爪由 Dynamixel XM430-W350-T 伺服电机驱动。我们在两个此前从未见过的真实室内环境中对系统进行了评估，整个过程无需任何真实世界数据采集或再训练。实验结果表明，该系统具备零样本泛化能力，能够在新环境中完成复杂任务，例如根据用户指令，在攀爬越过一张双人床（queen-size bed）后，成功抓取随机放置的毛绒玩具，任务成功率达到 60%。
Learning-based methods have achieved strong performance for quadrupedal locomotion. However, several challenges prevent quadrupeds from learning helpful indoor skills that require interaction with environments and humans: lack of end-effectors for manipulation, limited semantic understanding using only simulation data, and low traversability and reachability in indoor environments. We present a system for quadrupedal mobile manipulation in indoor environments. It uses a front-mounted gripper for object manipulation, a lowlevel controller trained in simulation using egocentric depth for agile skills like climbing and whole-body tilting, and pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) with a third-person fisheye and an egocentric RGB camera for semantic understanding and command generation. We use a Go2 quadruped and a custombuilt 3D printed Gripper actuated by Dynamixel XM430-W350-T servo motor. We evaluate our system in two unseen environments without any real-world data collection or training. Our system can zero-shot generalize to these environments and complete tasks, like following user’s commands to fetch a randomly placed stuff toy after climbing over a queen-sized bed, with a 60% success rate.
MODEL-BASED DIFFUSION SAMPLING FOR PREDICTIVE CONTROL IN OFFLINE DECISION MAKING
基于模型的扩散采样在离线决策预测控制中的应用
离线决策学习要求在不再与环境交互的前提下，从固定数据集中合成可靠的行为策略。然而，现有的生成式方法往往会产生在动力学上不可行的轨迹，限制了其在实际系统中的应用。
为此，我们提出 MPDiffuser（Model Predictive Diffuser），一种可组合的、基于模型的扩散式决策框架，由以下三个核心模块组成：(i) 规划器（Planner），用于生成多样化且与任务目标一致的轨迹；(ii) 动力学模型（Dynamics Model），用于强制轨迹与底层系统动力学保持一致；(iii) 排序器（Ranker），用于从候选行为中筛选最符合任务目标的策略。
MPDiffuser 采用一种交替式扩散采样机制，在采样过程中交错执行规划器更新与动力学约束更新，从而逐步优化生成轨迹，使其在任务一致性与动力学可行性之间同时收敛。我们还从理论上对该过程给出了合理性解释，说明该方法如何在数据先验保真度与动力学一致性之间实现有效平衡。
在实验方面，这种模块化设计显著提升了样本效率，使得模型即使在低质量数据条件下也能有效学习系统动力学，并能够无缝适应新的动力学环境。我们在无约束离线决策基准（D4RL）和有约束离线决策基准（DSRL）上对 MPDiffuser 进行了系统评估，结果显示其在各项指标上均稳定优于现有方法。
此外，我们还进行了初步研究，将 MPDiffuser 扩展至基于视觉输入的控制任务，展示了其向高维感知输入扩展的潜力。最后，我们将该方法成功部署到真实的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上，验证了 MPDiffuser 在现实世界控制任务中的实用性与可行性。
Offline decision-making requires synthesizing reliable behaviors from fixed datasets without further interaction, yet existing generative approaches often yield trajectories that are dynamically infeasible. We propose Model Predictive Diffuser (MPDiffuser), a compositional model-based diffusion framework consisting of: (i) a planner that generates diverse, task-aligned trajectories; (ii) a dynamics model that enforces consistency with the underlying system dynamics; and (iii) a ranker module that selects behaviors aligned with the task objectives. MPDiffuser employs an alternating diffusion sampling scheme, where planner and dynamics updates are interleaved to progressively refine trajectories for both task alignment and feasibility during the sampling process. We also provide a theoretical rationale for this procedure, showing how it balances fidelity to data priors with dynamics consistency. Empirically, the compositional design improves sample efficiency, as it leverages even low-quality data for dynamics learning and adapts seamlessly to novel dynamics. We evaluate MPDiffuser on both unconstrained (D4RL) and constrained (DSRL) offline decision-making benchmarks, demonstrating consistent gains over existing approaches. Furthermore, we present a preliminary study extending MPDiffuser to vision-based control tasks, showing its potential to scale to high-dimensional sensory inputs. Finally, we deploy our method on a real Unitree Go2 quadrupedal robot, showcasing its practicality for real-world control.
Autonomous Construction-Site Safety Inspection Using Mobile Robots: A Multilayer VLM LLM Pipeline
利用移动机器人进行自主施工现场安全检查：多层VLM LLM管道
建筑施工安全检查目前仍主要依赖人工完成，而现有的自动化方法通常依赖任务专用数据集，在施工环境快速变化的背景下需要频繁重新训练，维护成本高昂。同时，基于机器人的现场安全巡检仍高度依赖人工遥操作与人工报告生成，劳动强度大、效率有限。
本文旨在将机器人在自主导航过程中所感知到的环境信息与施工现场通行的安全规范相连接，从而实现自动化的安全检查与报告生成。为此，我们提出了一种多层次框架，由机器人系统层与人工智能层两大模块组成。
在机器人系统层，系统通过 SLAM 与自主导航技术实现可重复的环境覆盖，并可通过航点机制对重点区域进行定点复访。在人工智能层，框架包含多个协同模块：首先，基于视觉–语言模型（Vision Language Model，VLM）的模块生成场景描述；随后，一个检索增强模块将这些描述与 OSHA 标准及施工现场安全规范进行语义对齐；接着，另一层基于 VLM 的模块依据相关规则对现场安全状况进行评估；最后，大语言模型（Large Language Model，LLM）在整合上述信息的基础上，自动生成结构化的安全检查报告。
我们通过一个概念验证（proof-of-concept）系统对该框架进行了验证，并在一个模拟常见施工隐患的实验室环境中，围绕三种典型场景进行了系统评估。实验结果表明，该方法在保持较高召回率的同时，精度表现可与当前最先进的闭源模型相媲美。
本文的主要贡献在于提出了一条透明且具有良好泛化能力的处理流水线：通过显式暴露各层的中间结果，使系统不再是不可解释的黑箱模型，并支持“人机协同（human-in-the-loop）”的工作模式。该框架为未来在建筑领域及其他应用场景中的拓展任务奠定了基础。
在系统实现方面，本文采用了一台四足机器人平台：Unitree Go2 Edu。该机器人内置 RGB 相机，并外接了一套 K1 机械臂以及一台 Robosense Helios32 激光雷达，用于支持多模态感知与自主巡检任务。
Construction safety inspection remains mostly manual, and automated approaches still rely on task-specific datasets that are hard to maintain in fast-changing construction environments due to frequent retraining. Meanwhile, field inspection with robots still depends on human teleoperation and manual reporting, which are labor-intensive. This paper aims to connect what a robot sees during autonomous navigation to the safety rules that are common in construction sites, automatically generating a safety inspection report. To this end, we proposed a multi-layer framework with two main modules: robotics and AI. On the robotics side, SLAM and autonomous navigation provide repeatable coverage and targeted revisits via waypoints. On AI side, a Vision Language Model (VLM)-based layer produces scene descriptions; a retrieval component powered grounds those descriptions in OSHA and site policies; Another VLM-based layer assesses the safety situation based on rules; and finally Large Language Model (LLM) layer generates safety reports based on previous outputs. The framework is validated with a proof-of-concept implementation and evaluated in a lab environment that simulates common hazards across three scenarios. Results show high recall with competitive precision compared to state-of-the-art closedsource models. This paper contributes a transparent, generalizable pipeline that moves beyond black-box models by exposing intermediate artifacts from each layer and keeping the human in the loop. This work provides a foundation for future extensions to additional tasks and settings within and beyond construction context. To implement the framework, this paper employed a quadruped robot with various attachments. This quadruped robot is a Unitree Go2 Edu that has a built-in RGB camera, and a K1 Robotic Arm and a Robosense Helios32 Lidar is attached to the robot.
Schrodinger’s Navigator: Imagining an Ensemble of Futures for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
薛定谔的导航器：为零样本物体导航设想一系列未来
零样本目标导航（Zero-Shot Object Navigation，ZSON）要求机器人在未见过的环境中，在不依赖预先构建地图或任务专用训练的情况下，定位并到达指定目标物体。然而，现有 ZSON 方法在真实且复杂的环境中往往表现受限，尤其是在存在严重遮挡、未知风险或目标物体动态移动的场景下。
为应对上述挑战，我们提出 薛定谔导航器（Schrödinger’s Navigator）——一种受薛定谔不确定性思想实验启发的导航框架。该框架将未观测空间视为一组可能的未来世界，并在执行动作前对这些可能性进行推理。具体而言，在给定第一人称视觉输入及三条候选轨迹的条件下，一个轨迹条件化的三维世界模型沿每条路径对未来观测进行想象，从而使智能体能够在无需额外绕行或密集全局建图的情况下，看见遮挡之后的区域并提前感知潜在风险。
生成的三维想象观测被融合进导航地图中，并用于更新价值图（value map）。这些更新引导策略选择能够规避遮挡、减少对不确定空间暴露、并更有效追踪动态目标的运动轨迹。
我们在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上，围绕三种具有挑战性的场景开展了实验评估，包括：严重的静态遮挡、未知风险区域以及动态移动目标。实验结果表明，在遮挡密集的环境中，薛定谔导航器在自定位精度、目标定位能力以及整体任务成功率等指标上，均持续优于多种具有代表性的 ZSON 基线方法。
这些结果充分证明了**轨迹条件化三维想象（trajectory-conditioned 3D imagination）**在实现鲁棒零样本目标导航中的有效性。
Zero-shot object navigation (ZSON) requires a robot to locate a target object in a previously unseen environment without relying on pre-built maps or task-specific training. However, existing ZSON methods often struggle in realistic and cluttered environments, particularly when the scene contains heavy occlusions, unknown risks, or dynamically moving target objects. To address these challenges, we propose Schrodinger’s Navigator ¨ , a navigation framework inspired by Schrodinger’s thought experiment on uncertainty. ¨ The framework treats unobserved space as a set of plausible future worlds and reasons over them before acting. Condi-tioned on egocentric visual inputs and three candidate trajectories, a trajectory-conditioned 3D world model imagines future observations along each path. This enables the agent to see beyond occlusions and anticipate risks in unseen regions without requiring extra detours or dense global mapping. The imagined 3D observations are fused into the navigation map and used to update a value map. These updates guide the policy toward trajectories that avoid occlusions, reduce exposure to uncertain space, and better track moving targets. Experiments on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot across three challenging scenarios, including severe static occlusions, unknown risks, and dynamically moving targets, show that Schrodinger’s Navigator consistently out- ¨ performs strong ZSON baselines in self-localization, object localization, and overall Success Rate in occlusion-heavy environments. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of trajectory-conditioned 3D imagination in enabling robust zero-shot object navigation.
Zero-Splat TeleAssist: A Zero-Shot Pose Estimation Framework for Semantic Teleoperation
Zero-Splat TeleAssist：一种用于语义遥操作的零样本姿态估计框架
我们提出 Zero-Splat TeleAssist，一种零样本的多传感器融合流水线，能够将普通的监控摄像头（CCTV）视频流转换为一个共享的 六自由度（6-DoF）世界模型，用于支持多方协同的远程操控（teleoperation）。该系统融合了视觉–语言分割、单目深度估计、加权 PCA 位姿提取以及 三维高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting，3DGS） 等技术，在无需使用标志物（fiducials）或深度传感器的情况下，为每位操作者实时提供多机器人在全局坐标系中的位置与姿态信息，实现以交互为中心的远程操控体验。
我们在真实实验室环境中对所提出的框架进行了系统评估，实验平台包括多种异构机器人：Boston Dynamics Spot（黄色四足机器人）、Unitree Go2（灰色小型四足机器人）以及 AgileX Hunter（轮式无人地面车）。实验采用顶部架设的 RGB 摄像头进行观测，分辨率为 1080p，帧率为 15 FPS。实验结果验证了 Zero-Splat TeleAssist 在多机器人协同远程操控场景中的有效性与实用性。
We introduce Zero-Splat TeleAssist, a zero-shot sensor-fusion pipeline that transforms commodity CCTV streams into a shared, 6-DoF world model for multilateral teleoperation. By integrating vision–language segmentation, monocular depth, weighted-PCA pose extraction and 3-D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), TeleAssist provides every operator with real-time global positions and orientations of multiple robots without fiducials or depth sensors in an interaction-centric teleoperation. We evaluated the proposed framework in a real-world laboratory environment using multiple heterogeneous robots - Boston Dynamics Spot (yellow quadruped), Unitree Go2 (small grey quadruped), and AgileX Hunter (wheeled UGV), under overhead RGB camera observation (1080p, 15 FPS).
ReSPIRe Informative and Reusable Belief Tree Search for Robot Probabilistic Search and Tracking in Unknown Environments
ReSPIRe：用于未知环境下机器人概率搜索和跟踪的信息丰富且可重用的信念树搜索
目标搜索与跟踪（Search and Tracking，SAT）是搜救、环境探索等多种机器人应用中的一项基础问题。本文针对先验目标信息严重不准确且传感视场受限的未知复杂环境，提出了一种信息驱动的轨迹规划方法 ReSPIRe，用于高效完成目标搜索与跟踪任务。
首先，我们提出了一种基于σ 点（sigma point）的近似方法，在非高斯信念分布条件下实现对互信息（Mutual Information，MI）奖励的快速而精确估计。该方法通过在状态空间与观测空间中进行信息采样，有效缓解了互信息积分计算的计算不可 tractability 问题。针对先验目标信息不足所带来的高度不确定性，ReSPIRe 引入了一种分层粒子结构，既能够提取用于全局路径引导的关键粒子，又能根据规划需求自适应调整粒子数量，从而在保证性能的同时提升规划效率。
在此分层结构基础上，我们进一步提出了一种**可复用信念树搜索（reusable belief tree search）**方法，用于不确定性条件下的在线轨迹规划。该方法通过复用 rollout 评估结果构建策略树，从而显著提升规划效率。
大量仿真与真实世界实验结果表明，ReSPIRe 在保持卓越计算效率的同时，相较于代表性基线方法，能够实现更小的互信息近似误差、更高的搜索效率以及更加稳定的跟踪性能。
为验证所提方法在不同机器人平台上的通用性，我们分别在室内环境中采用 TurtleBot4 轮式机器人进行实验，并在室外环境中使用 Unitree Go2 四足机器人开展实验，进一步证明了 ReSPIRe 的跨平台适用性。
Target search and tracking (SAT) is a fundamental problem for various robotic applications such as search and rescue and environmental exploration. This paper proposes an informative trajectory planning approach, namely ReSPIRe, for SAT in unknown cluttered environments under considerably inaccurate prior target information and limited sensing field of view. We first develop a novel sigma point-based approximation approach to fast and accurately estimate mutual information reward under non-Gaussian belief distributions, utilizing informative sampling in state and observation spaces to mitigate the computational intractability of integral calculation. To tackle significant uncertainty associated with inadequate prior target information, we propose the hierarchical particle structure in ReSPIRe, which not only extracts critical particles for global route guidance, but also adjusts the particle number adaptively for planning efficiency. Building upon the hierarchical structure, we develop the reusable belief tree search approach to build a policy tree for online trajectory planning under uncertainty, which reuses rollout evaluation to improve planning efficiency. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that ReSPIRe outperforms representative benchmark methods with smaller MI approximation error, higher search efficiency, and more stable tracking performance, while maintaining outstanding computational efficiency. To demonstrate the generalizability of the proposed method across different robotic platforms, we adopted a Turtlebot4 wheeled robot for indoor experiments and a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot for outdoor experiments.
Playful DoggyBot: Learning Agile and Precise Quadrupedal Locomotion
Playful DoggyBot：学习敏捷精准的四足运动
四足动物在与真实世界物体交互时，能够展现出敏捷而富有玩性的行为。例如，经过训练的犬类可以在飞盘落地之前完成追踪并将其捕获，而独自在家的猫也可能跃起抓住门把手。在高动态运动过程中成功抓取物体，对感知精度与控制能力提出了极高要求。然而，在机器人系统中，由于硬件条件的限制，运动敏捷性与操作精度往往难以兼得。
在本工作中，我们采用了一种感知–控制解耦的系统架构，并基于强化学习（Reinforcement Learning，RL），旨在探索四足机器人在高动态运动过程中与物体交互时所能达到的操作精度上限。实验结果表明，所使用的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人在机身前部安装了一个被动夹爪后，能够完成类似真实受训犬类的目标跟踪与捕获任务。
具体而言，该机器人可以追踪速度高达 3 m/s 的空中目标，并能够通过跳跃动作成功抓取位于其上方的小型物体：在仿真环境中可达到 1.05 m 的高度，在真实世界实验中可达到 0.8 m。这些结果表明，即使在硬件受限的条件下，通过合理的系统解耦设计与学习策略，四足机器人仍能够在高动态运动场景中实现高精度的物体交互。
Quadrupedal animals can perform agile and playful tasks while interacting with real-world objects. For instance, a trained dog can track and catch a flying frisbee before it touches the ground, while a cat left alone at home may leap to grasp the door handle. Successfully grasping an object during high-dynamic locomotion requires highly precise perception and control. However, due to hardware limitations, agility and precision are usually a trade-off in robotics problems. In this work, we employ a perception-control decoupled system based on Reinforcement Learning (RL), aiming to explore the level of precision a quadrupedal robot can achieve while interacting with objects during high-dynamic locomotion. Our experiments show that our Unitree Go2 quadrupedal robot, mounted with a passive gripper in front of the robot’s chassis, can perform both tracking and catching tasks similar to a real trained dog. The robot can follow a mid-air ball moving at speeds of up to 3m/s and it can leap and successfully catch a small object hanging above it at a height of 1.05m in simulation and 0.8m in the real world.
GuangMing-Explorer: A Four-Legged Robot Platform for Autonomous Exploration in General Environments
光明探索者：一种用于通用环境自主探索的四足机器人平台
自主探索是一项基础能力，紧密融合了感知、规划、控制与运动执行等多个关键环节，在室内目标搜索、极端环境建图以及资源勘探等广泛应用中发挥着重要作用。尽管上述各个组件在近年来均取得了显著进展，但对于一个完全自主探索系统而言，能够同时涵盖硬件与软件、并具备实践可行性的整体化系统描述仍然较为匮乏。
本文提出 GuangMing-Explorer，一套高度集成的自主探索平台，旨在在多样化环境中实现稳定、可靠的自主运行。我们对系统架构进行了全面阐述，涵盖硬件设计、软件栈构成、算法部署方式以及实验配置等关键方面。
大量真实世界实验结果表明，该平台在执行自主探索任务时展现出良好的有效性与效率，凸显了其在复杂、非结构化环境中进行实际部署的潜力。本文所提出的自主探索平台基于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人构建，为面向真实应用的自主探索系统提供了一套完整且可复现的解决方案。
Autonomous exploration is a fundamental capability that tightly integrates perception, planning, control, and motion execution. It plays a critical role in a wide range of applications, including indoor target search, mapping of extreme environments, resource exploration, etc. Despite significant progress in individual components, a holistic and practical description of a completely autonomous exploration system, encompassing both hardware and software, remains scarce. In this paper, we present GuangMing-Explorer, a fully integrated autonomous exploration platform designed for robust operation across diverse environments. We provide a comprehensive overview of the system architecture, including hardware design, software stack, algorithm deployment, and experimental configuration. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate the platform’s effectiveness and efficiency in executing autonomous exploration tasks, highlighting its potential for practical deployment in complex and unstructured environments.
