Our exploration platform is built upon the Unitree Go2 robot.
Playing with Robots: Performing Arts Techniques for Designingand Understanding Robot Group Movement
与机器人玩耍：设计和理解机器人群体运动的表演艺术技巧
本文提出了一种源自表演艺术的形式化设计方法，用于设计机器人群体行为。在第一项实验中，我们采用参与式设计（participatory design）方法，与专业演员、导演以及非专业参与者合作，共同识别并归纳了常见的群体行为模式。
在随后的工作室研究中，我们系统性地识别出 12 种典型的群体运动模式，并将其转化为表演脚本，同时构建了一个用于支撑表演过程的比例模型，并在工作室条件下邀请一位资深演员对这些模式进行了评估。在第三项实验中，我们通过一项包含 20 名志愿者的用户研究，对上述经细化的模型进行了进一步验证。
基于情感环模型（affective circumplex）的分析结果表明，这些群体运动模式能够引发用户的积极情绪反应；同时，即使在没有任何先验训练的情况下，参与者在识别不同运动模式方面的表现也显著高于随机猜测水平。基于这些实验结果，我们提出了一系列面向社交机器人的行为与运动设计准则，以提升机器人在交互过程中的整体可理解性。
上述运动模式均基于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台实现。该平台因其优越的运动能力，且在人机交互（HCI）领域中被广泛采用，为群体行为与社交运动研究提供了良好的实验基础。
In this work, we introduce a formal design approach derived fromthe performing arts to design robot group behaviour. In our frst experiment, we worked with professional actors, directors, andnon-specialists using a participatory design approach to identifycommon group behaviour patterns. In a follow-up studio work, weidentifed twelve common group movement patterns, transposedthem into a performance script, built a scale model to support theperformance process, and evaluated the patterns with a senior actorunder studio conditions. We evaluated our refned models with 20volunteers in a user study in the third experiment. Results fromour afective circumplex modelling suggest that the patterns elicitpositive emotional responses from the users. Also, participantsperformed better than chance in identifying the motion patternswithout prior training. Based on our results, we propose design guidelines for social robots’ behaviour and movement design toimprove their overall comprehensibility in interaction. Movement patterns were implemented using the Unitree Go2 platform as it is increasingly used in the HCI community and has superior locomotion capabilities.
A Unified Framework to Learn Collision-Free Loco-Manipulation via Adversarial Motion Priors
基于对抗性运动先验的无碰撞运动操控学习统一框架
在非结构化真实环境中设计全身控制器以实现同时移动与操作（loco-manipulation）仍是一项极具挑战性的任务。以往方法主要关注扩展机械臂工作空间的同时保持四足机器人的着陆姿态，但这些方法未能充分发挥足式机器人的机动能力。
为解决上述问题，本文提出了一套统一的真实环境下碰撞自由的 loco-manipulation 框架。该框架包含两个核心模块：
Loco-manipulation Motion Prior：通过轨迹优化（Trajectory Optimization, TO）生成 loco-manipulation 技能轨迹；
Collision-free Manipulation 模块：基于模型预测路径积分（Model Predictive Path Integral, MPPI）的轨迹生成器与向量化轨迹跟随器，实现碰撞规避的操作执行。
我们在仿真与真实环境中进行了大量实验，评估了该框架在轨迹跟踪精度、全身协调性以及工作空间扩展能力方面的表现。实验平台为12 自由度四足机器人 Unitree Go2与机械臂 Unitree D1 的集成系统，实现了高机动性下的全身运动与操作协同。
Designing a whole-body controller for loco-manipulation in unstructured real-world environments remains a formidable challenge. Previous approaches have primarily focused on extending the workspace of robotic arms while maintaining quadrupedal landing postures. However, these methods fail to fully exploit the mobility of legged robots. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework for collision-free loco-manipulation in real-world applications. The framework comprises two key modules: (1) a Loco-manipulation Motion Prior, which generates loco-manipulation skill trajectories via Trajectory Optimization (TO), and (2) a Collision-free Manipulation module using a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI)-based trajectory generator and a vector-based trajectory follower. Extensive experiments have been conducted in both simulation and real-world scenarios to evaluate our framework’s tracking accuracy, whole-body coordination, and workspace expansion capabilities. Supplementary and videos are available at: https://sites.google.com/view/loco-mani-amp/ Our robot system integrates a 12-DoF legged robot, the Unitree Go2, with a robotic arm, the Unitree D1.
REASAN: Learning Reactive Safe Navigation for Legged Robots
REASAN：腿式机器人的反应式安全导航学习
我们提出了一种新颖的模块化端到端框架，用于四足机器人在复杂动态环境中的实时反应式导航，仅依赖单个激光雷达（LiDAR）传感器。系统由四个在仿真中训练的模块组成：三条强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）策略分别负责运动控制、碰撞安全保护与导航，以及一个基于Transformer的外部感知估计器，用于处理原始点云输入。
这种对复杂足式运动控制任务的模块化分解，使网络结构可以保持轻量化且简单，同时可通过标准 RL 训练方法结合目标导向的奖励设计和课程学习（curriculum learning）进行训练，无需依赖启发式规则或复杂的策略切换机制。我们进行了全面的消融实验，验证了设计选择的有效性，并在具有挑战性的导航任务中展示了相较现有方法更高的鲁棒性。
最终的系统 REASAN（Reactive Safe Navigation） 实现了在单机器人和多机器人环境下的全机载实时反应式导航。训练与部署代码已开源，详见：
https://github.com/ASIG-X/REASAN
在真实部署中，我们将 REASAN 完全运行在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上，配备 Livox Mid-360 LiDAR 与 Jetson AGX Orin（64 GB），实现了端到端、高效的自主反应导航。
We present a novel modularized end-to-end framework for legged reactive navigation in complex dynamic environments using a single light detection and ranging (LiDAR) sensor. The system comprises four simulation-trained modules: three reinforcement-learning (RL) policies for locomotion, safety shielding, and navigation, and a transformer-based exteroceptive estimator that processes raw point-cloud inputs. This modular decomposition of complex legged motor-control tasks enables lightweight neural networks with simple architectures, trained using standard RL practices with targeted reward shaping and curriculum design, without reliance on heuristics or sophisticated policy-switching mechanisms. We conduct comprehensive ablations to validate our design choices and demonstrate improved robustness compared to existing approaches in challenging navigation tasks. The resulting reactive safe navigation (REASAN) system achieves fully onboard and real-time reactive navigation across both single- and multi-robot settings in complex environments. We release our training and deployment code at https://github.com/ASIG-X/REASAN We deploy REASAN fully onboard a Unitree Go2 robot equipped with a Livox Mid-360 LiDAR and a Jetson AGX Orin (64 GB).
Impact of Robot Facial-Audio Expressions on Human Robot Trust Dynamics and Trust Repair
机器人面部音频表情对人机信任动态和信任修复的影响
尽管近年来在建筑工程（AEC）行业的人机协作机器人领域取得显著进展，信任通常仍被视为静态因素，对其在协作过程中随事件变化的动态规律缺乏研究指导。本文探讨了机器人任务执行表现及其在结果发生后产生的情感表达如何塑造人类信任的动态变化。为此，我们设计了一项受控的被试内实验，包括两个与建筑施工相关的任务：物料运送（Material Delivery）——物理协助任务，以及信息采集（Information Gathering）——感知辅助任务。在每个任务中，参与者的信任水平被重复测量四次，使用14项人机交互信任感知量表（Trust Perception Scale for HRI），并结合重新委派任务的选择行为。机器人在实验中呈现两种多模态情感表达：“高兴”表达表示任务成功后的简短确认，“悲伤”表达表示任务失败后的致歉并请求再次尝试机会。实验在实验室环境中进行，共有30名参与者，机器人平台为Unitree Go2四足机器人，配备集成传感与可表达硬件。结果显示，任务成功显著提升信任，任务失败导致信任急剧下降，而基于道歉的情感表达能够部分恢复信任（Material Delivery恢复44%，Information Gathering恢复38%）。进一步的项目级分析表明，恢复的信任主要由交互与沟通因素驱动，能力因素部分恢复，自主性因素变化最小。此外，参与者的年龄和先前态度对信任动态具有调节作用：年轻参与者变化幅度大但持续时间短，中期20多岁参与者的信任修复最持久，年长参与者的信任动态最为保守。本研究为未来根据任务需求和用户特征自适应信任修复策略的开发提供基础，有助于支持机器人在施工现场的安全、有效部署与应用。
Despite recent advances in robotics and human-robot collaboration in the AEC industry, trust has mostly been treated as a static factor, with little guidance on how it changes across events during collaboration. This paper investigates how a robot’s task performance and its expressive responses after outcomes shape the dynamics of human trust over time. To this end, we designed a controlled within-subjects study with two construction-inspired tasks, Material Delivery (physical assistance) and Information Gathering (perceptual assistance), and measured trust repeatedly (four times per task) using the 14-item Trust Perception Scale for HRI plus a redelegation choice. The robot produced two multimodal expressions, a “glad” display with a brief confirmation after success, and a “sad” display with an apology and a request for a second chance after failure. The study was conducted in a lab environment with 30 participants and a quadruped platform, and we evaluated trust dynamics and repair across both tasks. Results show that robot success reliably increases trust, failure causes sharp drops, and apology-based expressions partially restores trust (44% recovery in Material Delivery; 38% in Information Gathering). Item-level analysis indicates that recovered trust was driven mostly by interaction and communication factors, with competence recovering partially and autonomy aspects changing least. Additionally, age group and prior attitudes moderated trust dynamics with younger participants showed larger but shorter-lived changes, mid-20s participants exhibited the most durable repair, and older participants showed most conservative dynamics. This work provides a foundation for future effortsthat adapt repair strategies to task demands and user profiles to support safe, productive adoption of robots on construction sites. To implement the study, we used a Unitree Go2 quadruped platform with integrated sensing and expressive hardware.
GuideNav: User-Informed Development of a Vision-Only Robotic Navigation Assistant For Blind Travelers
GuideNav：面向盲人旅行者的纯视觉机器人导航助手的用户反馈式开发
尽管在面向盲人及低视力（BLV）群体的移动辅助系统用户研究中取得了显著进展，但能够直接为机器人导航设计提供参考的研究仍然十分有限。为弥补这一空白，我们开展了一项全面的人类研究，包括对26名导盲犬使用者、4名白手杖使用者、9名导盲犬训练师及1名O&M培训师的访谈，并进行了超过15小时的导盲犬辅助步行观察。去标识化处理后，我们开源了该数据集，以促进以人为本的辅助系统开发和设计决策。基于这项基础研究的洞见，我们开发了 GuideNav，一种仅依赖视觉的“教学-重复”（teach-and-repeat）导航系统。受导盲犬训练及协助使用者方式的启发，GuideNav 可以让机器人自主重复由有视力的人演示的路径。具体而言，该系统构建了所教授路线的拓扑表示，结合视觉位置识别与时间滤波，并利用相对位姿估计器计算导航动作——整个过程无需依赖昂贵、笨重且耗电的传感器如LiDAR。实地测试表明，GuideNav 在五个户外环境中均能实现公里级的路径跟随，即使在教学与重复运行过程中场景明显变化，也能保持可靠性。针对3名导盲犬使用者和1名导盲犬训练师的用户研究进一步验证了系统的可行性，这也是我们所知的首个四足移动机器人系统以类似导盲犬的方式成功完成路径重现。系统基于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人 构建，并配备了刚性背带手柄，以实现与用户的刚性连接。
While commendable progress has been made in user-centric research on mobile assistive systems for blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals, references that directly inform robot navigation design remain rare. To bridge this gap, we conducted a comprehensive human study involving interviews with 26 guide dog handlers, four white cane users, nine guide dog trainers, and one O&M trainer, along with 15+ hours of observing guide dog–assisted walking. After de-identification, we open-sourced the dataset to promote human-centered development and informed decision-making for assistive systems for BLV people. Building on insights from this formative study, we developed GuideNav, a vision-only, teach-andrepeat navigation system. Inspired by how guide dogs are trained and assist their handlers, GuideNav autonomously repeats a path demonstrated by a sighted person using a robot. Specifically, the system constructs a topological representation of the taught route, integrates visual place recognition with temporal filtering, and employs a relative pose estimator to compute navigation actions—all without relying on costly, heavy, power-hungry sensors such as LiDAR. In field tests, GuideNav consistently achieved kilometerscale route following across five outdoor environments, maintaining reliability despite noticeable scene variations between teach and repeat runs. A user study with 3 guide dog handlers and 1 guide dog trainer further confirmed the system’s feasibility, marking (to our knowledge) the first demonstration of a quadruped mobile system retrieving a path in a manner comparable to guide dogs.Our system is built on the Unitree Go2 robot equipped with a rigid harness handle that allows a rigid connection with the user.
FALCON: Actively Decoupled Visuomotor Policies for Loco-Manipulation with Foundation-Model-Based Coordination
FALCON：基于基础模型协调的主动解耦视觉运动策略在运动操控中的应用
我们提出了 FALCON（FoundAtion-model-guided decoupled LoCO-maNipulation visuomotor policies），一个用于 loco-manipulation 的框架，将模块化扩散策略与视觉–语言基础模型结合，用作协调器。该方法显式地将**运动（locomotion）与操作（manipulation）**解耦为两个独立的视觉-运动策略，使每个子系统可以依赖自身观测，从而减轻单一策略在融合来自运动与操作的异质或潜在不匹配观测时造成的性能下降。我们的关键创新在于通过视觉–语言基础模型恢复这两个独立策略之间的协调性，该模型将全局观测与语言指令编码为共享的潜在嵌入，用于条件化两个扩散策略。
在此基础上，我们引入了一个阶段进度头（phase-progress head），利用任务阶段的文本描述推断离散阶段与连续进度估计，无需人工标注阶段标签。为了进一步结构化潜在空间，我们采用了协调感知对比损失（coordination-aware contrastive loss），显式编码机械臂动作与底盘动作之间的跨子系统兼容性。
我们在两个具有挑战性的 loco-manipulation 任务上评估了 FALCON，这些任务需要同时完成导航、末端执行器精确放置以及紧密的底盘–机械臂协调。结果表明，FALCON 不仅超过了集中式和去中心化的基线方法，还表现出更高的鲁棒性和对分布外场景的泛化能力。在真实机器人平台上，我们将解耦的视觉-运动策略及若干基线策略部署在由 Unitree Go2 四足机器人底盘与 Airbot 机械臂组成的四足移动操作平台上，验证了方法的可行性与有效性。
We present FoundAtion-model-guided decoupled LoCO-maNipulation visuomotor policies (FALCON), a framework for loco-manipulation that combines modular diffusion policies with a vision–language foundation model as the coordinator. Our approach explicitly decouples locomotion and manipulation into two specialized visuomotor policies, allowing each subsystem to rely on its own observations. This mitigates the performance degradation that arise when a single policy is forced to fuse heterogeneous, potentially mismatched observations from locomotion and manipulation. Our key innovation lies in restoring coordination between these two independent policies through a vision–language foundation model, which encodes global observations and language instructions into a shared latent embedding conditioning both diffusion policies. On top of this backbone, we introduce a phase-progress head that uses textual descriptions of task stages to infer discrete phase and continuous progress estimates without manual phase labels. To further structure the latent space, we incorporate a coordination-aware contrastive loss that explicitly encodes crosssubsystem compatibility between arm and base actions. We evaluate FALCON on two challenging loco-manipulation tasks requiring navigation, precise end-effector placement, and tight base-arm coordination. Results show that it surpasses centralized and decentralized baselines while exhibiting improved robustness and generalization to out-of-distribution scenarios. On the real robot platform, we deploy our decoupled visuomotor policy and several baseline policies on a quadruped mobile manipulator composed of a Unitree Go2 base and an Airbot robotic arm.
Real-DRL: Teach and Learn at Runtime
Real-DRL：运行时教学与学习
本文提出了 Real-DRL 框架，面向安全关键的自主系统，能够在实际物理系统（real plants）中实现深度强化学习（DRL）智能体的运行时学习，同时优先保障系统安全。Real-DRL 框架由三个交互组件组成：DRL-Student、PHY-Teacher 和 Trigger。其中，DRL-Student 是一个强化学习智能体，采用双重自学习与教学学习（teaching-to-learn）范式，结合实时的安全感知批量采样进行策略优化。PHY-Teacher 则基于物理模型设计动作策略，专注于安全关键功能，在实时环境中承担两项关键任务：一是支持 DRL-Student 的教学学习，二是保障实际系统的安全。Trigger 组件负责管理 DRL-Student 与 PHY-Teacher 之间的交互。
通过这三个交互组件，Real-DRL 能够有效应对来自未知因素和仿真到真实环境差距（Sim2Real gap）的安全挑战。此外，Real-DRL 的特点包括：i) 安全保障，ii) 自动层次学习（先安全学习，再高性能学习），iii) 安全感知批量采样，用于解决因边缘情况导致的学习经验不平衡问题。
我们在真实四足机器人、NVIDIA Isaac Gym 仿真四足机器人以及倒立摆系统上进行了实验，并通过对比实验与消融研究验证了 Real-DRL 的有效性和独特功能。在真实四足机器人实验中，我们使用了基于 Python 的开发框架，应用于 Unitree A1 四足机器人，成功展示了框架在实际系统中的安全、高效学习能力。
This paper introduces the Real-DRL framework for safety-critical autonomous systems, enabling runtime learning of a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agent to develop safe and high-performance action policies in real plants (i.e., real physical systems to be controlled), while prioritizing safety! The Real-DRL consists of three interactive components: a DRL-Student, a PHY-Teacher, and a Trigger. The DRL-Student is a DRL agent that innovates in the dual self-learning and teaching-to-learn paradigm and the real-time safety-informed batch sampling. On the other hand, PHY-Teacher is a physics-model-based design of action policies that focuses solely on safety-critical functions. PHY-Teacher is novel in its realtime patch for two key missions: i) fostering the teaching-to-learn paradigm for DRL-Student and ii) backing up the safety of real plants. The Trigger manages the interaction between the DRL-Student and the PHY-Teacher. Powered by the three interactive components, the Real-DRL can effectively address safety challenges that arise from the unknown unknowns and the Sim2Real gap. Additionally, Real-DRL notably features i) assured safety, ii) automatic hierarchy learning (i.e., safety-first learning and then high-performance learning), and iii) safety-informed batch sampling to address the learning experience imbalance caused by corner cases. Experiments with a real quadruped robot, a quadruped robot in NVIDIA Isaac Gym, and a cart-pole system, along with comparisons and ablation studies, demonstrate the Real-DRL’s effectiveness and unique features. In our real quadruped robot experiment, we used a Python-based framework developed for the Unitree A1 robot.
A Navigation System to Improve Quadruped Robot’s Autonomous Path Planning and Locomotion on Outdoor Construction Sites
一种用于提高四足机器人在户外建筑工地自主路径规划和运动能力的导航系统
户外施工现场因结构不规则、障碍物密集以及地面复杂多变，对四足机器人的自主导航提出了极大挑战。现有四足机器人导航系统在此类环境下的自主性仍然有限。为此，我们提出了一种框架，使四足机器人能够在非结构化的户外施工环境中实现自主路径规划与自适应运动。该框架包含两个核心模块：路径规划器和运动控制器。路径规划模块通过代价地图整合障碍信息和目标信息，计算最优路径；命令生成器则结合全局梯度与局部窗口最小化方法生成速度指令。为增强地形感知能力，我们设计了基于视觉的顾问模块，由地形分类器和绊倒风险检测器组成，并在施工场景特定的 RGB 图像上进行训练。运动控制模块采用强化学习，使四足机器人能够在施工现场实现自主、地形自适应的运动。我们基于真实施工场地的地形设计了渐进式学习课程（progressive curriculum），帮助机器人学习地形感知的步态。实验在仿真环境和真实户外环境中使用 Unitree A1 四足机器人 进行验证。仿真结果显示，机器人运动成功率达到 86.15%，导航性能相较基线方法显著提升，成功率达到 85.56%。
Outdoor construction sites pose significant challenges for the navigation of quadruped robots due
to their irregular structures, dense obstacles, and complex surface properties. Existing navigation
systems of quadruped robots exhibit limited autonomy in such environments. We introduced a
navigation framework that enables autonomous path planning and adaptive locomotion for
quadruped robots in unstructured outdoor construction environments. The framework consists of
two key components, which are a path planner and a locomotion controller. The path planning
module computes optimal paths using a cost map that integrated obstacle information and goal
information. The command generator then combines the global gradient and local window
minimization to produce velocity commands. To enhance terrain awareness, a vision-based advisor
composed of a terrain classifier and a tripping risk detector was trained on construction-specific
RGB images. The locomotion control module employs reinforcement learning to train the
quadruped robot for autonomous, self-adaptive locomotion on construction sites. We designed a
progressive learning curriculum based on realistic construction site terrains, which helped the robot
learn terrain-aware locomotion gaits. We validated our proposed framework on simulation and
outdoor environments on a Unitree A1 robot. In simulation, it achieved a locomotion success rate of 86.15%. The
navigation performance showed a significant improvement over the baseline method, achieving
an 85.56% success rate.
A Framework for Deploying Learning-based Quadruped Loco-Manipulation
基于学习的四足动物运动操控部署框架
四足移动操作机器人在实现灵活的运动—操作一体化（loco-manipulation）方面具有巨大潜力，但其控制难度高，且从仿真到现实的可靠迁移仍然面临挑战。强化学习（RL）在全身控制方面展现出良好前景，但现有框架多为封闭系统，难以在真实硬件上复现。本文提出了一套开放式流水线，用于在 Unitree B1 四足机器人搭载 Z1 机械臂的平台上训练、评测并部署基于强化学习的控制器。
该框架通过 ROS 统一了 仿真到仿真（sim-to-sim） 与 仿真到现实（sim-to-real） 的迁移流程：首先复现并训练基于 Isaac Gym 的策略，然后通过硬件抽象层将其扩展至 MuJoCo，最终将同一控制器直接部署到真实机器人上。仿真到仿真实验揭示了 Isaac Gym 与 MuJoCo 在接触模型上的差异及其对策略行为的影响；而真实环境下的遥操作抓取实验表明，协调的全身控制能够有效扩展操作范围，并在操作性能上显著优于浮动基座的基线方法。
该流水线为基于强化学习的运动—操作控制器的开发与分析提供了透明、可复现的基础框架，并将以开源形式发布，以支持未来相关研究的发展。
Quadruped mobile manipulators offer strong potential for agile loco-manipulation but remain difficult to control and transfer reliably from simulation to reality. Reinforcement learning (RL) shows promise for whole-body control, yet most frameworks are proprietary and hard to reproduce on real hardware. We present an open pipeline for training, benchmarking, and deploying RL-based controllers on the Unitree B1 quadruped with a Z1 arm. The framework unifies sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfer through ROS, re-implementing a policy trained in Isaac Gym, extending it to MuJoCo via a hardware abstraction layer, and deploying the same controller on physical hardware. Sim-to-sim experiments expose discrepancies between Isaac Gym and MuJoCo contact models that influence policy behavior, while real-world teleoperated object-picking trials show that coordinated whole-body control extends reach and improves manipulation over floating-base baselines. The pipeline provides a transparent, reproducible foundation for developing and analyzing RL-based loco-manipulation controllers and will be released open source to support future research.
Drift of the Uncharted: A Speculative Fiction About Rising Sea-Level Landscapes through Robotic Performance
未知的漂移：一部关于海平面上升景观的机器人表演科幻小说
未知的漂移以机器人表演结合扩展电影的形式呈现，融合气候预测与真实景观重建，构建了一个当代城市景观在未来海平面上升中被淹没的推想世界。一台搭载投影仪的四足机器人作为“救援机器人”，同时穿行于物理与虚拟空间之中，将被淹没的城市景观投射到展览空间。本研究探讨了推想叙事与机器人表演如何将气候变化这一超越传统时空尺度的“超物体”转化为可体验的形式，并通过将机器人定位为叙事主体，拓展了机器人艺术的可能性。硬件配置、追踪与投影系统包括：一台安装了 Vive Tracker 和机载投影仪的 Unitree Go1 机器人、一台控制计算机以及四个 Vive Base Station。
Drift of the Uncharted presents as a robotic performance in combi-nation with expanded cinema. It combines climate prediction andreal-world landscape reconstruction, revealing a speculative worldwhere contemporary urban landscapes experience future sea-levelrise. A quadruped robot with an onboard projector serves as arescue robot, simultaneously traversing both physical and virtualspaces, projecting the drowned cityscapes into the exhibition space.This research examines how speculative narrative and robotic per-formance mediate climate change—a hyperobject that transcendsconventional scales of space and time into an experiential form while simultaneously expanding robotic art by positioning the robotas a narrative agent. Hardware Configuration, Tracking and Projection: Tracking andProjection: The setup includes a Unitree Go1 robot fitted with aVive Tracker and an onboard projector, a control computer, and fourVive Base Stations.
Spatially-enhanced recurrent memory for long-range mapless navigation via end-to-end reinforcement learning
通过端到端强化学习实现空间增强型循环记忆在长距离无地图导航中的应用
近年来，机器人导航领域取得了显著进展，尤其是基于端到端学习的方法（如强化学习，RL）在效率和效果上表现突出。然而，成功的导航在本质上仍依赖于两项关键能力：建图与规划，无论它们是显式实现还是隐式完成。传统方法依赖显式建图流程，将自我中心视角的观测转换并配准为一致的地图供规划模块使用；而端到端学习方法通常通过循环神经网络（RNN）将当前与历史观测融合到潜在空间中，从而隐式地实现这一过程。尽管现有结构（如 LSTM 和 GRU）能够捕捉时间依赖关系，我们的研究发现其存在一个关键局限：缺乏有效的空间记忆能力，而这一能力对于将来自不同视角的连续观测进行变换与整合、并构建支持规划任务的空间表征至关重要。为此，我们提出了空间增强循环单元（Spatially-enhanced Recurrent Units，SRUs），这是一种对现有 RNN 的简单而有效的改进，可显著增强空间记忆能力。为进一步提升导航性能，我们设计了一种结合 SRU 的注意力机制网络结构，使机器人仅依靠单个前向双目相机即可实现远距离、无地图导航。同时，我们引入正则化技术，以促进基于强化学习的端到端循环网络的稳定训练。实验结果表明，与现有 RNN 相比，我们的方法在长距离导航任务上的整体性能提升了 23.5%。此外，引入 SRU 记忆后，该方法在需要长时程建图与记忆能力的多样化环境中，分别较两种 RL 基线方法（一种依赖显式建图，另一种依赖历史观测堆叠）实现了 29.6% 和 105.0% 的整体性能提升。最后，我们通过在大规模合成深度数据上的预训练来缓解仿真到现实的差距，实现了零样本迁移，可直接部署于复杂多样的真实环境中；在真实环境实验中，我们在搭载 RIVR 学习式运动控制策略的 Unitree B2W 机器人上完成了多项零样本迁移验证。
Recent advancements in robot navigation, particularly with end-to-end learning approaches such as reinforcement learning (RL), have demonstrated remarkable efficiency and effectiveness. However, successful navigation still fundamentally depends on two key capabilities: mapping and planning, whether implemented explicitly or implicitly. Classical approaches rely on explicit mapping pipelines to transform and register egocentric observations into a coherent map for the planning module. In contrast, end-to-end learning often achieves this implicitly—through recurrent neural networks (RNNs) that fuse current and historical observations into a latent space for planning. While existing architectures, such as LSTM and GRU, can capture temporal dependencies, our findings reveal a critical limitation: their inability to effectively perform spatial memorization. This capability is essential for transforming and integrating sequential observations from varying perspectives to build spatial representations that support planning tasks. To address this, we propose spatially-enhanced recurrent units (SRUs)—a simple yet effective modification to existing RNNs—that enhance spatial memorization. To improve navigation performance, we introduce an attention-based network architecture integrated with SRUs, enabling long-range mapless navigation using a single forward-facing stereo camera. Additionally, we employ regularization techniques to facilitate robust end-to-end recurrent training via RL. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves long-range navigation performance by 23.5% overall compared to existing RNNs. Furthermore, when equipped with SRU memory, our method outperforms both RL baseline approaches—one relying on explicit mapping and the other on stacked historical observations—achieving overall improvements of 29.6% and 105.0%, respectively, in diverse environments that require long-horizon mapping and memorization capabilities. Finally, we address the sim-to-real gap by leveraging large-scale pretraining on synthetic depth data, enabling zero-shot transfer for deployment across diverse and complex real-world environments. In real-world environments, we conduct several zero-shot transfer experiments, on a Unitree B2W robot with a learning-based locomotion policy from RIVR.
Pedipulation in Quadruped Robots Using a Heuristic Inverse Kinematics Solver
基于启发式逆运动学求解器的四足机器人步态分析
四足机器人具有广泛的应用前景，主要面向自主探索与监测任务。与此类机器人相关的研究主要集中在运动与操作两大方向。近年来，“足部操作”（pedipulation）这一新兴研究方向逐渐出现，即利用机器人的某一条肢体来执行操作任务，旨在赋予四足机器人接近生物体的灵巧性，并提升其在日常环境中与人类进行物理与社会互动的潜力。然而，足部操作在控制与协调层面面临显著挑战，这主要源于肢体自由度的受限以及充分挖掘其运动学能力所带来的复杂性。本文研究了将启发式逆运动学求解器集成到基于模型的任务优先级控制框架中，用于执行初级复杂度的足部操作任务。所提出的方法通过仿真研究与在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人平台上的真实实验得到了验证。
Quadruped robots have a wide range of application domains, primarily focused on autonomous exploration and monitoring tasks. Locomotion and manipulation represent the two principal research areas associated with this class of robots. Recently, pedipulation, which consists of executing manipulation tasks using one of the robot’s limbs, has emerged as a novel research direction, aiming to provide these robots with a level of dexterity comparable to that of their biological counterparts, while also enhancing their potential for physical and social interaction with humans in everyday environments. Performing pedipulation tasks presents considerable challenges in terms of control and coordination, primarily due to the limited degrees of freedom of the limbs and the complexity involved in fully exploiting their kinematic capabilities. This paper investigates the integration of a heuristic inverse kinematics solver within a model-based, task-priority control framework for executing pedipulation tasks of initial complexity. The proposed approach is validated through both simulation studies and real-world experiments conducted on a Unitree Go1 quadruped robotic platform.
Physics-Based Motion Imitation with Adversarial Differential Discriminators
基于物理的对抗性差分判别器的运动模仿
多目标优化问题广泛存在于各类应用中，其核心在于同时优化多个目标。现有多目标优化方法通常依赖人工调节的聚合函数来构建联合优化目标，而这类方法的性能高度依赖于权重选择，这一过程既耗时又繁琐。类似的局限性也出现在基于强化学习的物理仿真角色运动跟踪任务中，为了获得高保真效果，往往需要精心设计复杂的奖励函数。这不仅要求深厚的领域经验和大量人工调参，还限制了奖励函数在不同技能之间的通用性。为此，本文提出了一种新的对抗式多目标优化方法，适用于包括运动跟踪在内的多种多目标强化学习任务。我们提出的对抗差分判别器（Adversarial Differential Discriminator，ADD）仅需一个正样本即可有效引导优化过程。实验表明，该方法在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上能够实现对多种高难度、敏捷和杂技式动作的高质量复现，在不依赖人工设计奖励函数的前提下，其效果可与当前最先进的运动跟踪方法相媲美。
Multi-objective optimization problems, which require the simultaneous opti-mization of multiple objectives, are prevalent across numerous applications.Existing multi-objective optimization methods often rely on manually-tunedaggregation functions to formulate a joint optimization objective. The perfor-mance of such hand-tuned methods is heavily dependent on careful weightselection, a time-consuming and laborious process. These limitations alsoarise in the setting of reinforcement-learning-based motion tracking meth-ods for physically simulated characters, where intricately crafted rewardfunctions are typically used to achieve high-fidelity results. Such solutionsnot only require domain expertise and significant manual tuning, but alsolimit the applicability of the resulting reward function across diverse skills.To bridge this gap, we present a novel adversarial multi-objective opti-mization technique that is broadly applicable to a range of multi-objectivereinforcement-learning tasks, including motion tracking. Our proposed Ad-versarial Differential Discriminator (ADD) receives a single positive sample,yet is still effective at guiding the optimization process. We demonstratethat our technique on Unitree Go1 robot can enable characters to closely replicate a variety of ac-robatic and agile behaviors, achieving comparable quality to state-of-the-artmotion-tracking methods, without relying on manually-designed rewardfunctions.
Dynamic Policy Learning for Legged Robot with Simplified Model Pretraining and Model Homotopy Transfer
基于简化模型预训练和模型同伦迁移的腿式机器人动态策略学习
为足式机器人生成高动态运动仍然是一项极具挑战性的任务。尽管强化学习在多种足式行走任务中已取得显著成果，但要产生高度动态的行为，往往需要大量的奖励函数调节或高质量示范数据。引入降阶模型有助于缓解这些问题，但在将策略迁移到全身动力学环境时，模型不一致性成为一项关键挑战。本文提出了一种基于连续化（continuation）的学习框架，将简化模型预训练与模型同伦迁移相结合，用于高效生成并逐步优化复杂的动态行为。首先，我们在单刚体模型上对策略进行预训练，在简化环境中捕捉运动的核心模式；随后，通过连续化策略将该策略逐步迁移至全身模型环境，从而将性能损失降至最低。为定义这一连续迁移路径，我们提出了一种从单刚体模型到全身模型的模型同伦方法，通过在躯干与四肢之间逐步重新分配质量与惯性来实现平滑过渡。实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，该方法不仅收敛速度更快，而且在迁移过程中表现出更优的稳定性。该框架在包括翻转和借助墙面的高动态机动等多种任务中得到了验证，并已成功部署于真实的 Unitree Go1 四足机器人平台上。
Generating dynamic motions for legged robots remains a challenging problem. While reinforcement learning has achieved notable success in various legged locomotion tasks, producing highly dynamic behaviors often requires extensive reward tuning or high-quality demonstrations. Leveraging reducedorder models can help mitigate these challenges. However, the model discrepancy poses a significant challenge when transferring policies to full-body dynamics environments. In this work, we introduce a continuation-based learning framework that combines simplified model pretraining and model homotopy transfer to efficiently generate and refine complex dynamic behaviors. First, we pretrain the policy using a single rigid body model to capture core motion patterns in a simplified environment. Next, we employ a continuation strategy to progressively transfer the policy to the full-body environment, minimizing performance loss. To define the continuation path, we introduce a model homotopy from the single rigid body model to the full-body model by gradually redistributing mass and inertia between the trunk and legs. The proposed method not only achieves faster convergence but also demonstrates superior stability during the transfer process compared to baseline methods. Our framework is validated on a range of dynamic tasks, including flips and wall-assisted maneuvers, and is successfully deployed on a real Unitree Go1 quadrupedal robot.
Collaborative Quadruped Transportation in 3D Terrain with Constrained Diffusion
具有约束扩散的三维地形中的四足动物协同运输
近年来，多机器人系统因其可扩展的效率、高可靠性和成本优势而受到广泛关注，其中一项关键能力是协同运输，即由多个机器人协作搬运负载。然而，该任务仍面临诸多挑战，包括团队层决策与个体机器人控制之间的潜在冲突、机器人—负载耦合所带来的团队运动学约束，以及三维地形中复杂多样的障碍物。本文提出了一种受约束扩散驱动的四足机器人协同运输方法（Collaborative Quadruped Transportation with Constrained Diffusion，CQTD），使一组紧密耦合的四足机器人能够在三维地形中协同搬运负载。该方法采用分层架构：上层基于扩散模型学习具备地形感知能力的团队级轨迹规划，在满足负载耦合所引入的团队运动学约束的同时实现整体协同；下层则针对单个机器人优化速度控制，满足碰撞规避和各向异性速度约束。高保真仿真实验以及在真实 Unitree Go1 四足机器人团队上的实验结果表明，在需要高度紧密协作的复杂三维地形场景中，CQTD 相较于基线方法展现出更优的性能。
Recently, multi-robot systems have gained significant attention for their promise of scalable efficiency, reliability, and cost savings. A crucial capability is collaborative transportation, where a team of robots works together to transport a payload. However, key challenges remain, such as potential conflicts between team-level decisions and individuallevel robot controls, team kinematic constraints imposed by the robot-payload coupling, and diverse obstacles encountered in 3D terrain. We present Collaborative Quadruped Transportation with Constrained Diffusion (CQTD), enabling a team of closely coupled quadruped robots to collaboratively transport a payload across 3D terrain. A diffusion-based upper level learns terrain-aware team-level trajectories satisfying team kinematic constraints due to the payload coupling, while a lower level optimizes velocity controls of individual robots satisfying collision and anisotropic velocity constraints. Experiments in high-fidelity simulations and on real-world Unitree Go1 quadruped robot teams demonstrate that CQTD outperforms baseline methods in challenging 3D terrain scenarios requiring closely-coupled collaboration between the quadruped robots.
Navigating the Wild: Pareto-Optimal Visual Decision-Making in Image Space
驾驭荒野：图像空间中的帕累托最优视觉决策
在复杂真实环境中实现可靠导航，需要机器人具备对语义环境的理解以及有效的决策能力。现有方法仍存在不足：不维护地图的传统反应式方法在复杂场景中往往表现欠佳；依赖地图的方法则需要投入大量精力进行建图；而基于学习的方法通常依赖大规模训练数据，并面临泛化能力受限的问题。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种新的视觉语义导航框架，将数据驱动的语义理解、帕累托最优决策以及图像空间规划相结合。该方法引入了一种称为“可通行性图像”的局部环境表示，使机器人无需先验地图或导航数据即可评估周围环境的即时可通行性。在此基础上，我们提出了帕累托最优视觉导航（Pareto-Optimal Visual Navigation，POVNav）决策框架，在图像空间中完成子目标选择、无碰撞路径构建，并通过视觉伺服生成控制指令。该框架还支持选择性导航行为，例如通过在局部表示中动态调整可通行性判据，主动避开虽然可通行但易打滑的草地，以防机器人受困。POVNav 结构轻量，仅依赖单目相机运行，无需地图存储或训练数据采集，使其能够灵活适配多种机器人平台和环境。大量全年实地实验验证了该方法在结构化室内环境和非结构化室外场景中的有效性，包括密林小径和积雪道路。基于多种图像分割技术的野外实验进一步展示了其在不同条件下的鲁棒性与适应性。此外，我们还展示了 POVNav 在涵洞检测任务中成功引导机器人穿越狭窄管道的能力。总体而言，本文证明了 POVNav 在复杂真实环境中的实用性，凸显了其在自主机器人应用中的灵活性与计算效率。真实世界实验使用了三种机器人平台：Clearpath 的 Jackal、Husky，以及 Unitree Go1 四足机器人。
Navigating complex real-world environments requires understanding the semantic context and effectively making decisions. Existing solutions leave room for improvements: traditional reactive approaches that do not maintain a map often struggle in complex environments, map-dependent methods demand significant effort in mapping processes, and learning-based methods rely on large training datasets and face the difficulty of generalization. To address these challenges, we propose a novel visual semantic navigation framework that combines data-driven semantic understanding, Pareto-optimal decision-making, and image-space planning. Our approach uses a local environmental representation called navigability image, which allows the robot to assess immediate traversability without relying on apriori mapping or navigation data. Building on this, we introduce Pareto-Optimal Visual Navigation (POVNav), a decision-making framework in the image space that identifies appropriate sub-goals, constructs collision-free paths, and generates control commands using visual servoing. This framework also supports selective navigation behaviors, such as avoiding traversable yet slippery grasslands to prevent getting stuck, by dynamically adjusting the navigability criteria within the local representation. POVNav is lightweight, operating solely with a monocular camera and without requiring map storage or training data collection, making it highly versatile for different robotic platforms and environments. Extensive year-round real-world experiments validated its efficacy in both structured indoor environments and unstructured outdoor settings, including dense forest trails and snow-covered roads. Field experiments using various image segmentation techniques demonstrated its robustness and adaptability across a wide range of conditions. Additionally, we demonstrate that POVNav sucessfully guides a robot through narrow pipes in a culvert inspection task. Overall, we showcase the utility of POVNav in real-world scenarios, highlighting its flexibility and computational efficiency for autonomous robots in complex environments. For real-world experiments, we utilized three different robotic platforms: Clearpath’s Jackal, Husky, and the Unitree Go1 quadruped.
Learning Embodied Quadruped Agents for Posture-Aware Locomotion
学习具身四足智能体以实现姿态感知运动
具身智能领域的最新进展为自主体在复杂物理环境中的运行开辟了新的方向。本文提出了一种通过深度强化学习训练的姿态感知运动代理（Posture-Aware Locomotion Agent，PALA）。不同于仅关注速度跟踪的传统四足机器人控制策略，该代理能够在仅依赖本体感知与外部指令的情况下，实时跟踪面向任务的六维运动指令，包括线速度、角速度以及期望机体姿态（高度、俯仰角和横滚角）。为提升鲁棒性与地形适应能力，我们引入了两项关键的启发式设计：渐进式奖励课程和姿态指令重采样策略。结合非对称 actor–critic 训练、对抗运动先验以及域随机化，这些设计使得单一策略即可在多样且具有挑战性的环境中实现零样本泛化。此外，我们将 PALA 与由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的自主智能体相结合，使其能够理解高层次指令，并将自然语言任务描述直接转换为可执行的六维运动命令。大量仿真与真实世界实验验证了该姿态感知运动代理在响应性与精度方面的优异表现，凸显了其作为非结构化环境中具身系统核心组件的潜力。我们还将所学习到的低层控制策略以零样本方式成功部署到了 Unitree A1 四足机器人上。
Recent advances in embodied intelligence have opened new di-rections for autonomous agents to operate in complex physicalenvironments. In this work, we propose a Posture-Aware Locomo-tion Agent (PALA) trained via deep reinforcement learning. Unliketraditional quadruped agents that focus solely on velocity track-ing, our agent learns to track task-oriented 6D motion commands,including linear and angular velocities, as well as desired body pos-ture (height, pitch, and roll), in real time using only proprioceptivesensing and external commands. To improve robustness and terrainadaptability, we introduce two key heuristic designs: a progres-sive reward curriculum and an orientation command resampling strategy. Combined with asymmetric actor-critic training, adver-sarial motion priors, and domain randomization, these componentsenable a single policy to generalize zero-shot across diverse andchallenging environments. Additionally, we extend PALA to han-dle high-level instructions by integrating it with an autonomousagent powered by a large language model (LLM), enabling naturallanguage task descriptions to be directly translated into executable6D commands. Extensive simulation and real-world experimentsdemonstrate the responsiveness and accuracy of our posture-awarelocomotion agent, underscoring its potential as a core componentfor embodied systems operating in unstructured settings. We deployed the learned low-level policy on a Uni-tree A1 quadruped robot zero-shot.
Signal Temporal Logic Compliant Co-design of Planning and Control
符合信号时序逻辑的规划与控制协同设计
本文提出了一种新颖的协同设计策略，将轨迹规划与控制结合，用于自主机器人在执行信号时序逻辑（Signal Temporal Logic, STL）任务时的运动规划。该方法分为两个阶段：（i）学习时空运动原语以封装机器人固有的运动约束；（ii）利用学习到的时空运动原语构建符合 STL 规范的运动计划。具体而言，首先通过强化学习构建一组控制策略库，使机器人能够执行运动原语所描述的轨迹；随后，将运动原语映射到时空特性上；接着，提出一种基于采样的 STL 约束运动规划策略，以确保生成的运动计划满足 STL 规范。我们在“差分驱动机器人”和“四足机器人”上进行了多种 STL 任务和环境的实验，验证了框架的有效性与适应性。演示视频可见：https://youtu.be/xo2cXRYdDPQ。该框架完全**无模型**，能够在多样环境下生成可行的
STL 约束运动计划，并在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上成功演示了其实际应用。
This work proposes a novel co-design strategy that integrates trajectory planning and control for motion planning in autonomous robots, to handle signal temporal logic (STL) tasks. The approach is structured into two phases: (i) learning spatio-temporal motion primitives to encapsulate the inherent robot-specific constraints and (ii) constructing STL-compliant motion plan using learned spatio-temporal motion primitives. Initially, we employ reinforcement learning to construct a library of control policies that perform trajectories described by the motion primitives. Then, we map motion primitives to spatio-temporal characteristics. Subsequently, we present a sampling-based STL-compliant motion planning strategy tailored to meet the STL specification. We demonstrate the effectiveness and adaptability of our framework through experiments conducted on ‘Differential-drive robot’ and ‘Quadruped’ for multiple STL specifications and environments. Videos of the demonstrations can be accessed at https://youtu.be/xo2cXRYdDPQ. The proposed framework is entirely model-free and capable of generating feasible STLcompliant motion plans across diverse environments. We demonstrate the proposed framework on a Unitree Go1 quadruped.
M-SEVIQ A Multi-band Stereo Event Visual-Inertial Quadruped-based Dataset for Perception under Rapid Motion and Challenging Illumination
M-SEVIQ：基于多波段立体事件视觉惯性四足动物的快速运动和复杂光照条件下感知数据集
腿式机器人的敏捷运动对视觉感知提出了极高要求。传统的帧式摄像头在高速运动或低光环境下容易产生模糊图像，从而限制了感知性能。相比之下，事件摄像头能够异步捕捉亮度变化，具备低延迟、高时间分辨率和高动态范围的优势，使其在快速运动和复杂光照条件下具有稳健感知能力。然而，现有的事件摄像头数据集在立体配置、多波段感知及不同光照条件下仍存在局限。为填补这一空白，我们构建了 M-SEVIQ，一个多波段立体事件视觉与惯性四足机器人数据集。数据采集平台为 Unitree Go2，配备立体事件摄像头、帧式摄像头、惯性测量单元（IMU）和关节编码器。该数据集包含 30 多条真实世界序列，涵盖不同速度等级、光照波长及光照条件。此外，数据集提供了全面的校准信息，包括内参、外参及时间对齐，以便于精确的传感器融合与基准测试。M-SEVIQ 可支持敏捷机器人感知、传感器融合、语义分割及多模态视觉在复杂环境下的研究。
Agile locomotion in legged robots poses significant challenges for visual perception. Traditional frame-based cameras often fail in these scenarios for producing blurred images, particularly under low-light conditions. In contrast, event cameras capture changes in brightness asynchronously, offering low latency, high temporal resolution, and high dynamic range. These advantages make them suitable for robust perception during rapid motion and under challenging illumination. However, existing event camera datasets exhibit limitations in stereo configurations and multi-band sensing domains under various illumination conditions. To address this gap, we present M-SEVIQ, a multiband stereo event visual and inertial quadruped dataset collected using a Unitree Go2 equipped with stereo event cameras, a framebased camera, an inertial measurement unit (IMU), and joint encoders. This dataset contains more than 30 real-world sequences captured across different velocity levels, illumination wavelengths, and lighting conditions. In addition, comprehensive calibration data, including intrinsic, extrinsic, and temporal alignments, are provided to facilitate accurate sensor fusion and benchmarking. Our M-SEVIQ can be used to support research in agile robot perception, sensor fusion, semantic segmentation and multi-modal vision in challenging environments.
REBot: Reflexive Evasion Robot for Instantaneous Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
REBot：用于瞬时动态避障的反射式规避机器人
动态障碍物避让（DOA）对于在有移动障碍物或人类的环境中运行的四足机器人至关重要。现有方法通常依赖基于导航的轨迹重新规划，这类方法假设有足够的反应时间，当障碍物快速接近时往往会失败。在这种场景下，四足机器人需要具备反射式规避能力，以实现即时、低延迟的机动操作。本文提出 Reflexive Evasion Robot（REBot），一种控制框架，使四足机器人能够实现实时反射式障碍物避让。REBot 在有限状态机内集成了避让策略与恢复策略，通过精心设计的学习课程、正则化机制和自适应奖励，实现了动态障碍物避让任务中的稳健规避与快速稳定。我们在仿真与真实环境中（Unitree Go2 四足机器人）对 REBot 进行了广泛验证，结果显示其在避让成功率、能效以及对快速移动障碍物的鲁棒性方面均显著优于现有方法。演示视频与附录可访问：https://rebot-2025.github.io/。
Dynamic obstacle avoidance (DOA) is critical for quadrupedal robots operating in environments with moving obstacles or humans. Existing approaches typically rely on navigation-based trajectory replanning, which assumes sufficient reaction time and leading to fails when obstacles approach rapidly. In such scenarios, quadrupedal robots require reflexive evasion capabilities to perform instantaneous, lowlatency maneuvers. This paper introduces Reflexive Evasion Robot (REBot), a control framework that enables quadrupedal robots to achieve real-time reflexive obstacle avoidance. REBot integrates an avoidance policy and a recovery policy within a finite-state machine. With carefully designed learning curricula and by incorporating regularization and adaptive rewards, REBot achieves robust evasion and rapid stabilization in instantaneous DOA tasks. We validate REBot through extensive simulations and real-world experiments on Unitree Go2, demonstrating notable improvements in avoidance success rates, energy efficiency, and robustness to fast-moving obstacles. Videos and appendix are available on https://rebot-2025.github.io/.
UniLegs: Universal Multi-Legged Robot Control through Morphology-Agnostic Policy Distillation
UniLegs：基于形态无关策略蒸馏的通用多足机器人控制
在腿式机器人运动控制中，实现能够跨多样形态泛化的控制器仍然是一个重大挑战。传统方法通常要么为每种机器人形态单独设计专用控制器，要么在追求通用性时牺牲性能。本文提出了一种两阶段师生框架（teacher–student framework），通过策略蒸馏来弥合这一差距。首先，为每种机器人形态训练专门的教师策略，以捕捉各自最优的控制策略；随后，将这些专门化的知识蒸馏到单一的基于 Transformer 的学生策略中，使其能够控制不同腿部配置的机器人。
我们在五种不同腿式机器人形态上进行了实验，结果显示该方法能够保留形态特定的最优行为：在训练形态上，Transformer 学生策略达到了教师策略性能的 94.47%，在未见过的机器人设计上达到了 72.64%。对比分析表明，基于 Transformer 的架构通过注意力机制有效建模不同运动结构间的关节关系， consistently 优于传统 MLP 基线。我们还在真实四足机器人上成功部署了该策略，验证了其实际可行性。
本研究提供了一种可扩展的方案，用于开发通用腿式机器人控制器，在保持接近最优性能的同时实现对多样形态的泛化能力。实验训练集包含五种不同形态：三种四足机器人（Unitree A1、Aliengo 和 ANYbotics ANYmal），以及六足和八足机器人，用于表示更复杂的运动学结构；在零-shot 泛化测试中，我们使用训练集中未出现的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人进行验证，评估方法的跨形态泛化能力。
Developing controllers that generalize across diverse robot morphologies remains a significant challenge in legged locomotion. Traditional approaches either create specialized controllers for each morphology or compromise performance for generality. This paper introduces a two-stage teacherstudent framework that bridges this gap through policy distillation. First, we train specialized teacher policies optimized for individual morphologies, capturing the unique optimal control strategies for each robot design. Then, we distill this specialized expertise into a single Transformer-based student policy capable of controlling robots with varying leg configurations. Our experiments across five distinct legged morphologies demonstrate that our approach preserves morphology-specific optimal behaviors, with the Transformer architecture achieving 94.47% of teacher performance on training morphologies and 72.64% on unseen robot designs. Comparative analysis reveals that Transformer-based architectures consistently outperform MLP baselines by leveraging attention mechanisms to effectively model joint relationships across different kinematic structures. We validate our approach through successful deployment on a physical quadruped robot, demonstrating the practical viability of our morphology-agnostic control framework. This work presents a scalable solution for developing universal legged robot controllers that maintain near-optimal performance while generalizing across diverse morphologies. Our experiments evaluate morphology-agnostic control across diverse legged robot platforms. The training set comprises five distinct morphologies: three quadrupedal robots (Unitree A1, Aliengo, and ANYbotics ANYmal) with varying physical characteristics, plus six-legged and eight-legged variants to represent more complex kinematic structures. For zeroshot generalization testing, we employ the Unitree Go2 quadruped, which is excluded from the training process.
Transferable Latent-to-Latent Locomotion Policy for Efficient and Versatile Motion Control of Diverse Legged Robots
可转移的潜在运动策略用于高效、多功能地控制各种腿式机器人
强化学习（RL）在机器人技能习得方面展现了出色能力，但每学习一个新技能仍需大量训练数据。预训练—微调（pretrain-and-finetune）范式为高效适应新机器人或新任务提供了有希望的方案。受启发于“已习得的知识可以加速相同机器人的新任务学习，也可帮助新机器人掌握已训练任务”的理念，我们提出了一种潜在空间训练框架（latent training framework）：在该框架下，一个可迁移的潜在到潜在（latent-to-latent）运动策略与多样化任务特定的观测编码器和动作解码器同时进行预训练。该潜在策略将编码后的潜在观测输入映射为潜在动作，再通过解码器生成实际动作，从而有潜力学习通用的抽象运动技能。
为保留决策与控制所需的关键信息，我们引入了扩散恢复模块（diffusion recovery module），在预训练阶段最小化信息重建损失。在微调阶段，预训练的潜在到潜在运动策略保持固定，仅优化轻量级的任务特定编码器和解码器，以实现高效适应。该方法使机器人能够利用自身在不同任务中的经验，以及其他形态多样机器人积累的经验，加速新任务和新平台的适应过程。
我们通过大量仿真和真实机器人实验验证了该方法，结果表明预训练的潜在到潜在运动策略能够有效泛化到新的机器人实体和任务，并显著提升学习效率。在真实机器人实验中，我们以 Unitree Go1 作为目标平台，并使用在 A1 机器人上预训练的潜在策略进行微调，取得了良好适应效果。
Reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated remarkable capability in acquiring robot skills, but learning each new skill still requires substantial data collection for training. The pretrain-and-finetune paradigm offers a promising approach for efficiently adapting to new robot entities and tasks. Inspired by the idea that acquired knowledge can accelerate learning new tasks with the same robot and help a new robot master a trained task, we propose a latent training framework where a transferable latent-to-latent locomotion policy is pretrained alongside diverse task-specific observation encoders and action decoders. This policy in latent space processes encoded latent observations to generate latent actions to be decoded, with the potential to learn general abstract motion skills. To retain essential information for decisionmaking and control, we introduce a diffusion recovery module that minimizes information reconstruction loss during pretrain stage. During fine-tune stage, the pretrained latent-to-latent locomotion policy remains fixed, while only the lightweight task-specific encoder and decoder are optimized for efficient adaptation. Our method allows a robot to leverage its own prior experience across different tasks as well as the experience of other morphologically diverse robots to accelerate adaptation. We validate our approach through extensive simulations and real-world experiments, demonstrating that the pretrained latent-to-latent locomotion policy effectively generalizes to new robot entities and tasks with improved efficiency. For our real-world experiments, we select the Unitree Go1 as the target platform and use the pretrained latent-to-latent policy on A1 robot to start finetuning.
EdgeNavMamba: Mamba-Optimized Object Detection for Energy-Efficient Edge Devices
EdgeNavMamba：面向节能边缘设备的Mamba优化目标检测
在自主导航中，高效且准确的深度学习模型部署长期以来一直是挑战，尤其是在资源受限的边缘设备上实现实时应用。边缘设备在计算能力和内存方面有限，因此模型效率与压缩成为关键需求。本文提出 EdgeNavMamba，一种基于强化学习的目标导向导航框架，结合高效的 Mamba 目标检测模型。为了训练与评估检测器，我们构建了一个自定义形状检测数据集，涵盖多样化室内场景，反映真实导航中常见的视觉特征。检测器作为预处理模块，将视觉输入提取为边界框（BBOX），再传入强化学习策略以控制目标导航。
实验结果表明，在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 和 Raspberry Pi 5 等边缘设备上，学生模型相比教师模型实现了模型尺寸减少 67%、每次推理能耗降低最多 73%，同时保持相同性能。在 MiniWorld 和 IsaacLab 仿真环境中，EdgeNavMamba 同样保持高检测精度，并将参数量相比基线减少 31%。真实部署平台包括搭载 Jetson Orin Nano 加速器的：(a) Unitree Go2 四足机器人 和 (b) Yahboom Rosmaster 巡航轮式机器人，验证了该方法在资源受限设备上的实用性与高效性。
Deployment of efficient and accurate Deep Learning models has long been a challenge in autonomous navigation, particularly for real-time applications on resource-constrained edge devices. Edge devices are limited in computing power and memory, making model efficiency and compression essential. In this work, we propose EdgeNavMamba, a reinforcement learning-based framework for goal-directed navigation using an efficient Mamba object detection model. To train and evaluate the detector, we introduce a custom shape detection dataset collected in diverse indoor settings, reflecting visual cues common in realworld navigation. The object detector serves as a pre-processing module, extracting bounding boxes (BBOX) from visual input, which are then passed to an RL policy to control goal-oriented navigation. Experimental results show that the student model achieved a reduction of 67% in size, and up to 73% in energy per inference on edge devices of NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano and Raspberry Pi 5, while keeping the same performance as the teacher model. EdgeNavMamba also maintains high detection accuracy in MiniWorld and IsaacLab simulators while reducing parameters by 31% compared to the baseline. Edge platforms with onboard Jetson Orin Nano accelerators: (a) the Unitree Go2 robot dog and (b) the Yahboom Rosmaster wheeled robot.
CoINS: Counterfactual Interactive Navigation via Skill-Aware VLM
COINS：基于技能感知虚拟线性模型的反事实交互式导航
近期的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在机器人规划中展现出显著潜力，但它们通常仅作为语义推理工具，缺乏对特定机器人物理能力的内在理解。这一局限在交互式导航中尤为关键，因为机器人必须主动改造杂乱环境以创建可通行路径。现有基于 VLM 的导航方法主要局限于被动避障，无法推理何时以及如何与物体交互以清理阻塞路径。
为解决这一问题，本文提出 CoINS（Counterfactual Interactive Navigation via Skill-aware VLM），一种层级式框架，将技能感知推理与稳健的低层执行结合。具体而言，我们微调了一个名为 InterNav-VLM 的 VLM，将技能可用性（skill affordance）及具体约束参数纳入输入上下文，并将其映射到度量尺度的环境表示。通过在新构建的 InterNav 数据集 上进行微调，模型内化了反事实推理逻辑，从而能够隐式评估移除物体对导航连通性的因果影响，进而判断交互的必要性及目标选择。
在执行生成的高层规划时，我们通过强化学习构建了完整的技能库，特别引入了以可通行性为导向的策略，以操作多样物体并清理通路。在 Isaac Sim 中建立了系统化基准，用于评估交互式导航的推理与执行能力。大量仿真与真实机器人实验表明，CoINS 显著优于代表性基线方法，在整体成功率上提高 17%，在复杂长航程场景中较最佳基线提升超过 80%，同时在不同物体类别间展现出稳健的泛化能力。项目主页：https://coins-internav.github.io/。
实验平台为 Unitree Go2 四足机器人，配备 ARX5 机械臂；环境感知采用 Unitree L1 LiDAR 获取地形信息。
Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in robotic planning. However, they typically function as semantic reasoners, lacking an intrinsic understanding of the specific robot’s physical capabilities. This limitation is particularly critical in interactive navigation, where robots must actively modify cluttered environments to create traversable paths. Existing VLM-based navigators are predominantly confined to passive obstacle avoidance, failing to reason about when and how to interact with objects to clear blocked paths. To bridge this gap, we propose Counterfactual Interactive Navigation via Skill-aware VLM (CoINS), a hierarchical framework that integrates skill-aware reasoning and robust low-level execution. Specifically, we fine-tune a VLM, named InterNav-VLM, which incorporates skill affordance and concrete constraint parameters into the input context and grounds them into a metric-scale environmental representation. By internalizing the logic of counterfactual reasoning through fine-tuning on the proposed InterNav dataset, the model learns to implicitly evaluate the causal effects of object removal on navigation connectivity, thereby determining interaction necessity and target selection. To execute the generated high-level plans, we develop a comprehensive skill library through reinforcement learning, specifically introducing traversability-oriented strategies to manipulate diverse objects for path clearance. A systematic benchmark in Isaac Sim is proposed to evaluate both the reasoning and execution aspects of interactive navigation. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that CoINS significantly outperforms representative baselines, achieving a 17% higher overall success rate and over 80% improvement in complex long-horizon scenarios compared to the best-performing baseline, while exhibiting robust generalization across diverse object categories. Our project page is available at https://coins-internav.github.io/. The robotic platform employed is the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot equipped with an ARX5 manipulator. For environmental perception, the robot utilizes a Unitree L1 LiDAR to acquire terrain information.
Offline Imitation Learning upon Arbitrary Demonstrations by Pre-Training Dynamics Representations
基于预训练动态表征的任意演示离线模仿学习
数据匮乏已成为离线模仿学习（Imitation Learning, IL）扩展的主要瓶颈。本文提出了一种在有限专家数据条件下提升 IL 性能的方法，即引入一个预训练阶段以学习动力学表示，这些表示源自对状态转移动力学的分解。我们首先从理论上证明，离线 IL 的最优决策变量存在于表示空间中，这显著减少了下游 IL 需要学习的参数量。此外，这些动力学表示可以通过任意符合相同动力学的数据进行学习，从而实现大量非专家数据的复用，缓解数据不足的问题。
在预训练阶段，我们提出了一种受噪声对比估计（Noise Contrastive Estimation, NCE）启发的可行损失函数，用于学习动力学表示。MuJoCo 仿真实验表明，该算法能够仅通过单条专家轨迹就模仿专家策略。在真实四足机器人 Unitree Go2 上的实验也验证了该方法的有效性：通过利用从仿真数据中预训练的动力学表示，仅用少量真实演示即可学习机器人行走。
Limited data has become a major bottleneck in scaling up offline imitation learning (IL). In this paper, we propose enhancing IL performance under limited expert data by introducing a pre-training stage that learns dynamics representations, derived from factorizations of the transition dynamics. We first theoretically justify that the optimal decision variable of offline IL lies in the representation space, significantly reducing the parameters to learn in the downstream IL. Moreover, the dynamics representations can be learned from arbitrary data collected with the same dynamics, allowing the reuse of massive non-expert data and mitigating the limited data issues. We present a tractable loss function inspired by noise contrastive estimation to learn the dynamics representations at the pre-training stage. Experiments on MuJoCo demonstrate that our proposed algorithm can mimic expert policies with as few as a single trajectory. Experiments on real quadrupeds Unitree Go2 show that we can leverage pre-trained dynamics representations from simulator data to learn to walk from a few real-world demonstrations.
Online Trajectory Optimization for Arbitrary-Shaped Mobile Robots via Polynomial Separating Hypersurfaces
基于多项式分离超曲面的任意形状移动机器人在线轨迹优化
一种新兴的轨迹优化方法通过联合优化机器人构型与分离超平面来实现避障。然而，由于线性分离器仅适用于凸集，这类方法通常需要将机器人和障碍物都近似为凸形体，在狭窄、拥挤或强非凸环境中往往过于保守，甚至直接失效。本文彻底消除了这一限制，提出使用由多项式函数参数化的非线性分离超曲面来实现避障。我们首先推广了经典的分离超平面定理，严格证明了：任意两个不相交的、有界闭集在欧几里得空间中都可以被一个多项式超曲面分离。这一结果为任意几何形状之间的非线性分离提供了坚实的理论基础。在此基础上，我们构建了一个非线性规划（NLP）问题，同时优化机器人的运动轨迹以及分离多项式的系数，从而实现具备几何感知能力的避障，无需对机器人或障碍物进行保守的凸化近似。该优化问题仍可通过标准 NLP 求解器高效求解。在仿真和真实机器人实验中，我们使用非凸形态的机器人验证了该方法的有效性。结果表明，在传统凸近似方法失败的复杂环境中，我们的方法依然能够生成平滑、无碰撞且敏捷的运动轨迹。在真实实验中，我们在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上安装了一个 L 形框架，进一步验证了该方法在真实非凸机器人系统中的实用性与鲁棒性。
An emerging class of trajectory optimization methods enforces collision avoidance by jointly optimizing the robot’s configuration and a separating hyperplane. However, as linear separators only apply to convex sets, these methods require convex approximations of both the robot and obstacles, which becomes an overly conservative assumption in cluttered and narrow environments. In this work, we unequivocally remove this limitation by introducing nonlinear separating hypersurfaces parameterized by polynomial functions. We first generalize the classical separating hyperplane theorem and prove that any two disjoint bounded closed sets in Euclidean space can be separated by a polynomial hypersurface, serving as the theoretical foundation for nonlinear separation of arbitrary geometries. Building on this result, we formulate a nonlinear programming (NLP) problem that jointly optimizes the robot’s trajectory and the coefficients of the separating polynomials, enabling geometry-aware collision avoidance without conservative convex simplifications. The optimization remains efficiently solvable using standard NLP solvers. Simulation and real-world experiments with nonconvex robots demonstrate that our method achieves smooth, collision-free, and agile maneuvers in environments where convex-approximation baselines fail. In the real-world experiments, we mount an L-shaped frame on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot.
Zero-shot adaptable task planning for autonomous construction robots a comparative study of lightweight single and multi-AI agent systems
面向自主施工机器人的零样本自适应任务规划：轻量级单智能体和多智能体人工智能系统的比较研究
机器人被认为将在未来建筑行业中发挥重要作用，但目前仍面临成本高昂以及难以适应动态任务等挑战。本文探讨了**基础模型（foundation models）**在提升建筑机器人任务规划适应性与泛化能力方面的潜力。研究提出并实现了四种模型，基于轻量级、开源的大语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs），包括一个单智能体模型以及三个通过协作生成机器人行动规划的多智能体团队模型。我们在三种建筑作业角色下对这些模型进行了评估，分别为油漆工、安全检查员和地面铺装工。实验结果表明，四智能体团队在大多数评价指标上均优于当前最先进的 GPT-4o，同时成本仅为其十分之一。此外，三智能体和四智能体团队展现出更强的泛化能力。通过分析智能体行为对输出结果的影响，本文加深了对 AI 团队协作机制的理解，并为其在建筑领域之外的多样化非结构化环境中的进一步研究提供了支持。实验平台为一台 Unitree Go2 Edu 四足机器人，其上搭载了 K1 机械臂 和 Robosense Helios32 激光雷达。
Robots are expected to play a major role in the future construction industry but face challenges due to high costs and difficulty adapting to dynamic tasks. This study explores the potential of foundation models to enhance the adaptability and generalizability of task planning in construction robots. Four models are proposed and implemented using lightweight, open-source large language models (LLMs) and vision language models (VLMs). These models include one single agent and three multi-agent teams that collaborate to create robot action plans. The models are evaluated across three construction roles: Painter, Safety Inspector, and Floor Tiling. Results show that the four-agent team outperforms the state-of-the-art GPT-4o in most metrics while being ten times more cost-effective. Additionally, teams with three and four agents demonstrate the improved generalizability. By discussing how agent behaviors influence outputs, this study enhances the understanding of AI teams and supports future research in diverse unstructured environments beyond construction. This quadruped robot is a Unitree Go2 Edu that is attached to a K1 Robotic Arm and a Robosense Helios32 Lidar.
VLingNav Embodied Navigation with Adaptive Reasoning and Visual-Assisted Linguistic Memory
VLingNav：基于自适应推理和视觉辅助语言记忆的具身导航
视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action，VLA）模型通过统一感知与规划，并继承大型视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models，VLMs）强大的泛化能力，在具身导航任务中展现出良好的潜力。然而，现有的大多数 VLA 模型依赖于从观测到动作的反应式映射，缺乏完成复杂、长时程导航任务所必需的显式推理能力和持久记忆机制。为此，我们提出了 VLingNav，一种基于语言驱动认知的具身导航 VLA 模型。首先，受人类认知双过程理论的启发，我们引入了一种自适应思维链（Adaptive Chain-of-Thought，AdaCoT）机制，仅在必要时动态触发显式推理，使智能体能够在快速直觉式执行与缓慢审慎式规划之间灵活切换。其次，为了应对长时程空间依赖问题，我们设计了视觉辅助的语言记忆模块（VLingMem），用于构建持久的跨模态语义记忆，使智能体能够回忆过去的观测，从而避免重复探索，并在动态环境中推断运动趋势。在训练方面，我们构建了 Nav-AdaCoT-2.9M，这是目前规模最大的、带有推理标注的具身导航数据集，其中引入的自适应 CoT 标注能够诱导一种既能调节“何时思考”，又能调节“思考什么”的推理范式。此外，我们还引入了在线专家引导的强化学习阶段，使模型超越纯模仿学习，获得更加稳健的、自主探索的导航行为。大量实验结果表明，VLingNav 在多种具身导航基准上均取得了当前最优性能。值得注意的是，VLingNav 能够以零样本方式迁移到真实世界的机器人平台，成功完成包括此前未见、未训练任务在内的实际导航任务，展现出强大的跨领域与跨任务泛化能力。
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising potential in embodied navigation by unifying perception and planning while inheriting the strong generalization abilities of large VisionLanguage Models (VLMs). However, most existing VLA models rely on reactive mappings directly from observations to actions, lacking the explicit reasoning capabilities and persistent memory required for complex, long-horizon navigation tasks. To address these challenges, we propose VLingNav, a VLA model for embodied navigation grounded in linguistic-driven cognition. First, inspired by the dual-process theory of human cognition, we introduce an adaptive chain-of-thought (AdaCoT) mechanism, which dynamically triggers explicit reasoning only when necessary, enabling the agent to fluidly switch between fast, intuitive execution and slow, deliberate planning. Second, to handle long-horizon spatial dependencies, we develop a visual-assisted linguistic memory module (VLingMem) that constructs a persistent, cross-modal semantic memory, enabling the agent to recall past observations to prevent repetitive exploration and infer movement trends for dynamic environments. For training, we construct Nav-AdaCoT-2.9M, the largest embodied navigation dataset with reasoning annotations to date, enriched with adaptive CoT annotations that induce a reasoning paradigm capable of adjusting both when to think and what to think about. Moreover, we incorporate an online expert-guided reinforcement learning stage, enabling the model to surpass pure imitation learning and to acquire more robust, self-explored navigation behaviors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VLingNav achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of embodied navigation benchmarks. Notably, VLingNav transfers to real-world robotic platforms in a zero-shot manner, successfully executing practical navigation tasks, including previously unseen and untrained tasks, and demonstrating strong cross-domain and cross-task generalization.
Energy-Efficient Omnidirectional Locomotion for Wheeled Quadrupeds via Predictive Energy-Aware Nominal Gait Selection
通过预测性能量感知名义步态选择实现轮式四足动物的节能型全方位运动
轮腿机器人结合了轮式系统的高效性与腿式系统的灵活性，但在复杂多样环境中的运动过程中仍面临显著的能耗优化挑战。本文提出了一种分层控制框架，将预测式功率建模与残差强化学习相结合，用于优化轮式四足机器人在全向运动中的能量效率。该方法引入了一种新颖的功率预测网络，可在 1 秒时间范围内预测不同步态模式下的能耗情况，从而智能选择最节能的名义步态。在此基础上，强化学习策略生成对名义步态的残差调整，对机器人动作进行精细调节，在能量效率与运动性能目标之间实现平衡。对比实验结果表明，与固定步态方法相比，该方法在保持相当速度跟踪性能的同时，能耗最多可降低 35%。我们在改装的 Unitree Go1 平台上通过大量仿真和真实实验验证了该框架的有效性，结果显示其在存在外部扰动的情况下仍具备稳健性能。相关视频和实现细节可参见：https://sites.google.com/view/switching-wpg。
Wheeled-legged robots combine the efficiency of wheels with the versatility of legs, but face significant energy optimization challenges when navigating diverse environments. In this work, we present a hierarchical control framework that integrates predictive power modeling with residual reinforcement learning to optimize omnidirectional locomotion efficiency for wheeled quadrupedal robots. Our approach employs a novel power prediction network that forecasts energy consumption across different gait patterns over a 1-second horizon, enabling intelligent selection of the most energy-efficient nominal gait. A reinforcement learning policy then generates residual adjustments to this nominal gait, fine-tuning the robot’s actions to balance energy efficiency with performance objectives. Comparative analysis shows our method reduces energy consumption by up to 35% compared to fixed-gait approaches while maintaining comparable velocity tracking performance. We validate our framework through extensive simulations and real-world experiments on a modified Unitree Go1 platform, demonstrating robust performance even under external disturbances. Videos and implementation details are available at https://sites.google.com/view/switching-wpg.
Dynamics-Driven Policy Transfer to Heavy Wheel-Legged Robots via Imitation and Optimization
通过模仿和优化实现动力学驱动的策略迁移到重型轮腿机器人
策略迁移是一种高效的特定机器人开发方法，其效果高度依赖于高质量的模仿数据集以及稳定的学习过程。然而，源机器人与目标机器人在几何结构和动力学特性上的显著差异带来了诸多挑战，单纯依赖运动学映射的方法以及人工参数调节往往难以保持运动学与动力学的一致性。本文将控制策略从四足机器人 Unitree Go1 迁移至我们自主研发的重载轮腿机器人 Tiangou，并提出了一种一致性感知重定向方法（Consistency-Aware Retargeting，CAR）。该方法在传统逆运动学的基础上引入动力学一致性约束，利用 Go1 的模型预测控制器（MPC）生成的运动数据，为 Tiangou 构建参考数据集。在此基础上，我们将贝叶斯优化（Bayesian Optimization，BO）引入模仿学习框架，实现对策略模型结构及优化超参数的自主调节。实验结果表明，CAR 能够有效降低足端位置误差，缓解关节角速度波动，并减少足端滑移现象；同时，贝叶斯优化显著提升了样本效率与训练稳定性。上述工作为异构机器人平台之间的策略迁移奠定了切实可行的实践基础。
Policy transfer is an efficient approach for developing specific robots. Its effectiveness depends on high-quality imitation datasets and a stable learning process. However, substantial differences in geometry and dynamics between source and target robots pose challenges. Purely kinematics-driven mapping methods and manual parameter tuning often fail to maintain kinematic-dynamic consistency. In this study, we transfer control policies from the quadruped robot Unitree Go1 to our self-developed heavy wheel-legged robot Tiangou. We propose a Consistency-Aware Retargeting (CAR) method. This extends conventional inverse kinematics by adding dynamic consistency constraints. Using motion data from Go1’s Model Predictive Controller (MPC), CAR generates a reference dataset for Tiangou. We then integrate Bayesian Optimization (BO) into the imitation learning framework. This enables autonomous tuning of policy model structures and optimization hyperparameters. Experiments show that CAR reduces foot-end position errors, mitigates joint angular velocity fluctuations, and decreases foot-end slippage. Moreover, Bayesian optimization improves sample efficiency and training stability. These contributions establish a practical foundation for policy transfer across heterogeneous robotic platforms. 
MPPF Mobile Probe Potential Field for Real-Time Multi-Agent Navigation in Industrial Environments
MPPF：用于工业环境中实时多智能体导航的移动探测势场
开放式室外非结构化多地形环境下的工业巡检对自主导航提出了严峻挑战。承担操作与近距离检测任务的地面机器人难以获得保障安全自主运行所需的全局环境感知能力，因此需要多智能体协同作业。这一场景要求在资源受限的边缘设备上并行处理多项协同任务，包括轨迹规划、环境感知以及实时动态障碍物的检测与避障。同时，复杂多变的地形条件对运动方式提出了更高要求，需要部署具备自适应步态能力的 Unitree Go1 四足机器人。为应对上述挑战，本文提出了一种多智能体协同框架，由自主空中飞行器（AAV）通过 RGB-D 相机提供环境感知、定位及动态障碍物检测，其中 RGB 信息采用深度学习方法处理，深度信息则通过经典视觉算法进行分析。四足机器人在执行具备地形自适应能力的运动及步态切换的同时，接收来自空中智能体的实时导航引导。针对计算资源受限条件下的高效轨迹规划问题，我们提出了移动探针势场（Mobile Probe Potential Field，MPPF）方法，该方法在人工势场（APF）框架下采用移动表面电荷模型对障碍物进行表示。所提出的算法引入基于虚拟障碍物的机制以解决局部极小值问题，并通过动态参数自适应实现平滑轨迹生成。实验结果表明，该协同框架可在 0.025 秒内完成轨迹生成，其轨迹平滑性优于对比方法，并成功实现在沙地、楼梯和碎石等复杂地形中的自主导航，验证了其在非结构化环境下执行工业巡检任务的有效性。
Industrial inspection in open outdoor unstructured multi-terrain environments creates critical autonomous navigation challenges. Ground agents required for manipulation and close inspection cannot achieve the comprehensive environmental perception necessary for safe autonomous operation, requiring multi-agent collaboration. This necessitates parallel processing of collaborative tasks, including trajectory planning, perception, real-time dynamic obstacle detection, and avoidance on resource-constrained edge devices. Terrain variations further demand adaptive locomotion strategies, necessitating Unitree Go1 legged robot deployment with adaptive gait patterns. To address these challenges, we propose a collaborative multi-agent framework where a autonomous aerial vehicles (AAV) provides environmental perception, localization, and dynamic obstacle detection through RGB-D cameras, utilizing deep learning for RGB processing and classical vision for depth analysis. The quadruped receives real-time guidance while executing terrainadaptive locomotion with adaptive gait transitions. For efficient trajectory planning under computational constraints, we present MPPF (Mobile Probe Potential Field), a moving surface charge model for obstacle representation in APF methods. Our algorithm incorporates a virtual obstacle-based framework for local minima resolution and smooth trajectory generation through dynamic parameter adaptation. Experimental validation of our proposed framework demonstrates trajectory generation in 0.025 seconds with superior smoothness compared to baseline methods, achieving successful navigation across sand, stairs, and stones for autonomous industrial inspection in unstructured environments.
Symbolic learning of interpretable reduced-order models for jumping quadruped robots
面向跳跃四足机器人的可解释降阶模型的符号学习
降阶模型在四足机器人运动规划与控制中起着核心作用，但现有模板模型通常针对特定运动模式进行人工设计，缺乏通用性与自动化能力。因此，亟需一种能够直接从数据中自动提取任务相关、具有良好可解释性的低维动力学模型的方法。本文提出了一种将线性自编码器与符号回归相结合的建模方法。线性自编码器为机器人构型、速度、加速度以及控制输入提供了统一且一致的潜在表示，使稀疏非线性动力学辨识（SINDy）能够在紧凑且符合物理结构的低维空间中进行建模。为保证在接触状态切换过程中的潜在坐标一致性，我们设计了一种多阶段、接触感知的混合训练策略。本文以四足机器人跳跃这一具有代表性、挑战性且相对受控的运动场景作为验证对象，在该场景下，构建合理的模板模型尤为关键。实验结果表明，所得到的符号化动力学模型在仿真和真实硬件平台上，跨多种机器人与跳跃模式，均优于当前最先进的人工设计驱动弹簧倒立摆（actuated Spring-Loaded Inverted Pendulum，aSLIP）基线模型，并在 Unitree Go1 机器人上获得了真实世界实验验证结果。
Reduced-order models are central to motion planning and control of quadruped robots, yet existing templates are often hand-crafted for a specific locomotion modality. This motivates the need for automatic methods that extract task-specific, interpretable low-dimensional dynamics directly from data. We propose a methodology that combines a linear autoencoder with symbolic regression to derive such models. The linear autoencoder provides a consistent latent embedding for configurations, velocities, accelerations, and inputs, enabling the sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) to operate in a compact, physics-aligned space. A multi-phase, hybrid-aware training scheme ensures coherent latent coordinates across contact transitions. We focus our validation on quadruped jumping— a representative, challenging, yet contained scenario in which a principled template model is especially valuable. The resulting symbolic dynamics outperform the state-of-the-art handcrafted actuated spring-loaded inverted pendulum (aSLIP) baseline in simulation and hardware across multiple robots and jumping modalities. Got Unitree Go1 real world results.

Language as Cost: Proactive Hazard Mapping using VLM for Robot Navigation
语言即成本：利用VLM进行机器人导航的主动式危险地图绘制
在以人为中心或高风险环境中运行的机器人，必须超越基础的障碍物检测，具备对潜在危险的前瞻性预判与规避能力。传统导航系统通常依赖静态地图，难以刻画诸如“门突然打开、行人出现”等动态风险，因此在处理此类危险时往往表现为被动反应而非主动预防。近年来，预训练的大语言模型和视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models，VLMs）的发展为主动式危险规避提供了新的契机。本文提出了一种零样本的“语言即代价”（language-as-cost）映射框架，利用 VLM 对视觉场景进行语义理解，评估潜在的动态风险，并在危险尚未显现之前预先赋予风险感知的导航代价，使机器人能够提前感知并规避隐患。通过将基于语言的代价地图与几何障碍物地图相结合，机器人不仅能够识别当前存在的障碍物，还能够预判由环境动态变化引发的潜在危险，并据此进行前瞻性的路径规划。仿真及多种动态环境下的实验结果表明，与反应式基线规划器相比，该方法显著提升了导航成功率，并有效减少了危险事件的发生。代码及补充材料已开源，地址为：https://github.com/Taekmino/LaC。实验所使用的机器人平台为
Unitree Go1 四足机器人，其路径规划采用 D* Lite 算法，控制层则使用 MPPI 方法。
Robots operating in human-centric or hazardous environments must proactively anticipate and mitigate dangers beyond basic obstacle detection. Traditional navigation systems often depend on static maps, which struggle to account for dynamic risks, such as a person emerging from a suddenly opening door. As a result, these systems tend to be reactive rather than anticipatory when handling dynamic hazards. Recent advancements in pre-trained large language models and vision-language models (VLMs) create new opportunities for proactive hazard avoidance. In this work, we propose a zero-shot language-as-cost mapping framework that leverages VLMs to interpret visual scenes, assess potential dynamic risks, and assign risk-aware navigation costs preemptively, enabling robots to anticipate hazards before they materialize. By integrating this language-based cost map with a geometric obstacle map, the robot not only identifies existing obstacles but also anticipates and proactively plans around potential hazards arising from environmental dynamics. Experiments in simulated and diverse dynamic environments demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves navigation success rates and reduces hazard encounters, compared to reactive baseline planners. Code and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/Taekmino/LaC. The robot platform was a quadruped robot Unitree Go1, which executed the D* Lite algorithm [25] for path planning and MPPI for control [26].
Traversability-Aware Legged Navigation by Learning from Real-World Visual Data
通过学习真实世界视觉数据实现可通行性感知腿式导航
足式运动带来的机动性提升使四足机器人能够在复杂、非结构化环境中灵活行走。然而，在兼顾不同地形通行所需能量差异的同时实现敏捷运动优化，仍然是一个亟待解决的难题。以往研究多侧重于基于人工标注环境特征的可通行性代价估计进行轨迹规划，但这种以人为中心的方法难以反映机器人在复杂地形上实际运动控制能力的差异，因而存在明显局限性。为此，本文提出了一种以机器人为中心的可通行性估计方法，该方法基于机器人运动控制器的价值函数，从控制层能力出发评估地形通行难度，并将其融入一种新的基于学习的 RGB-D 导航框架中。该框架通过多阶段训练，学习得到一个能够在避开障碍物和高难度地形的同时引导机器人到达目标位置的规划器。导航规划器的训练直接在真实环境中完成，采用了一种样本效率高的强化学习方法，联合利用在线交互数据与离线数据集进行学习。大量基准实验表明，所提出的框架在可通行性代价的精确估计以及多模态数据（包括彩色视觉、深度视觉和本体感知反馈）的高效学习方面均取得了最佳性能。借助该方法，四足机器人能够通过试错学习，在多种真实世界复杂地形环境中实现具备可通行性感知的自主导航，即便在仅依赖深度视觉难以区分的地形条件下亦能稳定运行。此外，机器人还展现出将所学导航能力泛化至未知场景的能力。相关实验视频可见：https://youtu.be/RSqnIWZ1qks。实验均在
Unitree Go1 四足机器人平台上完成。
The enhanced mobility brought by legged locomotion empowers quadrupedal robots to navigate through complex and unstructured environments. However, optimizing agile locomotion while accounting for the varying energy costs of traversing different terrains remains an open challenge. Most previous work focuses on planning trajectories with traversability cost estimation based on human-labeled environmental features. However, this human-centric approach is insufficient because it does not account for the varying capabilities of the robot locomotion controllers over challenging terrains. To address this, we develop a novel traversability estimator in a robot-centric manner, based on the value function of the robot’s locomotion controller. This estimator is integrated into a new learningbased RGBD navigation framework. The framework employs multiple training stages to develop a planner that guides the robot in avoiding obstacles and hard-to-traverse terrains while reaching its goals. The training of the navigation planner is directly performed in the real world using a sample efficient reinforcement learning method that utilizes both online data and offline datasets. Through extensive benchmarking, we demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves the best performance in accurate traversability cost estimation and efficient learning from multi-modal data (including the robot’s color and depth vision, as well as proprioceptive feedback) for realworld training. Using the proposed method, a quadrupedal robot learns to perform traversability-aware navigation through trial and error in various real-world environments with challenging terrains that are difficult to classify using depth vision alone. Moreover, the robot demonstrates the ability to generalize the learned navigation skills to unseen scenarios. Video can be found at https://youtu.be/RSqnIWZ1qks. The experiments are conducted on a quadrupedal robot (Unitree Go1).
Towards Safe Imitation Learning via Potential Field-Guided Flow Matching
基于势场引导流匹配的安全模仿学习
深度生成模型，尤其是扩散模型（Diffusion Models）和流匹配模型（Flow Matching Models），近期在通过模仿学习掌握复杂策略方面展现出了巨大的潜力。然而，生成动作的安全性在很大程度上仍被忽视，尤其是在存在固有障碍物的复杂环境中。在本文中，我们针对这一关键空白提出了势场引导的流匹配策略（Potential Field-Guided Flow Matching Policy, PF2MP）。这是一种全新的方法，能够从同一组成功的演示数据中，在学习任务策略的同时提取出以势场形式表示的障碍物相关信息。在推理阶段，PF2MP 通过学习到的势场来调制流匹配向量场，从而实现安全的动作生成。通过利用这些互补的场，我们的方法在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下，显著提升了在导航任务和机器人操作等多样化环境中的安全性。我们在仿真和真实世界设置中对 PF2MP 进行了评估，验证了其在任务空间和关节空间控制中的有效性。实验结果表明，与基准策略相比，PF2MP 显著增强了安全性并大幅减少了碰撞次数。这项工作为在非结构化且障碍密集的复杂环境中实现更安全的运动生成铺平了道路。最后，我们在由 Unitree B2 机器人底座和 Unitree Z1 机械臂组成的实机平台上验证了 PF2MP 的实际表现。
Deep generative models, particularly diffusion and flow matching models, have recently shown remarkable potential in learning complex policies through imitation learning. However, the safety of generated motions remains overlooked, particularly in complex environments with inherent obstacles. In this work, we address this critical gap by proposing Potential Field-Guided Flow Matching Policy (PF2MP), a novel approach that simultaneously learns task policies and extracts obstaclerelated information, represented as a potential field, from the same set of successful demonstrations. During inference, PF2MP modulates the flow matching vector field via the learned potential field, enabling safe motion generation. By leveraging these complementary fields, our approach achieves improved safety without compromising task success across diverse environments, such as navigation tasks and robotic manipulation scenarios. We evaluate PF2MP in both simulation and real-world settings, demonstrating its effectiveness in task space and joint space control. Experimental results demonstrate that PF2MP enhances safety, achieving a significant reduction of collisions compared to baseline policies. This work paves the way for safer motion generation in unstructured and obstaclerich environments. Finally, we evaluate PF2MP in a real-world scenario for a task executed on the Unitree Z1 robot arm mounted on a Unitree B2 base.
DeFM: Learning Foundation Representations from Depth for Robotics
DeFM：基于深度信息的机器人基础表征学习
深度传感器已广泛部署于各类机器人平台，而高速、高保真深度仿真技术的进步，使得基于深度观测训练的机器人策略能够在多种任务中实现稳健的“从仿真到现实”（sim-to-real）迁移。尽管如此，相较于大规模基础模型已确立领先地位的 RGB 模态，深度模态的表示学习仍处于开发不足的状态。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 DeFM：一个完全基于深度图像训练、专为机器人应用设计的自监督基础模型。通过在包含 6000 万张深度图像的精选数据集上采用 DINO 风格的自蒸馏目标函数，DeFM 学习到了能够泛化至多种环境、任务和传感器的几何与语义表示。为了在多尺度下保持度量感知（metric awareness）能力，我们引入了一种新颖的输入归一化策略。此外，我们将 DeFM 进一步蒸馏为紧凑型模型，以适配资源受限的机器人系统。在基于深度的分类、分割、导航、足式运动和机械臂操作等基准测试中，DeFM 达到了当前最先进（SOTA）的性能，并展现出从仿真到真实环境的强大泛化能力。我们开源了所有预训练模型，这些模型无需特定任务的微调，即可直接用于基于深度的机器人学习任务。项目主页：https://de-fm.github.io/。在具身感知点目标导航（章节 VI-B）中：利用 Unitree B2W 轮足机器人，这一远程任务 [18] 测试了必须处理机器人运动学特征和物理足迹的导航策略，其核心在于实现精确的几何障碍物规避。
Depth sensors are widely deployed across robotic platforms, and advances in fast, high-fidelity depth simulation have enabled robotic policies trained on depth observations to achieve robust sim-to-real transfer for a wide range of tasks. Despite this, representation learning for depth modality remains underexplored compared to RGB, where large-scale foundation models now define the state of the art. To address this gap, we present DeFM, a self-supervised foundation model trained entirely on depth images for robotic applications. Using a DINOstyle self-distillation objective on a curated dataset of 60M depth images, DeFM learns geometric and semantic representations that generalize to diverse environments, tasks, and sensors. To retain metric awareness across multiple scales, we introduce a novel input normalization strategy. We further distill DeFM into compact models suitable for resource-constrained robotic systems. When evaluated on depth-based classification, segmentation, navigation, locomotion, and manipulation benchmarks, DeFM achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong generalization from simulation to real-world environments. We release all our pretrained models, which can be adopted off-the-shelf for depth-based robotic learning without task-specific fine-tuning.
