Online Hierarchical Policy Learning using Physics Priors for Robot Navigation in Unknown Environments
基于物理先验的在线分层策略学习在未知环境下的机器人导航中应用
在大型、复杂且未知的室内环境中实现机器人自主导航是一项极具挑战性的任务。现有方法中，传统基于采样的规划算法在分辨率控制与可扩展性方面存在不足，而基于模仿学习的方法则高度依赖大量示范数据。近年来，主动神经时间场（Active Neural Time Fields，ANTFields）通过利用局部观测学习到达目标的代价函数、且无需示范数据，展现出良好的应用前景。然而，这类方法在复杂场景中仍受到谱偏置和灾难性遗忘等问题的制约，显著削弱了其实际效果。为此，本文将导航规划问题分解为一种分层结构：在高层规划中，通过稀疏图建模环境的全局连通性；在低层规划中，基于神经场的局部规划器通过求解 Eikonal 偏微分方程，实现对局部障碍物的精细避让。这种融合物理约束的策略有效克服了谱偏置和神经场拟合困难等常见问题，从而获得平滑且精确的代价空间表示。我们在大规模环境中对该框架进行了验证，实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在适应性和规划精度方面均具有明显优势，并展现出在在线探索、建图以及真实世界导航任务中的应用潜力。两种实验设置均采用配备 PandarXT-16 激光雷达传感器的 Unitree B1 四足机器人作为实验平台。
Robot navigation in large, complex, and unknown indoor environments is a challenging problem. The existing approaches, such as traditional sampling-based methods, struggle with resolution control and scalability, while imitation learning-based methods require a large amount of demonstration data. Active Neural Time Fields (ANTFields) have recently emerged as a promising solution by using local observations to learn cost-to-go functions without relying on demonstrations. Despite their potential, these methods are hampered by challenges such as spectral bias and catastrophic forgetting, which diminish their effectiveness in complex scenarios. To address these issues, our approach decomposes the planning problem into a hierarchical structure. At the high level, a sparse graph captures the environment’s global connectivity, while at the low level, a planner based on neural fields navigates local obstacles by solving the Eikonal PDE. This physics-informed strategy overcomes common pitfalls like spectral bias and neural field fitting difficulties, resulting in a smooth and precise representation of the cost landscape. We validate our framework in large-scale environments, demonstrating its enhanced adaptability and precision compared to previous methods, and highlighting its potential for online exploration, mapping, and real-world navigation. For both setups, we used a Unitree B1 quadruped robot equipped with a PandarXT-16 LiDAR sensor for perception.
LoopSR: Looping Sim-and-Real for Lifelong Policy Adaptation of Legged Robots
LoopSR：循环模拟与现实以实现腿式机器人的终身政策适应
Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown its remarkable and generalizable capability in legged locomotion through sim-to-real transfer. However, while adaptive methods like domain randomization are expected to make policy more robust to diverse environments, such comprehensiveness potentially detracts from the policy's performance in any specific environment according to the No Free Lunch theorem, leading to a suboptimal solution once deployed in the real world. To address this issue, we propose a lifelong policy adaptation framework named LoopSR, which utilizes a transformerbased encoder to project real-world trajectories into a latent space, and accordingly reconstruct the real-world environments back in simulation for further improvement. Autoencoder architecture and contrastive learning methods are adopted to better extract the characteristics of real-world dynamics. The simulation parameters for continual training are derived by combining predicted parameters from the decoder with retrieved parameters from the simulation trajectory dataset. By leveraging the continual training, LoopSR achieves superior data efficiency compared with strong baselines, with only a limited amount of data to yield eminent performance in both sim-to-sim and sim-to-real experiments. For real-world evaluations, we utilize the Unitree A1 robot to facilitate real-world deployment.
强化学习（Reinforcement Learning，RL）通过仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移，在足式机器人运动控制中展现了卓越且具有良好泛化性的能力。然而，诸如域随机化等自适应方法虽然旨在提升策略在多样环境下的鲁棒性，但根据“无免费午餐”定理，这种过度的通用性往往会牺牲策略在特定环境中的最优性能，导致策略在真实部署时仅能达到次优效果。为此，本文提出了一种名为 LoopSR 的终身策略自适应框架。该框架利用基于 Transformer 的编码器将真实世界中的运动轨迹映射到潜在空间，并据此在仿真中重构对应的真实环境，以实现策略的持续改进。我们采用自编码器结构与对比学习方法，更有效地提取真实世界动力学特征。持续训练所需的仿真参数通过融合解码器预测的参数与仿真轨迹数据集中检索得到的参数共同生成。借助这种持续训练机制，LoopSR 在数据效率方面显著优于强基线方法，仅需少量真实数据便可在仿真到仿真（sim-to-sim）以及仿真到现实（sim-to-real）实验中取得优异性能。在真实世界评估中，我们使用 Unitree A1 四足机器人作为实验平台，验证了该方法在实际部署中的有效性。
From knowing to doing Learning diverse motor skills through instruction learning
从知到行：通过指导学习掌握各种运动技能
近年来，机器人学习领域取得了诸多成功进展。然而，对于接触丰富的机器人任务而言，单纯依靠强化学习来学习协调的运动技能仍然具有较大挑战。模仿学习通过引入模仿奖励，鼓励机器人跟踪给定的参考轨迹，从而在一定程度上缓解了这一问题，但其学习效率较低，且容易对最终学到的运动形式产生约束。为此，本文提出了一种全新的“指令学习”（Instruction Learning）方法，该方法受人类学习过程启发，具有高效、灵活且通用的特点，适用于机器人运动技能学习。与模仿学习在奖励函数中引入参考信号不同，指令学习将参考信号直接作为前馈动作输入，并与通过强化学习获得的反馈动作相结合，共同控制机器人运动。此外，本文提出了一种动作约束技术，并去除了模仿奖励，实验表明这对于实现高效且灵活的学习至关重要。通过与模仿学习方法的对比实验，我们验证了指令学习不仅能够显著加快训练速度，还能确保机器人准确学习到期望的运动行为。本文在多种双足机器人和四足机器人运动学习任务中验证了指令学习的有效性，相关技能通常仅需数百万步即可学成。此外，我们还在真实四足机器人平台上开展了仿真到现实迁移以及在线学习实验。实验中设置了两组 sim-to-real 迁移方案：一组使用 Raisim 仿真软件并在 Unitree A1 四足机器人上进行验证，另一组使用 Isaac Gym 仿真平台并在 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上进行实验。指令学习展现出显著优势与应用潜力，是一种有望替代模仿学习的有效方法。
Recent years have witnessed many successful trials in the robot learning field. For contact-rich robotic tasks, it is challenging to learn coordinated motor skills by reinforcement learning. Imitation learning solves this problem by using a mimic reward to encourage the robot to track a given reference trajectory. However, imitation learning is not so efficient and may constrain the learned motion. In this paper, we propose instruction learning, which is inspired by the human learning process and is highly efficient, flexible, and versatile for robot motion learning. Instead of using a reference signal in the reward, instruction learning applies a reference signal directly as a feedforward action, and it is combined with a feedback action learned by reinforcement learning to control the robot. Besides, we propose the action bounding technique and remove the mimic reward, which is shown to be crucial for efficient and flexible learning. We compare the performance of instruction learning with imitation learning, indicating that instruction learning can greatly speed up the training process and guarantee learning the desired motion correctly. The effectiveness of instruction learning is validated through a bunch of motion learning examples for a biped robot and a quadruped robot, where skills can be learned typically within several million steps. Besides, we also conduct sim-to-real transfer and online learning experiments on a real quadruped robot. Instruction learning has shown great merits and potential, making it a promising alternative for imitation learning. We have two groups working on the sim-to-real transfer. One group uses the Raisim software and the Unitree A1 robot, while the other group uses the IsaacGym software and the Unitree Go1 robot.
UNCLE-Grasp: Uncertainty-Aware Grasping of Leaf-Occluded Strawberries
UNCLE-Grasp 不确定性感知抓取叶片遮挡的草莓
在存在部分遮挡的情况下，机器人草莓采摘面临显著挑战：叶片会引入较大的几何不确定性，使得基于单一确定性形状估计所做出的抓取决策变得不可靠。对于一次不完整的观测，往往可能对应多种彼此不一致的三维形状补全结果，在某一补全结果上看似可行的抓取，在另一种补全结果下却可能失败。为此，本文提出了一种面向部分遮挡草莓的、不确定性感知抓取流程，显式建模由遮挡以及学习式形状重建所带来的补全不确定性。该方法利用带有 Monte Carlo dropout 的点云补全网络对目标形状进行多次采样，生成多种形状假设；针对每一种补全结果生成候选抓取，并基于具有物理意义的力闭合指标评估其抓取可行性。不同于基于单一估计进行抓取选择，我们在多种形状补全结果上对抓取可行性进行聚合，并采用保守的下置信界（Lower Confidence Bound，LCB）准则来决定是否执行抓取，或在风险较高时安全放弃。我们在仿真环境和真实机器人平台上，对不同程度的合成与真实叶片遮挡条件下的方法进行了评估。实验结果表明，不确定性感知的决策机制能够在严重遮挡情况下可靠地避免高风险抓取，同时在几何置信度充足时保持稳健的抓取执行性能，在仿真和真实机器人实验中均优于确定性基线方法。该系统使用安装在 Unitree Z1 机械臂上的 Intel RealSense D435i RGB-D 相机进行感知。
Robotic strawberry harvesting is challenging under partial occlusion, where leaves induce significant geometric uncertainty and make grasp decisions based on a single deterministic shape estimate unreliable. From a single partial observation, multiple incompatible 3D completions may be plausible, causing grasps that appear feasible on one completion to fail on another. We propose an uncertainty-aware grasping pipeline for partially occluded strawberries that explicitly models completion uncertainty arising from both occlusion and learned shape reconstruction. Our approach uses point cloud completion with Monte Carlo dropout to sample multiple shape hypotheses, generates candidate grasps for each completion, and evaluates grasp feasibility using physically grounded force-closure–based metrics. Rather than selecting a grasp based on a single estimate, we aggregate feasibility across completions and apply a conservative lower confidence bound (LCB) criterion to decide whether a grasp should be attempted or safely abstained. We evaluate the proposed method in simulation and on a physical robot across increasing levels of synthetic and real leaf occlusion. Results show that uncertaintyaware decision making enables reliable abstention from highrisk grasp attempts under severe occlusion while maintaining robust grasp execution when geometric confidence is sufficient, outperforming deterministic baselines in both simulated and physical robot experiments. The system interfaces with an Intel RealSense D435i RGB-D camera mounted on a Unitree Z1 robotic arm.
VTAO-BiManip Masked Visual-Tactile-Action Pre-training with Object Understanding for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
VTAO-BiManip：基于物体理解的掩蔽视觉-触觉-动作预训练用于双手灵巧操作
由于每只手具有高自由度且需要精密协同，双手灵巧操作始终是机器人领域中的一项重大挑战。现有的单手操作方法通常依赖人类示范来引导强化学习过程，但在涉及多种子技能的复杂双手操作任务中往往难以泛化。本文提出了一种新的框架 VTAO-BiManip，将视觉-触觉-动作预训练与物体理解相结合，旨在通过课程化强化学习（Curriculum RL）实现类人化的双手操作能力。相较于以往方法，我们在预训练阶段引入了手部运动数据，为双手协同提供了更有效的引导。所提出的预训练模型在掩码多模态输入条件下，同时预测未来动作以及物体的位姿和尺寸，从而实现跨模态正则化。针对多技能学习带来的训练不稳定问题，我们设计了一种两阶段的课程强化学习策略，以提升训练过程的稳定性。我们在双手拧瓶盖任务上对该方法进行了评估，结果表明其在仿真环境和真实世界实验中均表现出良好效果。与现有视觉-触觉预训练方法相比，该方法的成功率提升超过 20%。此外，我们搭建了一个真实世界实验平台，采用配备触觉传感器的双 Leap Hands 以及一台 Unitree Z1 机械臂。
Bimanual dexterous manipulation remains a significant challenge in robotics due to the high DoFs of each hand and their coordination. Existing single-hand manipulation techniques often leverage human demonstrations to guide RL methods but fail to generalize to complex bimanual tasks involving multiple sub-skills. In this paper, we propose VTAOBiManip, a novel framework that integrates visual-tactileaction pre-training with object understanding, aiming to enable human-like bimanual manipulation via curriculum reinforcement learning (RL). We improve prior learning by incorporating hand motion data, providing more effective guidance for dual-hand coordination. Our pretraining model predicts future actions as well as object pose and size using masked multimodal inputs, facilitating cross-modal regularization. To address the multi-skill learning challenge, we introduce a two-stage curriculum RL approach to stabilize training. We evaluate our method on a bimanual bottle-cap twisting task, demonstrating its effectiveness in both simulated and realworld environments. Our approach achieves a success rate that surpasses existing visual-tactile pretraining methods by over 20%. We create a real-world experimental platform with dual Leap Hands equipped with tactile sensors and a Unitree Z1 arm
GPO Growing Policy Optimization for Legged Robot Locomotion and Whole-Body Control
GPO 增长策略优化用于腿式机器人运动和全身控制
由于动作空间维度高、硬件约束严格以及探索能力受限，针对足式机器人的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning，RL）策略训练仍然面临诸多挑战。现有的运动与全身控制方法在基于位置控制的场景中表现良好，通常依赖环境相关的启发式设计（如奖励塑形、课程学习和人工初始化），但在基于力矩控制的情形下效果显著下降，因为此时对动作空间进行充分探索并获得有效的梯度信号要困难得多。为此，我们提出了一种名为 Growing Policy Optimization（GPO）的训练框架，通过引入一种随时间变化的动作变换，在训练初期限制有效动作空间，从而促进更高效的数据采集与策略学习，随后逐步放宽该限制以增强探索能力并提升期望回报。我们从理论上证明了该动作变换能够保持 PPO 的更新规则不变，仅引入有界且逐渐消失的梯度畸变，从而保证训练过程的稳定性。我们在四足和六足机器人上对 GPO 进行了系统评估，并实现了将仿真中训练得到的策略零样本部署到真实硬件平台。实验结果表明，采用 GPO 训练的策略在各类任务中均取得了更优性能，验证了其作为一种通用、与环境无关的足式运动学习优化框架的有效性。为进一步验证 GPO 的实际效果，我们将学习到的策略部署在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上，并与多种代表性基线方法进行了对比，包括基于力矩的 PPO、纯力矩 DeCAP 以及位置辅助 DeCAP。
Training reinforcement learning (RL) policies for legged robots remains challenging due to high-dimensional continuous actions, hardware constraints, and limited exploration. Existing methods for locomotion and whole-body control work well for position-based control with environment-specific heuristics (e.g., reward shaping, curriculum design, and manual initialization), but are less effective for torque-based control, where sufficiently exploring the action space and obtaining informative gradient signals for training is significantly more difficult. We introduce Growing Policy Optimization (GPO), a training framework that applies a time-varying action transformation to restrict the effective action space in the early stage, thereby encouraging more effective data collection and policy learning, and then progressively expands it to enhance exploration and achieve higher expected return. We prove that this transformation preserves the PPO update rule and introduces only bounded, vanishing gradient distortion, thereby ensuring stable training. We evaluate GPO on both quadruped and hexapod robots, including zero-shot deployment of simulation-trained policies on hardware. Policies trained with GPO consistently achieve better performance. These results suggest that GPO provides a general, environment-agnostic optimization framework for learning legged locomotion. To validate the effectiveness of GPO, we deploy the learned policy on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot and compare it against several representative baselines, including torque-based PPO, Pure Torque DeCAP, and Positionassisted DeCAP.
Spatially-enhanced recurrent memory for long-range mapless navigation via end-to-end reinforcement learning
通过端到端强化学习实现空间增强型循环记忆在长距离无地图导航中的应用
近年来，机器人导航领域，尤其是强化学习（Reinforcement Learning，RL）等端到端学习方法，展现出了显著的效率与性能提升。然而，无论是显式还是隐式实现，成功的导航始终依赖于两项核心能力：建图与规划。传统方法通常依赖显式建图流程，将以自我为中心的观测信息进行转换与配准，构建统一地图供规划模块使用；而端到端学习方法则多通过循环神经网络（RNN）将当前与历史观测融合至潜在空间中，从而隐式完成建图与规划。尽管现有结构（如 LSTM 和 GRU）能够建模时间依赖关系，但我们的研究发现其存在一个关键缺陷：难以有效进行空间记忆，而这一能力对于从不同视角下的连续观测中构建和整合空间表示、支撑导航规划至关重要。为此，本文提出了一种空间增强循环单元（Spatially-Enhanced Recurrent Units，SRUs），通过对现有 RNN 的简单而有效的改造，显著提升其空间记忆能力。在此基础上，我们进一步提出了一种融合 SRUs 的注意力机制网络架构，使机器人仅依靠单一前向立体相机即可实现长距离、无显式地图的导航。此外，我们引入了一系列正则化技术，以提升基于强化学习的端到端循环训练过程的稳定性与鲁棒性。实验结果表明，与现有 RNN 方法相比，我们的方法在长距离导航任务中的整体性能提升达 23.5%；同时，在引入 SRU 记忆机制后，该方法分别优于两种强化学习基线方案——一种依赖显式建图，另一种依赖历史观测堆叠——在需要长时程建图与记忆能力的多样化环境中，整体性能提升分别达到 29.6% 和 105.0%。最后，为缓解仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距问题，我们利用大规模合成深度数据进行预训练，实现了在复杂多样真实环境中的零样本部署。
Recent advancements in robot navigation, particularly with end-to-end learning approaches such as reinforcement learning (RL), have demonstrated remarkable efficiency and effectiveness. However, successful navigation still fundamentally depends on two key capabilities: mapping and planning, whether implemented explicitly or implicitly. Classical approaches rely on explicit mapping pipelines to transform and register egocentric observations into a coherent map for the planning module. In contrast, end-to-end learning often achieves this implicitly—through recurrent neural networks (RNNs) that fuse current and historical observations into a latent space for planning. While existing architectures, such as LSTM and GRU, can capture temporal dependencies, our findings reveal a critical limitation: their inability to effectively perform spatial memorization. This capability is essential for transforming and integrating sequential observations from varying perspectives to build spatial representations that support planning tasks. To address this, we propose spatially-enhanced recurrent units (SRUs)—a simple yet effective modification to existing RNNs—that enhance spatial memorization. To improve navigation performance, we introduce an attention-based network architecture integrated with SRUs, enabling long-range mapless navigation using a single forward-facing stereo camera. Additionally, we employ regularization techniques to facilitate robust end-to-end recurrent training via RL. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves long-range navigation performance by 23.5% overall compared to existing RNNs. Furthermore, when equipped with SRU memory, our method outperforms both RL baseline approaches—one relying on explicit mapping and the other on stacked historical observations—achieving overall improvements of 29.6% and 105.0%, respectively, in diverse environments that require long-horizon mapping and memorization capabilities. Finally, we address the sim-to-real gap by leveraging large-scale pretraining on synthetic depth data, enabling zero-shot transfer for deployment across diverse and complex real-world environments.
Contact-Anchored Proprioceptive Odometry for Quadruped Robots
基于接触锚定的四足机器人本体感觉里程计
在缺乏相机或激光雷达的情况下，实现足式机器人的可靠里程计仍然充满挑战，主要原因在于 IMU 漂移以及关节速度测量噪声。本文提出了一种纯本体感知状态估计方法，仅依赖 IMU 和电机测量数据，对机体位姿与速度进行联合估计，并采用统一建模框架，适用于双足、四足及轮足机器人。其核心思想是将每条处于接触状态的支撑腿视为运动学锚点：通过基于关节力矩的足端力/力矩估计筛选可靠接触点，并利用相应的落足位置在世界坐标系下提供间歇性约束，从而有效抑制长期漂移。为防止长时间运动中的高度漂移问题，本文提出了一种轻量级的高度聚类与时间衰减校正方法，将新记录的落足高度对齐至先前观测到的支撑平面。针对编码器量化误差对足端速度观测的影响，采用基于逆运动学的立方容积卡尔曼滤波方法，直接从关节角度与角速度中滤波估计足端速度。在实现层面，该方法通过多接触几何一致性约束进一步抑制航向角漂移，并在 IMU 航向约束不可用或不可靠时，能够平滑退化为基于运动学推导的航向参考。我们在四个平台上对该方法进行了闭环轨迹实验验证，包括三台 Astrall 四足机器人和一台 Unitree Go2 EDU。在 Astrall A 型点足机器人上，约 200 米水平闭环和约 15 米垂直闭环的回环误差分别为 0.1638 米和 0.219 米；在 B 型轮足机器人上，对应误差分别为 0.2264 米和 0.199 米。在 C 型轮足机器人上，约 700 米水平闭环的误差为 7.68 米，约 20 米垂直闭环的误差为 0.540 米。Unitree Go2 EDU 在约 120 米水平闭环中的误差为 2.2138 米，在约 8 米垂直闭环中的高度误差小于 0.1 米。我们已公开完整实现代码（github.com/ShineMinxing/Ros2Go2Estimator.git）以及 Go2 EDU 实验的 ROS 数据包（含同步视频），以支持可复现评估。
Reliable odometry for legged robots without cameras or LiDAR remains challenging due to IMU
drift and noisy joint velocity sensing. This paper presents a purely proprioceptive state estimator that uses
only IMU and motor measurements to jointly estimate body pose and velocity, with a unified formulation
applicable to biped, quadruped, and wheel-legged robots. The key idea is to treat each contacting
leg as a kinematic anchor: joint-torque–based foot wrench estimation selects reliable contacts, and the
corresponding footfall positions provide intermittent world-frame constraints that suppress long-term drift.
To prevent elevation drift during extended traversal, we introduce a lightweight height clustering and timedecay correction that snaps newly recorded footfall heights to previously observed support planes. To
improve foot velocity observations under encoder quantization, we apply an inverse-kinematics cubature
Kalman filter that directly filters foot-end velocities from joint angles and velocities. The implementation
further mitigates yaw drift through multi-contact geometric consistency and degrades gracefully to a
kinematics-derived heading reference when IMU yaw constraints are unavailable or unreliable.
We evaluate the method on four quadruped platforms (three Astrall robots and a Unitree Go2
EDU) using closed-loop trajectories. On Astrall point-foot robot A, a ∼200 m horizontal loop and a
∼15 m vertical loop return with 0.1638 m and 0.219 m error, respectively; on wheel-legged robot B, the
corresponding errors are 0.2264 m and 0.199 m. On wheel-legged robot C, a ∼700 m horizontal loop
yields 7.68 m error and a ∼20 m vertical loop yields 0.540 m error. Unitree Go2 EDU closes a ∼120 m
horizontal loop with 2.2138 m error and a ∼8 m vertical loop with less than 0.1 m vertical error. We
publicly release the complete implementation (github.com/ShineMinxing/Ros2Go2Estimator.git) and the
ROS bags of the Go2 EDU trials, including synchronized video, to enable reproducible evaluation.
Toward Reliable Sim-to-Real Predictability for MoE-based Robust Quadrupedal Locomotion
面向基于运动学模型的稳健四足运动的可靠仿真到实际可预测性
强化学习在四足机器人敏捷运动控制方面展现出强大潜力，即便仅依赖本体感知信息也能实现优异表现。然而在实际应用中，仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距以及复杂地形下的奖励过拟合问题，往往导致策略难以有效迁移，而实体测试本身又存在风险高、效率低等局限。为应对上述挑战，本文提出了一套统一框架，包括基于专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）的多地形运动控制策略，以及名为 RoboGauge 的预测评估系统，用于量化仿真到现实的可迁移性。该 MoE 策略通过门控机制调度一组专门化专家网络，对潜在地形特征与运动指令建模进行解耦分解，仅凭本体感知信息即可实现更强的部署鲁棒性与泛化能力。RoboGauge 则通过在不同地形类型、难度等级和域随机化条件下开展仿真到仿真（sim-to-sim）测试，构建多维本体感知评估指标体系，从而在无需大量实体实验的情况下，实现对 MoE 策略的可靠筛选与预测评估。基于 Unitree Go2 的实验结果表明，该方法在多种未见过的复杂地形上均实现了稳健运动，包括雪地、沙地、楼梯、坡地以及 30 cm 高障碍物。在专门的高速测试中，机器人最高速度达到 4 m/s，并在高速运动状态下自发形成窄步态模式，表现出与高速稳定性提升相关的涌现行为。
Reinforcement learning has shown strong promise for quadrupedal agile locomotion, even with proprioception-only sensing. In practice, however, sim-to-real gap and reward overfitting in complex terrains can produce policies that fail to transfer, while physical validation remains risky and inefficient. To address these challenges, we introduce a unified framework encompassing a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) locomotion policy for robust multiterrain representation with RoboGauge, a predictive assessment suite that quantifies sim-to-real transferability. The MoE policy employs a gated set of specialist experts to decompose latent terrain and command modeling, achieving superior deployment robustness and generalization via proprioception alone. RoboGauge further provides multi-dimensional proprioception-based metrics via sim-to-sim tests over terrains, difficulty levels, and domain randomizations, enabling reliable MoE policy selection without extensive physical trials. Experiments on a Unitree Go2 demonstrate robust locomotion on unseen challenging terrains, including snow, sand, stairs, slopes, and 30 cm obstacles. In dedicated high-speed tests, the robot reaches 4 m/s and exhibits an emergent narrow-width gait associated with improved stability at high velocity.
UEREBot: Learning Safe Quadrupedal Locomotion under Unstructured Environments and High-Speed Dynamic Obstacles
UEREBot 在非结构化环境和高速动态障碍物下学习安全的四足运动
四足机器人正日益被部署于非结构化环境中。在此类场景下实现安全运动，需要同时满足长时域目标推进能力、复杂地形与静态约束条件下的可通行性，以及对高速动态障碍物的碰撞规避。然而，单一系统往往难以同时兼顾这三项目标：基于规划的方法可能响应过慢，而纯反应式方法则可能牺牲目标推进效率与地形通过能力。为解决这一矛盾，本文提出 UEREBot（Unstructured-Environment Reflexive Evasion Robot，非结构化环境反射式规避机器人）分层框架，将相对缓慢的全局规划与瞬时反射式规避机制相分离，并在执行过程中实现协调融合。UEREBot 将任务建模为受约束最优控制问题的蓝图结构，采用时空规划器为机器人提供面向目标的参考引导与威胁信号；随后通过一种具备威胁感知能力的切换机制，将导航决策与反射动作融合为名义控制指令，并利用控制障碍函数（Control Barrier Function, CBF）屏障作为最终执行安全保障。我们在 Isaac Lab 仿真环境中对 UEREBot 进行了系统评估，并将其部署于搭载机载感知系统的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上进行验证。在包含复杂静态结构与高速动态障碍物的多样化环境中，UEREBot 相较于代表性基线方法实现了更高的避障成功率和更稳定的运动表现，同时保持了持续的目标推进能力，展现出更优的安全性与效率权衡。
Quadruped robots are increasingly deployed in unstructured environments. Safe locomotion in these settings requires long-horizon goal progress, passability over uneven terrain and static constraints, and collision avoidance against high-speed dynamic obstacles. A single system cannot fully satisfy all three objectives simultaneously: planning-based decisions can be too slow, while purely reactive decisions can sacrifice goal progress and passability. To resolve this conflict, we propose UEREBot (Unstructured-Environment Reflexive Evasion Robot), a hierarchical framework that separates slow planning from instantaneous reflexive evasion and coordinates them during execution. UEREBot formulates the task as a constrained optimal control problem blueprint. It adopts a spatial–temporal planner that provides reference guidance toward the goal and threat signals. It then uses a threat-aware handoff to fuse navigation and reflex actions into a nominal command, and a control barrier function shield as a final execution safeguard. We evaluate UEREBot in Isaac Lab simulation and deploy it on a Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with onboard perception. Across diverse environments with complex static structure and high-speed dynamic obstacles, UEREBot achieves higher avoidance success and more stable locomotion while maintaining goal progress than representative baselines, demonstrating improved safety–progress trade-offs.
Risk Awareness and Management for Autonomous Robots: Assessing Non-Perceivable Hazards through Context-Aware Safety Adaptation
自主机器人风险意识与管理：通过情境感知安全适应评估不可感知危险
自主机器人能够在多种复杂条件下运行，因此必须始终确保其行为安全。由此引出一个关键问题：如何全面界定所有不安全状态。在这一过程中，设备制造商有责任明确安全运行条件，而实际操作人员则负责确保这些条件得到满足。然而，随着应用场景日益多样化，制造商往往难以预知用户将如何使用机器人，使得制造商与操作人员之间的责任接口变得愈发复杂。此外，另一个挑战在于，某些危险情形无法仅凭传感器检测识别，而必须通过限制机器人的运行域来加以管理和规避。本文围绕上述挑战展开讨论，并提出一种将情境感知风险评估机制融入机器人运行时自主系统的方法。该方法的核心思想在真实车间场景中进行了验证，实验平台包括 Unitree Go2 足式机器人以及一辆自主驾驶的 Unimog 卡车。
Autonomous robots can operate under a wide range of conditions and must act safely. Accordingly, the question arises of how to describe all unsafe conditions. Here, machinery manufacturers are responsible for specifying safe operating conditions, but the operator is responsible for ensuring they are met. Therefore, this interface between manufacturers and operators is becoming increasingly challenging because manufacturers do not know how operators will use the robots. Moreover, a further challenge is that some dangerous situations cannot be detected solely by sensors and must be managed by restricting the robot’s operational domain. This paper discusses these challenges and proposes an approach to incorporate context-aware risk assessment into a robot’s runtime autonomy. The central idea is demonstrated using a Unitree Go2 legged robot and an autonomous Unimog truck in a realistic workshop scenario.
PRISM Performer RS-IMLE for Single-pass Multisensory Imitation Learning
PRISM：用于单次多感官模仿学习的表演者 RS-IMLE
机器人模仿学习通常要求模型在满足实时控制频率的同时，刻画多模态动作分布，并兼容多种感知模态。尽管近年来诸如扩散模型、流匹配（Flow Matching）以及隐式最大似然估计（IMLE）等生成式方法取得了令人鼓舞的成果，但它们往往只能满足上述需求中的一部分。为此，本文提出 PRISM，一种基于 IMLE 批量全局拒绝采样变体的单次前向（single-pass）策略。PRISM 将时序多模态感知编码器（融合 RGB、深度、触觉、音频及本体感知信息）与基于 Performer 架构的线性注意力生成器相结合，实现高效建模。我们在多种真实硬件平台上验证了 PRISM 的有效性，包括搭载 7 自由度机械臂 D1 的 Unitree GO2 进行的移动操作任务，以及基于 UR5 机械臂的桌面操作任务。在预操作泊车、高精度插入、多目标抓取与放置等具有挑战性的实体任务中，PRISM 在成功率上较当前最先进的扩散策略提升 10–25%，同时保持 30–50 Hz 的高频闭环控制能力。我们还在大规模仿真基准上对方法进行了验证，包括 CALVIN、MetaWorld 和 Robomimic。在 CALVIN（10% 数据划分）设置下，PRISM 的成功率相较扩散模型提升约 25%，相较流匹配方法提升约 20%，同时将轨迹抖动（jerk）降低 20 至 50 倍。上述结果表明，PRISM 在避免迭代采样带来时延的同时，兼顾了多模态动作覆盖能力，是一种兼具高速度、高精度与多感知融合能力的高效模仿学习策略。
Robotic imitation learning typically requires models that capture multimodal action distributions while operating at real-time control rates and accommodating multiple sensing modalities. Although recent generative approaches such as diffusion models, flow matching, and Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE) have achieved promising results, they often satisfy only a subset of these requirements. To address this, we introduce PRISM, a single-pass policy based on a batchglobal rejection-sampling variant of IMLE. PRISM couples a temporal multisensory encoder (integrating RGB, Depth, tactile, audio, and proprioception) with a linear-attention generator using a Performer architecture. We demonstrate the efficacy of PRISM on a diverse real-world hardware suite, including loco-manipulation using a Unitree GO2 with a 7-DoF arm D1 and tabletop manipulation with a UR5 manipulator. Across challenging physical tasks such as pre-manipulation parking, highprecision insertion, and multi-object pick-and-place, PRISM outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion policies by 10–25% in success rate while maintaining high-frequency (30–50 Hz) closedloop control. We further validate our approach on large-scale simulation benchmarks, including CALVIN, MetaWorld, and Robomimic. In CALVIN (10% data split), PRISM improves success rates by ∼25% over diffusion and ∼20% over flow matching, while simultaneously reducing trajectory jerk by 20×– 50×. These results position PRISM as a fast, accurate, and multisensory imitation policy that retains multimodal action coverage without the latency of iterative sampling.
Fast Task Planning with Neuro-Symbolic Relaxation
利用神经符号放松法进行快速任务规划
现实世界中的任务规划通常需要在包含大量对象及其复杂关系与属性的场景中进行长时域推理，这使得传统符号规划方法面临组合爆炸问题。为缩减搜索空间，近年来的方法通常依赖神经网络预测少量“重要”对象，仅在由这些对象构成的简化任务上进行优先搜索。然而，这种简单的神经-符号（NeSy）融合方式可能遗漏关键对象，或在不可解的简化任务上浪费计算资源。为实现快速且可靠的规划，本文提出一种 NeSy 松弛策略 Flax，将神经重要性预测与符号扩展机制相结合。具体而言，我们首先训练图神经网络预测对象的重要性，构建简化任务并利用符号规划器进行求解；随后，通过求解规则松弛后的任务快速获得一个粗略规划方案，并将该方案中涉及的所有对象重新整合回简化任务，以恢复可能被忽略但至关重要的元素；最后，应用互补规则对更新后的任务进行细化，使其在保持紧凑性的同时兼具可靠性。我们在合成与真实迷宫导航基准上开展了大量实验，任务要求机器人穿越迷宫并与可移动障碍物进行交互。实验结果表明，与当前最先进的 NeSy 基线方法相比，Flax 将平均成功率提升了 20.82%，并将平均实际规划时间缩短了 17.65%。我们认为，Flax 为复杂环境中实现快速、可扩展的长时域任务规划提供了一条切实可行的路径。为进一步验证 Flax 的实际应用能力，如图 6 所示，我们将训练完成的模型部署于一台 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台，该平台配备 Livox Mid-360 激光雷达、6 自由度 D1 机械臂以及安装于夹爪附近的 Intel RealSense D455 深度相机。
Real-world task planning requires long-horizon reasoning over large sets of objects with complex relationships and attributes, leading to a combinatorial explosion for classical symbolic planners. To prune the search space, recent methods prioritize searching on a simplified task only containing a few “important” objects predicted by a neural network. However, such a simple neuro-symbolic (NeSy) integration risks omitting critical objects and wasting resources on unsolvable simplified tasks. To enable Fast and reliable planning, we introduce a NeSy relaxation strategy (Flax), combining neural importance prediction with symbolic expansion. Specifically, we first learn a graph neural network to predict object importance to create a simplified task and solve it with a symbolic planner. Then, we solve a rule-relaxed task to obtain a quick rough plan, and reintegrate all referenced objects into the simplified task to recover any overlooked but essential elements. Finally, we apply complementary rules to refine the updated task, keeping it both reliable and compact. Extensive experiments are conducted on both synthetic and real-world maze navigation benchmarks where a robot must traverse through a maze and interact with movable obstacles. The results show that Flax boosts the average success rate by 20.82% and cuts mean wall-clock planning time by 17.65% compared with the state-of-the-art NeSy baseline. We expect that Flax offers a practical path toward fast, scalable, long-horizon task planning in complex environments. To further validate Flax’s practical applicability, as shown in Fig. 6, we deployed the trained model on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot equipped with a Livox Mid-360 LiDAR, a 6-DoF D1 manipulator, and an Intel RealSense D455 camera mounted near the gripper.
A Nonlinear MPC Framework for Loco-Manipulation of Quadrupedal Robots with Non-Negligible Manipulator Dynamics
具有不可忽略的机械臂动力学的四足机器人运动控制的非线性模型预测控制框架
模型预测控制（MPC）结合降阶模板模型已成为动态足式运动轨迹优化的有力工具。然而，当四足机器人执行移动操作任务（loco-manipulation）时，系统复杂度显著提升，尤其是在搭载高自由度机械臂且其动力学不可忽略的情况下，需要具备高计算效率的 MPC 算法以处理高自由度模型。本文提出一种针对四足机器人移动操作任务的高效非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）框架，适用于机械臂动力学与四足基座动力学耦合不可忽略的场景。该方法采用分解策略，将基于单刚体（Single Rigid Body, SRB）等模板的运动规划模型与机械臂的全阶动力学模型进行耦合，实现扭矩层级控制下的协同优化。该分解机制使得 NMPC 问题能够以滚动时域方式在 60 Hz 下高效求解。由 NMPC 生成的最优状态与输入轨迹用于运动层，由运行频率为 500 Hz 的低层非线性全身控制器（WBC）进行跟踪，而机械臂的最优扭矩指令则直接下发执行。该分层控制架构通过大量数值仿真与硬件实验进行验证，实验平台为一台 15 kg 的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人，其搭载 4.4 kg、4 自由度的 Kinova Arm 机械臂。由于 Kinova 机械臂的动力学相对于 Go2 基座不可忽略，所提出的 NMPC 框架在多种移动操作任务中表现出良好的鲁棒稳定性，能够有效应对外部扰动、负载变化以及不平整地形等挑战。
Model predictive control (MPC) combined with reduced-order template models has emerged as a powerful tool for trajectory optimization in dynamic legged locomotion. However, loco-manipulation tasks performed by legged robots introduce additional complexity, necessitating computationally efficient MPC algorithms capable of handling high-degree-offreedom (DoF) models. This letter presents a computationally efficient nonlinear MPC (NMPC) framework tailored for locomanipulation tasks of quadrupedal robots equipped with robotic manipulators whose dynamics are non-negligible relative to those of the quadruped. The proposed framework adopts a decomposition strategy that couples locomotion template models—such as the single rigid body (SRB) model—with a full-order dynamic model of the robotic manipulator for torque-level control. This decomposition enables efficient real-time solution of the NMPC problem in a receding horizon fashion at 60 Hz. The optimal state and input trajectories generated by the NMPC for locomotion are tracked by a low-level nonlinear whole-body controller (WBC) running at 500 Hz, while the optimal torque commands for the manipulator are directly applied. The layered control architecture is validated through extensive numerical simulations and hardware experiments on a 15-kg Unitree Go2 quadrupedal robot augmented with a 4.4-kg 4-DoF Kinova arm. Given that the Kinova arm dynamics are non-negligible relative to the Go2 base, the proposed NMPC framework demonstrates robust stability in performing diverse loco-manipulation tasks, effectively handling external disturbances, payload variations, and uneven terrain.
Evaluating Dynamic Surface Compensation for Robots with Projected AR
评估具有投影增强现实的机器人的动态表面补偿
基于投影仪的增强现实（AR）技术使机器人能够在无需头戴设备的情况下向多个观察者传达空间相关信息，例如投影导航路径等。然而，这类系统通常要求投影表面平整且纹理较弱；否则必须对表面进行补偿以保证投影图像的原始效果。但现有的补偿方法通常假设投影仪—相机—表面之间的配置是静态的，在复杂且纹理丰富的动态环境中（如机器人实际导航场景）往往难以适用。本文在一台 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上，在搜索与救援场景中针对不连续、非平面且纹理复杂的表面，对当前最先进的基于深度学习的投影补偿方法进行了实验评估。我们提供了关于这些方法关键性能局限性的实证分析，指出其普遍依赖预先标定且无法在机器人移动过程中实现实时自适应，从而揭示了静态补偿能力与动态机器人通信需求之间的根本性差距。基于此，我们提出未来研究方向，旨在实现面向动态环境的实时运动自适应投影补偿机制，以提升机器人通信在复杂场景中的实用性。
Projector-based augmented reality (AR) enables robots to communicate spatially-situated information to multiple observers without requiring head-mounted displays, e.g., projecting navigation path. However, they require flat and weakly textured projection surfaces; otherwise, the surface needs to be compensated to retain the original projected image. Yet, existing compensation methods assume static projector-camera-surface configurations and may not work in complex, textured environments where robots must navigate. In this work, we evaluate state-of-the-art deep learning-based projection compensation on a Go2 robot dog in a search-and-rescue scene with discontinuous, non-planar, strongly textured surfaces. We contribute empirical evidence on critical performance limitations of state-of-the-art compensation methods: the requirement of pre-calibration and inability to adapt in real-time as the robot moves, revealing a fundamental gap between static compensation capabilities and dynamic robot communication needs. We propose future directions for enabling real-time, motion-adaptive projection compensation for robot communication in dynamic environments.
Scaling Law of Neural Koopman Operators
神经库普曼算子的标度律
数据驱动的神经 Koopman 算子理论已成为非线性机器人系统线性化与控制的重要工具。然而，这类模型的性能本质上依赖于样本规模与模型潜在维度之间的权衡关系，而该尺度规律（scaling law）尚未被系统揭示。本文构建了一个严格的理论与实证框架，推导并验证了连接样本数量、潜在空间维度与下游控制性能之间的缩放规律。我们从理论上给出了 Koopman 逼近误差的上界，将其明确分解为采样误差与投影误差，并证明这两项误差随数据规模和潜在维度以特定速率衰减，从而为尺度规律提供了严格依据。基于理论分析结果，本文进一步提出两种轻量级正则化方法用于神经 Koopman 算子学习：协方差损失（covariance loss）用于稳定潜在特征结构，逆控制损失（inverse control loss）用于约束模型与物理执行结构的一致性。系统性实验覆盖六个机器人环境，结果表明模型拟合误差符合所推导的缩放规律，且所引入的正则化方法显著提升动力学建模精度与闭环控制性能。综合来看，本文为在控制任务中合理分配数据采集成本与模型表达能力提供了一套简洁有效的指导原则。为评估高维欠驱动运动场景下的性能，我们在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人与 Unitree G1 人形机器人平台上进行了实验验证。
Data-driven neural Koopman operator theory has emerged as a powerful tool for linearizing and controlling nonlinear robotic systems. However, the performance of these data-driven models fundamentally depends on the trade-off between sample size and model dimensions, a relationship for which the scaling laws have remained unclear. This paper establishes a rigorous framework to address this challenge by deriving and empirically validating scaling laws that connect sample size, latent space dimension, and downstream control quality. We derive a theoretical upper bound on the Koopman approximation error, explicitly decomposing it into sampling error and projection error. We show that these terms decay at specific rates relative to dataset size and latent dimension, providing a rigorous basis for the scaling law. Based on the theoretical results, we introduce two lightweight regularizers for the neural Koopman operator: a covariance loss to help stabilize the learned latent features and an inverse control loss to ensure the model aligns with physical actuation. The results from systematic experiments across six robotic environments confirm that model fitting error follows the derived scaling laws, and the regularizers improve dynamic model fitting fidelity, with enhanced closed-loop control performance. Together, our results provide a simple recipe for allocating effort between data collection and model capacity when learning Koopman dynamics for control.To evaluate high-dimensional underactuated locomotion, we use the Unitree Go2 quadruped and G1 humanoid.
Seq-DeepIPC: Sequential Sensing for End-to-End Control in Legged Robot Navigation
Seq-DeepIPC：腿式机器人导航中用于端到端控制的顺序感知
我们提出 Seq-DeepIPC，一种面向真实环境中足式机器人导航的序列化端到端感知—控制模型。该方法通过紧密融合多模态感知（RGB-D + GNSS）与时序信息，实现感知与控制的协同优化，从而提升自主导航能力。模型联合预测语义分割与深度信息，为规划与控制提供更丰富的空间特征表示。为实现边缘设备上的高效部署，我们采用轻量级网络作为编码器，在降低计算开销的同时保持较高精度。在航向估计方面，我们移除噪声较大的 IMU 依赖，改为通过对连续 GNSS 坐标进行差分分析来推导全局航向，从而简化系统结构。我们构建了一个更大规模且更具多样性的多场景数据集，涵盖道路与草地等地形，并在一台 Unitree Go2 机器人平台上进行了系统验证。对比实验与消融研究表明，序列输入显著提升了模型在感知与控制任务中的性能，而其他基线方法未表现出同样收益。Seq-DeepIPC 在模型规模合理的前提下实现了具有竞争力甚至更优的表现；尽管基于 GNSS 的航向估计在高楼遮挡环境下可靠性下降，但在开阔区域表现稳定。总体而言，Seq-DeepIPC 将端到端导航拓展至更具通用性与时序感知能力的足式机器人系统。为支持后续研究，我们将在 GitHub（https://github.com/oskarnatan/Seq-DeepIPC）公开代码。数据集与传感器信息摘要见表

We present Seq-DeepIPC, a sequential end-to-end perception-to-control model for legged robot navigation in realworld environments. Seq-DeepIPC advances intelligent sensing for autonomous legged navigation by tightly integrating multi-modal perception (RGB-D + GNSS) with temporal fusion and control. The model jointly predicts semantic segmentation and depth estimation, giving richer spatial features for planning and control. For efficient deployment on edge devices, we use a lightweight model as the encoder, reducing computation while maintaining accuracy. Heading estimation is simplified by removing the noisy IMU and instead deriving global heading via differential analysis of sequential GNSS coordinates. We collected a larger and more diverse dataset that includes both road and grass terrains, and validated Seq-DeepIPC on a robot dog. Comparative and ablation studies show that sequential inputs improve perception and control in our models, while other baselines do not benefit. Seq-DeepIPC achieves competitive or better results with reasonable model size; although GNSS-only heading is less reliable near tall buildings, it is robust in open areas. Overall, Seq-DeepIPC extends end-to-end navigation beyond wheeled robots to more versatile and temporally-aware systems. To support future research, we will release the codes to our GitHub repo at https://github.com/oskarnatan/Seq-DeepIPC. TRANS Terrain-aware Reinforcement Learning for Agile Navigation of Quadruped Robots under Social Interactions
TRANS：面向社交互动的四足机器人敏捷导航的地形感知强化学习
本文提出 TRANS（Terrain-aware Reinforcement learning for Agile Navigation under Social interactions），一种用于非结构化地形下四足机器人社交导航的深度强化学习框架。传统四足导航方法通常将运动规划与运动控制分离，忽略了全身约束与地形感知能力；而端到端方法虽然更为一体化，但往往依赖高频感知输入，计算开销大且易受传感器噪声影响。此外，大多数现有方法假设环境静态，难以适用于人类密集的动态场景。为解决上述问题，本文提出一种两阶段训练框架，包含三个深度强化学习（DRL）流程：（1）TRANS-Loco 采用非对称 actor–critic（AC）结构进行四足机器人运动控制，在不显式依赖地形或接触信息的情况下，实现对不平整地形的跨越；（2）TRANS-Nav 采用对称 AC 框架实现社交导航，将变换后的 LiDAR 数据直接映射为基于差分驱动运动学的机器人动作；（3）统一流程 TRANS 将 TRANS-Loco 与 TRANS-Nav 融合，支持在复杂地形与社会交互环境中的地形感知型四足导航。我们在多种运动与社交导航基准上开展了系统性对比实验，结果表明该方法优于现有基线方法；硬件实验进一步验证了其仿真到现实迁移的可行性。实验基于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台完成。
This study introduces TRANS: Terrain-aware Reinforcement learning for Agile Navigation under Social interactions, a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for quadrupedal social navigation over unstructured terrains. Conventional quadrupedal navigation typically separates motion planning from locomotion control, neglecting whole-body constraints and terrain awareness. On the other hand, end-toend methods are more integrated but require high-frequency sensing, which is often noisy and computationally costly. In addition, most existing approaches assume static environments, limiting their use in human-populated settings. To address these limitations, we propose a two-stage training framework with three DRL pipelines. (1) TRANS-Loco employs an asymmetric actor–critic (AC) model for quadrupedal locomotion, enabling traversal of uneven terrains without explicit terrain or contact observations. (2) TRANS-Nav applies a symmetric AC framework for social navigation, directly mapping transformed LiDAR data to ego-agent actions under differential-drive kinematics. (3) A unified pipeline, TRANS, integrates TRANS-Loco and TRANS-Nav, supporting terrain-aware quadrupedal navigation in uneven and socially interactive environments. Comprehensive benchmarks against locomotion and social navigation baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of TRANS. Hardware experiments further confirm its potential for sim-to-real transfer. Experiments were conducted using the Unitree Go2 quadruped platform
Intelligent Gait Synthesis for Autonomous Ground Robots: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
面向自主地面机器人的智能步态合成：一种强化学习方法
我们提出 Reinforcement Learning Contrastive Optimization（RLCO），一种融合对比学习与强化学习的四足机器人运动控制框架，旨在提升策略学习的样本效率与动作序列稳定性。现有强化学习方法在四足运动控制中面临两个关键问题：样本利用效率低以及动作序列缺乏足够的时间一致性，导致在复杂环境下稳定性不足。为解决这一问题，我们引入一种基于历史—预测动作对齐的对比学习机制，通过约束过去动作与预测动作之间的表示一致性，确保动作序列在时间维度上保持连贯，从而增强运动控制的稳定性与物理合理性。该共优化机制在保留强化学习强探索能力的同时，提升动作输出的可预测性与连续性，使策略能够更好地适应复杂任务。实验结果表明，该方法在非结构化地形下显著提升了运动控制精度与环境适应能力。通过对不同训练策略的对比分析，我们系统验证了 RLCO 框架的有效性。室外实地测试涵盖楼梯、坡地及草地等场景，结果表明机器人能够快速适应多种地面条件。实验基于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人在真实环境中完成。
We propose Reinforcement Learning Contrastive Optimization (RLCO), a novel quadruped robot locomotion control framework that synergistically integrates contrastive learning with reinforcement learning. This framework addresses two critical limitations of existing reinforcement learning methods in quadruped motion control: low sample efficiency and insufficient stability in action sequences. To meet the temporal coherence requirements of motion policies in complex environments, we develop a history–prediction action alignment mechanism through contrastive learning. This approach ensures that an action sequence is consistent over time. It does this by reducing the difference between past actions and predicted actions. This approach greatly enhances the stability and reliability of motion control. The proposed co-optimization mechanism preserves reinforcement learning’s exploration capability for complex tasks while improving the physical plausibility and predictability of action sequences. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves notable improvements in motion control precision and environmental adaptability in unstructured terrains. Through comparative analysis of different training strategies, we systematically validate the effectiveness of the RLCO framework. Field tests in outdoor environments with stairs, slopes, and grassy terrain confirm the robot’s capabilities. The quadruped robot rapidly adapts to diverse ground conditions. Experiments were conducted in real-world environments using the Unitree Go2 robot.
IRIS: Learning-Driven Task-Specific Cinema Robot Arm for Visuomotor Motion Control
IRIS：面向视觉运动控制的学习驱动型任务特定电影机器人手臂
我们提出智能机器人成像系统（Intelligent Robotic Imaging System，IRIS），一种面向自主学习驱动电影级运动控制的任务专用 6 自由度机械臂系统。尽管机器人相机系统能够实现超越人类能力的动态与可重复运动，但其在实际应用中往往受限于工业级硬件的高成本与高复杂度。为此，IRIS 采用纵向一体化设计方案，将轻量化 3D 打印硬件结构与视觉-运动模仿学习框架相结合，实现低成本高性能的系统构建。我们基于目标条件化的 Transformer 动作分块方法（Goal-conditioned Action Chunking with Transformers, ACT）对模型进行改进，使系统能够直接从人类专家示教中学习目标感知驱动的平滑运动轨迹，而无需显式几何编程。整套系统成本低于 1000 美元，支持 1.5 kg 负载，且可实现约 1 mm 的重复定位精度。真实环境实验表明，该系统能够实现精确跟踪与可靠的自主执行，并在多样化电影级轨迹任务中具备良好的泛化能力。IRIS 的实现细节可参见：https://github.com/thejerrycheng/iris。系统硬件结构采用轻量化任务专用架构，结合分布式驱动与差动腕部设计，驱动单元为
Unitree GO-M8010-6 执行器。
Robotic camera systems enable dynamic and repeatable motion beyond human capabilities. Yet their adoption is restricted by high costs and operational complexity of industrial-grade hardware. We present intelligent robotic imaging system (IRIS), a task-specific 6-DOF manipulator, designed for autonomous learning-driven cinematic motion control. Our system leverages a vertically integrated stack that combines a lightweight, 3D-printed hardware design with a visuomotor imitation learning framework. By employing a goal-conditioned adaptation of Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), IRIS learns to execute object-aware, perceptually smooth trajectories directly from human expert demonstrations, without the need for explicit geometric programming. The complete system costs under $1,000 USD, supports a 1.5 kg payload, and achieves approximately 1 mm repeatability. Real-world experiments demonstrate accurate tracking and reliable autonomous execution that generalizes across diverse cinematic trajectories. Implementation details for IRIS are available at: https://github.com/thejerrycheng/iris. IRIS hardware overview: lightweight task-specific architecture with relocated actuation and a differential wrist, using Unitree GO-M8010-6 actuator.
Bellman Value Decomposition for Task Logic in Safe Optimal Control
安全最优控制中任务逻辑的贝尔曼值分解
现实任务通常涉及目标达成与安全约束之间的复杂组合。在高维场景下，这一问题更加突出：形式自动机方法变得繁琐复杂，而稀疏奖励的组合通常需要大量手工调参。针对这一挑战，本文从贝尔曼值（Bellman Value）的内在结构出发，将问题自然组织为更具结构化的形式，以提升学习效率与自动化性能。我们证明，对于由时序逻辑定义的复杂任务，其贝尔曼值可以分解为一个贝尔曼值图结构，并通过一组经典贝尔曼方程（Bellman Equations, BEs）进行连接，包括 Reach-Avoid BE、Avoid BE，以及一种新提出的 Reach-Avoid-Loop BE。基于该分解结构，我们提出 VDPPO 方法，将分解后的值图嵌入双层神经网络中，通过自举式方式隐式建模各子值之间的依赖关系，从而求解最优值函数与策略。我们在多种仿真与真实硬件场景中进行了验证，测试对象包括涉及异构团队与非线性动力学的复杂高维任务。结果表明，该方法相较于现有基线显著提升性能，并能够自动平衡安全性与任务可达性。最后，我们在 Herding 与 Delivery 场景中开展硬件实验，使用一组 Crazyflie（CF）无人机与 Unitree Go2 机器人进行协同任务，展示 VDPPO 在高维真实环境与异构协作条件下求解复杂任务规范的能力。
Real-world tasks involve nuanced combinations of goal and safety specifications. In high dimensions, the challenge is exacerbated: formal automata become cumbersome, and the combination of sparse rewards tends to require laborious tuning. In this work, we consider the innate structure of the Bellman Value as a means to naturally organize the problem for improved automatic performance. Namely, we prove the Bellman Value for a complex task defined in temporal logic can be decomposed into a graph of Bellman Values, connected by a set of well-known Bellman equations (BEs): the Reach-Avoid BE, the Avoid BE, and a novel type, the Reach-Avoid-Loop BE. To solve the Value and optimal policy, we propose VDPPO, which embeds the decomposed Value graph into a two-layer neural net, bootstrapping the implicit dependencies. We conduct a variety of simulated and hardware experiments to test our method on complex, high-dimensional tasks involving heterogeneous teams and nonlinear dynamics. Ultimately, we find this approach greatly improves performance over existing baselines, balancing safety and liveness automatically. Lastly, we perform hardware experiments corresponding to the Herding and Delivery environments using a swarm of Crazyflie (CF) drones collaborating with the Unitree Go2 to demonstrate the ability of VDPPO to solve complex task specifications in high-dimensional real-world settings with heterogeneous collaboration.
Sparse Video Generation Propels Real-World Beyond-the-View Vision-Language Navigation
稀疏视频生成推动现实世界中超越视野的视觉语言导航
视觉—语言导航是否必须依赖细粒度且冗长的语言指令？尽管详细指令有助于决策，但这种方式在本质上与现实场景中导航任务的目标相矛盾——理想情况下，智能体应具备仅依赖高层意图即可在未知环境中自主导航的能力。这一目标带来了一个重大挑战：超视距导航（Beyond-the-View Navigation，BVN），即机器人必须在缺乏密集逐步指导的情况下，定位远距离且不可见的目标。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法虽然擅长遵循细粒度指令，但由于其训练依赖短时监督，往往表现出短视行为；而简单延长监督时长又会破坏 LLM 的训练稳定性。本文指出，视频生成模型天然受益于长时域监督，从而能够更好地对齐语言指令，因此在 BVN 任务中具有独特优势。基于这一洞察，我们首次将视频生成模型引入该领域。然而，直接生成长达数十秒的视频会带来过高延迟，难以满足实时部署需求。为解决这一问题，我们提出 SparseVideoNav，通过生成一个覆盖 20 秒长时域的稀疏未来轨迹预测，实现亚秒级轨迹推理，相比未优化版本实现 27 倍加速。大规模真实环境零样本实验表明，SparseVideoNav 在 BVN 任务上的成功率达到当前最先进 LLM 基线的 2.5 倍，并首次在复杂夜间场景中实现该类能力。我们在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上开展真实世界实验验证。
Why must vision-language navigation be bound to detailed and verbose language instructions? While such details ease decision-making, they fundamentally contradict the goal for navigation in the real-world. Ideally, agents should possess the autonomy to navigate in unknown environments guided solely by simple and high-level intents. Realizing this ambition introduces a formidable challenge: Beyond-the-View Navigation (BVN), where agents must locate distant, unseen targets without dense and stepby-step guidance. Existing large language model (LLM)-based methods, though adept at following dense instructions, often suffer from short-sighted behaviors due to their reliance on shorthorizon supervision. Simply extending the supervision horizon, however, destabilizes LLM training. In this work, we identify that video generation models inherently benefit from long-horizon supervision to align with language instructions, rendering them uniquely suitable for BVN tasks. Capitalizing on this insight, we propose introducing the video generation model into this field for the first time. Yet, the prohibitive latency for generating videos spanning tens of seconds makes real-world deployment impractical. To bridge this gap, we propose SparseVideoNav, achieving sub-second trajectory inference guided by a generated sparse future spanning a 20-second horizon. This yields a remarkable 27× speed-up compared to the unoptimized counterpart. Extensive real-world zero-shot experiments demonstrate that SparseVideoNav achieves 2.5× the success rate of state-of-theart LLM baselines on BVN tasks and marks the first realization of such capability in challenging night scenes. We perform real-world experiments based on Unitree Go2 robotic dog.
User-Centric Object Navigation A Benchmark with Integrated User Habits for Personalized Embodied Object Search
以用户为中心的对象导航：基于用户习惯的个性化具身对象搜索基准测试
在家庭环境中的对象导航（Object Navigation, ON）任务近年来受到广泛关注。然而，现有 ON 基准通常将目标物体放置在遵循通用场景先验的位置，未考虑不同用户的个性化摆放习惯。这种忽略限制了导航智能体在真实个性化家庭场景中的适应能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出以用户习惯为核心的对象导航（User-centric Object Navigation，UcON）基准，将用户特定的物体摆放习惯显式纳入任务建模与评估框架。该基准要求智能体利用用户习惯信息进行更具针对性的决策与导航推理。UcON 规模约涵盖 22,600 条用户习惯，覆盖 489 个物体类别。据我们所知，这是首个在大规模层面上显式定义并评估习惯条件下对象导航任务的基准，同时覆盖最广泛的目标物体类别。基于该框架，我们进一步提出一种习惯检索模块，用于提取与目标物体相关的用户习惯信息，并辅助智能体推断目标更可能出现的位置，从而提升导航效率。实验结果表明，在用户习惯驱动的物体摆放条件下，当前最先进方法性能出现明显下降，而引入用户习惯信息后，成功率显著提升。代码已公开于：https://github.com/whcpumpkin/User-Centric-Object-Navigation。实验所使用的机器人平台（图2）为 Unitree GO2 Edu，其搭载一台安装在四根 0.5 米支撑杆上的 Astra Pro Plus RGB-D 相机。
In the evolving field of robotics, the challenge of Object Navigation (ON) in household environments has attracted significant interest. Existing ON benchmarks typically place objects in locations guided by general scene priors, without accounting for the specific placement habits of individual users. This omission limits the adaptability of navigation agents in personalized household environments. To address this, we introduce User-centric Object Navigation (UcON), a new benchmark that incorporates user-specific object placement habits, referred to as user habits. This benchmark requires agents to leverage these user habits for more informed decisionmaking during navigation. UcON encompasses approximately 22,600 user habits across 489 object categories. UcON is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark that explicitly formalizes and evaluates habit-conditioned object navigation at scale and covers the widest range of target object categories. Additionally, we propose a habit retrieval module to extract and utilize habits related to target objects, enabling agents to infer their likely locations more effectively. Experimental results demonstrate that current SOTA methods exhibit substantial performance degradation under habit-driven object placement, while integrating user habits consistently improves success rates. Code is available at https://github.com/whcpumpkin/ User-Centric-Object-Navigation. The robotic platform (Fig. 2) is a Unitree GO2 Edu equipped with an Astra Pro Plus RGB-D camera mounted on four 0.5m rods.
Co-jump: Cooperative Jumping with Quadrupedal Robots via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
Co-jump：基于多智能体强化学习的四足机器人协同跳跃
尽管单体四足机器人运动控制已取得显著进展，但单个机器人在物理驱动能力上仍然受到本身执行器极限的制约。为突破这一边界，我们提出 Co-jump——一种两台四足机器人协同完成高于各自单机能力的跳跃任务。在该任务中，两台机器人需要在无显式通信与预定义运动原语的条件下，实现高冲击接触动力学下的同步协调。我们针对这一问题，在去中心化框架下构建了基于多智能体近端策略优化（Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization, MAPPO）并结合渐进式课程学习策略的训练方法，有效缓解了机械耦合系统中稀疏奖励带来的探索困难。仿真与真实硬件实验结果表明，该方法能够稳定实现多方向跳跃，并成功跃升至 1.5 m 高的平台。实验中其中一台机器人实现足端最高 1.1 m 的抬升高度，相比单机四足机器人约 0.45 m 的跳跃高度提升 144%，显著增强了垂直运动性能。值得强调的是，该精确协同仅依赖本体感知信息实现，无需通信机制，从而为受限环境中的无通信协作运动奠定基础。我们部署了两台四足机器人，其中 Unitree Go2 作为跳跃机器人（Robot J，约 15 kg），另一台 Js01 作为发射机器人（Robot L，约 90 kg）。
While single-agent legged locomotion has witnessed remarkable progress, individual robots remain fundamentally constrained by physical actuation limits. To transcend these boundaries, we introduce Co-jump, a cooperative task where two quadrupedal robots synchronize to execute jumps far beyond their solo capabilities. We tackle the high-impulse contact dynamics of this task under a decentralized setting, achieving synchronization without explicit communication or pre-specified motion primitives. Our framework leverages Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) enhanced by a progressive curriculum strategy, which effectively overcomes the sparse-reward exploration challenges inherent in mechanically coupled systems. We demonstrate robust performance in simulation and successful transfer to physical hardware, executing multi-directional jumps onto platforms up to 1.5 m in height. Specifically, one of the robots achieves a foot-end elevation of 1.1 m, which represents a 144% improvement over the 0.45 m jump height of a standalone quadrupedal robot, demonstrating superior vertical performance. Notably, this precise coordination is achieved solely through proprioceptive feedback, establishing a foundation for communication-free collaborative locomotion in constrained environments. We deployed two quadruped robots consisting of a Go2 as the jumper (Robot J, approx. 15 kg) and a Js01 as the launcher (Robot L, approx. 90 kg).
Zero-Shot Visual Anomaly Detection on a Quadruped Robot Using State of the Art Visual Language Models
基于最先进视觉语言模型的四足机器人零样本视觉异常检测
在动态真实环境中进行异常检测对机器人系统仍然是一项重大挑战，传统基于视觉规则或手工特征的方法难以在缺乏任务专用训练的情况下理解复杂语义上下文。近年来视觉语言模型（Visual Language Models, VLMs）的发展为机器人实现零样本、语义感知驱动的感知能力提供了新的可能，但其在移动机器人平台上的实际部署仍然研究不足。本研究中，一台四足机器人按照预设路径与任务计划，在室内外环境中自主巡逻并执行实时零样本异常检测任务。机器人搭载机载 RGB 相机，并集成 VLM 对视觉数据进行语义推理，无需任何微调即可识别异常。异常检测通过基于提示的语义推理直接实现，可识别物体摆放异常、结构缺陷以及环境风险等问题。整个系统基于 ROS2 架构实现，以确保通信、控制与实时决策流程的高效协同。我们评估了两种推理部署方式：一种是在机器人本地运行轻量级 VLM 以实现边缘计算；另一种是使用性能更强的云端 VLM 进行远程推理。实验结果表明，两种配置均能够有效识别多种异常情况，验证了将四足平台与 VLM 零样本感知结合用于动态环境持续监测的可行性。此外，我们在多个最先进 VLM 模型上开展了系统性基准测试，包括 Gemini-2.5-Pro、GPT-5、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemma3-27B、Qwen3-VL-30B 以及 LLaVA-13B，并与人工评估结果进行对比分析。该对比研究系统性评估了模型行为与人类判断的一致性，为具身感知任务中现代 VLM 的优势与局限提供了更深入的洞察。实验所采用的机器人平台为 Unitree Go2 EDU+，该四足机器人专为室内外多场景应用设计。
Anomaly detection in dynamic real-world environments remains a significant challenge for robotic systems, largely because traditional vision and rule-based methods struggle to interpret complex semantic contexts without task-specific training. Recent advances in Visual Language Models (VLMs) offer new opportunities for robots to perform zero-shot, context aware perception; however, their practical deployment on mobile robotic platforms remains underexplored. In this study, a quadruped robot autonomously patrolled both indoor and outdoor environments following a predefined trajectory and schedule to perform real-time, zero-shot anomaly detection. The robot was equipped with an onboard RGB camera and integrated with a VLM to interpret visual data without any fine tuning. Anomalies were identified directly through prompt-based semantic reasoning, enabling detection of misplaced objects, structural defects, and environmental hazards. The overall framework was implemented under ROS2 to ensure seamless communication, control, and real-time decision making. Two inference configurations were evaluated: a lightweight VLM running locally on the robot for on-device processing, and a more powerful cloud-based VLM used for remote inference. Experimental results show that both configurations effectively identified diverse anomalies, demonstrating the feasibility of combining quadruped platforms with VLM-based zero-shot perception for continuous monitoring in dynamic environments. Furthermore, a comprehensive benchmarking study was conducted across multiple state-of-the-art VLMs Gemini-2.5-Pro, GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemma3-27B, Qwen3-VL-30B, and LLaVA-13B alongside human evaluators. This comparison enabled systematic assessment of model behavior and alignment with human judgment, providing deeper insights into the strengths and limitations of modern VLMs for embodied perception tasks. The robotic platform employed in this study is the Unitree Go2 EDU+, a quadruped robot designed for versatile operation in both indoor and outdoor environments.
Stairway to Success: An Online Floor-Aware Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation Framework via LLM-Driven Coarse-to-Fine Exploration
通往成功的阶梯：一种基于LLM驱动的粗到精探索的在线楼层感知零样本目标导航框架
可部署的服务与配送机器人在多层建筑中执行对象目标导航时面临显著挑战，因为现有系统通常基于单层假设，并依赖离线构建的全局一致地图，难以处理跨楼层过渡与垂直空间推理等问题。尤其在未知建筑环境中，楼层间的结构关系与通行路径需要实时推断，使多层场景成为对象目标导航的重要难点。虽然 HM3D 与 MP3D 等基准已涵盖多层真实环境，但现有方法缺乏支持在线、楼层感知的导航能力。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 ASCENT，一种用于零样本对象目标导航的在线框架，使机器人无需预建地图或针对新目标类别重新训练即可运行。该框架包含两个核心模块：（1）多楼层抽象模块，动态构建分层环境表示，结合楼梯感知的障碍建模与跨楼层拓扑建模，实现对多层结构的实时理解；（2）粗到细推理模块，将前沿边界排序机制与 LLM 驱动的语境分析相结合，支持多层导航决策中的高层语义与低层运动规划协同。我们在 HM3D 与 MP3D 基准上进行评估，结果优于当前最先进的零样本方法，并在真实环境中部署于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上进行验证。项目网页：https://zeying-gong.github.io/projects/ascent/
Deployable service and delivery robots struggle to navigate multi-floor buildings to reach object goals, as existing systems fail due to single-floor assumptions and requirements for offline, globally consistent maps. Multi-floor environments pose unique challenges including cross-floor transitions and vertical spatial reasoning, especially navigating unknown buildings. Object-Goal Navigation benchmarks like HM3D and MP3D also capture this multi-floor reality, yet current methods lack support for online, floor-aware navigation. To bridge this gap, we propose ASCENT, an online framework for Zero-Shot ObjectGoal Navigation that enables robots to operate without pre-built maps or retraining on new object categories. It introduces: (1) a Multi-Floor Abstraction module that dynamically constructs hierarchical representations with stair-aware obstacle mapping and cross-floor topology modeling, and (2) a Coarse-to-Fine Reasoning module that combines frontier ranking with LLMdriven contextual analysis for multi-floor navigation decisions. We evaluate on HM3D and MP3D benchmarks, outperforming state-of-the-art zero-shot approaches, and demonstrate real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot. The project website is at https://zeying-gong.github.io/projects/ascent/.
Coupled Local and Global World Models for Efficient First Order RL
用于高效一阶强化学习的耦合局部和全局世界模型
世界模型（World Models）为更准确地建模复杂动力学提供了一条有前景的路径，尤其是在接触、非刚性形变以及复杂感知信息（如视觉输入）难以通过标准仿真器精确刻画的场景下。然而，这类模型在计算上通常代价较高，难以直接与主流强化学习（RL）算法高效结合，而后者虽然已在复杂运动控制任务中取得成功，但在操作类任务中仍面临挑战。本文提出一种完全绕过传统仿真器的方法，在基于真实机器人与环境交互数据学习得到的世界模型内部直接训练强化学习策略。核心贡献在于一种新颖的解耦一阶梯度（First-order Gradient, FoG）方法，使大规模扩散型世界模型可用于策略优化：其中，完整规模的世界模型负责生成高精度的前向轨迹，而一个轻量级潜在空间替代模型用于近似其局部动力学，从而实现高效梯度计算。这种局部与全局世界模型的耦合机制在保证高保真展开的同时，使反向传播具备计算可行性。我们在 Push-T 操作任务上验证了该方法，相比 PPO 显著提升样本效率，并进一步在以四足机器人为主体的自我中心物体操作任务中进行了测试。实验表明，在无需依赖手工物理仿真的情况下，在数据驱动世界模型内部进行策略学习，是解决图像空间中难以建模的强化学习任务的一种有效路径。我们在两个真实系统上开展研究：一是带有固定基座相机的桌面机械臂 Flexiv Rizon-10S，二是搭载机载相机的 Unitree Go2 四足移动机器人。
World models offer a promising avenue for more faithfully capturing complex dynamics, including contacts and non-rigidity, as well as complex sensory information, such as visual perception, in situations where standard simulators struggle. However, these models are computationally complex to evaluate, posing a challenge for popular RL approaches that have been successfully used with simulators to solve complex locomotion tasks but yet struggle with manipulation. This paper introduces a method that bypasses simulators entirely, training RL policies inside world models learned from robots’ interactions with real environments. At its core, our approach enables policy training with large-scale diffusion models via a novel decoupled firstorder gradient (FoG) method: a full-scale world model generates accurate forward trajectories, while a lightweight latentspace surrogate approximates its local dynamics for efficient gradient computation. This coupling of a local and global world model ensures high-fidelity unrolling alongside computationally tractable differentiation. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on the Push-T manipulation task, where it significantly outperforms PPO in sample efficiency. We further evaluate our approach through an ego-centric object manipulation task with a quadruped. Together, these results demonstrate that learning inside data-driven world models is a promising pathway for solving hard-to-model RL tasks in image space without reliance on hand-crafted physics simulators. We conduct our study using two representative real-world examples: 1) a table-top manipulator (Flexiv Rizon-10S) with a fixed camera on the base overseeing the scene, and 2) a mobile robot (Unitree Go2 quadruped) with an onboard camera.
TIC-VLA A Think-in-Control Vision-Language-Action Model for Robot Navigation in Dynamic Environments
TIC-VLA：一种用于动态环境下机器人导航的基于思维控制的视觉-语言-动作模型
在动态且以人为中心的环境中，机器人必须在遵循语言指令的同时保持实时反应控制能力。视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型为这一问题提供了有前景的框架，但现有方法通常假设感知推理与控制决策在时间上同步，忽略了语义推理相对于实时动作执行存在固有延迟的现实情况。为此，我们提出 Think-in-Control（TIC）-VLA，一种感知延迟可建模的框架，显式刻画语义推理延迟对动作生成的影响。TIC-VLA 构建了一个延迟语义—控制接口，使动作生成同时条件于延迟语义状态、显式延迟元信息以及当前观测，从而使策略能够补偿异步推理带来的时间偏差。我们进一步提出一种延迟一致的训练流程，在模仿学习与在线强化学习阶段注入推理延迟，使训练过程与异步部署场景保持一致。为支持真实场景评估，我们构建了 DynaNav，一个物理精确、视觉逼真的仿真平台，用于语言引导的动态环境导航任务。大规模仿真与真实机器人实验表明，TIC-VLA 在多秒级推理延迟条件下仍能保持稳定的实时控制性能，并且整体表现优于现有 VLA 方法。导航策略在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上完成真实世界部署与测试。项目网页：https://ucla-mobility.github.io/TIC-VLA/
Robots in dynamic, human-centric environments must follow language instructions while maintaining real-time reactive control. Vision-languageaction (VLA) models offer a promising framework, but they assume temporally aligned reasoning and control, despite semantic inference being inherently delayed relative to real-time action. We introduce Think-in-Control (TIC)-VLA, a latency-aware framework that explicitly models delayed semantic reasoning during action generation. TIC-VLA defines a delayed semanticcontrol interface that conditions action generation on delayed vision-language semantic states and explicit latency metadata, in addition to current observations, enabling policies to compensate for asynchronous reasoning. We further propose a latency-consistent training pipeline that injects reasoning inference delays during imitation learning and online reinforcement learning, aligning training with asynchronous deployment. To support realistic evaluation, we present DynaNav, a physics-accurate, photo-realistic simulation suite for language-guided navigation in dynamic environments. Extensive experiments in simulation and on a real robot show that TICVLA consistently outperforms prior VLA models while maintaining robust real-time control under multi-second reasoning latency. The navigation policy is executed on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot in real-world navigation tasks. Project website: https://ucla-mobility.github.io/TIC-VLA/
Context-Aware Generation and Modulation of Expressive Motion Behavior using Multimodal Foundation Models
基于多模态基础模型的上下文感知表达性动作行为生成与调控
富有表现力的机器人运动能够显著提升人机交互质量，例如增强用户参与度、亲和力以及任务完成效果。本文提出一种方法，可根据多模态（文本、音频、视频）上下文描述自动生成并调制复杂的全身表达性动作序列。该方法基于对“动画十二原则”的统一数学建模，并通过动态运动基元（DMPs）实现可解释、可组合的运动生成框架，同时结合多模态基础模型生成高度上下文感知的动作序列及参数化变体。相比现有方法，该框架在灵活性与通用性方面具有优势，能够跨不同运动学结构的机器人平台迁移。系统还集成于连续控制框架，并通过知识蒸馏训练更小规模模型，在提升token效率的同时显著降低推理延迟。用户研究结果表明，在类人机器人平台 Pepper 上，参与者认为本方法生成的动作与交互语境匹配度更高。系统还在不同结构平台上验证，包括四足机器人 Unitree Go2 与机械臂 Kinova Gen3 Lite，结果显示在动作库更丰富的 Pepper 上可生成更多样化序列，而在动作库较小的 Go2 与 Gen3 Lite 上虽仍能生成完整全身表达动作，但存在一定重复模式。
Expressive robot motion positively impacts human-robot interaction by improving user engagement, likability, or task performance. We present a novel approach to automatically generate and modulate complex, expressive full-body gesture sequences from a multimodal (text, audio, video) context description. Based on a unified mathematical implementation of the Principles of Animation using Dynamic Movement Primitives, we use multimodal foundation models to generate such sequences along with parametric motion variations that are highly context-aware. This method extends the state of the art in terms of flexibility and generality by being interpretable, composable, and working across different robot morphologies. Moreover, we integrate the system into a continuous control framework and leverage knowledge distillation to learn a much smaller model, significantly improving token efficiency and system latency. Results from a user study with a human-like platform indicate that participants judged our system’s motions to be better aligned with the interaction context than motions produced under a non-modulated or API-level condition. We also demonstrate how the system generates expressive motion for robots with different kinematics, showcasing its versatility. Paper webpage: https://gen-mod-expressive-motion-behavior.github.io/. Our gesture library for Pepper is rather large, with over 30 different basic gestures, and our method produced diverse sequences. However, we noticed repeating patterns on the Go2 and Gen3 Lite, which use libraries that are less exhaustive, but still consist of whole-body gestures.
Self-Imitated Diffusion Policy for Efficient and Robust Visual Navigation
用于高效鲁棒视觉导航的自模仿扩散策略
扩散策略（Diffusion Policy, DP）在视觉导航中展现出强大的潜力，能够建模多模态轨迹分布。然而，大多数 DP 方法依赖的标准模仿学习（IL）往往继承专家示范中的次优性与冗余性，因此在推理阶段通常需要计算开销较大的“先生成后筛选”流程，并借助额外的选择器进行过滤。为解决这一问题，本文提出 Self-Imitated Diffusion Policy（SIDP），一种通过选择性模仿自身采样轨迹来实现规划优化的框架。具体而言，SIDP 引入奖励引导的自模仿机制，鼓励策略持续生成高质量且一致性更强的轨迹，从而减少对大规模采样与后处理筛选的依赖。在训练阶段，作者采用奖励驱动的课程学习策略以提升数据利用效率，并结合目标无关探索进行轨迹增强，提高规划鲁棒性。大规模仿真实验表明，SIDP 显著优于现有方法；真实机器人实验进一步验证了其在多平台上的有效性。在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 上，SIDP 推理时间为 110ms，相比基线 NavDP 的 273ms 提升约 2.5 倍，实现了高效实时部署。图 7 展示了该方法在 Unitree Go2 与 Agilex T-Rex 平台上的稳定真实世界表现。
Diffusion policies (DP) have demonstrated significant potential in visual navigation by capturing diverse multimodal trajectory distributions. However, standard imitation learning (IL), which most DP methods rely on for training, often inherits sub-optimality and redundancy from expert demonstrations, thereby necessitating a computationally intensive “generate-then-filter” pipeline that relies on auxiliary selectors during inference. To address these challenges, we propose SelfImitated Diffusion Policy (SIDP), a novel framework that learns improved planning by selectively imitating a set of trajectories sampled from itself. Specifically, SIDP introduces a rewardguided self-imitation mechanism that encourages the policy to consistently produce high-quality trajectories efficiently, rather than outputs of inconsistent quality, thereby reducing reliance on extensive sampling and post-filtering. During training, we employ a reward-driven curriculum learning paradigm to mitigate inefficient data utility , and goal-agnostic exploration for trajectory augmentation to improve planning robustness. Extensive evaluations on a comprehensive simulation benchmark show that SIDP significantly outperforms previous methods, with realworld experiments confirming its effectiveness across multiple robotic platforms. On Jetson Orin Nano, SIDP delivers a 2.5× faster inference than the baseline NavDP, i.e., 110ms VS 273ms, enabling efficient real-time deployment. Fig. 7 demonstrates the robust real-world performance of our method on Unitree Go2 and Agilex T-rex platforms.
ALORE: Autonomous Large-Object Rearrangement with a Legged Manipulator
ALORE：利用腿式机械臂实现大型物体自主重组
赋予机器人对大型重物（如家具）进行重排的能力，可显著减轻人类劳动负担。然而，该任务面临多重挑战：机器人需在复杂环境中与多样化物体交互，高效完成多物体重排，同时保证移动与操作过程中的无碰撞协同。为此，本文提出 ALORE（Autonomous Large-Object REarrangement），一种面向腿式移动操作机器人的大型物体自主重排系统，能够在多种场景中完成复杂重排任务。该系统具有三项核心特征：(i) 分层强化学习训练流程，用于多物体环境学习——在低层全身控制器之上训练高层物体速度控制器，实现跨多对象的高效稳定联合学习；(ii) 两个关键模块——统一交互构型表示与物体速度估计器，使单一策略能够精确调节不同物体的平面速度；(iii) 任务-运动联合规划框架，同时优化物体访问顺序与目标分配，从而提升整体任务效率并支持在线重规划。与强基线方法对比表明，ALORE 在策略泛化能力、物体速度跟踪精度及多物体重排效率方面均表现出持续优势。系统关键模块经过系统化评估，并通过大量仿真与真实实验验证整体鲁棒性与有效性。在真实实验中，系统成功连续完成 8 轮循环任务，在近 40 分钟内无失败地重排 32 把椅子，并实现约 40 米路径上的长距离自主重排。真实部署平台为 Unitree B2 四足机器人，背部搭载 Unitree Z1 机械臂构成腿式移动操作系统。值得注意的是，Z1 机械臂最大负载仅 2 kg，远低于被搬运物体质量，表明该系统主要通过全身协同与接触动力学实现大型物体的稳定移动，而非依赖传统高负载机械臂能力。
Endowing robots with the ability to rearrange various large and heavy objects, such as furniture, can substantially alleviate human workload. However, this task is extremely challenging due to the need to interact with diverse objects and efficiently rearrange multiple objects in complex environments while ensuring collision-free loco-manipulation. In this work, we present ALORE, an Autonomous Large-Object REarrangement system for a legged manipulator that can rearrange various large objects across diverse scenarios. The proposed system is characterized by three main features: (i) a hierarchical reinforcement learning training pipeline for multi-object environment learning, where a high-level object velocity controller is trained on top of a low-level whole-body controller to achieve efficient and stable joint learning across multiple objects; (ii) two key modules, a unified interaction configuration representation and an object velocity estimator, that allow a single policy to regulate planar velocity of diverse objects accurately; and (iii) a taskand-motion planning framework that jointly optimizes object visitation order and object-to-target assignment, improving task efficiency while enabling online replanning. Comparisons against strong baselines show consistent superiority in policy generalization, object-velocity tracking accuracy, and multi-object rearrangement efficiency. Key modules are systematically evaluated, and extensive simulations and real-world experiments are conducted to validate the robustness and effectiveness of the entire system, which successfully completes 8 continuous loops to rearrange 32 chairs over nearly 40 minutes without a single failure, and executes long-distance autonomous rearrangement over an approximately 40 m route. The open-source packages are available at https://zhihaibi.github.io/Alore/. During the real-world experiment, we use the Unitree B2 quadruped robot, equipped with a Unitree Z1 manipulator on the back, as our legged manipulator platform. The Z1 manipulator has a maximum payload of 2 kg, which is far below the mass of the objects we need to move.
INHerit-SG Incremental Hierarchical Semantic Scene Graphs with RAG-Style Retrieval
INHerit-SG 具有 RAG 风格检索的增量式分层语义场景图
在基础模型快速发展的推动下，语义场景图已成为机器人导航中进行高层三维环境抽象的重要范式。然而，现有方法通常依赖离线批处理或隐式特征嵌入，难以支持复杂环境中面向人类意图的可解释推理，因而与具身任务需求存在根本性错位。为解决这一问题，本文提出 INHerit-SG，将地图重新定义为结构化、面向检索增强生成（RAG）的知识库，引入自然语言描述作为显式语义锚点，使环境表示更好对齐人类意图。系统采用异步双进程架构，并构建 Floor-Room-Area-Object 分层结构，将几何分割与耗时的语义推理解耦；同时通过事件触发式地图更新机制，仅在发生关键语义事件时重构图结构，从而在较低计算开销下保持长期一致性。在检索阶段，系统引入多角色大语言模型对查询进行原子约束分解与逻辑否定处理，并结合“硬到软”的分级过滤策略以增强推理鲁棒性。这种显式可解释性显著提升了复杂查询的成功率与可靠性，使系统能够适应更广泛的人机交互任务。INHerit-SG 在新构建的数据集 HM3DSem-SQR 及真实环境中进行了评估，结果表明其在复杂查询任务上达到当前最优性能，并展现出对下游导航任务的良好可扩展性。真实部署中，系统使用 Unitree Go1 四足机器人连接云端服务器，根据 INHerit-SG 的检索结果执行顺序任务。
Driven by advancements in foundation models, semantic scene graphs have emerged as a prominent paradigm for high-level 3D environmental abstraction in robot navigation. However, existing approaches are fundamentally misaligned with the needs of embodied tasks. As they rely on either offline batch processing or implicit feature embeddings, the maps can hardly support interpretable human-intent reasoning in complex environments. To address these limitations, we present INHeritSG. We redefine the map as a structured, RAG-ready knowledge base where natural-language descriptions are introduced as explicit semantic anchors to better align with human intent. An asynchronous dual-process architecture, together with a Floor-Room-Area-Object hierarchy, decouples geometric segmentation from time-consuming semantic reasoning. An eventtriggered map update mechanism reorganizes the graph only when meaningful semantic events occur. This strategy enables our graph to maintain long-term consistency with relatively low computational overhead. For retrieval, we deploy multirole Large Language Models (LLMs) to decompose queries into atomic constraints and handle logical negations, and employ a hard-to-soft filtering strategy to ensure robust reasoning. This explicit interpretability improves the success rate and reliability of complex retrievals, enabling the system to adapt to a broader spectrum of human interaction tasks. We evaluate INHerit-SG on a newly constructed dataset, HM3DSem-SQR, and in realworld environments. Experiments demonstrate that our system achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex queries, and reveal its scalability for downstream navigation tasks. Project Page: https://fangyuktung.github.io/INHeritSG.github.io/ We use a Unitree Go1 robot connected to a cloud server to execute sequential tasks based on INHerit-SG retrievals.
A Three-Level Whole-Body Disturbance Rejection Control Framework for Dynamic Motions in Legged Robots
腿式机器人动态运动的三级全身抗扰控制框架
本文提出一种控制框架，以提升足式机器人在模型不确定性、外部扰动及故障等复杂条件下的稳定性与鲁棒性。该框架通过全状态反馈估计器对机器人全身动力学中的不确定项进行估计与补偿。首先，提出一种新型移动时域扩展状态观测器（MH-ESO），用于在足式系统中估计扰动并抑制噪声，可无缝集成至控制框架以实现扰动补偿。其次，设计三层全身扰动抑制控制框架（T-WB-DRC）。不同于传统两层结构，该三层框架同时考虑无不确定性动力学规划与含不确定性动力学规划，在负载运输能力、外部扰动抑制及故障容错方面实现显著提升。随后，在 Gazebo 仿真环境中对人形与四足机器人进行仿真验证，证明 T-WB-DRC 的有效性与通用性。最后，在真实四足机器人上开展大量实验，在多种扰动条件下验证系统的鲁棒性与稳定性。真实机器人对比实验基于 Unitree A1 四足平台，在单台 PC（Intel i7-13700KF, 3.4 GHz）上运行控制算法。机器人配备 15 位分辨率关节编码器及 1 kHz 采样频率的 IMU，所有实验均在平地条件下完成。
This paper presents a control framework designed to enhance the stability and robustness of legged robots in the presence of uncertainties, including model uncertainties, external disturbances, and faults. The framework enables the full-state feedback estimator to estimate and compensate for uncertainties in the whole-body dynamics of the legged robots. First, we propose a novel moving horizon extended state observer (MH-ESO) to estimate uncertainties and mitigate noise in legged systems, which can be integrated into the framework for disturbance compensation. Second, we introduce a three-level whole-body disturbance rejection control framework (T-WB-DRC). Unlike the previous two-level approach, this three-level framework considers both the plan based on whole-body dynamics without uncertainties and the plan based on dynamics with uncertainties, significantly improving payload transportation, external disturbance rejection, and fault tolerance. Third, simulations of both humanoid and quadruped robots in the Gazebo simulator demonstrate the effectiveness and versatility of T-WB-DRC. Finally, extensive experimental trials on a quadruped robot validate the robustness and stability of the system when using T-WB-DRC under various disturbance conditions. We first present two real-robot comparison experiments conducted on a single PC (Intel i7-13700KF, 3.4 GHz) using the Unitree A1 quadruped robot. The robot is equipped with joint encoders featuring a 15-bit resolution and an IMU operating at a 1 kHz sampling frequency, all performed on flat ground.
System Identification under Constraints and Disturbance A Bayesian Estimation Approach
约束和扰动下的系统辨识：一种贝叶斯估计方法
本文提出一种贝叶斯系统辨识（SysID）框架，用于高精度联合估计机器人的状态轨迹与物理参数。该方法将物理一致的逆动力学、接触与闭环约束，以及完整的关节摩擦模型，作为分阶段的硬等式约束嵌入优化问题中。框架基于能量驱动的回归器增强参数可观测性，支持对惯性与驱动参数施加等式与不等式先验约束，强制执行动力学一致的扰动投影，并通过引入能量观测补充本体感觉测量，以区分非线性摩擦效应。为保证算法可扩展性，作者推导了一种参数化的等式约束 Riccati 递推方法，在保持问题带状结构的同时，实现时间尺度上线性复杂度，并设计了高效的导数计算方法。仿真实验与真实硬件实验验证了该方法的有效性：在搭载机械臂的 Unitree B1 四足平台上（配备 Unitree Z1 机械臂），相比基于正向动力学或解耦辨识的基线方法，该框架表现出更快收敛速度、更低的惯性与摩擦参数估计误差，以及更好的接触一致性。当将辨识得到的模型嵌入模型预测控制（MPC）框架后，在复杂地形行走任务中实现了可测量的轨迹跟踪性能提升。
We introduce a Bayesian system identification (SysID) framework for jointly estimating robot’s state trajectories and physical parameters with high accuracy. It embeds physically consistent inverse dynamics, contact and loop-closure constraints, and fully featured joint friction models as hard, stage-wise equality constraints. It relies on energy-based regressors to enhance parameter observability, supports both equality and inequality priors on inertial and actuation parameters, enforces dynamically consistent disturbance projections, and augments proprioceptive measurements with energy observations to disambiguate nonlinear friction effects. To ensure scalability, we derive a parameterized equality-constrained Riccati recursion that preserves the banded structure of the problem, achieving linear complexity in the time horizon, and develop computationally efficient derivatives. Simulation studies on representative robotic systems, together with hardware experiments on a Unitree B1 equipped with a Z1 arm, demonstrate faster convergence, lower inertial and friction estimation errors, and improved contact consistency compared to forward-dynamics and decoupled identification baselines. When deployed within model predictive control frameworks, the resulting models yield measurable improvements in tracking performance during locomotion over challenging environments.
Insect-inspired adaptive behavioral compensation strategy against olfactory sensory deficiency for robotic odor source localization
昆虫启发式自适应行为补偿策略，用于弥补机器人嗅觉感觉缺陷，实现气味源定位
跨物种的气味源定位能力是生物体在觅食、择偶与筑巢等行为中普遍具备的核心能力。尽管昆虫神经系统结构简单，却展现出高度鲁棒的嗅觉导航能力，为仿生机器人研究提供了重要启示。现有具备气味源定位能力的机器人系统在实际部署中仍受限，尤其在传感器受损等物理受限条件下表现不足。本文以雄性家蚕（Bombyx mori）为研究对象，分析其利用性信息素定位雌性的行为机制，探讨感官缺失对气味定位能力的影响。实验结果表明，即便移除其主要嗅觉器官——一侧触角，家蚕仍能成功完成气味源定位，其导航策略与气味检测的空间分布密切相关。我们将该策略迁移至 Unitree Go1 四足机器人上，通过设计类触角的气味位置估计系统，实现对双侧或单侧气味线索的模拟与感知。机器人实验验证表明，基于气味感知的自适应行为选择机制能够在传感器受限条件下维持高效的气味定位性能。该研究揭示了构建具备传感器受损容错能力的鲁棒机器人导航系统的重要原理，对长时任务与救援场景具有重要参考价值。
The ability to navigate toward potential mates, food sources, or nesting sites is a fundamental trait shared across species. Despite their small nervous systems, insects demonstrate remarkable odor-guided navigation, making them ideal models for bioinspired robotics. Although robots capable of odor-source localization have been developed, their practical deployment remains limited, particularly under conditions involving physical impairment. In this study, we investigated how sensory deficits affect odor localization behavior in male silk moth Bombyx mori, which locates females using sex pheromones. Remarkably, even after the removal of one antenna, the primary olfactory organ, the silk moth retained its ability to locate the odor source. Behavioral analyses revealed that navigational strategy depended on the spatial position of odor detection. We replicated this strategy in a Unitree Go1 quadrupedal robot by designing a system capable of estimating odor positions analogous to moth antennae. Robotic experiments confirmed that adaptive behavioral selection based on bilateral or unilateral odor cues sustains efficient odor localization. These findings highlight fundamental principles of robust robotic navigation system development capable of maintaining performance even under sensor impairment, as required for long-duration or rescue missions.
CoLF: Learning Consistent Leader-Follower Policies for Vision-Language-Guided Multi-Robot Cooperative Transport
CoLF：面向视觉语言引导的多机器人合作运输的一致领导者-跟随者策略学习
本文研究基于视觉—语言指令的多机器人协同搬运任务，其中每个机器人需基于自身机载相机观测对自然语言指令进行语义落地。该任务在去中心化设置下的关键挑战在于感知对齐问题：由于视角差异与语言歧义，不同机器人对任务的理解可能不一致，从而影响协同搬运的稳定性与一致性。为缓解这一问题，我们采用依赖式的主从结构（leader–follower），其中一台机器人作为领导者，另一台作为跟随者。尽管该结构看似简单，但在缺乏显式归纳偏置的情况下，独立且对称的策略学习往往会导致行为对称或不稳定。针对这一问题，我们提出 Consistent Leader–Follower（CoLF），一种用于稳定主从角色分化的多智能体强化学习框架。CoLF 包含两个核心组件：（1）非对称策略设计，通过结构偏置促进角色区分；（2）基于互信息的训练目标，通过优化变分下界，使跟随者能够从自身局部观测中预测领导者的动作，从而强化行为一致性。领导者与跟随者策略在集中式训练、分布式执行（CTDE）框架下联合优化，在任务执行与协作稳定性之间取得平衡。我们在仿真与真实机器人环境中对方法进行验证，真实实验基于两台 Unitree Go1 四足机器人展开，实验结果证明该方法能够有效提升多机器人视觉—语言协同搬运任务中的稳定性与协调性。演示视频可见：https://sites.google.com/view/colf/
In this study, we address vision–language-guided multi-robot cooperative transport, where each robot grounds natural-language instructions from onboard camera observations. A key challenge in this decentralized setting is perceptual misalignment across robots, where viewpoint differences and language ambiguity can yield inconsistent interpretations and degrade cooperative transport. To mitigate this problem, we adopt a dependent leader–follower design, where one robot serves as the leader and the other as the follower. Although such a leader–follower structure appears straightforward, learning with independent and symmetric agents often yields symmetric or unstable behaviors without explicit inductive biases. To address this challenge, we propose Consistent Leader– Follower (CoLF), a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for stable leader–follower role differentiation.
