CoLF consists of two key components: (1) an asymmetric policy design that induces leader–follower role differentiation, and (2) a mutual-information-based training objective that maximizes a variational lower bound, encouraging the follower to predict the leader’s action from its local observation. The leader and follower policies are jointly optimized under the centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE) framework to balance task execution and consistent cooperative behaviors. We validate CoLF in both simulation and real-robot experiments using two quadruped robots. The demonstration video is available at https://sites.google.com/view/colf/. We evaluate the proposed method in real-world experiments using two Unitree Go1 quadruped robots.
What Matters for Simulation to Online Reinforcement Learning on Real Robots
从仿真到真实机器人在线强化学习，哪些因素至关重要？
本文系统研究哪些具体设计选择能够支撑在线强化学习（RL）在真实机器人平台上的成功部署。通过在三种不同机器人平台上开展超过 100 次真实世界训练实验，我们对通常被默认采用的算法、系统与实验设计决策进行系统性消融分析，评估这些选择对在线学习稳定性的影响。结果表明，一些广泛使用的默认配置在真实环境中反而具有负面影响，而一组基于标准强化学习实践但经过精心筛选的设计方案能够在不同任务与硬件平台上实现稳定收敛。这项研究提供了首个大样本规模的实证分析，为降低在线 RL 部署的工程复杂度提供了实践指导。我们在涵盖操作、运动与导航任务的三种机器人平台上开展实验。其中，在运动控制任务中，我们使用 Unitree Go1 实现基于手柄操控指令的跟随行走实验。
We investigate what specific design choices enable successful online reinforcement learning (RL) on physical robots. Across 100+ real-world training runs on three distinct robotic platforms, we systematically ablate algorithmic, systems, and experimental decisions that are typically left implicit in prior work. We find that some widely used defaults can be harmful, while a set of robust, readily adopted design choices within standard RL practice yield stable learning across tasks and hardware. These results provide the first large-sample empirical study of such design choices, enabling practitioners to deploy online RL with lower engineering effort. We conduct our experiments on three robotic platforms spanning manipulation, locomotion and navigation robotic tasks. Locomotion. We use a Unitree Go1 robot to follow joystick commands.
Event-Triggered Indirect Herding Control of a Cooperative Agent
事件触发的合作主体间接牧群控制
本文研究单个追踪主体对单个目标主体进行间接驱赶控制的问题，目标是将目标主体引导至指定位置。考虑到感知硬件的约束，我们构建了一种基于事件触发机制的跨主体影响模型，用以刻画追踪者与目标之间的交互关系。受实地感知系统启发，本文提出一种事件触发控制器及其触发机制，使系统能够满足用户设定的最小事件间隔时间要求。我们将追踪—目标耦合系统建模为一个在稳定与不稳定模式之间切换的切换系统，并基于驻留时间（dwell-time）分析推导出闭式解，用于计算追踪者在不稳定模式下允许目标自由演化的最大时间上限，超过该时间则必须更新控制输入。所设计的触发函数确保事件间隔时间上界不超过该最大驻留时间，从而保证系统稳定性。仿真与真实实验结果均验证了该方法的有效性，追踪者成功将目标引导至期望目标位置。实验在 Freefly Astro 与 Unitree Go1 平台上完成。
This work explores the indirect herding control problem for a single pursuer agent regulating a single target agent to a goal location. To accommodate the constraints of sensing hardware, an event-triggered inter-agent influence model between the pursuer agent and target agent is considered. Motivated by fielded sensing systems, we present an event-triggered controller and trigger mechanism that satisfies a user-selected minimum inter-event time. The combined pursuer-target system is presented as a switched system that alternates between stable and unstable modes. A dwell-time analysis is completed to develop a closed-form solution for the maximum time the pursuer agent can allow the target agent to evolve in the unstable mode before requiring a control input update. The presented trigger function is designed to produce inter-event times that are upper-bounded by the maximum dwell time. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through both simulated and experimental studies, where a pursuer agent successfully regulates a target agent to a desired goal location. The experiment was carried out using the Freefly Astro and Unitree Go1 platforms.
LocoVLM: Grounding Vision and Language for Adapting Versatile Legged Locomotion Policies
LocoVLM：为适应多功能腿式运动政策奠定基础的愿景和语言
近年来足式运动学习虽然取得显著进展，但主流方法仍主要依赖环境的几何表示进行控制，难以响应人类指令等高层语义信息。为弥补这一不足，本文提出一种将基础模型中的常识推理能力引入足式运动自适应过程的新方法。具体而言，我们利用预训练的大语言模型构建一个面向足式机器人的指令驱动技能数据库，并通过指令语义生成与组织技能集合。随后，采用预训练视觉—语言模型提取环境中的高层语义信息，并将其与技能数据库进行语义匹配，实现实时技能推荐与决策支持。为了实现多样化与可控的运动输出，我们训练一个风格条件化策略，使其能够在保持高鲁棒性的同时生成不同风格的运动行为。实验结果表明，该方法首次实现了基于环境语义与指令推理的实时足式运动自适应，在无需在线调用云端基础模型的情况下，指令遵循准确率最高达到 87%。运动控制器在 Unitree Go1 上训练完成，采用 PPO 算法与非对称 actor-critic 结构，并结合状态估计方法实现稳定学习，参考了相关方法的设计思路。
Recent advances in legged locomotion learning are still dominated by the utilization of geometric representations of the environment, limiting the robot’s capability to respond to higher-level semantics such as human instructions. To address this limitation, we propose a novel approach that integrates high-level commonsense reasoning from foundation models into the process of legged locomotion adaptation. Specifically, our method utilizes a pre-trained large language model to synthesize an instruction-grounded skill database tailored for legged robots. A pre-trained vision-language model is employed to extract high-level environmental semantics and ground them within the skill database, enabling real-time skill advisories for the robot. To facilitate versatile skill control, we train a styleconditioned policy capable of generating diverse and robust locomotion skills with high fidelity to specified styles. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to demonstrate real-time adaptation of legged locomotion using high-level reasoning from environmental semantics and instructions with instruction-following accuracy of up to 87% without the need for online query to on-the-cloud foundation models. The locomotion controller for a Unitree Go1 was trained using the proximal policy optimization (PPO) algorithm [44] with an asymmetric actorcritic implementation and state estimation, following the methodologies of [7] and [8].
Safe Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via Combined Model and Learning-based Control
基于模型和学习控制相结合的安全全身运动操控
同时实现运动与操作能力，使机器人能够突破固定底座的限制，与环境进行更灵活的交互。然而，在腿式运动与机械臂操作之间实现协调控制，同时在接触交互过程中兼顾安全性与顺应性，仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。为此，我们提出了一种全身控制框架，将基于模型的机械臂导纳控制与用于腿式运动的强化学习（RL）策略相结合。导纳控制器可将外部作用力/力矩（例如人在物理交互中施加的力）映射为期望的末端执行器速度，从而实现顺应性行为。这些速度由机械臂与腿部控制器协同跟踪，实现统一的六自由度（6-DoF）力响应。基于模型的设计通过引入参考调节器（Reference Governor, RG）实现精确的力控制与安全性保障；同时，通过结合神经网络的卡尔曼滤波器对基座速度进行可靠估计，进一步提升系统的鲁棒性。我们在仿真与真实硬件平台上对该方法进行了验证，实验平台为配备六自由度机械臂及腕部六维力/力矩传感器的Unitree Go2四足机器人。实验结果表明，该方法能够准确跟踪由交互驱动的速度指令，实现良好的顺应性表现，并在动态环境中展现出安全且可靠的性能。
Simultaneous locomotion and manipulation enables robots to interact with their environment beyond the constraints of a fixed base. However, coordinating legged locomotion with arm manipulation, while considering safety and compliance during contact interaction remains challenging. To this end, we propose a whole-body controller that combines a model-based admittance control for the manipulator arm with a Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy for legged locomotion. The admittance controller maps external wrenches--such as those applied by a human during physical interaction--into desired end-effector velocities, allowing for compliant behavior. The velocities are tracked jointly by the arm and leg controllers, enabling a unified 6-DoF force response. The model-based design permits accurate force control and safety guarantees via a Reference Governor (RG), while robustness is further improved by a Kalman filter enhanced with neural networks for reliable base velocity estimation. We validate our approach in both simulation and hardware using the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot with a 6-DoF arm and wrist-mounted 6-DoF Force/Torque sensor. Results demonstrate accurate tracking of interaction-driven velocities, compliant behavior, and safe, reliable performance in dynamic settings.
Control the ARmada: LMM Coordination for Multi-Robot AR-HRC
控制 ARmada：用于多机器人 AR-HRC 的 LMM 协调
增强现实（AR）已展现出在人人机协作（HRC）中实现更灵活交互的巨大潜力，例如通过传达机器人的状态与意图[1,3]以及提供直观的控制方式[1]。然而，尽管已有大量系统验证了AR在增强机器人控制方面的能力，这些系统通常只针对单个机器人协作者进行控制，且其交互方式往往依赖对虚拟内容的直接操作；在多机器人场景中，这类操作将变得更加频繁，从而因重复的人工干预而降低任务效率。此外，对虚拟内容的过度关注还可能削弱对现实环境的感知[2]，在存在潜在危险的情况下带来安全隐患。针对这些挑战，我们提出了ARmada——一种结合边缘场景理解与大语言多模态模型（LMM）的AR-HRC系统，旨在提升环境感知能力并支持多机器人场景下的AR控制。
系统设计：ARmada由四个主要组件构成：Meta Quest 3 AR头显、Unitree Go2四足机器人、边缘服务器以及云端LMM。受篇幅限制，额外的机器人协作者以6个虚拟无人机的形式呈现；不过，该系统同样支持接入多种形态的真实机器人。通过对Quest采集的深度与图像数据进行边缘计算与LMM处理，ARmada能够检测并以虚拟标记的形式标注关键环境要素（如潜在危险区域），从而提升用户与机器人的环境感知能力。在完成检测后，用户可以基于环境中的标记发出简洁的高层指令。借助基于LMM的机器人控制方法，系统能够自主引导机器人前往指定位置，或在无需进一步人工干预的情况下，将其组织为复杂队形（如几何形状）。
Augmented reality (AR) has shown strong potential to enable more flexible interaction in human-robot collaboration (HRC) by conveying a robot’s state and intent [1, 3] and enabling intuitive control [1]. However, while many systems exist that demonstrate AR’s ability to enhance robot control, they often incorporate control for only a singular robotic collaborator, with interaction techniques that require direct manipulation of virtual content; in scenarios with many robots, these manipulations would become much more frequent, lowering task efficiency through repeated manual interventions. Moreover, increased focus on virtual content could reduce awareness of the real environment [2], posing safety risks if this environment contains hazards. Motivated by these challenges, we present ARmada, an AR-HRC system leveraging edge scene understanding and an LMM to enhance environmental awareness and enable AR control in multi-robot settings. System Design: ARmada has 4 primary components: a Meta Quest 3 AR headset, a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, an edge server, and a cloud LMM. Due to space constraints, the additional robot collaborators are 6 virtual drones; however, the system can include multiple physical robots of diverse form factors. Through Quest depth and image data processing by the LMM and the edge, ARmada detects and virtually marks key landmarks such as environmental hazards, improving awareness for both the user and robots. Following detection, a user can issue concise, high-level commands relative to landmarks in the environment. Using LMM-based robot control, the system can autonomously direct robots to individual destinations or coordinate them into complex formations, such as geometric shapes, without further user input.
A Deployable Bio-inspired Compliant Leg Design for Enhanced Leaping in Quadruped Robots
一种用于增强四足机器人跳跃能力的可展开仿生柔性腿设计
四足机器人在工业巡检和灾害搜救等多种应用中正变得愈发重要，这些场景对机器人的敏捷性与越障能力提出了更高要求。然而，现有平台的性能常常受限于电机峰值功率不足，从而限制了其执行爆发性跳跃的能力。为应对这一问题，本文提出了一种仿生方法，模拟飞蝗（froghopper）腿部的能量存储机制。我们设计了一种可展开顺应腿（Deployable Compliant Leg, DCL），采用特殊的3D打印弹性材料——聚醚嵌段酰胺（Polyether Block Amide, PEBA），并构建了轻量化的内部晶格结构。该结构在功能上类似于生物肌腱，可在机器人下蹲阶段储存弹性能量，并在起跳时快速释放，从而增强电机输出。所提出的机械设计显著提升了机器人的垂直跳跃能力。通过有限元分析（FEA）与实验验证，我们证明该方法在垂直跳跃高度上实现了17.1%的相对性能提升。相关实验在真实的Unitree Go2四足机器人平台上完成。
Quadruped robots are becoming increasingly essential for various applications, including industrial inspection and catastrophe search and rescue. These scenarios require robots to possess enhanced agility and obstacle-navigation skills. Nonetheless, the performance of current platforms is often constrained by insufficient peak motor power, limiting their ability to perform explosive jumps. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a bio-inspired method that emulates the energy-storage mechanism found in froghopper legs. We designed a Deployable Compliant Leg (DCL) utilizing a specialized 3D-printed elastic material, Polyether block amide (PEBA), featuring a lightweight internal lattice structure. This structure functions analogously to biological tendons, storing elastic energy during the robot’s squatting phase and rapidly releasing it to augment motor output during the leap. The proposed mechanical design significantly enhances the robot’s vertical jumping capability. Through finite element analysis (FEA) and experimental validation, we demonstrate a relative performance improvement of 17.1 % in vertical jumping height. Experiments were conducted on a physical Unitree Go2 robot.
Robust Visual Servoing for Quadruped Robots: ISS-Based Target Tracking With Secondary Formation Objectives
面向四足机器人的鲁棒视觉伺服：基于ISS的具有次级编队目标的跟踪
This work presents the design, implementation, and experimental validation of a visual servo control scheme formulated at the task-space level and applied to a quadruped robot equipped with an active two degree of freedom (2DoF) vision system for continuous tracking of moving targets. The proposed controller is based on a differential kinematic model that maps the robot's task-space velocity references to the kinematic evolution of the active vision system, incorporating a target velocity estimator that enables dynamic compensation of the target motion projected onto the image plane. The control architecture exploits the kinematic redundancy of the robotic system to simultaneously address multiple control objectives within a hierarchical framework. The primary task ensures target centering in the image plane, thereby maintaining visibility within the robot's field of view (FoV), while the secondary task regulates relative formation by controlling the distance and orientation between the robot and the target. Quadruped locomotion is handled by a low-level gait controller and is not modified by the proposed scheme. Closed-loop stability is rigorously analyzed using Lyapunov theory, demonstrating Input-to-State Stability (ISS) properties in the presence of bounded disturbances. Simulation and real-world experimental results obtained with the Unitree Go2 robot confirm the robustness and stability of the proposed approach for dynamic visual tracking in realistic scenarios.
本文提出了一种在任务空间层级构建的视觉伺服控制方案，并将其应用于配备主动两自由度（2DoF）视觉系统的四足机器人，实现对运动目标的连续跟踪。所提出的控制器基于微分运动学模型，将机器人任务空间中的速度参考映射到主动视觉系统的运动学演化，同时引入目标速度估计器，对投影到图像平面的目标运动进行动态补偿。该控制架构利用机器人系统的运动学冗余，在分层框架下同时处理多重控制目标，其中主任务是实现目标在图像平面中的居中，从而保证其始终处于机器人的视场（FoV）内；次任务则通过调节机器人与目标之间的距离与相对姿态，实现期望的编队关系控制。四足机器人的运动由底层步态控制器负责，本方案不对其进行修改。在理论分析方面，基于李雅普诺夫方法对闭环系统稳定性进行了严格证明，表明在有界扰动存在的情况下系统满足输入到状态稳定性（ISS）性质。仿真与基于Unitree Go2机器人的真实实验结果表明，该方法在实际动态场景中具备良好的鲁棒性与稳定性，能够实现可靠的视觉跟踪性能。
REAL: Robust Extreme Agility via Spatio-Temporal Policy Learning and Physics-Guided Filtering
REAL：基于时空策略学习和物理引导滤波的鲁棒极限敏捷性
极限四足跑酷要求机器人在高度动态的环境中快速完成地形感知与精确落足。尽管近年来基于学习的方法已展现出令人印象深刻的敏捷性，但其在感知退化条件下仍然非常脆弱，即便是短暂的视觉噪声或延迟也可能导致灾难性失败。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了鲁棒极限敏捷学习（Robust Extreme Agility Learning, REAL），这是一种面向感知受损条件下可靠跑酷的端到端框架。不同于依赖理想无噪声感知的方案，REAL将视觉信息、本体感觉历史以及时序记忆紧密耦合。我们将跨模态教师策略蒸馏到一个可部署的学生模型中，该模型采用基于FiLM调制的Mamba主干网络，能够主动过滤视觉噪声并构建短期地形记忆。此外，引入物理约束的贝叶斯状态估计器，在高冲击动作过程中强制满足刚体一致性。基于Unitree Go2四足机器人的实验验证表明，即使在存在1米视觉盲区的情况下，REAL仍能成功穿越极端障碍，同时在严格满足实时控制约束的前提下，将推理时间控制在13.1毫秒以内。
Extreme legged parkour demands rapid terrain assessment and precise foot placement under highly dynamic conditions. While recent learning-based systems achieve impressive agility, they remain fundamentally fragile to perceptual degradation, where even brief visual noise or latency can cause catastrophic failure. To overcome this, we propose Robust Extreme Agility Learning (REAL), an end-to-end framework for reliable parkour under sensory corruption. Instead of relying on perfectly clean perception, REAL tightly couples vision, proprioceptive history, and temporal memory. We distill a cross-modal teacher policy into a deployable student equipped with a FiLM-modulated Mamba backbone to actively filter visual noise and build short-term terrain memory actively. Furthermore, a physics-guided Bayesian state estimator enforces rigid-body consistency during high-impact maneuvers. Validated on a Unitree Go2 quadruped, REAL successfully traverses extreme obstacles even with a 1-meter visual blind zone, while strictly satisfying real-time control constraints with a bounded 13.1 ms inference time.
SLowRL: Safe Low-Rank Adaptation Reinforcement Learning for Locomotion
SLowRL：用于运动的安全低秩自适应强化学习
从仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的运动策略迁移往往会由于不可避免的差距而导致性能下降。直接在真实硬件上对这些策略进行朴素微调存在明显问题，不仅有机械损坏的风险，而且样本效率较低。本文针对动态运动任务中强化学习（RL）策略的安全高效微调问题展开研究，重点关注在显式施加安全约束的前提下，将仿真中学得的策略直接迁移并微调到真实硬件上。为此，我们提出了SLowRL——一种将低秩适配（LoRA）与训练阶段安全约束（通过恢复策略实现）相结合的框架。我们在仿真环境以及真实的Unitree Go2四足机器人上，对跳跃与小跑任务进行了评估。实验结果表明，相较于标准的近端策略优化（PPO）基线方法，我们的方法将微调时间缩短了46.5%，同时几乎消除了安全违规行为。值得注意的是，我们发现仅使用秩为1的适配就足以在真实环境中恢复预训练性能，同时保持稳定且安全的在线微调过程。这些结果验证了在真实机器人动态任务中实现安全且高效微调的可行性。
Sim-to-real transfer of locomotion policies often leads to performance degradation due to the inevitable sim-to-real gap. Naively fine-tuning these policies directly on hardware is problematic, as it poses risks of mechanical failure and suffers from high sample inefficiency. In this paper, we address the challenge of safely and efficiently fine-tuning reinforcement learning (RL) policies for dynamic locomotion tasks. Specifically, we focus on fine-tuning policies learned in simulation directly on hardware, while explicitly enforcing safety constraints. In doing so, we introduce SLowRL —a framework that combines Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with training-time safety enforcement via a recovery policy. We evaluate our method both in simulation and on a real Unitree Go2 quadruped robot for jump and trot tasks. Experimental results show that our method achieves a 46.5% reduction in fine-tuning time and near-zero safety violations compared to standard proximal policy optimization (PPO) baselines. Notably, we find that a rank-1 adaptation alone is sufficient to recover pre-trained performance in the real world, while maintaining stable and safe real-world fine-tuning. These results demonstrate the practicality of safe, efficient fine-tuning for dynamic real-world robotic applications.
OA-NBV: Occlusion-Aware Next-Best-View Planning for Human-Centered Active Perception on Mobile Robots
OA-NBV：面向移动机器人以人为中心的感知遮挡感知最优视图规划
当视线被遮挡时，人类会自然地侧移或倾斜身体以绕过障碍，从而获取更有信息量的观察视角。赋予机器人类似的视角选择能力，对于以人为中心的任务（如搜索、分诊和灾害响应）至关重要，因为在这些场景中，杂乱环境与部分可见性往往会削弱后续感知性能。然而，许多下一最佳视角（Next-Best-View, NBV）方法主要优化通用探索或长时域覆盖，并未在真实运动约束下，针对“获取单次可用的被部分遮挡人员观测”这一即时目标进行专门设计。
本文提出了面向移动机器人的遮挡感知下一最佳视角规划方法（Occlusion-Aware Next-Best-View Planning for Human-Centered Active Perception, OA-NBV），这是一种能够自主选择下一个可达视角以获取更完整人体观测的NBV流程。OA-NBV通过以目标为中心的可见性模型对候选视角进行评分，综合考虑遮挡情况、目标尺度以及目标完整性，同时将候选视角限制在机器人可行位姿范围内，从而实现感知与运动规划的紧密结合。
在仿真与真实实验中，OA-NBV均实现了超过90%的成功率，而基线NBV方法在存在遮挡时性能显著下降。除成功率外，OA-NBV还显著提升了观测质量：与最强基线相比，其在不同设置下将归一化目标面积提升至少81%，关键点可见性提升至少58%，因此可以作为一个即插即用的视角选择模块，服务于多种以人为中心的下游任务。真实实验平台为Unitree Go2 Edu四足机器人，搭载Unitree L1激光雷达以及RealSense D435i RGB-D相机。
We naturally step sideways or lean to see around the obstacle when our view is blocked, and recover a more informative observation. Enabling robots to make the same kind of viewpoint choice is critical for human-centered operations, including search, triage, and disaster response, where cluttered environments and partial visibility frequently degrade downstream perception. However, many Next-Best-View (NBV) methods primarily optimize generic exploration or long-horizon coverage, and do not explicitly target the immediate goal of obtaining a single usable observation of a partially occluded person under real motion constraints. We present Occlusion-Aware Next-Best-View Planning for Human-Centered Active Perception on Mobile Robots (OANBV), an occlusion-aware NBV pipeline that autonomously selects the next traversable viewpoint to obtain a more complete view of an occluded human. OA-NBV integrates perception and motion planning by scoring candidate viewpoints using a targetcentric visibility model that accounts for occlusion, target scale, and target completeness, while restricting candidates to feasible robot poses. OA-NBV achieves over 90 % success rate in both simulation and real-world trials, while baseline NBV methods degrade sharply under occlusion. Beyond success rate, OANBV improves observation quality: compared to the strongest baseline, it increases normalized target area by at least 81 % and keypoint visibility by at least 58 % across settings, making it a drop-in view-selection module for diverse human-centered downstream tasks. For real-world experiments, a Unitree Go2 Edu carries a Unitree L1 LiDAR and a RealSense D435i RGB-D camera.
NavThinker: Action-Conditioned World Models for Coupled Prediction and Planning in Social Navigation
NavThinker：用于社会导航中耦合预测和规划的行动条件世界模型
社会导航要求机器人在动态的人类环境中安全行动。有效的行为不仅依赖于当前观测，还需要前瞻性思考：推理场景和行人如何在不同机器人动作下演变。这带来了预测与规划耦合的挑战——机器人动作与人类运动相互影响。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了NavThinker，一种面向未来的框架，将动作条件化的世界模型与在线策略强化学习相结合。该世界模型在Depth Anything V2的patch特征空间中运行，自回归预测未来的场景几何和人类运动；多头解码器随后生成未来深度图和人类轨迹，从而得到与可通行性和交互风险对齐的未来感知状态。关键在于，我们在使用DD-PPO训练策略时，注入了世界模型的前瞻信号：(i) 将动作条件化的未来特征融合到当前观测嵌入中，(ii) 基于预测的人类轨迹进行社会奖励塑形。单机器人和多机器人Social-HM3D实验表明，NavThinker实现了最先进的导航成功率，并可零样本迁移至Social-MP3D，同时在真实Unitree Go2四足机器人上部署验证了其泛化能力和实际可用性。
Social navigation requires robots to act safely in dynamic human environments. Effective behavior demands thinking ahead: reasoning about how the scene and pedestrians evolve under different robot actions rather than reacting to current observations alone. This creates a coupled predictionplanning challenge, where robot actions and human motion mutually influence each other. To address this challenge, we propose NavThinker, a future-aware framework that couples an action-conditioned world model with on-policy reinforcement learning. The world model operates in the Depth Anything V2 patch feature space and performs autoregressive prediction of future scene geometry and human motion; multi-head decoders then produce future depth maps and human trajectories, yielding a future-aware state aligned with traversability and interaction risk. Crucially, we train the policy with DD-PPO while injecting world-model think-ahead signals via: (i) actionconditioned future features fused into the current observation embedding and (ii) social reward shaping from predicted human trajectories. Experiments on single- and multi-robot Social-HM3D show state-of-the-art navigation success, with zero-shot transfer to Social-MP3D and real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2, validating generalization and practical applicability.
ADMM-Based Distributed MPC with Control Barrier Functions for Safe Multi-Robot Quadrupedal Locomotion
基于ADMM的分布式MPC及其控制屏障功能，用于安全的多机器人四足运动
本文提出了一种针对多足机器人系统安全关键轨迹规划的全分布式模型预测控制（MPC）框架，并引入了控制屏障函数（CBF）约束。CBF 约束的引入导致智能体之间产生显式的耦合，使得生成的优化问题无法直接分解。为了解决这一挑战，我们利用基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的结构化分布式优化框架，对中心化的安全关键 MPC 问题进行了重构。通过引入一种带有共识约束的新型点-边分裂（node-edge splitting）表述形式，该方法将全局问题分解为独立的点局部（node-local）和边局部（edge-local）二次规划问题，仅需邻居间的通信即可并行求解。这使得系统在保持安全性和动力学可行性的同时，实现了计算负载对称的全分布式轨迹优化。该框架被集成到四足机器人的分层运动控制架构中，结合了高层分布式轨迹规划、执行单刚体动力学的中层非线性 MPC，以及执行全阶机器人动力学的底层全身控制（WBC）。通过两台 Unitree Go2 四足机器人的硬件实验，以及多达四台机器人在包含崎岖地形和外部干扰的随机环境中导航的数值仿真，验证了该方法的有效性。结果表明，所提出的分布式方案达到了与中心化 MPC 相当的性能，同时在四台机器人的案例中将平均单周期规划时间缩短了 51%，实现了高效的实时分布式部署。
This paper proposes a fully decentralized model predictive control (MPC) framework with control barrier function (CBF) constraints for safety-critical trajectory planning in multi-robot legged systems. The incorporation of CBF constraints introduces explicit inter-agent coupling, which prevents direct decomposition of the resulting optimal control problems. To address this challenge, we reformulate the centralized safety-critical MPC problem using a structured distributed optimization framework based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). By introducing a novel node-edge splitting formulation with consensus constraints, the proposed approach decomposes the global problem into independent node-local and edge-local quadratic programs that can be solved in parallel using only neighbor-to-neighbor communication. This enables fully decentralized trajectory optimization with symmetric computational load across agents while preserving safety and dynamic feasibility. The proposed framework is integrated into a hierarchical locomotion control architecture for quadrupedal robots, combining high-level distributed trajectory planning, mid-level nonlinear MPC enforcing single rigid body dynamics, and low-level whole-body control enforcing full-order robot dynamics. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through hardware experiments on two Unitree Go2 quadrupedal robots and numerical simulations involving up to four robots navigating uncertain environments with rough terrain and external disturbances. The results show that the proposed distributed formulation achieves performance comparable to centralized MPC while reducing the average per-cycle planning time by up to 51% in the four-agent case, enabling efficient real-time decentralized implementation.
History-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
基于历史条件的时空视觉标记剪枝以实现高效的视觉语言导航
视觉语言导航（VLN）使机器人能够根据视觉环境遵循自然语言指令，是具身机器人系统的核心能力。近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽然展现出强大的导航性能，但其高昂的计算成本带来的延迟限制了实时部署。我们提出了一种专为基于 VLA 的视觉语言导航设计的免训练时空视觉标记裁剪框架。我们对当前视图应用空间标记选择，并对历史记忆进行时空压缩，从而在减少冗余计算的同时实现高效的长程推理。利用基于注意力的标记重要性和查询引导的时空过滤，该方法在无需重新训练或修改预训练模型的情况下保留了与导航相关的信息，实现了在现有 VLA 系统中的插件式集成。通过在标准 VLN 基准测试上的实验，我们证实该方法显著优于现有的裁剪策略。在极度裁剪的场景下，它依然能保持卓越的导航准确度，同时维持极具竞争力的推理效率。在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上的实机部署进一步验证了在实际机器人约束下，该方法能够实现可靠且低延迟的指令遵循导航。我们希望这项工作有助于弥合大规模多模态建模与机器人导航系统中高效、实时具身部署之间的差距。
Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) enables robots to follow natural-language instructions in visually grounded environments, serving as a key capability for embodied robotic systems. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong navigation performance, but their high computational cost introduces latency that limits real-time deployment. We propose a training-free spatio-temporal vision token pruning framework tailored to VLA-based VLN. We apply spatial token selection to the current view, alongside spatio-temporal compression for historical memories, enabling efficient long-horizon inference while reducing redundant computation. Leveraging attention-based token importance and query-guided spatio-temporal filtering, the proposed approach preserves navigation-relevant information without retraining or modifying pretrained models, allowing plug-and-play integration into existing VLA systems. Through experiments on standard VLN benchmarks, we confirm that our method significantly outperforms existing pruning strategies. It successfully preserves superior navigation accuracy under extreme pruning scenarios, all while maintaining the highly competitive inference efficiency. Real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot further validates reliable and low-latency instruction-following navigation under practical robotic constraints. We hope this work helps bridge the gap between large-scale multimodal modeling and efficient, real-time embodied deployment in robotic navigation systems.
MorFiC: Fixing Value Miscalibration for Zero-Shot Quadruped Transfer
MorFiC：修复零帧四足动物转移的数值校准误差
在具有不同形态的四足机器人之间泛化已学习的运动策略仍然是一个挑战。在单一机器人上训练的策略在部署到具有不同质量分布、运动学、关节限制或驱动约束的实体上时往往会失效，从而被迫对每个机器人进行重新训练。我们提出了 MorFiC，一种利用单一共享策略实现跨形态零样本运动控制的强化学习方法。MorFiC 解决了多形态 Actor-Critic 训练中的一个关键失效模式：共享 Critic 往往会平均化不同实体间不兼容的价值目标，导致优势函数（advantage）校准失衡。为了解决这一问题，MorFiC 通过由机器人物理和控制参数驱动的形态感知调制来调节 Critic，在共享网络中生成针对特定形态的价值估计。通过在仿真中使用单一源机器人进行形态随机化训练，MorFiC 可以迁移至未见过的机器人，并在多个目标上超越了以形态为条件的 PPO 基准测试，提升了稳定平均速度和最长稳定运行时间，其中在 A1 上速度提升了 16.1%，在 Cheetah 上提升约 2 倍，在 B1 上提升约 5 倍。我们进一步表明，MorFiC 降低了跨形态的价值预测误差方差并稳定了优势估计，证明了改进的价值函数校准对应着更强的迁移性能。最后，我们演示了在两台 Unitree Go1 和 Go2 机器人上无需微调的零样本部署，表明 Critic 端调节是实现跨形态泛化的一种实用方法。
Generalizing learned locomotion policies across quadrupedal robots with different morphologies remain a challenge. Policies trained on a single robot often break when deployed on embodiments with different mass distributions, kinematics, joint limits, or actuation constraints, forcing per robot retraining. We present MorFiC, a reinforcement learning approach for zero-shot cross-morphology locomotion using a single shared policy. MorFiC resolves a key failure mode in multi-morphology actor-critic training: a shared critic tends to average incompatible value targets across embodiments, yielding miscalibrated advantages. To address this, MorFiC conditions the critic via morphology-aware modulation driven by robot physical and control parameters, generating morphology-specific value estimates within a shared network. Trained with a single source robot with morphology randomization in simulation, MorFiC can transfer to unseen robots and surpasses morphology-conditioned PPO baselines by improving stable average speed and longest stable run on multiple targets, including speed gains of +16.1% on A1, ~2x on Cheetah, and ~5x on B1. We additionally show that MorFiC reduces the value-prediction error variance across morphologies and stabilizes the advantage estimates, demonstrating that the improved value-function calibration corresponds to a stronger transfer performance. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot deployment on two Unitree Go1 and Go2 robots without fine-tuning, indicating that critic-side conditioning is a practical approach for cross-morphology generalization.
QuadFM: Foundational Text-Driven Quadruped Motion Dataset for Generation and Control
QuadFM：用于生成和控制的基础性文本驱动四足动物运动数据集
尽管四足机器人技术取得了显著进展，但在整合多样化运动、情感表达行为和丰富语言语义的基础运动资源方面，仍然存在关键空白，而这些资源对于灵敏、直观的人机交互至关重要。现有的四足机器人运动数据集仅局限于少数动捕原语（如行走、小跑、坐下），缺乏具有丰富语言关联的多样化行为。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了 Quadruped Foundational Motion (QuadFM)，这是首个专为文本生成运动和通用运动控制设计的大规模、超高保真数据集。QuadFM 包含 11,784 段精选运动剪辑，涵盖了移动、交互及情感表达行为（如跳舞、拉伸、排尿等），每段剪辑均配有三层标注——细粒度动作标签、交互场景和自然语言指令——总计 35,352 条描述，以支持以语言为条件的理解和指令执行。
我们进一步提出了 Gen2Control RL，这是一个联合训练通用运动控制器和文本生成运动生成器的统一框架，能够在边缘硬件上实现高效的端到端推理。在搭载 NVIDIA Orin 的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人实机上，我们的系统实现了实时运动合成（延迟小于 500 毫秒）。仿真和现实世界的实验结果表明，该系统在保持鲁棒物理交互的同时，能够产生逼真且多样化的运动。
Despite significant advances in quadrupedal robotics, a critical gap persists in foundational motion resources that holistically integrate diverse locomotion, emotionally expressive behaviors, and rich language semantics-essential for agile, intuitive human-robot interaction. Current quadruped motion datasets are limited to a few mocap primitives (e.g., walk, trot, sit) and lack diverse behaviors with rich language grounding. To bridge this gap, we introduce Quadruped Foundational Motion (QuadFM) , the first large-scale, ultra-high-fidelity dataset designed for text-to-motion generation and general motion control. QuadFM contains 11,784 curated motion clips spanning locomotion, interactive, and emotion-expressive behaviors (e.g., dancing, stretching, peeing), each with three-layer annotation-fine-grained action labels, interaction scenarios, and natural language commands-totaling 35,352 descriptions to support language-conditioned understanding and command execution.
We further propose Gen2Control RL, a unified framework that jointly trains a general motion controller and a text-to-motion generator, enabling efficient end-to-end inference on edge hardware. On a real Unitree Go2 quadruped robot with an NVIDIA Orin, our system achieves real-time motion synthesis (<500 ms latency). Simulation and real-world results show realistic, diverse motions while maintaining robust physical interaction.
SmoothTurn: Learning to Turn Smoothly for Agile Navigation with Quadrupedal Robots
SmoothTurn：学习四足机器人平滑转弯以实现敏捷导航
四足机器人在火灾救援和工业巡检等实际应用中展现出巨大潜力。这类任务通常要求机器人具备极高的紧迫感和敏捷导航能力，进而要求其在高速奔跑时能够平滑地变换方向。现有的敏捷导航方法通常学习单目标到达策略，通过鼓励机器人在到达目标点后停留在原位来训练。因此，当该策略用于需要改变方向的连续目标任务时，机器人无法预判后续动作，也无法在目标切换时保持动量，从而限制了其充分发挥敏捷性的潜力。
在本文中，我们将该任务建模为连续局部导航，扩展了以往研究中单目标条件的局部导航表述。随后，我们引入了 SmoothTurn，这是一个基于学习的控制框架，旨在让机器人在高速奔跑中学习平滑转弯，以实现敏捷的连续局部导航。该框架采用了新颖的连续目标到达奖励机制、包含未来目标前瞻窗口的扩展观测空间，以及根据目标达成表现逐步增加采样目标序列难度的自动目标课程学习。训练后的策略可以直接部署在具有机载传感器和计算单元的真实四足机器人上。
仿真和实机实验结果均表明，SmoothTurn 学习到了一种敏捷的运动策略，能够在目标点之间实现平滑转弯，并展现出如切换目标时的动量控制、提前转向未来目标以及规划高效路径等涌现行为。我们在补充材料中提供了学习动作的视频演示。源代码和训练好的策略将在论文接收后公开。在实机实验中，我们将仿真训练的策略部署在了 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上。
Quadrupedal robots show great potential for valuable real-world applications such as fire rescue and industrial inspection. Such applications often require urgency and the ability to navigate agilely, which in turn demands the capability to change directions smoothly while running in high speed. Existing approaches for agile navigation typically learn a single-goal reaching policy by encouraging the robot to stay at the target position after reaching there. As a result, when the policy is used to reach sequential goals that require changing directions, it cannot anticipate upcoming maneuvers or maintain momentum across the switch of goals, thereby preventing the robot from fully exploiting its agility potential. In this work, we formulate the task as sequential local navigation, extending the single-goal-conditioned local navigation formulation in prior work. We then introduce SmoothTurn, a learning-based control framework that learns to turn smoothly while running rapidly for agile sequential local navigation. The framework adopts a novel sequential goal-reaching reward, an expanded observation space with a lookahead window for future goals, and an automatic goal curriculum that progressively expands the difficulty of sampled goal sequences based on the goal-reaching performance. The trained policy can be directly deployed on real quadrupedal robots with onboard sensors and computation. Both simulation and real-world empirical results show that SmoothTurn learns an agile locomotion policy that performs smooth turning across goals, with emergent behaviors such as controlling momentum when switching goals, facing towards the future goal in advance, and planning efficient paths. We have provided video demos of the learned motions in the supplementary materials. The source code and trained policies will be made available upon acceptance. We deploy the trained policies from simulation on the Unitree Go2 quadrupedal robot for our real-world experiments.
CoT-VLNBench: A Benchmark for Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Vision-Language-Navigation Robots
CoT-VLNBench：视觉语言导航机器人视觉思维链推理的基准测试
视觉语言模型（VLMs）在具身导航任务中展现出巨大的潜力。然而，现有的以机器人为中心的数据集主要侧重于感知和预测等传统 3D 任务，缺乏对视觉语言任务的充分支持。视觉语言导航（VLN）是实现在复杂环境中具有类人特性且可解释导航的关键能力。在本研究中，我们推出了 CoT-VLNBench，这是首个专门为四足机器人导航中的思维链（CoT）推理设计的大规模基准测试和数据集。我们的数据集涵盖了多样的室内外场景、多步导航轨迹以及丰富的自然语言指令，并全部附有细粒度的 CoT 推理轨迹标注。具体而言，该数据集包含 17.5 万帧图像、525 万个 3D 边界框以及 87.5 万个视觉问答（VQA）对。这一综合资源能够对具身智能体的感知和逐步推理能力进行全面评估。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的 CoT-VLN 模型，这是一个最先进的 7B 级 VLN 模型，它集成了视觉、语言和推理模块，以实现可解释且有效的导航。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法在这一新基准上显著优于现有的非 VLM 基准模型，强调了 CoT-VLN 在具身导航中的重要性。我们希望 CoT-VLNBench 能成为推动机器人、视觉、语言和推理交叉领域研究的有价值资源。我们手动改装并操作了一台 Unitree Go2 机器人，以采集各种环境下的轮足四足运动数据。
Recent advances in vision language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in embodied navigation tasks. However, existing robot-centric datasets primarily focus on traditional 3D tasks such as perception and prediction, lacking adequate support for vision-language tasks. Vision-language-navigation (VLN) is a key capability for achieving human-like and interpretable navigation in complex environments. In this study, we present CoT-VLN Bench, the first large-scale benchmark and dataset designed for chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in quadruped robot navigation. Our dataset encompasses a diverse range of indoor and outdoor scenes, multi-step navigation trajectories, and rich natural language instructions, all annotated with fine-grained CoT reasoning traces. Specifically, it contains 175K frames, 5.25M 3D bounding boxes, and 875K vision–question–answer (VQA) pairs. This comprehensive resource enables thorough evaluation of embodied agents’ perceptual and step-by-step reasoning abilities. Furthermore, we propose a novel CoT-VLN model, a state-of-the-art 7B VLN model that integrates visual, linguistic, and reasoning modules, to facilitate interpretable and effective navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing non-VLMs baselines on the new benchmark, underscoring the importance of CoT-VLN in embodied navigation. We hope that CoT-VLNBench will serve as a valuable resource to advance research at the intersection of robotics, vision, language, and reasoning. We manually modified and operated a Unitree Go2 robot (Unitree Robotics 2024) to collect wheeled quadruped locomotion data across various environments.
SEA-Nav: Efficient Policy Learning for Safe and Agile Quadruped Navigation in Cluttered Environments
SEA-Nav：面向复杂环境的四足动物安全敏捷导航的高效策略学习
在密集的杂乱环境中高效训练四足机器人导航仍然是一项重大挑战。现有方法要么在简单障碍物分布中缺乏安全性和敏捷性，要么在复杂环境中运动缓慢，且往往需要极长的训练阶段。为此，我们提出了 SEA-Nav（安全、高效且敏捷的导航），这是一种用于四足机器人导航的强化学习框架。在多样化且密集的障碍物环境中，一个基于可微控制屏障函数（CBF）的屏蔽机制约束导航策略输出安全的策略速度指令。同时，我们引入了自适应碰撞重放机制和危险探索奖励，以增加从关键经验中学习的概率，引导高效的探索与利用。最后，通过结合运动学动作约束来确保速度指令的安全性，从而促进物理部署的成功。据我们所知，这是首个在分钟级训练时间内实现极具挑战性的真实世界四足机器人导航的方法。我们在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上针对不同的障碍物环境对该方法进行了评估。
Efficiently training quadruped robot navigation in densely cluttered environments remains a significant challenge. Existing methods are either limited by a lack of safety and agility in simple obstacle distributions or suffer from slow locomotion in complex environments, often requiring excessively long training phases. To this end, we propose SEA-Nav (Safe, Efficient, and Agile Navigation), a reinforcement learning framework for quadruped navigation. Within diverse and dense obstacle environments, a differentiable control barrier function (CBF)-based shield constraints the navigation policy to output safe velocity commands. An adaptive collision replay mechanism and hazardous exploration rewards are introduced to increase the probability of learning from critical experiences, guiding efficient exploration and exploitation. Finally, kinematic action constraints are incorporated to ensure safe velocity commands, facilitating successful physical deployment. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first approach that achieves highly challenging quadruped navigation in the real world with minute-level training time. We evaluated our method on the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot across different obstacle environments.
CoMaTrack: Competitive Multi-Agent Game-Theoretic Tracking with Vision-Language-Action Models
CoMaTrack：基于视觉-语言-动作模型的竞争性多智能体博弈论跟踪
具身视觉跟踪（Embodied Visual Tracking, EVT）是具身智能中的一项核心动态任务，要求智能体精确跟随语言指令指定的目标。然而，现有方法大多依赖单智能体模仿学习，面临专家数据成本高昂以及训练环境静态导致的泛化性受限等问题。受竞争驱动的能力演化启发，我们提出了 CoMaTrack：一个基于竞争博弈论的多智能体强化学习框架，通过在带有竞争子任务的动态对抗场景中训练智能体，使其获得更强的自适应规划能力和抗干扰策略。我们进一步推出了 CoMaTrack-Bench，这是首个基于 Habitat 的开源基准协议和剧集集，专门用于语言条件的竞争性 EVT 动态对决，涵盖了跟踪者与自适应对手在多样化环境及指令下的博弈场景，实现了在主动对抗交互下的标准化鲁棒性评估。基于Go2的实验表明，CoMaTrack 在标准基准测试和 CoMaTrack-Bench 上均达到了最先进水平。值得注意的是，基于本框架训练的 3B 视觉语言模型（VLM）在极具挑战性的 EVT-Bench 上超越了以往基于 7B 模型的单智能体模仿学习方法，在 STT、DT 和 AT 指标上分别达到 92.1%、74.2% 和 57.5%。基准测试代码将在该网址发布。
Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT), a core dynamic task in embodied intelligence, requires an agent to precisely follow a language-specified target. Yet most existing methods rely on single-agent imitation learning, suffering from costly expert data and limited generalization due to static training environments. Inspired by competition-driven capability evolution, we propose CoMaTrack, a competitive game-theoretic multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that trains agents in a dynamic adversarial setting with competitive subtasks, yielding stronger adaptive planning and interference-resilient strategies. We further introduce CoMaTrack-Bench, the first open-source Habitat-based benchmark protocol and episode set for language-conditioned competitive EVT featuring dynamic dueling, featuring game scenarios between a tracker and adaptive opponents across diverse environments and instructions, enabling standardized robustness evaluation under active adversarial interactions. Experiments show that CoMaTrack achieves state-of-the-art results on both standard benchmarks and CoMaTrack-Bench. Notably, a 3B VLM trained with our framework surpasses previous single-agent imitation learning methods based on 7B models on the challenging EVT-Bench, achieving 92.1% in STT, 74.2% in DT, and 57.5% in AT. The benchmark code will be available at this https URL.
Whole-Body Safe Control of Robotic Systems with Koopman Neural Dynamics
基于库普曼神经动力学的机器人系统全身安全控制
具有强非线性、高维动力学的机器人控制仍然具有挑战性，因为带有安全约束的直接非线性优化通常难以实现实时计算。Koopman 算子提供了一种在提升空间中线性表示非线性系统的方法，从而能够使用高效的线性控制。我们提出了一个数据驱动框架，从数据中学习 Koopman 嵌入和算子，并将所得线性模型与安全集算法（SSA）相结合。这使得跟踪和安全约束可以在单个二次规划（QP）中求解，在无需独立安全过滤器的情况下确保了可行性和最优性。我们在 Kinova Gen3 机械臂和 Go2 四足机器人上验证了该方法，展示了精确的跟踪和避障能力。
Controlling robots with strongly nonlinear, high-dimensional dynamics remains challenging, as direct nonlinear optimization with safety constraints is often intractable in real time. The Koopman operator offers a way to represent nonlinear systems linearly in a lifted space, enabling the use of efficient linear control. We propose a data-driven framework that learns a Koopman embedding and operator from data, and integrates the resulting linear model with the Safe Set Algorithm (SSA). This allows the tracking and safety constraints to be solved in a single quadratic program (QP), ensuring feasibility and optimality without a separate safety filter. We validate the method on a Kinova Gen3 manipulator and a Go2 quadruped, showing accurate tracking and obstacle avoidance.
NavGSim: High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting Simulator for Large-Scale Navigation
NavGSim：用于大规模导航的高保真高斯散射模拟器
为机器人模拟真实环境被广泛公认为是机器人学习中的一项关键挑战，特别是在渲染和物理模拟方面。在导航任务中，由于轨迹往往延伸跨越多个房间或整个楼层，这一挑战变得更加突出。在这项工作中，我们推出了 NavGSim，这是一款基于高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）的模拟器，旨在生成高保真、大规模的导航环境。基于分层 3D 高斯泼溅框架，NavGSim 能够在跨越数百平方米的广阔场景中实现照片级逼真的渲染。为了模拟导航碰撞，我们引入了一种基于高斯泼溅的切片技术，直接从重建的高斯分布中提取可通行区域。此外，为了便于使用，我们提供了支持多 GPU 开发的全面 NavGSim API，包括用于自定义场景重建、机器人配置、策略训练和评估的工具。为了评估 NavGSim 的有效性，我们使用从 NavGSim 收集的轨迹训练了一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，并在模拟环境和 Unitree Go2 机器人的真实环境中评估其性能。我们的结果表明，NavGSim 显著增强了 VLA 模型的场景理解能力，使策略能够有效处理多样化的导航查询。
Simulating realistic environments for robots is widely recognized as a critical challenge in robot learning, particularly in terms of rendering and physical simulation. This challenge becomes even more pronounced in navigation tasks, where trajectories often extend across multiple rooms or entire floors. In this work, we present NavGSim, a Gaussian Splatting-based simulator designed to generate high-fidelity, large-scale navigation environments. Built upon a hierarchical 3D Gaussian Splatting framework, NavGSim enables photorealistic rendering in expansive scenes spanning hundreds of square meters. To simulate navigation collisions, we introduce a Gaussian Splatting-based slice technique that directly extracts navigable areas from reconstructed Gaussians. Additionally, for ease of use, we provide comprehensive NavGSim APIs supporting multi-GPU development, including tools for custom scene reconstruction, robot configuration, policy training, and evaluation. To evaluate NavGSim's effectiveness, we train a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model using trajectories collected from NavGSim and assess its performance in both simulated and real-world environments. Our results demonstrate that NavGSim significantly enhances the VLA model's scene understanding, enabling the policy to handle diverse navigation queries effectively.
Maximum Entropy Behavior Exploration for Sim2Real Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning
Sim2Real零样本强化学习的最大熵行为探索
零样本强化学习（Zero-shot RL）算法旨在从无奖励数据集中学习一系列策略，并在测试时直接针对任何奖励函数恢复出最优策略。自然地，预训练数据集的质量决定了恢复策略在各项任务中的表现。然而，在对下游任务缺乏先验知识的情况下，预先收集相关且多样化的数据集仍是一项挑战。在这项工作中，我们基于前向-后向（Forward-Backward, FB）算法，研究了用于真实机器人系统四足控制的零样本强化学习。我们观察到，无向探索产生的数据多样性较低，导致下游性能不佳，并使得策略在硬件直接部署时难以奏效。因此，我们提出了 FB-MEBE，这是一种在线零样本强化学习算法，它将无监督行为探索策略与正则化评论家（Critic）相结合。FB-MEBE 通过最大化所达成行为分布的熵来促进探索；此外，正则化评论家将恢复的策略引导向更自然且符合物理规律的行为。我们通过实验证明，与一系列模拟下游任务中的其他探索策略相比，FB-MEBE 实现了性能提升，并生成了无需进一步微调即可无缝部署到 Unitree Go2 硬件上的自然策略。视频和代码可在我们的网站获取。
Zero-shot reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms aim to learn a family of policies from a reward-free dataset, and recover optimal policies for any reward function directly at test time. Naturally, the quality of the pretraining dataset determines the performance of the recovered policies across tasks. However, pre-collecting a relevant, diverse dataset without prior knowledge of the downstream tasks of interest remains a challenge. In this work, we study
zero-shot RL for quadrupedal control on real robotic systems, building upon the Forward-Backward (FB) algorithm. We observe that undirected exploration yields low-diversity data, leading to poor downstream performance and rendering policies impractical for direct hardware deployment. Therefore, we introduce FB-MEBE, an online zero-shot RL algorithm that combines an unsupervised behavior exploration strategy with a regularization critic. FB-MEBE promotes exploration by maximizing the entropy of the achieved behavior distribution. Additionally, a regularization critic shapes the recovered policies toward more natural and physically plausible behaviors. We empirically demonstrate that FB-MEBE achieves and improved performance compared to other exploration strategies in a range of simulated downstream tasks, and that it renders natural policies that can be seamlessly deployed to Unitree Go2 hardware without further finetuning. Videos and code available on our website.
Watch Your Step: Learning Semantically-Guided Locomotion in Cluttered Environment
注意脚下：在杂乱环境中学习语义引导的运动
虽然足式机器人展示了在崎岖地形上令人印象深刻的机动性，但在杂乱环境中的安全使用仍是一项挑战。一个关键问题是它们无法避开踩踏低矮物体，例如平地上的高价值小型设备或线缆。这种局限性源于高层语义理解与底层控制之间的脱节，以及在实际操作过程中高程图（Elevation Maps）存在的误差。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了 SemLoco：一个旨在密集的杂乱环境中实现精确避障的强化学习（RL）框架。SemLoco 采用两阶段强化学习方法，结合了软约束和硬约束，并进行像素级的足端安全性推理，从而实现更准确的落脚点选择。此外，SemLoco 整合了语义地图来分配通行成本，而不仅仅依赖几何数据。SemLoco 显著减少了碰撞并提高了敏感物体周围的安全性，使得在传统控制器可能导致损坏的情况下实现可靠导航成为可能。在 Unitree Go2 上的实验结果进一步表明，SemLoco 可以有效地应用于更复杂、非结构化的真实环境。
Although legged robots demonstrate impressive mobility on rough terrain, using them safely in cluttered environments remains a challenge. A key issue is their inability to avoid stepping on low-lying objects, such as high-cost small devices or cables on flat ground. This limitation arises from a disconnection between high-level semantic understanding and low-level control, combined with errors in elevation maps during real-world operation. To address this, we introduce SemLoco, a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework designed to avoid obstacles precisely in densely cluttered environments. SemLoco uses a two-stage RL approach that combines both soft and hard constraints and performs pixel-wise foothold safety inference, enabling more accurate foot placement. Additionally, SemLoco integrates a semantic map to assign traversability costs rather than relying solely on geometric data. SemLoco significantly reduces collisions and improves safety around sensitive objects, enabling reliable navigation in situations where traditional controllers would likely cause damage. Experimental results on Unitree Go2 further demonstrate that SemLoco can be effectively applied to more complex, unstructured real-world environments.
AgentVLN: Towards Agentic Vision-and-Language Navigation
AgentVLN：迈向智能视觉与语言导航
视觉语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体在陌生环境中将复杂的自然语言指令转化为长程导航任务。虽然视觉语言模型（VLM）提供了强大的 2D 语义理解能力，但目前的 VLN 系统仍受限于空间感知不足、2D-3D 表示不匹配以及单目尺度模糊等问题。在本文中，我们提出了 AgentVLN：一种可部署在边缘计算平台上的新型高效具身导航框架。我们将 VLN 建模为一个部分可观测半马尔可夫决策过程（POSMDP），并引入了“VLM 作为大脑”的范式，通过即插即用的技能库将高层语义推理与感知及规划解耦。为了解决多层级表示的不一致性，我们设计了一种跨空间表示映射，将感知层的 3D 拓扑路标点投影到图像平面，为 VLM 生成像素级对齐的视觉提示。以此为桥梁，我们集成了上下文感知的自我纠错和主动探索策略，以从遮挡中恢复并抑制长轨迹上的误差累积。为了进一步解决非结构化环境中指令的空间模糊性，我们提出了一种查询驱动的感知思维链（QD-PCoT）方案，使智能体具备主动寻求几何深度信息的元认知能力。最后，我们构建了 AgentVLN-Instruct：一个根据目标可见性进行动态阶段路由的大规模指令微调数据集。大量实验表明，AgentVLN 在长程 VLN 基准测试中持续优于先前的最先进（SOTA）方法，为下一代具身导航模型的轻量化部署提供了一种实用的范式。我们采用 Unitree Go2 四足机器人作为物理平台，并配备 Intel RealSense D455 摄像头以获取第一人称观测结果。
Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to ground complex natural-language instructions into long-horizon navigation in unseen environments. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer strong 2D semantic understanding, current VLN systems remain constrained by limited spatial perception, 2D-3D representation mismatch, and monocular scale ambiguity. In this paper, we propose AgentVLN, a novel and efficient embodied navigation framework that can be deployed on edge computing platforms. We formulate VLN as a Partially Observable Semi-Markov Decision Process (POSMDP) and introduce a VLM-as-Brain paradigm that decouples high-level semantic reasoning from perception and planning via a plug-and-play skill library. To resolve multi-level representation inconsistency, we design a cross-space representation mapping that projects perception-layer 3D topological waypoints into the image plane, yielding pixel-aligned visual prompts for the VLM. Building on this bridge, we integrate a context-aware self-correction and active exploration strategy to recover from occlusions and suppress error accumulation over long trajectories. To further address the spatial ambiguity of instructions in unstructured environments, we propose a Query-Driven Perceptual Chain-of-Thought (QD-PCoT) scheme, enabling the agent with the metacognitive ability to actively seek geometric depth information. Finally, we construct AgentVLN-Instruct, a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset with dynamic stage routing conditioned on target visibility. Extensive experiments show that AgentVLN consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods (SOTA) on long-horizon VLN benchmarks, offering a practical paradigm for lightweight deployment of next-generation embodied navigation models. We employ the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot as our physical platform, equipped with an Intel RealSense D455 camera to acquire the egocentric observation O.
vAccSOL: Efficient and Transparent AI Vision Offloading for Mobile Robots
vAccSOL：面向移动机器人的高效透明的AI视觉卸载
移动机器人越来越多地被部署于巡检、巡逻及搜救任务中，并依赖计算机视觉进行感知、导航和自主决策。然而，由于机载计算资源有限且存在严格的能源约束，在机器人端运行现代视觉负载具有很大挑战性。虽然部分平台包含嵌入式加速器，但这些加速器通常受限于专有软件栈，导致用户自定义的负载只能在资源受限的伴随计算机上运行。
我们提出了 vAccSOL，这是一个用于在异构机器人和边缘平台间高效、透明地执行 AI 视觉负载的框架。vAccSOL 集成了两个核心组件：SOL（一种神经网络编译器，可生成具有极低运行时依赖项的优化推理库）和 vAccel（一个轻量级执行框架，可透明地将推理任务分配至机器人本地或附近的边缘基础设施）。这种结合实现了硬件优化的推理和灵活的执行位置分配，且无需修改机器人应用程序。
我们在包含商用四足机器人 Unitree Go2 的真实测试床上对 vAccSOL 进行了评估，涵盖了图像分类、视频分类和语义分割等 12 种深度学习模型。与 PyTorch 编译器基准相比，SOL 实现了相当或更优的推理性能。通过边缘卸载（offloading），vAccSOL 与 PyTorch 相比可降低机器人侧高达 80% 的功耗，并降低边缘侧高达 60% 的功耗，同时将视觉流水线的帧率提升高达 24 倍，从而延长了电池供电机器人的作业寿命。
Mobile robots are increasingly deployed for inspection, patrol, and search-and-rescue operations, relying on computer vision for perception, navigation, and autonomous decision-making. However, executing modern vision workloads onboard is challenging due to limited compute resources and strict energy constraints. While some platforms include embedded accelerators, these are typically tied to proprietary software stacks, leaving user-defined workloads to run on resource-constrained companion computers.
We present vAccSOL, a framework for efficient and transparent execution of AI-based vision workloads across heterogeneous robotic and edge platforms. vAccSOL integrates two components: SOL, a neural network compiler that generates optimized inference libraries with minimal runtime dependencies, and vAccel, a lightweight execution framework that transparently dispatches inference locally on the robot or to nearby edge infrastructure. This combination enables hardware-optimized inference and flexible execution placement without requiring modifications to robot applications.
We evaluate vAccSOL on a real-world testbed with a commercial quadruped robot Unitree Go2 and twelve deep learning models covering image classification, video classification, and semantic segmentation. Compared to a PyTorch compiler baseline, SOL achieves comparable or better inference performance. With edge offloading, vAccSOL reduces robot-side power consumption by up to 80% and edge-side power by up to 60% compared to PyTorch, while increasing vision pipeline frame rate by up to 24x, extending the operating lifetime of battery-powered robots.
Task-Aware Positioning for Improvisational Tasks in Mobile Construction Robots via an AI Agent with Multi-LMM Modules
基于多线性混合模型模块的人工智能代理在移动式建筑机器人中实现任务感知定位，以应对即兴任务
由于建筑施工环境具有不断变化的特性，工地的许多任务往往以即兴（improvisational）的方式发生。现有的移动建筑机器人研究在处理即兴任务方面仍存在局限性，因为这类任务所需的地点、发生时间以及执行任务所需的上下文信息均无法预先获知。我们提出了一个能够理解以自然语言给出的即兴任务、识别任务所需地点并进行自我定位的智能体。该智能体功能被分解为三个并行运行的大型多模态模型（LMM）模块，从而实现了利用 LMM 进行任务解读与拆解、基于施工图纸的导航，以及识别非预定义任务地点的视觉推理。该智能体在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上得以实现，在三项旨在评估即兴任务处理能力的测试中，其识别任务地点并定位的成功率达到了 92.2%。本研究使移动建筑机器人能够自主执行非预定义的任务。
Due to the ever-changing nature of construction, many tasks on sites occur in an improvisational manner. Existing mobile construction robot studies remain limited in addressing improvisational tasks, where task-required locations, timing of task occurrence, and contextual information required for task execution are not known in advance. We propose an agent that understands improvisational tasks given in natural language, identifies the task-required location, and positions itself. The agent's functionality was decomposed into three Large Multimodal Model (LMM) modules operating in parallel, enabling the application of LMMs for task interpretation and breakdown, construction drawing-based navigation, and visual reasoning to identify non-predefined task-required locations. The agent was implemented with a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot and achieved a 92.2% success rate for identifying and positioning at task-required locations across three tests designed to assess improvisational task handling. This study enables mobile construction robots to perform non-predefined tasks autonomously.
Beyond Imitation: Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for Adaptive Diffusion Navigation Policies
超越模仿：用于自适应扩散导航策略的强化学习微调
基于扩散模型的机器人导航策略在大型模仿学习数据集上训练，能够直接从机器人的视觉观测中生成多峰轨迹，绕过了传统的定位-建图-规划流程，并实现了强大的零样本泛化能力。然而，它们的性能仍受限于离线数据集的覆盖范围；当部署在未见过的设置中时，分布偏移（distribution shift）往往会导致轨迹误差累积和关键安全故障。利用强化学习（RL）微调扩散策略具有挑战性，因为其迭代去噪结构阻碍了有效的梯度反向传播，同时也使得训练额外的价值网络（Value Network）不仅计算成本高昂且稳定性较差。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种专门为基于扩散的导航设计的强化学习微调框架。该方法利用了扩散模型固有的多轨迹采样机制，并采用群体相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO），通过估算采样轨迹间的相对优势来避免对独立价值网络的需求。为了在实现适应性的同时保留预训练的表示，我们冻结了视觉编码器，并有选择地更新更高层的解码器和动作头，通过在线环境反馈增强安全意识行为。在 Isaac Sim 的 PointGoal 任务中，我们的方法在未见过场景下的成功率（Success Rate）从 52.0% 提升至 58.7%，SPL 从 0.49 提升至 0.54，同时降低了碰撞频率。进一步的实验表明，微调后的策略可以零样本迁移至真实的四足机器人平台 Unitree Go2，并在几何分布外（out-of-distribution）环境中保持稳定表现，这表明其对新领域的适应性和安全泛化能力得到了提升。
Diffusion-based robot navigation policies trained on large-scale imitation learning datasets, can generate multi-modal trajectories directly from the robot's visual observations, bypassing the traditional localization-mapping-planning pipeline and achieving strong zero-shot generalization. However, their performance remains constrained by the coverage of offline datasets, and when deployed in unseen settings, distribution shift often leads to accumulated trajectory errors and safety-critical failures. Adapting diffusion policies with reinforcement learning is challenging because their iterative denoising structure hinders effective gradient backpropagation, while also making the training of an additional value network computationally expensive and less stable. To address these issues, we propose a reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework tailored for diffusion-based navigation. The method leverages the inherent multi-trajectory sampling mechanism of diffusion models and adopts Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which estimates relative advantages across sampled trajectories without requiring a separate value network. To preserve pretrained representations while enabling adaptation, we freeze the visual encoder and selectively update the higher decoder layers and action head, enhancing safety-aware behaviors through online environmental feedback. On the PointGoal task in Isaac Sim, our approach improves the Success Rate from 52.0% to 58.7% and SPL from 0.49 to 0.54 on unseen scenes, while reducing collision frequency. Additional experiments show that the fine-tuned policy transfers zero-shot to a real quadruped platform Unitree Go2 and maintains stable performance in geometrically out-of-distribution environments, suggesting improved adaptability and safe generalization to new domains.
GuideTWSI A Diverse Tactile Walking Surface Indicator Dataset from Synthetic and Real-World Images for Blind and Low-Vision Navigation
高效且多功能的四足滑冰：基于强化学习和贝叶斯优化的最优协同设计
触觉地面定向标志（Tactile Walking Surface Indicators, TWSIs）是盲人及低视力（BLV）行人在寻找路口和危险区域时依赖的关键安全地标。通过对导盲犬使用者、训练员及定向行走（O&M）专家的观察，我们确认了可靠且准确的 TWSI 分割对于 BLV 人士导航辅助的关键重要性。实现这种可靠性需要大规模的标注数据。然而，TWSIs 在现有的城市感知数据集中严重缺失，即便是现有的专用铺装数据集也存在局限性：它们缺乏与机器人相关的视角（如第一人称视角或俯视图），且在地理分布上偏向于东亚常见的“条形引导砖”（用于沿人行道持续引导的平行凸起条纹）。这种狭隘的关注点忽略了“截断圆顶砖（truncated domes）”——即在北美和欧洲广泛使用，用于路缘、道口和站台边缘作为可检测警告标志的圆形凸起阵列。因此，仅在条形砖数据上训练的模型难以泛化到圆顶警告标志，导致在安全关键环境中出现漏检和错误停顿。该系统基于配备 RealSense D435 摄像头的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人构建，摄像头采用下倾角度部署，专门用于截断圆顶砖的分割。
Tactile Walking Surface Indicators (TWSIs) are safety-critical landmarks that blind and low-vision (BLV) pedestrians use to locate crossings and hazard zones. From our observation sessions with BLV guide dog handlers, trainers, and an O&M specialist, we confirmed the critical importance of reliable and accurate TWSI segmentation for navigation assistance of BLV individuals. Achieving such reliability requires large-scale annotated data. However, TWSIs are severely underrepresented in existing urban perception datasets, and even existing dedicated paving datasets are limited: they lack robot-relevant viewpoints (e.g., egocentric or top-down) and are geographically biased toward East Asian directional bars - raised parallel strips used for continuous guidance along sidewalks. This narrow focus overlooks truncated domes - rows of round bumps used primarily in North America and Europe as detectable warnings at curbs, crossings, and platform edges. As a result, models trained only on bar-centric data struggle to generalize to dome-based warnings, leading to missed detections and false stops in safety-critical environments. The system is built upon the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot equipped with a RealSense D435 camera positioned with a downward tilt for truncated dome segmentation
SaferPath: Hierarchical Visual Navigation with Learned Guidance and Safety-Constrained Control
SaferPath：基于学习引导和安全约束控制的分层视觉导航
视觉导航是移动机器人的核心能力，然而端到端的学习方法在未见过的、杂乱或狭窄的环境中往往面临泛化性和安全性方面的挑战。这些局限性在密集的室内设置中尤为明显，此类环境下极易发生碰撞，且端到端模型经常失效。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 SaferPath：一个分层视觉导航框架。该框架利用现有端到端模型所学习到的引导信息，并通过一个安全约束优化控制模块对其进行精炼。SaferPath 将视觉观测转化为可通行区域地图，并使用模型预测斯坦变分进化策略（MP-SVES）对引导轨迹进行修正，仅需几次迭代即可高效生成安全轨迹。修正后的轨迹由 MPC 控制器进行跟踪，确保了在复杂环境中的稳健导航。在包含未见障碍物、密集非结构化空间和狭窄走廊等场景的大量实验表明，SaferPath 一致地提高了成功率并减少了碰撞，表现优于 ViNT 和 NoMaD 等代表性基准模型，并在挑战性的现实设置中实现了安全导航。部署在 Unitree Go2 上的 SaferPath 成功避开了未见障碍物和动态障碍物，通过了狭窄空间，并始终保持在安全区域内。
Visual navigation is a core capability for mobile robots, yet end-to-end learning-based methods often struggle with generalization and safety in unseen, cluttered, or narrow environments. These limitations are especially pronounced in dense indoor settings, where collisions are likely and end-to-end models frequently fail. To address this, we propose SaferPath, a hierarchical visual navigation framework that leverages learned guidance from existing end-to-end models and refines it through a safety-constrained optimization-control module. SaferPath transforms visual observations into a traversable-area map and refines guidance trajectories using Model Predictive Stein Variational Evolution Strategy (MP-SVES), efficiently generating safe trajectories in only a few iterations. The refined trajectories are tracked by an MPC controller, ensuring robust navigation in complex environments. Extensive experiments in scenarios with unseen obstacles, dense unstructured spaces, and narrow corridors demonstrate that SaferPath consistently improves success rates and reduces collisions, outperforming representative baselines such as ViNT and NoMaD, and enabling safe navigation in challenging real-world settings. Our SaferPath deployed on the Unitree Go2 successfully avoids both unseen and dynamic obstacles, navigates narrow spaces, and consistently remains within safe areas.
Sensor-Driven Preventive Preservation of Underground Heritage: A Case Study of the Wine Cellars of Baltanás
基于传感器的地下遗产预防性保护：以巴尔塔纳斯酒窖为例
地下酒窖代表了一种脆弱的文化遗产，长期的微小气候失衡可能导致材料退化、结构不稳定以及内部坍塌。高湿度、通风受限和进入困难使得诊断与保护工作变得复杂。本研究展示了应用于西班牙巴尔塔纳斯（帕伦西亚）地下酒窖预防性监测策略的初步结果，重点关注作为劣化关键驱动因素的温度、相对湿度、墙体含水率和通风情况。在超过两年的监测期内，我们在一个代表性酒窖的四个区域部署了由商用温湿度传感器、墙体水分探头和气流传感器组成的无线网络。此外，还利用配备旋转环境传感模块的四足机器人进行了移动监测，实现在狭小且不稳定区域的测量。结果显示，该环境具有极强的热惯性，相对湿度持续偏高且经常趋于饱和，自然通风较弱且呈间歇性，墙体内部水分持续存在。这些条件与观察到的材料腐烂和内部滑坡现象相吻合。利用四足机器人进行的监测在识别固定传感器无法覆盖的局部高湿区域和空气停滞区方面被证明特别有价值。本研究展示了不同的监测方案如何支持地下遗产的预防性保护策略，并为早期风险检测和信息化管理决策提供了一个可扩展的框架。
Underground wine cellars represent a fragile form of cultural heritage, where long-term microclimatic imbalance can lead to material degradation, structural instability, and internal collapses. High humidity, limited ventilation, and the difficulty of access complicate both diagnosis and conservation. This study presents preliminary results from a preventive monitoring strategy applied to the underground wine cellars of Baltanás (Palencia, Spain), focusing on temperature, relative humidity, wall moisture content, and ventilation as key drivers of deterioration. A wireless network of commercial temperature–humidity sensors, wall moisture probes, and airflow sensors was deployed in four sections of a representative cellar over a monitoring period exceeding two years. In addition, mobile monitoring was performed using a quadruped robot equipped with a rotating environmental sensing module, enabling measurements in confined and unstable areas. Results reveal strong thermal inertia, persistently high relative humidity frequently approaching saturation, low and intermittent natural ventilation, and sustained internal wall moisture. These conditions are consistent with observed material decay and internal landslides. The monitoring with quadruped robot proved particularly valuable for identifying localized humidity pockets and stagnant air zones beyond the reach of fixed sensors. The study demonstrates how different solutions for monitoring can support preventive conservation strategies for subterranean heritage, providing a scalable framework for early risk detection and informed management decisions.
Learning Quadruped Walking from Seconds of Demonstration
通过几秒钟的演示学习四足动物行走
四足运动为理解“无模型学习（model-free learning）”何时能超越“基于模型的控制设计（model-based control）”提供了一个天然场景，它通过利用数据模式来绕过离散接触优化以及模态切换组合爆炸带来的困难。基于极限环结构、庞加莱回归映射（Poincaré return maps）以及神经网络的局部数值特性，我们对为什么四足机器人的模仿学习在小样本情况下依然天生有效进行了原理性分析。这种理解促成了一种新的模仿学习方法，该方法能够调节潜空间变量与输出动作变量之间的对齐关系。硬件实验证实，仅需几秒钟的演示就足以从零开始完全离线地训练出具有合理鲁棒性的各种运动策略。我们在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人及其对应的 IsaacLab 仿真器上进行了实验。
Quadruped locomotion provides a natural setting for understanding when model-free learning can outperform model-based control design, by exploiting data patterns to bypass the difficulty of optimizing over discrete contacts and the combinatorial explosion of mode changes. We give a principled analysis of why imitation learning with quadrupeds can be inherently effective in a small data regime, based on the structure of its limit cycles, Poincaré return maps, and local numerical properties of neural networks. The understanding motivates a new imitation learning method that regulates the alignment between variations in a latent space and those over the output actions. Hardware experiments confirm that a few seconds of demonstration is sufficient to train various locomotion policies from scratch entirely offline with reasonable robustness. We conduct experiments on the Unitree Go2 quadruped and its corresponding IsaacLab simulator.
FloorPlan-VLN: A New Paradigm for Floor Plan Guided Vision-Language Navigation
FloorPlan-VLN：一种基于平面图的视觉语言导航新范式
由于建筑施工环境具有不断变化的特性，工地的许多任务往往以即兴（improvisational）的方式发生。现有的移动建筑机器人研究在处理即兴任务方面仍存在局限性，因为这类任务所需的地点、发生时间以及执行任务所需的上下文信息均无法预先获知。我们提出了一个能够理解以自然语言给出的即兴任务、识别任务所需地点并进行自我定位的智能体。该智能体功能被分解为三个并行运行的大型多模态模型（LMM）模块，从而实现了利用 LMM 进行任务解读与拆解、基于施工图纸的导航，以及识别非预定义任务地点的视觉推理。该智能体在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上得以实现，在三项旨在评估即兴任务处理能力的测试中，其识别任务地点并定位的成功率达到了 92.2%。本研究使移动建筑机器人能够自主执行非预定义的任务。
Existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) task requires agents to follow verbose instructions, ignoring some potentially useful global spatial priors, limiting their capability to reason about spatial structures. Although human-readable spatial schematics (e.g., floor plans) are ubiquitous in real-world buildings, current agents lack the cognitive ability to comprehend and utilize them. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{FloorPlan-VLN}, a new paradigm that leverages structured semantic floor plans as global spatial priors to enable navigation with only concise instructions. We first construct the FloorPlan-VLN dataset, which comprises over 10k episodes across 72 scenes. It pairs more than 100 semantically annotated floor plans with Matterport3D-based navigation trajectories and concise instructions that omit step-by-step guidance. Then, we propose a simple yet effective method \textbf{FP-Nav} that uses a dual-view, spatio-temporally aligned video sequence, and auxiliary reasoning tasks to align observations, floor plans, and instructions. When evaluated under this new benchmark, our method significantly outperforms adapted state-of-the-art VLN baselines, achieving more than a 60\% relative improvement in navigation success rate. Furthermore, comprehensive noise modeling and real-world deployments demonstrate the feasibility and robustness of FP-Nav to actuation drift and floor plan distortions. These results validate the effectiveness of floor plan guided navigation and highlight FloorPlan-VLN as a promising step toward more spatially intelligent navigation. we deploy FP-Nav on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot
From Woofs to Words: Towards Intelligent Robotic Guide Dogs with Verbal Communication
从吠叫到语言：迈向具备语言交流能力的智能机器人导盲犬
辅助机器人技术是机器人学的一个重要分支，专注于提升残障人士的福祉。机器人导盲犬是一种辅助型四足机器人，旨在帮助视障人士避障和导航。在机器人导盲犬上实现语言能力，绝非简单地将现有对话系统移植到移动机器人上。其面临的新挑战包括将语言与动态变化的环境相结合（语境落地），以及增强人类使用者对空间的感知。为了应对这些挑战，我们为机器人导盲犬开发了一种新型对话系统，利用大语言模型将导航规划和场景信息转化为语言。其目标是实现语言交流，以支持使用者与机器人团队之间的协同决策。在实验中，我们通过人工研究评估了不同的语言化策略，并通过仿真研究评估了导航任务的效率和准确性。我们采用 Unitree Go2 作为四足机器人平台，并将其与我们的对话系统进行了集成。
Assistive robotics is an important subarea of robotics that focuses on the well-being of people with disabilities. A robotic guide dog is an assistive quadruped robot for assisting visually impaired people in obstacle avoidance and navigation. Enabling language capabilities on robotic guide dogs goes beyond naively adding an existing dialog system onto a mobile robot. The novel challenges include grounding language to the dynamically changing environment and improving spatial awareness for the human handler. To address those challenges, we develop a novel dialog system for robotic guide dogs that uses large language models to verbalize both navigational plans and scenes. The goal is to enable verbal communication for collaborative decision-making within the handler-robot team. In experiments, we performed a human study to evaluate different verbalization strategies, and a simulation study to evaluate the efficiency and accuracy in navigation tasks. We used a Unitree Go2 as a quadruped robot platform and integrated it with our dialog
system.
OGScene3D: Incremental Open-Vocabulary 3D Gaussian Scene Graph Mapping for Scene Understanding
OGScene3D：用于场景理解的增量式开放词汇3D高斯场景图映射
开放词汇场景理解对于机器人应用至关重要，它使机器人能够理解复杂的 3D 环境上下文，并支持导航和操作等各种下游任务。然而，现有方法需要预先构建完整的 3D 语义地图来构建场景图以进行场景理解，这限制了它们在增量探索环境的机器人场景中的适用性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 OGScene3D：一个能够实现增量式精确 3D 语义建图和场景图构建的开放词汇场景理解系统。我们的系统采用基于置信度的高斯语义表示，对语义预测及其可靠性进行联合建模，从而实现稳健的场景建模。基于该表示，我们引入了一种分层 3D 语义优化策略，通过建立局部对应关系和全局优化来实现语义一致性，进而构建全局一致的语义地图。此外，我们设计了一种长期全局优化方法，利用历史观测的时间记忆来增强语义预测。通过将 2D-3D 语义一致性与高斯渲染贡献相结合，该方法能够持续优化对整个场景的语义理解。此外，我们还开发了一种渐进式图构建方法，动态创建并更新节点及语义关系，允许 3D 场景图的持续更新。在广泛使用的数据集和真实场景上的大量实验证明了 OGScene3D 在开放词汇场景理解方面的有效性。
Open-vocabulary scene understanding is crucial for robotic applications, enabling robots to comprehend complex 3D environmental contexts and supporting various downstream tasks such as navigation and manipulation. However, existing methods require pre-built complete 3D semantic maps to construct scene graphs for scene understanding, which limits their applicability in robotic scenarios where environments are explored incrementally. To address this challenge, we propose OGScene3D, an open-vocabulary scene understanding system that achieves accurate 3D semantic mapping and scene graph construction incrementally. Our system employs a confidence-based Gaussian semantic representation that jointly models semantic predictions and their reliability, enabling robust scene modeling. Building on this representation, we introduce a hierarchical 3D semantic optimization strategy that achieves semantic consistency through local correspondence establishment and global refinement, thereby constructing globally consistent semantic maps. Moreover, we design a long-term global optimization method that leverages temporal memory of historical observations to enhance semantic predictions. By integrating 2D-3D semantic consistency with Gaussian rendering contribution, this method continuously refines the semantic understanding of the entire scene. Furthermore, we develop a progressive graph construction approach that dynamically creates and updates both nodes and semantic relationships, allowing continuous updating of the 3D scene graphs. Extensive experiments on widely used datasets and real-world scenes demonstrate the effectiveness of our OGScene3D on open-vocabulary scene understanding.
SPAN-Nav: Generalized Spatial Awareness for Versatile Vision-Language Navigation
SPAN-Nav：面向通用视觉语言导航的通用空间感知
最近利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的具身导航方法在通用的视觉语言导航（VLN）中表现出了强大的泛化能力。然而，由于空间感知不足，在复杂环境中进行可靠的路径规划仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 SPAN-Nav：一个旨在通过 RGB 视频流为具身导航注入通用 3D 空间感知的端到端基础模型。SPAN-Nav 通过在广泛的室内外环境中执行占据预测（occupancy prediction）任务，从多样化的场景中提取空间先验。为了减轻计算负担，我们引入了一种紧凑的空间先验表示方法，发现单个 Token 就足以封装导航任务所需的粗粒度线索。此外，受思维链（CoT）机制启发，SPAN-Nav 利用这单个空间 Token，通过端到端框架显式地将空间线索注入到动作推理中。凭借多任务共同训练，SPAN-Nav 从通用的空间先验中捕获任务自适应线索，使强大的空间感知能力甚至能泛化到缺乏显式空间监督的任务中。为了支持全面的空间学习，我们提出了一个包含 420 万个占据标注的大规模数据集，涵盖了多种导航任务下的室内外场景。SPAN-Nav 在横跨不同场景和多样导航任务的三个基准测试中均达到了最先进（SOTA）的性能。最后，真实世界实验验证了我们的方法在复杂物理场景下的稳健泛化能力和实际可靠性。在实际部署中，SPAN-Nav 运行在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上，该机器人配备了四台 SG3S11AFxK 摄像头以实现多视图 RGB 流传输。
Recent embodied navigation approaches leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong generalization in versatile Vision-Language Navigation (VLN). However, reliable path planning in complex environments remains challenging due to insufficient spatial awareness. In this work, we introduce SPAN-Nav, an end-to-end foundation model designed to infuse embodied navigation with universal 3D spatial awareness using RGB video streams. SPAN-Nav extracts spatial priors across diverse scenes through an occupancy prediction task on extensive indoor and outdoor environments. To mitigate the computational burden, we introduce a compact representation for spatial priors, finding that a single token is sufficient to encapsulate the coarse-grained cues essential for navigation tasks. Furthermore, inspired by the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism, SPAN-Nav utilizes this single spatial token to explicitly inject spatial cues into action reasoning through an end-to end framework. Leveraging multi-task co-training, SPAN-Nav captures task-adaptive cues from generalized spatial priors, enabling robust spatial awareness to generalize even to the task lacking explicit spatial supervision. To support comprehensive spatial learning, we present a massive dataset of 4.2 million occupancy annotations that covers both indoor and outdoor scenes across multi-type navigation tasks. SPAN-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks spanning diverse scenarios and varied navigation tasks. Finally, real-world experiments validate the robust generalization and practical reliability of our approach across complex physical scenarios. For real-world deployment, SPAN-Nav runs on a Unitree GO2 quadruped robot equipped
with four SG3S11AFxK cameras for multi-view RGB streaming.
DecoVLN: Decoupling Observation, Reasoning, and Correction for Vision-and-Language Navigation
DecoVLN：解耦观察、推理和校正以进行视觉语言导航
视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体遵循长程指令并在复杂的 3D 环境中进行导航。然而，现有方法面临两个主要挑战：构建有效的长期记忆库以及克服复合误差（compounding errors）问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 DecoVLN：一个专为长程导航中稳健的流式感知和闭环控制而设计的有效框架。首先，我们将长期记忆构建建模为一个优化问题，并引入了自适应精炼机制，通过迭代优化统一评分函数，从历史候选池中筛选帧。该函数共同平衡了三个关键标准：与指令的语义相关性、已选记忆的视觉多样性以及历史轨迹的时间覆盖范围。其次，为了缓解复合误差，我们引入了一种状态-动作对级别的纠错微调策略。通过利用状态间的测地线距离（geodesic distance）来精确量化与专家轨迹的偏差，智能体在信任区域内收集高质量的状态-动作对，同时过滤掉相关性较低的污染数据。这提升了纠错的效率和稳定性。大量实验证明了 DecoVLN 的有效性，并且我们已将其部署在真实环境中。我们采用 Unitree Go2 作为四足机器人平台，该平台将实时第一人称视频流传输到配备单张 RTX4090 GPU 的服务器上。
Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow long-horizon instructions and navigate complex 3D environments. However, existing approaches face two major challenges: constructing an effective long-term memory bank and overcoming the compounding errors problem. To address these issues, we propose DecoVLN, an effective framework designed for robust streaming perception and closed-loop control in long-horizon navigation. First, we formulate long-term memory construction as an optimization problem and introduce adaptive refinement mechanism that selects frames from a historical candidate pool by iteratively optimizing a unified scoring function. This function jointly balances three key criteria: semantic relevance to the instruction, visual diversity from the selected memory, and temporal coverage of the historical trajectory. Second, to alleviate compounding errors, we introduce a state-action pair-level corrective finetuning strategy. By leveraging geodesic distance between states to precisely quantify deviation from the expert trajectory, the agent collects high-quality state-action pairs in the trusted region while filtering out the polluted data with low relevance. This improves both the efficiency and stability of error correction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DecoVLN, and we have deployed it in real-world environments.  We employ the Unitree GO2 as our quadruped robot platform, which transmits the real-time
ego-centric video stream to a server equipped with a single RTX4090 GPU.
PEPA: a Persistently Autonomous Embodied Agent with Personalities
PEPA：具有人格的持久自主具身智能体
生物体通过内部产生的目标和自我维持的行为组织表现出持久的自主性，而目前的具身智能体仍受外部设定的目标驱动。这种对预定义任务规范的依赖限制了它们在持续的人工干预不切实际、动态且非结构化的环境中进行长期部署的能力。我们提出，人格特质为实现持久自主性提供了一种内在的组织原则。类似于基因型偏好塑造生物行为倾向，人格使智能体能够自主产生目标并在没有外部监督的情况下维持行为演化。为了实现这一目标，我们开发了 PEPA：一个通过三个相互作用系统运行的三层认知架构。系统 3（Sys3）自主合成与人格相符的目标，并通过情节记忆和每日自我反思对其进行提炼；系统 2（Sys2）进行审慎推理，将目标转化为可执行的动作计划；系统 1（Sys1）将智能体植入感觉运动交互中，执行动作并记录经验。我们通过在多层办公楼中的四足机器人真实部署验证了该框架。在不依赖固定任务规范的情况下，机器人自主地在用户请求和人格驱动的动机之间进行仲裁，据此搭乘电梯并探索环境。针对五种不同人格原型的定量分析展示了稳定且与特质相符的行为。结果证实，人格驱动的认知架构能够实现持久具身系统所特有的持续自主运行。硬件配置采用 Unitree Go2-W 轮足机器人作为移动底座，提供足式和轮式两种运动模式，以便穿越楼梯和平地。
Living organisms exhibit persistent autonomy through internally generated goals and self-sustaining behavioral organization, yet current embodied agents remain driven by externally scripted objectives. This dependence on predefined task specifications limits their capacity for long-term deployment in dynamic, unstructured environments where continuous human intervention is impractical. We propose that personality traits provide an intrinsic organizational principle for achieving persistent autonomy. Analogous to genotypic biases shaping biological behavioral tendencies, personalities enable agents to autonomously generate goals and sustain behavioral evolution without external supervision. To realize this, we develop PEPA, a three-layer cognitive architecture that operates through three interacting systems: Sys3 autonomously synthesizes personality-aligned goals and refines them via episodic memory and daily self-reflection; Sys2 performs deliberative reasoning to translate goals into executable action plans; Sys1 grounds the agent in sensorimotor interaction, executing actions and recording experiences. We validate the framework through real-world deployment on a quadruped robot in a multi-floor office building. Operating without reliance on fixed task specifications, the robot autonomously arbitrates between user requests and personality-driven motivations, navigating elevators and exploring environments accordingly. Quantitative analysis across five distinct personality prototypes demonstrates stable, trait-aligned behaviors. The results confirm that personality-driven cognitive architectures enable sustained autonomous operation characteristic of persistent embodied systems. The hardware configuration consists of a Unitree Go2-W wheeled quadruped as the mobile base, providing both legged and wheeled locomotion modes for traversing stairs and flat ground.
Navigation beyond Wayfinding: Robots Collaborating with Visually Impaired Users for Environmental Interactions
超越寻路导航：机器人与视障用户协作进行环境互动
机器人导航系统在支持盲人及视力障碍（BVI）人士的寻路和避障方面已显示出巨大潜力。然而，大多数现有系统都假设路径畅通，忽略了导航中一个至关重要的方面——即需要通过操纵物体来辅助移动的环境交互。这些交互对于“人-机”组合而言极具挑战性，因为它们需要：(i) 对交互目标（如按下电梯按钮）进行精确的定位和操纵；(ii) 用户与机器人运动之间的动态协调（如拉开椅子坐下）。我们提出了一种协作式的人机交互方法，将机器人导盲犬精确的感知和定位能力与用户进行物理操纵的能力相结合。该系统在两种模式之间切换：引导模式（Lead Mode），由机器人检测并引导用户走向目标；适应模式（Adaptation Mode），当用户与环境交互（如开门）时，机器人会调整自身的运动。评估结果表明，与传统的白手杖和非自适应引导系统相比，我们的系统使导航更加安全、平稳且高效，且随着任务对定位交互目标精度的要求提高，性能差距进一步拉大。这些发现凸显了人机协作在推动辅助技术向更具泛化性和现实意义的导航支持迈进方面的潜力。为了支持室内外不同地形的适应性，我们采用了低成本的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人。
Robotic guidance systems have shown promise in supporting blind and visually impaired (BVI) individuals with wayfinding and obstacle avoidance. However, most existing systems assume a clear path and do not support a critical aspect of navigation - environmental interactions that require manipulating objects to enable movement. These interactions are challenging for a human-robot pair because they demand (i) precise localization and manipulation of interaction targets (e.g., pressing elevator buttons) and (ii) dynamic coordination between the user's and robot's movements (e.g., pulling out a chair to sit). We present a collaborative human-robot approach that combines our robotic guide dog's precise sensing and localization capabilities with the user's ability to perform physical manipulation. The system alternates between two modes: lead mode, where the robot detects and guides the user to the target, and adaptation mode, where the robot adjusts its motion as the user interacts with the environment (e.g., opening a door). Evaluation results show that our system enables navigation that is safer, smoother, and more efficient than both a traditional white cane and a non-adaptive guiding system, with the performance gap widening as tasks demand higher precision in locating interaction targets. These findings highlight the promise of human-robot collaboration in advancing assistive technologies toward more generalizable and realistic navigation support. o support adaptation to different terrains in both indoor and out door environments, we adopted a low-cost Unitree Go2 quadruped robot.
DreamFlow: Local Navigation Beyond Observation via Conditional Flow Matching in the Latent Space
DreamFlow：基于潜在空间中条件流匹配的超越观察的局部导航
在杂乱环境中的局部导航经常受到密集障碍物和频繁局部极小值的影响。传统的局部规划器依赖于启发式方法且易于失败，而基于深度强化学习（DRL）的方法虽然具有适应性，但受限于有限的车载传感能力。由于机器人无法感知其视野之外的结构，这些局限性会导致导航失败。在本文中，我们提出了 DreamFlow：一个基于 DRL 的局部导航框架，通过条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching, CFM）扩展了机器人的感知视野。所提出的基于 CFM 的预测模块学习了以导航上下文为条件的局部高程图潜表示与更广泛空间表示之间的概率映射。这使得导航策略能够预测未观测到的环境特征，并主动避开潜在的局部极小值。实验结果表明，DreamFlow 在仿真中的潜状态预测准确性和导航性能方面均优于现有方法。该方法在杂乱的真实世界环境中通过四足机器人得到了进一步验证。真实世界实验是在 Unitree Go2 机器人上进行的。
Local navigation in cluttered environments often suffers from dense obstacles and frequent local minima. Conventional local planners rely on heuristics and are prone to failure, while deep reinforcement learning(DRL)based approaches provide adaptability but are constrained by limited onboard sensing. These limitations lead to navigation failures because the robot cannot perceive structures outside its field of view. In this paper, we propose DreamFlow, a DRL-based local navigation framework that extends the robot's perceptual horizon through conditional flow matching(CFM). The proposed CFM based prediction module learns probabilistic mapping between local height map latent representation and broader spatial representation conditioned on navigation context. This enables the navigation policy to predict unobserved environmental features and proactively avoid potential local minima. Experimental results demonstrate that DreamFlow outperforms existing methods in terms of latent prediction accuracy and navigation performance in simulation. The proposed method was further validated in cluttered real world environments with a quadrupedal robot. Real-world experiments were performed on a Unitree Go2 robot.
