Simulation Distillation: Pretraining World Models in Simulation for Rapid Real-World Adaptation
仿真蒸馏：在仿真环境中预训练世界模型以实现快速的现实世界适应
仿真到现实（Sim-to-real）的迁移仍然是机器人技术中的一个核心挑战，因为模拟与现实世界动力学之间的不匹配经常导致任务失败。虽然强化学习为适应性提供了一种原则性机制，但现有的仿真到现实微调方法在现实机器人典型的低数据场景下，往往难以进行有效的探索和长程信用分配（long-horizon credit assignment）。我们引入了仿真蒸馏（Simulation Distillation, SimDist）：这是一个仿真到现实的框架，它将模拟器的结构先验蒸馏到潜世界模型（latent world model）中，并通过在线规划和监督动力学微调实现快速的现实世界适应。通过直接从仿真中迁移奖励和价值模型，SimDist 能够从原始感知中提供密集的规划信号，而无需在部署期间进行价值学习。因此，现实世界的适应过程简化为了短程系统辨识，规避了长程信用分配问题，从而实现了快速、稳定的性能提升。在精密操作和四足运动任务中，SimDist 在数据效率、稳定性和最终性能方面均显著优于以往的方法。我们在 Unitree Go2 平台上进行了四足运动实验，动作指令以 12 个关节的位置目标形式给出。
Simulation-to-real transfer remains a central challenge in robotics, as mismatches between simulated and real-world dynamics often lead to failures. While reinforcement learning offers a principled mechanism for adaptation, existing sim-to-real finetuning methods struggle with exploration and long-horizon credit assignment in the low-data regimes typical of real-world robotics. We introduce Simulation Distillation (SimDist), a sim-to-real framework that distills structural priors from a simulator into a latent world model and enables rapid real-world adaptation via online planning and supervised dynamics finetuning. By transferring reward and value models directly from simulation, SimDist provides dense planning signals from raw perception without requiring value learning during deployment. As a result, real-world adaptation reduces to short-horizon system identification, avoiding long-horizon credit assignment and enabling fast, stable improvement. Across precise manipulation and quadruped locomotion tasks, SimDist substantially outperforms prior methods in data efficiency, stability, and final performance. We conduct quadrupedal experiments on a Unitree Go2 platform, with actions given as position targets for the 12 joints.
Who Let the Robot Dogs Out? Digital Forensic Analysis of Quadruped Robot
谁放出了机器狗？四足机器人的数字取证分析
四足机器人正日益广泛应用于工业、安全与消费等领域，通常以集成化系统的形式运行，涵盖机器人本体、控制接口、配套应用以及云服务。尽管部署规模不断扩大，针对四足机器人系统的数字取证分析仍有待深入研究。本文将四足机器人概念化为由多个相互作用组件构成的“信息物理生态系统”，并通过实证分析其运行过程中产生、分布与留存的数字取证痕迹。我们以在统一时间轴上关联分散于生态系统各处的残留痕迹为核心，重建机器人的运行情境。以 Unitree Go2 Pro 平台为案例，该平台体现了当代四足机器人的结构与功能特征。分析对关键取证痕迹进行了分类，并识别出跨组件的关联关系，证明可以构建统一时间线，将操作者行为与机器人响应加以关联。进一步地，本文提出一种集成化取证分析方法，并实现了一个原型工具，以支持对关联痕迹的可视化探索。案例研究表明，即使在机器人出现异常行为的情况下，该方法与工具仍能够有效重建其运行情境。本研究为四足机器人取证提供了基础性见解，并强调了在新兴四足机器人生态系统中开展事后证据分析的实践考量。
Quadruped robots are increasingly adopted across industrial, security, and consumer domains. They are typically operated as integrated systems that encompass the robot device, control interfaces, companion applications, and cloud services. Despite this growing deployment, digital forensic analysis of quadruped robot systems remains underexplored. This paper conceptualizes quadruped robots as cyber physical ecosystems composed of interacting components and empirically analyzes the digital forensic artifacts that are generated, distributed, and retained throughout operation. We focus on reconstructing a robot’s operational context by correlating residual artifacts distributed across the ecosystem on a common temporal axis. As a case study, we examine the Unitree Go2 Pro platform, which reflects structural and functional characteristics of contemporary quadruped robots. Our analysis categorizes key forensic artifacts and identifies cross component correlations, demonstrating that unified timelines can be reconstructed to link operator actions with robot behaviors. We further propose an integrated forensic analysis approach and implement a prototype tool to support visual exploration of correlated artifacts. Through the case study, we show that the proposed approach and tool can reconstruct operational context even when anomalous robot behavior is observed. This work offers foundational insights for quadruped robot forensics and highlights practical considerations for post incident evidence analysis in emerging quadruped robot ecosystems.​
OpenGo: An OpenClaw-Based Robotic Dog with Real-Time Skill Switching
OpenGo：一款基于OpenClaw、可实时切换技能的机器狗
单一机器人智能体在适应复杂任务与多场景方面仍面临显著挑战，尤其是在动态环境中实时获取、组织并灵活切换多种技能的能力，已成为具身智能的基础要求。我们提出 OpenGo——一款基于 OpenClaw 的具身机器狗，能够根据场景与任务指令实现技能的实时切换。具体而言，该智能体具备：（1）可定制的技能库，支持便捷的技能导入与自主技能验证；（2）调度器，可依据任务提示或自然语言指令选择并调用不同技能；（3）自学习框架，可基于任务完成情况与人类反馈对技能进行持续微调。我们将该系统部署于 Unitree 的 Go2 机器狗平台上，并验证了其在技能自检与自主切换方面的能力。此外，通过集成飞书平台通信，我们实现了自然语言引导与人类反馈，使得缺乏经验的用户也能通过简单指令对机器狗进行控制。
Adaptation to complex tasks and multiple scenarios remains a significant challenge for a single robot agent. The ability to acquire organize, and switch between a wide range of skills in real time, particularly in dynamic environments, has become a fundamental requirement for embodied intelligence. We introduce OpenGo, an OpenClaw-powered embodied robotic dog capable of switching skills in real time according to the scene and task instructions. Specifically, the agent is equipped with (1) a customizable skill library with easy skill import and autonomous skill validation, (2) a dispatcher that selects and invokes different skills according to task prompts or language instructions, and (3) a self-learning framework that fine-tunes skills based on task completion and human feedback. We deploy the agent in Unitree's Go2 robotic dog and validate its capabilities in self-checking and switching of skills autonomously. In addition, by integrating Feishu-platform communication, we enable natural-language guidance and human feedback, allowing inexperienced users to control the robotic dog through simple instructions.
Safety-Critical Centralized Nonlinear MPC for Cooperative Payload Transportation by Two Quadrupedal Robots
基于安全关键型集中式非线性模型预测控制的双四足机器人协同有效载荷运输
本文提出了一种面向安全关键场景的集中式非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）框架，用于两台四足机器人协同搬运负载。通过将机器人—负载耦合系统建模为离散时间的非线性微分—代数系统（DAE），刻画由完整约束与交互力/力矩所体现的耦合动力学关系。为在复杂环境中保障安全性，本文构建了基于控制屏障函数（CBF）的 NMPC 方法，在优化过程中对机器人及负载同时施加避碰约束。该方法将交互力/力矩保留为决策变量，从而形成具有结构化特征的 DAE 约束最优控制问题，并支持高效的实时求解与执行。我们在两台 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上开展了大量硬件实验，在存在质量与转动惯量不确定性以及外部推扰的复杂环境中完成协同搬运任务，验证了所提算法的有效性。
This paper presents a safety-critical centralized nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) framework for cooperative payload transportation by two quadrupedal robots. The interconnected robot-payload system is modeled as a discrete-time nonlinear differential-algebraic system, capturing the coupled dynamics through holonomic constraints and interaction wrenches. To ensure safety in complex environments, we develop a control barrier function (CBF)-based NMPC formulation that enforces collision avoidance constraints for both the robots and the payload. The proposed approach retains the interaction wrenches as decision variables, resulting in a structured DAE-constrained optimal control problem that enables efficient real-time implementation. The effectiveness of the algorithm is validated through extensive hardware experiments on two Unitree Go2 platforms performing cooperative payload transportation in cluttered environments under mass and inertia uncertainty and external push disturbances.
A Numerical Model for Estimating the Equivalent Magnetic Moment Induced on Electromagnetic Motors by High Intensity Magnetic Fields
用于估算高强度磁场作用下电磁电机等效磁矩的数值模型
随着机器人平台在高风险且磁环境复杂的场景（如 CERN 的地下科研设施）中的应用日益增多，亟需深入理解强外部磁场对机电驱动系统的影响。配备电磁（EM）电机的四足机器人尤为敏感，因为其执行器会与环境磁通直接发生相互作用，从而产生额外的机械力与力矩，进而影响系统稳定性、轨迹跟踪性能以及整体运行安全。本文提出了一种建模框架，用于估计电磁电机在强磁场作用下的等效磁矩。该方法将数值仿真数据集与基于磁偶极子的解析模型相结合，构建出一种计算高效的模型，能够实时预测由磁场引起的机械扰动。模型同时考虑了磁矩对外部磁场强度以及电机相对于磁场方向取向的依赖关系，使控制系统能够提前预判扰动力矩并实施相应的补偿策略。通过在受控磁场中对 Unitree GO-M8010-6 电机进行旋转实验，并将实测力矩与模型预测结果进行对比，验证了该模型的准确性与可靠性。实验结果在变化趋势与幅值上均表现出高度一致，表明该方法能够为强磁环境下的实时控制应用提供足够的建模精度。
The increasing use of robotic platforms in hazardous and magnetically complex environments, such as underground research facilities at CERN, demands a detailed understanding of how strong external magnetic fields affect electromechanical actuation. Quadruped robots equipped with electromagnetic (EM) motors are particularly vulnerable, as their actuators interact directly with ambient magnetic fluxes, generating additional mechanical forces and moments that can compromise stability, trajectory tracking and overall operational safety. This work presents a modeling framework for estimating the equivalent magnetic moment of an EM motor subjected to high-intensity magnetic fields. The proposed approach combines numerical simulation datasets with an analytical dipole-based formulation to derive a computationally efficient model capable of predicting magnetic-induced mechanical disturbances in real/time. The model accounts for the dependence of the magnetic moment on both the external field intensity and the motor’s orientation relative to the field lines, enabling the control system to anticipate disturbance torques and implement appropriate compensation strategies. The accuracy and reliability of the model were validated experimentally by rotating a Unitree GO-M8010-6 motor within controlled magnetic fields and comparing the measured torques with the model predictions. The results demonstrate close agreement in both trend and amplitude, confirming that the proposed formulation can provide the level of fidelity required for real-time control applications in magnetically harsh environments.
Natural Gradient Gaussian Approximation Filter on Lie Groups for Robot State Estimation
基于李群的自然梯度高斯逼近滤波器在机器人状态估计中的应用
针对在李群流形（如足式机器人）上演化的机器人系统，实现精确的状态估计是达成敏捷控制的前提。然而，该问题受到定义在曲率流形上的非线性观测模型所带来的挑战：现有滤波方法通常依赖在切空间进行局部线性化来处理非线性，从而导致误差逐步累积。为此，本文将流形上的滤波问题重新表述为关于高斯分布增量变量的参数优化问题，从而避免了线性化过程。在该框架下，增量通过指数映射被投影到李群上，并以乘法形式作用于先验估计，得到后验状态。进一步地，我们提出了一种自然梯度优化方法，其迭代过程利用增量变量的费舍尔信息矩阵来刻画切空间的曲率特性。在此基础上，形成了名为 NANO-L（基于李群的自然梯度高斯近似）滤波器的迭代算法。借助李导数中的扰动模型，本文证明：对于机器人定位任务中广泛采用的不变观测模型，NANO-L 的协方差更新可获得精确的闭式解，从而无需迭代更新，显著提升了计算效率。在 Unitree GO2 足式机器人跨多种地形的硬件实验中，NANO-L 在相当的计算开销下将估计误差降低约 40%，优于常用滤波方法。
Accurate state estimation for robotic systems evolving on Lie group manifolds, such as legged robots, is a prerequisite for achieving agile control. However, this task is challenged by nonlinear observation models defined on curved manifolds, where existing filters rely on local linearization in the tangent space to handle such nonlinearity, leading to accumulated estimation errors. To address this limitation, we reformulate manifold filtering as a parameter optimization problem over a Gaussian-distributed increment variable, thereby avoiding linearization. Under this formulation, the increment can be mapped to the Lie group through the exponential operator, where it acts multiplicatively on the prior estimate to yield the posterior state. We further propose a natural gradient optimization scheme for solving this problem, whose iteration process leverages the Fisher information matrix of the increment variable to account for the curvature of the tangent space. This results in an iterative algorithm named the Natural Gradient Gaussian Approximation on Lie Groups (NANO-L) filter. Leveraging the perturbation model in Lie derivative, we prove that for the invariant observation model widely adopted in robotic localization tasks, the covariance update in NANO-L admits an exact closed-form solution, eliminating the need for iterative updates thus improving computational efficiency. Hardware experiments on a Unitree GO2 legged robot operating across different terrains demonstrate that NANO-L achieves approximately 40% lower estimation error than commonly used filters at a comparable computational cost.
Terrain-Reactive Locomotion Policies from Vision-Language-Action Priors: Bridging Semantic Commands and Whole-Body Quadruped Control
基于视觉-语言-动作先验的地形反应式运动策略：连接语义指令和全身四足动物控制
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已在桌面操作任务中展现出卓越能力，但尚未应用于全身四足运动控制领域；该领域的动作空间高维、强依赖地形，并要求以 50–200 Hz 的频率进行反应式控制。本文提出 LocoVLA，一种将预训练 VLA 模型与四足机器人运动控制器相结合的分层框架。系统采用冻结的 VLA 主干网络，处理自视角相机图像与自然语言导航指令，生成具备地形感知能力的语义规划——即包含多种运动原语（如行走、小跑、攀爬、匍匐、跳跃）及其对应速度与航向目标的序列。底层控制策略通过强化学习在仿真中训练并迁移至真实硬件，负责执行各类运动原语，并依据本体感觉感知到的局部地形几何，自适应调整足端落点与机身姿态。本文的关键技术贡献在于提出“语义到运动”桥接模块：该模块在深度图提取的地形嵌入条件下，将 VLA 输出的离散原语标记转化为可供底层控制器使用的连续参考轨迹。在 Unitree Go2 机器人上的实验涵盖 5 类户外地形（平地、坡地、楼梯、碎石、草地）与 12 条语言指令，结果表明，LocoVLA 的指令完成率达到 87.5%，显著优于未使用 VLA 规划的基线方法（71.3%），并在累计 2.8 公里的行进过程中实现零跌倒，展现出稳健的运动能力。
Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in tabletop manipulation but have not been applied to whole-body quadruped locomotion, where the action space is high-dimensional, terrain-dependent, and requires reactive control at 50–200 Hz. We present LocoVLA, a hierarchical framework that bridges pretrained VLA models and quadruped motor controllers. A frozen VLA backbone processes egocentric camera images and natural-language navigation commands to produce a terrain-aware semantic plan—a sequence of locomotion primitives (walk, trot, climb, crawl, leap) with associated velocity and heading targets. A terrain-reactive lowlevel policy, trained via reinforcement learning in simulation and transferred to hardware, executes each primitive while adapting footstep placement and body posture to local terrain geometry sensed through proprioception. The key technical contribution is a semantic-to-motor bridge module that translates the VLA’s discrete primitive tokens into continuous reference trajectories consumable by the low-level controller, conditioned on a terrain embedding from the depth image. Evaluated on a Unitree Go2 robot across 5 outdoor terrain types (flat, slope, stairs, rubble, grass) and 12 language commands, LocoVLA achieves 87.5% command completion rate compared to 71.3% for a baseline without VLA-guided planning, while maintaining robust locomotion with zero falls across 2.8 km of traversal.
PriPG-RL: Privileged Planner-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Partially Observable Systems with Anytime-Feasible MPC
PriPG-RL：面向部分可观测系统的特权规划器引导强化学习，具有随时可行的模型预测控制能力
本文研究在部分可观测条件下训练强化学习（RL）策略的问题，通过引入一个仅在训练阶段可用、具备特权信息且具备“随时可行性”（anytime-feasible）的规划器智能体来提升学习效果。我们将该问题形式化为一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）：其中规划器智能体能够访问近似动力学模型与特权状态信息，用于指导仅能观测到真实状态有损投影的学习智能体。为实现该框架，本文提出一种具备随时可行性的模型预测控制（MPC）算法作为规划器；同时针对学习智能体，提出 Planner-to-Policy Soft Actor-Critic（P2P-SAC）方法，将规划器的特权知识蒸馏到策略中，以缓解部分可观测性带来的不利影响，从而提升样本效率与最终策略性能。我们对该框架进行了严格的理论分析，并在 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 仿真环境中完成验证，最终成功部署于真实的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人，在复杂、障碍密集的环境中实现稳定导航。
This paper addresses the problem of training a reinforcement learning (RL) policy under partial observability by exploiting a privileged, anytime-feasible planner agent available exclusively during training. We formalize this as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) in which a planner agent with access to an approximate dynamical model and privileged state information guides a learning agent that observes only a lossy projection of the true state. To realize this framework, we introduce an anytime-feasible Model Predictive Control (MPC) algorithm that serves as the planner agent. For the learning agent, we propose Planner-to-Policy Soft Actor-Critic (P2P-SAC), a method that distills the planner agent's privileged knowledge to mitigate partial observability and thereby improve both sample efficiency and final policy performance. We support this framework with rigorous theoretical analysis. Finally, we validate our approach in simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Lab and successfully deploy it on a real-world Unitree Go2 quadruped navigating complex, obstacle-rich environments.
Artificial plateau neurons with in-situ spike-malleability for rhythmic quadrupedal locomotion
具有原位脉冲可塑性的人工平台神经元，用于节律性四足运动
面向全身协同的智能运动系统长期面临执行冗余与能效低下的问题，制约了其在真实场景中的应用。受生物启发的中央模式发生器（CPG）为节律控制提供了有前景的框架，但其硬件实现往往难以兼顾生物系统所具备的高效率与自适应能力。本文提出一种原位“脉冲可塑”人工平台神经元，将双稳态平台门与瞬态阈值开关相结合。该神经元能够生成振幅可编程的节律性脉冲簇，通过由两个配对单元（平台门与阈值开关）构成的可扩展电路，实现对伸肌与屈肌的对抗式、低能耗激活。该设计采用分布式编码以支持协调的“肌肉”控制，单脉冲能耗低至 141.37 pJ。进一步扩展为四单元电路后，可增强脉冲的动态可塑性，从而支持多关节协调的并行处理。在四足机器人（Unitree Go2）上，这些分布式电路通过对节律脉冲进行高斯滤波，直接驱动关节级比例-微分（PD）控制器，实现无需集中式计算的高能效小跑运动。实验结果表明，该系统不仅能够实现稳定的地面行走，还可在真实环境中完成自适应步态切换。该方法将超紧凑硬件设计与仿生架构相结合，为面向高能效自主机器人的类脑计算系统提供了新的发展路径。
Whole-body intelligent locomotion systems face persistent challenges of redundant actuation and poor energy efficiency, limiting real-world deployment. Bio-inspired central pattern generators offer a promising framework for rhythmic control, yet hardware implementations struggle to match the efficiency and adaptability of biological systems. Here, we introduce an in-situ spike-malleable artificial plateau neuron integrating a bistable plateau gate with a transient threshold-switch. The neuron generates amplitude-programmable rhythmic spike bursts, achieving energy-efficient, antagonistic activation of extensors and flexors via a scalable circuit comprising two paired units (plateau gate and threshold-switch). The design leverages distributed encoding for coordinated muscle control, operating at ultra-low energy dissipation (141.37 pJ/spike). An expanded four-unit circuit enhances dynamic spike malleability, enabling parallel processing for multi-joint coordination. On a quadruped robot (Unitree Go2), these distributed circuits directly drive joint-level proportional derivative controllers using the Gaussian-filtered rhythmic spikes, enabling energy-efficient trotting without centralized computation. Critically, the system achieves stable on-ground locomotion and demonstrates adaptive gait transitions in real-world environments. Our approach merges ultra-compact hardware with bio-inspired architecture, advancing neuromorphic systems for energy-efficient autonomous robotics.
Quadruped Parkour Learning: Sparsely Gated Mixture of Experts with Visual Input
四足跑酷学习：基于视觉输入的稀疏门控专家混合模型
机器人跑酷为推进复杂地形下的运动能力提供了具有挑战性的基准任务，尤其涉及跨越高台阶等大尺度不连续地形。近年来的方法虽已展示出动态攀爬与跳跃等出色能力，但通常依赖于顺序结构的多层感知机（MLP），且各层为密集激活。相比之下，稀疏门控的专家混合（MoE）架构在大语言模型领域已被证明是一种有效范式，可通过在推理时仅激活部分参数来提升可扩展性与性能。本文探索将稀疏门控 MoE 架构应用于基于视觉的机器人跑酷任务，并在控制变量实验中，对标准 MLP 与 MoE 控制策略在“推理时激活参数量相同”的条件下进行对比。在真实的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人实验中，结果显示 MoE 策略具有显著性能优势：在跨越大型障碍任务中，其成功次数达到标准 MLP 基线的两倍。进一步分析表明，若要使标准 MLP 达到相当性能，需要将其参数规模扩展至与 MoE 模型总参数量相当，从而导致计算时间增加约 14.3%。这些结果表明，稀疏门控 MoE 架构在性能与计算效率之间提供了更优权衡，为视觉驱动的机器人跑酷控制策略的规模化发展提供了有效路径。
Robotic parkour provides a compelling benchmark for advancing locomotion over highly challenging terrain, including large discontinuities such as elevated steps. Recent approaches have demonstrated impressive capabilities, including dynamic climbing and jumping, but typically rely on sequential multilayer perceptron (MLP) architectures with densely activated layers. In contrast, sparsely gated mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures have emerged in the large language model domain as an effective paradigm for improving scalability and performance by activating only a subset of parameters at inference time. In this work, we investigate the application of sparsely gated MoE architectures to vision-based robotic parkour. We compare control policies based on standard MLPs and MoE architectures under a controlled setting where the number of active parameters at inference time is matched. Experimental results on a real Unitree Go2 quadruped robot demonstrate clear performance gains, with the MoE policy achieving double the number of successful trials in traversing large obstacles compared to a standard MLP baseline. We further show that achieving comparable performance with a standard MLP requires scaling its parameter count to match that of the total MoE model, resulting in a 14.3\% increase in computation time. These results highlight that sparsely gated MoE architectures provide a favorable trade-off between performance and computational efficiency, enabling improved scaling of control policies for vision-based robotic parkour.
Will People Enjoy a Robot Trainer? A Case Study with Snoopie the Pacerbot
人们会喜欢机器人教练吗？以Snoopie the Pacerbot为例的案例研究
运动的身体性使得体育教练这一角色具有独特优势：其实体在场能够引导学习者完成动作、示范练习，并提供直观反馈。四足机器人同样属于具身智能体，具备良好的机动性与“运动能力”。在本研究中，我们探讨四足机器人是否可以作为一种高效且有趣的个人训练设备。我们以跑步间歇训练为案例进行研究——这是一类重复性强、时间跨度长且对节奏精度与一致性要求较高的任务。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 SNOOPIE：一种基于 Unitree Go2 改造的四足机器人“配速员”，能够根据用户的个体能力定制并执行间歇训练任务。我们通过用户实验，将该机器人教练与可穿戴训练设备 Apple Watch 进行对比，以评估实体具身形态在运动交互中的优势。结果表明，相较于可穿戴设备，使用四足机器人训练可将配速遵从度提升 60.6%，并使跑步速度一致性提高 45.9%。主观评价结果亦显示，参与者在多个维度上明显更偏好机器人教练，包括易用性（+56.7%）、交互趣味性（+60.6%）以及实用性（+39.1%）。这些结果表明，具身四足机器人在运动训练场景中具有显著潜力。
The physicality of exercise makes the role of athletic trainers unique. Their physical presence allows them to guide a student through a motion, demonstrate an exercise, and give intuitive feedback. Robot quadrupeds are also embodied agents with robust agility and athleticism. In our work, we investigate whether a robot quadruped can serve as an effective and enjoyable personal trainer device. We focus on a case study of interval training for runners: a repetitive, long-horizon task where precision and consistency are important. To meet this challenge, we propose SNOOPIE, a modified Unitree Go2 robot quadruped pacer capable of running interval training exercises tailored to challenge a user's personal abilities. We conduct a set of user experiments that compare the robot trainer to a wearable trainer device--the Apple Watch--to investigate the benefits of a physical embodiment in exercise-based interactions. We demonstrate 60.6% better adherence to a pace schedule and were 45.9% more consistent across their running speeds with the quadruped trainer. Subjective results also showed that participants strongly preferred training with the robot over wearable devices across many qualitative axes, including its ease of use (+56.7%), enjoyability of the interaction (+60.6%), and helpfulness (+39.1%).
Toward Empathetic Robotic Dogs for Joint Attention Support in Autism Intervention
面向自闭症干预中共同注意力支持的共情机器人狗
共同注意是社会交往中的核心能力之一，但在自闭症人群中常常受损。本文对一款具备情感表达能力的四足机器人狗进行了平台验证：该机器人配备定制的云台式头部（pan–tilt）以及设备端人脸情绪识别功能，并探讨相比仅依赖注视行为，基于情绪驱动的反应是否能够使共同注意线索更加清晰且更具吸引力。在一项包含六名神经典型成人的被试内初步实验中，我们对比了两种条件：（A）仅进行人脸跟踪；（B）在人脸跟踪基础上加入情绪识别与共情反应。结果表明，参与者普遍认为机器人的方向性提示易于理解，能够产生有效的情绪感染，并表现出较强的再次交互意愿，尽管其拟真度评价较低。部分用户在安全感与舒适度方面反馈不一，而主观“共同注意”体验在不同参与者之间也存在差异，这表明需要进一步优化注视与运动时序，使其更加平滑且可预测。该研究在涉及自闭症人群的后续实验之前，有助于揭示关键设计约束与潜在失效模式。实验基于 Unitree Go2 平台完成。
Joint attention is a core component of social communication and is frequently impaired in individuals with autism. This work presents a platform validation of an emotionally expressive quadruped robot dog with a custom pan–tilt head and on-device facial emotion recognition, and asks participants whether emotion-driven reactions make joint-attention cues clearer and more engaging than gaze-only behavior. In a within-subjects pilot with six neurotypical adults, we compared (A) face tracking only and (B) face tracking plus emotion recognition and empathetic reactions. Participants generally found the robot’s directional cues easy to interpret, reported effective emotional contagion, and expressed strong willingness to interact again, despite low perceived realism. Perceived safety/comfort was mixed for some users, and subjective “shared attention” was inconsistent across participants, suggesting a need for smoother and more predictable gaze and motion timing. Learning Task-Invariant Properties via Dreamer: Enabling Efficient Policy Transfer for Quadruped Robots
通过 Dreamer 学习任务不变属性：实现四足机器人的高效策略迁移
在多样且动态变化的地形上实现四足机器人稳定运动面临显著挑战，其核心在于仿真环境与现实世界之间的差异。传统的 sim-to-real 迁移方法通常依赖人工特征设计或代价高昂的真实环境微调。为此，本文提出 DreamTIP 框架，在 Dreamer 世界模型架构中引入任务不变属性（Task-Invariant Properties）学习，以提升跨域迁移能力。在大语言模型的引导下，DreamTIP 自动识别并利用如接触稳定性与地形间隙等任务不变属性，这些属性对动态变化具有鲁棒性，并在不同任务间具备良好的可迁移性。通过将这些属性作为辅助预测目标融入世界模型，策略能够学习对底层动力学变化不敏感的表征。此外，本文设计了一种高效的自适应策略，结合混合经验回放缓冲区与正则化约束，实现对真实动力学的快速校准，同时有效缓解表征坍塌与灾难性遗忘问题。在包括楼梯（Stair）、攀爬（Climb）、倾斜（Tilt）与匍匐（Crawl）等复杂地形上的大量实验表明，DreamTIP 在仿真与现实环境中均显著优于当前先进方法：在八个仿真迁移任务中平均性能提升 28.1%；在真实世界的攀爬任务中，基线方法成功率仅为 10%，而本文方法达到 100%。在 Unitree Go2 机器人的实测中亦得到验证：面对 53 cm 高度的攀爬任务，成功率同样由基线的 10% 提升至 100%。这些结果表明，将任务不变属性引入 Dreamer 学习框架，为实现鲁棒且具备良好迁移性的机器人运动控制提供了一种有效的新路径。
Achieving quadruped robot locomotion across diverse and dynamic terrains presents significant challenges, primarily due to the discrepancies between simulation environments and real-world conditions. Traditional sim-to-real transfer methods often rely on manual feature design or costly real-world fine-tuning. To address these limitations, this paper proposes the DreamTIP framework, which incorporates Task-Invariant Properties learning within the Dreamer world model architecture to enhance sim-to-real transfer capabilities. Guided by large language models, DreamTIP identifies and leverages Task-Invariant Properties, such as contact stability and terrain clearance, which exhibit robustness to dynamic variations and strong transferability across tasks. These properties are integrated into the world model as auxiliary prediction targets, enabling the policy to learn representations that are insensitive to underlying dynamic changes. Furthermore, an efficient adaptation strategy is designed, employing a mixed replay buffer and regularization constraints to rapidly calibrate to real-world dynamics while effectively mitigating representation collapse and catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments on complex terrains, including Stair, Climb, Tilt, and Crawl, demonstrate that DreamTIP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both simulated and real-world environments. Our method achieves an average performance improvement of 28.1% across eight distinct simulated transfer tasks. In the real-world Climb task, the baseline method achieved only a 10\ success rate, whereas our method attained a 100% success rate. These results indicate that incorporating Task-Invariant Properties into Dreamer learning offers a novel solution for achieving robust and transferable robot locomotion. Real-world tests on the Unitree Go2 robot further validated our method: it reached a 100% success rate in the Climb task (53 cm), compared to the baseline’s 10%.
Learning Tactile-Aware Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation Policies
学习触觉感知四足动物的运动操控策略
四足机器人的行走—操作（loco-manipulation）通常依赖视觉感知与本体感觉，但在接触密集型操作中仍面临显著挑战：仅凭视觉与本体感觉难以准确刻画与环境之间不确定且不断变化的接触过程。触觉感知能够直接提供接触信息，但面向四足机器人行走—操作的一体化、可扩展触觉学习框架仍有待深入研究。本文提出一种分层结构的触觉感知行走—操作策略学习管线。该方法包含两个关键组成部分：首先，利用真实世界的人类示范数据训练一个以触觉为条件的视觉-触觉高层策略，该策略不仅预测操作所需的末端执行器轨迹，还能预测随时间演化的触觉交互特征，从而刻画接触应如何逐步形成；其次，在仿真环境中开展大规模强化学习，训练一个具备触觉感知能力的全身控制策略，用于跟踪多样化的轨迹指令与触觉交互信号，并实现零样本迁移到真实环境。两者结合，使系统能够在接触密集场景中实现协调的运动与操作。我们在多项真实任务中对系统进行了评估，包括手内重定向与插入操作、阀门旋紧以及精细物体操控等。与仅依赖视觉或基础视觉-触觉方法相比，本文方法在这些任务上的平均性能提升达 28.54%。实验平台由一台 12 自由度的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人与一台 6 自由度的 D1 机械臂组成，二者均由 Go2 电池供电。
Quadrupedal loco-manipulation is commonly built on visual perception and proprioception. Yet reliable contact-rich manipulation remains difficult: vision and proprioception alone cannot resolve uncertain, evolving interactions with the environment. Tactile sensing offers direct contact observability, but scalable tactile-aware learning framework for quadrupedal loco-manipulation is still underexplored. In this paper, we present a tactile-aware loco-manipulation policy learning pipeline with a hierarchical structure. Our approach has two key components. First, we leverage real-world human demonstrations to train a tactile-conditioned visuotactile high-level policy. This policy predicts not only end-effector trajectories for manipulation, but also the evolving tactile interaction cues that characterize how contact should develop over time. Second, we perform large-scale reinforcement learning in simulation to learn a tactile-aware whole-body control policy that tracks diverse commanded trajectories and tactile interaction cues, and transfers zero-shot to the real world. Together, these components enable coordinated locomotion and manipulation under contact-rich scenarios. We evaluate the system on real-world contact-rich tasks, including in-hand reorientation with insertion, valve tightening, and delicate object manipulation. Compared to vision-only and visuotactile baselines, our method improves performance by 28.54% on average across these tasks. which consists of a 12-DOF Unitree Go2 quadruped robot and a 6-DOF D1 robot arm, both powered by the battery of Go2.
Simulator Adaptation for Sim-to-Real Learning of Legged Locomotion via Proprioceptive Distribution Matching
基于本体感觉分布匹配的腿式运动模拟到真实学习的模拟器适应
在仿真中训练得到的足式机器人运动策略在真实硬件上往往出现性能下降，这主要源于仿真与现实之间的动力学差异，因此亟需能够“反向校准”仿真器以贴近真实行为的方法。以往研究通常通过对关节与机体轨迹进行精确、时间对齐的匹配来量化这种差异，但该过程依赖动作捕捉、特权传感信息以及严格控制的初始条件，实施成本较高。本文提出一种更为实用的替代方案——基于本体感觉分布匹配的方法，将真实硬件与仿真运行结果视为关节观测与动作的概率分布进行比较，从而无需时间对齐或外部传感。以该分布差异作为黑盒优化目标，我们进一步探索通过参数辨识、动作增量模型以及执行器残差模型来调整仿真动力学。实验表明，在 Go2 四足机器人上的大规模仿真对仿真（sim-to-sim）消融实验中，该方法在参数恢复精度与策略性能提升方面均可达到依赖特权状态匹配方法的水平。真实世界实验显示，仅需不到五分钟的硬件数据，即可显著减少策略漂移，即便是在双足行走这一具有挑战性的行为上亦如此。结果表明，本体感觉分布匹配为实现从仿真到现实的高效迁移提供了一条切实可行且效果显著的路径。
Simulation trained legged locomotion policies often exhibit performance loss on hardware due to dynamics discrepancies between the simulator and the real world, highlighting the need for approaches that adapt the simulator itself to better match hardware behavior. Prior work typically quantify these discrepancies through precise, time-aligned matching of joint and base trajectories. This process requires motion capture, privileged sensing, and carefully controlled initial conditions. We introduce a practical alternative based on proprioceptive distribution matching, which compares hardware and simulation rollouts as distributions of joint observations and actions, eliminating the need for time alignment or external sensing. Using this metric as a black-box objective, we explore adapting simulator dynamics through parameter identification, action-delta models, and residual actuator models. Our approach matches the parameter recovery and policy-performance gains of privileged state-matching baselines across extensive sim-to-sim ablations on the Go2 quadruped. Real-world experiments demonstrate substantial drift reduction using less than five minutes of hardware data, even for a challenging two-legged walking behavior. These results demonstrate that proprioceptive distribution matching provides a practical and effective route to simulator adaptation for sim-to-real transfer of learned legged locomotion.
Dual-Anchoring: Addressing State Drift in Vision-Language Navigation
双锚定：解决视觉语言导航中的状态漂移问题
视觉-语言导航（Vision-Language Navigation, VLN）要求智能体依据自然语言指令在三维环境中完成导航。尽管近年来视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）显著推动了该领域的发展，但在长时序任务中仍易受到“状态漂移”（State Drift）问题的影响：即智能体的内部状态逐渐偏离真实任务执行状态，导致无目的游走并无法完成关键操作。本文将该问题归因于两类认知缺陷：其一是“进度漂移”（Progress Drift），即无法区分已完成与未完成的子目标；其二是“记忆漂移”（Memory Drift），即历史表征逐渐退化，导致对已访问地标的记忆丧失。为此，本文提出一种“双锚定框架”（Dual-Anchoring Framework），通过显式约束指令进度与历史记忆来缓解上述问题。具体而言：首先，为解决进度漂移，提出“指令进度锚定”（Instruction Progress Anchoring），通过监督学习引导智能体生成结构化文本标记，以明确区分已完成与剩余子任务；其次，为缓解记忆漂移，提出“地标记忆锚定”（Memory Landmark Anchoring），构建以地标为中心的世界模型，对由 Segment Anything Model 提取的目标级嵌入进行回溯预测，从而促使智能体显式验证过往观测并维持对已访问地标的清晰表征。为支持该框架，本文构建了两个大规模数据集：包含 360 万条显式进度描述样本的数据集，以及 93.7 万条用于回溯验证的地标标注数据。在仿真与真实环境中的大量实验表明，所提方法具有显著优势，在成功率上提升 15.2%，在长时序任务中提升高达 24.7%。为促进后续研究，本文将开源代码、数据生成流程及相关数据集。
Vision-Language Navigation(VLN) requires an agent to navigate through 3D environments by following natural language instructions. While recent Video Large Language Models(Video-LLMs) have largely advanced VLN, they remain highly susceptible to State Drift in long scenarios. In these cases, the agent's internal state drifts away from the true task execution state, leading to aimless wandering and failure to execute essential maneuvers in the instruction. We attribute this failure to two distinct cognitive deficits: Progress Drift, where the agent fails to distinguish completed sub-goals from remaining ones, and Memory Drift, where the agent's history representations degrade, making it lose track of visited landmarks. In this paper, we propose a Dual-Anchoring Framework that explicitly anchors the instruction progress and history representations. First, to address progress drift, we introduce Instruction Progress Anchoring, which supervises the agent to generate structured text tokens that delineate completed versus remaining sub-goals. Second, to mitigate memory drift, we propose Memory Landmark Anchoring, which utilizes a Landmark-Centric World Model to retrospectively predict object-centric embeddings extracted by the Segment Anything Model, compelling the agent to explicitly verify past observations and preserve distinct representations of visited landmarks. Facilitating this framework, we curate two extensive datasets: 3.6 million samples with explicit progress descriptions, and 937k grounded landmark data for retrospective verification. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate the superiority of our method, achieving a 15.2% improvement in Success Rate and a remarkable 24.7% gain on long-horizon trajectories. To facilitate further research, we will release our code, data generation pipelines, and the collected datasets.
FSUNav: A Cerebrum-Cerebellum Architecture for Fast, Safe, and Universal Zero-Shot Goal-Oriented Navigation
FSUNav：一种基于大脑-小脑的快速、安全、通用的零尝试目标导向导航架构
当前视觉-语言导航方法在异构机器人适配性、实时性能以及导航安全性方面仍存在显著瓶颈，同时也难以支持开放词汇语义泛化与多模态任务输入。为解决上述问题，本文提出 FSUNav：一种用于快速、安全且通用的零样本目标导向导航的“脑-小脑”（Cerebrum–Cerebellum）架构，并创新性地将视觉语言模型（VLMs）融入该体系。该框架中，“小脑”模块作为高频率端到端执行单元，基于深度强化学习构建通用局部规划器，实现跨异构平台（如人形、四足及轮式机器人）的统一导航控制，从而提升导航效率并显著降低碰撞风险。“大脑”模块则构建三层推理结构，利用 VLMs 建立端到端的检测与验证机制，使系统能够在无需预定义类别 ID 的情况下实现零样本开放词汇目标导航，从而提升仿真与真实环境中的任务成功率。此外，该框架支持文本、目标描述与图像等多模态输入，进一步增强系统的泛化能力、实时性、安全性与鲁棒性。在 MP3D、HM3D 及 OVON 等基准测试中的实验结果表明，FSUNav 在物体导航、实例图像导航及任务导航等任务上均达到当前最优性能，并显著优于现有方法。在多种机器人平台上的真实部署进一步验证了其鲁棒性与工程适用性，其中包括 Unitree Go2 EDU 四足机器人平台。
Current vision-language navigation methods face substantial bottlenecks regarding heterogeneous robot compatibility, real-time performance, and navigation safety. Furthermore, they struggle to support open-vocabulary semantic generalization and multimodal task inputs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes FSUNav: a Cerebrum-Cerebellum architecture for fast, safe, and universal zero-shot goal-oriented navigation, which innovatively integrates vision-language models (VLMs) with the proposed architecture. The cerebellum module, a high-frequency end-to-end module, develops a universal local planner based on deep reinforcement learning, enabling unified navigation across heterogeneous platforms (e.g., humanoid, quadruped, wheeled robots) to improve navigation efficiency while significantly reducing collision risk. The cerebrum module constructs a three-layer reasoning model and leverages VLMs to build an end-to-end detection and verification mechanism, enabling zero-shot open-vocabulary goal navigation without predefined IDs and improving task success rates in both simulation and real-world environments. Additionally, the framework supports multimodal inputs (e.g., text, target descriptions, and images), further enhancing generalization, real-time performance, safety, and robustness. Experimental results on MP3D, HM3D, and OVON benchmarks demonstrate that FSUNav achieves state-of-the-art performance on object, instance image, and task navigation, significantly outperforming existing methods. Real-world deployments on diverse robotic platforms further validate its robustness and practical applicability. On Unitree Go2 EDU quadruped robotic platform.
AnchorVLA: Anchored Diffusion for Efficient End-to-End Mobile Manipulation
AnchorVLA：用于高效端到端移动操控的锚定扩散
移动操作中的一个核心挑战，是在执行过程中同时保留多种合理动作模型，并维持对环境变化的快速反应能力。在复杂场景中，例如瓶子可能以多种有效方式被接近与抓取，系统需要在保持动作多样性的同时，对动态变化保持敏感。扩散策略（diffusion policy）因能够建模多模态动作分布而具有吸引力，避免了单一解的塌缩。然而在实际应用中，完整的迭代去噪过程在控制时刻计算成本较高。动作分块（action chunking）虽然可以摊销推理开销，但也会引入一定的开环特性，使得微小误差逐步累积并导致轨迹漂移。为此，本文提出 AnchorVLA：一种基于扩散模型的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）移动操作策略。其核心思想是：当采样从一个接近合理解流形的锚点开始时，无需完整去噪过程即可恢复高质量的多模态动作解。AnchorVLA 结合轻量级 VLA 适配骨干网络与锚定扩散动作头，在锚定轨迹附近进行局部去噪，并采用截断扩散调度，从而在保留多模态生成能力的同时降低推理成本，实现闭环控制。此外，为缓解动作分块带来的漂移问题，我们引入测试时自校正机制：通过轻量残差修正模块在执行过程中进行高频逐步调整，从而增强系统的稳定性与鲁棒性。在多种移动操作任务中，AnchorVLA 在扰动与分布偏移条件下均显著提升成功率与稳定性，同时保持低延迟推理能力。在真实机器人实验中，我们使用 Unitree Go2 四足机器人作为移动底座，并搭载 SO101 机械臂作为操作执行器，验证了该方法在实际移动操作场景中的有效性。
A central challenge in mobile manipulation is preserving multiple plausible action models while remaining reactive during execution. A bottle in a cluttered scene can often be approached and grasped in multiple valid ways. Robust behavior depends on preserving this action diversity while remaining reactive as the scene evolves. Diffusion policies are appealing because they model multimodal action distributions rather than collapsing to one solution. But in practice, full iterative denoising is costly at control time. Action chunking helps amortize inference, yet it also creates partially open-loop behavior, allowing small mismatches to accumulate into drift. We present AnchorVLA, a diffusion-based VLA policy for mobile manipulation built on the core insight that when sampling begins near a plausible solution manifold, extensive denoising is unnecessary to recover multimodal, valid actions. AnchorVLA combines a lightweight VLA adaptation backbone with an anchored diffusion action head, which denoises locally around anchor trajectories using a truncated diffusion schedule. This retains multimodal action generation while reducing inference cost for closed-loop control. Crucially, to mitigate chunking-induced drift, we introduce a test-time self-correction mechanism via a lightweight residual correction module that makes high-frequency, per-step adjustments during rollout. Across diverse mobile manipulation tasks, AnchorVLA improves success and stability under disturbances and distribution shifts while maintaining low-latency inference. For real-world mobile manipulation experiments, we use a Unitree Go2 quadruped as the mobile base and a mounted SO101 arm as the manipulator.
RoboHaptics: Designing Haptic Interactions for Lower Body withQuadruped Robot Dogs
RoboHaptics：为四足机器狗设计下肢触觉交互
扩展现实（XR）已在视听沉浸方面取得显著进展，但触觉反馈尤其是下肢触觉仍然受到明显限制。本文提出 RoboHaptics，这是首个基于商用四足机器人探索下肢触觉反馈的系统。RoboHaptics 利用四足机器人可自由移动与可重构的特性，在无需穿戴设备的情况下同时提供主动与被动触觉反馈。我们贡献了一个面向四足机器人媒介触觉的设计空间，开发了一套可编程触觉效果软件工具，并通过实验验证了系统能力：四足机器人可提供 3–28 N 的安全力反馈（低于痛觉阈值），能够以 2.1–5.1 mm 的精度与 3.7–17 mm 的准确度触达下肢位置，并支持多种触觉效果的生成。在包含 12 名参与者的用户研究中，结果进一步表明，该系统在通过提供下肢触觉反馈增强真实感与沉浸感方面具有显著潜力。总体而言，本研究确立了四足机器人作为一种用于 XR 的移动式、非穿戴触觉平台的可行性与多功能性。系统基于 Unitree Go2 EDU 四足机器人构建。
Extended Reality (XR) has advanced audiovisual immersion, yet haptic feedback, especially for the lower body, remains limited. We present RoboHaptics, the first system to explore lower-body haptics using commercial quadruped robots. RoboHaptics leverages its freestanding and reconfigurable nature to deliver both active and passive tactile feedback without requiring worn devices. We contribute a design space for quadruped-mediated haptics, a software toolkit with a programmable library of tactile effects, and empirical evaluations showing that quadruped robots can deliver safe force feedback from 3–28 N (below nociceptive thresholds), reach lower-body locations with precision of 2.1–5.1 mm and accuracy of 3.7–17 mm, and support a wide range of tactile effects. A 12-participant study further revealed significant inputs into how RoboHaptics can be used to increase realism and immersion by providing lower-body haptic feedback. Together, our work establishes quadruped robots as a versatile platform for mobile, off-body haptics in XR. We build our system on the Unitree Go2 EDU 1 quadruped robot.
Learning from Demonstration with Failure Awareness for Safe Robot Navigation
从演示中学习并具备故障感知能力，以实现机器人安全导航
学习示范（Learning from Demonstration）已被广泛用于机器人导航任务，但其存在一个根本性局限：示范数据主要由成功轨迹构成，对危险状态的覆盖极为有限。这一问题使得机器人在面对分布外场景时容易产生安全性下降。相较之下，失败经验（如碰撞）包含了对危险区域的重要信息，但长期未被充分利用。其关键困难在于：失败数据无法直接提供有效的动作模仿信号，若将其简单纳入策略学习过程，往往会导致性能退化。为解决这一问题，本文提出一种“失败感知学习框架”，显式解耦成功与失败数据的作用。在该框架中，失败经验用于塑造危险区域的价值估计，而策略学习仅依赖成功示范进行，从而避免失败数据对行为克隆过程的干扰。这种分离机制使得失败数据能够被有效利用，同时不破坏策略稳定性。我们在离线强化学习（offline RL）框架下实现该方法，并在仿真与真实环境中进行评估。实验结果表明，该框架在保持任务成功率的同时，持续降低碰撞率，并在不同环境与机器人平台之间展现出良好的泛化能力。真实系统实验基于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台（图 4b），并搭载 Livox MID-360 三维激光雷达传感器完成验证。
Learning from demonstration is widely used for robot navigation, yet it suffers from a fundamental limitation: demonstrations consist predominantly of successful behaviors and provide limited coverage of unsafe states. This limitation leads to poor safety when the robot encounters scenarios beyond the demonstration distribution. Failure experiences, such as collisions, contain essential information about unsafe regions, but remain underutilized. The key difficulty lies in the fact that failure data do not provide valid guidance for action imitation, and their naive incorporation into policy learning often degrades performance. We address this challenge by proposing a failure-aware learning framework that explicitly decouples the roles of success and failure data. In this framework, failure experiences are used to shape value estimation in hazardous regions, while policy learning is restricted to successful demonstrations. This separation enables the effective use of failure data without corrupting policy behavior. We implement this design within an offline reinforcement learning (RL) setting and evaluate it in both simulation and real-world environments. The results show that our framework consistently reduces collision rates while preserving the task success rate, and demonstrate strong generalization across different environments and robot platforms. Legged Robot Platform: A Unitree Go2 robot (Fig. 4b) equipped with a Livox MID-360 3–D LiDAR.
Safe Large-Scale Robust Nonlinear MPC in Milliseconds via Reachability-Constrained System Level Synthesis on the GPU
基于GPU可达性约束系统级综合，在毫秒级实现安全的大规模鲁棒非线性模型预测控制
我们提出 GPU-SLS，这是一个面向安全、鲁棒非线性模型预测控制（MPC）的 GPU 并行化框架，能够扩展至高维不确定机器人系统以及长时域规划问题。该方法在实时条件下联合优化三部分内容：满足不等式约束且动力学可行的名义轨迹、轨迹跟踪控制器，以及在扰动作用下的闭环可达集。为高效计算名义轨迹，我们设计了一种基于顺序二次规划（SQP）的求解流程，并提出一种新型 GPU 加速二次规划（QP）求解器，该求解器在交替方向乘子法（ADMM）框架下结合并行关联扫描与自适应缓存机制。同时，该 GPU QP 内核也被用于通过系统级综合（SLS）优化鲁棒跟踪控制器与闭环可达集，从而在固定时域与滚动时域设置中实现具备可达性约束的控制。实验结果显示，该方法在性能上显著优于现有方法：名义轨迹求解时间相较最先进 CPU 求解器降低 97.7%，相较 GPU 求解器降低 71.8%，同时 SLS 控制与可达性计算加速达 237 倍。尽管问题规模巨大，该方法仍实现 100% 的经验安全性，而高维学习型可达性基线方法无法达到这一水平。我们在复杂非线性系统上进行了验证，包括 61 维全身四足机器人与 75 维人形机器人，并能够在 GPU 上以平均 20 毫秒的延迟在线合成鲁棒控制策略，问题规模可扩展至 2×10^5 个决策变量与 8×10^4 个约束。为验证该方法在真实四足机器人上的可用性，我们在 Unitree Go2 EDU（61 维）实体平台上进行了全身约束 NMPC 与 SLS 实验。
We present GPU-SLS, a GPU-parallelized framework for safe, robust nonlinear model predictive control (MPC) that scales to high-dimensional uncertain robotic systems and long planning horizons. Our method jointly optimizes an inequality-constrained, dynamically-feasible nominal trajectory, a tracking controller, and a closed-loop reachable set under disturbance, all in real-time. To efficiently compute nominal trajectories, we develop a sequential quadratic programming procedure with a novel GPU-accelerated quadratic program (QP) solver that uses parallel associative scans and adaptive caching within an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) framework. The same GPU QP backend is used to optimize robust tracking controllers and closed-loop reachable sets via system level synthesis (SLS), enabling reachability-constrained control in both fixed- and receding-horizon settings. We achieve substantial performance gains, reducing nominal trajectory solve times by 97.7% relative to state-of-the-art CPU solvers and 71.8% compared to GPU solvers, while accelerating SLS-based control and reachability by 237x. Despite large problem scales, our method achieves 100% empirical safety, unlike high-dimensional learning-based reachability baselines. We validate our approach on complex nonlinear systems, including whole-body quadrupeds (61D) and humanoids (75D), synthesizing robust control policies online on the GPU in 20 milliseconds on average and scaling to problems with 2 x 10^5 decision variables and 8 x 10^4 constraints. To validate the real-world practicality of our formulation for legged robots, we perform whole-body constrained NMPC and SLS on a physical Unitree Go2 EDU quadruped (61D).
SpaAct: Spatially-Activated Transition Learning with Curriculum Adaptation for Vision-Language Navigation
SpaAct：基于空间激活的过渡学习与课程适应，用于视觉语言导航
Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) aims to enable an embodied agent to follow natural-language instructions and navigate to a target location in unseen 3D environments. We argue that adapting VLMs to VLN requires endowing them with two complementary capabilities for acquiring such awareness, namely backward action reasoning (why) and forward transition prediction~(how). Based on this insight, we propose SpaAct, a simple yet effective training framework that activates the dynamic spatial awareness in VLMs. Specifically, SpaAct introduces two spatial activation tasks: Action Retrospection, which asks the model to infer the executed action sequence from visual transitions, and Future Frame Selection, which forces the model to predict the visual transitions conditioned on history and action. These two objectives provide lightweight supervision on both backward action reasoning and forward transition prediction, encouraging the model to build dynamic spatial awareness in a VLM-friendly way. To further stabilize adaptation, we design TriPA, a Tri-factor Progressive Adaptive curriculum learning method that organizes training samples from easy to hard, allowing the model to gradually acquire navigation skills from basic locomotion to long-horizon reasoning. Experiments on standard VLN-CE benchmarks show that SpaAct consistently improves VLM-based navigation and achieves state-of-the-art performance. We will release the code and models to support future research. We conduct real-world navigation experiments using a Unitree Go2 quadrupedal robot.
视觉与语言导航（VLN）旨在使具身智能体能够遵循自然语言指令，在未见过的三维环境中导航至目标位置。我们认为，将视觉语言模型（VLM）适配到VLN任务，需要赋予其两种互补能力以形成动态空间认知：其一是“向后动作推理”（why），即对行为因果进行回溯分析；其二是“向前状态预测”（how），即对环境状态随动作变化的演化进行建模。基于这一观察，我们提出 SpaAct，一种简单而有效的训练框架，用于激活VLM中的动态空间感知能力。具体而言，SpaAct引入两类空间激活任务：动作回溯（Action Retrospection），要求模型从视觉变化中推断已执行的动作序列；以及未来帧选择（Future Frame Selection），要求模型在历史与动作条件下预测可能的视觉转移。这两个目标为模型提供了轻量级监督信号，同时覆盖向后与向前两种时序推理，从而以对VLM友好的方式增强其动态空间理解能力。为进一步稳定训练过程，我们设计了TriPA（Tri-factor Progressive Adaptive）课程学习方法，通过由易到难组织训练样本，使模型逐步掌握从基础移动到长时程推理的导航能力。在VLN-CE标准基准上的实验结果表明，SpaAct在基于VLM的导航任务中持续提升性能，并取得当前最优结果。我们将开源代码与模型以支持后续研究，并在真实环境中使用 Unitree Go2 四足机器人进行了导航实验验证。
CMP Robust Whole-Body Tracking for Loco-Manipulation via Competence Manifold Projection
基于能力流形投影的CMP稳健全身跟踪用于运动操控
虽然分离式控制方案在足式移动操作机器人中已展现出较强鲁棒性，但在学习整体式全身控制策略以跟踪全局末端执行器位姿时，系统仍然容易受到分布外（Out-of-Distribution, OOD）输入的影响，例如传感器噪声或不可行的用户指令，从而导致性能不稳定。为在不牺牲任务性能与连续性的前提下提升对这些扰动的鲁棒性，本文提出 Competence Manifold Projection（CMP）方法。具体而言，我们设计了帧级安全机制（Frame-Wise Safety Scheme），将无限时域的安全约束转化为计算高效的单步流形包含问题，从而降低在线计算复杂度。为构建该“能力流形”，我们引入下界安全估计器（Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator），用于区分训练分布之外尚未掌握的意图与已具备能力覆盖的状态。进一步地，我们提出同构潜空间（Isomorphic Latent Space, ILS），将流形几何结构与安全概率对齐，使系统能够以 O(1) 复杂度对任意OOD意图进行高效防御。实验结果表明，在典型OOD场景中，CMP相较基线方法可将“存活率”提升至约10倍，同时末端跟踪性能退化控制在10%以内。值得注意的是，该系统还展现出一种“渐进式最优尝试”（best-effort）泛化行为，即在遵守能力边界约束的前提下逐步逼近并完成OOD目标任务。实验平台由 Unitree Go2 四足机器人搭载 Hexfellow Saber 执行器构成。
While decoupled control schemes for legged mobile manipulators have shown robustness, learning holistic whole-body control policies for tracking global end-effector poses remains fragile against Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs induced by sensor noise or infeasible user commands. To improve robustness against these perturbations without sacrificing task performance and continuity, we propose Competence Manifold Projection (CMP). Specifically, we utilize a Frame-Wise Safety Scheme that transforms the infinite-horizon safety constraint into a computationally efficient single-step manifold inclusion. To instantiate this competence manifold, we employ a Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator that distinguishes unmastered intentions from the training distribution. We then introduce an Isomorphic Latent Space (ILS) that aligns manifold geometry with safety probability, enabling efficient O(1) seamless defense against arbitrary OOD intents. Experiments demonstrate that CMP achieves up to a 10-fold survival rate improvement in typical OOD scenarios where baselines suffer catastrophic failure, incurring under 10% tracking degradation. Notably, the system exhibits emergent `best-effort'' generalization behaviors to progressively accomplish OOD goals by adhering to the competence boundaries. The robot model comprises a Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a Hexfellow Saber
MEMOR-E In-Context and Fine-Tuned LLM Personalization for Alzheimer’s Assistive Robotics
MEMOR-E 针对阿尔茨海默病辅助机器人的情境化和精细化LLM个性化
阿尔茨海默病是一种神经退行性疾病，其特征是记忆与语言能力逐步衰退，进而降低患者在日常生活中的独立性，这也推动了社会辅助型机器人支持系统的发展。本文提出 MEMOR-E，一种基于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人的移动平台系统，该机器人配备交互式平板界面，可通过用药提醒、日常流程引导、记忆辅助交互以及陪伴功能来支持患者与护理人员。我们评估了对大语言模型（LLM）进行微调以模拟不同疾病阶段一致的认知行为的可行性，并利用来自235名阿尔茨海默病患者的语音转写数据以及合成健康对照数据，在标准神经心理语言任务中对模型输出进行解释与分析。此外，我们进一步研究了上下文学习（in-context learning, ICL）的应用，即由第二个LLM生成与认知错误相关的领域与严重程度总结。实验结果表明，MEMOR-E能够生成具有疾病阶段感知能力的非诊断性认知摘要，从而支持个性化辅助交互；同时，可解释人工智能机制将模型输出转化为透明、可读的人类证据，以支持护理人员监督并提升人机交互的可信度。
Alzheimer’s disease is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive declines in memory and language that reduce independence in daily life, motivating the development of socially assistive robotic support. This paper presents MEMOR-E, a mobile quadruped robot Unitree Go2 equipped with an interactive tablet interface designed to assist patients and caregivers through medication reminders, routine guidance, memory-oriented interactions, and companionship. We evaluate the feasibility of fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) to emulate stage-consistent cognitive behavior and interpret responses across standard neuropsychological language tasks using audio transcriptions from 235 Alzheimer’s patients along with synthetically generated healthy controls. Additionally, we investigate the use of in-context learning (ICL), where a second LLM generates domain- and severity-level cognitive error summaries. Our results show that MEMOR-E can produce stage-aware, non-diagnostic cognitive summaries that support personalized assistive interactions, while explainable AI mechanisms translate model outputs into transparent, human-readable evidence to enable caregiver oversight and trustworthy human–robot interaction.
Kinematic-Cognitive Trade-Offs in Human-Robot Coordinated Walk Distance Stability vs. Speed Dis-similarity with Cognitive Load
人机协同行走中的运动学-认知权衡：距离稳定性与速度差异以及认知负荷
人机协同步行既可以通过规划实现，也可能在交互过程中自发涌现。本研究在低认知负荷与高认知负荷条件下，对这两种协调方式进行了比较。共有67名参与者在与四足机器人共同行走的过程中完成两种任务：简单行走任务以及附加搜索任务。其中一组参与者与机器人进行预先规划并维持协调行走，而另一组则在无明确规划的情况下与机器人自然形成自发协调行走。结果显示，在规划协调组中，人机距离的变化更小，但与之对应的是步行速度差异更大。加入搜索任务后，两种协调方式均表现出速度差异的增加，但人机距离的波动则相应减少。在主观感知方面，规划协调组即使在简单行走条件下也报告了更高的认知负荷，而自发协调组仅在附加搜索任务条件下才出现认知负荷上升。总体结果表明，人机协同步行不仅涉及运动学上的权衡，还伴随着一定的认知成本。
Human-Robot coordinated walk can be planned but also emerge spontaneously. This study compared the two coordination types under low and high cognitive load. Participants (n=67) completed a simple walk and a walk with an additional search task, with a quadruped robot. One group of participants planned and maintained a coordinated walk with the robot, whereas another group simply walked with the robot with an emergent coordination. The planned coordination group had less variability in the H-R distance associated with greater dissimilarity in walking speed. The added search task was associated with increased speed dissimilarity for both coordination types, but with a respective decrease in distance variability. The planned coordination group reported a higher perceived cognitive load even with the simple walk, and the spontaneous coordination group reported an increase in perceived cognitive load only with the additional search task. The findings imply that coordinated H-R walk is associated with kinematic tradeoffs and cognitive costs.
SGM-SLAM: Scene Graph Matching for Data-Efficient Distributed SLAM
SGM-SLAM：面向数据高效分布式SLAM的场景图匹配
我们提出了一种面向多机器人系统的数据高效型分布式同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）框架，适用于配备激光雷达、相机与惯性传感器的机器人团队。该框架利用场景图匹配来识别机器人之间的测量约束。不同于以往依赖特征级匹配的方法，我们的方法首次仅基于目标类别标签与质心信息实现了场景图匹配。具体而言，我们通过融合RGB与LiDAR点云数据构建场景图，在估计机器人轨迹的同时，生成语义分割点云层以及离散有界目标层。场景图匹配过程通过机器人之间交换并匹配目标数据，以协同方式完成。为最大化通信效率，我们设计了一种多阶段的数据交换与优化机制。最后，我们基于仿真环境以及由宇树（Unitree）Go2足式机器人在室内外场景中采集的真实数据集，对所提出方法的有效性与高效性进行了验证。
We introduce a data-efficient distributed Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) framework designed for a team of robotsequipped with LiDAR, cameras, and inertial sensors. Our framework uses scene graph matching to identify inter-robot measure-ment constraints. Unlike prior approaches that rely on feature-level matching, our framework is the first to perform scene graphmatching using only object labels and centroids. Our approach constructs a scene graph by using fused RGB-LiDAR point cloudsto generate both a semantically segmented point cloud layer, and a layer of discrete bounded objects, to accompany estimated robottrajectories. Scene graph matching is performed collaboratively through exchanging and matching object data with neighboringrobots. To maximize communication efficiency, we utilize a multi-step data exchange and optimization process. We demonstratethe effectiveness and efficiency of our approach using both simulation and real-world datasets collected by legged robots Unitree Go2 in indoorand outdoor environments.
Think before Go: Hierarchical Reasoning for Image-goal Navigation
三思而后行：基于层级推理的图像目标导航
图像目标导航（Image-Goal Navigation）旨在引导智能体在未知环境中前往由目标图像所指定的位置。现有方法通常通过学习端到端导航策略来完成该任务，即比较目标图像与当前观测图像之间的相似性，并直接预测动作。然而，当目标距离较远或位于其他房间时，这类方法往往难以提取有效的视觉线索，从而导致智能体在环境中无目的徘徊。受人类认知机制中“高层审慎推理指导低层快速反应执行”这一原则的启发，我们提出了分层推理导航框架（Hierarchical Reasoning Navigation, HRNav），将图像目标导航任务划分为高层规划与低层执行两个阶段。在高层规划阶段，我们基于自采集数据集训练视觉—语言模型，以生成短时域导航计划，例如判断机器人应“穿过门”还是“沿走廊前进”。这一过程有效降低了长时域导航任务的复杂度，使其更适合后续执行模块处理。在低层执行阶段，我们采用在线强化学习策略，根据短时域规划结果决策具体动作。此外，我们还设计了一种新的“徘徊抑制惩罚”（Wandering Suppression Penalty, WSP）机制，以进一步缓解智能体无目的游走的问题。上述模块共同构成了一个用于图像目标导航的分层导航框架。大量仿真与真实环境实验结果表明，所提出方法在性能上优于现有方法。其中，真实环境实验基于宇树（Unitree）Go2机器人平台完成。
Image-goal navigation steers an agent to a target location specified by an image in unseen environments. Existing methods primarily handle this task by learning an end-to-end navigation policy, which compares the similarities of target and observation images and directly predicts the actions. However, when the target is distant or lies in another room, such methods fail to extract informative visual cues, leading the agent to wander around. Motivated by the human cognitive principle that deliberate, high-level reasoning guides fast, reactive execution in complex tasks, we propose Hierarchical Reasoning Navigation (HRNav), a framework that decomposes image-goal navigation into high-level planning and low-level execution. In high-level planning, a vision-language model is trained on a self-collected dataset to generate a short-horizon plan, such as whether the agent should walk through the door or down the hallway. This downgrades the difficulty of the long-horizon task, making it more amenable to the execution part. In low-level execution, an online reinforcement learning policy is utilized to decide actions conditioned on the short-horizon plan. We also devise a novel Wandering Suppression Penalty (WSP) to further reduce the wandering problem. Together, these components form a hierarchical framework for Image-Goal Navigation. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate the superiority of our method. Our real-world experiments were conducted on a Unitree Go2 robot
Take the Dog to the Park: Quadruped Robot for Joint Attention Training with Autistic Children in Naturalistic Settings
带狗去公园：四足机器人助力自闭症儿童在自然环境中进行共同注意力训练
面向孤独症儿童联合注意（Joint Attention, JA）能力的机器人辅助干预研究已取得了积极成效，但现有多数研究仍局限于室内固定式机器人场景，从而限制了技能泛化能力以及更广泛的发展性收益。为此，我们提出了一种基于四足机器狗的联合注意干预方法，使机器人以“同伴式伙伴”的角色，在室内与室外环境中共同参与JA训练。在该干预过程中，机器狗通过引导儿童关注环境中的分散目标并主动发起联合注意任务，促进儿童的注意共享行为。我们针对6名孤独症儿童开展了一项为期四周的前后测探索性研究，结果表明，儿童的联合注意表现得到了提升，并初步显示出向日常社会沟通能力迁移的趋势。此外，研究过程中还观察到了诸如动作模仿（如模仿爬行动作）以及与机器人产生新的自发性社会互动等行为，表明该方法可能带来更广泛的发展性收益。这些发现为移动机器人支持下、面向自然场景的联合注意干预的有效性提供了初步证据，并为未来相关系统的设计提供了启示。我们的系统基于宇树（Unitree）Go2四足机器人平台构建。
Robot-supported interventions for joint attention (JA) in autistic children have shown encouraging outcomes, yet most remain confined to stationary robots in indoor settings, limiting opportunities for skill generalization and broader developmental benefits. We introduce an intervention that employs a quadruped robot dog as a peer-like partner for JA training across both indoor and outdoor environments. In this intervention, the robot dog directs children’s attention to distributed targets in the environment and initiates JA trials. A four-week pre-post exploratory study with six autistic children demonstrated improvements in JA performance and indications of transfer to daily social communication. Spontaneous behaviors such as motor imitation (crawling) and novel social interactions with the robot also emerged, suggesting potential for broader developmental gains. These findings provide initial evidence for the efficacy of mobile robot-supported JA interventions in naturalistic contexts and offer implications for future design. The physical foundation of our system is a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot.
ANCHOR: A Physically Grounded Closed-Loop Framework for Robust Home-Service Mobile Manipulation
ANCHOR：一种用于稳健的家庭服务移动操作的物理接地闭环框架
近年来，开放词汇（open-vocabulary）移动操作技术的进展推动机器人逐步进入真实家庭环境。在此类场景中，机器人不仅需要理解开放集合中的目标指代，还必须在频繁扰动条件下实现可靠的长时序任务执行。然而，当前系统仍然存在大量失败案例，而这些失败并非源于语义理解错误，而更多来自符号规划与不断变化的物理世界之间的不一致性，具体表现为三类反复出现的问题：（i）现有系统通常依赖预先扫描生成的语义地图，但在场景变化或受到扰动后，这些地图会迅速失效并与真实环境不一致；（ii）系统在选择导航终点时缺乏对后续操作可行性的考虑，从而导致“虽然到达目标位置，但无法执行操作”的问题；以及（iii）系统往往通过无差别的全局重规划来处理异常情况，难以有效隔离局部错误，并容易引发级联失败。为解决上述执行一致性问题，我们提出了 ANCHOR——一种基于物理锚定（physical grounding）的闭环框架，其核心目标是在执行过程中实现符号推理与可验证物理状态之间的持续对齐。ANCHOR 集成了三项关键机制：（i）基于物理锚点的任务规划机制，将符号谓词绑定到可观测的几何锚点之上，并在每次动作执行后重新验证其有效性；（ii）面向可操作性的底盘位姿对齐机制，确保导航终点同时满足运动学可达性与局部避碰可行性；以及（iii）“最小责任层级”分层恢复机制，通过在感知层、底盘—机械臂协同层以及执行层之间精确定位故障来源，防止错误在系统内部级联传播。在此前从未见过的真实环境中进行的60次机器人实验表明，ANCHOR 将任务成功率从53.3%提升至71.7%，并在受到扰动的情况下实现了71.4%的恢复成功率。这些结果表明，显式的物理锚定机制与结构化的故障隔离策略，对于实现鲁棒的移动操作系统至关重要。我们基于由宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人与 ARX X5 六自由度机械臂组成的移动操作平台，对 ANCHOR 系统进行了验证。
Recent advances in open-vocabulary mobile manipulation have brought robots into real domestic environments. In such settings, reliable long-horizon execution under open-set object references and frequent disturbances becomes essential. However, many failures persist. These are not caused by semantic misunderstanding but by inconsistencies between symbolic plans and the evolving physical world, manifested as three recurring limitations: (i) existing systems often rely on pre-scanned semantic maps that become inconsistent after scene changes and disturbances; (ii) they select navigation endpoints without considering downstream manipulation feasibility, causing the "arrived but inoperable" problem; and (iii) they handle anomalies through undifferentiated global replanning, which often fails to contain local errors. To address this execution inconsistency, we present ANCHOR, a physically grounded closed-loop framework that aligns symbolic reasoning with verifiable physical state during execution. ANCHOR integrates three mechanisms: (i) physically anchored task planning, which binds symbolic predicates to observable geometric anchors and re-validates them after each action; (ii) operability-aware base alignment, which ensures that navigation endpoints satisfy kinematic reachability and local collision feasibility; and (iii) minimum-responsible-layer hierarchical recovery, which localizes failures across perception, base-arm coordination, and execution layers to prevent cascading retries. Across 60 real-robot trials in previously unseen environments, ANCHOR improves task success from 53.3% to 71.7% and achieves a 71.4% recovery rate under perturbations, demonstrating that explicit physical grounding and structured failure containment are critical for robust mobile manipulation. We evaluate ANCHOR on a mobile manipulation platform comprising a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot and an ARX X5 6-DOF manipulator.
F2F-AP: Flow-to-Future Asynchronous Policy for Real-time Dynamic Manipulation
F2F-AP：面向未来的实时动态操作异步策略
异步推理（Asynchronous Inference）已逐渐成为机器人操作领域中的主流范式，并在提升轨迹平滑性与执行效率方面取得了显著进展。然而，一个系统性挑战仍未得到有效解决：由于推理过程本身存在固有时延，生成的动作不可避免地会滞后于实时环境状态。在动态场景中，这种时间错位问题尤为严重，会显著削弱策略对快速变化环境的理解与响应能力。为此，本文提出了一种新的框架，通过利用预测目标流（predicted object flow）生成未来观测结果，并引入一种基于流的对比学习目标，使预测观测的视觉特征表示能够与真实未来状态保持一致。在这种“预期视觉上下文”（anticipated visual context）的支持下，我们的异步策略获得了主动规划与前瞻运动能力，从而能够显式补偿系统时延，并在目标持续运动的动态操作任务中实现鲁棒执行。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在复杂动态操作任务中显著提升了系统的响应能力与任务成功率。针对移动操作场景中的挑战，我们进一步基于宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人与 Hexfellow Saber 机械臂构建实验平台，对该方法进行了验证。
Asynchronous inference has emerged as a prevalent paradigm in robotic manipulation, achieving significant progress in ensuring trajectory smoothness and efficiency. However, a systemic challenge remains unresolved, as inherent latency causes generated actions to inevitably lag behind the real-time environment. This issue is particularly exacerbated in dynamic scenarios, where such temporal misalignment severely compromises the policy's ability to interpret and react to rapidly evolving surroundings. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that leverages predicted object flow to synthesize future observations, incorporating a flow-based contrastive learning objective to align the visual feature representations of predicted observations with ground-truth future states. Empowered by this anticipated visual context, our asynchronous policy gains the capacity for proactive planning and motion, enabling it to explicitly compensate for latency and robustly execute manipulation tasks involving actively moving objects. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances responsiveness and success rates in complex dynamic manipulation tasks.Addressing the challenges of mobile manipulation, we employ a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot integrated with an Hexfellow Saber robotic arm
AsyncShield: A Plug-and-Play Edge Adapter for Asynchronous Cloud-based VLA Navigation
AsyncShield：用于异步云端 VLA 导航的即插即用边缘适配器
尽管视觉—语言—动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型在机器人控制中已展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，但其庞大的参数规模通常依赖云端部署。然而，云端部署会引入网络抖动与推理延迟，从而在持续位移的移动导航任务中造成严重的时空错位问题，使得过去自我视角帧中表达的“过时意图”在当前时刻已不再具备空间正确性，进而可能导致碰撞风险。为解决这一问题，我们提出 AsyncShield——一种即插即用的异步控制框架。该方法摒弃传统黑箱式时序预测，而采用确定性的物理白盒空间映射机制，通过维护时间序位姿缓冲区并结合运动学变换，将时间延迟显式转换为空间位姿偏移，从而恢复VLA模型原始的几何意图。在意图恢复精度与物理安全性之间的权衡方面，我们将边缘侧自适应过程建模为受约束马尔可夫决策过程（Constrained Markov Decision Process, CMDP），并通过PPO-Lagrangian算法求解，使强化学习适配器能够在“跟踪VLA意图”与“满足高频LiDAR避障硬约束”之间动态权衡。此外，得益于标准化的通用子目标接口、域随机化机制以及通过碰撞半径膨胀实现的感知层适配，AsyncShield能够作为轻量级即插即用模块运行。在仿真与真实环境实验中，我们表明该方法无需对云端基础模型进行任何微调，即可实现零样本与鲁棒泛化能力，显著提升异步导航任务的成功率与物理安全性。为验证其“即插即用”能力与零样本迁移性能，我们在宇树（Unitree）Go2四足机器人平台上部署并测试了AsyncShield系统。
While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have been demonstrated possessing strong zero-shot generalization for robot control, their massive parameter sizes typically necessitate cloud-based deployment. However, cloud deployment introduces network jitter and inference latency, which can induce severe spatiotemporal misalignment in mobile navigation under continuous displacement, so that the stale intents expressed in past ego frames may become spatially incorrect in the current frame and lead to collisions. To address this issue, we propose AsyncShield, a plug-and-play asynchronous control framework. AsyncShield discards traditional black-box time-series prediction in favor of a deterministic physical white-box spatial mapping. By maintaining a temporal pose buffer and utilizing kinematic transformations, the system accurately converts temporal lag into spatial pose offsets to restore the VLA's original geometric intent. To balance intent restoration fidelity and physical safety, the edge adaptation is formulated as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). Solved via the PPO-Lagrangian algorithm, a reinforcement learning adapter dynamically trades off between tracking the VLA intent and responding to high-frequency LiDAR obstacle avoidance hard constraints. Furthermore, benefiting from a standardized universal sub-goal interface, domain randomization, and perception-level adaptation via Collision Radius Inflation, AsyncShield operates as a lightweight, plug-and-play module. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that, without fine-tuning any cloud-based foundation models, the framework exhibits zero-shot and robust generalization capabilities, effectively improving the success rate and physical safety of asynchronous navigation. To validate the “plug-and-play” feasibility and zero-shot transferability, we deployed AsyncShield on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot.
Cognitive Trust in HRI: “Pay Attention to Me and I’ll Trust You Even If You Are Wrong”
人机交互中的认知信任：“只要你关注我，即使你错了，我也会信任你”
认知信任（cognitive trust）是指个体认为机器人能够准确执行任务的信念，是实现有效人机交互的关键基础。尽管既有研究普遍认为机器人的能力与可靠性是建立认知信任的核心因素，但近期研究表明，诸如“注意力”等情感性因素同样在其中发挥重要作用。本研究进一步探讨能力与注意力之间的交互关系，重点考察二者是否存在相互补偿效应。参与者在一项基于宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人的搜索任务中完成实验，采用2×2实验设计，分别操控机器人能力水平（高/低）与注意力水平（高/低）。结果显示，高注意力能够有效补偿低能力的不足：当参与者与一个注意力表现较高但任务执行能力较弱的机器人互动时，其信任水平与使用高能力机器人时相当。研究结果表明，认知信任的形成不仅依赖传统的能力维度，还受到情感与社会认知过程的显著影响，从而对以能力为中心的传统信任模型提出了重要补充与拓展。
Cognitive trust, the belief that a robot can accurately perform tasks, is crucial for effective human-robot interaction. While robot competence and reliability are known to build this trust, recent research shows that affective factors like attentiveness also matter. This study examines how competence and attentiveness interact to shape cognitive trust, specifically testing whether one factor can compensate for the other. Participants completed a search task with a Unitree Go2 robotic dog in a 2 × 2 design varying competence (high/low) and attentiveness (high/low). Results showed that high attentiveness compensates for low competence: participants working with an attentive but poorly performing robot reported trust levels similar to those working with highly competent robot. These findings suggest that building cognitive trust involves emotional processes often overlooked in traditional competence-based models.
Safe Navigation in Unknown and Cluttered Environments via Direction-Aware Convex Free-Region Generation
通过方向感知凸自由区域生成实现未知和杂乱环境中的安全导航
凸自由区域（Convex Free Regions）为机器人在未知且拥挤环境中的导航提供了一种结构化且便于优化的无碰撞空间表示。然而，现有方法通常主要依据周围障碍物的几何分布来扩展局部无碰撞区域。在复杂拥挤环境中，这类策略往往难以生成既能够容纳机器人自身几何形态、又能够沿候选运动方向保持可通行扩展性的自由区域，从而限制后续路径穿越能力，尤其在狭窄通道场景中表现更为明显。即便已经获得可行自由区域，安全运动生成仍然具有挑战性，因为基于离散轨迹采样点的安全检测，并不能在显式建模机器人几何形态的情况下，保证运动过程始终连续无碰撞。为解决上述问题，我们提出了一种导航框架，将候选运动方向与机器人几何信息共同纳入凸自由区域生成过程，并通过连续安全轨迹生成机制实现全程连续无碰撞运动。在每个自由区域内部，框架进一步执行面向机器人几何结构的目标位姿选择与轨迹生成，同时结合基于 Lipschitz 条件的连续安全性认证与局部优化机制。生成的自由区域及候选运动被维护在一个基于区域的图结构中，以支持增量式规划。二维拥挤导航场景中的定量实验结果表明，所提出方法能够生成更符合后续通行需求的自由区域，并实现稳定可靠的无碰撞导航。此外，在宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人与无人机平台上的三维与真实环境实验进一步验证了该框架的可扩展性与实际应用价值。
Convex free regions provide a structured and optimization-friendly representation of collision-free space for robot navigation in unknown and cluttered environments. However, existing methods typically enlarge local collision-free regions mainly according to surrounding obstacle geometry. In cluttered environments, such strategies may fail to generate regions that both accommodate robot geometry and preserve traversable extension along candidate motion directions, thereby limiting downstream traversal, especially in narrow passages. Even when such a region is available, safe motion generation remains challenging, because safety checking at discretized trajectory samples does not guarantee continuously collision-free motion when robot geometry is modeled explicitly. To address these issues, we propose a navigation framework that jointly incorporates candidate motion directions and robot geometry into convex free-region generation, and achieves continuously collision-free motion through continuous-safe trajectory generation. Within each region, the framework performs geometry-aware target pose selection and trajectory generation, together with Lipschitz-based continuous safety certification and local refinement. The resulting free regions and candidate motions are maintained in a region-based graph to support incremental planning. Quantitative results in cluttered 2D navigation scenarios show that the proposed method generates free regions better aligned with downstream traversal and enables reliable collision-free navigation, while additional 3D and real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 quadrupedal robot and a UAV demonstrate the extensibility and practical applicability of the framework.
Inverse Safety Filtering: Inferring Constraints from Safety Filters for Decentralized Coordination
逆安全滤波：从安全滤波器推断分散式协调的约束
在不确定环境中，实现安全的多智能体协同可以从其他智能体的行为中学习安全约束信息。通过动作隐式传递安全约束是一种具有潜力的方法，它能够在无需高成本通信通道的情况下，实现智能体之间的协同与安全维持。本文提出了一种在线约束推断方法，通过观察其他智能体经过安全过滤（safety-filtered）的动作来推断其安全约束。我们的方法基于安全过滤器实现前向安全保证，并进一步利用其结构特性反向推导潜在约束条件。针对该方法，我们给出了能够成功推断约束的充分条件，并证明了所提出约束推断算法的收敛性。该约束推断机制进一步与一种去中心化规划方法相结合，在约束激活距离足够大的条件下能够保证系统整体安全性。最后，我们通过蒙特卡洛仿真以及基于宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人的真实硬件实验，对所提出方法进行了实证验证。
Safe multi-agent coordination in uncertain environments can benefit from learning constraints from other agents. Implicitly communicating safety constraints through actions is a promising approach, allowing agents to coordinate and maintain safety without expensive communication channels. This paper introduces an online method to infer constraints from observing the safety-filtered actions of other agents. We approach the problem by using safety filters to ensure forward safety and exploit their structure to work backwards and infer constraints. We provide sufficient conditions under which we can infer these constraints and prove that our inference method converges. This constraint inference procedure is coupled with a decentralized planning method that ensures safety when the constraint activation distance is sufficiently large. We then empirically validate our method with Monte Carlo simulations and hardware experiments with Unitree Go2 quadruped robots.
Collaborative Map-based and Route-based Policy Learning for Continuous Vision-and-Language Navigation
基于地图和路径的协同策略学习用于连续视觉和语言导航
连续环境中的视觉—语言导航（Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments, VLN-CE）要求智能体依据自然语言指令，在未知三维环境中导航至目标位置。一个高性能的VLN-CE智能体在跨模态规划过程中需要具备两项关键能力：其一是在部分可观测环境中进行空间推理，从而有效探索目标位置；其二是实现程序性对齐（procedural alignment），即将导航路径与语言指令进行匹配，以完成顺序化引导。现有跨模态规划策略主要分为两类，并分别侧重于上述能力之一：基于地图（map-based）的策略通过在图结构表示上对语言指令进行空间锚定，从而强化空间推理能力；而基于路径（route-based）的策略则通过将连续观测与语言指令进行对齐，更强调程序性引导能力。然而，这两类策略通常被独立研究，导致仅依赖单一能力的智能体难以在复杂场景中实现有效规划。受人类导航行为启发，我们提出了一种协同策略学习框架，用于融合两类策略在跨模态规划中的优势。该框架包括三个核心过程：（1）“时空—程序拓扑建图”（Spatio-Procedural Topological Mapping），通过构建多层图结构，为基于地图与基于路径的策略学习提供统一支撑；（2）“双流编码”（Dual-Stream Encoding），并行执行两类策略的跨模态编码；以及（3）“层级策略融合”（Hierarchical Policy Integration），通过特征级协同与logit级融合实现双策略整合。在VLN-CE数据集上的大量实验结果验证了该框架的有效性。我们在单目视觉感知配置下，基于 g3D-LF 主干网络实现 CoMaR，并将跨模态规划管线部署于云端服务器，同时在宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人平台上完成实验验证。
Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an agent to follow language instructions to reach a target in unseen, 3D environments. A powerful VLN-CE agent requires two crucial abilities during cross-modal planning: spatial reasoning to explore towards the target location in partially observable environments, and procedural alignment to match navigation routes with language instructions for sequential guidance. Existing cross-modal planning policies are divided into two types, each focusing on one of these capabilities. The map-based policy promotes spatial reasoning by grounding instructions on graph representations, while the route-based policy favors procedural alignment by aligning sequential observations with language instructions. However, these policies are typically studied independently, making agents that rely on a single crucial ability unable to plan effectively in complex scenes. Inspired by human navigation, we propose a collaborative policy learning framework that integrates the advantages of both policies for cross-modal planning. This framework includes three processes: Spatio-Procedural Topological Mapping, which constructs a multiplex graph to support the learning of map-based and route-based policies; Dual-Stream Encoding, which performs cross-modal encoding for both policies in parallel; and Hierarchical Policy Integration, which fuses both policies via feature-level collaboration and logit-level fusion. Extensive experiments on the VLN-CE datasets confirm the effectiveness of our framework. We apply CoMaR under the monocular sensing setup with the g3D-LF backbone [22], using a Unitree Go2 quadruped and running the cross-modal planning pipeline on a cloud server
Dynamic Legged Ball Manipulation on Rugged Terrains with Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
基于分层强化学习的崎岖地形动态腿球操控
提升四足机器人在复杂地形中的动态运动—操作（loco-manipulation）能力，对于执行多样化任务具有重要意义。其中，在崎岖环境下实现动态控球任务面临两项关键挑战：其一，是如何协调不同运动模态，从而实现复杂地形穿越与球体操控之间的无缝融合；其二，是端到端强化学习中普遍存在的稀疏奖励问题，这会严重阻碍策略的高效收敛。为解决上述问题，我们提出了一种分层强化学习框架。其中，高层策略基于本体感知信息与球体位置，自适应切换多个预训练低层技能，包括控球运球与复杂地形导航等。与此同时，我们进一步提出了一种“动态技能聚焦策略优化”（Dynamic Skill-Focused Policy Optimization）方法，通过抑制非激活技能产生的梯度干扰，强化关键技能的学习效果。仿真与真实环境实验结果均表明，所提出方法在崎岖地形中的动态控球任务上显著优于基线方法，展现出其在复杂环境下的有效性与鲁棒性。我们基于宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人平台对该方法进行了验证。
Advancing the dynamic loco-manipulation capabilities of quadruped robots in complex terrains is crucial for performing diverse tasks. Specifically, dynamic ball manipulation in rugged environments presents two key challenges. The first is coordinating distinct motion modalities to integrate terrain traversal and ball control seamlessly. The second is overcoming sparse rewards in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which impedes efficient policy convergence. To address these challenges, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework. A high-level policy, informed by proprioceptive data and ball position, adaptively switches between pre-trained low-level skills such as ball dribbling and rough terrain navigation. We further propose Dynamic Skill-Focused Policy Optimization to suppress gradients from inactive skills and enhance critical skill learning. Both simulation and real-world experiments validate that our methods outperform baseline approaches in dynamic ball manipulation across rugged terrains, highlighting its effectiveness in challenging environments. We evaluate our method using a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot.
HiPAN: Hierarchical Posture-Adaptive Navigation for Quadruped Robots in Unstructured 3D Environments
HiPAN：面向非结构化三维环境的四足机器人分层姿态自适应导航
在非结构化三维环境中对四足机器人进行导航面临显著挑战，需要同时实现目标驱动运动、有效探索以摆脱局部最优陷阱，以及姿态自适应以通过狭窄或高度受限空间。传统方法通常采用“建图—规划”的串行管线，但容易受到感知误差累积与计算开销较高的影响，从而限制其在资源受限平台上的应用。针对上述问题，我们提出分层姿态自适应导航框架HiPAN（Hierarchical Posture-Adaptive Navigation），该方法在部署阶段直接基于机载深度图像进行端到端决策。HiPAN采用分层结构设计：高层策略网络生成具有全局意义的导航指令（包括平面速度与机体姿态），低层控制器则根据这些指令执行姿态自适应的运动控制。为缓解短视行为并提升长时程导航能力，本文进一步引入路径引导的课程学习策略，使训练过程从局部避障逐步过渡到长距离策略性导航。在仿真环境中，HiPAN在导航成功率与路径效率方面均优于经典反应式规划方法及端到端基线方法；在真实世界实验中，该方法进一步验证了其在多种非结构化三维环境中的适用性与鲁棒性。
Navigating quadruped robots in unstructured 3D environments poses significant challenges, requiring goal-directed motion, effective exploration to escape from local minima, and posture adaptation to traverse narrow, height-constrained spaces. Conventional approaches employ a sequential mapping-planning pipeline but suffer from accumulated perception errors and high computational overhead, restricting their applicability on resource-constrained platforms. To address these challenges, we propose Hierarchical Posture-Adaptive Navigation (HiPAN), a framework that operates directly on onboard depth images at deployment. HiPAN adopts a hierarchical design: a high-level policy generates strategic navigation commands (planar velocity and body posture), which are executed by a low-level, posture-adaptive locomotion controller. To mitigate myopic behaviors and facilitate long-horizon navigation, we introduce Path-Guided Curriculum Learning, which progressively extends the navigation horizon from reactive obstacle avoidance to strategic navigation. In simulation, HiPAN achieves higher navigation success rates and greater path efficiency than classical reactive planners and end-to-end baselines, while real-world experiments further validate its applicability across diverse, unstructured 3D environments.
Efficient On-policy Visual-RL via Stochastic Decoupled Policy Gradient
基于随机解耦策略梯度的鲁棒高效在轨视觉强化学习
我们提出了一种名为“随机解耦策略梯度”（SDPG）的轻量级视觉强化学习（RL）方法。该方法能够在单块 NVIDIA RTX 4080 GPU 上，仅用数小时便实现多种视觉运动控制策略的端到端训练。SDPG 通过对轨迹采样的随机扰动来估算策略梯度，从而将批量渲染环境的需求降低了几个数量级，并大幅削减了计算与内存开销。在视觉 MuJoCo 基准测试中，SDPG 在训练耗时、内存占用及获得的奖励方面，均持续优于各类基线方法。此外，为了助力未来的相关研究，我们引入了一套逼真的视觉机器人基准测试集，涵盖了灵巧操作及极具挑战性的步态控制任务；同时，我们还成功展示了该方法在物理硬件上的高效“仿真到现实”（sim-to-real）迁移能力。我们在 Unitree Go2 机器人硬件平台上对 SDPG 进行了验证。该机器人利用机载的 RealSense 深度相机感知周围环境，并在包括崎岖地面、箱体障碍及楼梯在内的复杂地形中进行导航。其控制策略完全在仿真环境中进行训练，仅需单块 GPU 且耗时不足两小时，随后便通过“零样本”（zero-shot）的方式直接迁移至现实世界中应用。
We present the Stochastic Decoupled Policy Gradient (SDPG), a lightweight visual reinforcement learning (RL) method that trains diverse visuomotor control policies end-to-end within a few hours on a single NVIDIA RTX 4080 GPU. SDPG estimates policy gradients via random perturbations of trajectory rollouts, requiring orders of magnitude fewer batch-rendered environments and substantially reducing compute and memory overhead. On visual MuJoCo benchmarks, SDPG consistently outperforms baseline methods in training time, memory usage, and rewards. Finally, to support future research, we introduce a suite of realistic visual robotics benchmarks spanning dexterous manipulation and challenging locomotion, and demonstrate effective sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware. We validate SDPG on Unitree Go2 hardware. The robot uses an egocentric RealSense depth camera to perceive its environment and navigate challenging terrains, including uneven surfaces, boxes, and stairs. The policy is trained entirely in simulation in under 2 hours on a single GPU and transferred to the real world via zero-shot sim-to-real.
MUJICA: Multi-skill Unified Joint Integration of Control Architecture for Wheeled-Legged Robots
MUJICA：轮足机器人多技能统一联合控制架构集成
轮足机器人有望在复杂地形中实现高效穿越，且相比纯足式机器人，其机动性更为优越。然而，轮足机器人必须在轮式驱动与足式控制之间实现有效的平衡。此外，受限于本体感知信号的噪声干扰以及现实世界中电机性能的约束，要在电机性能极限下实现鲁棒且自适应的运动控制，依然面临巨大挑战。为此，我们提出了一种名为“多技能统一联合控制架构”（MUJICA）的方案。这是一个专为轮足机器人设计的统一且完全基于本体感知的控制框架，它将全向移动、高台攀爬以及跌倒恢复等多种低层级技能整合于单一的控制策略之中。所有技能均通过独特的指示变量加以区分，并在结合精确的直流电机约束模型的基础上进行联合训练。此外，我们还训练了一个高层级技能选择器，使其能够仅依据本体感知信息动态选取最优技能，从而实现对周围环境的自适应响应。因此，MUJICA显著增强了从仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）迁移的鲁棒性，并实现了不同运动模式间的无缝切换，从而助力机器人实现对环境的自主适应与调整。我们在 Unitree Go2-W 机器人平台上，通过仿真与实物实验对该框架进行了全面验证，结果表明，在非结构化环境中，该框架在环境适应性与任务成功率方面均取得了显著提升。
Wheeled-legged robots hold promise for traversing complex terrains and offer superior mobility compared to legged robots. However, wheeled-legged robots must effectively balance both wheeled driving and legged control. Furthermore, due to noisy proprioceptive sensing and real-world motor constraints, realizing robust and adaptive locomotion at peak performance of motors remains challenging. We propose the Multi-skill Unified Joint Integration of Control Architecture (MUJICA), a unified, fully proprioceptive control framework for wheeled-legged robots that integrates diverse low-level skills—including omnidirectional moving, high platform climbing, and fall recovery—within a single policy. All skills, distinguished by unique indicator variables, are trained jointly with accurate DC-motor constraint modeling. Additionally, a high-level skill selector is learned to dynamically choose the optimal skill based solely on proprioceptions, enabling adaptive responses to the surrounding environment. Therefore, MUJICA enhances sim-to-real robustness and enables seamless transitions across diverse locomotion modes, facilitating autonomous adjustment to the environment. We validate our framework in both simulation and real-world experiments on the Unitree Go2-W robot, demonstrating significant improvements in adaptability and task success in unstructured environments.
Dynamics Aware Quadrupedal Locomotion via Intrinsic Dynamics Head
基于内在动力学头部的动力学感知四足运动
