四足运动在实现复杂地形下的敏捷、多功能移动方面发挥着至关重要的作用。理解并估计其潜在的物理动力学特性，对于实现高效且稳定的四足运动至关重要。我们提出了一种新颖的四足运动训练框架，旨在使控制策略（Control Policy）能够理解并对物理动力学进行推理。在仿真环境中，我们与控制策略同步训练一个“内在动力学”（ID）模块，该模块负责学习状态到扭矩的动力学映射；同时，我们定义了一种基于该ID模块的动力学奖励机制，旨在引导控制策略呈现出更具可预测性的动力学行为。此外，我们还提供了一种机制，允许通过调节ID模块的训练系数，来对所得控制策略中习得的动力学特性进行微调。仿真实验结果表明，该机制能够促使模型在广泛的标准四足运动奖励指标下收敛至更优解，从而生成更高效、更平滑的控制策略。实机机器人实验进一步验证了上述改进成果在“仿真到实机”（sim-to-real）迁移中的有效性，在扭矩效率（提升16.8%）、动作频率（提升18.6%）和机械功率（提升12.8%）方面均取得了显著提升，同时还将安全扭矩利用率提高了6.4%。
Quadrupedal locomotion plays a critical role in enabling agile, versatile movement across complex terrains. Understanding and estimating the underlying physical dynamics are essential for achieving efficient and stable quadrupedal locomotion. We propose a novel training framework for quadrupedal locomotion that enables the Control Policy to understand and reason about physical dynamics. In simulation, we concurrently train an Intrinsic Dynamics (ID) Head that learns state-to-torque dynamics alongside the Control Policy, and we define a dynamics reward enabled by the ID Head that encourages the Policy toward more predictable dynamical behavior. We also provide a mechanism to tune the learned dynamics in the resulting Policy by controlling the training coefficients of the ID Head. Our simulation experiments show that this mechanism drives convergence to better optima across a wide range of standard quadrupedal locomotion rewards, yielding more efficient and smoother policies. Our real-robot experiments demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of these improvements, with significant gains in torque efficiency (16.8%), action rate (18.6%), and mechanical power (12.8%), while improving safe torque occupancy by 6.4%.
Short Paper: The Starlink Robot: A Platform and Dataset for Mobile Satellite Communication
短论文：Starlink Robot：一种用于移动卫星通信的平台与数据集
将卫星通信集成到移动设备中代表着连接方式的范式转变，但其在运动和环境遮挡下的性能特征仍不甚明了。我们推出了星链机器人（Starlink Robot），这是首个配备星链卫星互联网和全面传感器套件（包括向上摄像头、激光雷达和惯性测量单元）的移动机器人平台，旨在系统地研究运动过程中的卫星通信性能。我们的多模态数据集捕捉了各种场景下的同步通信指标、运动动力学、天空可见度和三维环境信息，这些场景包括稳态运动、变速运动和不同的遮挡条件。该平台和数据集使研究人员能够开发运动感知通信协议、预测连接中断，并针对从智能手机到自动驾驶汽车等新兴移动应用优化卫星通信。
The integration of satellite communication into mobile devices represents a paradigm shift in connectivity, yet the performance characteristics under motion and environmental occlusion remain poorly understood. We present the Starlink Robot, the first mobile robotic platform equipped with Starlink satellite internet, comprehensive sensor suite including upward-facing camera, LiDAR, and IMU, designed to systematically study satellite communication performance during movement. Our multi-modal dataset captures synchronized communication metrics, motion dynamics, sky visibility, and 3D environmental context across diverse scenarios including steady-state motion, variable speeds, and different occlusion conditions. This platform and dataset enable researchers to develop motion-aware communication protocols, predict connectivity disruptions, and optimize satellite communication for emerging mobile applications from smartphones to autonomous vehicles.
OCELOT: Odometry and Contact Estimation for Legged Robots
OCELOT：足式机器人里程计与接触估计
足式机器人领域的一项重大挑战在于，仅利用机载本体感知传感器来实现精确的里程计估计。在本研究中，我们提出了一套完整的足式里程计流程，该流程基于误差状态扩展卡尔曼滤波器（ESEKF），且完全依赖于本体感知数据——即固定在机体上的惯性测量单元（IMU）、关节编码器以及力传感器；其中，滤波器的状态更新通过判定处于静止支撑状态的足部数据进行校正。本研究的核心贡献在于一套融合式的接触检测与不确定性量化模块，该模块旨在显式地识别并剔除足部打滑（slippage）现象。针对每一个足部，该模块并行运行两个检测器：1）一个基于力的、由高斯混合模型（GMM）引导且经过去抖处理的有限状态机（FSM），用于确认足部是否发生物理接触；2）一个基于运动学的广义似然比检验（GLRT），用于检测足部估计速度的异常情况。来自这两个检测器的连续质量评分将被融合处理，以判定足部是否同时满足“承受物理载荷”与“运动学上处于静止状态”这两个条件，并作为各次接触事件的不确定性信号输入至滤波器。为了验证本方法的有效性，我们采集了一组多模态数据集，共包含29个序列，涵盖了多种室内外地形（如混凝土路面、草地、碎石地及岩石地），总里程达2.4公里。我们对本方法进行了基准测试，并将其性能与现有的本体感知及外部感知类方法进行了对比。实验结果表明，本方法能够提供精确的里程计估计，且在易发生打滑的环境中表现出极强的鲁棒性。此外，我们已将本研究的代码及实时运行的ROS2软件包作为开源资源向社区发布。
One of the significant challenges in legged robotics is achieving accurate odometry using only onboard proprioceptive sensors. In this study, we present a complete leg odometry pipeline based on an Error-State EKF (ESEKF) that relies exclusively on proprioceptive data: a body fixed IMU, joint encoders, and force sensors, where filter's state is corrected by feet determined to be in a stationary stance. The core of our contribution is fused contact detection and an uncertainty quantification module designed to explicitly identify and reject slippage. This module runs two detectors in parallel for each foot, 1) a debounced, force-based Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) guided Finite State Machine (FSM) to confirm physical contact, and 2) a kinematic-based Generalized Likelihood Ratio Test (GLRT) on the estimated velocity of the foot. The continuous quality scores from both estimators are fused to detect if the foot is both physically loaded and kinematically stationary and served as an uncertainty signal for each contact. To validate our approach, we collected a multi-modal dataset of 29 sequences spanning diverse indoor and outdoor terrains (e.g., concrete, grass, pebble, and rock) total of 2.4 km long. We benchmarked our approach against both proprioceptive and exteroceptive methods. The results demonstrate our method's efficacy in providing accurate odometry estimates, robustly handling slippage-prone environments. We also share our code and real-time ROS2 package as open-source.
TravExplorer: Cross-Floor Embodied Exploration via Traversability-Aware 3-D Planning
TravExplorer：基于可通行性感知的3D规划实现跨楼层具身探索
零样本物体导航（ZSON）在未知环境中进行开放词汇目标搜索方面已展现出巨大潜力，然而，大多数现有系统仍受限于平面表征和单层楼假设。在真实的建筑环境中，这些假设显得捉襟见肘，因为实际导航往往涉及楼层、楼梯、楼梯平台以及垂直重叠的空间。本文提出了一种名为 TravExplorer 的跨楼层具身探索框架，该框架将零样本语义引导与感知可通行性的三维规划相结合。TravExplorer 维护着一张统一的体素地图，该地图能够区分被占据的结构体与机器人可触达的支撑表面，并从相互连通的支撑表面（包括地面、楼梯和楼梯平台）中提取出可通行的边界。此外，一种感知视场（FOV-aware）的主动感知策略进一步解决了跨楼层穿越过程中因视角受限而导致的观测不完整问题。为了降低语义推理的延迟，一个轻量级的引导模块将来自在线开放词汇分割的概率实例地图，与来自快速图像-文本匹配的空间价值地图进行了对齐。基于这些几何与语义记忆，一个分层规划器针对物体假设、可通行边界以及楼梯地标，执行了以目标为导向的边界巡游；并通过落足点引导的三维搜索以及受垂直方向约束的局部轨迹优化，生成了可执行的跨楼层运动指令。在 HM3D 和 MP3D 数据集上进行的 4195 次模拟实验表明，TravExplorer 相较于具有代表性的 ObjectNav 基线方法，展现出了持续且显著的优势。此外，在 Unitree Go2 机器人上进行的 50 次真实世界实验进一步验证了该框架在单层及跨楼层室内环境中，无需预先地图或人工干预即可实现开放词汇目标搜索的能力。
Zero-shot Object Navigation (ZSON) has shown promise for open-vocabulary target search in unseen environments, yet most existing systems remain tied to planar representations and single-floor assumptions. These assumptions become inadequate in real buildings, where navigation involves floors, stairs, landings, and vertically overlapping spaces. This article presents TravExplorer, a cross-floor embodied exploration framework that couples zero-shot semantic guidance with traversability-aware 3-D planning. TravExplorer maintains a unified volumetric map that distinguishes occupied structures from robot-reachable support surfaces and extracts traversable frontiers from connected support surfaces, including floors, stairs, and landings. A FOV-aware active perception strategy further resolves incomplete observations during cross-floor traversal. To reduce semantic-reasoning latency, a lightweight guidance module aligns a probabilistic instance map from online open-vocabulary segmentation with a spatial value map from fast image-to-text matching. Based on these geometric and semantic memories, a hierarchical planner performs target-aware frontier touring over object hypotheses, traversable frontiers, and stair landmarks, and generates executable cross-floor motions through foothold-guided 3-D search and vertically constrained local trajectory optimization. Experiments over 4,195 simulated episodes on HM3D and MP3D demonstrate consistent advantages over representative ObjectNav baselines. Fifty real-world trials on a Unitree Go2 further validate open-vocabulary target search across single-floor and cross-floor indoor environments without prior maps or human intervention.
Mitigating EXACT-MPPI: Exact Signed-Distance Navigation for Arbitrary-Footprint Robots from Point Clouds via Path Integral Control
通过在线轨迹精修缓解多模块误差，实现动态环境下的可靠导航
地面机器人通常携带着有效载荷、作业机具或其他附件，这使得其有效足迹呈现出复杂且非凸的形状。若要在杂乱环境中安全导航，必须对这种真实的几何形状进行精确推理；然而，大多数局部规划器往往将其简化为凸形或膨胀后的代理形状，并将传感器数据栅格化为占据栅格或距离场。当环境间隙与机器人足迹的几何尺寸相近时，上述两种简化处理方式都会导致可行的运动路径被错误地排除。本文提出了一种名为 EXACT-MPPI 的免训练局部导航框架，该框架能够将局部的点云观测数据与稀疏的引导信号直接映射为运动指令，无需任何中间地图表示。该框架将一种解析式的、精确的符号距离评估器嵌入到了模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器之中。对于一般的凸形或凹形平面足迹，该框架将其表示为简单的多边形；针对矩形足迹，则采用一种基于矩形覆盖的特化表示方式以实现更快速的评估。这一设计使得系统能够在不依赖凸分解、足迹膨胀或深度学习编码器的情况下，实现对足迹敏感的碰撞代价计算。在每一次 MPPI 轨迹推演过程中，观测到的障碍点云会被变换至预测时刻的机器人本体坐标系下，并针对机器人足迹进行碰撞评估。所有的计算操作均通过 JAX 框架进行批量化处理，从而充分利用 GPU 的并行计算能力，实现实时的滚动时域控制。实验结果表明，相较于基于深度学习的点云-机器人距离评估基线方法，EXACT-MPPI 显著提升了批量距离评估的运算速度；在那些基于凸形足迹假设的规划器失效的场景中，EXACT-MPPI 依然能够保留可行的运动路径；此外，在面对密集分布的静态及动态障碍物时，该框架依然表现出极强的鲁棒性。该框架具有极高的通用性，仅需修改足迹描述与运动学模型，即可直接部署于差速驱动、阿克曼转向、全向移动以及混合模式等多种机器人平台上，且无需针对特定平台进行单独训练。通过将精确的足迹几何表示与基于采样的预测控制技术相结合，本文为实现跨越各类机器人的、对足迹敏感的局部导航功能，提供了一条实用且无需训练的有效途径。
Ground robots often carry payloads, implements, or other attachments that turn their effective footprint into complex, non-convex shapes. Navigating safely through clutter then requires reasoning about this true geometry, yet most local planners simplify it with convex or inflated proxies and rasterize sensor data into occupancy grids or distance fields. Both choices eliminate feasible motions when clearance is comparable to the footprint geometry. We present EXACT-MPPI, a training-free local navigation framework that maps local point-cloud observations and sparse guidance directly to motion commands, without any intermediate map representation. The framework embeds an analytic, exact signed-distance evaluator into a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller. The footprint is represented as a simple polygon for general convex or concave planar shapes, with a rectangle-cover specialization for faster evaluation of rectilinear footprints, enabling footprint-aware collision costs without convex decomposition, inflation, or learned encoders. During each MPPI rollout, observed obstacle points are transformed into the predicted body frame and evaluated against the footprint. All operations are batched in JAX, leveraging GPU parallelism for real-time receding-horizon control. Experiments show that EXACT-MPPI accelerates batched distance evaluation over a learned point-to-robot baseline, preserves feasible motion where convex-footprint planners fail, and remains robust under dense static and moving obstacles. The same framework deploys on differential-drive, Ackermann, omnidirectional, and hybrid-mode platforms by changing only the footprint description and motion model without per-platform training. Pairing exact footprint geometry with sampling-based predictive control thus offers a practical, training-free path to footprint-aware local navigation across diverse robots.
CANINE: Coaching Visually Impaired Users for Interactive Navigation with a Robot Guide Dog
CANINE：辅导视障用户利用机器人导盲犬进行交互式导航
机器人导盲犬能够提供导航辅助，极大地拓展了视障人士的独立出行能力；然而，若要有效利用这类机器人，用户必须掌握一种微妙的人机协作技巧，而这种技巧很难仅凭通用的口头指令来习得。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种名为 CANINE 的自动化辅导系统。该系统通过提供个性化、自适应的口头反馈，旨在训练用户掌握与机器人导盲犬进行交互式导航所需的技能。CANINE 将复杂的协作任务拆解为若干子技能，并在两个层面上开展工作。在宏观层面，系统利用“知识追踪”技术实时监测学习者在各项子技能上的熟练度，并优先针对其掌握最为薄弱的环节安排训练内容，从而决定“教什么”。在微观层面，CANINE 通过观察用户每一次的实际练习过程来决定针对特定子技能“如何教”：它利用基础模型来推断用户失误背后的深层原因，并据此自适应地生成具有针对性的口头纠正建议。我们开展了一项对照实验，邀请蒙眼参与者作为视障群体的替代样本进行定量评估。实验结果表明，与仅提供通用口头指令的传统方式相比，CANINE 能够显著提升用户的学习效率及最终的导航表现。此外，我们还通过一项技能保持度研究和一项探索性案例研究，进一步验证了 CANINE 的有效性。技能保持度研究显示，在结束训练两周后，用户的相关技能水平依然保持着显著的提升。案例研究则不仅证实了 CANINE 在辅导视障用户方面的实际成效，还揭示了该系统在面向真实世界场景进行部署时所需考量的更多设计细节。上述两项后续研究的结果均与此前的对照实验结论高度吻合。
Robot guide dogs offer navigation assistance that greatly expands the independent mobility of the visually impaired, but their effective use requires subtle human-robot coordination that is difficult for users to learn from generic verbal instructions. To tackle this challenge, we present CANINE, an automated coaching system that trains users for interactive navigation with a robot guide dog, through personalized, adaptive verbal feedback. CANINE decomposes a complex coordination task into sub-skills and operates at two levels. At the high level, it decides what to train by tracking the learner's proficiency across sub-skills using knowledge tracing and prioritizing training on the weakest areas. At the low level, CANINE decides how to train each sub-skill by observing each human practice episode, using foundation models to infer the underlying causes of errors, and generating targeted verbal corrections adaptively. A controlled study with blindfolded participants, treated as a proxy population for quantitative evaluation, demonstrates that CANINE significantly improves both learning efficiency and final navigation performance compared to generic verbal instructions. We further validate CANINE through a retention study and an exploratory case study. The retention study shows lasting skill improvement after two weeks. The case study confirms CANINE's effectiveness in training a visually impaired user, while revealing additional design considerations for real-world deployment. Both are well aligned with the findings of the controlled study.
NavOL: Navigation Policy with Online Imitation Learning
NavOL：基于在线模仿学习的导航策略
学习鲁棒的导航策略仍然是机器人学领域的一项核心挑战。离线模仿学习面临分布偏移和在策略执行（rollout）阶段产生累积误差的问题，而强化学习则需要进行繁琐的奖励工程设计，且学习效率较低。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为 NavOL 的在线模仿学习范式；该范式通过与仿真环境进行交互，并利用在线收集的专家演示数据来迭代更新自身策略。NavOL 建立在一种预训练的导航扩散策略之上，该策略能够将局部观测信息映射为未来的路径点。NavOL 的训练过程采用一种“执行-更新”的循环模式：在执行阶段，策略在仿真环境中采取行动，并向一个全局规划器发出查询请求——该规划器拥有对全局环境的特权访问权限，从而能够提供最优的路径片段作为“真值”轨迹标签；在更新阶段，策略利用在线收集到的“观测-轨迹”配对数据进行训练。这种在线模仿学习循环机制不仅消除了对奖励函数进行人工设计的必要，提高了学习效率，而且通过直接利用策略自身在探索过程中产生的执行轨迹进行训练，有效缓解了分布偏移问题。我们的系统基于 IsaacLab 平台构建，该平台具备高速、高保真的并行渲染能力，并支持对相机位姿及起终点配对进行域随机化处理。得益于这些技术优势，我们的系统能够在配备 8 块 RTX 4090 GPU 的硬件环境下，跨越 50 个不同的场景进行大规模扩展训练；每小时可收集超过 2000 条全新的轨迹数据，且每条轨迹的平均步长超过 400 步。此外，我们还引入了一项室内视觉导航基准测试，其中预设了固定的起终点位置，旨在用于评估策略在面对未知环境时的“零样本泛化”能力。我们在多个仿真基准测试（包括 NavDP 基准测试以及本文提出的新基准测试）上进行了广泛的评估，并辅以精心设计的真实世界实验；这些详实的测试结果充分证实了 NavOL 范式的有效性，展现了其在在线模仿学习任务中持续且显著的性能提升。
Learning robust navigation policies remains a core challenge in robotics. Offline imitation learning suffers from distribution shift and compounding errors at rollout, while reinforcement learning requires reward engineering and learns inefficiently. In this paper, we propose NavOL, an online imitation learning paradigm that interacts with a simulator and updates itself using expert demonstrations gathered online. Built upon a pretrained navigation diffusion policy that maps local observations to future waypoints, NavOL trains in a rollout update loop: during rollout, the policy acts in the simulator and queries a global planner which has privileged access to the global environment for the optimal path segment as ground truth trajectory labels; during update, the policy is trained on the online collected observation trajectory pairs. This online imitation loop removes the need for reward design, improves learning efficiency, and mitigates distribution shift by training on the policy own explored rollouts. Built on IsaacLab with fast, high-fidelity parallel rendering and domain randomization of camera pose and start-goal pairs, our system scales across 50 scenes on 8 RTX 4090 GPUs, collecting over 2,000 new trajectories per hour, each averaging more than 400 steps. We also introduce an indoor visual navigation benchmark with predefined start and goal positions for zero-shot generalization. Extensive evaluations on simulation benchmarks, including the NavDP benchmark and our proposed benchmark, as well as carefully designed real-world experiments, demonstrate the effectiveness of NavOL, showing consistent performance gains in online imitation learning.
Constraint-Aware Diffusion Priors for High-Fidelity and Versatile Quadruped Locomotion
面向高保真与通用四足步态的约束感知扩散先验
强化学习与模仿学习的结合极大地推动了仿生四足步态控制领域的发展。然而，将这些框架扩展至海量、多源的数据集时，却暴露出了一些根本性的瓶颈。首先，传统的基于GAN（生成对抗网络）的判别器容易发生“模式崩溃”现象，难以从未经筛选的原始数据集中捕捉到多样化的运动分布。其次，现有的运动先验模型存在“分布外”（OOD）追踪冲突的问题，导致机器人在执行复杂机动动作时发生严重的非预期航向漂移。此外，若将未经约束的运动先验直接部署到物理硬件上，由于忽略了执行器的动力学特性，将引发严重的安全隐患。为了克服上述挑战，我们提出了一种名为 Diff-CAST（扩散引导的约束感知对称追踪）的新型运动先验框架。该框架利用扩散模型强大的多模态分布建模能力来构建风格化奖励函数。Diff-CAST 有效地取代了传统的 GAN 判别器，从而实现了在异构数据集上进行稳健的数据规模化扩展。为了确保高保真的意图执行以及在现实世界中的可靠部署，我们构建了一套综合性的“仿真到现实”（Sim2Real）架构。该架构集成了“对称增强指令条件化”（SACC）模块以实现无漂移追踪，并引入了“约束强化学习”（Constrained RL）机制以保障硬件运行安全。在四足机器人平台上进行的实验结果表明，Diff-CAST 能够有效缓解模式崩溃问题，实现不同技能之间的无缝切换，并确保机器人步态既稳健可靠，又符合硬件运行的各项约束。
Reinforcement learning combined with imitation learning has significantly advanced biomimetic quadrupedal locomotion. However, scaling these frameworks to massive, multi-source datasets exposes fundamental bottlenecks. First, traditional GAN-based discriminators are prone to mode collapse, struggling to capture diverse motion distributions from uncurated datasets. Second, existing kinematic priors suffer from out-of-distribution (OOD) tracking conflicts, leading to severe unintended heading drifts during complex maneuvers. Furthermore, deploying unconstrained priors to physical hardware poses critical safety risks by disregarding actuator dynamics. To overcome these challenges, we propose Diff-CAST (Diffusion-guided Constraint-Aware Symmetric Tracking), a novel motion prior framework leveraging the multi-modal distribution modeling capabilities of diffusion models for stylistic rewards. Diff-CAST effectively replaces traditional GAN discriminators, unlocking robust data scaling on heterogeneous collections. To ensure high-fidelity intent execution and reliable real-world deployment, we introduce a comprehensive Sim2Real architecture integrating Symmetric Augmented Command Conditioning (SACC) for drift-free tracking, and Constrained RL for hardware safety. Experiments on a quadruped demonstrate that Diff-CAST mitigates mode collapse, enables seamless transitions between diverse skills, and ensures robust, hardware-compliant locomotion.
Real-Time Behavior Recognition Using a Legged Robot for Animal–Robot Interaction
基于足式机器人的动物-机器人交互实时行为识别
动物与机器人交互是一个新兴的跨学科领域，旨在探索动物与机器人系统之间的动态关系，以及实现有效交互的设计原则。尽管此前的研究已探讨了动物对机器人刺激的反应，但尚未将人工智能（AI）技术整合进来，以实现交互过程中的实时行为分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出了一种由AI驱动的框架，使机器狗能够自主监测并分析牲畜（具体针对牛和鸡）的行为。本系统利用深度学习模型处理摄像头的实时观测数据，从而实现对动物存在的检测及行为的识别。该系统集成了三个神经网络：YOLO-Chicken 和 YOLO-Cows（分别用于精准检测鸡和牛），以及 DARTEMIS——一种新型的、经过知识蒸馏处理的单模态网络变体，源自当前最先进的动物行为识别模型。这些网络通过 Redis 以轻量级的方式进行高效通信，且所有的计算处理均在机器人本体上本地完成。我们利用 COCO 数据集中关于牛的子集以及一个公开的鸡行为数据集，分别对 YOLO-Cow 和 YOLO-Chicken 进行了训练，最终获得的 mAP@50-95 分数分别为 0.67 和 0.56。而 DARTEMIS（与 ARTEMIS 模型一样，基于 Animal Kingdom 数据集进行训练）的 mAP 分数达到了 77.3。基于上述模型，我们通过实地试验在真实环境中对本系统进行了测试，并对其准确检测动物及分类动物行为的能力进行了评估。本研究首次成功地将高效的深度学习模型集成至机器人平台中，实现了对动物行为的实时分析。所提出的框架为实现牲畜的持续自动化监测奠定了基础，并在改善动物福利及农场管理方面展现出巨大的应用潜力。本系统的完整实现代码已对外公开，​​且其设计具备良好的通用性，可适配于各类机器人平台及相关的应用挑战。
Animal–robot interaction is an emerging interdisciplinary field that explores the dynamics between animals and robotic systems, as well as the design principles for effective engagement. While previous approaches have investigated animal responses to robotic stimuli, they have yet to integrate artificial intelligence (AI) for real-time behavioral analysis during the interaction. This paper addresses this gap by introducing an AI-driven framework that enables a robotic dog to autonomously monitor and analyze livestock behavior, specifically in cows and chickens. Our system processes real-time camera observations using deep-learning models to detect animal presence and recognize actions. It integrates three neural networks: YOLO-Chicken and YOLO-Cows, for accurate detection of chickens and cows, respectively, and DARTEMIS, a novel, distilled unimodal variant of a state-of-the-art Animal Action Recognition model. The networks communicate efficiently via Redis in a lightweight manner, with all processing conducted onboard the robot. We trained YOLO-Cow and YOLO-Chicken on a subset of the COCO data set for cows and a public data set for chickens, achieving mAP@50-95 scores of 0.67 and 0.56, respectively. DARTEMIS, trained on the Animal Kingdom data set like ARTEMIS, reached an mAP of 77.3. With these models, we tested our system in real-world conditions through field trials, evaluating its ability to accurately detect animals and classify their behaviors. This study presents the first successful integration of efficient deep- learning models into a robotic platform for real-time animal behavior analysis. The proposed framework paves the way for continuous automated livestock monitoring, with potential applications in improving animal welfare and farm management. The full implementation is publicly available and designed to be adaptable to various robotic platforms and related challenges.
HCLM: A Hierarchical Framework for Cooperative Loco-Manipulation with Dual Quadrupeds
HCLM：一种基于双四足机器人的协同运动操纵分层框架
我们提出 HCLM，这是一个针对双四足机器人系统进行通用协同移动操作的分层框架。由于空间协调、稳健移动以及闭链物理交互之间存在相互冲突的需求，协调跨浮动基座的多机器人协同操作极具挑战性。为解决这一难题，我们的架构系统地将高层协同推理与低层稳健运动执行解耦开来。在顶层，一个集中式的“联合扩散策略”（Joint Diffusion Policy）利用一种 SE(3) 不变的任务空间表征，学习与坐标系无关的空间协调模式。为了将这些与坐标系无关的参考指令转化为实际的物理运动，一个以任务为中心的混合式“全身控制器”将主动的运动学模型预测控制（用于无碰撞的速度分配）与被动的执行层相结合，实现了协同增效。至关重要的是，该被动执行层不仅确保了对末端执行器进行精确追踪时的快速响应能力，还通过一种协同导纳控制方案集成了主动力调节功能，从而在闭链交互过程中安全地化解运动学冲突并严格调控内部应力。我们在难度递增的仿真场景中对该框架进行了验证，涵盖了协同搬运、装箱以及物品交接等任务；其中，物品交接任务已成功部署至真实世界环境中。实验结果表明，该框架具备可靠的任务执行能力、严格的配置无关性，以及面对剧烈物理扰动时的卓越鲁棒性，为多机器人具身协同提供了一条高度稳健的实现路径。
We introduce HCLM, a hierarchical framework for general-purpose cooperative loco-manipulation with dual quadrupedal systems. Coordinating multi-robot collaborative manipulation across floating bases is highly challenging due to the conflicting demands of spatial coordination, robust locomotion, and closed-chain physical interactions. To resolve this, our architecture systematically decouples high-level collaborative reasoning from low-level robust motion execution. At the high level, a centralized Joint Diffusion Policy leverages an SE(3)-invariant task-space representation to learn coordinate-agnostic spatial coordination patterns. To translate these frame-agnostic references into physical motion, a task-centric hybrid Whole-Body Controller synergizes a proactive kinematic Model Predictive Control for collision-free velocity distribution with a reactive execution layer. Crucially, this reactive layer guarantees rapid responsiveness for precise end-effector tracking, while concurrently integrating active force regulation via a cooperative admittance scheme to safely resolve kinematic conflicts and strictly regulate internal stresses during closed-chain interactions. We validate the framework across progressively challenging simulated scenarios, including cooperative carrying, packing and handovers, and successfully deploy the latter in the real world. The results demonstrate reliable task execution, strict configuration agnosticism, and exceptional resilience against severe physical perturbations, offering a highly robust pathway for multi-robot embodied coordination.
Asymptotically Optimal Ergodic Coverage on Generalized Motion Fields
广义运动场上的渐近最优遍历覆盖
在偏远及极端环境中开展自主机器人探索，使科学家能够对由持续变形的流场所描述的复杂输运现象及群体行为进行建模。尽管这些环境在本质上应被建模为随时间变化的动态域，但大多数自适应探索方法却假定环境是静态的，从而无法提供充分的覆盖效果，也无法满足任何形式化的性能保证。在海洋学领域，这一问题尤为突出；在该领域中，自主水下系统（UxS）面临着极其严格的计算资源与载荷限制，因此迫切需要一种路径规划方法，能够在开环及欠驱动的工况下，生成稳健的数据采集策略。
为解决上述难题，本文提出将自适应搜索问题重新构建为一种“遍历覆盖”问题，并着重研究如何在受流场诱导动力学影响且随时间演变的动态域中，对覆盖效果进行遍历意义上的形式化验证。我们基于近期的一项研究成果——即证明了“最大均值差异”（MMD）可作为一种函数式遍历度量指标——进一步加以拓展；在此基础上，我们推导出一套“流场自适应”的数学表述，该表述能够在覆盖目标函数中显式地纳入动态域的演变特性。研究结果表明，该方法不仅能在存在环境流场的条件下维持遍历覆盖的性能保证，而且通过将环境动力学特性整合进规划流程，实现了在欠驱动乃至开环规划场景下的高效探索。实验结果证实，本文所提出的方法具有良好的泛化能力，可适用于多种时空动态过程，涵盖海洋探索、人类活动追踪以及牛群迁徙监测等应用场景。此外，我们在空中机器人与足式机器人平台上开展的物理实验也进一步验证了该方法的有效性：在受流场限制的非凸形复杂环境中，该方法依然能够在充分尊重机器人自身动力学特性的前提下，实现理想的遍历覆盖效果。
Autonomous robotic exploration in remote and extreme environments allows scientists to model complex transport phenomena and collective behaviors described by continuously deforming flow fields. Although these environments are naturally modeled as time-varying domains, most adaptive exploration methods assume static environments and fail to provide adequate coverage or satisfy any formal guarantees. This is especially the case in oceanography where autonomous underwater systems (UxS) have highly restrictive compute and payload requirements that necessitate path planning methods that yield robust data collection strategies in open-loop and underactuated settings.
In this work, to address the aforementioned issues, we propose to formulate adaptive search as an ergodic coverage problem and investigate certifying coverage in the ergodic sense over evolving domains with flow-induced dynamics. We expand upon recent work demonstrating maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) as a functional ergodic metric, and derive a flow-adaptive formulation that explicitly accounts for domain evolution within the coverage objective. We show that this approach preserves ergodic coverage guarantees in ambient flows and enables effective exploration in under-actuated, and even open-loop planning settings by integrating environment dynamics. Experiments validate that our method generalizes to diverse spatiotemporal processes including ocean exploration, and tracking human and cattle movement. Physical experiments on aerial and legged robotic platforms validate our ability to obtain ergodic coverage in non-convex, flow-restricted environments while respecting robot dynamics.
Multi-Floor Exploration for Ground Robots via an Incremental Reachable Graph and Structural Priors
基于增量可达图与结构先验的地面机器人多楼层探索
对于地面移动机器人而言，多层建筑的自主探索依然充满挑战，因为传统的二维（2D）和准三维（2.5D）地图无法有效表征诸如楼梯、坡道及多层可达高度等相互重叠的可通行表面。本文提出了一种基于增量式可达图的多层探索框架。该框架在可达支撑面上构建稀疏图，通过引入“暂定图元素”机制，在观测数据稀疏的情况下仍能保留潜在的有效连通性，从而实现对物理可达边界的稳健检测。为了引导机器人探索当前已建图楼层以外的区域，我们将已探索楼层的“任务区域先验信息”投影至目标楼层，以此初始化一个“假设图”，并随着新观测数据的涌入对该假设图进行增量式修正与融合。随后，一个分层规划器将对已确认结构与假设结构进行联合推理，从而提供全局探索指引。在仿真实验中，与现有基准方法相比，本文所提出的方法在探索效率和地图构建完整性方面均展现出了显著提升。此外，通过在真实环境中进行的机载实验，进一步验证了该方法的实际可行性及其优异的实时性能。
Autonomous exploration of multi-floor buildings remains challenging for ground robots because conventional 2D and 2.5D maps cannot represent overlapping traversable surfaces such as stairs, ramps, and multiple reachable elevations. This letter presents a multi-floor exploration framework based on an incremental reachable graph. Built as a sparse graph over reachable support surfaces, the graph preserves potentially valid connectivity through tentative graph elements under sparse observations and enables stable, physically reachable frontier detection. To guide exploration beyond the currently mapped floor, we project task-zone priors from an explored floor to initialize a hypothetical graph on the target floor and reconcile it incrementally with incoming observations. A hierarchical planner then jointly reasons over confirmed and hypothetical structures for global guidance. In simulation, the proposed method demonstrates improved exploration efficiency and mapping completeness compared to evaluated baselines. Furthermore, onboard real-world experiments validate its practical feasibility and real-time performance.
Urbanverse: Scaling urban simulation by watching city-tour videos
Urbanverse：通过观看城市漫游视频实现城市模拟的规模化
从配送机器人到四足仿生体，各类具身人工智能（Embodied AI）智能体正日益普及于我们的城市之中，穿梭于繁忙混乱的街道间，提供“最后一公里”的连接服务。若要实现此类智能体的规模化训练，必须依赖多样化且高保真的城市环境；然而，现有的由人工构建或通过程序生成的仿真场景，往往要么缺乏可扩展性，要么无法充分捕捉现实世界的复杂性。为此，我们推出 UrbanVerse——一套数据驱动的“由实入虚”（real-to-sim）系统，能够将众包收集的城市漫游视频转化为具备物理感知能力的交互式仿真场景。UrbanVerse 主要包含两大组件：(i) UrbanVerse-100K，这是一个拥有超过 10 万个已标注城市 3D 资产的资源库，每个资产均附带丰富的语义与物理属性；(ii) UrbanVerse-Gen，这是一条自动化处理流水线，能够从视频数据中提取场景布局信息，并利用检索到的资产自动构建出具备精确度量尺度的 3D 仿真场景。基于 IsaacSim 平台运行，UrbanVerse 目前已提供 160 个涵盖全球 24 个国家的高质量构建场景，并附带一套由专业艺术家精心设计的、包含 10 个测试场景的基准测试集。实验结果表明，UrbanVerse 生成的场景不仅精准保留了现实世界的语义信息与空间布局，其逼真度在人类主观评估中也达到了与人工精心构建场景相媲美的水平。在城市导航任务中，基于 UrbanVerse 训练的策略展现出了显著的“规模化幂律”（scaling power laws）效应以及强大的泛化能力；与现有方法相比，其在仿真环境中的任务成功率提升了 6.3%，在“零样本”仿真到现实迁移（sim-to-real transfer）任务中的成功率更是大幅提升了 30.1%，最终仅需两次人工干预便成功完成了长达 300 米的现实世界导航任务。
Urban embodied AI agents, ranging from delivery robots to quadrupeds, are increasingly populating our cities, navigating chaotic streets to provide last-mile connectivity. Training such agents requires diverse, high-fidelity urban environments to scale, yet existing human-crafted or procedurally generated simulation scenes either lack scalability or fail to capture real-world complexity. We introduce UrbanVerse, a data-driven real-to-sim system that converts crowd-sourced citytour videos into physics-aware, interactive simulation scenes. UrbanVerse consists of: (i) UrbanVerse-100K, a repository of 100k+ annotated urban 3D assets with semantic and physical attributes, and (ii) UrbanVerse-Gen, an automatic pipeline that extracts scene layouts from video and instantiates metric-scale 3D simulations using retrieved assets. Running in IsaacSim, UrbanVerse offers 160 high-quality constructed scenes from 24 countries, along with a curated benchmark of 10 artist-designed test scenes. Experiments show that UrbanVerse scenes preserve real-world semantics and layouts, achieving human-evaluated realism comparable to manually crafted scenes. In urban navigation, policies trained in UrbanVerse exhibit scaling power laws and strong generalization, improving success by +6.3% in simulation and +30.1% in zero-shot sim-to-real transfer comparing to prior methods, accomplishing a 300 m real-world mission with only two interventions.
PlanGS: Active 3D Gaussian Reconstruction with Real-Time Planning
PlanGS：基于实时规划的主动式三维高斯重建
得益于其极高的渲染效率和重建质量，3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）领域的近期进展已使其成为新视角合成和三维重建领域的主流表示方法。然而，现有方法通常依赖于人工采集的图像数据，这种方式存在采集效率低下且场景覆盖范围有限的问题。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种主动重建框架，使自主智能体能够高效地探索未知环境，并采集富含信息量的观测数据以实现高质量重建。本方法采用泊松圆盘采样（Poisson-disk sampling）生成均匀分布的候选视点，并构建路径图结构以实现高效探索。此外，我们提出了一种基于A*算法的自适应规划器，能够动态平衡局部探索与全局引导。大量实验结果表明，本方法在实现最先进的光度精度（photometric accuracy）的同时，在同类方法中取得了最短的探索时间。进一步地，我们在四足机器人平台上验证了该系统的可行性，充分展示了其在现实世界中实现自主三维重建的巨大潜力。
Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have made it a mainstream representation for novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction, owing to its high rendering efficiency and reconstruction quality. However, existing approaches typically rely on manually collected image data, which suffers from low acquisition efficiency and limited scene coverage. To overcome these limitations, we propose an active reconstruction framework that enables an autonomous agent to efficiently explore unknown environments and collect informative observations for high-quality reconstruction. Our method employs Poisson-disk sampling to generate uniformly distributed candidate viewpoints and constructs a path graph structure for efficient exploration. In addition, we propose an A*-based adaptive planner that dynamically balances local exploration and global guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art photometric accuracy, while achieving the shortest exploration time among comparable methods. Furthermore, we validate the feasibility of our system on a quadruped robot, showcasing its potential for real-world autonomous 3D reconstruction.
Tightening Mixed-Integer Convex Relaxations for Efficient Temporal Logic Motion Planning via Logic Network Flow
基于逻辑网络流的混合整数凸松弛紧化，实现高效的时序逻辑运动规划
本文提出了一种基于优化的任务与运动规划框架，命名为“逻辑网络流”（Logic Network Flow，LNF），旨在将时序逻辑规范整合至高效的混合整数规划模型中。在该框架下，时序谓词被编码为网络流模型各边上的多面体约束，而非像传统“逻辑树”表述那样被编码为节点间的约束。这一设计使得该框架在与各类分段仿射（PWA）动力系统模型相结合时，能够产生经理论证明更为紧致的凸松弛解，并显著减少约束数量。针对车辆路径规划、多机器人协同以及基于质点和线性倒立摆模型的动力系统时序逻辑控制等多个领域的综合实验表明，该框架能够实现高达数个数量级的计算加速。
This paper proposes an optimization-based task and motion planning framework, named "Logic Network Flow" (LNF), to integrate temporal logic specifications into efficient mixed-integer programs. Temporal predicates are encoded as polyhedron constraints on each edge of a network flow model, instead of as constraints between nodes as in traditional Logic Tree formulations. This leads to provably tighter convex relaxations and fewer constraints when synthesized with various piecewise-affine (PWA) dynamic system formulations. Comprehensive experiments across vehicle routing, multi-robot coordination, and temporal logic control on dynamical systems using point mass and linear inverted pendulum models demonstrate up to orders of magnitude computational speedups.
SigLoMa: Learning Open-World Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation from Ego-Centric Vision
SigLoMa：基于自我中心视觉的开放世界四足移动操纵学习
设计一套适用于开放环境的四足机器人移动-操作（loco-manipulation）系统极具挑战性。传统的强化学习框架若依赖外部感知信息，往往会面临极低的样本利用效率以及巨大的“仿真-现实”鸿沟。此外，视觉追踪固有的延迟特性与高精度浮动基座控制所需的高频率响应需求之间存在根本性的冲突。因此，现有的系统往往高度依赖昂贵的外部运动捕捉设备和离板计算资源。为了消除这些依赖，我们提出了一种名为 SigLoMa 的框架，这是一套完全基于机载计算和第一人称视角视觉感知的抓取-放置（pick-and-place）系统。SigLoMa 的核心在于引入了“Sigma点”（Sigma Points）——一种轻量级的外部感知几何表示方法，它不仅保证了极高的可扩展性，还能实现天然的“仿真-现实”对齐。为了弥合低频感知与高频控制之间的频率鸿沟，我们设计了一种基于第一人称视角的卡尔曼滤波器，以提供鲁棒且高频率的状态估计。在学习策略方面，我们通过一种由“提示姿态”（Hint Poses）引导的“主动采样课程”来缓解样本利用效率低下的问题；同时，我们利用时间编码技术并结合仿真的随机游走漂移机制，有效解决了机器人自身结构所造成的视觉盲点问题。实地实验结果证实：仅凭一个运行频率为 5Hz（延迟 200毫秒）的开放词汇目标检测器，SigLoMa 便能成功执行跨多项任务的动态移动-操作动作，其综合性能已达到甚至媲美人类专家的远程遥控操作水平。
Designing an open-world quadrupedal loco-manipulation system is highly challenging. Traditional reinforcement learning frameworks utilizing exteroception often suffer from extreme sample inefficiency and massive sim-to-real gaps. Furthermore, the inherent latency of visual tracking fundamentally conflicts with the high-frequency demands of precise floating-base control. Consequently, existing systems lean heavily on expensive external motion capture and off-board computation. To eliminate these dependencies, we present SigLoMa, a fully onboard, ego-centric vision-based pick-and-place framework. At the core of SigLoMa is the introduction of Sigma Points, a lightweight geometric representation for exteroception that guarantees high scalability and native sim-to-real alignment. To bridge the frequency divide between slow perception and fast control, we design an ego-centric Kalman Filter to provide robust, high-rate state estimation. On the learning front, we alleviate sample inefficiency via an Active Sampling Curriculum guided by Hint Poses, and tackle the robot's structural visual blind spots using temporal encoding coupled with simulated random-walk drift. Real-world experiments validate that, relying solely on a 5Hz (200 ms latency) open-vocabulary detector, SigLoMa successfully executes dynamic loco-manipulation across multiple tasks, achieving performance comparable to expert human teleoperation.
SPICD-Net: A Siamese PointNet Framework for Autonomous Indoor Change Detection in 3D LiDAR Point Clouds
SPICE-Net：一种用于三维 LiDAR 点云自主室内变化检测的孪生点云网络框架
对于使用 3D LiDAR 的自主机器人系统来说，室内环境中的可靠变化检测仍然是一个挑战。现有方法通常需要手动注释、计算密集型架构或关注室外场景。本文提出了 SPICD-Net，这是一种用于室内 3D 变化检测的轻量级 Siamese PointNet 框架，专门针对合成生成的异常进行训练，从而消除了手动标记。该框架提供了三个面向部署的贡献：一个三类 Siamese 公式，将未更改、已更改和几何不一致的图块对分开； FPS 前异常注入策略，将综合训练与推理时间预处理相结合；以及随机门控倒角统计分支，在消费级硬件限制下用显式几何线索补充学习嵌入。在室内走廊数据集中进行 14 次受控模拟实验评估后，SPICD-Net 实现了聚合精度 = 0.86、召回率 = 0.82、F1 分数 = 0.84 和准确度 = 0.96，在无变化基线中误报为零，在单个消费者 GPU 上对 172 个图块地图的平均推理时间为 22.4 秒。额外的鲁棒性实验将配准准确性确定为主要的操作先决条件。在一个看不见的房间（四次扫描，67 个图块）中进行的有限现实世界验证实现了精度 = 0.583、召回率 = 1.000 和 F1 = 0.737。
Reliable change detection in indoor environments remains a challenge for autonomous robotic systems using 3D LiDAR. Existing methods often require manual annotation, computationally intensive architectures, or focus on outdoor scenes. This paper presents SPICD-Net, a lightweight Siamese PointNet framework for indoor 3D change detection trained exclusively on synthetically generated anomalies, eliminating manual labeling. The framework offers three deployment-oriented contributions: a three-class Siamese formulation separating no-change, changed, and geometrically inconsistent tile pairs; a pre-FPS anomaly injection strategy that aligns synthetic training with inference-time preprocessing; and a stochastic-gated Chamfer-statistics branch that complements learned embeddings with explicit geometric cues under consumer-grade hardware constraints. Evaluated on 14 controlled simulation experiments in an indoor corridor dataset, SPICD-Net achieved aggregated Precision = 0.86, Recall = 0.82, F1-score = 0.84, and Accuracy = 0.96, with zero false positives in the no-change baseline and mean inference time of 22.4 s for a 172-tile map on a single consumer GPU. Additional robustness experiments identified registration accuracy as the main operational prerequisite. A limited real-world validation in one unseen room (four scans, 67 tiles) achieved Precision = 0.583, Recall = 1.000, and F1 = 0.737.
MCNav: Memory-Aware Dynamic Cognitive Map for Zero-shot Goal-oriented Navigation
MCNav：面向零样本目标导向导航的内存感知动态认知地图
在复杂环境中导航至特定实例级目标是一项充满挑战的难题。许多现有的零样本（zero-shot）方法通过对整个环境进行建模并利用大型语言模型进行场景理解，从而实现了优异的性能。然而，此类策略主要侧重于探索未知区域，却缺乏对已探索区域内信息的深度挖掘。因此，当目标位于曾访问过的区域内却被遗漏或误识时，往往会导致导航任务的失败。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种名为 MCNav 的记忆感知型导航框架，该框架配备了动态认知地图。这张地图能够高效地存储关于已探索区域内相关对象的可查询信息。基于这一记忆结构，MCNav引入了两种记忆感知型探索策略：一是“目标重验证”（goal re-validation），用于重新评估此前观察到的对象，以纠正匹配失误；二是“遗漏目标重探索”（missed goal re-exploration），通过利用上下文线索来估算目标存在于已探索区域内的概率。此外，我们还通过“黑名单机制”来防止重复性错误，并辅以“双重检查机制”以确保高置信度的确认，从而进一步增强了上述策略的稳健性。我们在 HM3Dv1 和 HM3Dv2 数据集上针对三项不同的任务对 MCNav 进行了评估；结果显示，该框架取得了当前最先进（state-of-the-art）的性能表现，尤其是在实例级目标导航任务中表现尤为突出。
Navigating to instance-level targets in complex environments is a challenging problem. Many existing zero-shot methods achieve strong performance by modeling the entire environment and leveraging large language models for scene understanding. However, such strategies primarily focus on exploring new regions while lacking a deeper exploitation of information from previously explored areas. Consequently, when targets are missed or misidentified within previously visited regions, navigation failures occur frequently. To address these limitations, we propose MCNav, a memory-aware navigation framework with a dynamic cognitive map. This map stores efficiently queryable information about relevant objects in explored areas. Building on this memory structure, MCNav introduces two memory-aware exploration strategies: goal re-validation, which re-assesses previously seen objects to correct matching failures, and missed goal re-exploration, which estimates the likelihood that a target is present in an explored region from contextual cues. These strategies are further stabilized by a blacklist mechanism to prevent repeated errors and a double-check mechanism for high-confidence confirmation. We evaluate MCNav on the HM3Dv1 and HM3Dv2 datasets across three different tasks, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly on the instance-level goal navigation task.
Melding LLM and temporal logic for reliable human-swarm collaboration in complex scenarios
融合大语言模型与时序逻辑，实现复杂场景下的可靠人机群协作
机器人群集有望在复杂且危险的环境中提供可扩展的辅助能力。任务规划是人机群集协作的核心所在，它负责将操作员的意图转化为协调一致的群集行动，并协助判定在任务执行过程中何时需要进行验证或干预。然而，在动态场景下的长周期任务中，维持可靠的任务规划往往面临巨大挑战：突发事件与环境变化要求系统必须持续进行自适应调整，而操作员若需全程保持监督，则会承受沉重的认知负担。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的规划工具虽能辅助生成任务规划，但仍易产生无效的任务排序或不可行的机器人动作，从而导致操作员不得不频繁进行手动修正。为此，我们提出了一种面向长周期人机群集协作的“神经-符号”混合框架，该框架将可验证的任务规划与基于情境感知的LLM推理紧密融合。在该框架中，任务目标与操作规则被形式化为时序逻辑公式，而允许的任务排序则被形式化为任务自动机。在这些形式化约束条件及实时的感知情境的共同制约下，LLM能够生成既符合任务规则、又与当前场景高度契合的可执行子任务序列。随后，一个具备不确定性感知能力的调度器会将这些子任务分配给异构机器人群集中的各个成员，旨在最大化任务的并行执行效率，同时确保系统对各类干扰具备鲁棒性。此外，我们还设计了一种基于事件触发的交互协议，旨在将操作员的介入范围严格限定在稀疏且高层级的确认与指导环节。将该框架部署于异构机器人编队中进行实测，结果不仅印证了其有效性，更展现出其对各类硬件特有的执行与通信不确定性具备极强的鲁棒性。综合而言，上述研究成果确立了一种形式化且可扩展的范式，为在动态环境中实现可靠且低开销的人机群集协作奠定了坚实基础。
Robot swarms promise scalable assistance in complex and hazardous environments. Task planning lies at the core of human-swarm collaboration, translating the operator's intent into coordinated swarm actions and helping determine when validation or intervention is required during execution. In long-horizon missions under dynamic scenarios, however, reliable task planning becomes difficult to maintain: emerging events and changing conditions demand continual adaptation, and sustained operator oversight imposes substantial cognitive burden. Existing LLM-based planning tools can support plan generation, yet they remain susceptible to invalid task orderings and infeasible robot actions, resulting in frequent manual adjustment. Here we introduce a neuro-symbolic framework for long-horizon human-swarm collaboration that tightly melds verifiable task planning with context-grounded LLM reasoning. We formalize mission goals and operational rules as temporal logic formulas and admissible task orderings as task automata. Conditioned on these formal constraints and live perceptual context, LLMs generate executable subtask sequences that satisfy mission rules and remain grounded in the current scene. An uncertainty-aware scheduler then assigns subtasks across the heterogeneous swarm to maximize parallelisms while remaining resilient to disruptions. An event-triggered interaction protocol further limits operator involvement to sparse, high-level confirmation and guidance. Deployment on a heterogeneous robotic fleet yields similar results while remaining robust to hardware-specific actuation and communication uncertainties. Together, these results support a formal and scalable paradigm for reliable and low-overhead human-swarm collaboration in dynamic environments
Learning Terrain-Aware Whole-Body Control for Perceptive Legged Loco-Manipulation
面向感知式足式移动操纵的、地形感知型全身控制学习
足式机械臂集卓越的地形适应性与移动操作能力于一身，这使其在以人为中心的环境中具有极高的应用前景。通过协调腿部与臂部的控制，全身控制器能够显著扩展足式机械臂的操作工作空间。然而，许多现有的全身控制器主要依赖于本体感知，却未整合有效感知地形拓扑所需的关键外部感知信息。这一局限性阻碍了它们适应多变环境条件以及在复杂地形中高效导航的能力。本文提出了一种针对足式机械臂的“地形感知全身控制”框架（TA-WBC），该框架采用了一种新颖的、基于强化学习（RL）的统一策略，专为各类地形下的全身移动操作任务量身打造。具体而言，我们采用了一种混合式外部感知编码器来提取地形特征，为机器人主动调整姿态及落足点提供了必要的基础。此外，为促进跨地形移动操作的稳定性，我们提出了一种基于足部接触面的新型末端执行器采样方法，从而将操作目标与基座的晃动解耦开来。不仅如此，我们还引入了一个双策略蒸馏模块，旨在将广域的全身运动能力与地形适应性相融合，且避免发生“灾难性遗忘”现象。仿真及实物实验结果验证了所提控制器的鲁棒性，该控制器实现了更大的可达空间、更低的轨迹跟踪误差，并显著减少了意外绊倒的发生。这一统一策略充分彰显了足式机械臂在复杂地形中执行移动操作任务所具备的巨大潜力。
Legged manipulators integrate exceptional terrain adaptability along with mobile manipulation capabilities, which make them highly promising for deployment in human-centric environments. By coordinating the control of both legs and arms, a whole-body controller can significantly expand the operational workspace of legged manipulators. However, many existing whole-body controllers primarily depend on proprioception and do not incorporate the critical exteroception required for effective terrain topology perception. This limitation can hinder their ability to adapt to varying environmental conditions and navigate complex terrains effectively. In this paper, we introduce TA-WBC, a terrain-aware whole-body control framework for legged manipulators, which features a novel RL-based unified policy tailored to whole-body loco-manipulation tasks in various terrains. Specifically, we employ a hybrid exteroception encoder to extract terrain features, providing an essential basis for the robot to proactively adapt posture and footholds. Furthermore, to facilitate stable cross-terrain loco-manipulation, we propose a novel end-effector sampling method based on the foot contact plane, decoupling manipulation target from base fluctuations. Moreover, a dual-policy distillation module is introduced to integrate expansive whole-body motion with terrain adaptability without catastrophic forgetting. The simulation and real-world experiments validate the robustness of our proposed controller, which leads to a larger reachable space, less tracking error, and reduced unexpected stumbles. This unified policy highlights the promising capabilities of legged manipulators in performing loco-manipulation tasks across complex terrains.
A Taxonomy of Environmental Cues for Quadruped Robot Navigation in Construction Environments Informed by Human Operator Behavior
基于人类操作员行为的建筑环境中四足机器人导航环境线索分类体系
鉴于建筑环境空间布局复杂、障碍物动态变化且具有社会互动属性，实现机器人在此类环境中的自主导航仍是一项重大挑战。现有的导航方法主要依赖预设规则和成本函数来解读环境线索（例如：与障碍物保持至少0.3米的最小距离，或对崎岖地形及靠近障碍物的情况赋予较高的成本权重）。然而，目前尚缺乏实证依据来明确究竟哪些具体的环境线索对于在此类场景中实现安全、高效的导航至关重要。自动驾驶领域的研究表明，通过分析人类驾驶员的第一视角视频，能够揭示出对安全驾驶至关重要的环境线索。受此启发，我们开展了一项研究，旨在探究在繁忙的建筑工地上，人类操作员手动操控四足机器人进行导航时，究竟是哪些环境线索在引导其行为。我们在一个正在作业的建筑工地上部署了一台由人工操控的四足机器人，并采用自然情境下的实地观测方法，采集了大量第一视角视频数据。随后，我们运用主题分析法对这些视频进行了深入剖析，旨在识别出那些触发操作员采取特定行动（如停止或转向）的环境特征。分析结果揭示了一套包含三大类别的环境线索分类体系：地形线索（涉及地面纹理及地形几何特征）、障碍与危险线索（涵盖静态及动态物体），以及交流线索（包括人类的手势动作及环境中嵌入的视觉指示信号）。这些研究发现基于实证数据，为我们深入理解在繁忙的建筑环境中实现机器人安全导航所必需的关键环境线索提供了坚实基础；进而，这些发现也将为设计具备情境感知能力及社会互动智能的机器人自主导航感知模块提供重要的理论指导。
Autonomous robot navigation in construction environments remains a significant challenge due to their complex spatial configurations, dynamic obstacles, and socially interactive nature. Existing approaches rely on pre-programmed rules and costs to interpret environment cues (e.g., maintaining a minimum distance of 0.3 meters from obstacles, assigning higher costs to uneven terrain or proximity to obstacles). However, there is no empirical evidence identifying which specific cues are essential for safe and effective navigation in these settings. Research in autonomous driving has demonstrated that analyzing human drivers’ behavior through egocentric video can reveal the environmental cues critical to safe navigation. Inspired by this approach, we investigate theenvironmental cues that inform human navigation behavior during manual control of a quadruped robot on an active construction site. We deployed a manually controlled quadruped on an active site and collected egocentric video using naturalistic field methods. After that, we analyzed the videos using thematic analysis to identify the environmental features that triggered operators’ actions, such as stopping and turning. Our analysis resulted in a taxonomy of three cue categories: topography cues, which pertain to ground surface texture and terrain geometry; obstacle and hazard cues, which involve both static and dynamic objects; and communicative cues, which include human gestures and embedded visual indicators. These findings provide an empirically grounded understanding of the environmental cues that are essential for safe robot navigation in active construction environments and, in turn, inform the design of perception modules for context-aware, socially competent autonomy.
Kine2Go: Kinematic dataset for the Unitree Go2 robot with diverse gaits and motions
Kine2Go：包含多种步态与动作的 Unitree Go2 机器人运动学数据集
近年来，机器人技术的普及与硬件成本的持续下降，降低了机器人研究的准入门槛，并推动了该领域的快速发展。Unitree Go2 四足机器人便是其中的典型代表，常被研究人员用于运动控制、导航及控制算法等领域的研究。许多研究人员将 Go2 机器人与模仿学习、强化学习及行为克隆等技术相结合，以实现由机器学习系统完全控制机器人。然而，这些技术往往依赖于包含机器人运动学信息及电机动作指令的演示数据；获取此类数据不仅难度大、耗时长，还需要构建复杂的处理流程。为解决这一难题，我们推出了 Kine2Go 数据集。该数据集包含 800 条针对 Unitree Go2 机器人的多样化步态运动学轨迹数据，这些数据源自 40 种不同的控制策略。我们的数据处理流程能够接收来自不同四足机器人构型的数据，并将其转换为 Go2 兼容的格式；随后，我们利用强化学习训练策略以复现特定动作，并收集这些策略运行产生的数据，从而获得包含相应电机级动作指令的、具有鲁棒性且包含扰动信息的运动学数据。
The recent popularity of robotics, combined with the steadily decreasing cost of robotic hardware, has lowered the entry barrier to robotics research and enabled rapid advancements in the field. One of the primary examples is the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, which is often used by researchers in the areas of locomotion, navigation, control, and others. Many researchers use the Go2 robot in combination with techniques like imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and behavioral cloning to allow machine learning systems to take full control of the robot. At the same time, many of those techniques require demonstration data consisting of the robot's kinematics information and actions applied to the motors. Obtaining such data is difficult, requires building complex pipelines, and can take significant time. To aid in those kinds of efforts, we present Kine2Go - a dataset with 800 diverse gait kinematics trajectory motion data for the Unitree Go2 robot, derived from 40 distinct policies. Our pipeline accepts data from various quadruped morphologies and translates them to a Go2-compatible format. Then we use Reinforcement Learning to train policies following a given motion, and finally we gather data from those policies, which grants robust, perturbed kinematic data with corresponding motor-level actions.
Autonomous Navigation System for Library Service Robot Based on Unitree Go2 Edu
基于 Unitree Go2 Edu 的图书馆服务机器人自主导航系统
图书馆环境要求自主机器人既能在狭窄通道内安静移动，又能确保在读者、座椅、包袋和推车等障碍物周围安全运行。本文针对搭载4D激光雷达、前置深度相机及惯性测量单元（IMU）的Unitree Go2 Edu四足机器人，提出了一套基于ROS 2的导航系统。该系统不将图书馆环境简单视为崎岖地形，而是着眼于实际部署中遇到的移动性挑战，包括地面材质变化、临时杂物以及部分受阻的通道——这些场景往往是底盘离地间隙较小的轮式平台难以应对的。系统采用RTAB-Map进行视觉-激光雷达SLAM（同步定位与建图），利用AMCL与基于EKF的传感器融合技术实现定位，并结合包含A*和DWA算法的Nav2导航栈，支持路径规划与局部避障。在实际图书馆环境的测试中，该系统在静态、低密度动态及高密度动态场景下的任务成功率分别达到100%、96%和88%；同时，通过与实测基准距离进行比对验证，地图构建的平均度量误差仅为3.7厘米。
Libraries require autonomous robots to move quietly through narrow aisles while remaining safe around readers, chairs, bags, and carts. This paper presents a ROS 2 navigation system for a Unitree Go2 Edu quadruped equipped with a 4D LiDAR, a front depth camera, and an IMU. Rather than assuming the library is rough terrain, we target the practical mobility discontinuities of real deployments, including floor transitions, temporary clutter, and partially blocked passages where low-clearance wheeled platforms are less tolerant. RTAB-Map is used for visual-LiDAR SLAM, AMCL and EKF-based sensor fusion provide localization, and a Nav2 stack with A* and DWA supports planning and local avoidance. In a real library, the system achieves 100%, 96%, and 88% success rates in static, low-density dynamic, and high-density dynamic scenes, while map validation against surveyed control distances yields a mean metric error of 3.7 cm.
Racing a Wheeled Quadruped: Active Load Transfer Mitigation via Model Predictive Control
轮式四足机器人的竞速：基于模型预测控制的主动载荷转移抑制
本文提出了一种结合模型预测控制（MPC）与强化学习（RL）的分层控制框架，用于轮式四足机器人在自动驾驶竞速过程中的主动侧倾控制，旨在管理横向载荷转移。该框架集成了离线生成时间最优赛车路线、在线MPC规划器（主动最小化横向载荷转移率，即LTR）以及直接部署于机器人16个执行器上的底层全身RL策略。MPC基于Unitree Go2-W平台的车辆动力学自行车模型构建。机器人的腿部执行器充当主动悬架，通过膝关节产生抗侧倾力矩，使车身在过弯时向内侧倾斜。实地赛道实验表明，该主动侧倾控制方案使平均LTR降低了高达44%，最快单圈时间缩短了8.7%，并将峰值横向加速度能力提升了21.3%（达到1.98 m/s²），从而在非倾斜基准控制器无法胜任的工况下，依然保持了稳健的高速行驶稳定性。
This paper presents a hierarchical control framework using model predictive control (MPC) and reinforcement learning (RL) for active roll control to manage lateral load transfer during autonomous racing of a wheeled quadruped. The framework integrates offline time-optimal raceline generation, an online MPC planner that actively minimizes the lateral Load Transfer Ratio (LTR), and a low-level, whole-body RL policy deployed directly onto the robot's 16 actuators. The MPC is based on a vehicle dynamics bicycle model of the Unitree Go2-W platform. The robot's leg actuators act as active suspension where knee joints generate anti-roll torque to bank into turns. Physical track experiments demonstrate that active roll control reduces mean LTR by up to 44%, improves the fastest lap time by 8.7%, and boosts peak lateral acceleration capability by 21.3% to 1.98 m/s2, maintaining robust high-speed stability beyond the range of a non-tilting baseline controller.
Long-Distance Real-World Navigation of the Legged-Wheeled Robot Go2-W Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
基于深度强化学习的足轮式机器人 Go2-W 长距离真实环境导航
足轮式机器人因其能够结合轮式在平坦地面上的高效移动能力与腿式在复杂地形上的适应能力，长期以来备受研究关注。然而，将此类机器人应用于真实环境中的长距离自主导航的案例仍然有限。本文介绍了一项针对市售足轮式机器人 Go2-W 的研究工作，旨在构建基于深度强化学习（DRL）的运动控制器及自主导航系统，并将其应用于真实环境中的长距离自主导航任务。在运动控制方面，我们将此前为四足机器人开发的仅依赖本体感知（proprioception-only）的控制策略，扩展应用到了这款具有 16 个自由度的足轮式机器人上。研究发现，轮式移动会导致负载集中于髋关节并引发热量积聚，从而阻碍持续行进；为此，我们获得了一种通过分配负载来抑制该问题的控制策略。我们在“筑波挑战赛 2025”（Tsukuba Challenge 2025）中对该系统进行了评估，结果表明，该机器人能够自主穿越全长约 2.8 公里的路线（涵盖人行道、公园及楼梯），且未因过热而中途停顿。
Legged-wheeled robots have long been studied for their potential to combine the efficient flat-ground mobility of wheels with the rough-terrain capability of legs. However, examples of their application to long-range autonomous navigation in real environments remain limited. This paper reports our effort to build a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based locomotion controller and an autonomous navigation system for the commercially available legged-wheeled robot Go2-W, and to apply them to long-range autonomous navigation in a real environment. For locomotion control, we extended a proprioception-only policy, which we had previously developed for quadruped robots, to the 16-DoF legged-wheeled robot. We also found that wheeled locomotion concentrates the load on the hip joints and causes heat concentration that hinders sustained travel, and obtained a policy that suppresses it by distributing the load. We evaluated the system at the Tsukuba Challenge 2025, demonstrating that it can autonomously traverse an approximately 2.8 km route including sidewalks, a park, and stairs without stopping due to overheating.
ForEnt: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Characterizing Quadruped Robot Entrapments in Forest Environments
ForEnt：用于表征四足机器人森林环境被困情况的多模态数据集
足式机器人正越来越多地应用于森林生态调查与监测，但在穿越森林环境时，其自主运行常因各种挑战而中断。例如，当机器人腿部被藤蔓或其他植被缠绕导致“森林环境中的被困”（forest entrapment）时，往往会引发失稳甚至倾倒。此类事故不仅会打断任务并需要人工干预，还可能导致机器人硬件受损。为填补针对森林环境中此类故障模式研究缺乏专用数据集的空白，我们推出了 ForEnt——这是一个多模态数据集，由低成本 Unitree Go2 四足机器人在英国南安普顿公地林区（Southampton Common Woodlands）的八个森林站点采集而成。该数据集涵盖了 11 个序列、总计约 1.7 公里的穿越行程，记录了 69 起被困事件。ForEnt 包含时间同步的 RGB-D 图像、激光雷达（LiDAR）扫描数据、本体感知数据以及第三人称视角视频，既支持分析导致被困的地形因素，又能提供用于可复现基准测试的标注传感器数据流。通过支持对被困检测策略的评估，ForEnt 降低了开发能够在复杂森林环境中稳健运行的四足机器人的技术门槛。
Legged robots are increasingly deployed in forests for ecological surveying and monitoring, yet their autonomy is often interrupted consequent to the challenges posed in traversing forest environments. Forest entrapments, for example, when a robot's legs are ensnared in vines or other vegetation, result in loss of stability and toppling. Such events not only disrupt the mission and require manual intervention, but also risk damage to the robot hardware. To address the absence of a dedicated dataset to investigate these failure modes in forest environments, we present ForEnt, a multi-modal dataset collected with the low-cost Unitree Go2 quadruped across eight forest sites in the Southampton Common Woodlands, UK. For our dataset, over approximately 1.7 km of traversals in 11 sequences were conducted, yielding 69 recorded entrapment events. ForEnt includes time-synchronized RGB-D images, LiDAR scans, proprioceptive data, and third-person video, enabling analysis of terrain factors contributing to entrapment and providing labeled sensor streams for reproducible benchmarking. By supporting the evaluation of entrapment detection strategies, ForEnt lowers the barrier to developing robust quadruped robot deployments in challenging forest environments.
StairMaster: Learning to Conquer Risky Hollow Stairs for Agile Quadrupedal Robots
StairMaster：学习征服具有风险的镂空楼梯，赋能敏捷四足机器人
对于四足机器人而言，攀爬镂空楼梯仍是一项极具挑战性的任务，这主要归因于腿部被卡住的高风险、深度数据的严重稀疏性以及高频深度感知噪声。本文提出了 StairMaster，这是一个新颖的三阶段强化学习框架，旨在实现机器人在此类极端不连续地形上的稳定运动。该架构集成了交叉注意力（Cross-Attention）机制，用于从含噪深度数据中提取结构特征；同时引入了空间感知循环单元（SRU），通过维持稳健的时空记忆来缓解感知盲区问题。为了弥合深度感知领域的“仿真到现实”（sim-to-real）差距，我们提出了一种高保真的深度传感器建模流程，能够真实复现现实世界中的传感器伪影。此外，我们采用了基于三维航点引导的主动感知奖励机制以实现前瞻性感知，并结合针对镂空缝隙的运动学惩罚及针对楼梯边缘的惩罚项，从而确保落脚点的精确性。我们将 StairMaster 成功部署在 Unitree Go2 机器人上，并通过零样本迁移（zero-shot transfer）验证了其攀爬镂空楼梯的能力，成功应对了高达 55° 的前所未有的坡度。据我们所知，这是首个在现实环境中实现如此陡峭镂空楼梯攀爬的基于强化学习的控制策略。
Climbing hollow stairs remains a challenging problem for quadruped robots due to the high risk of leg trapping, severe depth sparsity, and high-frequency depth-sensing noise. In this paper, we propose StairMaster, a novel three-stage reinforcement learning framework for stable locomotion on such extreme discontinuous terrains. Our architecture integrates a Cross-Attention mechanism to extract structural features from noisy depth data, alongside a Spatial-aware Recurrent Unit (SRU) that maintains robust spatio-temporal memory to mitigate perception blind spots. To bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception, we propose a high-fidelity sim-to-real depth sensor modeling pipeline that faithfully replicates real-world sensor artifacts. Additionally, we employ a 3D waypoint-guided active perception reward for proactive sensing, alongside hollow gap kinematic and stair edge penalties to ensure precise foothold placement. We successfully deployed StairMaster on a Unitree Go2 robot, demonstrating its ability to conquer hollow stairs with an unprecedented incline of up to 55° through zero-shot transfer. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first RL-based policy to achieve such steep hollow stair climbing in real-world environments.
Continual Quadruped Robots Coordination via Semantic Skill Discovery
基于语义技能发现的持续四足机器人协作
多足式机器人（四足机器人）协同因其更高的负载能力、更广的接触覆盖范围以及对复杂任务的更强适应性，正日益受到关注。现有的多足机器人协同操作方法通常针对预定义或封闭的任务集，多依赖多智能体强化学习（MARL）来训练特定任务的协同策略。然而，这些方法在开放式持续学习场景下往往难以应对——在此类场景中，任务按顺序到来，机器人既需掌握新的协同技能，又要复用既有技能，同时避免发生“灾难性遗忘”。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 Conquer 框架，这是一个基于语义技能库的框架，将多足机器人持续协同过程建模为“检索-适应-更新”的循环。首先，为适应不同任务中变化的团队规模，我们设计了一种具有团队结构的“自我-队友-目标”（SAG）骨干网络；该网络通过显式建模每个机器人的自身状态、队友上下文信息及任务目标，支持不同数量成员构成的机器人团队。针对每个新任务，Conquer 利用执行前的信息构建任务级语义描述符，并从技能库中检索相关技能进行适应性调整。任务成功执行后，Conquer 通过提取轨迹级语义描述符并根据语义距离进行组织，从而更新技能库，进而实现技能的持续积累与跨任务知识迁移。仿真实验表明，Conquer 最终平均成功率达到 95.6%，展现出强大的前向迁移能力，且几乎未发生灾难性遗忘。基于 Unitree Go2 机器人团队的实地部署测试，进一步验证了 Conquer 在实际多足机器人协同场景中的部署可行性。
Multi-quadruped coordination has attracted increasing attention due to its enhanced payload capacity, broader contact coverage, and improved adaptability to challenging tasks. Existing methods for multi-quadruped manipulation typically focus on predefined or closed task families, often relying on multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train task-specific coordination policies. However, such methods struggle in open-ended continual learning settings, where tasks arrive sequentially and robots are expected to acquire new coordination skills while reusing previously learned ones without catastrophic forgetting. To address this challenge, we propose Conquer, a semantic skill-library framework that formulates continual multi-quadruped coordination as a retrieve-adapt-update process. First, to accommodate varying team sizes across tasks, we design a team-structured Self-Allies-Goal (SAG) backbone that supports variable-cardinality robot teams by explicitly modeling each robot's own state, teammate context, and task goal. For each incoming task, Conquer constructs a task-level semantic descriptor from pre-execution information and retrieves a relevant skill from the library for adaptation. After successful execution, Conquer updates the skill library by extracting trajectory-level semantic descriptors and organizing them according to semantic distance, thereby enabling continual skill accumulation and cross-task knowledge transfer. Simulation experiments show that Conquer achieves a final average success rate of 95.6%, demonstrating strong forward transfer and negligible catastrophic forgetting. Real-world rollouts on Unitree Go2 teams further validate the deployment feasibility of Conquer for practical multi-quadruped coordination.
SLowRL: Safe Low-Rank Adaptation for Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Legged Locomotion
SLowRL：用于弥合足式运动“仿真到现实”差距的安全低秩自适应方法
仿真器充其量只是智能体最终将在其中行动的真实世界的一个粗略、低保真的模型。在硬件上弥合这一残余差距，是“在广阔世界（big-world）中运行”这一典型场景的体现：真实环境呈现出的接触动力学、延迟和扰动，是智能体在预训练阶段未曾获得建模能力（即参数或数据）去处理的。直接在硬件上进行简单的微调风险很高——策略在改进之前可能会损坏机器人——而全参数更新则需要极长的交互时间。我们提出了 SLowRL，这是一个持续微调框架，通过两种互补的容量限制形式来应对这种“广阔世界”适应问题：(i) 在 Actor 和 Critic 网络的每一层应用秩为 1（rank-1）的 LoRA 适配器，将每一层的更新限制在其值域空间内的单一方向上（基于冻结的仿真训练策略），以及 (ii) 采用一种与任务无关的恢复策略，该策略由离散安全滤波器控制，一旦本体感知限值被突破，便将机器人拉回正常状态。在针对 Unitree Go2 四足机器人的“仿真到仿真（sim-to-sim）”及“仿真到现实（sim-to-real）”微调实验中，SLowRL 仅需全参数微调所需时间的一小部分即可达到预训练阶段的奖励水平，消除了绝大部分跌倒情况，并且在动态跳跃任务中表现与全参数基线相当甚至更优——这有力地证明了在面对“广阔世界”分布偏移时，更小的模型规模意味着更快的速度与更高的安全性。
A simulator is, at best, a coarse low-fidelity model of the real world the agent eventually has to act in. Closing this residual gap on hardware is a canonical instance of operating in a big world: the real environment exposes contact dynamics, latencies, and disturbances that the agent was never given the capacity (parameters or data) to model during pretraining. Naive on-hardware fine-tuning is risky --- the policy can damage the robot before it improves --- and full-parameter updates require prohibitive interaction time. We propose SLowRL, a continual fine-tuning framework that confronts this big-world adaptation problem with two complementary forms of capacity limitation: (i) a rank-1 LoRA adapter applied per layer to both actor and critic, restricting each layer's update to a single direction in its image space (
% of FFT's trainable parameter count) over a frozen sim-trained policy, and (ii) a task-agnostic recovery policy gated by a discrete safety filter that pulls the robot back to a nominal state whenever proprioceptive limits are violated. On sim-to-sim and sim-to-real fine-tuning of a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, SLowRL reaches the pretraining reward in
% of the wall-clock time of full fine-tuning, eliminates
%of falls, and still matches or exceeds full-parameter baselines on the dynamic jump task --- evidence that under big-world distribution shift, smaller is faster and safer.
Bayesian Optimization for Learning Nonlinear MPC in Autonomous Agent Navigation
用于自主智能体导航中非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）学习的贝叶斯优化
在动态且未知的环境中实现实时自主导航，对于移动机器人而言仍是一项根本性挑战。我们提出了一种无需构建地图的框架，该框架将反应式滚动时域规划与非线性模型预测控制（MPC）紧密结合。在每个控制周期内，系统利用激光雷达（LiDAR）数据构建基于高斯分布的占用表示，并通过A*搜索生成无碰撞轨迹；随后，利用结合了平滑Sigmoid障碍物势垒函数的CasADi/IPOPT MPC方案对轨迹进行跟踪控制。为了提高系统对参数敏感性的鲁棒性，我们采用了一种基于树结构Parzen估计器（TPE）的离线贝叶斯优化方案，针对综合导航目标确定近乎最优的控制器参数。此外，我们还利用高斯过程代理模型分析参数敏感性，并深入探究优化目标函数的特性。
该框架具有通用性，不依赖于特定机器人平台；我们首先在Gazebo仿真环境中利用Unitree Go2四足机器人对其进行了评估，随后将其部署到实体机器人上。实验结果表明，在仿真中调优的参数能有效迁移至硬件平台，且无需额外调整即可保持相当的性能。该系统在实际部署中实现了高达90.0%的导航成功率，并在各项仿真环境评估指标上取得了平均38.9%的性能提升。
Real-time autonomous navigation in dynamic, unknown environments remains a fundamental challenge for mobile robotics. We propose a map-free framework that tightly integrates reactive rolling-horizon planning with nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC). At each control cycle, a LiDAR-based Gaussian occupancy representation is constructed and used to generate collision-free trajectories via A* search, which are then tracked by a CasADi/IPOPT MPC formulation incorporating a smooth sigmoid obstacle barrier. To improve robustness to parameter sensitivity, we adopt an offline Bayesian optimization scheme based on Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE), which identifies near-optimal controller parameters with respect to a composite navigation objective. In addition, a Gaussian Process surrogate is used to analyze parameter sensitivity and provide insight into the optimization landscape.
The proposed framework is robot-agnostic and is evaluated on the Unitree Go2 quadruped in simulation using Gazebo, followed by deployment on the physical robot. Experimental results show that parameters tuned in simulation transfer effectively to hardware, maintaining comparable performance without additional tuning. The full system achieves up to a 90.0\% navigation success rate when deployed, along with a 38.9\% average improvement in the evaluation metrics across simulated environments.
Deskewed LiDAR Odometry for Quadruped Robots in Environments with Varying Elevation
面向高程变化环境的四足机器人去畸变激光雷达里程计
随着机器人技术的进步，四足机器人已经能够在具有不同海拔的复杂环境中操作，包括对传统轮式平台具有挑战性的坡道和水平变化。虽然这种地形适应性为检查、救援和探索任务带来了新的机会，但腿部运动固有的重复性影响、频繁的地面接触转变和突然的姿势变化对激光雷达测距提出了重大挑战。高频步态振动和突然的姿态变化会导致扫描内运动失真，而传统的单扭转校正无法充分抑制这种失真。此外，高程变化环境中稀疏的垂直几何约束削弱了 Z 轴可观测性，允许垂直漂移通过 Hessian 耦合破坏水平姿态估计。为了在仅 LiDAR 框架内解决这些故障模式，我们提出了一种分段恒速偏移校正方案，该方案将每次扫描划分为多个时间段，并在垂直和姿态分量上进行安全钳位，以及将 SE(3) 优化解耦为水平（x、y、偏航）和垂直（z、滚动、俯仰）阶段的两阶段 ICP，并在垂直更新中应用可观测性加权。所提出的里程计前端根据配备 Velodyne VLP-16 LiDAR 的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人收集的四个现实世界序列进行评估。实验结果表明，所有序列的绝对位姿误差 (APE) 始终低于 ICP、KISS-ICP 和 F-LOAM。垂直漂移抑制在包含斜坡的序列中最为明显，其中基线方法表现出显着的 Z 轴发散。
As robotics technology advances, quadruped robots have become capable of operating in complex environments with varying elevation, including ramps and level changes that are challenging for conventional wheeled platforms. While this terrain adaptability opens new opportunities for inspection, rescue, and exploration tasks, the repetitive impacts, frequent ground-contact transitions, and abrupt postural changes inherent to legged locomotion pose significant challenges for LiDAR odometry. High-frequency gait vibrations and abrupt attitude changes introduce intra-scan motion distortion that conventional single-twist deskewing cannot adequately suppress. In addition, sparse vertical geometric constraints in elevation-varying environments weaken Z-axis observability, allowing vertical drift to corrupt the horizontal pose estimate through Hessian coupling. To address these failure modes within a LiDAR-only framework, we propose a Piecewise-Constant Velocity deskewing scheme that partitions each scan into multiple temporal segments with safety clamping on vertical and attitude components, together with a two-stage ICP that decouples SE(3) optimization into horizontal (x, y, yaw) and vertical (z, roll, pitch) stages and applies observability-aware weighting in the vertical update. The proposed odometry front-end is evaluated on four real-world sequences collected with a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot equipped with a Velodyne VLP-16 LiDAR. Experimental results show consistently lower Absolute Pose Error (APE) than ICP, KISS-ICP, and F-LOAM across all sequences. Vertical drift suppression is most pronounced in the ramp-containing sequences, where baseline methods exhibit substantial Z-axis divergence.
SemGeoNav:A Safety-Guided Visual Navigation Approach with Semantic Reasoning and Geometric Planning
SemGeoNav：一种结合语义推理与几何规划的安全导向视觉导航方法
基于学习的视觉导航技术提升了实现语义目标的能力。然而，纯端到端模型因其“黑盒”特性，往往缺乏明确的几何约束，导致在开放环境中出现不可预测且不可靠的避障行为。相比之下，传统的几何规划方法虽能确保安全性，却难以应对高维视觉目标。为克服这些局限，我们提出了一种名为 SemGeoNav 的新型分层视觉导航框架。该框架将端到端模型的高层语义推理能力与基于几何的方法可靠的局部规划能力紧密结合，在实现稳健的视觉导航的同时，显著提升了避障性能。此外，我们引入了时序轨迹平滑机制，以确保机器人运动的连续性与稳定性。我们在真实环境中使用 Unitree Go2 四足机器人对 SemGeoNav 进行了评估。实验结果表明，SemGeoNav 优于 ViNT 和 NoMaD 等现有代表性方法，实现了更高的任务成功率和更短的导航耗时。
Learning-based visual navigation has enhanced semantic goal-reaching capabilities. However, due to their black-box nature, purely end-to-end models often lack explicit geometric constraints, leading to unpredictable and unreliable obstacle avoidance in open environments. Conversely, traditional geometric planners ensure safety but struggle with high-dimensional visual targets. To address these limitations, we propose SemGeoNav, a novel hierarchical visual navigation this http URL tightly integrates the high-level semantic reasoning of end-to-end models with the reliable local planning ability of geometry-based methods, achieving robust image-based navigation while significantly improving obstacle avoidance. Furthermore, we introduce a temporal trajectory smoothing mechanism to ensure continuous and stable robot motion. We evaluated SemGeoNav on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot in real-world environments. The results demonstrate that SemGeoNav outperforms existing representative methods, including ViNT and NoMaD, achieving higher success rates and shorter navigation times.
LoComposition: Terrain-Adaptive Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion without Gait Priors
LoComposition：无需步态先验的、适应地形且节能高效的四足运动
基于学习的四足机器人运动控制通常依赖于复杂的奖励函数设计，将任务目标、运行限制、步态偏好及地形适应性等多种因素耦合在单一优化目标中。相比之下，我们采用不同的机制分别处理这些要素：利用奖励函数定义任务目标，通过约束条件设定运行限制，利用能量最小化引导步态偏好，并结合外部感知根据地形难度调整能耗。实验表明，这些组件协同实现了高效且适应地形的运动能力，且移除任一组件都会导致特定的失效模式。我们的方法摒弃了显式的步态先验设定（如滞空时间、触地次数及足端离地高度等目标），转而依赖系统涌现出的行为特性。与采用复杂奖励函数的传统基准方法相比，我们的方法在保持相当的地形通过能力的同时，将运输成本降低了56%，并将违反运行限制的情况减少了96%。由此训练出的控制策略能够直接（零样本）迁移至搭载激光雷达（LiDAR）高程建图功能的实体Unitree Go2机器人上运行。
Learning-based quadrupedal locomotion typically relies on complex reward formulations that entangle task specification, operational limits, gait preference, and terrain adaptation within a single optimization objective. We instead treat these functions through distinct mechanisms: rewards for task specification, constraints for operational limits, energy minimization for gait preference, and exteroceptive perception for adapting energy use to terrain difficulty. We show that these components jointly enable efficient, terrain-adaptive locomotion, and that removing each component exposes a distinct failure mode. Our formulation removes explicit gait priors (including air-time, contact-count, and foot-clearance targets) in favor of emergent behavior. Compared to a conventional complex-reward baseline, our formulation achieves comparable terrain traversal while reducing cost of transport by 56% and operational-limit violations by 96%. The resulting policies transfer zero-shot to a physical Unitree Go2 using LiDAR-based elevation mapping.
FlashNav: Ultra-Fast Policy Training for Robot Navigation within 20 Seconds
FlashNav：20秒内实现机器人导航的超快速策略训练
深度强化学习在机器人导航领域展现出巨大潜力，但其在实际应用中的部署仍受限于策略训练所需的长耗时。本文提出了 FlashNav，这是一个专为基于测距（range-based）的机器人导航任务设计的超快速训练框架，该框架优先利用 GPU 算力。据我们所知，FlashNav 是首个实现秒级策略训练的基于深度强化学习（DRL）的机器人导航框架，其训练出的可部署策略耗时不到 20 秒。其核心思想是将仿真过程与导航马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）相匹配：FlashNav 保留了速度级导航的关键要素——包括占用几何信息、测距感知、目标条件控制、机器人运动动力学、碰撞处理、终止与重置机制——同时剔除了训练循环中不必要的渲染和高保真物理细节。FlashNav 基于批处理位图仿真器和完全驻留于 GPU 的训练流水线（采用 FastDSAC 学习算法）构建，能够完全在 GPU 上生成海量的并行导航转换数据。在 TurtleBot2 和 Unitree Go2 机器人上的实验表明，该框架在 RTX 5090 显卡上能在 20 秒内实现 100% 的导航成功率，且在各类桌面级 GPU 上均能保持在数十秒的训练时长内。训练所得策略可进一步迁移至室内静态及动态场景中的轮式和足式实体机器人，这证明了基于 DRL 的导航策略既能以秒级速度完成训练，又能保持有效的避障行为。
Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for robot navigation, but its practical deployment is still limited by the long wall-clock cost of policy training. This paper presents FlashNav, a GPU-first framework for ultra-fast range-based robot navigation training. To the best of our knowledge, FlashNav is the first DRL-based robot navigation framework that reaches seconds-level policy training, with the fastest deployable policy trained in less than 20 seconds. The key idea is to align simulation with the navigation MDP: FlashNav preserves the essential components for velocity-level navigation, including occupancy geometry, range sensing, goal-conditioned control, robot motion dynamics, collision handling, termination, and reset, while removing unnecessary rendering and high-fidelity physical details from the training loop. Built on a batched bitmap simulator and a fully GPU-resident training pipeline with our FastDSAC learner, FlashNav generates massive parallel navigation transitions entirely on GPU. Experiments on TurtleBot2 and Unitree Go2 show that FlashNav achieves a 100\% success-rate below 20 seconds on an RTX 5090 and remains within tens of seconds across desktop GPUs. The learned policies further transfer to physical wheeled and legged robots in static and dynamic indoor scenes, demonstrating that DRL-based navigation can be trained at seconds-level speed while preserving deployable obstacle-avoidance behavior.
MPC-Injection: Biasing Off-Policy Locomotion RL Toward Controller-Induced Behavior Basins
MPC-Injection：引导离策略运动强化学习趋向控制器诱导的行为吸引域
用于运动控制的强化学习（RL）往往会收敛到局部最优但无法实际部署的行为（例如肢体高频抖动或躯干拖地滑行），这些行为虽然能最大化累积回报，却无法形成可用的步态。我们提出了一种名为 MPC-Injection 的低开销方法，通过将模型预测控制器（MPC，求解同一马尔可夫决策过程）生成的轨迹片段插入经验回放缓冲区，引导强化学习策略向设计者期望的步态收敛。与奖励塑形（reward shaping）不同，MPC-Injection 无需重新设计任务奖励函数；与对抗式模仿学习相比，它也不需要引入判别器、运动学重定向或辅助目标函数。相反，该方法纯粹通过经验回放中的状态分布，将控制器的期望行为特征迁移给强化学习策略。通过二维仿真行走器实验以及 Go2 四足机器人的“虚实迁移”（sim-to-real）评估，我们证明了 MPC-Injection 仅需包含一两项的任务奖励，即可引导策略进入控制器期望的行为区域；其生成的步态质量可与包含二十一项经精细调优项的奖励塑形方法，以及对抗式运动先验方法相媲美，且无需后者所需的判别器和重定向开销。此外，我们还分析了注入的轨迹片段如何引导 Actor-Critic 算法的更新过程偏向控制器所访问的状态，从而使策略能够学习到纯强化学习在简单奖励函数下难以触及的行为模式。
Reinforcement learning (RL) for locomotion frequently converges to locally optimal but undeployable behaviors, such as vibrating limbs or scooting on the torso, that maximize return without producing a usable gait. We present MPC-Injection, a low-overhead method that steers RL toward a designer-preferred gait by inserting transitions into the replay buffer from a model predictive controller solving the same Markov decision process. Unlike reward shaping, MPC-Injection does not require redesigning the task reward, and unlike adversarial imitation learning, it adds no discriminator, no kinematic retargeting, and no auxiliary objective. Instead, the controller's preferred behavior is transferred to the policy purely through the replay state distribution. On a 2D walker in simulation and with sim-to-real evaluation on a Go2 quadruped, we show that MPC-Injection drives the policy into the controller's behavior basin using a one to two-term task reward, producing gaits qualitatively comparable to those of reward shaping with twenty-one tuned terms and of adversarial motion priors without their discriminator and retargeting overhead. We further analyze how the injected transitions bias actor-critic updates toward controller-visited states, allowing the policy to learn behaviors that pure RL may fail to reach under simple reward functions.
High-Load-Density Electro-Permanent Magnetic Foot with Controllable Adhesion for Quadruped Wall-Climbing Robots
面向四足爬壁机器人的高负载密度、吸附力可控电永磁足
为了实现四足机器人于铁磁性表面上的可靠攀爬运动，本文提出了一种具有可控吸附能力的高负载密度电永磁足，该足集成了具备力反馈功能的环形Halbach阵列电永磁（CHN-EPM）吸附单元及相应的磁化控制系统。凭借其三维磁路结构与磁通汇聚效应，CHN-EPM构建了分布式的并行磁通路径，提高了磁通利用率，从而降低了对气隙变化的敏感度，即便在部分接触的情况下也能保持有效的吸附力。该CHN-EPM产生的最大吸附力超过1000 N，负载自重比超过200:1。研究还开发了磁化驱动器及两级脉冲电流控制策略，用于调节励磁电流的幅值与持续时间，从而实现精确可靠的磁化操作。通过集成柔性压力传感器以获取接触力反馈，该系统能够有效监测吸附与脱离状态，确保在不确定接触条件下实现稳健的吸附切换。该系统被集成于商用四足机器人（Unitree GO2）上，验证了其在天花板及垂直墙面上的高负载吸附能力，以及在涂漆、穿孔及曲面等铁磁性表面上的稳定运动性能。
To enable reliable climbing locomotion of quadruped robots on ferromagnetic surfaces, this paper presents a high-load-density electro-permanent magnetic foot with controllable adhesion, featuring force-feedback circular Halbach-net electro-permanent magnet (CHN-EPM) adhesion units and a magnetization control system. Due to its three-dimensional magnetic circuit structure and flux-concentration effect, the CHN-EPM enables a distributed parallel magnetic flux path with enhanced flux utilization, resulting in reduced sensitivity to air-gap variations and allowing effective adhesion to be maintained even under partial contact conditions. The proposed CHN-EPM generates a maximum adhesion force exceeding 1000 N with a load-to-weight ratio over 200:1. A magnetization driver and a two-stage pulse current control strategy are developed to regulate the excitation current amplitude and duration, enabling accurate and reliable magnetization. By incorporating a flexible pressure sensor for contact force feedback, the system can effectively monitor attachment and detachment states, ensuring robust adhesion switching under uncertain contact conditions. The proposed system is integrated into a commercial quadruped robot (Unitree GO2), demonstrating high-load adhesion on ceiling and vertical-wall surfaces and stable locomotion on painted, perforated, and curved ferromagnetic surfaces.
fARfetch: Enabling Collocated AR-HRC in Large Visually Diverse Environments with VLM-Driven AR Content Adaptation
fARfetch：利用 VLM 驱动的 AR 内容自适应，在视觉环境多变的大型空间中实现协同定位 AR-HRC
增强现实（AR）技术能够通过可视化机器人的状态与意图并实现直观控制，从而提升人机共处环境下的协作效率；然而，户外等视觉环境复杂多变的大型场景，给交互操作及虚拟内容的可视认性（legibility）带来了挑战，尤其是在远距离或超出视线范围的情况下。为此，我们提出了 fARfetch——一种 AR 人机协作（AR-HRC）系统，该系统集成了以下功能：(i) AR 头显与机器人之间共享的语义环境映射，通过在 AR 中可视化检测到的地标，支持基于地标的“前往”指令；(ii) 针对共享环境的上下文感知“微缩世界”（world-in-miniature）表征，用于精细化的路径规划与设定；以及 (iii) 由视觉-语言模型驱动的 AR 视图管理机制，通过动态调整虚拟内容的颜色、尺寸和朝向，确保其在视觉环境复杂多变的大型场景中保持良好的可视认性。我们基于 Meta Quest 3 头显和 Unitree Go2 四足机器人实现了 fARfetch 系统，并针对一项真实世界中的大规模（30.5米）户外巡检任务开展了受试者内设计（within-subjects）的用户研究（N=13）。实验结果显示，与非 AR 对照组相比，使用 fARfetch 完成任务的速度显著更快（提升 66%），且在心理需求（降低 43%）、时间压力（降低 34%）和挫败感（降低 66%）方面的负荷显著降低。针对可视认性的专项问卷调查表明，fARfetch 在大型户外环境中有效地维持了虚拟内容的可视认性。
Augmented Reality (AR) can improve collocated human-robot collaboration by making robot state and intent visible and enabling intuitive control, yet large, visually diverse environments like the outdoors challenge both interaction and content legibility, especially at long distances and beyond visual line of sight. We present fARfetch, an AR-HRC system that integrates (i) shared semantic environment mapping across an AR headset and robot that visualizes detected landmarks in AR to support landmark-grounded go-to commands, (ii) a context-aware world-in-miniature representation of the shared environment for fine-grained path authoring, and (iii) vision-language-model driven AR view management that jointly adapts virtual content color, size, and orientation to maintain legibility in large visually diverse environments. We implement fARfetch with a Meta Quest 3 headset and Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, and conduct a within-subjects user study (N=13) on a real-world large-scale (30.5m) outdoor inspection task. fARfetch yielded significantly faster completion times than a non-AR baseline (66%) and significantly lower workload in mental demand (-43%), temporal demand (-34%), and frustration (-66%). A custom legibility survey indicated fARfetch effectively maintained virtual content legibility in the large outdoor environment.
MSTR-PPO: A Multi-Scale Temporal Residual PPO Controller for Freeze-Prone Indoor Navigation
MSTR-PPO：一种用于易发生“冻结”现象室内导航场景的多尺度时间残差 PPO 控制器
在受限的室内环境中，当狭窄的几何结构和移动障碍物压缩了可行的局部运动空间时，局部导航控制器可能会陷入停滞（即“冻结”现象）。这种冻结事件会触发重复的恢复行为，并导致原本有效的全局路径无法执行。本文将冻结现象视为局部控制的失效，并归因于三种可观测机制：路径视界（path horizo​​n）不足、单帧感知中的运动歧义性，以及学习到的速度指令不稳定。我们提出了 MSTR-PPO（多尺度时序残差近端策略优化），这是一种具备冻结感知能力的残差局部控制器，定义在标准的“传感器-路径-速度指令”接口之上。MSTR-PPO 并非用无约束的端到端策略取代几何控制器，而是学习针对“纯追踪”（Pure Pursuit）标称动作的有界修正量。该控制器采用了多尺度路径 Transformer 来获取近、中、远视界的路径上下文信息，利用一阶时序高通滤波器获取低成本激光雷达（LiDAR）的测距变化线索，并基于纯追踪算法实施有界残差动作。我们在包含动态障碍物的九个 Gazebo 仿真环境中评估了八种局部控制变体（所有方法共计 2,880 次试验），并通过 ROS 2（机器人操作系统 2）的 Nav2（导航 2）C++ 控制器接口部署了训练好的策略，作为具有代表性的评估架构。在两个容易发生冻结的目标环境中，MSTR-PPO 在全部 80 次评估试验中均成功到达目标，且未触发任何系统级的恢复事件；相比之下，表现最好的默认参数经典基准方法在同一子集上的成功率为 86.2%。在包含七个环境的主评估集（W1–W7）中，MSTR-PPO 取得了 91.1% 的平均成功率，且 CPU 控制周期延迟在 5 到 10 毫秒之间。压力测试揭示了其在连续曲率路径上的局限性，而在针对 Unitree Go2 机器人的初步测试中，该方法在 30 次试验中成功了 27 次。
Local navigation controllers can fail to make progress in constrained indoor environments when narrow geometry and moving obstacles compress the feasible local motion space. These freeze events trigger repeated recovery behaviors and can prevent otherwise valid global paths from being executed. This paper treats freezing as a failure of local control under three observable mechanisms: insufficient path horizon, motion ambiguity in single-frame sensing, and unstable learned velocity commands. We present MSTR-PPO (Multi-Scale Temporal Residual Proximal Policy Optimization), a freeze-aware residual local controller defined at the standard sensor--path--velocity-command interface. Rather than replacing the geometric controller with an unconstrained end-to-end policy, MSTR-PPO learns a bounded correction around a Pure Pursuit nominal action. The controller uses a Multi-Scale Path Transformer for near-, mid-, and far-horizon route context, a First-Order Temporal High-Pass Filter for low-cost light detection and ranging (LiDAR) range-change cues, and a Bounded Residual Action around Pure Pursuit. We evaluate eight local-control variants across nine Gazebo worlds with dynamic obstacles, totaling 2,880 trials across all methods, and deploy the trained policy through a Robot Operating System 2 (ROS, 2) Navigation 2 (Nav2) C++ controller interface as a representative evaluation stack. In the two target freeze-prone worlds, MSTR-PPO reaches the goal in all 80 evaluated trials and triggers no stack-level recovery events, while the best default-parameter classical baseline reaches 86.2% success on the same subset. On the main seven-world evaluation suite (W1--W7), MSTR-PPO obtains 91.1% average success and runs with 5--10, ms central processing unit (CPU) control-cycle latency. Stress tests expose a limitation on continuous-curvature paths, and a preliminary Unitree Go2 test succeeds in 27 of 30 trials.
Mixture-of-Experts RL for Fault-Tolerant Legged Locomotion
用于容错腿式运动的专家混合强化学习
用于行星探测及其他偏远环境的足式机器人，必须在面对执行器故障和复杂地形条件时，依然保持可靠的运动能力。尽管强化学习在足式机器人运动控制方面已取得显著成效，但单一的整体式策略（monolithic policies）往往难以高效地表征应对各种故障工况所需的多样化控制策略。为此，本文提出了一种故障感知模块化控制架构；该架构明确利用故障诊断信息，针对不同的执行器故障模式激活相应的专用控制专家。实验结果表明，这种基于故障条件的模块化策略在各项故障场景下的运动性能均优于同等规模的整体式策略。此外，该模块化架构即便在网络容量大幅受限的情况下，仍能保持极具竞争力的性能，这凸显了其在算力受限的机器人平台（如典型的航天应用平台）上的适用性。
Legged robots deployed in planetary exploration and other remote environments must maintain reliable locomotion despite actuator failures and challenging terrain conditions. Although reinforcement learning has achieved strong results in legged locomotion, monolithic policies can struggle to efficiently represent the diverse control strategies required to compensate for different fault conditions. In this work, we propose a fault-aware modular control architecture that explicitly leverages fault-diagnosis information to activate specialized control experts associated with distinct actuator failure modes.
