Experimental results show that explicit fault-conditioned modular policies consistently outperform monolithic policies of comparable size, achieving higher locomotion performance across failure scenarios. Moreover, the proposed modular architecture retains competitive performance even under significantly reduced network capacity, highlighting its suitability for compute-constrained robotic platforms, such as those typically employed in space applications.
OctoSense: Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal Robot Perception
OctoSense：用于多模态机器人感知的自监督学习
我们推出了 OctoSense，这是一个集成了多种传感器的开源平台，包括立体 RGB 相机、事件相机、激光雷达（LiDAR）、热成像相机、惯性测量单元（IMU）、RTK 校正的全球定位系统（GPS）以及本体感知数据（如车辆 CAN 总线数据和四足机器人关节角度）。同名的 OctoSense 数据集包含了 59 小时的时间同步驾驶数据，涵盖了不同时段和多种环境类型，其中包括传感器性能严重受限（退化）的场景。我们利用这些真实的机器人数据展示了多模态自监督学习的应用，这些数据涉及具有不同表征形式、采样频率、延迟特性和噪声水平的传感器。我们的方法采用了一种“晚期融合”（late-fusion）掩码自编码器架构：(i) 利用模态特定的 Tokenizer（标记化器）来适应各类传感器不同的时空特性；(ii) 在推理阶段缓存模态特定的 Token，以便实时处理新到达的测量数据。该架构具有以下优势：(i) 运行速度快（在 NVIDIA 5090 和 Orin NX 上计算表征的耗时分别为 6.68 毫秒和 112 毫秒）；(ii) 在光流估计、深度估计、语义分割及自身运动估计（平移、旋转和转向角）等任务上，性能优于现有的仅基于图像的基础模型；(iii) 能够在夜间或传感器数据质量较差的情况下实现稳健的预测。
We present OctoSense, an open-source sensor platform with stereo RGB and event cameras, LiDAR, a thermal camera, an inertial measurement unit, RTK-corrected global positioning system, and proprioception (CAN bus data from a car, and joint angles for a quadruped robot). The eponymous OctoSense dataset contains 59 hours of time-synchronized driving data across different types of environments at different times of the day, including situations with highly degraded sensors. We demonstrate multi-modal self-supervised learning using such real-world robotics data, where sensors have different representations, frequencies, latencies and noise. Our approach, a "late-fusion" masked autoencoder, (i) uses modality-specific tokenizers to account for different spatiotemporal characteristics of these sensors, and (ii) caches modality-specific tokens at inference time to process new measurements as they come. This architecture (i) is fast (6.68 ms and 112 ms on NVIDIA 5090 and Orin NX respectively, to compute the representation), (ii) performs better than existing image-only foundation models on tasks such as estimation of optical flow, depth, semantic segmentation, and ego-motion (translation, rotation, and steering angle), and (iii) predicts robustly at nighttime or in situations where sensory data is degraded.
Asymmetric physics enables efficient learning in quadrupedal robot swarms
非对称物理特性助力四足机器人集群实现高效学习
动物群体依靠局部协调在复杂环境中穿行，而机器人集群在物理世界中复现这一能力仍面临挑战。端到端学习为实现这种协调提供了一条途径，但将其扩展到具身集群系统却困难重重：当视觉感知、密集的机器人间交互以及涉及频繁接触的运动控制需要同时学习时，传统的基于采样的强化学习方法往往效率低下。本文展示了“非对称物理”（asymmetric physics）机制如何助力大规模四足机器人集群实现基于视觉的去中心化控制策略的高效端到端学习。在训练过程中，四足机器人在共享环境中交互：高保真但不可微的仿真器负责生成逼真的运动与接触动力学效果，而可微的代理模型则为导航和运动策略提供梯度信息。这种分离机制使得多达 512 台四足机器人能够在障碍物密布的环境中学习协同导航策略。在实际部署阶段，每台机器人仅依赖单个前向深度相机进行决策，无需显式通信、集中式规划或全局地图。这些策略展现出了良好的泛化能力，能够适应森林、桥梁、围栏、狭窄通道及迷宫等多种环境，并能实现“零样本”迁移，成功应用于五种真实场景下的六台物理四足机器人。最终形成的集群表现出了预测性避障、靠右避让、瓶颈处停顿等待以及沿墙行进等行为，证明了非对称物理机制能够有效支持四足机器人集群可扩展去中心化控制策略的训练。
Animal collectives navigate cluttered environments through local coordination, yet robot swarms still struggle to reproduce this capability in the physical world. End-to-end learning offers a route to such coordination, but scaling it to embodied swarms remains difficult: standard sampling-based reinforcement learning becomes inefficient when visual perception, dense robot-robot interaction, and contact-rich locomotion must be learned together. Here we show that asymmetric physics enables efficient end-to-end learning of vision-based, decentralized control in large swarms of quadrupedal robots. During training, quadrupeds interact in shared environments, where a high-fidelity, non-differentiable simulator generates realistic motion and contact dynamics, and differentiable surrogate models provide gradients for navigation and locomotion policies. This separation enables up to 512 quadrupeds to learn coordinated navigation policies in obstacle-rich environments. At deployment, each robot acts from a single forward-facing depth camera, without explicit communication, centralized planning, or global maps. The policies generalize across forests, bridges, enclosures, narrow passages, and mazes, and zero-shot transfer to six physical quadrupeds across five real-world scenarios. The resulting swarms exhibit predictive avoidance, right-side yielding, pausing before bottlenecks, and wall following, showing that asymmetric physics enables efficient training of scalable decentralized control policies for quadrupedal robot swarms.
Shield-Loco: Shielding Locomotion Policies with Predictive Safety Filtering
Shield-Loco：利用预测性安全滤波保护运动策略
强化学习（RL）策略虽能实现动态腿式运动，却缺乏机制来避免违反训练期间未曾遇到的安全约束；而依靠大规模离线安全学习来覆盖所有极端工况（edge cases）在实际中并不可行。现有的安全框架要么依赖无法推断全身行为的降阶模型，要么依赖会降低任务性能的保守型恢复控制器。为此，我们提出了一种预测性安全滤波器，用于对输入给 RL 策略的名义接触点位置进行事后（post-hoc）过滤。当预测到碰撞时，该方法利用全物理模型，通过基于采样的优化器异步搜索更安全的接触序列，同时利用学习到的价值函数来引导长时程回报的估计。我们设计的三个算法组件——采样接触点的几何投影、动量增强更新以及副本交换（replica-exchange）——使得在不连续的接触状态空间中进行优化变得切实可行。我们在仿真和真实世界的密集杂乱环境中对四足机器人进行了验证，结果表明该滤波器能显著减少安全违规行为，且对名义输入的偏差极小。
Reinforcement learning (RL) policies enable dynamic legged locomotion but lack mechanisms to avoid violations of safety constraints that are absent during training. Large-scale offline safe learning is impractical for covering all edge cases. Existing safety frameworks either rely on reduced-order models that cannot reason about whole-body behaviors or require conservative recovery controllers that degrade task performance. We propose a predictive safety filter that post-hoc filters the nominal contact locations fed to the RL policy. When a collision is predicted, a sampling-based optimizer asynchronously searches for safer contact sequences using a full-physics model, while a learned value function bootstraps long-horizon returns. Our three algorithmic components (geometric projection of sampled contacts, momentum-augmented updates, and replica-exchange) make the optimization tractable in a discontinuous contact landscape. We validate the filter on a quadruped robot in dense, cluttered environments, both in simulation and in the real world, showing substantial reductions in safety violations with minimal deviation from the nominal input.
QuadVerse: An Integrated Framework Aligning Visual-Physical Reality for Quadruped Simulation
QuadVerse：一种用于四足机器人仿真、对齐视觉与物理现实的集成框架
仿真在机器人学习中至关重要，但“仿真到现实”（sim-to-real）的差距仍是一个主要瓶颈。现有方法往往分别处理视觉或动力学层面的差异，却忽视了这些偏差如何在机器人状态演变过程中累积与传递。本文提出了 QuadVerse，这是一个集成框架，利用重建场景作为校准基准，以对齐视觉感知、物理交互和执行器动力学。基于采集的 RGB 视频，我们构建了受几何约束的 3D 高斯溅射（3DGS）场景，支持批量生成逼真的自车视角（ego-view）渲染图像，并提取可用于碰撞检测的语义网格。这些网格进一步支持接触校准：首先初始化空间变化的摩擦力先验，随后通过基于轨迹的后验搜索对其进行精细化调整。为了解决剩余的执行器偏差，QuadVerse 在已完成接触校准的地形上回放真实世界轨迹，从而训练一个残差动力学补偿器，以此解耦地形引起的接触误差与执行器非理想特性。实验表明，与相关基准方法相比，QuadVerse 提升了场景重建质量及运动跟踪性能。基于此基础，我们展示了稳健的零样本（zero-shot）视觉导航策略部署能力，且无需在现实世界中进行针对特定任务的试运行（rollouts）。
Simulation is central to robot learning, yet the sim-to-real gap remains a major bottleneck. Existing approaches often tackle visual or dynamic gaps separately, overlooking how these individual mismatches accumulate and propagate throughout the robot's state evolution. In this paper, we introduce QuadVerse, an integrated framework that uses reconstructed scenes as a calibration substrate for aligning visual perception, physical interaction, and actuator dynamics. From captured RGB videos, we reconstruct geometry-constrained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes that support batched photorealistic ego-view rendering and collision-ready semantic mesh extraction. The meshes further enable contact calibration by initializing spatially varying friction priors and refining them through trajectory-based posterior search. To address remaining actuator discrepancies, QuadVerse trains a residual dynamics compensator by replaying real-world trajectories on the contact-calibrated terrain, reducing the entanglement between terrain-induced contact errors and actuator non-idealities. Experiments show that QuadVerse improves reconstruction quality and locomotion tracking over relevant baselines. Leveraging this foundation, we demonstrate robust zero-shot visual-navigation policy deployment without task-specific real-world rollouts.
Affordance-Based Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Pedipulation
基于可供性的四足机器人足部操作分层强化学习
四足机器人的物体操作能力是一项亟待解决的研究挑战。尽管既往研究多侧重于底层策略学习，但任务执行仍依赖于专家预先设计的上层轨迹。若能自主选择目标物体上适宜交互的点位以及机器人适宜的基座姿态，便无需再依赖预设轨迹。本研究提出了一种三层分层强化学习（RL）框架：利用姿态“可供性”（affordance）指导导航策略，进而由导航策略驱动运动控制策略；同时，利用交互点可供性指导肢体操作策略，从而实现四足机器人以物体为中心的姿态对齐及高效的末端执行器操作规划。我们在 IsaacSim 生态系统中对该框架进行了训练，并在仿真与真实世界环境中进行了评估。我们在仿真环境的多种场景下验证了姿态可供性的有效性，并在真实世界中针对各类物体交互任务进行了测试，构建了相应的物体交互数据集。实验结果表明，该框架能够根据可供性自主识别候选姿态，并在无需人工干预的情况下，在真实世界中成功执行物体操作任务。
The object manipulation capabilities of quadruped robots is an open research challenge. While previous studies have focused on low-level policy learning, task execution still relies on expert-designed high-level trajectories. Autonomous selection of both an affordable interaction point on the target object and an affordable robot base pose removes the need for pre-designed trajectories. This study proposes a three-level hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework that utilizes pose affordances to guide the navigation policy, while the navigation policy drives the locomotion policy. In addition, the pedipulation policy is guided by interaction-point affordances, enabling object-centric pose alignment of the quadruped robot and effective end-effector manipulation planning. We train the proposed framework in the IsaacSim ecosystem and evaluate it in both simulation and real-world settings. We investigate the effectiveness of pose affordance across multiple scenarios in simulation while various object interaction tasks are validated on real-world setting forming an object-interaction dataset. The results show that the proposed framework can autonomously identify candidate poses based on their affordance and successfully execute object manipulation tasks in the real world without human guidance.
Large Language Model and Knowledge Graph-Based Intelligent Control Framework for Smart Manufacturing
基于大语言模型与知识图谱的智能制造智能控制框架
大语言模型（LLM）与机器人技术的飞速发展正在从根本上重塑制造业。然而，将LLM应用于机器人控制仍面临挑战，尤其是在理解不同物体间的空间与逻辑关系方面。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种新型工业机器人控制方案——基于LLM与知识图谱（KG）的智能体框架（LKPI）。该框架旨在利用知识图谱提供的外部知识与逻辑关系，增强机器人在复杂生产环境中的感知与决策能力。在针对山核桃加工场景的实验验证中，LKPI在动态且存在噪声干扰的环境下展现出了卓越的逻辑推理与环境适应能力。即便在存在噪声的情况下，LKPI也能利用知识图谱中存储的环境背景与关系信息，顺利完成搬运与导航任务。通过整合RGB-D相机的实时识别与深度测量数据，机器人能够根据移动目标位置的变化实时调整路径。借助物联网技术实时更新知识图谱，LLM能够利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术实现对环境的实时感知。本研究展示了LKPI框架在推理控制、动态感知及实时适应方面的能力。实验结果显示，LKPI框架的成功率达到96.67%，并成功实现了对目标物体的动态追踪。这些结果证明了LKPI在复杂工业环境中进行动态信息获取与机器人控制的能力，从而有效提升了整体任务完成率。
The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) and robotics is fundamentally reshaping the manufacturing sector. However, there are challenges for applying LLMs in robotic control, particularly in understanding the spatial and logical relationships between different objects. To address the problem, this article proposes a novel industrial robot control scheme called the LLM knowledge graph powered intelligent agent framework (LKPI). The goal is to leverage the external knowledge and logical relationships provided by knowledge graph (KG) to enhance robotic perception and decision-making in complex production environments. In experimental validation, LKPI demonstrated superior logical reasoning and environmental adaptability in a dynamic and noise-prone pecan processing case study. Even in the presence of noise, LKPI utilized environmental background information and relationship information stored in the KG to accomplish transportation and navigation. By integrating real-time recognition and depth measurement from an RGB-D camera, the robot continuously adjusts its path in response to changes in the position of moving targets. By leveraging Internet of Things technologies to continuously update the knowledge graph in real time, LLMs can achieve real-time environmental awareness through the use of retrieval-augmented generation. This research demonstrates the reasoning control capability, dynamic perception capability, and real-time adaptation capability of the LKPI framework. Experimental results show that the LKPI framework achieved a 96.67% success rate and successfully realized dynamic tracking of target objects. These results demonstrate LKPI’s capability for dynamic information acquisition and robotic control in complex industrial environments, thereby improving the overall task completion rate.
AllDayNav: Lifelong Navigation via Real-World Reinforcement Learning
AllDayNav：基于现实世界强化学习的终身导航
在动态环境中实现终身具身导航，要求机器人能够从碎片化的观测中构建持久的场景理解；然而，现有的依赖显式地图或场景图的方法往往难以在结构化环境之外实现泛化。为此，我们提出了 AllDayNav——一个终身自学习导航框架。该框架利用强化学习，将场景动态特性隐式编码进大模型的十亿级参数中，并依托一个自演进的多模态记忆系统来维护和更新视觉关键帧、语义描述及时间上下文信息，同时自主生成开放词汇指令、图像目标和结构化奖励信号。在涵盖跨房间、跨回合及跨任务场景的合成与真实环境实验中，AllDayNav 的成功率接近 100%，且在路径效率与鲁棒性方面始终优于基于地图、VLM（视觉语言模型）及 RL（强化学习）的强基线方法。这表明，基于记忆驱动的隐式强化学习可作为一种可扩展的替代方案，取代显式建图，从而实现可靠的终身导航。
Lifelong embodied navigation in dynamic environments requires robots to form persistent scene understanding from fragmentary observations, which remains difficult for existing methods that rely on explicit maps or scene graphs and struggle to generalize beyond structured settings. We propose AllDayNav, a lifelong self-learning navigation framework that implicitly encodes scene dynamics into the billion-scale parameters of a large model via reinforcement learning, powered by a self-evolving multimodal memory that maintains and updates visual keyframes, semantic descriptions, and temporal context while autonomously generating open-vocabulary instructions, image goals, and structured rewards. Experiments in both synthetic and real-world environments across cross-room, cross-episode, and cross-task scenarios show that AllDayNav achieves success rates approaching 100% and consistently surpasses strong map-based, VLM, and RL baselines in path efficiency and robustness, demonstrating implicit, memory-driven reinforcement learning as a scalable alternative to explicit mapping for reliable lifelong navigation.
VOiLA: Vectorized Online Planning with Learned Diffusion Model for POMDP Agents
VOiLA：面向 POMDP 智能体的基于学习扩散模型的向量化在线规划
在不确定性条件下进行规划是自主机器人的一项核心能力。部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）为实现这一能力提供了一个强大的框架。尽管基于POMDP的规划技术已取得显著进展，但其在现实世界问题中的应用往往受限于难以获取精确可靠的POMDP模型。本文提出了VOiLA（Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents），这是一个用于不确定性条件下在线规划的框架，能够学习与具体任务无关的POMDP模型。VOiLA利用条件扩散模型学习状态转移和观测采样器，并学习观测似然模型以支持基于粒子的信念更新。为了实现高效的在线规划，该框架将扩散采样器蒸馏为紧凑的前馈生成器，并将其与VOPP（Vectorized Online POMDP Planner，一种利用GPU并行计算能力的在线POMDP规划器）相结合。实验结果表明，这种蒸馏策略将采样成本降低了近三个数量级，使得学习到的生成式POMDP模型能够满足在线规划的实用需求。在三个基准问题上的评估显示，VOiLA在仅使用不到10%训练数据的情况下，性能与Recurrent Soft Actor-Critic（RSAC）相当甚至更优，且在未见过的环境配置上表现出更强的泛化能力。在实体机器人上的评估表明，VOiLA利用仅通过仿真数据学习到的模型生成的策略，在10次试验中均成功完成了任务。
Planning under uncertainty is an essential capability for autonomous robots. The Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) provides a powerful framework for such a capability. Although POMDP-based planning has advanced significantly, its application to real-world problems is often limited by the difficulty of obtaining faithful POMDP models. We present Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents (VOiLA), a framework that learns task-agnostic POMDP models for online planning under uncertainty. VOiLA learns transition and observation samplers using conditional diffusion models and learns observation-likelihood models for particle-based belief updates. To enable efficient online planning, the diffusion samplers are distilled into compact feedforward generators and integrated with Vectorized Online POMDP Planner (VOPP), an online POMDP planner designed to leverage GPU parallelization. Experimental results indicate the distillation strategy reduces sampling cost by up to nearly three orders of magnitude, making learned generative POMDP models practical for online planning. Evaluation of VOiLA on three benchmark problems indicate that VOiLA achieves equal or better performance than Recurrent Soft Actor Critic while using less than 10% training data, and generalizes much better to unseen environment configurations. Physical robot evaluation indicates VOiLA uses the models learned using only simulated data and generates a policy that successfully accomplish the task in 10 of 10 runs.
FT-WBC: Learning Fault-Tolerant Whole-Body Control for Legged Loco-Manipulation
FT-WBC：面向足式移动操作的容错全身控制学习
足式操作机器人结合了足式平台的移动能力与机械臂的操作能力。然而，机械臂运动引起的质心偏移和动态扰动，使得系统在执行器发生故障时更容易失稳，进而可能导致跌倒、任务失败或安全隐患。现有的容错控制方法主要侧重于移动控制，而对于容错移动操作中全身稳定性与机械臂可达性相耦合的问题，则鲜有涉及。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 FT-WBC——一种针对足式操作机器人在执行器故障情况下的鲁棒全身容错控制框架。FT-WBC 采用上、下半身解耦的策略架构，并引入了两个关键模块：故障估计器（FE）和姿态自适应模块（PAM）。FE 利用下半身的本体感知历史数据预测故障关节，而 PAM 则利用该故障信息调整由机械臂策略生成的基座姿态规划，将可能导致不稳定的姿态请求转化为安全且可执行的基座姿态指令。通过这种故障感知姿态自适应机制，FT-WBC 能够在执行器故障时生成补偿性步态，在维持全身稳定性的同时，尽可能保留机械臂的工作空间。仿真与实物实验表明，FT-WBC 在面对执行器性能衰减或锁死故障时，显著提升了系统的生存率与工作空间，并能实现向真实足式操作机器人的零样本（zero-shot）迁移。
Legged manipulators combine the mobility of legged platforms with the manipulation capability of robotic arms. However, arm-induced Center-of-Mass shifts and dynamic disturbances make the system more prone to instability under actuator failures, potentially leading to falls, task failures, or safety risks. Existing fault-tolerant control methods mainly focus on locomotion alone, leaving the coupled problem of whole-body stability and arm reachability in fault-tolerant loco-manipulation largely unaddressed. To bridge this gap, we propose FT-WBC, a fault-tolerant loco-manipulation framework for robust whole-body control of legged manipulators under actuator failures. FT-WBC adopts a decoupled upper- and lower-body policy architecture and introduces two key modules: a Fault Estimator (FE) and a Posture Adaptation Module (PAM). The FE predicts faulty joints from lower-body proprioceptive histories, while the PAM uses this fault information to adapt the base posture plan generated by the arm policy, converting potentially unstable posture requests into safe and executable base posture commands. Through this fault-aware posture adaptation mechanism, FT-WBC synthesizes compensatory gaits under actuator failures and preserves as much arm workspace as possible while maintaining whole-body stability. Simulation and real-world experiments show that FT-WBC significantly improves survival rate and workspace under weakening or locked failures, and transfers zero-shot to a real legged manipulator in the real world.
SCAN-Planner: Spatial Collision-Aware Local Planning for Route-Guided Long-Range Quadruped Navigation
SCAN-Planner：面向路径引导长距离四足机器人导航的、具备空间碰撞感知能力的局部规划方法
人们对四足机器人穿越狭窄通道、杂乱室内场景及大规模三维非结构化环境的能力提出了越来越高的要求。现有的局部规划器通常采用各向同性的几何膨胀来近似机器人形态，或依赖于平面及高程图表示，这导致机器人在狭窄空间内的运动过于保守，且难以有效处理悬空结构。本文提出了一种名为 SCAN-Planner 的框架，这是一种面向四足机器人长距离导航、具备空间碰撞感知能力的局部规划方案。该框架利用考虑偏航角（yaw）的双圆柱体足迹模型来表征细长的机器人机身，从而能够通过在膨胀后的三维占用图（occupancy map）中进行稀疏查询，实现全身碰撞评估。此外，该框架引入了一种投影 A* 搜索算法，在插值生成的贴地曲面上规划无碰撞引导路径，并通过抑制 Z 轴梯度变化，在实现水平避障的同时保持垂直方向的稳定性。为了支持大规模部署，系统采用了以机器人为中心的滑动地图机制及边界回退策略，从而提供高分辨率的局部碰撞检测，并具备从局部死胡同脱困的能力。仿真与实地实验表明，SCAN-Planner 能够在密集杂乱环境、三维非结构化场景、楼梯穿越及长距离导航任务中生成安全、平滑且高效的运动轨迹。
Quadruped robots are increasingly expected to navigate through narrow passages, cluttered indoor scenes, and large-scale 3D unstructured environments. Existing local planners commonly approximate the robot using isotropic geometric inflation or rely on planar and elevation-map representations, leading to conservative motion in tight spaces and limited reasoning about overhanging structures. This letter presents SCAN-Planner, a spatial collision-aware local planning framework for long-range quadruped navigation. A yaw-aware twin-cylinder footprint is used to model the elongated robot body, enabling whole-body collision evaluation through sparse queries in an inflated 3D occupancy map. We further introduce a projected A* search that generates collision-free guidance on an interpolated ground-following surface, with z-gradient suppression to avoid obstacles horizontally while maintaining vertical stability. For large-scale deployment, a robot-centric sliding map with boundary fallback provides high-resolution local collision checking and recovery from local dead ends. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that SCAN-Planner generates safe, smooth, and efficient trajectories in dense clutter, 3D unstructured scenes, stair traversal, and long-range navigation tasks.
SGM-SLAM: Scene Graph Matching for Data-Efficient Distributed SLAM
SGM-SLAM：面向数据高效分布式 SLAM 的场景图匹配
我们提出了一种数据高效的分布式同步定位与建图（SLAM）框架，专为配备激光雷达（LiDAR）、相机和惯性传感器的机器人团队设计。该框架利用场景图匹配来识别机器人间的观测约束。与以往依赖特征级匹配的方法不同，我们的框架是首个仅利用物体标签和质心进行场景图匹配的方案。在构建场景图时，我们融合RGB图像与激光雷达点云，生成语义分割点云层和离散的带边界物体层，并结合估计的机器人轨迹进行表征。场景图匹配过程通过与邻近机器人交换并匹配物体数据来协同完成。为了最大化通信效率，我们采用了一种多步数据交换与优化流程。我们利用仿真数据以及由足式机器人在室内外环境中采集的真实数据集，验证了该方法的有效性与高效性。
We introduce a data-efficient distributed Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) framework designed for a team of robots equipped with LiDAR, cameras, and inertial sensors. Our framework uses scene graph matching to identify inter-robot measurement constraints. Unlike prior approaches that rely on feature-level matching, our framework is the first to perform scene graph matching using only object labels and centroids. Our approach constructs a scene graph by using fused RGB-LiDAR point clouds to generate both a semantically segmented point cloud layer, and a layer of discrete bounded objects, to accompany estimated robot trajectories. Scene graph matching is performed collaboratively through exchanging and matching object data with neighboring robots. To maximize communication efficiency, we utilize a multi-step data exchange and optimization process. We demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach using both simulation and real-world datasets collected by legged robots in indoor and outdoor environments.
Speech-to-trajectory: learning intuitive verbal guidance for robot motion
语音转轨迹：学习用于机器人运动的直观口头引导
利用自然口语实现直观的机器人底层控制，对于在日常环境中部署服务机器人至关重要。然而，口头指令往往具有多变性和歧义性；若不依赖大量人工编写的规则或预定义模板，机器人很难稳定地理解并执行这些指令。本文提出了一种名为“指令语言模型”（Directive Language Model，简称 DLM）的新型语音转轨迹框架，该框架能将不受约束的口头指令直接映射为机器人的底层运动轨迹。DLM 采用行为克隆（BC）技术，基于仿真环境中的演示数据进行训练；在这些演示中，人类参与者发出语音引导并相应地控制机器人的运动。为了增强模型对不同表述方式的泛化能力，我们利用 GPT-4 进行语义增强，生成了多种含义相同但措辞各异的指令变体，并将其关联至同一轨迹标签。随后，模型采用文本条件扩散策略（text-conditioned diffusion policy）来生成符合用户意图、平滑且灵活的运动轨迹。与那些依赖提示工程（prompt engineering）且响应往往不可预测的大语言模型（LLM）方案不同，DLM 能够确保运动生成的稳定性，并具备高效的推理能力，非常适合在机器人本体上进行部署。我们在仿真环境及四足机器人上的实验结果表明，DLM 能够稳健地理解各种用户指令——包括改写、截断或隐含意图的指令——且无需依赖感知系统或符号规划。这些特性使得 DLM 非常适合用于服务机器人的自然语音控制，特别是在与未经专业训练的用户进行交互的场景中。
Enabling intuitive, low-level robot control through natural spoken language is essential for deploying service robots in everyday environments. However, verbal commands are inherently variable and often ambiguous, making it difficult for robots to consistently interpret and execute them without extensive handcrafted rules or predefined templates. In this paper, we present the directive language model (DLM), a novel speech-to-trajectory framework that directly maps unconstrained verbal instructions to low-level robot motion trajectories. DLM is trained using behavior cloning (BC) on demonstrations in simulation, where human participants issue spoken guidance and control the robot’s motion accordingly. To improve generalization across phrasings, we apply semantic augmentation via GPT-4, generating diverse paraphrases that share the same trajectory labels. A text-conditioned diffusion policy is then employed to generate smooth and flexible trajectories that align with user intent. Unlike large language model (LLM)-based approaches that require prompt engineering and often yield unpredictable responses, DLM ensures consistent motion generation with efficient inference suitable for onboard deployment. Our results, validated in both simulation and on a quadruped robot, show that DLM robustly interprets a wide range of user commands, including paraphrased, truncated, and implicit instructions, without relying on perception or symbolic planning. These capabilities make DLM well-suited for natural, speech-based control of service robots interacting with untrained users.
Redesigning Regularization for Effective Policy Smoothing
重新设计正则化以实现有效的策略平滑
本文提出了一种新颖的正则化设计，旨在有效平滑强化学习中的策略函数。尽管最初考虑的是增强“全局”Lipschitz连续性的正则化方法，但受限于平滑性与表达能力之间的权衡，其实际应用往往局限于“局部”Lipschitz连续性。然而，实践表明，原有的实现方式不仅繁琐，且平滑效果不佳，因此人们更倾向于采用更简单的实现方案。这种局限性源于理论与实现之间的脱节，而更恰当的实现方式有望改善平滑效果。为此，本文分析了导致原有实现方式效果不佳的三个原因，并提出了相应的改进措施。这种改进后的正则化方法在多种任务和算法中表现优异，既实现了平滑的运动，又提升了控制性能。此外，通过将其应用于四足机器人的“仿真到现实”（sim-to-real）强化学习任务，验证了平滑运动能够增强系统对目标速度指令突变的鲁棒性。
This paper proposes a novel regularization design to effectively smooth policy functions in reinforcement learning. While regularization that enhances ``global'' Lipschitz continuity was initially considered, it has been limited to ``local'' Lipschitz continuity due to a tradeoff between smoothness and expressiveness. However, it has become apparent that the original implementation is cumbersome and does not provide sufficient smoothing, leading to a preference for simpler implementations. This stems from a discrepancy between theory and implementation, and a more appropriate implementation can expect to facilitate smoothing. Therefore, this paper identifies three reasons why the original implementation does not function adequately and provide remedies for them. This modified regularization performs well across multiple tasks and algorithms, successfully achieving smooth motion while improving control performance. Furthermore, by applying it to sim-to-real reinforcement learning for a quadruped robot, it is demonstrated that smooth motion provides robustness against sudden changes in target velocity commands.
Safe, Real-Time Active Model Discrimination and Fault Diagnosis for Nonlinear Systems via Differentiable Reachability
基于可微可达性分析的非线性系统安全实时主动模型辨识与故障诊断
针对存在过程和测量扰动的不确定连续时间非线性系统，我们提出了一种用于主动故障诊断和模型辨识的安全实时算法。给定一组代表正常及故障模式（包括执行器和传感器故障）的候选模型，我们将问题构建为基于输出反馈的时变策略优化任务，该任务旨在：(i) 在有限时域内鲁棒地满足状态-输入安全约束；(ii) 驱动系统产生仅与单一模型相符的采样测量值，从而实现确定性诊断。为了实时求解该问题，我们利用可达状态集和输出集的区间上界近似（interval over-approximations）开发了一种可行的近似方案，并通过一个可微目标函数来表征可诊断性——该函数对不同模型的可达输出集之间的重叠进行惩罚。最终的优化问题利用 JAX 和可微可达性原语，通过基于梯度的方法在线高效求解。我们在多个高维非线性机器人系统（包括四旋翼飞行器和战斗机仿真模型、差速驱动硬件机器人以及四足机器人导航任务）中，针对传感器和执行器故障诊断（涵盖多达 11 种故障模式）对该方法进行了评估。在这些案例研究中，我们的方法能在 50 毫秒内实现可靠的模型辨识，在辨识成功率和速度方面均优于基准方法，同时提供了形式化的安全保证。
We present a safe, real-time algorithm for active fault diagnosis and model discrimination for uncertain continuous-time nonlinear systems with process and measurement disturbances. Given a finite set of candidate models representing nominal and faulty modes, including actuator and sensor faults, we formulate an output-feedback, time-varying policy optimization problem that (i) robustly enforces state-input safety constraints over a finite horizon and (ii) drives the system to produce sampled measurements consistent with at most one model, enabling deterministic diagnosis. To solve this problem in real time, we develop a tractable approximation using interval over-approximations of reachable state and output sets, and encode diagnosability via a differentiable objective that penalizes overlap between the reachable output sets of possible models. The resulting optimization is solved efficiently online with gradient-based methods using JAX and differentiable reachability primitives. We evaluate our method on sensor and actuator fault diagnosis (up to 11 fault modes) in several high-dimensional nonlinear robotic systems, including a simulated quadrotor and fighter-jet model, a hardware differential-drive robot, and quadrupedal navigation. Across these case studies, our approach achieves reliable model discrimination in under 50 ms, outperforming baselines in discrimination success rate and speed while providing formal safety guarantees.
Physics-Guided Robotic Radiation Source Localization along Arbitrary Measurement Paths in Unstructured Environments
非结构化环境中沿任意测量路径的物理引导机器人放射源定位
利用机器人估算辐射源位置是提高效率与安全性的有效途径。现有方法多侧重于规划机器人路径以实现精确估算，通常涉及向辐射源靠近；然而，靠近辐射源会增加机器人遭受辐射损伤的风险。此外，仅针对辐射源定位（RSL）设计的路径规划算法限制了机器人在放射性环境中执行任务的灵活性。本研究提出了一种用于机器人辐射源定位的自动化框架，该框架利用物理信息机器学习（PIML）模型，在未知环境中无需特定测量路径即可精确估算辐射源位置。研究为PIML设计了基于物理特性的模型张量，以处理因未知障碍物而衰减的伽马射线通量信号，并采用多模型并行计算以提升辐射源定位的鲁棒性与精度。该方法在包含不同空间尺度、辐射源类型、障碍物材质与几何形状以及机器人轨迹等多种随机场景的高保真仿真环境中，利用蒙特卡洛粒子输运技术进行了评估；同时，还在未包含于仿真评估的配置下通过物理实验进行了验证。此外，该方法在实际机器人部署中应用了持续学习技术，增强了在线机器人辐射源定位系统的实际适用性。该方法推动了机器人辐射感知技术从点状通量检测向空间智能感知的跨越。
Using robots to estimate the location of the radiation source is an effective way to improve efficiency and safety. Existing methods focus on planning the robot's path to achieve precise estimation, typically approaching the source. However, approaching the source increases the risk of radiation damage to a robot. In addition, a path-planning algorithm designed solely for radiation source localization (RSL) limits the flexibility of missions that deploy robots into radioactive environments. This study presents an automation framework for robotic RSL that leverages a physics-informed machine learning (PIML) model to precisely estimate the source location, regardless of measurement paths, in unknown environments. Physics-inspired model tensors have been designed for PIML to handle attenuated gamma-ray flux signals from unknown obstacles, and multiple models are computed in parallel to improve the robustness and precision of the RSL. The proposed method is evaluated in high-fidelity simulation environments using Monte Carlo particle transport across diverse randomized domains, including spatial scales, radiation source types, obstacle materials and geometries, and robot trajectories. The method is also validated through physical experiments on configurations that are not included in the simulation-based evaluation. The continuous learning technique is applied in real-robot deployment to enhance the practical applicability of the online robotic RSL system. The proposed method advances robot radiation perception from pointwise flux detection to spatial intelligence.
Metis: A Generalizable and Efficient World-Action Model for Autonomous Driving and Urban Navigation
Metis：一种适用于自动驾驶与城市导航的通用且高效的世界-动作模型
世界动作模型（WAMs）在自动驾驶和城市导航领域展现出了巨大潜力。现有的基于“视觉-语言-动作”模型或视频生成模型的方法存在两个主要局限：(1) 推理阶段因需要预测未来观测而导致高延迟；(2) 视频与动作建模的紧密耦合导致表征不匹配及泛化能力下降。为解决这些问题，我们提出了 Metis，这是一个将视频生成与动作预测解耦的端到端 WAM 框架。具体而言，Metis 采用了一种“Transformer 混合”（Mixture-of-Transformers）架构，利用专用专家模型分别处理视频生成和动作预测任务，从而保留了各项任务固有的分布特性。为了提高效率，我们引入了一种非对称注意力掩码（asymmetric attention mask），既支持两个专家模型的联合训练，又允许动作模型在推理阶段跳过显式的视频生成过程。这种设计确保了训练与推理的一致性，并在不牺牲规划性能的前提下显著降低了计算成本。大量实验表明，该方法在 NAVSIM（navhard 和 navtest）及 CityWalker 导航基准测试中均达到了业界领先水平，验证了其在不同任务中的泛化能力与高效性。在真实机器人上的部署进一步证实了该方法的可行性。
World action models~(WAMs) have shown great promise for autonomous driving and urban navigation. Built upon Vision-Language-Action models or video generation models, existing approaches suffer key limitations: (1) High inference latency due to future observation prediction at test time, and (2) tightly coupled video and action modeling leading to representational mismatch and degraded generalization. To address both issues, we propose Metis, an end-to-end WAM framework that decouples video generation and action prediction. Specifically, Metis employs a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture with dedicated experts for video generation and action prediction, preserving the intrinsic distributional properties of each task. To enhance efficiency, we introduce an asymmetric attention mask that enables joint training of both experts while allowing the action model to bypass explicit video generation during inference. This design ensures training-inference consistency and significantly reduces computational costs without compromising planning performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the NAVSIM navhard and navtest benchmarks and the CityWalker navigation benchmark, validating both the generalizability and efficiency across diverse tasks. Real-robot deployments further confirm the practical feasibility of our approach.
RoamFlow: Reinforcement-Aligned One-Step Action MeanFlow Policy for Image-Goal Navigation
RoamFlow：面向图像目标导航的强化对齐单步动作均值流策略
基于图像目标的导航是具身机器人领域的一项关键挑战，要求智能体仅根据目标图像所指定的地点进行导航。现有的强化学习方法通​​常将感知观测直接映射为动作，但在建模长时程依赖关系方面存在困难，往往导致生成次优的导航轨迹。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了 RoamFlow——一种利用 MeanFlow 预测平均速度场以合成轨迹的生成式导航框架，该框架实现了高效的少步生成并降低了推理延迟。此外，我们采用了一种两阶段训练策略：首先通过专家模仿学习实现稳定的模型初始化，随后利用强化学习针对特定任务对策略进行精细化调整。在 Habitat 仿真环境及真实机器人平台上的大量实验表明，RoamFlow 既能实现高效推理，又能满足实时性约束，同时保持卓越的导航性能。
Image-goal navigation is a key challenge in embodied robotics, where an agent must reach a target specified solely by a goal image. While existing reinforcement learning approaches map perceptual observations directly to actions, they struggle to model long-horizon dependencies, often leading to suboptimal trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose RoamFlow, a generative navigation framework that leverages MeanFlow to predict the average velocity field for trajectory synthesis, enabling efficient few-step generation and reducing inference latency. We further adopt a two-stage training strategy that combines expert imitation for stable initialization with reinforcement learning for task-specific policy refinement. Extensive experiments in both Habitat simulation and real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that RoamFlow achieves efficient inference while maintaining strong navigation performance under real-time constraints.
FlowDec: Temporal Conditional Flow Decorruptor for Robust Continuous Vision-Language Navigation
FlowDec：用于鲁棒连续视觉语言导航的时序条件流去噪器
连续环境中的视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）要求智能体在未见过的场景中遵循自然语言指令。尽管大模型（LM）推动了 VLN-CE 的发展，但现实世界中的视觉退化问题仍严重制约其性能——这是一个至关重要却鲜少被研究的领域性挑战。为此，我们提出了一种专为基于大模型的 VLN-CE 设计的新型图像恢复框架——时序条件流去退化器（FlowDec）。FlowDec 整合了混合时序条件策略，将生成流路径与历史上下文对齐，并采用动作质心引导滤波技术，动态评估并融合输出结果。大量实验表明，无论是在导航准确率还是生成延迟方面，FlowDec 的表现均优于现有的最先进去退化方法。我们的方法为不可预测的现实环境下的鲁棒具身导航确立了一种高效且稳健的新范式。
Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to follow natural-language instructions in unseen scenes. While Large Models (LMs) have advanced VLN-CE, their performance remains severely degraded by real-world visual corruptions, a critical yet underexplored domain constraint. We introduce Temporal Conditional Flow Decorruptor (FlowDec), a novel image restoration framework tailored for LM-based VLN-CE. FlowDec integrates a hybrid temporal conditioning strategy to align the generative flow path with historical context and employs action-centroid guided filtering to dynamically assess and integrate outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlowDec outperforms state-of-the-art decorruption methods in both navigation accuracy and generation latency. Our approach establishes a robust, efficient paradigm for resilient embodied navigation in unpredictable real-world conditions.
Toward Autonomous UGV-Based Radio-Frequency Measurement Campaigns: Tutorial and Application
迈向基于自主无人地面车辆（UGV）的射频测量任务：教程与应用
现场射频（RF）测量对于监管层面的电磁场（EMF）暴露评估及无线电覆盖特性分析至关重要。以往，这些任务主要依赖于基于离散点位测量的人工密集型勘测；此类方法空间分辨率有限，往往需要借助仿真工具进行辅助。上述局限性促使人们转向自动化且可扩展的射频测量方案。本文提出了一套利用移动机器人平台进行自主射频测量的设计准则，并阐述了其在模块化系统架构中的实现方式；该方案展示了如何整合射频感知与机器人自主导航技术，从而实现一致性强、带有地理位置信息的數據采集，并根据具体测量目标及实时无线电环境采用自适应采集策略。研究人员利用搭载专业射频测试设备的四足机器人，在私有5G独立组网（SA）环境中开展户外测量实验，对所提框架进行了验证。实验结果表明，该系统能够自主执行覆盖特性分析与EMF暴露评估任务，证明了该方法作为传统射频测量手段的一种可扩展且高效替代方案的潜力。
In-situ RF measurements are essential for regulatory Electromagnetic Field (EMF) exposure assessment and radio coverage characterization. These tasks have historically relied on labor-intensive surveys based on discrete spot measurements, which provide limited spatial resolution and, therefore, often require support from simulation tools. These limitations call for a shift toward automated and scalable RF measurement campaigns. This paper formalizes a set of design guidelines for autonomous RF measurement campaigns using mobile robotic platforms and illustrates their implementation within a modular system architecture, showing how to integrate RF sensing and autonomous robotic navigation to enable consistent, geo-referenced data collection and adaptive acquisition strategies tailored to specific measurement objectives and driven by observed radio conditions. The proposed framework is validated through an outdoor measurement campaign on a private 5G Standalone network using a quadruped robot equipped with professional RF instrumentation. Experimental results show that the system supports the autonomous execution of measurement missions for both coverage characterization and EMF exposure assessment, demonstrating the potential of the proposed approach as a scalable and effective alternative to traditional RF measurement practices.
EffiNav: Fusing Depth and Vision-Language for Efficient Object Goal Navigation
EffiNav：融合深度与视觉-语言信息的高效物体目标导航
在探索未知环境的同时定位目标物体，是自主智能体的一项基本能力，其应用场景涵盖了从搜救行动到野外作业机器人等多个领域。物体目标导航（ObjNav）正是此类任务的一种简化形式。在 ObjNav 任务中，成功抵达目标物体是衡量性能的基本指标；然而，导航轨迹的效率同样至关重要，因为它反映了智能体探索策略的智能程度，并决定了后续任务可用的时间余量。在未知环境中，实现高效导航的关键在于决策下一步的探索方向。尽管许多既有研究致力于解决这一核心挑战，并在特定场景下取得了显著成效，但近期的基于训练的模型和非训练框架仍分别面临泛化能力不足和效率低下的问题；在极端情况下，这些问题可能导致智能体对已访问区域进行过度探索，或产生冗余的往返移动。我们在 Habitat Matterport 3D (HM3D) 和 Open-Vocabulary Object goal Navigation (OVON) 这两个广泛使用的仿真基准上评估了 EffiNav，并进一步在真实世界的物理机器人上验证了其有效性。我们针对海量仿真实验回合进行了失效分析。此外，仅需极少量的修改，我们便将 EffiNav 扩展到了 GOAT-BENCH 数据集上的记忆增强型 ObjNav 任务中，从而展示了其超越标准 ObjNav 设定场景的适应能力。在成功率（SR）和路径长度加权成功率（SPL）这两项标准指标上，EffiNav 的表现均持平或优于近期的基准方法，充分体现了其高效性、鲁棒性及实际应用价值。鉴于两个数据集侧重点各异，实验结果表明，该框架在实现高效 ObjNav 方面展现出了更佳的平衡性与泛化能力。
To locate a target object while exploring the unknown environment is a fundamental capability for autonomous agents, with applications ranging from search-and-rescue to field robots. A simplified version of such task is Object Goal Navigation (ObjNav). In ObjNav, successful arrival at the target object provides a basic measure of performance; however, the efficiency of the navigation trajectory is equally important, as it indicates how intelligently the agent explores and how much time remains for subsequent tasks. In unknown environments, the key to efficient navigation lies in deciding where to explore next. While many prior works aim to address this core challenge and achieved promising performance in certain settings, recent training-based models and non-training frameworks still suffer from generalization and efficiency issues respectively, which in the worst cases can lead to excessive exploration of already-visited areas or redundant back-and-forth motion. We evaluate EffiNav on two widely used simulation benchmarks Habitat Matterport 3D (HM3D) and Open-Vocabulary Object goal Navigation (OVON), and further validate its effectiveness on physical robots in real-world settings. We conduct failure analysis on massive simulation episodes. With minimal modification, we also extend EffiNav to a memory-augmented ObjNav task on the GOAT-BENCH dataset, demonstrating its adaptability beyond standard ObjNav settings. Across two standard metrics--Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL), EffiNav matches or outperforms recent baselines, reflecting its efficiency, robustness, and practical applicability. Recognizing the different emphases of the two datasets, the performances reveals this framework is more balanced and generalizable for efficient ObjNav.
Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
Qwen-RobotNav 技术报告：专为智能体导航系统设计的可扩展导航模型
智能体导航系统需要一种基础导航模型，其观测策略能够在推理阶段进行外部重配置；这是因为指令遵循、物体搜索、目标追踪和自动驾驶虽然共享相同的感知-规划主干网络，但对视觉流的处理策略却截然不同。我们提出了 Qwen-RobotNav，这是一个可扩展的导航模型，通过一个包含两个互补维度的参数化接口来解决上述问题：一是用于选择导航行为的多种任务模式，二是用于控制视觉历史编码方式的可调观测参数（如 Token 预算、各摄像头的权重）。通过在训练阶段对所有参数进行随机化处理，Qwen-RobotNav 能够稳健地适应推理阶段的各种配置，且无需对模型主干架构进行任何修改。我们在 1560 万个样本上训练了 Qwen-RobotNav；与视觉-语言数据的联合训练有效避免了仅使用轨迹数据训练时常出现的“退化为反应式动作序列映射器”的问题。该参数化接口还使 Qwen-RobotNav 成为构建智能体系统的理想组件：在长程任务场景中，上层规划器可将目标分解为子任务，并在任务执行过程中动态切换 Qwen-RobotNav 的任务模式与上下文策略，从而通过重复调用同一模型来组合出复杂的行为。大量实验表明，Qwen-RobotNav 在各项主流导航基准测试中均刷新了最佳性能记录。该模型在参数量从 20 亿（2B）扩展至 80 亿（8B）的过程中表现出良好的扩展性；联合多任务训练构建了一个共享的空间规划基础，实现了跨任务类别的能力迁移，并在多种环境下的真实机器人应用中展现出了强大的零样本泛化能力。
Agentic navigation systems require a base navigation model whose observation strategy can be externally reconfigured at inference time, because instruction following, object search, target tracking, and autonomous driving share the same perception-planning backbone yet demand fundamentally different strategies for consuming the visual stream. We present Qwen-RobotNav, a scalable navigation model built on Qwen-RobotNav that addresses it through a parameterised interface with two complementary dimensions: multiple task modes that select the navigation behaviour, and controllable observation parameters (e.g., token budget, per-camera weights) that govern how visual history is encoded. With training-time randomization over all parameters, Qwen-RobotNav is robust to any inference-time configuration requiring zero architectural modification to the Qwen-RobotNav backbone. We train Qwen-RobotNav on 15.6M samples; co-training with vision-language data prevents the collapse into reactive action-sequence mappers observed in trajectory-only training. The parameterised interface also makes Qwen-RobotNav a natural building block for agentic systems: for long-horizon scenarios, an upper-level planner decomposes goals into sub-tasks and dynamically switches Qwen-RobotNav's task mode and context strategy mid-episode, composing complex behaviours from repeated calls to the same model. Extensive experiments show that Qwen-RobotNav sets new state-of-the-art results across major navigation benchmarks. The model exhibits favourable scaling from 2B to 8B parameters, with joint multi-task training developing a shared spatial-planning substrate that transfers across task families, and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalisation to real-world robots across diverse environments.
WaveForward: An Omnidirectional Passive Wheeled Quadruped Robot with Casters
Wave Forward：一款采用万向轮的全向被动轮式四足机器人
轮腿式机器人兼具复杂地形下的灵活机动性与高能效特性，非常适合长距离运输任务。传统的轮腿式机器人因集成轮式组件，往往需要专门的硬件与电气设计。为此，我们提出了一种新型低成本被动轮腿式机器人，其每条腿均配备标准万向轮，从而实现全向移动能力。该机器人的控制方案采用非对称 Actor-Critic 架构，能够利用被动万向轮角度及速度等特权信息。我们基于速度指令开发了一种万向轮基座姿态调整策略，利用主动关节改变基座轴线姿态，进而调节万向轮的推进方向。此外，我们还实现了多种推进模式，通过产生不同程度的万向轮扭转振荡将其转化为推进力。通过绕桩测试与模式切换实验，结果表明该被动轮式四足机器人不仅具备灵活的全向移动能力，且相比纯腿式运动，其运输成本（COT）降低了高达 89.1%。
Wheeled-legged robots possess both agile mobility for traversing complex terrains and high efficiency, making them suitable for long-distance transportation applications. Conventional actuated wheeled robots require specialized hardware and electrical design due to the incorporation of wheel components. We propose a novel and low-cost passive wheeled legged robot equipped with standard casters on each leg to obtain omnidirectional mobility. The control method employs an asymmetric actor-critic structure, enabling the utilization of the privileged information of the passive caster's angles and velocities. We develop a caster base posture adjustment strategy based on velocity commands, utilizing actuated joints to modify the caster base joint axis posture and thereby adjust the propulsion direction of the casters. Moreover, we implemented multiple propulsion modes to achieve varying degrees of caster twisting oscillation, converting these into propulsive force. We conducted a slalom test and mode switch experience, which shows the passive wheeled quadruped could achieve omnidirectional movement versatility, and reduce the cost of transport (COT) by up to 89.1% with respect to legged motion.
Learning Contact Representation for Leg Odometry
学习用于腿部里程计的接触表征
足式机器人的里程计估算依赖于这样一个假设：在支撑相期间，足部相对于世界坐标系的速度保持为零。由于机体速度的反馈信息源自足部的运动学串联链，因此准确检测腿部运动相位便成了一个关键子问题。许多研究采用安装在足端的地面反作用力传感器来进行相位分类，但并非所有足式机器人都能配备此类传感器。此外，当足部与地面保持接触时，这些传感器往往无法响应某些未被纳入考量的干扰（例如打滑）。本研究提出了一种用于接触检测的自监督表征学习框架，该框架仅利用关节编码器这一标准传感器配置，无需依赖额外的力传感器。我们利用学习到的表征，以概率方式对支撑相和摆动相进行建模。实验结果证实了所提出的自监督接触检测器的有效性。与需要增加传感器配置及进行数据标注的监督学习方法，以及基准概率方法相比，我们的框架表现出了更优越的性能。此外，我们已将相关代码向公众开源。
The estimation of odometry in legged robots depends on the assumption that the velocity of the foot with respect to the world remains zero during the stance phase. Feedback for the main body velocity is derived from the kinematic serial chain of the feet making accurate leg phase detection is a critical subproblem. A considerable number of studies employ ground reaction force sensors mounted at the tip of the foot to classify, yet these sensors may not be universally available for all legged robots. Additionally, these sensors are often unresponsive to unaccounted disturbances, such as slippage, while the foot remains in contact with the ground. In this study, we propose a self-supervised representation learning framework for contact detection that utilizes the standard sensor set of joint encoders without reliance on force sensor augmentations. We employ learned representations to model the stance and swing phases probabilistically. The experimental results obtained confirm the efficacy of the proposed self-supervised contact detector. Our framework exhibited superior performance in comparison to supervised methods which necessitate sensor set augmentation and labeling, as well as baseline probabilistic approaches. Additionally, we make our code available to the public.
X-Morph: Human Motion Priors for Scalable Robot Learning Across Morphologies
X-Morph：支持跨形态可扩展机器人学习的人体运动先验
人形机器人行为模型的近期进展在很大程度上得益于海量的人类动作数据，然而，对于四足、六足及带机械臂四足机器人等非人形腿式机器人而言，类似的动作数据却十分匮乏。一种极具前景的替代方案是跨形态复用人类动作；然而，直接进行动作重定向（retargeting）往往会产生视觉上合理但物理上不一致，或在机器人动力学约束下难以跟踪的动作。为此，我们提出了 X-Morph——一套将人类动作转化为适用于多种非人形腿式机器人形态的可部署运动及“移动-操作”（loco-manipulation）策略的流程。该流程包含一个跨形态重定向阶段，将人类动作转化为运动学上合理且保留了动作意图的机器人参考轨迹；随后，利用特权强化学习（privileged RL）策略对这些轨迹进行跟踪，并将其蒸馏为因果学生策略。我们在三种形态各异的平台上对 X-Morph 进行了评估：四足机器人、六足机器人以及配备机械臂的四足机器人。所得策略不仅能跟踪各种重定向动作，还能泛化至未见过的人类动作，并支持包括基于视频的遥操作、基于行为先验的控制以及文本条件动作生成在内的下游应用。这些结果表明，大规模人类动作数据可作为学习广泛且可复用行为先验的基础，从而惠及人形机器人以外的各类机器人。
Recent progress in humanoid behavior models has been driven in large part by abundant human motion data, but comparable motion data is scarce for non-humanoid legged robots such as quadrupeds, hexapods, and quadruped manipulators. A promising alternative is to repurpose human motion across embodiments; however, direct retargeting often produces motions that are visually plausible yet physically inconsistent or difficult to track under robot dynamics. We present X-Morph, a human-motion-to-robot-behavior pipeline that converts human motion into deployable locomotion and loco-manipulation policies for diverse non-humanoid legged morphologies. A cross-morphology retargeting stage converts human motions into kinematically plausible, intent-preserving robot references, which are then tracked by a privileged RL policy and distilled into a causal student policy. We evaluate X-Morph on three morphologically distinct platforms: a quadruped, a hexapod, and a quadruped equipped with a manipulator. The resulting policies track diverse retargeted motions, generalize to unseen human motions, and support downstream use cases including video-based teleoperation, behavior-prior control, and text-conditioned motion generation. These results suggest that large-scale human motion can serve as a substrate for learning broad, reusable behavior priors beyond humanoid robots.
From Seeing to Experiencing: Scaling Navigation Foundation Models with Reinforcement Learning
从视觉感知到具身体验：利用强化学习扩展导航基础模型
基于海量互联网级数据训练的导航基础大模型，使得智能体能够跨越多样化的环境与身体形态实现泛化。然而，这些仅在离线数据上训练的模型通常缺乏推理其动作后果或通过反事实理解（Counterfactual understanding）进行自适应的能力。因此，在避开障碍物和移动行人等交互性与安全性至关重要的真实世界城市导航中，它们面临着巨大的局限性。
为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了“视到验”（Seeing-to-Experiencing, S2E）学习框架，利用强化学习扩展导航基础模型的性能。S2E 将离线视频预训练的优势与强化学习后训练（Post-training）相结合，在保留从大规模真实世界视频中获得的泛化能力的同时，通过仿真环境中的强化学习增强其交互能力。
具体而言，我们引入了两项创新：1）一种用于离线预训练的锚点引导分布匹配（Anchor-Guided Distribution Matching）策略，通过基于锚点的监督稳定学习过程并建模多样化的运动模式；2）一种用于强化学习的残差注意力模块（Residual-Attention Module），能够在不抹去模型预训练知识的前提下，从仿真环境中获取反应性行为。
此外，我们构建了一个全面的端到端评估基准 NavBench-GS，该基准基于集成物理交互的真实世界场景的高保真 3D 高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）重建而打造，能够系统化地评估导航基础模型的泛化性与安全性。
Navigation foundation models trained on massive web-scale data enable agents to generalize across diverse environments and embodiments. However, these models, which are trained solely on offline data, often lack the capacity to reason about the consequences of their actions or adapt through counterfactual understanding. They thus face significant limitations in the real-world urban navigation where interactive and safe behaviors, such as avoiding obstacles and moving pedestrians, are critical. To tackle these challenges, we introduce the Seeing-to-Experiencing (S2E) learning framework to scale the capability of navigation foundation models with reinforcement learning. S2E combines the strengths of pre-training on offline videos and post-training through reinforcement learning. It maintains the model's generalizability acquired from large-scale real-world videos while enhancing its interactivity through reinforcement learning in simulation environments. Specifically, we introduce two innovations: 1) an Anchor-Guided Distribution Matching strategy for offline pretraining, which stabilizes learning and models diverse motion patterns through anchor-based supervision; and 2) a Residual-Attention Module for reinforcement learning, which obtains reactive behaviors from simulation environments without erasing the model’s pretrained knowledge. Moreover, we establish a comprehensive end-to-end evaluation benchmark, NavBench-GS, built on photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions of real-world scenes that incorporate physical interactions. It can systematically assess the generalizability and safety of navigation foundation models.
Beyond Transformers: Linear Attention Policy for Open-Vocabulary Object Goal Navigation
超越 Transformer：面向开放词汇目标物体导航的线性注意力策略
开放词汇目标导航（Open-Vocabulary Object Goal Navigation, OVON）要求智能体在部分可观测性下运行，因此有效的内部状态更新对导航性能至关重要。这一更新过程通常由策略网络实现，近期的方法多采用基于 Transformer 的骨干网络，在上下文窗口上使用自注意力机制（Self-attention）来整合时序信息。然而，我们的控制变量实验表明，基于 Transformer 的策略性能并未随着上下文长度的增加而提升，这引发了对自注意力机制是否适合导航中状态整合的质疑。
为此，我们提出了基于线性注意力的导航（Linear Attention-based Navigation, LANav），该方法采用线性注意力（Linear Attention, LA）作为策略骨干网络，以维持结构化的状态更新，而非在上下文窗口上执行自注意力。在相同设定下评估的多种 LA 变体中，LANav 均持续优于基于 Transformer 的基线模型。性能随着状态更新机制变得更加结构化和受调控而得到提升，凸显了状态更新设计的重要性。
为了进一步提高状态更新的有效性，我们引入了加权状态扩展线性注意力（Weighted State-Expansion Linear Attention, WSLA），它将每个注意力头的状态扩展为多个子状态，并使用可学习的加权读出（Weighted readout）来聚合扩展后的子状态。装备 WSLA 的 LANav 在 HM3D-OVON 基准上实现了 36.4% 的平均成功率（SR），在宏观平均成功率上超越基于 Transformer 的同行 6.3 个百分点，同时保持了高效的计算效率。按距离分层的实验结果表明，在长距离 Episode 中增益更为显著，而 HSSD 迁移与微调则展示了对不同场景分布的鲁棒性。在宇树（Unitree）Go2 机器人的真实世界部署中，LANav 在 50 次实验中取得了 82% 的成功率，进一步验证了其工程可行性与仿真到真实世界（Sim-to-Real）的迁移能力。
Open-Vocabulary Object Goal Navigation (OVON) requires agents to operate under partial observability, making effective internal state updates critical for navigation performance. This update is implemented by the policy network, where recent approaches adopt Transformer-based backbones with self-attention over a context window to integrate temporal information. However, our controlled experiments show that performance does not scale with context length under Transformer-based policies, questioning the suitability of self-attention for state integration in navigation. To this end, we propose Linear Attention-based Navigation (LANav), which adopts linear attention (LA) as the policy backbone to maintain a structured state update rather than self-attention over the context window. Across multiple LA variants evaluated under identical settings, LANav consistently outperforms Transformer-based baselines. Performance improves as state update mechanisms become more structured and regulated, highlighting the importance of state update design. To improve state update effectiveness, we introduce Weighted State-Expansion Linear Attention (WSLA), which expands each attention head's state into multiple sub-states and uses learnable weighted readout to aggregate expanded sub-states. Equipped with WSLA, LANav achieves 36.4% average success rate (SR) on HM3D-OVON, outperforming Transformer-based counterparts by 6.3 percentage points in macro-averaged SR, while maintaining computational efficiency. Distance-stratified results show larger gains in long-distance episodes, while HSSD transfer and fine-tuning demonstrate robustness across scene distributions. Real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2 further achieves an 82% success rate over 50 trials, supporting the practical feasibility and sim-to-real transfer of LANav.
Empowering Multi-Robot Cooperation via Sequential World Models
利用序列化世界模型赋能多机器人协作
基于模型的强化学习（Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, MBRL）凭借其高样本效率与规划能力，在机器人领域取得了显著成功。然而，由于联合动力学（Joint dynamics）的复杂性，将 MBRL 拓展至物理多机器人协同依然面临巨大挑战。
为了解决这一难题，我们提出了序列化世界模型（Sequential World Model, SeqWM）——一套将序列化范式（Sequential paradigm）融合至多机器人 MBRL 中的创新框架。SeqWM 采用独立的、自回归的智能体级世界模型来表征联合动力学；其中，每个智能体均基于其前序智能体的预测，生成自身的未来轨迹并规划其动作。这一设计降低了建模复杂度，并通过显式的意图共享（Intention sharing）催生出了高级协同行为。
在 Bi-DexHands（双双手灵巧操作）和 Multi-Quadruped（多四足机器人）环境上的实验表明，SeqWM 在整体性能与样本效率方面均优于现有的 SOTA（State-of-the-art）基于模型和无模型（Model-free）基线，同时展现出了诸如预测性自适应、时序对齐以及角色分工等高级协同行为。此外，SeqWM 已成功部署于物理四足机器人硬件上，验证了其在真实世界多机器人系统中的有效性。
Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable success in robotics due to its high sample efficiency and planning capability. However, extending MBRL to physical multi-robot cooperation remains challenging due to the complexity of joint dynamics. To address this challenge, we propose the Sequential World Model (SeqWM), a novel framework that integrates the sequential paradigm into multi-robot MBRL. SeqWM employs independent, autoregressive agent-wise world models to represent joint dynamics, where each agent generates its future trajectory and plans its actions based on the predictions of its predecessors. This design lowers modeling complexity and enables the emergence of advanced cooperative behaviors through explicit intention sharing. Experiments on Bi-DexHands and Multi-Quadruped demonstrate that SeqWM outperforms existing state-of-the-art model-based and model-free baselines in both overall performance and sample efficiency, while exhibiting advanced cooperative behaviors such as predictive adaptation, temporal alignment, and role division. Furthermore, SeqWM has been successfully deployed on physical quadruped robots, validating its effectiveness in real-world multi-robot systems. Demos and code are available at: https://github.com/zhaozijie2022/seqwm
LocalNav: Distilling Frontier VLMs and Embodied RL for On-Device Object Goal Navigation
LocalNav：通过蒸馏前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）与具身强化学习（RL），实现端侧物体目标导航
视觉语言模型（VLMs）已作为一种强大的工具涌现于机器人领域，能够实现结合语言上下文的环境感知，并作为开放词汇任务（如 ObjectNav）的催化剂。然而，其庞大的计算资源占用通常将其限制在云端运行，阻碍了在资源受限的机器人上进行本地部署以实现低延迟推理。
为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种蒸馏策略，将复杂空间-语义推理能力从大型前沿模型转移到一个轻量级的 4B 参数本地 VLM 中，以便在嵌入式 GPU 设备（如 Jetson Orin）上进行边缘执行。我们首先基于 Claude Sonnet 4.6 构建了一个处于 SOTA 水平的场景图（Scene Graph, SG）流水线，在 HM3D OVON 基准测试上取得了 39.7% 的成功率（SR）。随后，我们证明仅使用 500 条前沿模型的推理轨迹对 Qwen3.5-4B 进行微调，即可有效赋予其导航能力，取得 34.5% 的成功率，大幅缩小了与大型云端模型性能的差距。
最后，我们引入了带有 Token 生成（TG）正则化的 E-RLVR，在将智能体与其任务紧密接地（Grounding）的同时，压缩用于物理部署的输出序列长度。这种下游优化将 TG 开销降低了 72.1%，延迟降低了 71.8%。结合量化技术，这种联合策略在没有明显牺牲性能的前提下，将整体推理延迟累计降低了 82.8%，为移动机器人上本地、低延迟的 VLM 执行提供了一种可行的范式。
Vision Language Models (VLMs) have emerged in the robotic domain as a powerful tool that enables environmental perception with language context, serving as a catalyst for open-vocabulary tasks like ObjectNav. Yet, their computational footprint typically confines them to cloud execution, hindering low-latency inference with local deployment on resource-constrained robots. To address this challenge, we present a distillation strategy that transfers complex spatial-semantic reasoning from large frontier models into a lightweight, 4B-parameter local VLM for edge execution on embedded GPU devices (e.g., Jetson Orin). We first establish a State of the Art (SotA), Scene Graph (SG)-based pipeline using Claude Sonnet 4.6, achieving a 39.7% Success Rate (SR) on the HM3D OVON benchmark. We then demonstrate that fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 500 frontier reasoning traces effectively enables navigation capabilities, yielding a SR of 34.5%, narrowing the gap to the performance of large cloud models. Finally, we introduce E-RLVR with Token Generation (TG) regularization to compress output sequence lengths for physical deployment while grounding the agent in its task. This downstream optimization reduces TG overhead by 72.1% and latency by 71.8%. Combined with quantization, this joint strategy yields a cumulative 82.8% reduction in overall inference latency without significantly sacrificing performance, presenting a viable paradigm for local, low-latency VLM execution on mobile robots.
Joint On-and-Off Policy Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
面向视觉-语言导航的联合“在线-离线”策略学习
视觉-语言导航（Vision-and-Language Navigation, VLN）要求具身智能体遵循自然语言指令在物理世界中进行导航。视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展推动了基于 VLM 的 VLN 方法的发展，目前主要存在两种主流范式：1）在专家示范上进行模仿学习（Imitation Learning, IL），随后利用数据集聚合（DAgger）算法增强错误恢复能力；2）由可验证奖励驱动的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL），用以增强推理与探索能力。
一个显著的空白在于，这两类截然不同的范式之间缺乏融合。本文提出了 JOP-VLN——一套全新的 VLN 框架，该框架在一个三阶段训练流水线中协同结合了离策略（Off-policy）模仿学习与同策略（On-policy）探索。
首先，在专家示范上应用模仿学习以获取基础导航技能。随后，利用 DAgger 算法生成启发式探索轨迹，并将其用于模仿学习以提升错误恢复能力。最后，实现了一个同/离策略联合学习框架，其具备高熵轨迹采样以提高 RL 训练效率，以及错误修正优先的轨迹排序策略以实现有效的错误纠正。大量实验证明了 JOP-VLN 的有效性，其在 VLN-CE R2R 和 RxR 基准测试上分别取得了 69.9% 和 68.0% 的成功率，在 R2R 上创下了全新的 SOTA（State-of-the-art）。
Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) necessitates an embodied agent to navigate in the physical world by adhering to natural language instructions. Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLM) have propelled the development of VLM-based VLN methods with two predominant paradigms: (1) imitation learning (IL) on expert demonstrations, followed by the Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) algorithm to bolster error recovery capabilities; (2) reinforcement learning (RL) driven by verifiable rewards to enhance reasoning and exploration. A notable gap is the absence of integration between these two distinct paradigms. This paper introduces JOP-VLN, a novel VLN framework that synergistically combines off-policy imitation learning and on-policy exploration within a three-stage training pipeline. Initially, IL is employed on expert demonstrations to acquire basic navigation skills. Subsequently, the DAgger algorithm is utilized to generate heuristic exploration trajectories, which are then used for imitation learning to improve error recovery capabilities. Finally, a joint on-and-off policy learning framework is implemented, featuring high-entropy trajectory sampling to enhance RL training efficiency and an error-correction-prioritized trajectory sorting strategy for effective error correction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of JOP-VLN, achieving success rates of 69.9% and 68.0% on the VLN-CE R2R and RxR benchmarks, respectively, setting a new state-of-the-art on R2R.
Unleashing Infinite Motion: Scaling Expressive Quadrupedal Motion via Generative Video Priors
释放无限运动缩放：利用生成式视频先验实现富有表现力的四足运动
四足机器人已经实现了卓越的移动能力（Locomotion），然而其行为库仍然局限于少数几种步态，这与人们长期设想的具有丰富表现力、陪伴型的机器人形象相去甚远。尝试引入人形机器人领域大规模运动数据配方的做法继承了一个隐性假设：即机器人运动必须首先通过动物身体进行传递，这使得数据收集依赖于合作的动物，重构过程在跨物种时极其脆弱，且重定向（Retargeting）在不兼容的形态之间表现为不适定问题（Ill-posed）。
为此，我们提出了 Uni-Mo——一个全自动流水线，通过将数据匮乏重构为一个生成问题，彻底将“动物”排除在循环之外：由大语言模型（LLM）提出运动提示词（Motion prompts），视频扩散模型合成相应的机器人行为，随后生成的视频被提升（Lifted）为 3D 参考轨迹，用于训练并部署于真实宇树（Unitree）Go2 机器人上的跟踪策略。
为了使朴素漂移（Naively-drifting）的生成视频能够被可靠提取，我们引入了身份一致性损失（Identity Consistency Loss），该损失在帧间强制执行外观连贯性。我们在此链接下开源了由此生成的 Quad-Imaginarium 数据集，该数据集包含 7,488 个附带语言标注的四足机器人运动（共 18.5 小时），涵盖杂技与表演性行为。我们在真实宇树 Go2 机器人上对随机抽样的 392 个运动进行了验证，取得了 96.7% 的部署成功率；同时，在仿真环境中对整个数据集的测试达到了 97.6% 的成功率。
Quadruped robots have achieved remarkable locomotion, yet their behavioral repertoire remains confined to a few gaits--far from the expressive, companion-like presence long envisioned for them. Attempts to import the humanoid recipe of large-scale motion data have inherited one tacit assumption: that robot motion must first pass through an animal body, making data collection dependent on cooperative animals, reconstruction fragile across species, and retargeting ill-posed across incompatible morphologies. We propose Uni-Mo, a fully automated pipeline that removes the animal from the loop by reframing data scarcity as a generation problem: an LLM proposes motion prompts, a video diffusion model synthesizes the corresponding robot behaviors, and the generated videos are lifted into 3D reference trajectories used to train tracking policies deployed on a real Unitree Go2. To make naively-drifting generations reliably extractable, we introduce an Identity Consistency Loss that enforces appearance coherence across frames. We release Quad-Imaginarium at this https URL, the resulting open-source dataset of 7,488 language-annotated quadruped motions (18.5 hours) spanning acrobatic and performative behaviors. We validate 392 randomly sampled motions on a real Unitree Go2 with a 96.7% deployment success rate, complemented by a 97.6% success rate across the full dataset in simulation.
From Language to Navigation Goals: A Vision-Language Approach for Semantic Navigation of Mobile Robots Using RGB-D Perception
从语言到导航目标：一种利用 RGB-D 感知的移动机器人语义导航视觉-语言方法
自然语言交互为非专业用户与机器人平台进行沟通提供了一种直观的方式。然而，将用户请求转化为可执行的导航动作仍是一项具备挑战性的任务，这需要集成语言理解、环境感知以及自主导航能力。本文提出了一套语言驱动的导航框架，该框架使移动机器人能够理解自然语言形式的用户请求以将机器人移动至目的地，并自主向其导航。
该框架由模块化的 ROS 2 组件构成，这些组件相互协作，将自然语言指令转化为导航动作。当接收到涉及环境中目标的自然语言请求时（例如“前往邮箱”），系统会识别被引用的物体，利用 RGB-D 数据估计其位置，并生成导航目标点，随后通过 ROS 2 Nav2 导航堆栈执行该目标。基于 ROS 2 的实现方案促进了跨不同机器人平台的便携性与可移植性，仅需配置对应的 Topic 和 Service 即可完成适配。
我们在仿真与真实世界场景中，分别使用 TurtleBot3 Waffle 以及搭载 RealSense 摄像头的宇树（Unitree）Go2 机器人对系统进行了评估。实验结果表明，该框架成功地理解了直接指令与上下文请求，合成了具备实际意义的自然语言反馈，并成功导航至期望目标。这些结果验证了结合语义感知与自主导航以提供直观人机交互范式的可行性。代码将在论文被接收后开源。
Natural language interaction provides an intuitive way for non-expert users to communicate with robotic platforms. However, transforming user requests into executable navigation actions remains a challenging task, requiring the integration of language understanding, environment perception, and autonomous navigation. This work presents a language-driven navigation framework that enables mobile robots to interpret user requests in natural language to move the robot to a destination and autonomously navigate towards it.
The framework is composed of modular ROS 2 components that cooperate to transform natural language instructions into navigation actions. Given a natural language request referring to a target in the environment (e.g., "go to the mail box"), the system identifies the referenced object, estimates its position using RGB-D data, and generates a navigation goal, which is then executed through the ROS 2 Nav2 navigation stack. The ROS 2-based implementation facilitates portability across different robotic platforms, requiring only the configuration of the corresponding topics and services.
The system is evaluated in both simulation and real-world scenarios using a TurtleBot3 Waffle and a Unitree Go2 robot with a RealSense camera. Experimental results show that the framework successfully interprets both direct commands and contextual requests, generates meaningful natural-language feedback, and navigates towards the desired target. These results demonstrate the feasibility of combining semantic perception and autonomous navigation to provide an intuitive human-robot interaction paradigm. Code will be released as open source upon acceptance.
Towards Platform-Agnostic Geospatial Awareness: Fusing Satellite Priors with LiDAR Laser Point cloud for Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Navigation
迈向平台无关的地理空间感知：融合卫星先验信息与激光雷达点云以实现室内外无缝导航
自主导航高度依赖于其感知系统的准确性与精度，而里程计漂移（Odometry drift）与 GNSS（全球导航卫星系统）信号衰减仍是面临的主要挑战。我们提出了一套初步的与平台无关（Platform-agnostic）的导航框架，无论 GNSS 是否可用，均能在里程计频率下提供地理空间定位，将室外与室内导航视为统一的环境。
为了实现这一目标，我们结合地理参考（Georeferenced）卫星与航空图像，并利用梅山对准（Umeyama alignment）计算局部到全局的坐标转换。该先验信息被输入至传统的迭代最近点（ICP）配准算法中，允许任何移动机器人或车辆纠正其局部位置，并允许将 FAST-LIO2 状态重新初始化（Re-initialize）至全局坐标系中。
我们使用宇树（Unitree）Go2 EDU 作为移动平台对该系统进行了验证，机器人遵循一条由手动选择坐标构成的轨迹运行，该轨迹包含了室内外穿梭过渡以及因接入斜坡产生的海拔高度变化。
Autonomous navigation is highly dependent on the accuracy and precision of its perception system, with odometry drift and GNSS signal degradation remaining major challenges. We propose a preliminary platform-agnostic navigation frame- work that provides geospatial localization at odometry frequen- cies, regardless of GNSS availability, treating outdoor and indoor navigation as a unified environment. To achieve this, we leverage georeferenced satellite and aerial imagery alongside Umeyama alignment to compute a local-to-global transformation. This prior feeds into a traditional Iterative Closest Point (ICP) registration, allowing any mobile robot or vehicle to correct its local position and allows the re-initializitation of the FAST-LIO2 state into global coordinates. The system was validated using a Unitree Go2 EDU as a mobile platform, following a trajectory of manually selected coordinates that incorporates indoor-outdoor transitions and altitude variations due to access ramps. Index Terms—Autonomous Navigation, Geospatial Awareness, LiDAR-Inertial Odometry, GNSS-Denied Localization, Sensor Fusion, Indoor-Outdoor Mapping, Mobile Robots.
Predictive Training with Latent Imagination for Visual Quadruped Navigation
基于潜在想象的视觉四足机器人导航预测性训练
面向足式机器人的强化学习导航策略通常仅基于当前观测与短期记忆做出反应式动作选择，在预判移动障碍物在近期内如何演化方面的能力相当有限。在动态环境中，这种反应性会导致机器人响应过迟，因为碰撞风险取决于短时程的场景结构，而非仅仅取决于当前障碍物的位置。
在训练期间对策略的循环状态施加轻量级预测性监督，能够编码前瞻性的障碍物动力学，同时无需对推理阶段的控制器进行任何修改。我们使用辅助的 JEPA 风格预测器与 SIGReg 正则化增强了反应式 LSTM-SRU 导航骨干网络：在训练期间，预测器监督确定性隐状态以预判其自身的下一个状态；在推理期间，预测器被完全舍弃，产生零额外的计算成本。
在包含动态障碍物的仿真与真实世界导航基准测试中，我们的方法仅凭预测性训练信号，在不增加推理期参数的前提下，显著提升了导航成功率并降低了碰撞率。在宇树（Unitree）Go2 机器人上的真实部署展示了零样本仿真到真实世界（Zero-shot Sim-to-Real）的迁移能力：控制器在未经微调的情况下，即可在拥挤的室内以及动态的室外环境中成功导航，其回避行为与仿真中观察到的碰撞减少现象保持一致。
Reinforcement-learning navigation policies for legged robots select actions reactively from current observations and short-term memory, with limited capacity to anticipate how moving obstacles will evolve in the near future. In dynamic environments, this reactivity causes the robot to respond too late because collision risk depends on short-horizon scene structure rather than on current obstacle positions alone. Lightweight predictive supervision applied to the policy's recurrent state during training can encode anticipatory obstacle dynamics without modifying the inference-time controller. We augment a reactive LSTM-SRU navigation backbone with an auxiliary JEPA-style predictor and SIGReg regularization: during training, the predictor supervises the deterministic hidden state to anticipate its own next state; at inference, it is fully discarded, incurring zero additional computational cost. On simulated and real-world navigation benchmarks with dynamic obstacles, our method substantially improves navigation success while reducing collision rates through the predictive training signal alone, without additional inference-time parameters. Real-robot deployment on a Unitree Go2 demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer: the controller navigates cluttered indoor and dynamic outdoor environments without fine-tuning, with evasive behavior consistent with the collision reduction observed in simulation.
Learning Agile Navigation in Crowded Environments for Quadruped Robots
四足机器人拥挤环境下的敏捷导航学习
由于严重的传感器遮挡以及不可预测的人类运动，在动态与拥挤环境中导航给四足机器人带来了巨大的挑战。现有方法面临着权衡取舍：诸如速度障碍法（Velocity Obstacles, VO）等基于模型的方法在理论上能保证安全性，但依赖于准确的障碍物运动估计，而这种估计在拥挤人群中往往会失效；而端到端学习方法虽然具备鲁棒性，但缺乏对障碍物运动预测的能力，从而导致碰撞或过于保守的行为。
为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 VOP-Nav——一套将速度障碍法（VO）的几何安全性与端到端学习的敏捷自适应性相结合的全新导航系统。仅利用本地板载观测数据，我们的系统避免了显式的障碍物检测与跟踪流水线。VOP-Net 处理多帧 LiDAR 数据，以隐式地编码动态约束，并预测衍生自速度障碍理论的安全速度区域。重要的是，VO 预测发挥着双重作用：在推理过程中用作导航策略的输入，在训练过程中用作奖励信号以鼓励安全运动。
在 Isaac Gym 中的评估表明，VOP-Nav 取得了比所有基线更高的成功率，同时平衡了移动速度与避障能力。在宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人上的真实世界部署，进一步验证了该系统在复杂的室内与室外动态环境中的鲁棒性与高效性。
Navigating dynamic and crowded environments presents significant challenges for quadruped robots due to severe sensor occlusion and unpredictable human motion. Existing approaches face a trade-off: model-based methods, such as Velocity Obstacles (VO), theoretically guarantee safety but rely on accurate obstacle motion estimates that often fail in dense crowds, while end-to-end learning methods offer robustness but lack motion prediction capability of obstacles, leading to collisions or conservative behaviors. To solve this, we propose VOP-Nav, a novel navigation system that combines the geometric safety of VO with the agile adaptability of end-to-end learning. Using only local onboard observations, our system avoids explicit obstacle detection and tracking pipelines. The VOP-Net processes multi-frame LiDAR data to implicitly encode dynamic constraints and predict a safe velocity region derived from Velocity Obstacle theory. Importantly, the VO predictions serve a dual role: they are used as input to the navigation policy during inference and as a reward signal during training to encourage safe motion. Evaluations in Isaac Gym demonstrate that VOP-Nav achieves higher success rates than all baselines while balancing locomotion speed and collision avoidance. Real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot further validates the system's robustness and efficiency in complex indoor and outdoor dynamic environments.
TypeGo: An OS Runtime for Embodied Agents
TypeGo：面向具身智能体的操作系统运行时
大语言模型（LLMs）能够根据自然语言为具身智能体规划行为，但将 LLM 视为关键路径上的“请求/响应”预言机（Oracle），在根本上与实时控制及并发目标相矛盾。我们主张为具身智能体构建一套操作系统（OS）风格的运行时（Runtime），并在早期原型系统 TypeGo 中实现了这一构想。
TypeGo 将基于 LLM 的规划构建为与执行相重叠的多时间尺度异步循环，并像操作系统管理硬件一样管理智能体的物理躯体：技能内核（Skill Kernel）在并发的单任务进程之间仲裁具类型的物理子系统；调度器按来源对进程进行抢占、恢复或替换；推测性技能流（Speculative skill streaming）将 LLM 延迟隐蔽于持续的运动之后，而快速首动作路径（First-action path）则能在 1 秒内给出可见反馈。用户通过自然语言指令（Prescriptions）来编程行为，TypeGo 会将其分发给基于 LLM 的规划器，或编译为低延迟的中断处理程序。
我们在名为 Kalos 的宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人原型上验证了该设计：在当前的任务集测试中，与逐步规划相比，它将每步延迟降低了 50%；与单体式（Monolithic）规划相比，将首次动作响应时间缩短了 73%，同时以极低的调度开销支持了并发任务的执行。
Large language models (LLMs) can plan behavior for embodied agents from natural language, but treating the LLM as a request/response oracle on the critical path is fundamentally at odds with real-time control and concurrent goals. We argue for an operating-system-style runtime for embodied agents, and instantiate this idea in an early prototype, TypeGo. TypeGo structures LLM-based planning as asynchronous loops at multiple timescales that overlap with execution, and manages the agent's physical body like an OS manages hardware: the Skill Kernel arbitrates typed physical subsystems among concurrent per-task processes, a scheduler preempts them and resumes or replaces each by source, and speculative skill streaming hides LLM latency behind ongoing motion, while a fast first-action path yields visible feedback within a second. Users program behavior through natural language prescriptions that TypeGo dispatches to the LLM-based planners or compiles into low-latency interrupt handlers. Our prototype of Kalos, a Unitree Go2 quadruped, provides preliminary evidence for the design: in our current task suite, it cuts per-step delay by 50% over step-by-step planning and time-to-first-action by 73% over monolithic planning, while admitting concurrent tasks at low scheduling overhead.
Milo, a Fully Autonomous Indoor/Outdoor Robotic Guide Dog
Milo——一款全自动室内外机器人导盲犬
许多盲人及低视力（BLV）人士依赖导盲犬来进行实时导航，例如保持在路径上以及避开障碍物和行人。然而，导盲犬的获取和维护成本昂贵（约 5 万美元外加后续费用），通常需要漫长的等待名单，且寿命相对较短。虽然机器人导盲犬提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但现有的探索方法存在若干缺陷：它们往往缺乏真实世界部署所需的自主性，依赖环境的先验 3D 扫描、外部计算或对使用者的有限感知。
在这项工作中，我们提出了 Milo——首个开源、低成本（约 2000 美元）的机器导盲犬平台，能够履行导盲犬所期望的基础协作导航职责。Milo 具备完全的自主性，无需环境的先验知识，且完全自包含（所有计算均在板载完成），适用于室内外导航，同时能够避开障碍物和行人。
我们的系统包含一台改装后的宇树（Unitree）Go2 机器人（配备板载计算单元、传感器及拉手）、一套结合体素映射与地面、障碍物和行人检测的感知堆栈，以及一套基于在自定义鸟瞰图（BEV）仿真器中训练的避障策略构成的导航堆栈。我们在真实的室内外障碍赛道中对 Milo 进行了评估，并将其与基于代价图（Costmap）的基线进行了对比，展示出了更平滑的导航性能和更少的使用者碰撞。为了最大化 BLV 用户的可及性，我们将机器人硬件构建指南和完整的软件堆栈全部予以开源。
Many Blind and Low-Vision (BLV) people rely on guide dogs for moment-to-moment navigation, such as staying on path and avoiding obstacles and pedestrians. However, guide dogs are expensive to acquire and maintain (approximately $50k USD plus ongoing costs), often involve long waiting lists, and have relatively short life expectancies. While robot guide dogs offer a promising alternative, existing approaches exploring this idea suffer from several drawbacks: They often lack the autonomy required for real-world deployment, relying on prior 3D scans of the environment, external computation, or limited awareness of the handler. In this work, we present Milo, the first open-source, low-cost (approximately $2k USD) robotic guide dog platform capable of fulfilling the basic collaborative navigation role expected of a guide dog. Milo is fully autonomous, requiring no a priori knowledge of the environment, completely self-contained with all computation performed onboard, and suitable for both indoor and outdoor navigation while avoiding obstacles and pedestrians. Our system consists of a modified Unitree Go2 robot (equipped with onboard compute, sensors, and a handle), a perception stack combining voxel mapping with floor, obstacle, and pedestrian detection, and a navigation stack based on an obstacle-avoidance policy trained in a custom bird's-eye-view simulator. We evaluate Milo in real indoor and outdoor obstacle courses and compare it against a costmap-based baseline, demonstrating smoother navigation and fewer handler collisions. To maximize accessibility for BLV users, we release both the robot hardware instructions and the complete software stack as open source.
TAC-LOCO: Unified Whole-Body Control for Quadrupedal TACtile-Informed LOCO-Manipulation
TAC-LOCO：面向四足机器人触觉感知运动-操作任务的统一全身控制方法
动态移动操作（Dynamic loco-manipulation）要求足式机器人协调全身运动，同时在不确定的外力作用下保持与所抓取物体的稳定物理交互。尽管触觉感知在机器人操作中已被广泛研究，但其在动态全身控制中的作用仍很大程度上未被探索。缺乏触觉反馈的现有工作通常倾向于紧紧抓牢，而非根据交互动态调节抓握力。
我们提出了 TAC-LOCO——一个触觉增强的统一强化学习框架。该框架将来自柔性夹爪的触觉阵列观测编码为紧凑的隐表示（Latent representation），并将其与本体感觉相结合，实现对腿部、机械臂和夹爪的统一控制。通过有效的抓握稳定性奖励设计，该策略学会了在渐进式载荷变化和突发释放事件下，同时跟踪机身速度与末端执行器轨迹、调节抓握力并防止物体滑脱。
我们将该策略零样本部署于配备 Interbotix WidowX 250 机械臂和触觉夹爪的宇树（Unitree）Go2 机器人上，展示了在不同外部交互下由触觉感知的动态移动操作，实现了抓握力降低 47% 且掉落率低于 1% 的卓越表现。
Dynamic loco-manipulation requires legged robots to coordinate whole-body motion while maintaining stable physical interaction with grasped objects under uncertain external forces. While tactile sensing has been widely studied for robotic manipulation, its role in dynamic whole-body control remains largely unexplored. Existing works without tactile feedback commonly grasp firmly rather than regulate the grasp according to the interaction. We propose TAC-LOCO, a tactile-augmented unified reinforcement learning framework that encodes tactile array observations from compliant grippers into a compact latent representation and joins it with proprioception for unified control of the legs, arm, and gripper. With effective grasp stability reward design, the policy learns to simultaneously track body velocity and end-effector trajectories, moderate grasp force, and prevent object slip under both gradual load changes and sudden release events. We deploy the policy zero-shot on a Unitree Go2 with an Interbotix WidowX 250 arm and tactile gripper, demonstrating dynamic tactile-informed loco-manipulation under varying external interactions, achieving a 47% reduction in grasping force and an object drop rate of less than 1%.
MIRROR: Multisensory Implicit Rejection-sampled RObotic policy
MIRROR：多模态隐式拒绝采样机器人策略
机器人模仿学习通常要求模型在以实时控制速率运行并兼容多种感知模态的同时，捕捉多模态的动作分布。尽管扩散模型（Diffusion models）、流匹配（Flow matching）以及隐式最大似然估计（IMLE）等近期涌现的生成式方法取得了令人满意的成果，但它们往往仅能满足这些要求中的一部分。
为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 MIRROR——一种基于 IMLE 批次-全局拒绝采样（Batch-global rejection-sampling）变体的单次前向（Single-pass）策略。MIRROR 将时序多感官编码器（集成了 RGB、深度、触觉、音频和本体感觉）与采用 Performer 架构的线性注意力生成器相结合。
我们在多样化的真实世界硬件套件上证明了 MIRROR 的有效性，包括使用搭载 7 自由度 D1 机械臂的宇树（Unitree）Go2 进行的移动操作，以及使用 UR5 机械臂进行的桌面级操作。在诸如操作前停靠（Pre-manipulation parking）、高精度插入以及多物体抓取与放置等具备挑战性的物理任务中，MIRROR 在保持高频（30–50 Hz）闭环控制的同时，成功率超越了最先进的扩散策略 10–25%。
我们还在大型仿真基准（包括 CALVIN、MetaWorld 和 Robomimic）上进一步验证了我们的方法。在 CALVIN（10% 数据分割）中，MIRROR 相较于扩散模型成功率提升了约 25%，相较于流匹配提升了约 20%，同时将轨迹加加速度（Jerk，冲动度/抖动）降低了 20 至 50 倍。这些结果证明了 MIRROR 是一种快速、精确且支持多感官的模仿策略，在不产生迭代采样延迟的前提下保留了多模态动作覆盖能力。
Robotic imitation learning typically requires models that capture multimodal action distributions while operating at real-time control rates and accommodating multiple sensing modalities. Although recent generative approaches such as diffusion models, flow matching, and Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE) have achieved promising results, they often satisfy only a subset of these requirements. To address this, we introduce MIRROR, a single-pass policy based on a batch-global rejection-sampling variant of IMLE. MIRROR couples a temporal multisensory encoder (integrating RGB, Depth, tactile, audio, and proprioception) with a linear-attention generator using a Performer architecture. We demonstrate the efficacy of MIRROR on a diverse real-world hardware suite, including locomanipulation using a Unitree GO2 with a 7-DoF arm D1 and tabletop manipulation with a UR5 manipulator. Across challenging physical tasks such as pre-manipulation parking, highprecision insertion, and multi-object pick-andplace, MIRROR outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion policies by 10–25% in success rate while maintaining high-frequency (30–50 Hz) closedloop control. We further validate our approach on large-scale simulation benchmarks, including CALVIN, MetaWorld, and Robomimic. In CALVIN (10% data split), MIRROR improves success rates by ∼25% over diffusion and ∼20% over flow matching, while simultaneously reducing trajectory jerk by 20×–50×. These results position MIRROR as a fast, accurate, and multisensory imitation policy that retains multimodal action coverage without the latency of iterative sampling.
NavCMPO: Critic-Guided MeanFlow Policy Optimization for Adaptive Navigation
NavCMPO：用于自适应导航的评论器引导均流策略优化
基于扩散（Diffusion）的端到端策略在无地图视觉导航中展现出了强大的性能，但其迭代去噪过程引入了巨大的推理延迟，同时行为克隆（Behavior cloning）也将其性能限制在专家示范的质量水平上。
我们提出了 NavCMPO——一套结合了几步（Few-step）MeanFlow 轨迹生成、评论器引导精炼（Critic-guided refinement）以及强化学习微调的两阶段自适应导航框架。在预训练期间，障碍物接近度预测任务促使视觉表示捕捉具备障碍物感知能力的空间信息。为了弥补几步生成所导致的避障能力下降，评论器引导轨迹精炼（CGTR）利用经障碍物点云监督训练的评论器梯度来精炼中间轨迹。在自适应阶段，使用带有行为克隆正则化的近端策略优化（PPO）对 MeanFlow 策略进行微调，同时更新评论器以适应特定具身（Embodiment-specific）的观测变化。
在 InternVLA-N1 基准测试的相同训练预算下，NavCMPO 取得了 74.7% 的平均成功率，超越重新训练的 NavDP 基线 6.4 个百分点，同时将推理延迟从 85 ms 降低至 60 ms。在宇树（Unitree）Go2 机器人上的实验进一步证明了其有效的仿真到真实世界（Sim-to-Real）迁移能力。
End-to-end diffusion-based policies have demonstrated strong performance in mapless visual navigation, but their iterative denoising process introduces substantial inference latency, while behavior cloning limits performance to the quality of expert demonstrations. We present NavCMPO, a two-stage adaptive navigation framework that combines few-step MeanFlow trajectory generation, critic-guided refinement, and reinforcement learning fine-tuning. During pre-training, an obstacle proximity prediction task encourages the visual representation to capture obstacle-aware spatial information. To compensate for the degradation in obstacle avoidance caused by few-step generation, Critic-Guided Trajectory Refinement (CGTR) uses gradients from a critic trained with obstacle-point-cloud supervision to refine intermediate trajectories. During adaptation, the MeanFlow policy is fine-tuned using Proximal Policy Optimization with behavior-cloning regularization, while the critic is updated to accommodate embodiment-specific observation changes. Under a matched training budget on the InternVLA-N1 benchmark, NavCMPO achieves an average success rate of 74.7\%, exceeding the retrained NavDP baseline by 6.4 percentage points, while reducing inference latency from 85\,ms to 60\,ms. Experiments on a Unitree Go2 further demonstrate effective sim-to-real transfer.
ADMM-Based Safety-Critical Distributed NMPC for Cooperative Transportation by Quadrupedal Robots
基于ADMM的四足机器人协同运输安全关键分布式NMPC
本文提出了一套用于四足机器人团队协同载荷运输的安全关键型分布式非线性模型预测控制（Distributed Nonlinear Model Predictive Control, DNMPC）框架。所提方法将机器人团队与共享载荷建模为具备刚性完整耦合约束（Rigid holonomic coupling constraints）的动态耦合网络化系统，该约束源自协同运输过程。
