为了实现分布式实时优化，集中式有限时域最优控制问题被分解为并行局部 NMPC 子问题，并通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM）进行协调。由此产生的分布式框架不仅对载荷状态和交互力矩（Interaction-wrench）轨迹强制执行一致性，还在分布式预测控制公式中显式引入了加速度级完整耦合约束。通过使用高阶控制屏障函数（Higher-Order Control Barrier Functions, HOCBFs），机器人智能体与载荷的安全关键型避障约束得到了强制执行。
该框架通过由 2 个、3 个和 4 个四足机器人组成的团队在拥挤环境中运输共享载荷的数值仿真进行了验证。在 2 机器人和 3 机器人团队上进行的实时实验表明，在载荷不确定性和外部干扰下，系统能够实现安全且鲁棒的运输。与集中式 NMPC 相比，所提框架在保持相当的闭环性能的同时，非线性规划（NLP）的平均求解时间降低了高达 23%。消融实验进一步展示了对通信延迟的鲁棒性，并表明与现有的仅力矩一致性（Wrench-only consensus）公式相比，显式的载荷状态一致性与完整约束显著提升了载荷跟踪能力与分布式协调效果。
This paper presents a safety-critical distributed nonlinear model predictive control (DNMPC) framework for cooperative payload transportation by teams of quadrupedal robots. The proposed approach models the robotic team and the shared payload as a dynamically coupled networked system with rigid holonomic coupling constraints arising from cooperative transportation. To enable distributed real-time optimization, the centralized finite-horizon optimal control problem is decomposed into parallel local NMPC subproblems coordinated through the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). The resulting distributed framework enforces consensus over both payload-state and interaction-wrench trajectories while explicitly incorporating acceleration-level holonomic coupling constraints within the distributed predictive control formulation. Safety-critical obstacle avoidance constraints for both the robotic agents and payload are enforced using higher-order control barrier functions (HOCBFs). The framework is validated through numerical simulations with teams of two, three, and four quadrupedal robots transporting shared payloads in cluttered environments. Real-time experiments on two- and three-robot teams demonstrate safe and robust transportation under payload uncertainty and external disturbances. Compared with centralized NMPC, the proposed framework achieves up to 23% reduction in average NLP solve time while maintaining comparable closed-loop performance. Ablation studies further demonstrate robustness to communication delays and show that explicit payload-state consensus and holonomic constraints substantially improve payload tracking and distributed coordination over existing wrench-only consensus formulations.
SONG: A Photorealistic 3D Gaussian Simulation Platform for Benchmarking Social Navigation
SONG：用于社交导航基准测试的逼真 3D 高斯（3D Gaussian）仿真平台
社交导航（Social navigation）已从简化的 2D 环境走向更通用的基于视觉的设定，在此设定下，机器人需要仅凭板载视觉观测来实现符合社交规范的行为。然而，支持这一领域的仿真平台并未跟上发展步伐：现有选择要么缺乏视觉观测，要么缺乏移动的人类虚拟形象（Avatars），或者在外观和行人行为的真实世界保真度上有所欠缺，对推进基于视觉的社交导航提供的支持相当有限。
我们推出了 SONG——一套由 3D 聚类喷射（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）驱动的社交导航平台。它利用 3DGS 进行场景与虚拟形象的表示，使用由大语言模型生成的具备语义基础的轨迹驱动行人，并通过轨迹条件生成器合成其全身运动，从而产生连续、自然的动作。
在平台之上，我们构建了 SONG-Bench，这是一套按难度分层的评估剧集（Episodes），并提出了涵盖有效性、安全性和社交规范性的多维度指标套件。对代表性导航基线的系统评估揭示了三大发现：1）基于视觉的社交导航远未被攻克；2）关键的安全性缺陷优先于社交礼仪问题；3）真实世界数据比模型规模更重要。至关重要的是，我们证明了在我们的精选数据上进行微调能够有效提升真实世界环境中的成功率。我们希望我们的平台能够为下一代基于视觉的社交导航研究提供一个忠实且严谨的测试平台。
Social navigation has progressed from simplified 2D environments toward a more general vision-based setting, in which a robot needs to achieve socially compliant behavior purely from onboard visual observations. Yet supporting simulation platforms have not kept pace: existing options either lack visual observations, lack moving human avatars, or fall short of real-world fidelity in appearance and pedestrian behavior, offering limited support for advancing vision-based social navigation. We introduce SONG, a SOcial Navigation platform powered by 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS). It leverages 3DGS for both scene and avatar representations, drives pedestrians using semantically grounded trajectories generated by a large language model, and synthesizes their full-body motion with a trajectory-conditioned generator to produce continuous, natural movement. On top of the platform, we curate SONG-Bench, a set of evaluation episodes stratified by difficulty, and propose a multi-dimensional metric suite covering effectiveness, safety, and social compliance. A systematic evaluation of representative navigation baselines reveals three findings: (a) vision-based social navigation is far from solved; (b) a critical safety deficit precedes social etiquette; (c) real-world data matters more than model scale. Crucially, we demonstrate that fine-tuning on our curated data effectively improves the success rate in real-world environments. We hope our platform provides a faithful and rigorous testbed for the next generation of vision-based social navigation research.
An Edge-Deployable Visible-Thermal Framework for Cow-Head Detection and Cross-Camera Association in Robotic Dairy Monitoring
一种用于机器人奶牛场监测中牛头检测和跨摄像头关联的边缘可部署可见光-热成像框架
面部表面温度能够为奶牛健康、福利、热应激以及繁殖状态监测提供有价值的非接触式信息。红外热成像（Infrared thermography）能够捕获眼部、口鼻部、鼻孔和耳部等面部区域的热信息，但仅凭红外图像往往缺乏清晰的纹理和解剖边界，导致在移动机器人巡检过程中难以对奶牛头部进行可靠定位。可见光图像虽然能提供更丰富的结构线索，却无法提供温度信息。
本研究提出了 YOLO11-AFE——一套面向四足巡检机器人的轻量级“可见光-热成像”奶牛头部检测与异构相机关联框架。论文引入了 ADown 模块以实现轻量化下采样，引入 C3k2_FE 模块以进行自适应特征增强，并引入 SPPF_ECA 模块以获得通道感知的多尺度表示。随后，采用改进的匈牙利匹配算法（Hungarian matching algorithm），在同步的可见光与红外伪彩检测结果之间建立了一对一的奶牛头部对应关系。
YOLO11-AFE 在可见光测试子集中取得了 97.51% 的精确率（Precision）、96.26% 的 mAP@0.5 和 70.64% 的 mAP@0.5:0.95；在红外子集中则取得了 95.92% 的精确率、99.07% 的 mAP@0.5 和 91.41% 的 mAP@0.5:0.95。与 YOLO11n 相比，其参数量和浮点运算量（FLOPs）分别降低了 17.37% 和 18.17%。在 Jetson Orin NX 上的 TensorRT 部署中，完整核心流水线的处理速度达到了 36.71 FPS。所有 187 对奶牛头部均被正确关联，这表明该框架为未来非接触式面部温度监测提供了一个可边缘部署的前端系统。
Facial surface temperature can provide useful non-contact information for dairy-cow health, welfare, heat-stress, and reproductive-status monitoring. Infrared thermography can capture thermal information from facial regions such as the eyes, muzzle, nostrils, and ears, but infrared images alone often lack clear texture and anatomical boundaries, making reliable cow-head localisation difficult during mobile robotic inspection. Visible-light images provide richer structural cues but no temperature information. This study proposes YOLO11-AFE, a lightweight visible–thermal cow-head detection and heterogeneous-camera association framework for quadruped inspection robots. ADown was introduced for lightweight downsampling, C3k2_FE for adaptive feature enhancement, and SPPF_ECA for channel-aware multi-scale representation. An improved Hungarian matching algorithm was then used to establish one-to-one cow-head correspondence between synchronized visible-light and infrared pseudo-colour detections. YOLO11-AFE achieved Precision, mAP@0.5, and mAP@0.5:0.95 values of 97.51%, 96.26%, and 70.64% on the visible-light test subset, and 95.92%, 99.07%, and 91.41% on the infrared subset. Compared with YOLO11n, parameters and FLOPs were reduced by 17.37% and 18.17%. TensorRT deployment on Jetson Orin NX reached 36.71 FPS for the complete core pipeline. All 187 cow-head pairs were correctly associated, indicating that the framework provides an edge-deployable front end for future non-contact facial temperature monitoring.
Vectorized Online POMDP Planning with Neural POMDP Models
基于神经POMDP模型的向量化在线POMDP规划
部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs）为不确定性下的决策制定提供了原则性的框架，但现有的求解方法要么依赖于人工构建的模型，要么需要海量的任务特定训练数据。近期的研究通过将神经 POMDP 模型集成到基于搜索的决策制定中，把规划与学习结合了起来。然而，这些方法通常依赖于顺序执行或受限于 CPU 的规划算法，限制了对神经 POMDP 模型的有效利用——而后者的评估天生适配现代 GPU 上的大规模批处理张量运算。
在本文中，我们提出了 VOiLA（Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents，基于学习扩散模型的向量化在线规划 POMDP 智能体框架），这 critical 框架将学习得到的神经 POMDP 模型与大规模并行在线规划相结合。VOiLA 的核心是 VOPP（Vectorized Online POMDP Planner，向量化在线 POMDP 求解器），它是一个完全 GPU 原生的在线 POMDP 求解器，将信念树（Belief trees）表示为张量，并通过数万个并行仿真来进行规划。
基于这一架构，VOiLA 从离线仿真数据中学习任务无关的神经状态转移模型、观测模型与似然模型，并将它们直接集成到规划与信念估计中。实验结果表明，VOPP 在使用显著降低的规划预算前提下，取得了与最先进的在线 POMDP 求解器相当的规划性能。此外，VOiLA 在所需训练数据量大幅少于循环强化学习（Recurrent RL）、对未见环境具备更强泛化能力以及成功实现仿真到真实世界（Sim-to-Real）迁移的同时，展现出了极具竞争力的性能表现。
Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) provide a principled framework for decision making under uncertainty, but existing solution approaches either rely on hand-crafted models or require large amounts of task-specific training data. Recent methods have combined planning and learning by integrating neural POMDP models into search-based decision making. However, these approaches often rely on sequential or CPU-bound planning algorithms, limiting efficient utilization of neural POMDP models, whose evaluation naturally maps to large batched tensor operations on modern GPUs. In this paper, we present Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents (VOiLA), a framework that combines learned neural POMDP models with massively parallel online planning. Central to VOiLA is Vectorized Online POMDP Planner (VOPP), a fully GPU-native online POMDP solver that represents belief trees as tensors and performs planning through tens of thousands of parallel simulations. Building on this architecture, VOiLA learns task-agnostic neural transition, observation, and likelihood models from offline simulation data and integrates them directly into planning and belief estimation. Experimental results show that VOPP achieves planning performance comparable to state-of-the-art online POMDP solvers while using up to
smaller planning budgets. Furthermore, VOiLA achieves competitive performance while requiring less than
% of the training data used by recurrent reinforcement learning, stronger generalization to unseen environments, and successful sim-to-real transfer.
Implicit Virtual Leader: Decentralized Vision-Only Relative Pose Estimation for Multi-Robot Formations
隐式虚拟领导者：面向多机器人编队的去中心化纯视觉相对位姿估计
经典的领航者-跟随者（Leader-follower）编队控制存在单点故障与误差累积传播的问题，且高度依赖绝对定位传感器，这使其难以胜任缺乏 GPS 信号的环境。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一套基于图神经网络（GNNs）的完全去中心化、仅依赖视觉的相对位姿估计框架。
该框架的核心思想是隐式虚拟领航者（Implicit Virtual Leader, IVL）：一种非物理的编队参考系，它不绑定于任何单台机器人，而是仅利用单目图像和机器人间通信在 GNN 内部隐式学习得到。我们挂载了用于偶发不确定性（Aleatoric uncertainty）的异方差高斯负对数似然（GNLL）预测头，并结合用于认知不确定性（Epistemic uncertainty）的蒙特卡洛 Dropout（MC Dropout），在仿真与真实世界测试集上进行了系统性的对比评估。
我们的框架取得了极具竞争力的位姿估计精度，并能自然地泛化至异构机器人平台以及不同规模的编队结构中。
Classical leader-follower formation control suffers from single points of failure and error propagation, and relies on absolute localization sensors that are ill-suited for GPS-denied environments. We address these limitations by introducing a fully decentralized, vision-only relative pose estimation framework based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). The key idea is the implicit virtual leader (IVL): a non-physical formation reference frame that is not tied to any individual robot but is implicitly learned within the GNN using only monocular images and inter-robot communication. We attach a heteroscedastic GNLL head for aleatoric uncertainty and MC~Dropout for epistemic uncertainty, and conduct a systematic comparison across simulation and real-world test sets. Our framework achieves competitive pose estimation accuracy and generalizes naturally to heterogeneous robot platforms and varying formation sizes.
LLM-Powered Interactive Robotic Action Synthesis from Multimodal Speech, Gestures, and Music
基于LLM的多模态语音、手势和音乐交互式机器人动作合成
实现直观且自然的采集人机交互（HRI）仍是机器人学领域的一项重大挑战。传统方法通常依赖僵硬、预编程的指令，这限制了机器人的表达能力与自适应性。
本文引入了一套全新的框架，利用大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力，从丰富的人类多模态输入（自然语音、手势以及音乐/声音节拍）中合成复杂的机器人动作。我们的系统架构集成了语音转录模型、手势识别模块以及用于节拍检测的信号处理流水线。这些处理后的输入借助提示词模板（Prompt templates）进行上下文构建并输入至 LLM 中。在预定义机器人动作空间的指导下，LLM 对整合后的多模态输入进行推理，以生成连贯的动作序列。该序列随后被分发至动作队列，并通过 ROS（机器人操作系统）在四足机器人上执行。
该框架具备理解并融合来自语音的语义指令、来自手势的指示性信息（Deictic information）以及来自音乐的节奏线索的能力。这项工作代表着在打造能够以更流畅、更有创造力且具备上下文感知能力的方式与人类进行交互的机器人方面迈出了重要一步。
The quest for intuitive and natural human-robot interaction (HRI) remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional methods often rely on rigid, pre-programmed commands that limit the robot's expressiveness and adaptability. This paper introduces a novel framework that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to synthesize complex robotic actions from a rich tapestry of multimodal human inputs: natural speech, hand gestures, and music/sound beats. Our system architecture integrates a speech transcription model, a gesture recognition module, and a signal processing pipeline for beat detection. These processed inputs are contextualized using prompt templates and fed into a LLM. The LLM, informed by a predefined robot action space, reasons over the combined inputs to generate a coherent sequence of actions. This sequence is dispatched to an action queue for execution on a quadruped robot over ROS. The framework has ability to interpret and fuse semantic commands from speech, deictic information from gestures, and rhythmic cues from music. This work represents a step towards creating robots that can interact with humans in a more fluid, creative, and context-aware manner.
Beyond Episodic Evaluation: Memory Architectural Bottlenecks in Sequential Embodied Question Answering
超越情景式评估：顺序具身问答中的记忆架构瓶颈
具身问答（Embodied Question Answering, EQA）传统上是在单剧集（Episodic）设定下进行评估的，即智能体独立解决每个任务，并在剧集之间重置内部状态。然而，真实世界中的机器人是持续运行的，必须积累、保留并选择性地复用从先前交互中获取的信息。尽管这一需求极具实用价值，但支持 EQA 中顺序记忆（Sequential memory）所需的架构机制仍未得到充分探索。
在这项工作中，我们研究了在对 EQA 智能体进行顺序评估时，不同记忆架构的表现——在相同场景中回答多个问题，同时将记忆跨查询向前传递。我们发现，仅仅保留现有记忆通常是不够的。仅保留可通行性信息（如 2D 占据网格图）的智能体只记得机器人探索过的位置，却无法记住后续问题所需的视觉-语义证据。而在短时程单剧集数据上训练的智能体面临着不同的挑战：当暴露于连续的多查询历史中时，其继承的上下文存在严重的时序不匹配问题，无法形成可复用的场景表示。
为了克服这一架构瓶颈，我们强调了结构化、空间接地记忆（Spatially grounded memory）的必要性：将持久的视觉观测映射到度量 3D 几何上的架构，能够在一致的场景表示中保留视觉-语义证据。在仿真环境中的大量实验表明，这种形式的记忆打破了顺序设定下的“准确率-效率”权衡，同时实现了更高的回答准确率和更低的导航成本。我们在真实世界移动机器人上进一步验证了这些发现，证明了空间接地视觉记忆对于在物理环境中实现持续、智能的操作至关重要。
Embodied question answering (EQA) is traditionally evaluated under an episodic formulation, where agents solve each task independently and reset internal state between episodes. However, real-world robots operate continuously and must accumulate, retain, and selectively reuse information acquired from prior interactions. Despite this practical requirement, the architectural mechanisms needed to support sequential memory in EQA remain underexplored. In this work, we investigate how different memory architectures behave when EQA agents are evaluated sequentially, with multiple questions answered in the same scene while memory is carried forward across queries. We find that simply preserving existing memory is often insufficient. Agents that retain only traversability information, such as 2D occupancy maps, remember where the robot has explored but not the visual-semantic evidence needed for later questions. Agents trained on short-horizon episodic data face a different challenge: when exposed to continuous, multi-query histories, their inherited context suffers from severe temporal mismatch, rather than forming a reusable scene representation. To overcome this architectural bottleneck, we highlight the necessity of structured, spatially grounded memory: architectures that map persistent visual observations onto metric 3D geometry preserve visual-semantic evidence in a coherent scene representation. Extensive experiments in simulated environments reveal that this form of memory breaks the accuracy-efficiency tradeoff in sequential settings, simultaneously achieving higher answer accuracy and lower navigation costs. We further validate these findings on a real-world mobile robot, demonstrating that spatially grounded visual memory is critical for enabling continuous, intelligent operation in physical environments.
Covariance Volume Maximization for Embodied Latent Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning
深度强化学习中具身潜在探索的协方差体积最大化
高效探索仍是深度强化学习中的核心挑战，特别是对于在具有高维观测和复杂动态特性的现实环境中运行的具身智能体而言。近期的隐空间探索方法在学习到的隐空间（Latent space）中定义奖励加成（Bonuses），但在以下设定中往往面临困境：1）表征可能存在噪声或依赖于策略；2）诸如随机隐空间目标或固定方向跨越等常用策略过于脆弱，无法提升全局覆盖度。
我们提出了协方差体积最大化（Covariance Volume Maximization, CVM）——一套由覆盖度驱动的隐空间探索框架，包含两个核心组成部分。首先，我们使用策略混合目标学习行为状态编码器，以减少快速变化的探索策略下的表征漂移，从而产生稳定且具备行为意义的隐位移（Latent displacements）。其次，CVM 通过近期的隐位移协方差对数行列式的精确增量来奖励每次状态转移，显式地扩展已探索区域并优先覆盖探索不足的方向。该目标与经典的 D-最优设计（D-optimal design）标准相吻合，为信息效率提供了理论支撑。
在具身导航与操作任务上开展的大量实验表明，CVM 显著提升了探索效率与鲁棒性，并能有效地扩展至不同的测试环境。
Efficient exploration remains a key challenge in deep reinforcement learning, especially for embodied agents operating in realistic environments with high-dimensional observations and complex dynamics. Recent latent exploration methods define bonuses in a learned latent space, but often struggle in these settings where (i) representations can be noisy or policy-dependent, and (ii) common strategies such as randomized latent objectives or fixed directional spanning are brittle and fail to improve global coverage. We propose Covariance Volume Maximization (CVM), a coverage-driven latent exploration framework with two key components. First, we learn a behavioral state encoder using a policy-mixture objective to reduce representation drift under rapidly changing exploration policies, yielding stable and behaviorally meaningful latent displacements. Second, CVM rewards each transition by its exact increase in the log-determinant of the covariance of recent latent displacements, explicitly expanding the explored region and prioritizing under-covered directions. This objective coincides with the classical D-optimal design criterion, providing an information-efficiency justification. Extensive experiments on embodied navigation and manipulation tasks demonstrate that CVM substantially improves exploration efficiency and robustness, and scales effectively to different environments.
EA-Nav: Learning Safe Visual Navigation Policies with Embodiment Awareness
EA-Nav：学习具有具身感知能力的安全视觉导航策略
跨具身（Cross-embodiment）导航是具身智能领域的核心挑战。由于形态上的差异，相同的视觉观测对于不同的智能体可能意味着不同的动作，如果仅依赖视觉信息，会导致动作预测产生歧义。现有的研究主要依赖强化学习，但这需要大规模的交互和精心的奖励函数设计，难以支持可拓展的预训练与真实世界自适应。相比之下，基于模仿学习的方法依然受到限制。
为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一套基于模仿学习的具身感知导航框架，该框架采用了模块化的多阶段设计。在预训练阶段，我们从互联网视频中构建了一个跨具身导航数据集，并引入具身几何形态（Embodiment geometry）作为条件 Token，以减少相同观测下的动作歧义。在微调阶段，我们设计了一种基于解耦架构的多模态信息注入机制。具体而言，我们设计了一种轨迹增强策略来生成高风险样本，用于分别训练空间感知与风险感知修正，从而显式地融合具身几何形态以实现安全导航。
实验结果表明，所提方法有效提升了不同具身设定下的导航性能，验证了将具身几何形态融入具身导航的有效性。
Cross-embodiment navigation is a key challenge in embodied intelligence. Due to differences in embodiment, the same visual observation may imply different actions for different agents, making prediction ambiguous when relying solely on vision. Existing studies mainly rely on reinforcement learning, which requires large-scale interaction and careful reward design, making it difficult to support scalable pretraining and real-world adaptation. In contrast, imitation-learning-based approaches remain limited. To address these challenges, we propose an imitation-learning-based embodiment-aware navigation framework with a modular multi-stage design. In pretraining, we construct a cross-embodiment navigation dataset from Internet videos and introduce embodiment geometry as conditional tokens to reduce action ambiguity under the same observation. In fine-tuning, we design a multimodal information injection mechanism based on a decoupled architecture. Specifically, we design a trajectory augmentation strategy to generate high-risk samples, which are used to train spatial perception and risk-aware correction separately, thereby explicitly incorporating embodiment geometry for safe navigation. Experimental results show that the proposed method effectively improves navigation performance across different embodiment settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of incorporating embodiment geometry into embodied navigation.
DDS-Mamba-YOLO: Improved adaptive state-space modeling for tomato fruit and leaf disease detection
DDS-Mamba-YOLO：改进的番茄果实和叶片病害检测自适应状态空间模型
番茄是全球范围内栽培最广泛、经济价值最重要的作物之一，尤其是在大型温室环境中，植物健康监测与果实检测对于智慧作物管理至关重要。温室环境面临着诸多挑战：密集的结构可能会遮挡早期病害症状和果实，且需要准确检测处于不同成熟阶段和不同尺寸的果实。此外，在移动机器人平台携带的边缘设备上部署检测模型，面临着模型体积和计算成本的严格限制。
本研究提出了一套全新的混合检测框架——DDS-Mamba-YOLO（Deformable Dynamic State-space Mamba-You Only Look Once）。该框架基于可变形动态状态空间（DDS）与 Mamba（一种基于选择性状态空间模型的 YOLO）构建，旨在解决上述挑战的同时平衡检测性能与模型体积。具体而言，我们在 Mamba-YOLO 主干网络中集成了三个创新模块以提升性能：1）基于空间自适应下采样模块构建的空间可变形通道模块（SDCM），以更好地捕获被遮挡目标和小目标；2）Dysample 上采样模块，用于自适应地保留细粒度特征；3）长短期融合精炼模块（LSFR），该模块将双分支切分 Mamba 块与卷积特征精炼模块相结合，以增强梯度传播和信息流。
在从真实温室环境采集的图像数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的模型在仅有 3.28M 参数量和 8.3 GFLOPs 计算量的情况下，取得了 93.3% 的 mAP@50-95 和 98.1% 的 mAP@50，超越了七种同等规模的 YOLO 系列模型和三种近期提出的叶片病害检测模型。消融实验进一步验证了各个模块的必要性及其互补协同作用。除了模型训练之外，我们还建立了一个初步的原型系统，将 DDS-Mamba-YOLO 模型与基于四足机器人的自主温室巡检及基于大语言模型（LLM）的管理咨询相结合。该集成系统验证了所提模型在边缘设备上的实际部署潜力，并为大规模智慧农业管理提供了一份初步的蓝图。
Tomato is one of the most extensively cultivated and economically important crops worldwide, particularly in large-scale greenhouse environments, where plant health monitoring and fruit detection are essential for smart crop management. Greenhouse environments present multiple challenges: dense structures can obscure early disease symptoms and fruits, and fruits across different maturity stages and sizes need to be detected accurately. Moreover, deploying detection models on edge devices carried by mobile robotic platforms faces strict constraints on model size and computational cost. In this study, we propose a novel hybrid detection framework, DDS-Mamba-You Only Look Once (YOLO), built upon Deformable Dynamic State-space (DDS) and Mamba, a selective state space model-based YOLO to tackle the aforementioned challenges while balancing detection performance and model size. Specifically, three modules are proposed to integrate into the Mamba-YOLO backbone to enhance the performance: (1) a Spatial Deformable Channel Module (SDCM), built upon spatial adaptive downsample modules to better capture occluded and small targets; (2) a Dysample upsampling module to preserve fine-grained features adaptively, and (3) a Long Short Fusion Refiner (LSFR) module, which combines a dual-branch split Mamba block with a convolutional feature refinement module to strengthen gradient propagation and information flow. Experimental results on an image dataset collected from real greenhouse environments show that our model, with only 3.28M parameters and 8.3 GFLOPs, achieves 93.3% mAP@50-95 and 98.1% mAP@50, surpassing seven comparably-sized YOLO series models and three recent leaf disease detection models. Ablation experiments further validate the necessity of each module and its complementary interactions. Beyond training the model, we further establish a preliminary prototype that couples the DDS-Mamba-YOLO model with quadruped robot-based autonomous greenhouse inspection and Large Language Model (LLM)-based management consultation. This integrated system validates the practical deployment potential of the proposed model on edge devices and provides a preliminary blueprint for intelligent agricultural management at scale.
SoftNav: Injecting 3D Scene Tokens into VLMs for Embodied Navigation
SoftNav：将 3D 场景令牌注入虚拟语言模型以实现具身导航
在目标导向的具身导航（Goal-directed embodied navigation）中，智能体必须在未见环境中定位指定目标，这要求 3D 场景理解与导航推理紧密协同。当前的方法通常通过文本将 3D 场景信息传输给视觉语言模型（VLMs），表明在我们的测试配置中存在表征鸿沟（Representation gap）；一项对照消融实验证实，直接进行嵌入级（Embedding-level）的传输显著优于所评估的文本序列化格式。
我们提出了 SoftNav，它通过轻量级投影器（Projector），将实体级 3D 连续表征——即每个检测到的物体或边界（Frontier）对应一个 Token——作为软 Token（Soft tokens）注入到 VLM 的隐空间中。在冻结 3D 编码器和 VLM 的情况下，仅需约 1,200 个样本和约 1,700 万（17M）个可训练参数。在 HM3D-OVON 数据集上，SoftNav 在三个划分集上分别取得了 74.2% / 68.3% / 66.7% 的成功率（SR），在成功率（SR）和按路径长度加权的成功率（SPL）上均超越了以往的所有方法；相同的导航策略无需重新训练或修改架构，即可零样本迁移至 GOAT-Bench（67.2% SR）、SG3D（47.2% s-SR）以及真实世界机器人部署中。
直接将 3D 场景 Token 注入 VLM 中弥合了表征鸿沟，从而以极小的训练开销实现了具备可迁移性的导航能力。
In goal-directed embodied navigation, where an agent must locate a specified target in an unseen environment, 3D scene understanding and navigation reasoning must work in concert. Current approaches transmit 3D scene information to vision-language models (VLMs) through text, suggesting a representation gap in our tested configurations; a controlled ablation confirms that direct embedding-level transfer significantly outperforms the evaluated text serialization formats. We introduce SoftNav, which injects entity-level 3D continuous representations -- one token per detected object or frontier -- into a VLM's hidden space as soft tokens through a lightweight projector. With the 3D encoder and VLM frozen, only ~1,200 samples and ~17M trainable parameters are needed. On HM3D-OVON, SoftNav achieves 74.2%/68.3%/66.7% SR across three splits, surpassing all prior methods in both SR and SPL; the same navigation policy transfers zero-shot to GOAT-Bench (67.2% SR), SG3D (47.2% s-SR), and real-world robot deployment without retraining or architectural modification. Injecting 3D scene tokens directly into VLMs bridges the representation gap, enabling transferable navigation with minimal training.
EAGOR: Embodied Reasoning in Omni-direction
EAGOR 全方位具身推理
全向（360°）相机为具身智能体提供了周围环境的整体视角，使其非常适合用于导航和物体搜索等任务中的方向推理。现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）将 360° 观测投影为 2D 等矩形投影（Equirectangular projection, ERP）图像，并使用针对透视图像设计的架构对其进行处理。然而，它们忽略了 360° 观测的球面特性——在球面表示中，每个像素都代表相对于智能体的一个观察方向。因此，在由智能体运动引起的相机视角转换下，它们的方向估计往往会变得不一致。这一局限性对于无地图导航（Map-free navigation）尤为关键，因为智能体必须在其自我中心坐标系（Egocentric frame）中持续估计目标方向。
我们提出了 EAGOR——一套用于具身 360° 方向推理的免训练、几何感知框架。EAGOR 没有将目标方向预测为 ERP 图像坐标，而是将方向推理直接公式化为球面上进行的递归贝叶斯估计（Recursive Bayesian estimation）。它维持着对目标方向的连续信念（Belief），并在智能体运动下等变地（Equivariantly）传播该信念，而无需训练主干 VLM。为了实现这一点，我们引入了球谐函数信念场（Spherical Harmonic Belief Field, SH-BF），其球谐函数表示为球面流形上的方向估计提供了全局定义且具备旋转感知能力的基底。这一公式化消除了 ERP 的缝隙不连续性、纬度失真以及插值误差。
我们在两个基准数据集以及四足机器人上的真实世界实验中对 EAGOR 进行了方向推理任务的评估。EAGOR 持续超越现有的方法，在 HOS 和 OSR-Bench 上分别取得了 +34.4% 和 +45.6% 的平均相对增益，同时将导航成功率提升了 +14.6%，步数减少了 17.7%，平均角度误差降低了 24.5%。
Omni-directional (360°) cameras provide embodied agents with a holistic view of their surroundings, making them suited for directional reasoning in tasks such as navigation and object search. Existing Vision Language Models (VLMs) project 360° observations to 2D equirectangular projection (ERP) images and process them using architectures designed for perspective images. However, they ignore the spherical nature of 360° observations, where each pixel represents a viewing direction relative to the agent. Consequently, their direction estimates often become inconsistent under camera view transformations caused by agent motion. This limitation is particularly critical for map-free navigation, where the agent must continuously estimate the target direction in its egocentric frame. We propose EAGOR, a training-free, geometry-aware framework for embodied 360° directional reasoning. Instead of predicting target directions as ERP image coordinates, EAGOR formulates directional reasoning as recursive Bayesian estimation directly on the sphere. It maintains a continuous belief over target directions and propagates it equivariantly under agent motion without training the backbone VLMs. To achieve this, we introduce the Spherical Harmonic Belief Field (SH-BF), whose spherical harmonic representation provides a globally defined, rotation-aware basis for directional estimation on the spherical manifold. This formulation eliminates ERP seam discontinuities, latitude distortions, and interpolation errors. We evaluate EAGOR on two benchmark datasets and real-world experiments with a legged robot across directional reasoning tasks. EAGOR consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving average relative gains of +34.4% and +45.6% on HOS and OSR-Bench, respectively, while improving navigation success by +14.6%, reducing step count by 17.7%, and lowering mean angular error by 24.5%.
I Move Therefore I Learn: Experience-Based Traversability in Outdoor Robotics
我行动，故我学习：户外机器人中基于经验的可穿越性
准确的可通行性估计（Traversability estimation）对于户外机器人在复杂环境中实现安全且有效的导航至关重要。本文介绍了一套全新的基于经验的方法，使机器人能够根据以往的导航经验自主学习哪些地形是可通行的，而无需依赖大规模预先标记的数据集。
该方法将高程与纹理数据整合到多层网格图（Multi-layered grid maps）中，并使用在通用纹理数据集上训练的变分自编码器（VAE）进行处理。在初始遥控阶段，机器人一边在环境中移动一边收集传感器数据。这些导航经验被编码为紧凑的特征向量，并使用 BIRCH 聚类算法进行聚类，从而高效地表示可通行地形区域。在部署阶段，机器人将新的地形块与已学习的特征簇进行对比，以实时评估其可通行性。所提方法无需使用来自目标场景的数据进行训练，能够跨多样化的地表与机器人平台进行泛化，并在遇到新地形时进行动态适应。
在合成基准测试以及针对轮式和足式机器人的真实世界场景中进行的大量评估表明，与最先进的方法相比，该方法展现出了出色的有效性、鲁棒性与卓越的自适应能力。
Accurate traversability estimation is essential for safe and effective navigation of outdoor robots operating in complex environments. This paper introduces a novel experience-based method that allows robots to autonomously learn which terrains are traversable based on prior navigation experience, without relying on extensive pre-labeled datasets. The approach integrates elevation and texture data into multi-layered grid maps, which are processed using a variational autoencoder (VAE) trained on a generic texture dataset. During an initial teleoperated phase, the robot collects sensory data while moving around the environment. These experiences are encoded into compact feature vectors and clustered using the BIRCH algorithm to represent traversable terrain areas efficiently. In deployment, the robot compares new terrain patches to its learned feature clusters to assess traversability in real time. The proposed method does not require training with data from the targeted scenarios, generalizes across diverse surfaces and platforms, and dynamically adapts as new terrains are encountered. Extensive evaluations on both synthetic benchmarks and real-world scenarios with wheeled and legged robots demonstrate its effectiveness, robustness, and superior adaptability compared to state-of-the-art approaches.
Hierarchical Object Representation for Spatial Robot Perception Points, Meshes, and Superquadrics
空间机器人感知的分层对象表示：点、网格和超二次曲面
分层 3D 场景图（Hierarchical 3D Scene Graphs, 3DSG）已成为长时自主性（Long-term autonomy）中一种具可操作性且具备可扩展性的表征形式，它融合了场景中的度量、语义和拓扑信息。然而，3DSG 中物体的几何表征问题一直被忽视，因为大多数方法使用的是简化的几何模型，如局部点云或 3D 包围盒。
在这项工作中，我们引入了一种分层物体表征，可用于高保真物体级重建、基于物体的鲁棒重定位或地图对准，以及在密集拥挤环境中为安全机器人导航规划提供高效且解析的碰撞检测。该表征在结构上组织为四个不同的层级，从原始传感器数据到密集 3D 网格，再到诸如超二次曲面（Superquadrics）等解析原语（Analytical primitives），逐步对场景进行抽象，从而为物体几何形状提供了一种稀疏且解析的表征。
我们开发了一套流水线，能够从机器人采集的 RGB-D 图像流中构建该分层物体表征，并在室内和室外环境的真实世界开放集物体场景中展示了其工作效果。在包括 HOPE、ReplicaCAD、Kimera-Multi 以及使用 Unitree B2 机器人采集的 NUS 校区数据集在内的多个数据集上开展的大量实验，验证了我们的流水线在室内和室外环境中的有效性。我们表明，我们基于超二次曲面的地图对准方法超越了当前最先进的基于物体的地图对准方法 ROMAN。
Hierarchical 3D Scene Graphs (3DSG) have emerged as an actionable and scalable representation for long-term autonomy incorporating metric, semantic, and topological information in the scene. However, the question of geometric representation of objects in 3DSG has been overlooked as most methods use simplified geometric models such as partial point clouds or 3D bounding boxes. In this work, we introduce a hierarchical object representation that can be leveraged for high-fidelity object-level reconstruction, object-based robust re-localization or map alignment, and efficient and analytical collision checking for safe robot navigation planning in dense and cluttered environments. The representation is structurally organized into four distinct layers, progressively abstracting the scene from raw sensor data to dense 3D meshes to analytical primitives such as superquadrics, which provide a sparse and analytical representation for object geometry. We develop a pipeline that builds the hierarchical object representation from RGB-D image stream captured by a robot, and demonstrate its working in real-world open-set object scenes in both indoor and outdoor environments. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets including HOPE, ReplicaCAD, Kimera-Multi, and NUS Campus Dataset collected using Unitree B2 Robot validate our pipeline in both indoor and outdoor environments. We show that our superquadric-based map alignment method outperforms the current state-of-the-art object based map alignment method ROMAN.
UniLM-Nav A Unified Framework for Zero-Shot Last-Mile Navigation
UniLM-Nav：面向零尝试最后一公里导航的统一框架
移动操作（Mobile manipulation）要求机器人导航至目标物体或容器（Receptacle），随后执行预期的操作任务。然而，到达目标附近并不保证能够获得适合进行操作的基座位姿（Manipulation-ready base pose），这一难题被称为“最后一公里导航”（Last-mile navigation）。先前的最后一公里导航方法要么依赖人工位姿标注，要么依赖特定任务的训练，这限制了它们向具有细粒度空间约束的开放词汇表（Open-vocabulary）设定的扩展能力。
我们提出了 UniLM-Nav——一套用于零样本（Zero-shot）开放词汇最后一公里导航的统一框架。UniLM-Nav 将最后一公里导航分解为视角选择、任务条件下的可负担性接地（Affordance grounding）以及几何感知基座位姿推理，这些模块均由共享的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）后端进行统一求解。具体而言，UniLM-Nav 首先从近期采集的观测数据中选择最能捕获目标物体或容器的参考视角；随后在所选视角中接地与任务相关的可负担性点（Affordance point），并将结果提升（Lift）至以机器人为中心的坐标系中；最后，在接地的可负担性、任务上下文和机器人几何结构的条件下，推理出适合机器人进行操作的基座位姿。
我们在 OVMM 基准测试上对 UniLM-Nav 进行了评估，其性能超越了先前最先进的方法 MoTo 3.13 个百分点。分析表明，我们方法的各个组成部分对最终性能至关重要，且 MLLM 后端的选择也产生了重大影响。我们进一步将 UniLM-Nav 部署在配备 6 自由度 Unitree Z1 机械臂的 Unitree B2 四足机器人上，验证了其在真实世界移动操作任务中的适用性。
Mobile manipulation requires a robot to navigate to a target object or receptacle and then perform intended manipulation. However, reaching the vicinity of the target does not guarantee a manipulation-ready base pose, a problem known as last-mile navigation. Prior methods for last-mile navigation either rely on manual pose annotation or task-specific training, limiting their scalability to open-vocabulary settings with fine-grained spatial constraints. We propose UniLM-Nav, a unified framework for zero-shot open-vocabulary last-mile navigation. UniLM-Nav decomposes last-mile navigation into view selection, task-conditioned affordance grounding, and geometry-aware base-pose reasoning, all resolved with a shared multimodal large language model (MLLM) backend. Specifically, UniLM-Nav first selects a reference view that best captures the target object or receptacle from recently collected observations. It then grounds task-relevant affordance point in the selected view and lifts the result into the robot-centric coordinate frame. Finally, conditioned on the grounded affordance, task context, and robot geometry, it infers a manipulation-ready base pose for the robot. We evaluate UniLM-Nav on the OVMM benchmark, where it outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method, MoTo, by 3.13 percentage points. Analyses show that the components of our method are crucial to final performance, and that the choice of MLLM also has a substantial effect. We further deploy UniLM-Nav on a Unitree B2 quadruped robot with a 6-DoF Unitree Z1 manipulator, validating its applicability to real-world mobile manipulation tasks.
A Robust Shear-Based Optical Tactile Sensor for Quadruped-Mounted Manipulation
一种用于四足机器人操控的稳健型剪切式光学触觉传感器
基于视觉的触觉传感器（Vision-based tactile sensors, VBTS）在实验台上表现出色，但足式机器人上的移动操作会带来非结构化接触、意外碰撞和野外杂物，现有的传感器无法很好地应对这些问题。基于凝胶（Gel-based）和基于标记点（Marker-based）的 VBTS 磨损直接发生在感知表面上，因此在野外部署中，传感器更换与重新校准成为了瓶颈。
我们使用了一种光学触觉传感器，其基于剪切力的工作原理和分层结构将信号质量与表面磨损分离开来。染色感知层位于可更换的透明保护罩后方，永不直接接触物体。
这项工作从野外部署的角度审视了该传感器的设计，将其表征结果与移动应用相结合，并描述了其作为搭载于四足机器人上的机械臂触觉前端的集成方案。
Vision-based tactile sensors (VBTS) work well on the benchtop, but mobile manipulation on legged robots brings unstructured contact, incidental collisions and field debris that existing sensors do not handle well. Gel-based and markerbased VBTS wear directly on the sensing surface, so replacement and recalibration become a bottleneck in the field. We use an optical tactile sensor whose shear-based principle and layered construction separate signal quality from surface wear. The dyed sensing layer sits behind a replaceable transparent cover and never touches the object. This work looks at the sensor’s design from a field-deployment angle, ties its characterization results to mobile use, and describes its integration as the tactile frontend of a quadruped-mounted robot arm.
MonoGlass3D: Monocular 3-D Glass Detection With Plane Regression and Adaptive Feature Fusion
MonoGlass3D：基于平面回归和自适应特征融合的单目3D眼镜检测
在 3D 环境中检测与定位玻璃对视觉感知系统构成了重大挑战，因为玻璃的光学特性往往会妨碍传统传感器准确区分玻璃表面。缺乏专注于玻璃物体的真实世界数据集进一步阻碍了该领域的发展。
为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一个全新的数据集，该数据集包含从不同真实世界场景中采集的、涵盖广泛玻璃配置并带有精准 3D 标注的数据。基于此数据集，我们提出了 MonoGlass3D——一套专为跨多样化环境下的单目 3D 玻璃检测而设计的创新方法。为了克服玻璃外观模糊性和上下文多样性带来的挑战，我们提出了一套自适应特征融合模块，使网络能够有效地捕获不同条件下的上下文信息。此外，为了利用玻璃表面独特的平面几何特性，我们提出了一套平面回归流水线，实现了几何属性在框架内的无缝集成。
大量实验表明，我们的方法在玻璃分割和单目玻璃深度估计方面均超越了最先进的方法。我们的结果突出了将几何线索与上下文线索结合用于透明表面理解的优势。
Detecting and localizing glass in 3-D environments poses significant challenges for visual perception systems, as the optical properties of glass often hinder conventional sensors from accurately distinguishing glass surfaces. The lack of real-world datasets focused on glass objects further impedes progress in this field. To address this issue, we introduce a new dataset featuring a wide range of glass configurations with precise 3-D annotations, collected from distinct real-world scenarios. On the basis of this dataset, we propose MonoGlass3D, a novel approach tailored for monocular 3-D glass detection across diverse environments. To overcome the challenges posed by the ambiguous appearance and context diversity of glass, we propose an adaptive feature fusion module that empowers the network to effectively capture contextual information in varying conditions. In addition, to exploit the distinct planar geometry of glass surfaces, we present a plane regression pipeline, which enables seamless integration of geometric properties within our framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both glass segmentation and monocular glass depth estimation. Our results highlight the advantages of combining geometric and contextual cues for transparent surface understanding.
Act on What You See: Unlocking Safe Social Navigation in Vision-Language-Action Models
根据所见采取行动：在视觉-语言-行动模型中解锁安全的社交导航
在 3D 环境中检测与定位玻璃对视觉感知系统构成了重大挑战，因为玻璃的光学特性往往会妨碍传统传感器准确区分玻璃表面。缺乏专注于玻璃物体的真实世界数据集进一步阻碍了该领域的发展。
为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一个全新的数据集，该数据集包含从不同真实世界场景中采集的、涵盖广泛玻璃配置并带有精准 3D 标注的数据。基于此数据集，我们提出了 MonoGlass3D——一套专为跨多样化环境下的单目 3D 玻璃检测而设计的创新方法。为了克服玻璃外观模糊性和上下文多样性带来的挑战，我们提出了一套自适应特征融合模块，使网络能够有效地捕获不同条件下的上下文信息。此外，为了利用玻璃表面独特的平面几何特性，我们提出了一套平面回归流水线，实现了几何属性在框架内的无缝集成。
大量实验表明，我们的方法在玻璃分割和单目玻璃深度估计方面均超越了最先进的方法。我们的结果突出了将几何线索与上下文线索结合用于透明表面理解的优势。
Safe social navigation requires robots to distinguish people from ordinary obstacles and to react before danger becomes imminent. We show that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models already encode pedestrian-object distinctions and future collision signals in their internal representations, but behavior cloning fails to translate these signals into socially appropriate actions. To address this mismatch, we propose SALSA, a two-stage annotation-free post-training framework: (1) social behavioral alignment bridges intermediate-layer social features to the action head and trains on counterfactual human-object scene pairs to break visual saliency shortcuts; (2) temporal safety alignment provides automatically generated future-risk supervision to enable anticipatory collision avoidance. On SCAND and real-world deployment, SALSA reduces near-collisions by 86.4% and improves social counterfactual accuracy from 53% to 93%, demonstrating that safer social navigation can be achieved by teaching VLA policies to act on representations they already possess. These results show that pretrained VLA policies can be adapted for safer social navigation by better aligning their latent representations with action generation.
Rapid Embodiment Adaptation for Quadrupedal Locomotion
面向四足运动的快速具身适应
人类能够随着身体因衰老、受伤或负重而发生变化迅速调整运动方式，但基于学习的机器人策略在硬件属性发生变化时往往会失效。
我们提出了一套面向四足运动的在线具身自适应框架，该框架能够从短暂的交互历史中推理出具身参数（Embodiment parameters），并以推理出的硬件状态为条件来控制机器人。我们的方法将一个在具身随机化设定下训练的通用策略（Generalist policy）与一个轻量级自适应模块相匹配，该模块能够在半秒（0.5 秒）内识别出物理属性的变化。我们评估了两种具有代表性的具身变化形式：关节范围约束和躯干质量变化，分别对应关节层面的运动学退化和身体层面的动力学变化。
在仿真中，该模块能够准确估计这些变化，并实现闭环控制，其性能显著优于直接以交互历史为条件的策略。在真实世界的 Unitree Go2 机器人上，我们的系统在所评估的严苛变化场景下（包括单腿完全锁定以及搭载 5 kg 负载）仍能保持稳定的运动，而非自适应方法在这些场景下均告失败。这些结果证明了显式在线具身识别在快速适应关节极限和负载质量变化方面的实用性，并为处理更广泛形式的不确定、退化或变化的机器人硬件迈出了重要一步。
Humans readily adapt their movements as their bodies change through aging, injury, or load carrying, but learning-based robot policies often break when hardware properties shift. We introduce an online embodiment adaptation framework for quadrupedal locomotion that infers embodiment parameters from short interaction histories and conditions control on the inferred hardware state. Our method pairs a generalist policy trained under embodiment randomization with a lightweight adaptation module that identifies physical changes within half a second. We evaluate two representative forms of embodiment variation: joint-range constraints and trunk-mass changes, corresponding to joint-level kinematic degradation and body-level dynamic variation. In simulation, the module accurately estimates these changes and enables closed-loop control that substantially outperforms policies conditioned directly on interaction history. On a real Unitree Go2 robot, our system maintains stable locomotion under severe instances of the evaluated changes, including a fully locked leg and a 5 kg payload, where non-adaptive methods fail. These results demonstrate the practicality of explicit online embodiment identification for rapid adaptation to joint-limit and payload-mass changes, and provide a step toward handling broader forms of uncertain, degraded, or changing robot hardware.
Motion Control Technology for Quadruped Robots Based on Reinforcement Learning
基于强化学习的四足机器人运动控制技术
四足机器人具备卓越的地形适应能力，在搜救、野外考察等场景中展现出广阔的应用前景。然而，传统的基于模型的运动控制方法面临着建模过程繁琐以及泛化性能较差的问题，难以胜任非结构化的复杂环境。
为了解决这些局限性，本文对基于深度强化学习的四足机器人运动控制技术进行了系统性的综述。文章首先梳理了机器人运动学与强化学习的基础理论，随后将该领域的研究进展划分为三个核心研究分支进行分类归纳与总结：步态生成、自主导航以及自适应步态切换。此外，本文深入分析了在硬件部署、样本效率以及模型泛化能力方面面临的主流挑战与相应的应对策略。文中指出，多算法的进一步融合、仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）转换的优化以及整体策略设计的提升将成为该领域的主要发展趋势。
通过梳理当前的技术瓶颈并预测未来的发展趋势，本作为该领域的技术落地与后续研究提供了有价值的参考。
Quadruped robots possess outstanding terrain adaptability and boast extensive application prospects in scenarios such as search and rescue, field exploration, and more. Nevertheless, conventional model-based motion control methods suffer from cumbersome modeling processes and poor generalization performance, making them ill-suited for unstructured complex environments. To address these limitations, this paper presents a comprehensive review of deep reinforcement learning-based motion control technologies for quadruped robots. It first organizes the fundamental theories concerning robot kinematics and reinforcement learning, then categorizes and summarizes research advances across three core research branches: gait generation, autonomous navigation, and adaptive gait transition. Furthermore, this paper analyzes prevailing challenges and corresponding countermeasures regarding hardware deployment, sample efficiency, and model generalization capacity. It points out that further integration of multi-algorithms, optimization of sim-to-real transformation and overall strategy design will be the main trends in this field. By identifying current technical bottlenecks and forecasting future development trends, this work offers valuable references for practical technical implementation and subsequent research within this field.
Modeling mechanical disturbances induced by high intensity magnetic fields on electric motors
高强度磁场作用下电动机机械扰动的建模
在诸如欧洲核子研究中心（CERN）的地下研究设施等危险且磁场环境复杂的场所中，机器人平台的使用日益增加，这对深入理解强外部磁场如何影响机电驱动提出了紧迫要求。搭载电磁（EM）电机的四足机器人尤为脆弱，因为它们的执行器会与环境磁通量发生直接相互作用，产生附加的机械力与力矩，进而削弱系统稳定性、轨迹跟踪精度以及整体运行安全性。
本工作提出了一套建模框架，用于估计强磁场作用下电磁电机的等效磁矩。所提方法将数值仿真数据集与基于偶极子的解析公式相结合，导出了一套高计算效率的模型，能够实时预测磁感应机械扰动。该模型考虑了磁矩对外部磁场强度以及电机相对于磁场线方向的依赖性，从而使控制系统能够预判扰动力矩并实施恰当的补偿策略。
通过将 Unitree GO-M8010-6 电机在受控磁场中旋转，并将实测力矩与模型预测值进行对比，实验验证了该模型的准确性与可靠性。结果表明，预测值与实测值在趋势和幅值上均展现出高度一致性，证实了所提公式能够提供强磁场严酷环境下实时控制应用所需的保真度。
The increasing use of robotic platforms in hazardous and magnetically complex environments, such as underground research facilities at CERN, demands a detailed understanding of how strong external magnetic fields affect electromechanical actuation. Quadruped robots equipped with electromagnetic (EM) motors are particularly vulnerable, as their actuators interact directly with ambient magnetic fluxes, generating additional mechanical forces and moments that can compromise stability, trajectory tracking and overall operational safety. This work presents a modeling framework for estimating the equivalent magnetic moment of an EM motor subjected to high-intensity magnetic fields. The proposed approach combines numerical simulation datasets with an analytical dipole-based formulation to derive a computationally efficient model capable of predicting magnetic-induced mechanical disturbances in real/time. The model accounts for the dependence of the magnetic moment on both the external field intensity and the motor’s orientation relative to the field lines, enabling the control system to anticipate disturbance torques and implement appropriate compensation strategies. The accuracy and reliability of the model were validated experimentally by rotating a Unitree GO-M8010-6 motor within controlled magnetic fields and comparing the measured torques with the model predictions. The results demonstrate close agreement in both trend and amplitude, confirming that the proposed formulation can provide the level of fidelity required for real-time control applications in magnetically harsh environments.
Learning to Walk With Less: A Dyna-Style Approach to Quadrupedal Locomotion
学会“少即是多”：一种基于 Dyna 架构的四足运动控制方法
传统的面向四足运动的同策略（On-policy）强化学习（RL）控制器通常面临数据效率低下的问题，需要与仿真环境进行数百万次交互才能实现稳定控制。
我们在 Dyna 风格的框架中集成了基于模型的优化技术，通过使用合成数据增强 PPO（Proximal Policy Optimization）的轨迹采样（Rollouts）来提升样本效率。我们的方法采用一个已学习的状态转移模型为每条轨迹生成短时程的合成尾部（Synthetic tails），并以基于物理的仿真为锚点以保持系统稳定性。一种预定义的调度策略逐渐引入合成状态转移，从而避免在预测准确率较低的训练早期使用该模型。通过大量的消融实验，我们深入分析了不同数据参数对 PPO 学习行为的影响。
最后，我们在 Unitree Go1 机器人仿真环境中验证了该方法：在不降低策略性能或收敛性的前提下，以显著减少的仿真步数（19.64M 对比 27.53M）和 12.24% 的训练实际时间（Wall-clock time）缩减实现了收敛。在 ANYmal 和 Unitree Go2 上的跨平台实验进一步证实，尽管在复杂形态上存在奖励权衡，该框架仍具备以大幅减少的仿真经验学习高维运动控制的能力。
Traditional on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) controllers for quadrupedal locomotion often suffer from low data efficiency, requiring millions of interactions with simulated environments to achieve stable control. We integrate model-based techniques that improve sample efficiency by augmenting PPO rollouts with synthetic data in a Dyna-style framework. Our method employs a learned transition model to generate short-horizon synthetic tails for each trajectory, anchored by physics-based simulation to preserve stability. A predefined scheduling strategy gradually integrates synthetic transitions, preventing model usage during early training stages when prediction accuracy is low. Through extensive ablation studies, we analyze how varying data parameters influence PPO’s learning behavior. Finally, we validate our method in simulation on a Unitree Go1 robot, reaching convergence with substantially fewer simulation steps (19.64M vs. 27.53M) and a 12.24% reduction in wall-clock training time, without compromising policy performance or convergence. Cross-platform experiments on ANYmal and Unitree Go2 further confirm the framework’s ability to learn high-dimensional locomotion control with substantially reduced simulation experience, despite reward trade-offs on complex morphologies.
Residual-Based Adaptive Kalman Filtering for Legged Robot State Estimation
面向腿式机器人状态估计的基于残差的自适应卡尔曼滤波
状态估计是行走机器人基于模型控制的核心组成部分，并且广泛应用于需要推理隐变量（Hidden variables）的各种场景。卡尔曼滤波器（Kalman filter）被广泛用于通过融合多种感知模态来估计浮动基座（Floating-base）的位置和速度。然而，调校噪声参数极具挑战性，通常需要专家经验。此外，固定的噪声参数无法适应多变的步态与环境。
我们提出了一套针对过程噪声协方差矩阵 Q 与测量噪声协方差矩阵 R 的在线自适应策略。具体而言，我们引入了一种基于滤波器残差（Residual）与创新（Innovation）的协方差自适应方法，用于足式机器人状态估计，并将其与依赖惯性测量单元（IMU）和足端力测量的基线方法进行了评估对比。所提自适应机制在融合 IMU 与腿部运动学的不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器（Invariant Extended Kalman Filter, InEKF）中实现。在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上进行的室内与室外数据集实验表明，仅对 R 进行自适应便已足够，且在小跑（Trotting）步态下，相比固定参数调校的 InEKF，估计精度提升了 25%。最后，所提基于残差的自适应方法在无需足端力传感器或额外参数调校的情况下，取得了与足端力方法相当的性能。
State estimation is a key component in model-based control of walking robots and, more broadly, applicable wherever hidden variables must be inferred. The Kalman filter is widely used to estimate floating-base position and velocity by fusing multiple sensing modalities. However, tuning noise parameters is challenging and typically requires expert knowledge. Moreover, fixed noise parameters are unsuitable for varying gaits and environments. We propose an online adaptation strategy for the process noise covariance matrix Q and the measurement noise covariance matrix R. Specifically, we introduce a filter residual and innovation-based covariance adaptation method for legged robot state estimation and evaluate it against a baseline approach relying on IMU and foot force measurements. The proposed adaptation is implemented within an Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (InEKF) fusing IMU and leg kinematics. Experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets with a Unitree Go2 quadruped show that adapting R is sufficient and improves accuracy by 25% for the trotting gait compared to the fixed-tuned InEKF. Finally, the proposed residual-based adaptation achieves comparable performance to the foot force approach, without requiring foot force measurements or additional parameter tuning.
Vision-Based Autonomous Quadrupedal Robot for Rapid Post-Earthquake Crack-Based Building Damage Detection
基于视觉的自主四足机器人：震后基于裂缝的建筑物损伤快速检测
地震后快速且可靠的基于裂缝的视觉损伤检测，对于安全有效的灾害响应至关重要。对于深入不稳定结构内部的工程师而言，人工巡检往往漫长且充满危险。
本研究提出了一套用于强化混凝土结构地震后基于裂缝的快速视觉损伤检测的四足机器人巡检系统。一台配备 Intel RealSense D435i RGB-D 相机的 Unitree Go2 机器人从野外现场和公开来源收集了包含 3255 张带标注裂缝图像的数据集。在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier 上训练并部署的 YOLOv8n 模型，在强化混凝土试件的实验室测试中展现出了出色的检测性能，精确率（Precision）、召回率（Recall）以及 mAP@50 值均超过了 85%。该系统提供了快速、准确且自动化的结构健康评估，降低了人员风险并提升了危险灾后环境下的巡检效率。
未来的工作将集中于扩展损伤检测能力以及真实世界的部署落地。
Rapid and reliable crack-based visual damage detection after earthquakes is crucial for safe and effective disaster response. Manual inspections are often slow and hazardous for engineers in unstable structures. This study proposes a quadrupedal robotic inspection system for rapid post-earthquake crack-based visual damage detection in reinforced concrete structures. A Unitree Go2 robot equipped with an Intel RealSense D435i RGB-D camera collected a dataset of 3255 annotated crack images from both field and public sources. The YOLOv8n model, trained and deployed on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier, demonstrated high detection performance in laboratory tests on reinforced concrete specimens, with precision, recall, and mAP@50 values all exceeding 85%. The system provides fast, accurate, and automated structural health assessments, reducing human risk and improving inspection efficiency in hazardous post-disaster environments. Future work will focus on expanding damage detection capabilities and real-world deployment.
Open-DiffLoco: Open-Source Differentiable Learning for Deployable Blind Quadruped Locomotion
Open-DiffLoco：面向可部署盲态四足运动的可微分学习开源方案
本文介绍了 Open-DiffLoco——一套利用可微仿真（Differentiable simulation）训练可部署盲眼四足运动策略的开源框架。该框架在 MuJoCo XLA (MJX) 中实现了短时程 Actor-Critic（Short-Horizon Actor-Critic, SHAC）算法，并训练了一套能够直接迁移至真实硬件的本体感觉（Proprioceptive）策略。部署后的策略去除了包括基座线速度在内的特权 Actor 观测信息，且不依赖任何参考轨迹。此外，它采用了一套大幅简化的奖励函数，使机器人能够自主探索并形成行走模式，而无需传统强化学习流水线中常用的复杂辅助奖励。
在真实世界实验中，训练好的策略以低于 0.2 m/s 的均方根误差跟踪全向速度指令，最高速度突破 1 m/s，并对非平整地形和外部物理干扰保持了强鲁棒性。在报告的各种配置中，训练在单张 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 GPU 上占用的显存不足 6 GB，且仅需约 20 到 60 分钟即可完成。
作为 SHAC 的一种算法扩展，我们提出了雅可比增强价值估计（Jacobian Augmented Value Estimation, JAVE），该方法通过监督 Critic 的雅可比矩阵来改善训练早期的梯度的基于一阶政策导向的训练。据我们所知，Open-DiffLoco 是首个利用可微仿真训练可部署运动策略的开源框架。部署视频与源代码可在对应页面获取。
This paper introduces Open-DiffLoco, an open-source framework for training deployable blind quadruped locomotion policies with differentiable simulation. The framework implements the Short-Horizon Actor-Critic (SHAC) algorithm in MuJoCo XLA (MJX) and trains a proprioceptive policy that transfers to real-world hardware. The deployed policy removes privileged actor observations, including base linear velocity, and does not rely on reference trajectories. It also uses a substantially simplified reward function, allowing the robot to discover walking patterns without the complex auxiliary rewards often used by conventional reinforcement learning pipelines. In real-world experiments, the trained policy tracks omnidirectional velocity commands with root-mean-square error below 0.2 m/s, reaches speeds above 1 m/s, and remains robust to uneven terrain and external physical disturbances. Across the reported configurations, training uses under 6 GB of VRAM on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 GPU and completes in approximately 20-60 minutes. As an algorithmic extension to SHAC, we propose Jacobian Augmented Value Estimation (JAVE), which supervises critic Jacobians to improve early first-order policy-gradient training. To our knowledge, Open-DiffLoco is the first open-source framework for training deployable locomotion policies using differentiable simulation. Deployment videos and source code are available on this page.
TRACE: Ergodic Trajectory Optimization for Active Scene Reconstruction
TRACE：用于主动场景重建的各态历经轨迹优化
基于 3D 高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）地图的现存主动重建系统通常采用贪婪策略选择观测，在每一步仅优化单一的最优下一视角（Next-Best-View, NBV），并通过短时程路径规划将所选视角连接起来。这种贪婪解耦忽略了场景信息的全局结构，导致生成的轨迹效率低下，在所选视角之间的移动过程中浪费了感知能力。
在这项工作中，我们将主动重建重新表述为一个遍历覆盖问题（Ergodic coverage problem）：传感器的时均空间统计特性（Time-averaged spatial statistics）应当与当前地图引导的目标信息分布相匹配。我们的方法在线从不确定性与可见性中推导出该目标分布，并通过结合梯度流（Gradient flow）与视场消耗（Footprint depletion）的核函数遍历时程规划器（Kernel-ergodic horizon planner）计算遍历轨迹，从而闭环了地图构建与轨迹优化。
我们在 Replica 数据集上将 TRACE 与主流的 NBV 基线进行了全面评估，在 PSNR 上实现了 1.5 dB 的提升。
Existing active reconstruction systems with Gaussian-splatting maps select observations greedily, optimizing a single next-best-view (NBV) at each step and connecting the chosen views by short-horizon path planning. This greedy decoupling disregards the global structure of scene information, producing inefficient trajectories that waste sensing capacity in transit between selected views. In this work, we study active reconstruction as an ergodic coverage problem: the time-averaged spatial statistics of the sensor trajectory should match a target information distribution induced by the current map. Our approach derives this target distribution online from uncertainty and visibility, and calculates ergodic trajectories via a kernel-ergodic horizon planner with gradient flow and footprint depletion, closing the loop between mapping and trajectory optimization. We thoroughly evaluate TRACE on the Replica dataset against the Next-Best-View (NBV) baselines, improving PSNR by 1.5 dB.
SCAPE: Scenario-Conditioned Simulation-Augmented Policy Evaluation
SCAPE：基于场景条件与仿真增强的策略评估
可靠的性能评估是将机器人学习策略部署于真实世界条件下的核心瓶颈。真实世界测试虽然忠实反映真实情况，但成本高昂且难以扩展；而基于仿真的测试虽然易于扩展，但不可避免地受到仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）差距的偏置影响。现有的结合仿真的增强评估方法将有限的真实世界轨迹与丰富的仿真代理结合起来，但其重点关注的是在初始条件和部署设定上平均后的性能。这种群体层面的平均掩盖了特定场景下的差异，并且对于策略“何时”以及“在何处”可以安全部署所提供的指导相当有限。
我们提出了 SCAPE——一套基于场景条件的仿真增强策略评估框架（Scenario-conditioned simulation-augmented policy evaluation framework），该框架利用有限的成对仿真与真实样本以及大规模仿真轨迹，预测基于场景条件的真实世界策略性能。SCAPE 在训练预测模型之前校正仿真标签中的 Sim-to-Real 偏置，并通过符合性预测（Conformal prediction）校准预测的不确定性。
我们在自动驾驶和四足机器人速度跟踪任务上验证了 SCAPE。在仿真到仿真（Sim-to-Sim）研究中，相较于场景条件神经网络和聚合统计基线，SCAPE 将场景层面的预测误差平均降低了 4.9%/34.7%（驾驶）和 14.5%/27.7%（四足）。我们进一步评估了部署在物理 Unitree Go2 机器人上的速度跟踪策略。SCAPE 还提升了测试样本效率，产生了更窄且经过校准的预测区间，能更好地泛化到域外（Out-of-distribution）场景，并支持细粒度的部署策略。
Reliable performance evaluation is a central bottleneck for deploying robot-learning policies in real-world conditions. Real-world testing is faithful but costly and difficult to scale, whereas simulation-based testing scales easily but is inevitably biased by the sim-to-real gap. Existing simulation-augmented methods combine limited real-world rollouts with abundant simulation proxies, but focus on performance averaged over initial conditions and deployment settings. Such population-level averages obscure scenario-specific variation and provide limited guidance about when and where a policy can be safely deployed. We propose SCAPE, a scenario-conditioned simulation-augmented policy evaluation framework that predicts scenario-conditioned real-world policy performance using limited paired sim-and-real samples and large-scale simulation rollouts. SCAPE corrects sim-to-real bias in simulation labels before training the prediction model and calibrates prediction uncertainty through conformal prediction. We validate SCAPE on autonomous driving and quadruped velocity tracking. In sim-to-sim studies, SCAPE reduces scenario-level prediction error by 4.9%/34.7% (driving) and 14.5%/27.7% (quadruped) relative to scene-conditioned neural and aggregate statistical baselines on average. We further evaluate a velocity-tracking policy deployed on a physical Unitree Go2. SCAPE also improves testing sample efficiency, produces narrower calibrated prediction intervals, generalizes better to out-of-distribution scenarios, and enables fine-grained deployment strategies.
OccPlanner: Goal-Aware Occupancy-Conditioned Diffusion Planner for Pixel-Goal Navigation
OccPlanner：面向像素级目标导航的、具备目标感知能力且基于占用状态条件的扩散规划器
像素目标导航（Pixel-goal navigation）直接在智能体的相机视图中指定目标，但目标像素既无法提供度量深度（Metric depth），也无法提供可通行性信息（Traversability），使得 3D 目标接地（3D goal grounding）和无碰撞连续规划面临严峻挑战。
我们提出了 OccPlanner——一套目标感知的占据条件扩散规划器（Goal-aware occupancy-conditioned diffusion planner），它将像素目标接地到以自我为中心的度量空间（Egocentric metric space）中，并在时序视觉上下文和已学习的局部 3D 占据特征（Local 3D occupancy features）上对目标表示进行顺序条件化。为了大规模提供占据标注监督，我们引入了 L3ROcc，该方法通过几何重建与基于光线的光照/可见性推理（Ray-based visibility reasoning），将单目 RGB 导航视频转换为以机器人为中心的局部 3D 占据标注。
我们在 InternData-N1 上训练了 OccPlanner，并在 InternScenes 的四个未见场景类别和两个目标距离范围内进行了闭环仿真评估。在 5-8 米的设定下，OccPlanner 在四个类别中将相比 NavDP 的平均成功率（SR）从 20.81% 提升至 71.55%，并在“易杂乱（Cluttered-easy）”和“难杂乱（Cluttered-hard）”场景中分别达到了 86.20% 和 84.92%。在 Unitree Go2 上进行的真实世界开环实验进一步提供了 Sim-to-Real 迁移以及利用 L3ROcc 生成的监督进行自适应的初步证据。
Pixel-goal navigation specifies targets directly in the agent's camera view, but a target pixel provides neither metric depth nor traversability, making 3D goal grounding and collision-free continuous planning challenging. We present OccPlanner, a goal-aware occupancy-conditioned diffusion planner that grounds pixel goals in egocentric metric space and sequentially conditions the goal representation on temporal visual context and learned local 3D occupancy features. To provide occupancy supervision at scale, we introduce L3ROcc, which converts monocular RGB navigation videos into robot-centric local 3D occupancy annotations through geometric reconstruction and ray-based visibility reasoning. We train OccPlanner on InternData-N1 and evaluate it in closed-loop simulation across four unseen scene categories from InternScenes and two goal-distance ranges. In the 5-8 m setting, OccPlanner increases the average success rate (SR) over NavDP from 20.81% to 71.55% across the four categories, reaching 86.20% and 84.92% in cluttered-easy and cluttered-hard scenes, respectively. Real-world open-loop experiments on a Unitree Go2 further provide initial evidence of sim-to-real transfer and adaptation with L3ROcc-generated supervision.
Semantic-Geometric Fusion NMPC for Executable Mapless Quadruped Navigation on Tactile Paving
面向触觉铺装路面无图导航的可执行语义-几何融合非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）
在受限行人环境中的无图自主导航，要求移动机器人将局部语义与几何感知转化为物理上可执行的运动指令。本文提出了一套适用于在包含静态和动态障碍物的盲道（Tactile paving）上运行的四足机器人的语义-几何融合导航框架。
基于形态学的拓扑重建模块在不依赖预建地图的情况下，将视觉语义掩码（Visual semantic masks）转换为连续的中心线参考，同时提升了对局部断裂和噪声的鲁棒性。视觉盲道轨迹与 LiDAR 障碍物观测随后被投影到一个统一的机器人机体坐标系中，为局部规划提供度量表示。在此表示的基础上，特定任务的非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）方案整合了语义路径跟踪、几何避障、角速度响应近似、指令平滑以及执行层安全过滤。
在配备 RGB-D 与 LiDAR 传感器的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上进行的实验表明，与传统的路径提取和局部规划基线相比，该框架提升了路径覆盖率、缺口修复精度、无碰撞穿越能力，并降低了指令振荡。结果表明，所提框架提升了四足机器人在盲道环境中导航的鲁棒性与可执行性。
Mapless autonomous navigation in constrained pedestrian environments requires mobile robots to transform local semantic and geometric perception into physically executable motion commands. This paper presents a semantic-geometric fusion navigation framework for a quadruped robot operating on tactile paving with static and dynamic obstacles. A morphology-based topological reconstruction module converts visual semantic masks into continuous centerline references without relying on pre-built maps, while also improving robustness to local fractures and noise. Visual tactile-paving trajectories and LiDAR obstacle observations are then projected into a unified robot body frame, providing a metric representation for local planning. Based on this representation, a task-specific nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) scheme integrates semantic path tracking, geometric obstacle avoidance, angular-velocity response approximation, command smoothing, and execution-layer safety filtering. Experiments on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot equipped with RGB-D and LiDAR sensors demonstrate improved path coverage, gap-repair accuracy, collision-free traversal, and reduced command oscillation compared with conventional path extraction and local planning baselines. The results show that the proposed framework improves the robustness and executability of quadruped navigation in tactile-paving environments.
Learning-Based Measurement-Robust Control Barrier Functions for Obstacle Avoidance under State Estimation Error
面向状态估计误差下避障任务的基于学习的抗测量噪声控制障碍函数
安全过滤器（Safety filters）是在安全攸关系统（Safety-critical systems）中强制执行约束的有效工具，但大多数现有方法均假设具备完美的状态信息，这在实际中极少能满足。近期工作已开始通过开发对状态估计误差具备鲁棒性的过滤机制来填补这一空白，但随着估计误差的增大，这些方法仍可能出现安全违规或表现出过于保守的行为。
针对避障问题，我们提出了两种全新的控制屏障函数（Control Barrier Function, CBF）构型：漂移测量鲁棒 CBF（Drift-Measurement-Robust CBF, DMR-CBF）以及神经网络测量鲁棒 CBF（Neural Measurement-Robust CBF, NMR-CBF）。DMR-CBF 通过对漂移动力学中最坏情况不确定性进行内部优化来增强标准 CBF 条件，从而提升对估计误差的鲁棒性。随后，该 DMR-CBF 监督 NMR-CBF 的预训练阶段，后者用一个已学习的项替代了内部优化。NMR-CBF 随后通过可微轨迹采样（Differentiable trajectory rollouts）进行微调，所得到的过滤器取得了与 DMR-CBF 相当的经验安全性，同时降低了保守性与计算开销。
我们提供了 DMR-CBF 的理论分析，并在平面双积分器（Planar double integrator）和 12 维四旋翼无人机（12D Quadrotor）上进行了数值实验，结果表明，在我们提出的方法成功防止碰撞的同时，其他鲁棒方法要么失败，要么过于保守。最后，我们将 NMR-CBF 部署于 Unitree Go2 机器人上，实现在导致标准 CBF 发生碰撞的里程计误差下，成功完成了障碍物区域的导航。
Safety filters are an effective tool for enforcing constraints in safety-critical systems, but most existing methods assume perfect state information, which is rarely available in practice. Recent work has begun to close this gap by developing filtering mechanisms that are robust to state estimation error, but these methods can still exhibit safety violations or overly conservative behavior as estimation error grows. Focusing on obstacle avoidance, we develop two new control barrier function (CBF) formulations: drift-measurement-robust (DMR)-CBFs and neural measurement-robust (NMR)-CBFs. The DMR-CBF augments the standard CBF condition with an inner optimization over the worst-case uncertainty in the drift dynamics, improving robustness to estimation error. This DMR-CBF then supervises a pretraining phase for the NMR-CBF, which replaces the inner optimization with a learned term. The NMR-CBF is subsequently finetuned through differentiable trajectory rollouts, yielding a filter that achieves empirical safety comparable to the DMR-CBF while reducing both conservativeness and computational cost. We provide theoretical analysis of the DMR-CBF along with numerical results on a planar double integrator and a 12D quadrotor, where both proposed approaches prevent collisions while other robust methods either fail or are overly conservative. Finally, we deployed the NMR-CBF on a Unitree Go2, enabling successful navigation of an obstacle field under odometry errors that caused a standard CBF to collide.
CompCPZ: Preserving Multi-Modal Intent in Language-Guided Robot Manipulation
CompCPZ：在语言引导的机器人操作任务中保持多模态意图
当收到“将杯子放在红盘子或蓝盘子附近”的指令时，机器人可能会到达两者之间的质心位置，在几何形态上看似成功，却未能满足指令中的任何一个析取分支（Disjunct）。这种隐蔽的语义失败暴露了语言条件机器人策略（Language-conditioned robot policies）的结构性局限：将析取指令折叠为单个连通集的表示方式无法保留所有可行的模态（Feasible modes），而在运行时面对模态不确定性时盲目承诺单一动作的规划器性能会严重退化。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了 CompCPZ——一套完备的代数层，语言条件学习系统可以通过包裹该代数层来恢复多模态析取表示。它沿着语言语法解析树，递归组合每个原语的约束多项式 Zonotope 包络（Constrained polynomial zonotope enclosures），具备无分布符合性覆盖能力且运行时间达到毫秒级以下（Sub-millisecond）。在闭环 ManiSkill3 桌面操作基准测试中，CompCPZ 击败了凸集基线、多峰解码器以及零样本视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（取得 1,900/1,918 次成对胜出，p << 10^(-30)）；该编译器还在无需重新调校的情况下，成功迁移到了在运动捕捉系统下运行的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人的平面真实世界实验中。这些结果表明，组合式语言接地不仅应通过是否到达解码目标来评估，更应通过所表示的可行集是否保持了用户意图的连通分量结构来评估。
A robot asked to "place the cup near the red plate or the blue plate" may reach the centroid between them and appear geometrically successful, while satisfying neither disjunct of the instruction. This silent semantic failure exposes a structural limitation of language-conditioned robot policies: representations that collapse a disjunctive instruction into a single connected set cannot preserve all feasible modes, and planners that commit to one action degrade under run-time mode uncertainty. We address this limitation with CompCPZ, a sound algebraic layer that language-conditioned learning systems wrap to recover multi-modal disjunctive representation, recursively composing per-primitive constrained polynomial zonotope enclosures along the language parse tree with distribution-free conformal coverage and sub-millisecond runtime. On a closed-loop ManiSkill3 tabletop-manipulation benchmark, CompCPZ outperforms convex set baselines, multi-peak decoders, and a zero-shot vision-language-action model (1,900/1,918 paired wins, p << 10^(-30)); the same compiler also transfers without retuning to planar real-robot trials on a Unitree Go2 quadruped under motion capture. These results suggest that compositional language grounding should be evaluated not only by reaching a decoded target, but by whether the represented feasibility set preserves the connected-component structure of the user's intent.
An Edge-Deployable Method for Cow-Head Detection and Cross-Camera Association in Visible–Thermal Robotic Dairy Monitoring
一种用于可见光-热红外机器人奶牛监测的牛头检测与跨相机关联的边缘部署方法
面部表面温度为监控奶牛的健康、福利、热应激和繁殖状态提供了有价值的非接触式信息。红外热成像技术可以获取眼部、吻部、鼻孔和耳部等面部区域的热信息；然而，红外图像通常纹理较弱且解剖边界模糊，这可能会妨碍移动机器人巡检过程中可靠的奶牛头部定位。可见光图像能提供更丰富的结构信息，但并不包含温度数据。
本研究开发了 YOLO11-AFE——一种适用于四足巡检机器人的轻量级可见光-热红外奶牛头部检测与异构相机关联方法。该检测器引入了用于轻量化下采样的 ADown 模块、用于自适应特征增强的 C3k2_FE 模块，以及用于通道感知的多尺度表示的 SPPF_ECA 模块。随后，使用改进的匈牙利匹配算法（Hungarian matching algorithm）在同步的可见光和红外伪彩图像中的奶牛头部检测结果之间建立了一对一的对应关系。
在三次独立运行中，YOLO11-AFE 在可见光测试子集上分别取得了 97.59 ± 0.20% 的精确率、96.37 ± 0.24% 的 mAP@0.5 和 70.76 ± 0.51% 的 mAP@0.5:0.95；在红外子集上分别取得了 96.11 ± 0.24%、99.07 ± 0.10% 和 91.50 ± 0.40%。该模型的参数量为 214 万，计算量为 5.27 GFLOPs，相比 YOLO11n 分别减少了 17.37% 和 18.17%。在联合验证与测试评估中，该关联方法在 371 对真值（Ground-truth）奶牛头部配对上达到了 98.11% 的总体准确率。在 Jetson Orin NX 上采用 TensorRT FP16 进行部署时，完整的核心处理流水线达到了 36.71 FPS。这些结果表明，YOLO11-AFE 为未来使用移动巡检机器人进行非接触式面部温度监控提供了一个准确且计算高效的感知前端。
Facial surface temperature provides useful non-contact information for monitoring dairy-cow health, welfare, heat stress, and reproductive status. Infrared thermography can capture thermal information from facial regions such as the eyes, muzzle, nostrils, and ears; however, infrared images often contain weak texture and indistinct anatomical boundaries, which can hinder reliable cow-head localization during mobile robotic inspection. Visible-light images provide richer structural information but do not contain temperature data. This study developed YOLO11-AFE, a lightweight visible–thermal cow-head detection and heterogeneous-camera association method for quadruped inspection robots. The detector incorporates ADown for lightweight downsampling, C3k2_FE for adaptive feature enhancement, and SPPF_ECA for channel-aware multi-scale representation. An improved Hungarian matching algorithm was subsequently used to establish one-to-one correspondences between cow-head detections in synchronized visible-light and infrared pseudo-colour images. Across three independent runs, YOLO11-AFE achieved precision, mAP@0.5, and mAP@0.5:0.95 values of 97.59 ± 0.20%, 96.37 ± 0.24%, and 70.76 ± 0.51%, respectively, on the visible-light test subset, and 96.11 ± 0.24%, 99.07 ± 0.10%, and 91.50 ± 0.40%, respectively, on the infrared subset. The model required 2.14 million parameters and 5.27 GFLOPs, representing reductions of 17.37% and 18.17%, respectively, relative to YOLO11n. The association method achieved an overall accuracy of 98.11% across 371 ground-truth cow-head pairs in the combined validation and test evaluation. TensorRT FP16 deployment on the Jetson Orin NX achieved 36.71 FPS for the complete core processing pipeline. These results demonstrate that YOLO11-AFE provides an accurate and computationally efficient perception front end for future non-contact facial-temperature monitoring using mobile inspection robots.
Embodied Multimodal Grounding for Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation via Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting
基于语义3D高斯溅射的开放词汇移动操作具身多模态接地
具身移动操作（Embodied mobile manipulation）要求在执行前将语言、视觉观测、三维场景结构以及动作可行性进行对齐。
我们研究了局部家庭工作空间中带少样本操作的开放词汇目标接地（Open-vocabulary target grounding），并提出了一套具身多模态接地框架，该框架集成了主动多视角语义 3D 高斯泼溅（Semantic-3DGS）、可达性感知的基座定位，以及基于扩散模型的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。一个任务驱动的局部 Semantic-3DGS 作为跨主动感知、语言条件化 3D 定位、障碍物感知场景推理、基座准备和动作模型语义条件化的共享接口。为了保留预训练的动作先验，3D 语义线索仅被注入到晚期动作专家块（Late action-expert blocks）中。
在与代表性视觉-语言-动作（VLA）方法的 50 次拓展真实机器人对比评估中，完整系统实现了 60% 的长时程（Long-horizon）成功率，而 PointVLA 为 40%，DexVLA 为 28%；在重度杂乱操作中取得了 74% 的成功率，而单视角变体为 52%，PointVLA 为 46%。系统还在 75 厘米的高度偏移下保持了 75% 的成功率，并消除了照片诱导的假抓取（Photo-induced false grasps）。这些结果表明，显式且可刷新的 3D 语义接地可以提高在杂乱、遮挡、视角变化和具身约束下的鲁棒性。
Embodied mobile manipulation requires language, visual observations, three-dimensional scene structure, and action feasibility to be aligned before execution. We study open-vocabulary target grounding with few-shot manipulation in local household workspaces and present an embodied multimodal grounding framework that integrates active multi-view Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (Semantic-3DGS), reachability-aware base positioning, and a diffusion-based vision-language-action policy. A task-driven local Semantic-3DGS serves as a shared interface across active sensing, language-conditioned 3D localization, obstacle-aware scene reasoning, base preparation, and semantic conditioning of the action model. To preserve pretrained action priors, the 3D semantic cues are injected only into the late action-expert blocks. In expanded 50-trial real-robot evaluations against representative vision-language-action (VLA) approaches, the full system achieves 60% long-horizon success compared with 40% for PointVLA and 28% for DexVLA, and reaches 74% success in heavily cluttered manipulation compared with 52% for the single-view variant and 46% for PointVLA. It also maintains 75% success under a 75 cm height shift and eliminates photo-induced false grasps. These results indicate that explicit, refreshable 3D semantic grounding can improve robustness under clutter, occlusion, viewpoint variation, and embodiment constraints.
GuideFetch: A Task Coordination Framework for Concurrent Navigation and Object Retrieval in Assistive Robot Dogs
GuideFetch：一种用于辅助导盲机器狗并发执行导航与物体取回任务的协调框架
设想一只机器人导盲犬护送视障用户就座，同时第二只机器人检索并交付物品的场景。我们提出了 GuideFetch——一套用于在异构机器人协同下协调这种并“引导-检索”（Guide-and-fetch）任务的框架。
大型语言模型（LLM）实例化了一个受调度条件约束的四动作模式（Four-action schema）；确定性归一化与验证机制强制落实已注册的目标、机器人能力以及所选调度，而机器人与物品的状态则控制着执行与完成。我们在 90 个场景与随机种子组合下，针对脚本化（Scripted）与在线计划来源（Online plan-provenance）条件，记录了 360 次仿真运行。所有 180 次在线响应均在首次请求时通过验证并与其脚本参考相匹配，因此计划来源对比测试的是归一化计划的一致性，而非独立的执行因素。一项无仿真器的突变测试（Mutation test）接受了两个有效控制组，并拒绝了全部 32 个违反规则的变体。
在每个调度下的 90 个场景-种子案例中，顺序（Sequential）与并行（Parallel）执行分别取得了 72/90 和 71/90 的运行成功率。在 56 个共同成功的案例中，所实现的角色重新分配并行协议将平均完工时间（Makespan）缩短了 41.3%。这种系统层面的增益结合了角色分配、动作重叠与场景几何；状态检查将计划有效性与已验证的任务完成情况区分开来。
Consider one robot guide dog escorting a blind user to a seat while a second retrieves and delivers an object. We introduce GuideFetch, a framework for coordinating this concurrent guide-and-fetch mission with heterogeneous robots. A large language model (LLM) instantiates a schedule-conditioned four-action schema; deterministic normalization and validation enforce registered targets, robot capabilities, and the selected schedule, while robot and object states govern execution and completion. We record 360 simulator runs over 90 scene--seed combinations under scripted and online plan-provenance conditions. All 180 online responses validate on the first request and match their scripted references, so the plan-provenance comparison tests normalized-plan agreement rather than a distinct execution factor. A simulator-free mutation test accepts two valid controls and rejects all 32 rule-violating variants. Across 90 scene--seed cases per schedule, sequential and parallel execution achieve 72/90 and 71/90 operational successes. Among 56 common successes, the implemented role-reassigned parallel protocol reduces mean makespan by 41.3\%. This system-level gain combines role assignment, action overlap, and scene geometry; state checks distinguish plan validity from verified mission completion.
Robot-Body-Aware Traversal Risk Graph Planning for Wheeled-Legged Robots in Complex Terrain
复杂地形下轮腿式机器人基于机体感知能力的通行风险图规划
通行风险图（Traversal Risk Graphs, TRGs）为全局导航提供了一种紧凑且感知地形的图表示，但原生的 TRG 代价计算是基于圆形节点邻域和沿边对齐的地形区域，而非机器人的定向机体占用空间（Oriented body footprint）。对于轮履/轮足式（Wheeled-legged）机器人而言，这种抽象会忽略局部支撑丢失和机体-地形干涉，尤其是在转弯过程中。
我们提出了机器人机体感知 TRG 规划（Robot-Body-Aware TRG planning, RB-TRG），该方法构建于稀疏 TRG 表示之上，并将边向地形风险搜索提升为感知朝向与转弯的机体风险转移。在图边与偏航角扫描路径上对定向矩形占用空间进行采样，以测量纵向支撑变化、横向倾角、地形干涉以及对不可信地图区域的暴露程度。均值与上尾部特征（Mean-and-upper-tail features）被整合到转移代价中，其累积值通过 A* 算法在有序节点对状态上进行最小化，从而保留了 TRG 的构建流程及其规划接口。
我们在四个扫描地形环境的同图对比实验以及成对的闭环 MuJoCo 仿真试验中对 RB-TRG 进行了评估。RB-TRG 降低了三项核心几何机体放置指标，并将端到端成功率从 51.5% 提高至 68.5%，同时平均路径长度仅增加 2.3%。在 Go2-W 机器人上的部署进一步展示了 RB-TRG 与完整 LiDAR 导航栈的结合，该成果在 IEEE ICRA 2026 足式机器人挑战赛中荣获最佳自主奖（Best Autonomy）与最佳移动力奖（Best Mobility）。
Traversal Risk Graphs (TRGs) provide a compact, terrain-aware representation for global navigation, but native TRG costs are computed over circular node neighborhoods and edge-aligned terrain regions rather than the robot's oriented body footprint. For wheeled-legged robots, this abstraction can miss partial support loss and body-terrain interference, especially during turns. We present Robot-Body-Aware TRG planning (RB-TRG), which builds on the sparse TRG representation and lifts edge-wise terrain-risk search to heading- and turn-aware body-risk transitions. An oriented rectangular footprint is sampled along graph edges and yaw sweeps to measure longitudinal support variation, lateral inclination, terrain interference, and exposure to untrusted map regions. Mean-and-upper-tail features are incorporated into transition costs, whose accumulated value is minimized by A* over ordered node-pair states, preserving TRG construction and its planning interface. We evaluate RB-TRG in a same-graph study on four scanned terrain environments and in paired closed-loop MuJoCo trials. RB-TRG reduces the three core geometric body-placement metrics and increases end-to-end success from 51.5% to 68.5%, while increasing mean path length by 2.3%. A Go2-W deployment further demonstrates RB-TRG with a full LiDAR navigation stack, which received the Best Autonomy and Best Mobility awards at the IEEE ICRA 2026 Legged Robot Challenges.
Efficient Ripeness Monitoring in Open-Facility Environments Using a Quadruped Robot and Panoramic AI Recognition
利用四足机器人与全景AI识别技术在开放式设施环境中高效监测成熟度
在温室环境中，不平整的地形限制了传统轮式与轨道式平台的使用，而平面相机所提供的覆盖范围有限，这使得设施规模的高效番茄成熟度监控依然十分困难。
本研究开发了一套集成激光雷达（LiDAR）、深度相机和全景相机的轮足式四足机器人监控系统。一种自适应步态切换策略支持了机器人在异构地形上的导航。全景图像被投影为六个透视图，并使用基于 YOLOv8 的成熟度识别模型对左侧和右侧视图进行处理。时间同步的检测结果与机器人姿态被融合，将成熟度观测映射到三维温室坐标系中。在商业番茄设施中进行的五次野外实验展示了机器人的自主跨行穿越、行间换道以及对行人、障碍物和种植边界的避让。识别流水线在变化的光照、叶片遮挡和机器人运动情况下持续识别了多个成熟度阶段，同时空间融合程序合成了设施规模的三维成熟度分布。
地形自适应四足移动力、全景感知与空间映射的结合，为连续成熟度监控提供了一个实用的框架，并可为精准采摘、产量预测和作物管理提供支持。
Efficient facility-scale tomato ripeness monitoring remains difficult in greenhouses where uneven terrain limits conventional wheeled and rail-guided platforms and planar cameras provide restricted coverage. This study developed a wheel-legged quadruped monitoring system integrating LiDAR, a depth camera, and a panoramic camera. An adaptive gait-switching strategy supported navigation across heterogeneous terrain. Panoramic images were projected into six perspective views, and the left and right views were processed using a YOLOv8-based ripeness recognition model. Time-synchronized detections and robot poses were fused to map ripeness observations into three-dimensional greenhouse coordinates. Five field experiments in a commercial tomato facility demonstrated autonomous row traversal, inter-row transition, and avoidance of pedestrians, obstacles, and cultivation boundaries. The recognition pipeline continuously identified multiple ripeness stages under variable illumination, foliage occlusion, and robot motion, while the spatial fusion procedure produced a facility-scale three-dimensional ripeness distribution. The integration of terrain-adaptive quadruped mobility, panoramic perception, and spatial mapping provides a practical framework for continuous ripeness monitoring and can support targeted harvesting, yield forecasting, and crop management.
Dog Walk: Narrating Human-AI Alignment through Companion Robots
遛狗：通过伴侣机器人讲述人类与人工智能对齐的故事
《永远的最佳朋友》（Best Friends Forever, BFF）通过共同抚养两只机器人狗，探索了人类与人工智能关系中的亲密性、具身性、智能以及对齐问题。两位艺术家兼研究人员将相同的机器躯体与作为大脑的本地化、定制化大语言模型（LLMs）进行配对。在生成式人工智能时代，艺术家们训练模型行为，并就心灵、具身性与关系性等问题与模型开展对话。
这项反笛卡尔主义（Anti-Cartesian）的实验通过电影、表演和写作被记录下来，在合作者们交换并优化 AI 心灵、以追求介于人类复杂性与合成智能之间的结果的过程中，质询了仿真与真实性之间的边界。表演将现场的人机对话与来自人类及机器视角的双模态图像相结合，创造出一种混合的影音语言。
通过在真实空间中进行的主要交互赋予大语言模型以现场存在感与物理能动性，BFF 拓展了扩展现实（Extended Reality）的概念，使其涵盖了人工智能与机器人技术增强并最终变革我们日常生活场所的方式。
Best Friends Forever explores intimacy, embodiment, intelligence, and alignment in human-AI relationships by co-parenting two robot dogs. Two artist-researchers pair identical machine bodies with local, customized Large Language Models as brains. The artists train model behavior and dialogue with them on questions of mind, embodiment, and relationality in the age of generative AI. This anti-Cartesian experiment is documented through film, performance, and writing, interrogating boundaries between simulation and authenticity as the collaborators exchange and optimize the AIs minds towards an outcome between human complexity and synthetic intelligence. The performance blends live human-robot dialogue with multi-modal imagery drawn from human and machine perspectives, creating a hybrid cinematic language. With primary interactions occurring in real space, giving LLMs presence and physical agency, BFF broadens notions of extended reality to encompass the ways in which AI and robotics augment, and ultimately transform, our sites of daily life.
Spatiotemporal Agility: Time-Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Guided Dynamic Quadrupedal Interception
时空敏捷性：面向视觉引导动态四足机器人拦截任务的时间约束强化学习
足式机器人需要具备鲁棒的敏捷性，以便在受限的时间内感知复杂且动态的环境并与之交互。然而，大多数现有的四足机器人步态控制工作都依赖于速度跟踪策略（Velocity-tracking policy），这难以在严格的时间约束下精确到达特定目标。此外，由于传感器延迟和处理时延的存在，将实时感知与敏捷步态相结合以应对高动态目标仍然具有挑战性。
为了在动态环境中具体研究并基准测试这种敏捷性，我们引入了一项极具挑战性的足式机器人接球任务（Ball-catching task）。本文提出了一套集成框架，该框架将用于落点与时间预测的视觉模块与直接受位置和时间条件约束的强化学习（RL）步态策略相结合，而非采用中间速度指令。除了方法设计外，本工作还给出了系统层面的贡献：实现了一个完整的实时机器人拦截系统，该系统将多相机感知、在线轨迹预测、低延迟目标通信以及仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）步态控制集成到闭环部署流水线中。通过显式地预测未来时空目标，我们的方法缓解了动态拦截过程中的感知延迟。
我们为足式机器人开展了大量的接球实验。通过与速度跟踪基线的对比实验，我们的直接目标条件化方法在截获预测落点在 2 米以内、飞行时间介于 0.8 至 1.2 秒之间的球时取得了更高的成功率。这表明机器人系统在我们测试的设定下成功完成了动态接球任务。此外，我们的策略在部署后表现出更小的性能差距，表明在这些试验中具有改善的 Sim-to-Real 表现。
Legged robots require robust agility to perceive and interact with complex and dynamic environments within a constrained time. However, most existing quadruped locomotion works rely on velocity-tracking policy, which struggle to reach precise targets within strict temporal constraints. Moreover, integrating real-time perception with agile locomotion for highly dynamic targets remains challenging due to sensor latency and processing delays. To concretely study and benchmark such agility in dynamic settings, we introduce a challenging ball-catching task for legged robots. This paper proposes an integrated framework that combines a vision module for landing point and time prediction with a direct position and time conditioned RL locomotion policy, instead of intermediate velocity commands. Beyond the method design, this work presents a system-level contribution that completes real-time robotic interception system that integrates multi-camera perception, online trajectory prediction, low-latency target communication, and sim-to-real locomotion control into a closed-loop deployment pipeline. By explicitly predicting the future spatial-temporal target, our approach mitigates perception latency during dynamic interception. We conducted extensive ball-catching experiments for the legged robot. Through comparative experiments against a velocity-tracking baseline, our direct target-conditioned approach achieves a higher success rate in catching balls with predicted landing spots within 2 meters and flight times between 0.8 and 1.2 seconds.
