This shows that the robot has successfully completed the dynamic ball-catching task under our tested setup. Furthermore, our policy exhibits a smaller performance gap after deployment, suggesting improved sim-to-real behavior in these trials.
RAEM: Robust Autonomous Exploration for Multi-Floor Environments with a Quadruped Robot
RAEM：面向多层环境的四足机器人鲁棒自主探索
在这项工作中，我们提出了 RAEM——一套适用于四足机器人在多层建筑环境中运行的鲁棒自主探索框架（Robust autonomous exploration framework）。大多数现有的地面机器人探索方法依赖于平面可通行性表示（Planar traversability representations），这无法充分表示多层建筑的重叠结构和跨楼层连通性。尽管基于断层扫描（Tomography-based）的表示方法为多层导航提供了有效的可通行性建模，但在频繁重规划的在线探索过程中，维护全局断层扫描地图会带来巨大的计算开销。此外，楼梯间稀疏且碎裂的 LiDAR 观测会降低局部可通行性估计的质量，导致不规则的视点放置和暂时的拓扑断连。
为了解决这些挑战，RAEM 采用了一种混合的“局部-全局”可通行性表示：其中，局部断层扫描地图（Local tomography map）和显式分类的局部 3D 网格地图用于在线地形分析和连通性评估；而根据这些局部空间表示增量构建的感知高程全局拓扑图（Elevation-aware global topological graph），则用于高效的跨楼层探索规划。我们进一步引入了楼梯中心对齐策略，以减少爬楼梯过程中的急剧偏航角变化；同时提出了双重路径搜索机制，当全局拓扑在局部发生断连时恢复引导路径。
大量的仿真与真实世界实验表明，机器人实现了跨多层建筑结构的鲁棒且计算稳定的自主探索，包括对五层楼梯间进行的连续探索。
In this paper, we propose RAEM, a robust autonomous exploration framework for quadruped robots operating in multi-floor environments. Most existing ground-robot exploration approaches rely on planar traversability representations, which cannot adequately represent the overlapping structures and cross-floor connectivity of multi-floor buildings. Although tomography-based representations provide effective traversability modeling for multi-floor navigation, maintaining a global tomography map incurs substantial computational overhead for online exploration with frequent replanning. Moreover, sparse and fragmented LiDAR observations in stairwells can degrade local traversability estimation, leading to irregular viewpoint placement and temporary topological disconnections. To address these challenges, RAEM adopts a hybrid local-global traversability representation, in which a local tomography map and an explicitly categorized local 3D grid map are used for online terrain analysis and connectivity evaluation, while an elevation-aware global topological graph is incrementally constructed from these local spatial representations for efficient cross-floor exploration planning. We further introduce a staircase center alignment strategy to reduce abrupt yaw variations during climbing and a dual path searching mechanism to recover guidance paths when the global topology is locally disconnected. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate robust and computationally stable autonomous exploration across multi-floor structures, including continuous exploration of a five-floor stairwell.
AECNav: Active Evidence Consolidation for Efficient Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation
AECNav：有效的零样本开放词汇对象导航的主动证据整合
开放词汇场景下的零样本目标导航（Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation, ZSON）极具挑战性，因为它要求机器人在未经特定任务训练的情况下，在未见环境中定位任意指定的目标物体。目前，由于冗余的感知流水线以及缺乏用于可靠目标确证的充分证据，该任务仍面临高延迟和低准确率的问题。
在本文中，我们将 ZSON 重构为一个证据驱动的“感知到决策”问题，并提出了 AECNav——一套构建于三个关键组件之上的免训练（Training-free）流水线：
证据门控感知（Evidence-gated perception）：在所有推理阶段使用共享编码，建立统一的语义基础并消除冗余计算；
证据整合（Evidence consolidation）：将检测结果聚合为聚类层面的对数几率信念（Log-odds beliefs），明确区分真正的目标支持与视觉相似干扰项的虚假置信度，同时将缺失的预期检测视为负面证据；
主动证据获取（Active evidence acquisition）：通过选择以最小穿越代价实现最大信息增益的前沿点（Frontiers），在弱语义线索下维持高效的探索。
因此，AECNav 显著超越了先前的方案，在 HM3D-v2、HM3D-OVON 和 MP3D 数据集上分别取得了 84.7%、57.3% 和 51.3% 的 SOTA（State-of-the-art）成功率，且推理开销大幅降低；同时在物理四足机器人上进行的 40 次实验中达到了 95% 的成功率，运行频率约为 5 Hz。代码将在论文被接收后公开发布。
Zero-shot object-goal navigation (ZSON) in open-vocabulary scenarios is challenging, as it requires a robot to locate an arbitrarily specified object in an unseen environment without task-specific training. Currently, the task still suffers from high latency and limited accuracy due to redundant perception pipelines and insufficient evidence for reliable target confirmation. In this letter, we reframe ZSON as an evidence-driven perception-to-decision problem and present AECNav, a training-free pipeline built on three components: i) Evidence-gated perception, which utilizes a shared encoding across all reasoning stages to establish a unified semantic basis and eliminate redundant computations; ii) Evidence consolidation, which aggregates detections into cluster-level log-odds beliefs. This explicitly separates genuine target support from the false confidence of visually similar distractors, while treating the absence of expected detections as negative evidence; and iii) Active evidence acquisition, which sustains productive exploration under weak semantic cues by selecting frontiers that maximize information gain at minimal traversal cost. As a result, AECNav significantly outperforms previous methods and achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 84.7%, 57.3%, and 51.3% on HM3D-v2, HM3D-OVON, and MP3D, respectively, with substantially lower inference overhead, and attains 95% success across 40 trials on a physical quadruped robot at roughly 5Hz. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
Trajectory-Level Automatic Curriculum Learning for Legged Locomotion on Unstructured Terrain
面向非结构化地形腿式运动的轨迹级自动课程学习
针对复杂非结构化地形训练运动控制策略（Locomotion policies）需要课程学习（Curriculum learning），以避免早期探索失败。然而，由于非结构化地形缺乏用于课程设计的显式难度排序，现有的方法退而求其次，在参数化地形上采用启发式课程。这种抽象限制了泛化能力，因为策略可能会过度适应近乎固定的感知模式。
为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 TACL——一种轨迹级自动课程学习（Trajectory-level Automatic Curriculum Learning）框架，该框架直接从非结构化地形地图中生成训练任务。在每次课程更新时，评估器（Evaluator）针对当前策略学习一个难度函数，将给定的轨迹任务映射为一个难度得分。随后，采样器（Sampler）在已学习评估器的指导下提出新的轨迹，作为下一次策略更新的课程。这形成了一个闭环，使课程能够迭代匹配不断演进的策略。
定量与定性实验表明，TACL 在非结构化地形上持续提供有效的课程，相比于没有课程的直接训练，将轨迹成功率提高了 56.3%。与人工设计的课程学习相比，我们的方法在最难的地形任务上将成功率提高了 18.5%，而在针对同一障碍物类型从不同趋近方向评估穿越时，成功率提高了高达 39.74%。
Training locomotion policies for complex unstructured terrain requires a curriculum to avoid early exploration failures. However, since unstructured terrain lacks explicit difficulty ordering for curriculum design, existing methods resort to heuristic curricula over parameterized terrains. This abstraction limits generalization, as policies can overadapt to near-fixed perceptual patterns. To address this, we propose \textbf{\ourname{}}, an \textbf{T}rajectory-level \textbf{A}utomatic \textbf{C}urriculum \textbf{L}earning framework that generates training tasks directly from unstructured terrain maps. At each curriculum update, the evaluator learns a difficulty function for the current policy that maps a given trajectory task to a difficulty score. The sampler then proposes new trajectories guided by the learned evaluator as the curriculum for the next policy update. This forms a closed loop in which the curriculum is iteratively matched to the evolving policy. Quantitative and qualitative experiments show that \ourname{} continuously provides effective curricula on unstructured terrain, improving trajectory success rate by \(56.3\%\) over direct training without curriculum. Compared with handcrafted curriculum learning, our method improves success rate by \(18.5\%\) on the hardest terrain tasks and by up to \(39.74\%\) when evaluating traversal from diverse approach directions on the same obstacle type.
TONAV: Task-Oriented Navigation and Action-Velocity Chunk Learning for Articulated Object Quadrupedal Mobile Manipulation
TONAV：面向关节型物体操作的四足移动操作——任务导向导航与动作-速度组块学习
四足移动操作（Quadruped mobile manipulation）需要两种紧密耦合的能力：到达面向操作的就绪构型（Manipulation-ready configurations），以及在铰接物体（Articulated objects）交互过程中保持稳定的接触。然而，现有方法通常将导航终止于目标附近，在可达性与操作就绪度之间留下了断层；同时，跟踪滞后、运动抖动和接触不稳定性限制了连续交互的性能。
为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 TONAV——一套将面向任务的导航与动作-速度块学习（Action-velocity chunk learning）相集成的统一框架。首先，我们引入了一个位置-速度耦合的遥操作框架，显式捕捉运动动力学，以提高主从一致性并采集平滑且时序一致的示范数据。其次，面向任务的导航利用视觉-语言推理将高层指令分解为可执行的子目标，并自适应地将机器人基座调整至面向操作的就绪构型。最后，动作-速度块学习在速度监督下共同对关节位置及其时序过渡进行建模，从而实现平滑且稳定的持续接触操作。
在各种铰接物体任务上进行的真实世界实验表明，TONAV 在面向任务的导航和完整的移动操作中均取得了更高的成功率，填补了导航与操作之间的断层，并提升了连续接触交互的能力。
Quadruped mobile manipulation requires two tightly coupled capabilities: reaching manipulation-ready configurations and maintaining stable contact throughout articulated-object interaction. However, existing methods often terminate navigation near the target, leaving a gap between reachability and manipulation readiness, while tracking lag, motion jitter, and contact instability limit continuous interaction. To address these challenges, we present TONAV, a unified framework integrating task-oriented navigation with action-velocity chunk learning. First, we introduce a position-velocity-coupled teleoperation framework that explicitly captures motion dynamics to improve master-follower consistency and collect smooth, temporally consistent demonstrations. Next, task-oriented navigation leverages vision-language reasoning to decompose high-level instructions into executable subgoals and adaptively refine the robot base toward a manipulation-ready configuration. Finally, action-velocity chunk learning jointly models joint positions and their temporal transitions under velocity supervision, enabling smooth and stable sustained-contact manipulation. Real-world experiments across diverse articulated-object tasks demonstrate that TONAV achieves higher success rates in both task-oriented navigation and complete mobile manipulation, mitigating the navigation-manipulation gap and improving continuous-contact interaction.
SC2-WM: A Self-Correcting World Model with Closed-Loop Feedback for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
SC2-WM：一种用于连续环境视觉语言导航的、具备闭环反馈机制的自校正世界模型
连续环境中的视觉-语言导航（Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments, VLN-CE）要求智能体在局部可观测条件下做出细粒度的导航决策。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于开环执行，缺乏在推理过程中检测和纠正内部状态漂移（Internal state drift）的机制。我们提出了 SC^2-WM——一套引入内部反馈以在 VLN-CE 中实现闭环决策的自纠正世界模型框架（Self-correcting world model framework）。我们的方法利用世界模型的预见力（Foresight）导出反馈，在动作执行前进行状态层面的计划精炼（Plan refinement）。为了应对具挑战性的场景，我们进一步引入了条件化世界感知自适应（Conditional world-aware adaptation），当反馈表明模型能力不足时，通过在测试阶段选择性地更新世界模型来实现模型层面的纠正。在标准 VLN-CE 基准数据集上的实验表明，所提方法提升了导航的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to make fine-grained navigation decisions under partial observability. However, most existing methods rely on open-loop execution, lacking mechanisms to detect and correct internal state drift during inference. We propose SC2-WM, a self-correcting world model framework that introduces internal feedback for closed-loop decision making in VLN-CE. Our method derives feedback from world-model foresight to perform state-level plan refinement before action execution. To handle challenging scenarios, we further introduce conditional world-aware adaptation, which enables model-level correction by selectively updating the world model at test time when feedback indicates model capacity insufficiency. Experiments on standard VLN-CE benchmarks demonstrate improved navigation robustness and generalization.
From Routes to Steps: Separating Semantic Progress from Local Execution in Vision-and-Language Navigation
从路径到步骤：视觉语言导航中语义进展与局部执行的分离
连续与离散环境下的视觉-语言导航（Vision-and-Language Navigation, VLN）要求智能体通过自我中心视觉观测（Egocentric visual observations）来执行组成步骤，从而遵循路线级指令（Route-level instruction）。现有的基于大视觉语言模型（VLM）的导航器通常仅通过下一动作预测（Next-action prediction）来监督这两项能力，这使得进度跟踪误差（Progress-tracking errors）难以与执行误差（Execution errors）区分开来。当智能体偏离路线时，校正性动作标签虽然可以恢复下一步运动，但无法指示智能体是选择了错误的子指令，还是未能成功执行正确的子指令。因此，智能体可能会继续基于错误的状态做出决策。
为了解决这一歧义，我们提出了 Route2Step——一套通过显式步骤级接口（Step-level interface）将语义进度跟踪与动作生成解耦的框架。指令分析模块（MIA）根据全局指令和历史视觉信息预测该进度状态。基于预测的状态和近期观测，动作生成模块（MAG）生成局部动作块（Action chunks）。为了在无需人工时间标签的情况下监督进度状态，我们引入了步骤对齐程序 E-SPA，将子指令与其对应的路线级示范片段进行关联。这些对齐使得针对不正确进度估计的显式状态监督成为可能，而直接动作监督则仅保留给在正确当前子指令下反复失败的采样轨迹组（Rollout groups）。
在 R2R-CE 基准数据集上，Route2Step 仅使用 19 万个状态级校正样本和 11,500 个直接动作监督状态，就将成功率（SR）从 48.1% 提升至 55.3%，将按路径长度加权的成功率（SPL）从 43.3% 提升至 48.2%。在真实世界室内外环境中的实验进一步验证了 Route2Step 的实际应用价值。
Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to follow a route-level instruction by executing its constituent steps from egocentric visual observations. Existing VLM-based navigators typically supervise both capabilities through next-action prediction alone, making progress-tracking errors difficult to distinguish from execution errors. When an agent deviates from the route, a corrective action label may recover the next movement but does not indicate whether the agent selected the wrong sub-instruction or failed to execute the correct one. Consequently, the agent may continue making decisions from an erroneous progress state. To resolve this ambiguity, we propose \textbf{Route2Step}, a framework that decouples semantic progress tracking from action generation through an explicit step-level interface. The Instruction Analysis Module (MIA) predicts this state from the global instruction and visual history. Conditioned on the predicted state and recent observations, the Action Generation Module (MAG) generates local action chunks. To supervise the progress state without manual temporal labels, E-SPA, a step-alignment procedure, associates sub-instructions with their corresponding portions of route-level demonstrations. These alignments enable state supervision for incorrect progress estimates, while direct action supervision is reserved for rollout groups that repeatedly fail under the correct active sub-instruction. On R2R-CE, Route2Step improves SR from 48.1\% to 55.3\% and SPL from 43.3\% to 48.2\%, using 190K state-level corrective samples while requiring only 11.5K directly action-supervised states. Experiments in real-world indoor and outdoor environments further demonstrate the practical applicability of Route2Step.
A hierarchical multi-encoder fusion architecture for robust quadrupedal locomotion
用于鲁棒四足运动的分层多编码器融合架构
四足机器人在非结构化环境中展示出了出色的移动能力，然而在受限感知条件下实现鲁棒的运动控制依然是一项重大挑战。深度强化学习的最新进展表明，仅依靠本体感觉反馈（Proprioceptive feedback）即可支持自适应步态生成，而无需依赖外部感知。
基于这一见解，我们提出了一套适用于纯本体感觉四足机器人运动控制的分层多编码器 Actor 框架（Hierarchical multi-encoder actor framework）。该架构包含三层：传感器编码器层：独立学习速度、接触以及预测性本体感觉表示；融合层：将这些隐空间特征（Latent features）整合到一个由 PPO（近端策略优化）优化的紧凑统一空间中；
动作层：根据融合表示与当前观测共同生成电机控制指令。
这种分层设计促进了模块化表示学习与隐式地形推理，使机器人能够在未见过的复杂地形上实现稳定且自适应的运动——而无需依赖相机或高程图（Elevation maps）。
Quadrupedal robots demonstrate impressive mobility in unstructured environments, yet achieving robust locomotion under limited sensing remains a significant challenge. Recent progress in deep reinforcement learning suggests that proprioceptive feedback alone can support adaptive gait generation without external perception. Building on this insight, we propose a hierarchical multi-encoder actor framework for proprioception-only quadrupedal locomotion. The architecture consists of three layers: a sensor-encoder layer that independently learns velocity, contact, and predictive proprioceptive representations; a fusion layer that integrates these latent features into a compact unified space optimized via PPO; and an action layer that produces motor commands from both the fused representations and current observations. This hierarchical design facilitates modular representation learning and implicit terrain inference, enabling stable and adaptive locomotion on unseen and challenging terrains—without relying on cameras or elevation maps.
Provable Ordering and Continuity in Vision-Language Pretraining for Generalizable Embodied Agents
面向可泛化具身智能体的视觉-语言预训练中的可证明排序与连续性
在人类动作视频上预训练视觉-语言表示，已成为减少对大规模专家示范依赖、从而训练具身智能体的一种前景广阔的方法。然而，先前的方法通常采用基于目标达成启发式（Goal-reaching heuristics）的时间对比学习，将语言指令从初始帧逐步对齐到最终帧。这种对未来帧的过度强调可能会导致错误的视觉-语言关联，因为动作可能会提前终止，或者在末尾包含无关的时刻。
为了解决这一问题，我们提出了动作时间相干性学习（Action Temporal Coherence Learning, AcTOL），以在无需硬性目标约束的情况下学习有序且连续的视觉-语言表示。AcTOL 将视频视为连续的轨迹，在此轨迹中它：对比帧间的语义差异以反映其自然顺序；施加局部布朗桥约束（Local Brownian bridge constraint），以确保中间帧之间的平滑过渡。
在模拟和真实机器人上进行的大量模仿学习实验表明，预训练特征显著增强了下游操作任务，且对不同语言风格的指令具有很高的鲁棒性，为通往泛化具身智能体提供了一条可行的途径。
Pre-training vision-language representations on human action videos has emerged as a promising approach to reduce reliance on large-scale expert demonstrations for training embodied agents. However, prior methods often employ time contrastive learning based on goal-reaching heuristics, progressively aligning language instructions from the initial to the final frame. This overemphasis on future frames can result in erroneous vision-language associations, as actions may terminate early or include irrelevant moments in the end. To address this issue, we propose Action Temporal Coherence Learning (AcTOL) to learn ordered and continuous vision-language representations without rigid goal-based constraint. AcTOL treats a video as a continuous trajectory where it (1) contrasts semantic differences between frames to reflect their natural ordering, and (2) imposes a local Brownian bridge constraint to ensure smooth transitions across intermediate frames. Extensive imitation learning experiments on both simulated and real robots show that the pretrained features significantly enhance downstream manipulation tasks with high robustness to different linguistic styles of instructions, offering a viable pathway toward generalized embodied agents.
SoFar: Language-Grounded Orientation Bridges Spatial Reasoning and Object Manipulation
SoFar：基于语言的朝向表征连接了空间推理与物体操作
尽管空间推理在物体定位关系方面取得了进展，但它往往忽略了物体朝向（Object orientation）——这是 6 自由度（6-DoF）精细化操作的关键要素。传统的姿态表示依赖于预定义的坐标系或模板，限制了泛化能力和语义接地（Semantic grounding）。
在本文中，我们提出了语义朝向（Semantic orientation）的概念，它以一种无参考系（Reference-frame-free）的方式使用自然语言来定义物体朝向（例如 USB 的“插头”方向或杯子的“把手”方向）。为了支持这一概念，我们构建了 OrienText300K——一个包含 3D 物体及语义朝向标注的大规模数据集，并开发了 PointSO——一个用于零样本语义朝向预测的通用模型。
通过将语义朝向集成到大视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体中，我们的 SoFar 框架实现了 6-DoF 空间推理并生成机器人动作。大量实验证明了 SoFar 的有效性与泛化能力，例如在 Open6DOR 上取得了 48.7% 的零样本成功率，在 SIMPLER-Env 上取得了 74.9% 的零样本成功率。
While spatial reasoning has made progress in object localization relationships, it often overlooks object orientation—a key factor in 6-DoF fine-grained manipulation. Traditional pose representations rely on pre-defined frames or templates, limiting generalization and semantic grounding. In this paper, we introduce the concept of semantic orientation, which defines object orientations using natural language in a reference-frame-free manner (e.g., the ''plug-in'' direction of a USB or the ''handle'' direction of a cup). To support this, we construct OrienText300K, a large-scale dataset of 3D objects annotated with semantic orientations, and develop PointSO, a general model for zero-shot semantic orientation prediction. By integrating semantic orientation into VLM agents, our SoFar framework enables 6-DoF spatial reasoning and generates robotic actions. Extensive experiments demonstrated the effectiveness and generalization of our SoFar, e.g., zero-shot 48.7\% successful rate on Open6DOR and zero-shot 74.9\% successful rate on SIMPLER-Env.
Embodied-Navigator: Point, Think, Memorize, and Align for Efficient Navigation
Embodied-Navigator：指向、思考、记忆与对齐，实现高效导航
尽管大视觉-语言模型（VLMs）显著推动了具身导航的发展，但其直接部署依然面临挑战，因为现有方法往往迫使 VLMs 进入与其 2D 预训练先验不匹配的非自然动作空间，同时伴随着僵硬的推理调度和低效的内存管理。
为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了 TAMP-Nav——一套用于高效具身导航的统一框架。像素到 3D 动作公式化（Pixel-to-3D Action Formulation, Point）：将导航重构为 2D 视觉提示（Visual prompting）。具体而言，VLM 仅选择 2D 像素点，随后将其投影为 3D 坐标并交付底层 SLAM 控制器执行。该设计将具身执行与 VLM 内在的 2D 视觉能力自然对齐；选择性推理与锚点轨迹记忆机制（Selective Reasoning and Anchor-Trajectory Memory, Think and Memorize）：动态触发思维链（Chain-of-Thought），且仅在关键节点保留高保真记忆，将冗余轨迹压缩为轻量级的时空指示符（Space-Time Indicators），从而保留关键历史信息并增强时空感知；两级对齐范式（Two-Level Alignment Paradigm, Align）：通过群体相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）设计对齐范式。通过叠加全局结果奖励与细粒度过程奖励，这种密集的监督将智能体的认知规划与物理环境反馈紧密对齐，赋予模型自适应推理能力。
实验表明，TAMP-Nav 实现了 SOTA 性能（例如在 R2R-CE 基准上达到 66.2% 的成功率 SR），同时具备极高的运行时间与样本效率（仅需 9.0 万条训练轨迹）。
Although Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced embodied navigation, their direct deployment remains challenging, as existing methods often force VLMs into unnatural action spaces that misalign with their 2D pre-training priors, compounded by rigid reasoning schedules and inefficient memory management. To overcome these limitations, we propose TAMP-Nav, a unified framework for efficient embodied navigation. First, we introduce a Pixel-to-3D Action Formulation (Point) that reformulates navigation into 2D visual prompting. Specifically, the VLM merely selects 2D pixels, which are then projected into 3D coordinates for a low-level SLAM controller. This design naturally aligns embodied execution with the VLM's inherent 2D visual capabilities. Second, we propose an integrated Selective Reasoning and Anchor-Trajectory Memory mechanism (Think and Memorize), which dynamically triggers Chain-of-Thought and retains high-fidelity memory only at critical nodes, compressing redundant trajectories into lightweight Space-Time Indicators, thereby preserving critical historical information and enhancing spatio-temporal perception. Finally, we design an efficient Two-Level Alignment Paradigm (Align) via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). By superimposing global outcome rewards with fine-grained process rewards, this dense supervision tightly aligns the agent's cognitive planning with physical environmental feedback, endowing the model with adaptive reasoning capabilities. Experiments demonstrate that TAMP-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance (e.g., 66.2% SR on R2R-CE) with high runtime and sample efficiency (requiring only 90k training trajectories).
Probabilistic Control Barrier Functions: Safety in Probability for Discrete-Time Stochastic Systems
概率控制障碍函数：离散时间随机系统的概率安全性
在真实世界中运行的控制系统面临着无数不可预测的不确定性来源。这些随机扰动会使确定性保证失效，并导致灾难性的安全故障。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一套针对离散时间随机系统设计安全控制器的方法，该方法保留了概率意义上的安全保证。
为此，我们修改了控制屏障函数（Control Barrier Function, CBF）的传统概念，以显式地应对这些随机不确定性，并将这些新的修改后的函数称为概率控制屏障函数（Probabilistic CBFs）。我们证明了概率 CBF 可用于设计控制器，以指定的概率保证在有限时间步长内的安全性。随后，通过利用各种不确定性量化方法（如集中不等式与场景法），我们提供了一系列充分条件，从而在大量实际场景中导出了具有可调概率保证且计算可可行的控制器。
最后，我们在仿真以及四足机器人控制的硬件实验中展示了所提结果的适用性。
Control systems operating in the real world face countless sources of unpredictable uncertainties. These random disturbances can render deterministic guarantees inapplicable and cause catastrophic safety failures. To overcome this, this paper proposes a method for designing safe controllers for discrete-time stochastic systems that retain probabilistic guarantees of safety. To do this we modify the traditional notion of a control barrier function (CBF) to explicitly account for these stochastic uncertainties and call these new modified functions probabilistic CBFs. We show that probabilistic CBFs can be used to design controllers that guarantee safety over a finite number of time steps with a prescribed probability. Next, by leveraging various uncertainty quantification methods, such as concentration inequalities and the scenario approach, we provide a variety of sufficient conditions that result in computationally tractable controllers with tunable probabilistic guarantees across a plethora of practical scenarios. Finally, we showcase the applicability of our results in simulation and hardware for the control of a quadruped robot.
Hybrid Zero-Shot Interactive Navigation with LLMs: Path Planning Under Dual Constraints of Speech and Environment
基于大语言模型的混合零样本交互式导航：语音与环境双重约束下的路径规划
本研究提出了一种用于移动机器人的新型混合交互式导航框架（Novel hybrid interactive navigation framework），旨在使机器人在未来具有挑战性的协作工作场景中，能够在环境和随行人员语音的双重约束下运行。通过利用人类的感知能力，所提框架显著提升了机器人的避障能力与灵活性。
具体而言，本文引入了一种创新的合成算法（Composition algorithm），将传统的基于代价地图（Costmap）的导航与新提出的基于大语言模型（LLM）辅助的语音交互方法相结合，从而实现了优势互补的实时人机协作导航。在该框架下，机器人不仅可以依靠空间传感器避开障碍物，还可以遵循人类的口头指令，绕过难以探测的隐患。此外，语音音量被创新性地引入作为融合权重，允许随行人员通过语音音量的调制自然地引导机器人。
为了验证所提框架和算法的可行性与性能，我们开展了仿真与真实世界实验。进行了一系列的消融实验和对比研究，以评估各种配置的优缺点，并最终根据实验结果给出了最佳配置方案。本工作拓展了实时人机交互在导航领域的应用范围，为未来的研究提供了新的视角。
This study proposes a novel hybrid interactive navigation framework for mobile robots, designed to enable robots to operate under dual constraints imposed by both the environment and the speech of accompanying humans in challenging future collaborative working scenarios. By leveraging human perceptual capabilities, the proposed framework significantly enhances the obstacle-avoidance capabilities and flexibility of robots. Specifically, an innovative composition algorithm is introduced to integrate traditional costmap-based navigation with a newly proposed LLM-assisted voice-based interaction method, thereby achieving real-time human–robot collaborative navigation with complementary advantages. Within this framework, robots can not only rely on spatial sensors to avoid obstacles but also follow verbal instructions from humans to bypass hazards that are difficult to detect. Moreover, the volume of speech is innovatively incorporated as a fusion weight, allowing the accompanying human to naturally guide the robot through voice volume modulation. To validate the feasibility and performance of the proposed framework and algorithm, we conducted both simulation and real-world experiments. A series of ablation and comparative studies was conducted to evaluate the merits and limitations of various configurations, ultimately providing optimal configurations based on the results. This work expands the scope of real-time human–robot interaction in navigation, offering new perspectives for future research.
Observation-Constrained Joint-Space Viewpoint Optimization for Robotic Inspection of Cylindrical Cavities
面向圆柱形空腔机器人检测的观测约束关节空间视点优化
检查（Inspection）是工业设施监控、基础设施维护、农业以及搜救等众多移动机器人应用中的核心能力。按照针对响应机器人的 ASTM 搜救任务基准标准，观察圆柱形腔体（Cylindrical cavity）的底部代表了一项典型挑战：机器人必须在满足可读性/可见性、运动学和防碰撞约束的同时，精确定位其相机。
本文介绍了一种在机器人关节空间中实现的、面向观察受限圆柱形腔体检查的全自主方法。该方法并不指定单一的笛卡尔相机姿态，而是将检查目标表示为一组有效的视角几何结构（Valid viewing geometries），从而避免误删可达视点以及关节极限裕度较差的构型。
RGB 感知前端利用语义掩码，结合弧线支持的椭圆拟合以及主体和侧母线线索，估计出开口中心和腔体方向轴。这些估计参数化了关于相机轴线对齐、横向偏移和轴向向外距离（Axial standoff）的约束。随后，多起始点无导数搜索算法（Multistart derivative-free search）在以约束满足为词典序优先级的条件下优化机器人关节构型；可行构型根据运动经济性、关节极限裕度和视角质量进行排序。
生成的候选构型由感知碰撞的运动规划器进行评估，最终执行的相机姿态通过几何方式和基于光线的底部可见性估计进行验证。在 Isaac Sim 仿真中，所提方法在 100 个目标构型中成功完成了 92 个，且在执行的试验中达到了 91.65% 的平均底部可见性；相比之下，多起始点坐标搜索基线方法仅成功完成 76 个，平均底部可见性为 84.3%。桌面实验和搭载于宇树 Unitree A2 机器人的实验验证了完整的“感知-规划-执行”流水线。
Inspection is a core capability in many mobile robotics applications, including industrial facility monitoring, infrastructure maintenance, agriculture, and search and rescue. Observing the bottom of a cylindrical cavity, as required by ASTM search-task benchmarks for response robots, presents a representative challenge: the robot must position its camera precisely while satisfying visibility, kinematic, and collision constraints. This paper presents a fully autonomous method for observation-constrained inspection of cylindrical cavities in robot joint space. Rather than prescribing a single Cartesian camera pose, the method represents the inspection objective as a set of valid viewing geometries, thereby avoiding the rejection of reachable viewpoints and configurations with poor joint-limit margins. An RGB perception front end estimates the opening center and directed cavity axis from semantic masks using arc-supported ellipse fitting together with body and side-generator cues. These estimates parameterize constraints on camera-axis alignment, lateral offset, and axial standoff. A multistart derivative-free search then optimizes robot joint configurations with lexicographic priority given to constraint satisfaction; feasible configurations are ranked according to motion economy, joint-limit margin, and view quality. The resulting candidates are evaluated by a collision-aware motion planner, and the executed camera pose is verified geometrically and using a ray-based estimate of bottom visibility. In Isaac Sim, the proposed method successfully completes 92 of 100 target configurations and attains 91.65% mean bottom visibility among executed trials, compared with 76 of 100 and 84.3% for a multistart coordinate-search baseline. Tabletop and Unitree A2-mounted experiments demonstrate the complete perception-planning-execution pipeline.
Video2DoorTraversal: Push Door Traversal via Simulated Door Twins
Video2DoorTraversal：基于模拟门孪生体的推门通行
开门与穿越（Door opening and traversal）是一项长程长时域（Long-horizon）的移动操作（Loco-manipulation）任务，需要精确的门把手交互以及协调的基座-机械臂控制。我们提出了 Video2DoorTraversal——一套针对轮履/轮足式移动操作机器人（Wheel-legged mobile manipulators）的单视频“实-虚-实”（Real-to-sim-to-real）框架。
给定一帧真实门的 RGB 视频，DoorTwin 能够重建出具有真实几何结构与外观的实例对齐、铰接式且可直接用于仿真（Simulation-ready）的数字孪生门（Door twin）。随后，一个在仿真环路中的智能体（Simulation-in-the-loop agent）将恢复出的铰接结构转换为参数化的技能程序（Skill program），并通过迭代精炼失败的轨迹展开（Rollouts），生成物理上可执行的示范数据。
这些示范数据被用于训练 ArticuACT——一种双深度策略网络（Dual-depth policy），它利用以机器人为中心（Robot-centric）的相机条件化与交互感知监督（Interaction-aware supervision），来预测协调的基座、机械臂及末端夹爪指令。在所有感知与策略推理均在板载（Onboard）运行的条件下，系统在 5 个真实门上取得了 96.57% 的平均成功率，在结构相似的未见过的门上取得了 80.95% 的零样本（Zero-shot）成功率，同时平均仅需约 13 秒即可完成整个靠近、开门及穿越的全套动作序列。
Door opening and traversal is a long-horizon loco-manipulation task that requires precise handle interaction and coordinated base–arm control. We present Video2DoorTraversal, a single-video real-to-sim-to-real framework for wheel-legged mobile manipulators. Given one RGB video of a real door, DoorTwin reconstructs an instance-aligned, articulated, and simulation-ready door twin with realistic geometry and appearance. A simulation-in-the-loop agent converts the recovered articulation into a parameterized skill program and iteratively refines failed rollouts to generate physically executable demonstrations. These demonstrations are used to train ArticuACT, a dual-depth policy that predicts coordinated base, arm, and gripper commands using robot-centric camera conditioning and interaction-aware supervision. With all perception and policy inference running onboard, the system achieves a 96.57% average success rate across five real doors and an 80.95% zero-shot success rate on structurally similar unseen doors, while completing the full approach, opening, and traversal sequence in approximately 13 s on average.
Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
利用基于采样的模型预测控制加速视觉策略学习
学习用于运动与操控的视觉策略需要协调与环境的接触，这会带来巨大的计算与 GPU 显存成本。一阶策略梯度（FoPG）通过可微仿真降低了训练成本，但局部优化容易收敛到非预期的接触模式。为解决这一不足，我们提出了基于采样引导的策略搜索（SGPS），该方法将基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）所进行的循环动作目标精炼，与一阶策略优化相结合。
系统首先利用行为克隆（BC）从采样动作中初始化策略；随后，训练过程在扰动初始状态和随机化动力学条件下，交替进行基于采样的精炼与短时域（short-horizon）FoPG 更新。针对视觉策略训练，我们采用了一种解耦的 FoPG 形式，将渲染过程排除在计算图之外，从而无需状态策略教师（state-policy teacher）即可直接从深度观察中进行学习。
在单张 GPU 上，SGPS 为仿真环境中的宇树（Unitree）Go2 和 G1 机器人学习到了用于运动、障碍穿越、推箱子以及双手携物的策略。我们的实验进一步表明，精炼机制对策略学习的提升超出了单纯的初始化与跟踪。在硬件部署方面，蒸馏后的策略零样本（zero-shot）迁移至真实 Go2 机器人上，能够利用机载深度信息自主实现小跑（trot）、爬行（crawl）、跨越障碍，并在这些行为之间灵活切换。
Learning visual policies for locomotion and manipulation requires coordinating contact with the environment and can incur substantial computation and GPU memory costs. First-order policy gradients (FoPG) reduce training cost through differentiable simulation, but local optimization can converge to unintended contact patterns. To address this shortfall, we propose Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS), which couples recurring action-target refinement by sampling-based model-predictive control with first-order policy optimization. Behavior cloning initializes the policy from sampled actions; training then alternates sampling-based refinement with short-horizon FoPG updates under perturbed initial states and randomized dynamics. For visual policy training, we use a decoupled FoPG formulation that excludes rendering from the computation graph, enabling direct learning from depth observations without a state-policy teacher. On a single GPU, SGPS learns policies for locomotion, obstacle traversal, crate pushing, and bimanual carrying on simulated Unitree Go2 and G1 robots. Our experiments further show that refinement improves policy learning beyond initialization and tracking alone. For hardware deployment, the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Go2 and uses onboard depth to autonomously trot, crawl, clear hurdles, and switch between these behaviors.
LocoWM: High-Precision Locomotion through World-Model-Guided Residual Adaptation
LocoWM：基于世界模型引导残差自适应的高精度运动控制
高精度移动（high-precision locomotion）要求机器人将运动指令追踪与任务相关的物理状态精确调控相结合，从而在运动过程中与周围环境实现可靠交互。然而，传统的端到端联合优化往往导致精度目标优化不足，而传统的反应式残差控制则只能在偏差已经显现后才进行被动调整，无法对潜在的扰动进行前瞻性补偿。
为此，本文提出了 LocoWM——一个基于世界模型的预动式残差自适应（preactive residual adaptation）框架。该框架由基础策略、动作条件世界模型与残差适配器三部分组成：基础策略负责提供指令跟随移动能力，动作条件世界模型根据本体感受历史与提议的基础动作预测未来物理状态序列，而残差适配器则以该预测序列为条件生成附加的动作校正，从而主动补偿预期的偏差。在训练架构上，该方法采用两阶段训练策略，首先学习移动控制与动作条件动力学，随后在冻结这两个模块的同时专门训练适配器，从而实现了移动能力获取与精度自适应的有效解耦。
涵盖地形平整、加速度补偿和抗推恢复等场景的广泛实验表明，与传统的端到端方法及反应式残差基线相比，LocoWM 显著提升了控制精度和面对外部扰动时的鲁棒性。这些结果充分证明了世界模型在赋能人形机器人高精度、自适应动态移动方面的强大潜力，为实现更具预见性的具身控制开辟了新途径。
High-precision locomotion combines motion-command tracking with precise regulation of task-relevant physical states, enabling robots to interact reliably with their surroundings during motion. Joint end-to-end optimization can leave precision objectives insufficiently optimized, while reactive residual control adjusts actions only after deviations become observable. We present \textbf{LocoWM}, a world-model-guided preactive residual adaptation framework for high-precision locomotion. A base policy provides command-following locomotion, while an action-conditioned world model predicts a sequence of future physical states from proprioceptive history and the proposed base action. A residual adapter conditions on this predicted sequence to generate additive action corrections that compensate for anticipated deviations. Two-stage training first learns locomotion and action-conditioned dynamics, then freezes both modules while training the adapter, separating locomotion acquisition from precision adaptation. Experiments spanning terrain leveling, acceleration compensation, and push recovery demonstrate improved control precision and disturbance robustness over end-to-end and reactive residual baselines.
SABER: Learning Attention-based Semantic Affordance for Legged Locomotion
SABER：学习用于足式运动的基于注意力的语义可供性
感知足式移动技术通过将地形几何信息集成到学习策略中取得了飞速发展，但对地形“语义含义”的深入解析却仍然匮乏。例如，管道、草坪或脆弱的箱子在几何形态上或许是完全可穿越的，但在实际作业中却不具备接触适宜性。特别是在足式机器人应用日益广泛的工业环境中，单次错误的落脚不仅可能损坏昂贵的设备，还可能导致机器人失稳，甚至威胁整个作业区域的安全。
为此，本文提出了 SABER——一个无需重型规划器（planner-free）的强化学习策略框架，能够联合推理地形的几何特征与语义接触许可（semantic contact permission）。该策略接收统一的地形示能图（terrain-affordance map）作为输入，图中的每个网格单元同时编码局部 3D 几何特征与语义接触代价。在网络架构上，SABER 通过引入可学习的带符号语义偏置（signed semantic bias）对交叉注意力机制进行增强：该偏置项作为加性项作用于注意力 Logits 上，由接触代价进行门控，并根据标记网格与最近足端的距离对其权重进行动态重塑造。这种设计使得危险区域能够在影响下一落脚点的位置重新塑造注意力权重，而在无法产生影响的位置其作用则自动衰减，从而确保策略选择允许的支撑区域落脚，并在整个摆动相（swing phase）中使腿部远离禁止接触的区域。
系统化的消融实验隔离验证了各架构组件的贡献，结果显示，仅移除语义偏置项就会使禁止区域的误接触增加 55%，而速度追踪精度保持不变。研究团队在 Unitree B2 机器人上对该策略进行了实机验证，成功展示了涵盖室内外环境及四种语义障碍物类别的高鲁棒 Sim-to-Real 语义接触选择能力。
Perceptive legged locomotion has advanced rapidly by integrating terrain geometry into learned policies, yet the integration of terrain meaning remains sparse: a pipe, a patch of grass, or a fragile box may be geometrically traversable while being inappropriate for contact. In industrial environments, where legged robots increasingly operate, a single misplaced step can damage fragile equipment, destabilize the robot, or endanger the site. To address this, we introduce SABER, a planner-free reinforcement-learning policy that jointly reasons about terrain geometry and semantic contact permission. The policy consumes a unified terrain-affordance map, where each cell encodes local 3D geometry and a semantic contact cost. We augment cross-attention with a learned, signed semantic bias: an additive term on the attention logits, gated by the contact cost, that reweights flagged cells by their distance from the nearest foot. A hazard therefore reshapes attention where it can still affect the next foothold, and its influence fades where it cannot. The resulting policy selects footholds on permitted support and keeps the leg clear of forbidden regions throughout the swing phase. We perform a systematic ablation that isolates the contribution of each architectural component; removing the semantic bias alone increases forbidden contacts by 55% while velocity tracking is unchanged. We validate the policy on a Unitree B2, demonstrating sim-to-real semantic contact selection across indoor and outdoor environments and four semantic obstacle classes.
MimicAgent: Quadruped Skills via Prompt-to-Trajectory Generation
MimicAgent：基于“提示词转轨迹”生成的四足机器人技能
四足机器人策略的强化学习训练长期以来高度依赖繁琐的奖励塑形（reward shaping），过程往往耗时且充满试错。尽管诸如 Eureka 之类的方法尝试利用大语言模型自动化奖励函数设计，但在泛化到多样化技能与形态时表现欠佳。相比之下，具身人形机器人能够受益于大规模动作捕捉数据集作为参考轨迹的示范引导强化学习（example-guided RL），而四足机器人领域则长期面临缺乏现成参考运动数据的困境。
为突破这一瓶颈，本文提出了 MimicAgent——一个面向四足机器人动态技能学习的提示词到轨迹生成框架（prompt-to-trajectory generation framework）。该框架的核心洞察在于，让人类或大语言模型直接生成参考运动轨迹，远比手动塑形复杂的奖励函数更为直观。具体而言，MimicAgent 构建了一个代理夹具（agentic harness），在给定技能文本提示后，能够利用编码智能体（coding agents）自动生成四足机器人的粗糙参考轨迹，进而将这些轨迹输入示例引导的强化学习管线中，训练出可直接部署于仿真及真实世界的控制策略。
实验结果表明，通过在代理夹具中合理调度先进的大语言模型（如 Claude），高达 87% 的提示词能够成功转化为语义对齐的参考轨迹。通过将这些自动生成的参考轨迹转化为有效的强化学习监督信号，该系统能够高效合成具备高度动态特性的四足机器人运动技能，并在真实世界硬件及仿真环境中展现出卓越的泛化能力与鲁棒性，为缺乏大规模动作捕捉数据的机器人形态提供了一条高效的具身技能自动化生成路径。
We present MimicAgent, a prompt-to-trajectory generation framework for learning dynamic quadruped skills. Although reward shaping is extensively used when training quadruped policies, navigating the resulting reward landscape is notoriously difficult, requiring hours of "graduate student descent". Eureka attempts to automate reward design with LLMs, but we find that it struggles to generalize across diverse skills and morphologies. Our key observation is that it is far easier for a human - and by association, an LLM - to generate reference motions than to shape reward functions. Our hypothesis is motivated by the success of example-guided RL for humanoids, which exploits large-scale motion capture datasets as references for training locomotion policies. Unlike humanoids, quadrupeds lack such reference motion data. Towards this end, we propose MimicAgent, an agentic harness that, given a skill prompt, generates quadruped reference trajectories with coding agents. These coarse reference trajectories are then used to train example-guided RL policies that are deployable in simulation and in the real-world. Notably, we find that when prompting Claude Fable 5.1 within our agentic harness, 87% of prompts yield semantically aligned reference trajectories.
Contact as a Decision Variable: Capability-Tradeoff Contact Selection for Legged Loco-Manipulation
将接触作为决策变量：面向足式移动操作的能力权衡式接触选择
在具身机器人的移动操控（loco-manipulation）任务中，利用环境支撑点（如靠墙、扶桌等）能够显著提升物理稳定性，但同时也可能对任务执行所需的运动范围构成约束。因此，如何为特定的移动操控任务联合选择最佳的环境支撑接触点（support contact）与全身构型（whole-body configuration），成为兼顾稳定与灵活性的核心难题。为每个候选支撑点精确评估其能力通常需要进行重复且高开销的全身优化，面临着严峻的计算效率瓶颈。
针对这一挑战，本文提出了能力权衡接触选择（Capability-Tradeoff Contact Selection, CTCS）框架。该方法首先基于任务满足后剩余的物理能力，定义了三大核心能力指标：残差力矩（residual wrench）、末端执行器可达性（end-effector reach）以及基座移动性（base mobility），并将它们与接触获取成本进行综合权衡。为了大幅降低计算开销，CTCS 引入了一套高效的候选筛选与预测机制：首先快速筛选接触与任务可行性，将同一表面内的相似候选点进行分组；随后利用局部敏感性分析（local sensitivity analysis），基于少数锚点（anchors）的精确评估结果来预测其余候选点的能力；最后通过选择性精确评估验证预测，对候选点进行排序，并仅对精简后的候选列表进行全量精确计算以完成最终决策。
研究团队在包含 AgileX NERO 机械臂的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上，针对 392 种任务条件和 9 个可选支撑表面进行了仿真与硬件验证。评估结果表明，CTCS 显著优于纯地面支撑以及固定接触支撑的基线方法，能够根据任务需求灵活选择具备最佳能力权衡的环境支撑面。与对所有候选点进行逐一精确评估相比，CTCS 实现了约 3 倍的计算加速，同时保持了几乎一致的平均目标优化指标，为复杂环境下的即时全身接触规划与高负载移动操控提供了高效的算法支撑。
In this paper, we study the joint selection of an environmental support contact and a whole-body configuration for a prescribed loco-manipulation task. A contact may provide greater physical support while restricting the motion required for the task. We formulate this problem through three capability measures: residual wrench, end-effector reach, and base mobility available after satisfying the task requirements, and we balance them against contact acquisition cost. Evaluating these capabilities for every candidate requires repeated whole-body optimizations. To reduce this computational cost, we propose Capability-Tradeoff Contact Selection (CTCS). CTCS screens candidates for contact and task feasibility, groups similar candidates within each surface, and predicts their capabilities from exact anchor evaluations using local sensitivity analysis. It checks these predictions through selective exact evaluations, ranks candidates by capability, and evaluates a shortlist exactly for final selection. We evaluate CTCS in simulations and hardware experiments using a Unitree Go2 quadruped with an AgileX NERO arm across 392 task conditions with nine available support surfaces. Results show that CTCS outperforms ground-only and fixed-contact support, as it can select support surfaces that provide favorable capability trade-offs for the task. Compared with evaluating every candidate exactly, CTCS achieves approximately 3× speedup while closely matching the resulting mean objective value.
Talk2Escape: Conversational Grounding for Vision-and-Language Navigation
Talk2Escape：面向视觉-语言导航的对话式共识建立
视觉语言导航（Vision-and-Language Navigation, VLN）虽然取得了显著进展，但其普遍采用的单轮交互范式暴露出一个根本性缺陷：即智能体在严格的开环模式下运行。在实际部署环境中，感知混叠、传感器噪声以及里程计漂移等因素会导致微小偏差随时间不断累积，最终往往引发无法挽回的任务失败，且系统缺乏内置的错误纠正与恢复机制。
为了克服这一局限，本文提出了 Talk2Escape——一个主动式且与模型无关的对话干预框架，旨在将导航重新构想为一个闭环的交互过程。该框架的核心是一个轻量级的视觉语言模块，能够持续监控智能体的运动学状态；一旦检测到局部循环或严重的轨迹分歧，它便会将原始的第一视角观测转化为简洁、具地基的查询，从而向算法预言机或人在回路（human-in-the-loop）征求针对性的纠正反馈。
在包括 R2R-CE、RxR-CE 和 VLNVerse 在内的高保真模拟器中的广泛评估表明，Talk2Escape 能够在各种基础智能体上实现持续的性能提升。实证结果显示，Talk2Escape 在 R2R-CE 上取得了 66.0% 的成功率（Success Rate），超越了当前最新的监督式与零样本先进方法。此外，研究团队在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上成功验证了其 Sim-to-Real 迁移能力，充分证明了主动式对话干预机制能够显著提升物理环境中导航的鲁棒性。
While Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has demonstrated remarkable success, the prevailing single-turn paradigm exposes a fundamental vulnerability: agents operate in a strictly open-loop manner. In practice, factors such as perceptual aliasing, sensor noise, and odometry drift can cause minor deviations to accumulate over time, often leading to catastrophic mission failures with no built-in mechanism for error recovery. To address this, we introduce \textit{Talk2Escape}, a proactive and model-agnostic dialogue intervention framework that reframes navigation as a closed-loop interactive process. At its core, a lightweight vision-language module continuously monitors agent kinematics. Upon detecting localized looping or severe trajectory divergence, it translates raw egocentric observations into concise, grounded queries to solicit targeted corrective feedback from either an algorithmic oracle or a human-in-the-loop. Extensive evaluations in high-fidelity simulators, including R2R-CE, RxR-CE, and VLNVerse,
demonstrate that \textit{Talk2Escape} exhibits consistent improvements across diverse base agents. Empirically, \textit{Talk2Escape} achieves a 66.0\% Success Rate on R2R-CE, outperforming the current supervised and zero-shot state-of-the-art methods. We further validate its sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree Go2 quadruped, proving that proactive dialogue drastically improves navigation robustness in physical environments.
OmniMimic: Dynamics-completed Motion Augmentation for Multi-style Omnidirectional Quadruped Locomotion
OmniMimic：面向多风格全向四足运动的动力学补全式运动增强
动物示范为四足机器人提供了自然且独特的步态风格，但由于其方向覆盖范围往往较为狭窄，难以在后退、侧向和转向等非示范指令方向上提供风格一致的监督信号，从而限制了其在全向移动任务中的泛化能力。
为此，本文提出了 OmniMimic 训练框架，旨在将方向受限的动物示范转化为覆盖目标各轴速度范围的单一多步态策略。该框架首先结合了时间反转（temporal reversal）、受约束的动力学补全（constrained dynamics completion）以及矢状面反射（sagittal reflection），构建出超出原始观测方向的机器人特异性运动学与物理监督信号；随后将控制指令从示范的速度分布逐步扩展至目标各轴边界；最后采用共享的行动者（shared actor）与软门控（soft-gated）的步态专用残差专家网络，巧妙地平衡了可复用的基础运动技能与步态特异性的动态修正。
在仿真环境中涵盖四种步态的广泛评估表明，与匹配的 APEX 基线相比，OmniMimic 在前向和后向参考速度下的平均足端位置均方根误差（RMSE）降低了 12.9%，在均匀笛卡尔指令网格上的速度追踪 RMSE 更大幅降低了 63.1%。该方法有效克服了动物示范数据方向稀疏的局限，为四足机器人生成自然、多向且鲁棒的复杂运动技能开辟了新途径。
Animal demonstrations provide quadruped robots with natural and distinctive gait styles that are difficult to specify through hand-crafted rewards. However, their narrow directional coverage leaves little style-consistent supervision for backward, lateral, and turning commands. We present OmniMimic, a training framework that turns directionally limited animal demonstrations into a single multi-gait policy over target per-axis velocity ranges. OmniMimic first combines temporal reversal, constrained dynamics completion, and sagittal reflection to construct robot-specific kinematic and physical supervision beyond the observed directions. It then expands commands progressively from the demonstrated velocity distribution toward the target per-axis bounds, and uses a shared actor with soft-gated, gait-specialized residual experts to balance reusable locomotion skills with gait-specific corrections. Across four gaits in simulation, OmniMimic reduces mean foot-position RMSE at forward and backward reference velocities by 12.9% and velocity-tracking RMSE on a uniform Cartesian command grid by 63.1%, compared with the matched APEX baseline.
ROOT: Discovering Rewards for User-Specified Embodied Behaviors
ROOT：发现针对用户指定具身行为的奖励
具身控制中的强化学习长期受困于奖励函数设计的复杂性。尽管近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法能够根据自然语言描述自动生成奖励函数，但它们往往难以捕捉人类在意的微妙行为属性（如自然流畅的步态、优美的姿态与特定的运动风格），因为许多期望的行为在视觉上往往易于识别，却极难准确编码进形式化的奖励函数中。
为此，本文提出了 ROOT（Reward Optimization via Observable Trees）框架，旨在通过观察引导的搜索机制来发现能够精准契合用户指定具身行为的奖励函数。ROOT 摒弃了传统方法单纯依赖标量训练统计数据的局限，将奖励设计巧妙地转化为在持久化实验树（persistent experiment tree）上的观察引导搜索；该实验树能够系统性地存储奖励程序、训练策略及运行轨迹观测，并结合视频-语言模型（Vid-LLM）所提炼的行为洞察，精准诊断行为失败的根本原因，进而指导后续的奖励迭代与精炼。
研究团队在涵盖模拟 Hopper、HalfCheetah、Ant、Unitree Go2 以及真实世界 Unitree Go2 等 4 种机器人形态的 7 项复杂任务上对 ROOT 进行了全面评估。实验结果表明，ROOT 生成的行为较现有 LLM 奖励生成方法更能深度贴合用户意图，实现了高达 86.8% 的移动完整性准确率，并将 Vid-LLM 的行为对齐得分从 3.56 分提升至 4.14 分（实现了 16.5% 的显著提升）；广泛的人类主观盲评进一步验证了其优越性，在各项成对比较中获得了 51% 至 63% 的高偏好选择率，为具身智能中视觉一致性与策略优化的对齐提供了一种高效且具扩展性的全新路径。
Reinforcement learning for embodied control remains constrained by the difficulty of reward specification. Although recent large language model (LLM)-based methods can synthesize reward functions from natural-language descriptions, they often fail to capture subtle behavioral properties that humans care about, such as natural gait, posture, and movement style. This limitation arises because many desired behaviors are easier to recognize visually than to encode in a reward function. We introduce Reward Optimization via Observable Trees (ROOT), a framework for discovering reward functions that align learned policies with user-specified embodied behaviors. Rather than relying solely on scalar training statistics, ROOT casts reward design as an observation-guided search over a persistent experiment tree that stores reward programs, trained policies, and rollout observations, together with behavioral insights distilled by a video-language model, to diagnose behavioral failures and guide subsequent reward refinements. We evaluate ROOT on seven tasks across four embodiments: simulated Hopper, HalfCheetah, Ant, Unitree Go2, and as well as the real-world Unitree Go2. ROOT produces behaviors that better align with user intent than those generated by existing LLM-based reward-generation methods, achieving up to 86.8% locomotion-completeness accuracy and improving Vid-LLM behavioral alignment from 3.56/5 to 4.14/5, a 16.5% improvement over baselines. Human evaluations further support these results, with ROOT preferred in 51-63% of pairwise comparisons.
RangeNav: Task-Aligned LiDAR Range-Image Pretraining for Robot Navigation
RangeNav：面向机器人导航的、与任务对齐的激光雷达距离图像预训练
在拥挤人群与复杂 cluttered 现场中运行的自主移动机器人亟需具备 360° 全景感知能力以实时应对周围的动态风险。尽管全景激光雷达（LiDAR）能够提供全方位的环境覆盖，但在稀疏奖励机制下通过强化学习（RL）学习有效表征的样本效率极低，且现有的 3D 预训练点云编码器体积庞大、计算开销过高，难以支撑大规模并行的强化学习仿真需求。
为此，本文提出了 RangeNav——一个仅包含 18.3 万参数的轻量级 LiDAR 距离图像编码器，其完全基于合成数据进行预训练。RangeNav 创新性地采用各向异性卷积（anisotropic convolutions）与循环填充（circular padding）技术，完美克服了距离图像极端的宽高比以及方位角拼接缝隙所带来的建模难题。该网络通过融合距离重建、语义分割与鸟瞰图（BEV）预测的导航对齐目标进行预训练，随后在策略学习阶段将其冻结，从而在保证特征鲁棒性的同时大幅降低了计算负担。
仿真实验表明，引入语义与 BEV 监督机制使机器人的导航成功率较单纯依赖重建的基线分别提升了 32.03 个百分点（程序生成的训练环境）和 23.73 个百分点（分布外真实测试环境）。在真实世界验证中，通过将训练好的策略零样本（zero-shot）部署至 Unitree B2-W 四足机器人上，RangeNav 在密集人群、低光照环境以及传统有限视场（FOV）深度策略难以应对的复杂施工区域中，均展现出了卓越的鲁棒导航与避障能力。
Autonomous mobile robots operating in dense crowds and cluttered sites require 360° perception to react to surrounding hazards. While panoramic LiDAR offers full-surround coverage, learning representations within reinforcement learning (RL) is sample-inefficient under sparse rewards, and existing 3D pretrained point-cloud encoders are too memory-heavy for massively parallel RL simulation.
We present RangeNav, a compact (183k parameters) LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data. RangeNav uses anisotropic convolutions and circular padding to handle the extreme aspect ratio and azimuthal seam of range images. We pretrain the network using a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and bird’s-eye-view (BEV) prediction, then freeze it for policy learning.
In simulation, adding semantic and BEV supervision increases success rates over a reconstruction-only baseline by an average of 32.03 and 23.73 percentage points (pp) in procedurally generated training and out-of-distribution realistic test environments, respectively. Zero-shot real-world deployments on a Unitree B2-W quadruped demonstrate robust navigation through dense crowds, low-light settings, and construction zones where limited-field-of-view depth policies struggle. Code and models will be open-sourced.
GG-Nav: Goal-oriented Grounding Chain-of-Thought Elicits Reasoning in Navigation Foundation Models
GG-Nav：面向目标的“定位-思维链”机制，旨在激发导航基础模型的推理能力
尽管强大的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）推动了导航基础模型的发展，但其在面向目标的导航（goal-oriented navigation）任务中仍表现不佳。深入的动机研究表明，其性能瓶颈的核心在于对流式观测（streaming observations）的利用不充分以及目标定位不够精确，导致智能体在复杂环境中频繁丢失关键线索并产生严重的定位与导航偏移。
为此，本文提出了 GG-Nav——一个简单而高效的导航框架，通过监督微调学习结构化的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）机制，显式定位与目标相关的实例、累积定位证据并支持更可靠的决策。该结构化 CoT 包含两个关键阶段：首先是“观测到证据（Observation-to-Evidence）”阶段，通过对相邻决策步骤之间的所有中间帧进行深度推理，持续保留有用的目标相关线索；其次是“证据到决策（Evidence-to-Decision）”阶段，将当前观测与累积证据相结合，以精准锚定目标并支持后续导航动作或澄清问题的生成。
在多项权威基准测试中，GG-Nav 展现出了显著的性能优势，在 HM3D ObjectNav、VL-LN 和 CoIN 基准上的成功率分别较现有最先进方法提升了 3.1%、16.6% 和 5.3%。消融实验进一步证实，累积中间观测证据使证据缺失导致的失败率降低了 11.6%，显式证据定位则将停止误差大幅减少了 49.4%。此外，研究团队将 GG-Nav 成功部署于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上，充分验证了其在未见真实世界环境中的零样本泛化能力。
Emerging strong Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced navigation foundation models. However, these models still have unsatisfactory performance on goal-oriented navigation settings. In this paper, we first conduct a motivating study revealing that the key issue lies in the insufficient utilization of streaming observations and imprecise target localization. To tackle these challenges, we propose GG-Nav, a simple yet effective navigation framework that learns a structured chain-of-thought (CoT) mechanism via supervised fine-tuning to explicitly localize goal-relevant instances, accumulate grounding evidence, and support more reliable decision-making. Specifically, the structured CoT is designed with two key stages: (i) Observation-to-Evidence, which reasons over all intermediate frames between adjacent decision steps to retain useful goal-related evidence; and (ii) Evidence-to-Decision, which integrates the current observation with accumulated evidence to ground the target and support the generation of navigation actions or clarification questions. Extensive experiments show that GG-Nav outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in terms of success rates on the HM3D ObjectNav, VL-LN, and CoIN benchmarks by 3.1%, 16.6%, and 5.3%, respectively. Ablation studies further show that accumulating evidence from intermediate observations reduces evidence-missing failures by 11.6%, while explicit grounding reduces stopping errors by 49.4%. We also deploy GG-Nav on a Unitree Go2 robot, demonstrating its zero-shot generalization capability in unseen real-world environments.
SHOES: Sim-to-real Hardware-adaptation via On-policy Expansion of Skills for Legged Robots
SHOES：通过在线策略技能扩展实现足式机器人“仿真到现实”的硬件适配
人类可以通过穿戴合适的鞋履（如登山鞋或冰鞋）改变足底与地面的接触界面，从而显著扩展自身在复杂地形上的移动能力。然而，在机器人学中，绝大多数移动控制器都是针对固定且单一的躯体形态（morphology）进行训练的；当为机器人安装鞋履等末端装具时，足部几何形状、质量分布以及摩擦力特性的剧烈改变往往会导致已有控制策略的性能发生严重退化。
为此，本文提出了 SHOES——一个用于使移动策略高效自适应鞋履所致躯体形态变化的微调框架（sample-efficient adaptation framework）。为了在真实硬件上实现极高的高样本效率自适应，SHOES 冻结了在仿真中预先训练好的标称策略（nominal policy），仅在机器人上微调轻量化且经过恒等初始化（identity-initialized）的调置模块（modulation modules）；这种结构设计不仅完美保留了标称策略原有的鲁棒基础行为，还大幅降低了在线微调的参数量与收敛时间。此外，研究团队还引入了 SafeBox——一个具备工作空间感知的路点采样器（workspace-aware waypoint sampler），将在线自适应过程严格约束在用户定义的安全工作空间内，有效防止了实机微调期间因失控导致的机械损坏。
在配备不同鞋履的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上的仿真实验表明，在极少的自适应预算下，SHOES 能够大幅恢复因形态变化而退化的移动性能；在相同的自适应开销下，其表现显著优于纯 FiLM、纯线性适配器（Linear Adapter）以及残差强化学习（Residual RL）等主流基线方法。进一步的真实世界硬件实验在穿戴真实人类鞋履的 Unitree Go2 上展开，全面验证了 SHOES 在面对物理装具变更时极佳的 Sim-to-Real 自适应能力与部署效率。
Humans expand their locomotion capability by wearing appropriate footwear, such as hiking boots for mountains or skates for ice. Footwear changes the ground-contact interface and enables traversal of otherwise difficult terrain. In contrast, locomotion controllers are typically trained for a fixed morphology, and their performance can degrade when shoes alter foot geometry, mass, and friction. We propose SHOES, a sample-efficient framework for adapting locomotion policies to footwear-induced morphology changes. SHOES freezes a simulation-trained nominal policy and fine-tunes only lightweight, identity-initialized modulation modules on the robot, preserving the initial behavior while enabling efficient hardware adaptation. We also introduce SafeBox, a workspace-aware waypoint sampler that constrains online adaptation within a user-defined workspace. The simulation results with a shoe-equipped Unitree Go2 show that SHOES substantially recovers locomotion performance after footwear-induced morphology changes using limited additional adaptation. Under the same adaptation budget, SHOES outperforms FiLM-only, Linear Adapter-only, and residual-RL baselines. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 fitted with human shoes further evaluate the effectiveness of SHOES for hardware deployment.
Anticipatory Gait Switching for Quadrupeds via Look-Ahead MDP Planning
基于前瞻性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）规划的四足机器人步态预判切换
四足机器人在复杂混合地形中穿行时，通常需要通过切换步态来保证运动安全性。然而，传统方法多由近场感知阈值来触发步态决策，往往导致在局部高度图中粗糙地形临近接触时才做出响应，从而造成决策滞后；同时，实践中为了硬件安全而强制执行的驻留或保护间隔等切换约束，又进一步加剧了反应式切换的局限性。因此，如何克服近场感知的滞后性，实现兼顾硬件约束与前瞻规划的步态智能切换，成为提升具身机器人全地形适应能力的关键瓶颈。
为此，本文提出了一种轻量级的纯高度图步态监督器，将前瞻性预测与底层运动约束统一整合进一个严密的决策框架中。该方法首先将以机器人为中心的局部高度图划分为近场、中场和远场三个几何环带，并将每个环带离散化为特定的地形类别，进而将环带随时间的演变建模为一个马尔可夫过程。在此基础上，步态选择被形式化为一个前瞻性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其转移模型与代价函数显式编码了平台特定的切换约束（如硬件驻留间隔），使机器人能够提前评估前方地形并规划出最优的步态序列。
研究团队在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上开展了详尽的室内与室外实地实验。评估结果表明，与经过精心调参的被动反应式基线相比，该方法显著减少了晚期切换现象，大幅降低了机器人在粗糙地形上使用无效步态的时间，并明显改善了机器人的横滚轴稳定性。该基于 MDP 的前瞻性约束感知步态切换框架在无需针对特定场地进行繁琐重新调参的前提下，有效增强了四足机器人在复杂多变环境中的运动鲁棒性。
Quadruped robots often switch gaits to traverse mixed terrain safely. Many practical supervisors enforce hardware constraints (e.g., dwell or guard intervals) using a transition handler. However, the switch decision itself is often driven by near-field thresholds, which can delay commitment when rough terrain is only detected shortly before contact in the local height map. We propose a lightweight height-map-only gait supervisor that unifies look-ahead and locomotion constraints in a single decision policy. A robot-centered height map is partitioned into near-, mid-, and far-field bands, each discretized into a terrain class, and band evolution is modeled as a Markov process. Gait selection is cast as a look-ahead Markov Decision Process whose transition model and cost explicitly encode platform-specific switching constraints. Indoor and outdoor experiments on a Unitree Go2 platform show reduced late switching, lower time spent using ineffective gaits on rough terrain, and improved roll stability compared to tuned reactive baselines. Overall, the MDP formulation yields anticipative constraint-aware gait switching that improves robustness without course-specific retuning.
Taming an End-to-End Autonomous Driving Policy for Urban Navigation of Quadruped Robots
面向四足机器人城市导航的端到端自动驾驶策略调控
将自动驾驶领域的端到端轨迹规划框架迁移至四足机器人城市导航时，往往面临机器人特有动力学、狭窄人行道几何约束及复杂微观场景的挑战。传统的自动驾驶规划模型多针对四轮车辆设计，难以直接适应面向人行道等复杂城市环境的短视界、高度灵活的目标导向局部导航需求。
为此，本文提出了 Go2-DrivoR——一个将经典的端到端自主驾驶轨迹规划框架 DrivoR 进行目标条件化适配的创新系统。该方法通过引入目标 Token（goal token）将局部坐标系下的子目标显式地融入轨迹生成流程，并在不重新设计核心解码器的前提下对车辆中心评分机制进行了精细化适配；同时，针对人行道导航特性重新定义了可行驶区域的合规性约束，并将原有的自我进展项（ego progress term）演化为目标条件化的自我进展度量，从而高效支撑了四足机器人的短视界局部轨迹规划。
该模型完全基于 TartanGround 仿真数据集进行训练，在未见过的仿真环境中显著提升了航点条件化的规划性能，并成功实现了向真实世界开环轨迹预测的零样本（zero-shot）泛化迁移。Go2-DrivoR 有效打通了自动驾驶端到端规划技术向四足具身智能城市导航的跨界演进通道，为复杂人行路网中的自主穿行提供了坚实的技术支撑。
We present Go2-DrivoR, a goal-conditioned adaptation of the end-to-end autonomous driving trajectory planning framework DrivoR for urban navigation with quadrupedal robots. By conditioning trajectory generation on a local-frame subgoal through a goal token and adapting the vehicle-centric scoring formulation, the method extends DrivoR to short-horizon goal-conditioned local planning without redesigning its core decoders. Specifically, we redefine drivable-area compliance for sidewalk-oriented navigation and reformulate the original ego progress term as goal-conditioned ego progress. Trained exclusively on TartanGround simulation data, Go2-DrivoR improves waypoint-conditioned planning performance on unseen simulation environments and transfers zero-shot to open-loop real-world trajectory prediction.
Feedback-Modulated Harmonic Policies for Quadruped Locomotion
用于四足运动的反馈调制谐波策略
传统的学习型四足机器人移动策略通常将观测直接映射为关节级动作，这使得运动的周期性结构在策略内部处于隐式状态。为了突破这一局限，本文研究了一种显式的替代表示方法，将每个关节轨迹表达为命令条件化的傅里叶级数（Fourier series），并利用来自机器人状态的反馈进行在线动态修正。这种设计将运动学的周期性先验直接嵌入网络架构中，克服了纯隐式映射在捕捉长期动态时序上的不足。
在该框架中，上下文网络（context network）负责生成傅里叶系数以及单步反馈网络的权重，其输出在执行过程中动态调整关节偏移量、谐波增益、频率和相位。为了深入理解底层机制，研究人员在仿真中对比了这种显式频率结构与直接输出关节目标的传统多层感知机（MLP）策略的隐藏层激活情况。动态模态分解（dynamic mode decomposition）表明，标准 MLP 策略在足端高度振荡频率及其二阶谐波附近也隐式展现出主导的激活模态，揭示了周期性结构在隐式策略中的自然涌现特征。
通过将仿真中训练完成的谐波控制器部署至 Unitree Go2 四足机器人硬件平台上，研究团队对其极限运行性能与负载能力进行了实地验证。实验结果表明，该控制器在独立测试中记录了高达每秒 3.67 米的机载估计峰值速度，并成功在背部承载高达 5.883 公斤的额外负载。这一成果充分证明了显式傅里叶级数表征与在线状态反馈相结合的控制策略，在实现高速奔跑及强大负载适应性方面的卓越效能。
Learned quadruped locomotion policies commonly map observations directly to joint-level actions, leaving the periodic structure of locomotion implicit in the policy. We investigate an alternative representation in which each joint trajectory is expressed as a command-conditioned Fourier series and modified online using feedback from the robot state. A context network generates the Fourier coefficients and the weights of a per-step feedback network, whose outputs adjust joint offsets, harmonic gains, frequency, and phase during execution. In simulation, we examine this explicit frequency structure alongside the hidden activations of an MLP policy that directly outputs joint targets. The harmonic waveforms change frequency and shape with commanded speed. Dynamic mode decomposition of selected MLP rollouts reveals dominant activation modes near the foot-height oscillation frequency and its second harmonic, showing periodic structure without an explicit Fourier generator. On a Unitree Go2, the simulation-trained harmonic controller records a provisional onboard-estimated peak speed of 3.67 meter per second and carries added loads up to 5.883 kilogram in separate trials.
PROOF: Perceptive Robustness via Out-of-Distribution Fallback for Legged Locomotion
PROOF：通过腿运动的分布外回退实现感知鲁棒性
基于视觉的感知移动（perceptive locomotion）使足式机器人能够在复杂环境中展现出卓越的地形适应与高动态运动能力。然而，这类系统的可靠性高度依赖于连续、高质量的视觉观测，本质上极易受到环境遮挡、镜面反射以及光照剧烈变化等退化视觉条件的影响，在实际部署中往往因感知失效而导致灾难性的移动崩溃。
为此，本文提出了 PROOF——一个能够在严重视觉干扰下实现鲁棒移动的感知运动框架。该方法创新性地采用了一种两阶段的教师-学生（teacher–student）学习范式，显式地对感知可靠性进行联合建模：教师策略同时学习由视觉驱动的主动感知行为与基于本体感受的安全回退（fallback）行为；而学生策略则引入不确定性预测机制，能够准确估计外感受特征的置信度，并在遭遇分布外（OOD）输入或视觉退化时主动抑制不可靠的视觉信号，无缝过渡至鲁棒的盲行（blind locomotion）状态。
研究团队在配备 RealSense D435 深度相机的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上对 PROOF 进行了真实世界的全面验证。在正常视觉条件下，该方法使机器人能够流畅执行高动态的跑酷机动，包括精准跨越大型鸿沟、登上高架平台以及在狭窄独木桥地形上平稳穿行；而在遭遇重度遮挡、强光突变等严重视觉退化场景时，机器人依然能够维持稳定、可靠的移动性能，有效解决了视觉感知失效带来的安全隐患。
Vision-based perceptive locomotion has enabled legged robots to achieve agile and terrain-aware locomotion across complex environments. However, the reliability of such systems heavily depends on visual observations, which are inherently susceptible to occlusion, reflective surfaces, and illumination variations, often resulting in catastrophic locomotion failures under degraded perception conditions. In this paper, we present PROOF, a perceptive locomotion framework that enables robust locomotion under severe visual disturbances. Our method adopts a two-stage teacher–student learning paradigm that explicitly models perception reliability: the teacher learns both perception-driven and proprioceptive fallback behaviors, while the student predicts exteroceptive features with uncertainty and suppresses them under out-of-distribution inputs. We evaluate our method on a Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a RealSense D435 depth camera in real-world settings. Under normal visual conditions, our method enables the robot to successfully perform high-dynamic parkour maneuvers, including traversing large gaps, elevated platforms, and narrow beam terrains. Under severe visual degradation, such as heavy occlusion and strong illumination changes, the robot continues to maintain stable and robust locomotion performance.
SG-CPG: Severity-Gated Central Pattern Generators for Adaptive Quadruped Locomotion under Continuous Actuator Degradation
SG-CPG：面向执行器持续退化环境下自适应四足运动的“严重程度门控型”中央模式发生器
自然界中的动物在四肢出现局部损伤或力量减弱时，往往不会生硬地切换步态，而是通过主动卸载受损肢体、重新协调其余健康肢体，并根据损伤的严重程度进行渐进式调整。这种平滑的梯度适应机制使动物能够在部分肢体力量丧失的情况下依然维持稳定的运动能力，而无需在健康状态与彻底失效之间进行离散的阶跃式转变。
受这一生物学行为的启示，本文提出了 SG-CPG——一个专为四足机器人持续执行动作衰退而设计的中央模式发生器（Central Pattern Generator, CPG）控制框架。SG-CPG 完整保留了预训练的健康 CPG 策略，并创新性地引入了两个由损伤严重程度驱动的门控机制：一是用于重新协调四条腿运动的残差门（residual gate），二是随着衰退加剧而渐进缩短受损腿步幅的振幅门（amplitude gate）。为了在仿真中精确复现真实的执行器退化，研究人员设计了两种模拟机制：降低关节扭矩上限的“上限机制（ceiling mechanism）”以及缩减底层控制器增益的“增益机制（gain mechanism）”，以此代表不同类型的执行器物理损伤。
在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上的仿真实验表明，在经历高达 95% 的关节力量损失且全向指令调度下，SG-CPG 依然保持了 100% 的小跑步态（trot）生存率，同时将指令跟踪误差控制在 8% 以内。在扭矩上限降低的场景下，若移除残差门中的严重程度观测或振幅门，当力量损失达到 80% 时，受损关节的饱和限幅比例将分别从 4.4% 飙升至 13.6% 和 26.3%。此外，在真实的 Unitree Go2 硬件平台上，面对高达 93% 的小腿扭矩退化，SG-CPG 在 29 次前向与转向测试中成功完成了 28 次。这些实验结果充分证明，基于严重程度门控的自适应策略能够将健康的运动控制能力无缝扩展至执行器渐进式衰退的场景中，避免了将故障视为离散失效的传统弊端。
An animal with a weakened limb does not necessarily switch its gait, instead it unloads the affected limb, re-coordinates the remaining limbs, and scales its response with injury severity. This graded adaptation allows locomotion to persist despite partial loss of limb strength, rather than requiring a discrete transition between healthy and failed. Inspired by this behavior, we propose SG-CPG, a central pattern generator (CPG) for quadruped locomotion under continuous actuator degradation. SG-CPG preserves a frozen healthy CPG policy and introduces two severity-driven gates: a residual gate that re-coordinates all four legs and an amplitude gate that progressively shortens the weakened leg's stride as degradation increases. We emulate progressive degradation through two mechanisms: lowering the joint torque ceiling (ceiling mechanism) and scaling its low-level controller gains (gain mechanism), representing distinct forms of actuator weakening. Our simulations on a Unitree Go2 show that SG-CPG maintains a trot gait with 100% survival across an omnidirectional command schedule under 95% joint strength loss while tracking commands within 8%. Under a lowered torque ceiling, removing either severity path, the residual's severity observation or the amplitude gate, raises clipping at the weakened joint from 4.4% to 13.6% and 26.3% of steps at an 80% loss. On a real Go2, SG-CPG survives 28 of 29 forward and turning trials with up to 93% calf torque degradation. These results show that severity-gated adaptation can extend a healthy locomotion policy to progressive actuator degradation without treating the fault as a discrete failure.
Magnet-Aware Control of Legged Robots
面向腿式机器人的磁感知控制
大型科学设施（如粒子加速器或核聚变反应堆）中的强磁场环境对自主机器人的运行构成了严峻的技术挑战。强磁场不仅会干扰并破坏机载传感器的正常读数，还会对机器人本体产生位置依赖的机械旋量（mechanical wrenches），从而严重破坏系统稳定性，导致传统的反应式控制器频繁失效。因此，如何在强磁场环境中实现对空间变化磁力的精确建模、实时估计与动态补偿，成为提升四足机器人极端环境作业鲁棒性的核心所在。
为此，本文提出了一套专为强磁场环境打造的先进控制与建模框架。首先，研究团队在 MuJoCo 仿真器中开发了一个定制物理插件，用于高精度建模刚体元件上的磁力交互；其次，创新性地引入了一种逆向场估计框架（inverse field-estimation framework），能够直接从四足机器人的动态响应及任意数量的传感器读数中推断出潜在的空间磁场分布。在此基础之上，本文构建了磁敏感模型预测控制（Magnet-Aware MPC）与全身控制（WBC）协同架构，在移动过程中主动预测并抵消磁场扰动，从而显著扩展了机器人的安全工作磁场包络。
在仿真验证与真实硬件实验的双重测试中，该方法展现出了卓越的补偿与抗扰性能。实验表明，相比于非补偿系统，该方法将磁场在力空间中的最大可抵抗扰动提升了 2.5 倍，在力矩空间中提升了 1.6 至 2 倍。在拟议的磁场测试范围内，机器人的有效可运行面积扩大了 29.34%，其中有 10.84% 的区域在传统非补偿控制器下会导致机器人发生即时结构性坍塌。该研究为机器人进入并长期服务于高能物理、核能等极端大科学设施开辟了一条全新的技术路径。
Autonomous robots can increase uptime and reduce human exposure in Big Science facilities, but strong magnetic fields needed for their operation corrupt sensors and induce pose-dependent mechanical wrenches that destabilize robots and challenge conventional reactive controllers. This paper presents a control framework for modeling, estimating, and dynamically compensating for spatially varying magnetic wrenches acting on legged robots to improve robustness in these fields. We introduce a custom physics plugin for the MuJoCo simulator to model magnetic forces on rigid-body elements, alongside an inverse field-estimation framework to infer the latent magnetic field directly from quadruped dynamic responses and any number of sensor readings. Furthermore, we develop a Magnet-Aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Whole-Body Control (WBC) architecture that predicts and counteracts magnetic perturbations during locomotion to increase the range of magnetic fields in which the robot can operate. The effectiveness of the framework is validated through both simulation and physical hardware experiments. We show our method increases the the maximum rejectable disturbances from magnetic field in the force space by a factor of 2.5 and and between 1.6-2 times in torque space compared to a non-compensated system. Within the proposed magnetic field, this constitutes an increase in the area in which the robot can operate by 29,34% of which 10,84% would have previously caused an immediate collapse to non-compensated controllers.
Deformable Object Manipulation under Partial Observability via Real-Time Full-Shape Estimation
基于实时全形估计的、在部分可观测条件下的可变形物体操作
由于可变形物体（Deformable Objects, DOs）具有高维状态空间、欠驱动动力学以及严重的部分可观测性，对其进行精确操控一直是机器人学中的核心难点。传统的物理模拟模型（如 XPBD 模型）虽然能够刻画复杂的形变过程，但往往依赖繁琐的物理参数辨识且计算开销巨大，难以满足实时闭环控制的需求。如何在仅依靠稀疏边界观测的条件下实现高维状态的高效重建，并将其嵌入模型预测控制框架中，构成了实现复杂可变形物体智能操控的关键瓶颈。
为此，本文提出了 cRVAE——一个轻量级的条件循环变分自编码器（conditional recurrent variational autoencoder），旨在仅利用局部的部分角点观测（corner-node observations）在推理时准确估计出完整的可变形物体状态。该模型被无缝集成至滚动时域最优控制（receding-horizon optimal control）框架中，作为前向动力学模型支撑避障条件下的协同可变形物体操控。尤为重要的是，cRVAE 在推理阶段完全不需要任何物理参数作为模型输入，也彻底摆脱了复杂的在线参数辨识流程。
在针对绳索与织物的仿真评估中，cRVAE 在保持与参数辨识后的 XPBD 模型相媲美精度的同时，展现出了压倒性的计算效率优势：其单步前向推理速度在绳索任务中比 XPBD 快约 350 倍，在织物任务中更是超过 1500 倍，从而将时域规划控制稳稳维持在 100 毫秒的严格控制预算之内（而 XPBD 在短时域内即告超时）。这种在控制循环内实现全形态高速估计的能力，为其在真实硬件上的落地铺平了道路，研究团队最终在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上成功验证了该算法在真实世界的协同操控效能。
Manipulating deformable objects (DOs) is challenging due to their high-dimensional state space, underactuated dynamics, and partial observability. In this paper, we propose cRVAE, a lightweight conditional recurrent variational autoencoder that estimates the full DO state from only partial corner-node observations during inference. The resulting model is used as the forward model in a receding-horizon optimal control framework for obstacle-aware collaborative DO manipulation. In simulation on rope and fabric, cRVAE estimates the full DO state from the available corner-node measurements alone, matching the accuracy of a parameter-identified XPBD model. At inference it uses no physical parameters as model inputs and performs no online parameter identification. It also runs approximately 350 times faster on the rope and over 1500 times faster on the fabric per forward pass, keeping horizon-based planning within the 100 ms control budget where XPBD exceeds it already at short horizons. Full-shape estimation from corner sensing at in-loop speed is what makes the model deployable on hardware, which we demonstrate on a Unitree Go2 robot.
Transporting Unsecured Stacked Payloads with a Quadrupedal Robot via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
利用多目标强化学习，通过四足机器人运输未固定的堆叠负载
在复杂不平坦地形中，使用足式机器人运送未固定负载面临着一个根本性的性能权衡：激进的移动策略虽然能保证机器人的本体平衡，却极易导致货物失稳、倾覆或滑落。这一挑战在缺乏专用负载传感器或主动夹持机构的场景下尤为严峻（例如在无边缘的躯干搭载板上搬运堆叠纸箱），传统的固定控制策略无法在动态行进中自适应调整运动剧烈程度与货物稳定性的边界。
为此，本文提出了 PAMORT（Payload-Adaptive Multi-Objective Reinforcement learning for Transportation，面向负载自适应的多目标强化学习运输框架）。该方法的核心创新在于将运输任务建模为一个多目标优化问题：首先训练一个以偏好向量为条件的多元基础策略，该向量对“机器人移动性能”与“负载稳定性”两组奖励函数进行加权平衡；在此基础之上，系统训练了一个轻量级的权重调节器（weight adjuster），固定底层策略的同时，仅凭机器人自身的本体感觉（proprioception）在在线执行过程中实时调整偏好权重，从而在无需外部视觉或载荷传感器的情况下动态响应负载状态的变化。
在仿真实验中，PAMORT 在多种负载配置下展现出了卓越的泛化能力，不仅在常规任务中表现优异，甚至在仅使用两箱配置训练的情况下，实现了向未见的三箱堆叠任务的零样本泛化，整体运输成功率显著优于单一目标的对比基线。研究团队将该算法零样本部署至真实的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人硬件平台上，在难度达到或超过训练水平的坡道与台阶场景中进行了严苛测试。在涵盖八项任务的真实世界评估中，PAMORT 的平均成功率达到了 0.850，而对照基线仅为 0.675，充分证明了基于本体感觉的在线移动-负载权衡自适应机制在无固定载荷运输中的强大鲁棒性。
Transporting unsecured payloads with legged robots over uneven terrain requires balancing locomotion performance and payload stability, since aggressive motion can destabilize the payload even when the robot remains stable. We study quadrupedal transportation of unsecured stacked boxes on an edgeless torso-mounted board without dedicated payload sensors or active carrier mechanisms. To address this trade-off, we propose Payload-Adaptive Multi-Objective Reinforcement learning for Transportation (PAMORT). PAMORT trains a multi-objective base policy conditioned on a preference vector that weights locomotion and payload-stability reward groups, then trains a weight adjuster on the frozen policy to adapt this preference online from proprioception. In simulation, PAMORT achieves comparable or better overall transportation success than a corresponding single-objective baseline across different payload configurations, including an unseen three-box stack, despite training only with two boxes. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 demonstrate zero-shot transfer to slopes and steps at or beyond the training difficulty, with mean success rates of 0.850 for PAMORT and 0.675 for the baseline across eight tasks. These results demonstrate robust unsecured-payload transportation with online adaptation of the locomotion--payload trade-off from proprioceptive information.
E2DRL: End-to-End Differentiable Reinforcement Learning for 3D Obstacle Avoidance in Quadruped Robots
E2DRL：用于四足机器人三维避障的端到端可微强化学习
可微分强化学习（Differentiable Reinforcement Learning）在机器人策略学习中展现出巨大的潜力，然而其在足式机器人移动领域的应用长期局限于盲行（blind walking）或简化的二维仿真任务。将该技术扩展至端到端视觉障碍规避（end-to-end visual obstacle avoidance）面临着严峻的理论与优化挑战：传统的硬碰撞约束以及接触即终止的策略机制会严重破坏一阶梯度信息，导致优化器在复杂空间中极易陷入局部最优。
为此，本文提出了 E2DRL，通过引入一种软可微分的障碍物交互公式（soft differentiable obstacle-interaction formulation）成功克服了梯度污染的瓶颈。该方法在多个身体关键点之间精细施加穿透惩罚（penetration penalties），并结合速度条件化的停止梯度塑形（velocity-conditioned stop-gradient shaping），为三维障碍物规避提供了稳定可靠的一阶训练信号。在此基础上，系统采用软解析策略优化（SAPO）在可微分仿真器中训练一个具备特权信息的教师策略，随后通过 DAgger 算法将其高效蒸馏为基于循环神经网络的深度感知学生策略，并在最终部署时通过地形感知门控模块（terrain-aware gating module）将其与基础移动策略完美融合。
在仿真评估中，E2DRL 展现出远超传统 PPO 的样本效率，并在速度跟踪性能以及三维障碍物规避能力上全面优于 PPO 与基于对偶的 DCBF NMPC 基线方法。研究团队在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上完成了动静态环境下的实地测试，实现了端到端可微分强化学习在三维障碍物规避任务中的首次仿真到真实世界（sim-to-real）的成功验证，显著拓展了可微分控制在复杂具身智能场景中的应用边界。
Differentiable reinforcement learning shows strong promise for robot policy learning, but its application to legged locomotion has remained limited to blind walking or simulated 2D tasks. Extending it to end-to-end visual obstacle avoidance is challenging because hard collision constraints and early termination upon contact corrupt first-order gradients, trapping optimizers in local minima. We present E2DRL, which addresses this with a soft differentiable obstacle-interaction formulation: penetration penalties across multiple body keypoints with velocity-conditioned stop-gradient shaping to provide the first-order training signals for 3D obstacle avoidance. To realize a deployable perception-control system, a privileged teacher trained via Soft Analytic Policy Optimization (SAPO) in a differentiable simulator is distilled into a recurrent depth-based student via DAgger, then blended with a base locomotion policy using a terrain-aware gating module for deployment. In simulation, E2DRL achieves higher sample efficiency than PPO and demonstrates superior velocity-tracking performance and 3D obstacle-avoidance capability compared with both PPO and Duality-based DCBF NMPC. We present the first sim-to-real validation of end-to-end differentiable RL for 3D obstacle avoidance on a Unitree Go2 in static and dynamic environments.
Walking on Roofs: Exploring the Potential of Walking Robots for Construction Work on Roofs
屋顶行走：探索步行机器人用于屋顶施工作业的潜力
屋顶环境作为具身机器人自动化作业中一个极具挑战性且长期被忽视的新兴场景，兼具极高的职业安全风险与繁重重复的劳动力需求，具有广阔的机器人替代潜力。然而，四足机器人在该领域的规模化部署长期受阻，部分原因在于缺乏针对特定应用场景的专用设计与定制化控制框架。为此，本文针对四足步行机器人在屋顶环境中的自动化作业可行性展开了深入研究，旨在探究复杂屋顶曲面与倾斜架构对现有腿式机器人软硬件架构提出的本质挑战。
为了科学评估机器人的基准性能，研究团队搭建了一个专属的屋顶表面物理测试台，并以商用四足机器人 Unitree Go2 作为实验平台进行系统性测试。实验重点考察了机器人在不同倾斜角度下的移动基准，深入分析了足端与屋顶建筑材质之间的接触力学、起立与躺下等基础姿态转换的可行性，以及滑动动力学特征。通过精确隔离标准移动基元在屋顶材料上的失效模式，该研究揭示了通用室内外控制范式在面对极端摩擦变化和重力偏置时的局限性，为理解足式机器人在非结构化建筑外立面上的动力学交互提供了重要数据支撑。
实验结果揭示了标准球形足（ball feet）在屋顶环境中固有的严重局限性：打滑现象随倾斜角度的增加呈二次方级数恶化，起立与躺下等动作序列仅能在微小倾坡上勉强完成，而当坡度达到 25° 的中等倾斜度时，系统便会频繁发生系统性失效与严重跌落。这项工作首次对四足机器人在屋顶环境中的移动性能进行了系统性评估，明确指出了当前技术的瓶颈与潜力。研究表明，未来实现屋顶自主作业需要将面向任务的专用足部形态设计、先进的接触力学建模以及专为屋顶适应性优化的强化学习控制策略进行深度有机结合。
This paper investigates the feasibility of deploying quadruped walking robots for the automation of work in roof environments. While quadrupeds have demonstrated versatility across various domains, their large-scale deployment remains limited, partly due to lack of application-specific designs. Roof environments represent a novel and unexplored use case, combining high safety risks for human workers with repetitive, strenuous tasks that could benefit from robotic assistance. A dedicated test rig of a roof's surface was designed to evaluate the baseline performance of a commercial quadruped, the \emph{Unitree Go2}, in this new environment. Experiments revealed that standard ball feet are inherently inadequate for locomotion on sloped roofs: slippage increased quadratically with incline angle, get-up and lie-down sequences were only possible on small inclines, and critical failures already occurred regularly on moderate inclines of 25°. This work provides the first systematic assessment of quadruped locomotion in roof environments, highlighting both the potential and the current limitations of this application and establishes a baseline for future research. Effective solutions will require a combination of task-oriented foot designs, advanced contact mechanics and environment-specific control strategies, such as reinforcement learning for roof-adapted gaits.
On-Device Vision-Language Reasoning for Context-Aware Event Verification and Label-Free Detector Training on an Assistive Quadruped
面向辅助型四足机器人的端侧视觉-语言推理：实现情境感知事件验证与无需标注的检测器训练
辅助四足机器人不能仅仅简单地将躺在地板上的人员判定为异常，而是必须在车载端实时推理出该人员究竟是在休息、伸展取物还是确实发生了意外跌倒。然而，机器人的视觉视角通常较低且处于持续运动状态，若仅依靠单一姿态阈值进行判断，极易产生误报或漏报，难以满足安全攸关场景下的智能行为识别需求。
为此，该研究采用小型视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为多模态推理器，在无需任何训练的条件下，利用机器人低位且运动的视角对事件进行语义验证并编写简短报告，从而实现基于上下文而非单纯姿态的高级推理。由于该模型运行速度较慢而无法持续在线运行，研究团队将其置于关键控制路径之外（off the critical path），利用其对原始视频素材进行标注，并在完全没有人工标签的情况下蒸馏出一个耗时仅为 1 毫秒的检测器；该检测器保持常驻运行（always-on），并随着机器人观测到更多场景而不断自我改进。
研究团队以人类跌倒检测这一安全关键型案例来验证这种上下文依赖的推理能力，并在 UR-Fall 数据集以及真实硬件平台——Unitree Go2 四足机器人上开展了系统的评估，充分证明了该方法在实际复杂具身环境中的可行性。
An assistive quadruped should not simply flag a person lying on the floor. It has to reason, from what it sees, whether the person is resting, reaching for something, or has actually fallen, on board and in real time. We use a small vision-language model as the multimodal reasoner. On the robot’s low, moving view, with no training, it verifies the event and writes a short report, reasoning about context rather than posture alone. Because the model is too slow to run continuously, we use it off the critical path. It labels raw footage and distils a one-millisecond detector with no human labels, which then runs always-on and keeps improving as the robot sees more. We take human fall detection as a concrete, safety-critical case of this context-dependent reasoning, and evaluate on UR-Fall and on a Unitree Go2.
LocoPilot: Single-Operator Bilateral Teleoperation for Loco-Manipulation Policy Learning
LocoPilot：用于移动操作策略学习的单操作员双向遥操作方法
学习具身协同移动操作（loco-manipulation）策略需要能够捕获目标机体上底座与机械臂协同运动的高质量示范数据。传统的无机器人接口虽然提高了数据收集的灵活性，却无法直接捕获平台特定的底层指令、本体感受以及机载观测数据；而机载遥操作虽然能够直接获取这些关键信号，但往往需要一套能够同时并发控制整个复杂系统的专用交互接口。
为此，本文提出了 LocoPilot——一个专为四足移动操作设计的单操作员双边遥操作与数据收集框架。该系统在一个 12 自由度的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上进行实现，该平台集成了 6 自由度的 AgileX Piper L 机械臂、Intel RealSense D435 腕部相机以及 Intel RealSense D405 头部相机。系统通过第二个 6 自由度 Piper L 机械臂作为主端（leader）并配合两个手持控制器，实现对移动底座、躯干姿态、机械臂及夹爪的并发控制；随动臂的交互力在无需专用力/力矩传感器的前提下进行估计，并通过受无源性约束的触觉通道渲染给操作员。同时，一个 ROS 2 管道负责记录同步的多模态观测数据，并提供了一个统一的 11 维动作空间，贯穿遥操作与策略部署的全过程。
相比以往工作，LocoPilot 独特地统一了机器人闭环移动数据采集、无需动作捕捉仪器的力反馈机制，以及部署时保持一致的动作接口。研究团队在多项移动操作任务中对该交互接口进行了广泛评估，并通过对抓取放置（pick-and-place）示范数据进行微调 MolmoAct2 模型，成功在真实的物理机器人上完成了完整的“收集到部署”全流程验证，实现了无需动作重定向或额外逆运动学的直接部署。
Learning loco-manipulation policies requires demonstrations that capture coordinated base and arm motion on the target embodiment. Robot-free interfaces allow demonstrations to be collected independently of the target robot, increasing flexibility but without directly capturing platform-specific commands, proprioception, and body-mounted observations. On-robot teleoperation allows to capture these signals directly, but requires an interface capable of commanding the complete system concurrently. This paper presents LocoPilot, a single-operator bilateral teleoperation and data-collection framework implemented on a 12-DoF Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a 6-DoF AgileX Piper L manipulator, an Intel RealSense D435 wrist camera, and an Intel RealSense D405 head camera. A second 6-DoF Piper L arm, used as the leader and two handheld controllers provide simultaneous control of the base, body posture, manipulator, and gripper. The follower arm interaction forces are estimated without a dedicated force/torque sensor and rendered to the operator through a passivity-constrained haptic channel. A ROS~2 pipeline records synchronized multimodal observations together with a unified 11D action shared by teleoperation and policy deployment. Compared to prior work, LocoPilot uniquely unifies robot-in-the-loop legged data collection, force feedback without motion-capture instrumentation, and the same action interface at deployment. We evaluate the interface across multiple loco-manipulation tasks and validate the complete collection-to-deployment pipeline by fine-tuning MolmoAct2 \cite{MOLMO} on pick-and-place demonstrations and deploying on the physical robot without action retargeting or additional inverse kinematics.
LLA-MPPI: Rapidly Adaptive Whole-body Control of Legged Robots with GPU-Accelerated Parallel Simulations
LLA-MPPI：基于GPU加速并行仿真的足式机器人快速自适应全身控制
足式机器人的实时全身控制器通常依赖于固定的名义模型，一旦部署时的动力学环境发生变化，控制性能便会显著退化。传统的自适应方法往往要求接触动力学难以提供的特定模型结构，或者需要针对每一种预期工况进行繁琐的离线训练。因此，如何在无需离线训练的前提下实现对未知或动态变化环境的实时在线适应，一直是腿式机器人控制领域亟待解决的核心痛点。
为此，本文提出了 LLA-MPPI（回看与前瞻自适应模型预测路径积分控制，Look-back and Look-ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral control）。该方法将全身适应性问题巧妙地转化为对一组具有不同物理或结构参数的 GPU 批处理接触模拟器库的选择过程；通过窗口化预测误差来挑选出能够最好地解释近期运动状态的模拟器，随后全身 MPPI 规划器便基于该选定模型进行控制优化。该框架不仅完全摆脱了离线训练的依赖，而且其所选取的模型假设具备清晰的物理可解释性。
在四项模拟任务的综合评估中，LLA-MPPI 取得了 97.5% 的成功率，而最强对比基线仅为 74%，逼近拥有真实模型信息的理想预言机（oracle）所达到的 98.5%。研究团队在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人硬件平台上对该系统进行了严格的物理验证，实验表明机器人成功实现了在运行中途添加负载、单条腿失效后继续正常行走，以及在动态增加质量的同时推动箱子到达目标位置等高难度任务，充分彰显了该方法在应对复杂环境突变时的卓越鲁棒性与在线自适应能力。
Real-time whole-body controllers for legged robots typically plan through a fixed nominal model and degrade when the deployed dynamics change. Adaptive methods typically require a model structure that contact dynamics do not provide, or they need offline training for each anticipated condition. We present Look-back and Look-ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral control (LLA-MPPI). The method converts whole-body adaptation into selection over a bank of GPU-batched contact simulators with different physical or structural parameters. Windowed prediction errors select the simulator that best explains recent motion. A whole-body MPPI planner optimizes controls through the selected model. The framework requires no offline training, and its selected hypotheses are physically interpretable.
