Across four simulated tasks, it achieves 97.5% success while the strongest baseline reaches 74% and an oracle with the true model reaches 98.5%. Hardware validation on a Unitree Go2 shows the robot walking under a payload added mid-run, walking after one leg is disabled, and pushing a box to its goal while increasing its mass on the fly.
Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies
面向机器人策略的高效测试时自适应
强化学习（RL）策略在机器人移动部署时，常因运行条件发生偏移（如崎岖或湿滑地形、负载变化、感知退化）而失效，且在受限的机载延迟和内存约束下，重新训练或手动重新校准往往难以实现。为此，本文研究了机器人控制的测试时自适应（test-time adaptation, TTA）：在执行过程中无需奖励信号，在线且以自监督方式对预训练策略进行自适应调整。
在以冻结的预训练评论家（critic）作为部署时性能替代物、仅更新行动者（actor）的轻量级基线基础之上，本文提出了 TEMPO（测试时熵正则化、记忆引导的策略优化方法，Test-time Entropy-regularized, Memory-guided Policy Optimization），旨在严重环境偏移下稳定评论家驱动的更新。TEMPO 主要包含两个核心组件：一是针对评论家预测分布引入熵促进正则化项，以缓解过度自信的外推现象；二是受优先经验回放启发的基于分数的记忆机制，该机制优先处理低价值（即“困难”）观测，并通过重要性采样将有限的计算资源集中在最具价值的部署条件上。
在 MuJoCo Playground 仿真环境中针对 Go1、Go2 和 G1 机器人在四种代表性环境偏移及多种架构下进行的评估表明，TEMPO 实现了稳定的性能增益，在单设备设置下取得了高达 80% 的性能提升。此外，研究人员在搭载了额外小腿负载的真实 Unitree Go2 硬件平台上进行了实地验证，完全机载的自适应策略在真实世界的多次测试中均显著优于未经自适应的基线。
Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspired by prioritized replay, that prioritizes low-value ("hard") observations and applies importance sampling to focus limited computation on the most informative deployment conditions. Across Go1, Go2, and G1 in MuJoCo Playground under four representative shifts and multiple architectures, TEMPO yields consistent gains, reaching up to 80% improvement in a single-device setting. We further validate on a physical Unitree Go2 with an added calf payload, where fully on-device adaptation improves performance over the non-adapted baseline across real-world episodes.
Unified Whole-Body Control for Quadrupedal Tactile-Informed Loco-Manipulation
面向四足机器人触觉感知运动与操作的统一全身控制
动态移动操作（loco-manipulation）要求足式机器人在面对不确定外力时，既能协调全身运动，又能与被抓取物体保持稳定的物理交互。尽管触觉感知在机器人操作领域得到了广泛研究，但其在动态全身控制中的作用长期以来仍未得到充分探索。现有的无触觉反馈方法通常采用死板的紧握策略，而无法根据实时的物理交互情况自适应调节抓握力度。
为此，本文提出了 TAC-LOCO——一个触觉增强的统一强化学习框架。该框架将来自柔性夹爪的触觉阵列观测编码为紧凑的潜在表征（latent representation），并将其与本体感觉无缝结合，实现对腿部、手臂和夹爪的统一控制。通过精心设计的抓握稳定性奖励机制，该策略能够同时追踪机体速度与末端执行器轨迹、适度调节抓握力，并在遭遇渐进式负载变化或突发释放事件时有效防止物体滑落。
研究团队将该策略零样本（zero-shot）部署至搭载了 Interbotix WidowX 250 机械臂及触觉夹爪的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上。实验结果表明，TAC-LOCO 在面对多变的外界物理交互时展现出了卓越的动态触觉感知移动操作能力，成功实现了抓握力降低 47% 且物体跌落率低于 1% 的优异性能，显著提升了移动操作系统的智能化水平与鲁棒性。
Dynamic loco-manipulation requires legged robots to coordinate whole-body motion while maintaining stable physical interaction with grasped objects under uncertain external forces. While tactile sensing has been widely studied for robotic manipulation, its role in dynamic whole-body control remains largely unexplored. Existing works without tactile feedback commonly grasp firmly rather than regulate the grasp according to the interaction. We propose TAC-LOCO, a tactile-augmented unified reinforcement learning framework that encodes tactile array observations from compliant grippers into a compact latent representation and joins it with proprioception for unified control of the legs, arm, and gripper. With effective grasp stability reward design, the policy learns to simultaneously track body velocity and end-effector trajectories, moderate grasp force, and prevent object slip under both gradual load changes and sudden release events. We deploy the policy zero-shot on a Unitree Go2 with an Interbotix WidowX 250 arm and tactile gripper, demonstrating dynamic tactile-informed loco-manipulation under varying external interactions, achieving a 47% reduction in grasping force and an object drop rate of less than 1%.
MagGAT: Structure-Aware Spatiotemporal Graph Attention for Motor-Induced Magnetic Interference Compensation in Quadruped Robots
MagGAT：面向四足机器人电机引起磁干扰补偿的结构感知时空图注意力机制
永久磁同步电机（Permanent-magnet synchronous motors）为紧凑型机器人提供了精准的运动控制能力，然而其产生的漏磁场（leakage fields）会严重干扰并污染机载磁力计的测量数据。尽管基于物理建模的补偿方法在固定几何条件下表现有效，但四足机器人在移动过程中其电机与传感器之间的相对空间关系处于持续变化之中，导致传统静态物理模型难以适应复杂运动学状态下的磁场畸变。
为此，本文提出了 MagGAT——一种结构感知时空图注意力网络（structure-aware spatiotemporal graph attention network），旨在根据电机状态与近场测量值精确估计出经过补偿的磁场信号。该方法利用杆装远场磁力计（boom-mounted far-field magnetometer）提供监督训练与场级评估所需的伪参考基准，并将全局-局部双分支图注意力模块（用于捕捉多电机之间的空间耦合关系）与门控循环单元（GRU，用于对时间演化过程中的磁场扰动进行建模）进行有机结合。
研究团队在室内外环境中利用 Unitree Go2 四足机器人采集了同步的近场与远场测量数据、关节角度、角速度以及指令力矩，对 MagGAT 进行了系统性评估。实验结果表明，在采用不同随机种子进行的多次运行中，MagGAT 的三轴磁场残余均方根误差（RMSE）均保持在 87.72–89.41 nT 之间，全面超越了基于物理的固定参数模型、静态神经网络方法以及时间卷积基线；消融实验进一步证实了空间图建模与时间建模对于提升补偿精度的关键作用，为抑制紧凑型足式机器人上的电机感应磁干扰提供了高效的结构感知时空学习方案。
Permanent-magnet synchronous motors enable precise motion control in compact robots, but their leakage fields can corrupt onboard magnetometer measurements. Physics-based compensation is effective under fixed geometric conditions, whereas quadruped locomotion continuously changes the motor–sensor relationship. We propose MagGAT, a structure-aware spatiotemporal graph attention network that estimates compensated magnetic field signals from motor states and near-field measurements. A boom-mounted far-field magnetometer provides a pseudo-reference for supervised training and field-level evaluation. MagGAT combines a global–local dual-branch graph attention module for multi-motor spatial coupling with a gated recurrent unit for temporal disturbance modeling. Experiments on a Unitree Go2 quadruped used synchronized near-field and far-field measurements, joint angles, angular velocities, and commanded torques collected in indoor and outdoor environments. Across three runs with different random seeds, MagGAT achieved mean residual three-axis magnetic field RMSE values of 87.72–89.41 nT across the three test sequences and outperformed a physics-based fixed-parameter model, a static neural network method, and a temporal convolutional baseline. Ablation studies confirmed that both spatial graph modeling and temporal modeling contributed to compensation accuracy. These results support structure-aware spatiotemporal learning for suppressing motor-induced magnetometer interference on compact legged robots.
CMP-IRRT*: A Perception-Assisted Height-Adaptive Planner for Quadruped Robots
CMP-IRRT*：一种面向四足机器人的感知辅助式高度自适应规划器
四足机器人在复杂地形中具备跨越低矮障碍物的能力，然而传统的二维路径规划流水线通常将障碍物简单建模为二值占用区域，并依赖于在有限计算预算下效率低下的采样搜索方法。这种粗粒度的二值化建模忽略了地形的连续高度特征与可通行性，导致机器人在面对可跨越障碍时无法生成最优的穿行路径，严重制约了机器人在非结构化环境中的导航效率。
为此，本文提出了一种名为 CMP-IRRT*（Channel Mamba PointNet-guided Informed RRT*）的感知辅助高度自适应规划框架。该框架的感知模块通过标定的俯视 RGB 观测估计障碍物区域，并将深度预测转换为地面相对高度图；在此基础上，规划器执行高度条件下的碰撞检查，将高大障碍物视为不可通行的阻挡区，同时允许低矮障碍物作为可通行区域。此外，该方法引入了基于 Channel Mamba 和 PointNet 的引导机制，在保留标准自由空间与知情采样回退机制的同时，将采样偏向更具潜力的区域，从而大幅提升搜索效率。
在二维规划基准测试中，CMP-IRRT* 相比传统与神经引导的基线方法显著减少了探索节点数与迭代次数，且控制消融实验充分证实了基于 Mamba 的引导模块的核心贡献。在构建的可通行性感知场景中，当低矮障碍物允许通行时，该规划器将路径长度缩短了高达 16.3%；研究团队进一步在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上完成了实地部署，成功验证了该系统在真实物理环境中执行绕行与跨越行为的卓越可行性。
Quadruped robots can traverse low obstacles, but many 2D planning pipelines still model obstacles as binary occupied regions and rely on sampling-based search that can be inefficient under a limited budget. We propose a perception-assisted height-adaptive planning framework based on CMP-IRRT*, a Channel Mamba PointNet-guided Informed RRT* planner. Given a calibrated top-view RGB observation, the perception module estimates obstacle regions and converts depth predictions into a ground-relative height map. The planner then performs height-conditioned collision checking, treating high obstacles as blocked while allowing low obstacles to be traversed, and uses the CMP guide to bias sampling toward promising regions while retaining standard free-space and informed sampling fallbacks. Experiments on 2D planning benchmarks show that CMP-IRRT* reduces explored nodes and iterations compared with classical and neural-guided baselines, and a controlled ablation supports the contribution of the Mamba-based guide. In constructed traversability-aware scenarios, the proposed planner reduces path length by up to 16.3% when low obstacles are traversable, and a Unitree Go2 demonstration further shows executable bypassing and traversal behaviors.
A Model-Based Approach to Security Assessment of Robotic Systems in Healthcare: The Case of a Quadruped Robot
一种基于模型的方法：医疗保健领域机器人系统的安全评估——以四足机器人为例
医疗环境（如康复中心）正日益引入机器人系统，通过执行常规任务来协助不堪重负的医护人员。然而，在临床环境中部署机器人会引入必须在投入使用前进行评估的安全风险。小型设施往往不具备进行全面网络安全审计所需的专业专长或预算，而现有的安全分析方法又严重依赖于分析师的个人专家知识，难以在资源受限的环境中推广。
为此，本文提出了一种基于模型的安全分析方法，旨在协助非专家评估已部署系统的安全性。该方法引导非专家利用通用指导词以及衍生自系统模型的指导词来创建攻击树。此外，研究引入大语言模型（LLM）在攻击树创建过程中充当安全专家团队成员：由安全专家进行一次性的提示词模板创建活动，使非专家仅需填入系统的具体信息，即可获取由 LLM 生成的攻击树输出。
研究团队以部署在康复中心中的 Unitree Go2 Air 机器人狗为例，展示了该方法的各个方面。文章详细展示了为 LLM 创建提示词模板的初步步骤，并通过实例验证了通用指导词与基于模型的指导词在帮助非专家构建更具相关性的攻击树过程中的重要实用价值。
Robotic systems are increasingly being adopted in healthcare environments such as rehabilitation centres, in order to help support overburdened staff by performing more routine tasks. However, deploying a robot in a clinical setting introduces security risks that must be assessed before use. Small facilities rarely have access to the specialised expertise or budget needed to perform a full cybersecurity audit, and existing approaches to security analysis rely heavily on the expert knowledge of the analyst. We propose a model-based security analysis approach that assists non-experts in assessing the security of a deployed system. The approach guides non-experts in creating attack trees using both generic guidewords, as well as guidewords that are derived from system models. Additionally, an LLM is used to act as a security expert team member in the attack tree creation process. We have a security expert create a prompt template as a one-time activity, so that non-experts only need to fill in specific information on the system in order to get an attack tree output by the LLM. We use an example scenario of a Unitree Go2 Air robot dog deployed in a rehabilitation centre to demonstrate various aspects of our approach. We show initial steps towards creating a prompt template for the LLM, and show the usefulness of both the generic and model-based guidewords in creating more relevant attack trees by non-experts.
PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
PROMO：面向四足机器人的偏好条件多目标强化学习
四足机器人的移动控制需要在指令跟踪、稳定性和能效等相互冲突的目标之间进行精细权衡。然而，传统的强化学习（RL）方法在训练阶段将这些优先级硬编码为固定的标量奖励，缺乏根据实际运行需求灵活调整控制偏好的能力，导致策略无法在部署时实时响应操作员的动态意图或适应多样化的任务场景。
为此，本文提出了 PROMO（Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning，偏好条件化多目标强化学习）——一种语义多目标控制方法，将目标权衡转化为单一移动策略的显式运行时输入。PROMO 通过将策略条件化绑定至部署面向的偏好（deployment-facing preferences），同时保持机体特异的移动先验固定，成功将操作员的高层意图与生成可行步态所需的奖励塑形项清晰分离，从而在保持单一可部署策略的同时实现了目标专业化与高度的鲁棒性。
在仿真环境对 100 种采样偏好的评估中，有 67 种行为在精确帕累托优势（Pareto dominance）下达成了非支配解，其平均偏好-目标相关性高达 0.843，充分证明了该方法具备广泛的帕累托前沿覆盖率与高度可预测的偏好响应特性。研究团队将该策略零样本（zero-shot）部署至真实的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上，实验结果表明，仅通过动态改变偏好设置，即可使机器人的特定能耗降低高达 30.4%、位置误差减少 38.7%、峰值躯干姿态偏差降低 59.0%（相对于平衡偏好），确立了偏好条件化多目标强化学习作为自适应足式移动实用运行时接口的核心价值。
Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting objectives such as command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency, yet conventional reinforcement learning (RL) hardcodes these priorities into a fixed scalar reward at training time. We present PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning), a semantic multi-objective approach that makes this trade-off an explicit runtime input to a single locomotion policy. PROMO conditions the policy on deployment facing preferences while keeping embodiment-specific locomotion priors fixed, thereby separating operator intent from reward shaping terms required for viable gait generation. Compared with fixed-objective controllers, multi-objective baselines, and independently trained specialists, PROMO achieves objective specialization and robustness from a single deployable policy. Across 100 sampled preferences in simulation, 67 behaviors are non-dominated under exact Pareto dominance, with a mean preference-objective correlation of 0.843, demonstrating broad Pareto coverage and predictable preference response. The same policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree Go2, where preference changes alone reduce specific energy by up to 30.4%, position error by 38.7%, and peak body-attitude deviation by 59.0% relative to the balanced preference. These results establish preference-conditioned multi-objective RL as a practical runtime interface for adaptive legged locomotion, extending its role beyond offline Pareto-set construction.
Weakly Supervised Discovery of Motion Styles for Compositional Robot Control
用于组合式机器人控制的运动风格弱监督发现
当机器人的自由度超过任务实际需求时，多条不同的运动轨迹均可通过独特的运动风格（motion styles）达成同一目标。组合式机器人控制（compositional robot control）旨在保持选定风格的同时，同步执行独立的任务指令，从而在这些可能存在冲突的目标之间实现有效平衡。
为此，本文提出了 CODES——一个用于组合式机器人控制的创新框架，能够从多样化的录制数据中发现一个连贯的风格库（style repertoire），并将其与独立的任务指令进行有机组合。该框架包含三个核心处理阶段：首先，通过动作重定向（motion retargeting）将录制数据映射为目标机器人可执行的动作；其次，利用弱监督共识编码（weakly supervised consensus encoding）与基于密度的聚类方法，在无需预设风格数量的前提下识别录制内部及跨录制的运动风格；最后，通过强化学习训练策略，将发现的风格与独立指令进行组合控制。
研究团队在两个仿真器以及真实物理硬件平台上，以 Unitree Go2 四足机器人为对象对 CODES 进行了全面评估。实验结果表明，与传统基线方法相比，CODES 显著提升了运动学连贯性（kinematic coherence）。此外，该控制器能够成功跟踪超出录制数据支持范围的速度指令，在跨仿真器与真实世界的硬件部署中均展现出鲁棒且清晰可辨的风格特征。
When a robot possesses more degrees of freedom than a task requires, multiple trajectories can achieve the same objective using distinct motion styles. Compositional robot control aims to preserve a selected style while simultaneously executing an independent task command, effectively balancing these potentially competing objectives. In this paper, we present CODES, a framework for compositional robot control that discovers a coherent style repertoire from diverse recordings and composes it with independent commands. First, motion retargeting maps the recordings to motions executable by the target robot; next, weakly supervised consensus encoding and density-based clustering identify styles within and across recordings without a prescribed count; finally, reinforcement learning trains a policy to compose the discovered styles with independent commands. We evaluate CODES on a Unitree Go2 quadruped across two simulators and physical hardware. Compared to baselines, CODES significantly improves kinematic coherence. Furthermore, our controller successfully tracks velocity commands that generalize beyond the support of the recorded data, exhibiting robust and distinguishable style characteristics during both cross-simulator and real-world hardware deployments.
EIDA: Execution-Interface Dynamics Adaptation for Real-to-Sim-to-Real Robot Navigation
EIDA：面向“实-仿-实”机器人导航的执行-接口动态自适应
机器人策略在从仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的迁移过程中，常因速度指令所产生的实际运动及反馈与策略训练时的建模假设存在差异而导致部署失败。传统的自适应方法通常依赖于复杂的执行器动力学重建，但在实际应用中，准确建模底层驱动与传动特性极其困难。因此，如何在不直接重建繁琐执行器动力学的前提下，利用目标平台的执行数据在线补偿动态偏差，成为了提升移动机器人导航迁移鲁棒性的核心挑战。
为此，本文提出了 EIDA（Execution-Interface Dynamics Adaptation，执行-接口动力学自适应） 框架。该方法直接从目标平台的执行数据中拟合系统响应，而无需显式重构底层的执行器动力学。具体而言，系统设计了一个机体坐标系姿态增量模型来更新模拟器的几何结构，并通过一个独立的预测模型来估计策略所观测到的速度反馈，同时将短期的速度反馈历史纳入策略输入中；这些拟合出的模型随后被嵌入到一个轻量级的 GPU 并行模拟器中，实现高效的策略优化与评估。
在 Jackal 和 Go2 的完整验证集上，EIDA 拟合模型相比模拟器预定义的运动模型显著降低了位置和偏航预测误差。在包含 100 个基准导航环境的独立基于物理的模拟器评估中，EIDA 在有或无全局引导的情况下均取得了最高的成功率与导航得分，而反馈消融实验则进一步验证了匹配策略端速度估计的必要性。在真实的 Unitree Go2 硬件平台测试中，EIDA 在全部 20 次静态场景试验中均实现了无碰撞到达目标（相比之下基线方法仅为 4/20），充分证明了执行-接口自适应在无需详细执行器模拟的情况下大幅提升导航迁移性能的卓越效能。
Simulation-to-robot transfer can fail when velocity commands produce motion and feedback that differ from those modeled during policy training. We present execution-interface dynamics adaptation (EIDA), which fits these responses from target-platform execution data without reconstructing actuator dynamics. A model of body-frame pose increments updates simulator geometry, while a separate model predicts the velocity feedback observed by the policy; a short history of velocity feedback is included in the policy input. The fitted models are used within a lightweight GPU-parallel simulator. On the full Jackal and Go2 validation sets, the fitted models reduced position and yaw prediction errors relative to the simulator's predefined motion model. Across 100 benchmark navigation environments evaluated in a separate physics-based simulator, EIDA achieved the highest success rate and navigation score among the compared learned policies, both with and without global guidance. Feedback ablations further supported the need to match policy-facing velocity estimates. On a physical Unitree Go2, EIDA reached the goal without collision in all 20 static-scene trials, compared with 4 of 20 for the baseline. These results show that execution-interface adaptation can improve navigation transfer without detailed actuator simulation.
Navigation Explainability for Object Avoidance with LLMs for Assistive Robots
基于大语言模型的辅助机器人避障导航可解释性研究
盲人和视觉障碍人士（Blind and visually impaired, BVI）在不熟悉的环境中导航时常面临极大的不确定性，无论是依靠盲杖还是导盲犬，应对复杂多变的环境均存在诸多挑战。为了缓解这一痛点，本文提出了 ContextAware Navigation Explanation（上下文感知导航解释） 框架，旨在利用大语言模型（LLM）对辅助导盲机器人在避障与导航过程中的运动行为进行自然语言解释。
该系统将视觉/环境感知上下文与规划的未来运动轨迹进行深度融合，从而生成针对机器人行为的自然语言解释，提升人机交互中的透明度。研究团队将该框架部署于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上，并在室内导航场景中开展了系统评估，重点探究了不同的解释上下文配置（context configurations）对用户信任度（trust）与解释满意度（explanation satisfaction）的具体影响。
实验结果表明，用户的解释满意度与信任度之间存在显著的正相关关系；同时，数据分析进一步指出，将障碍物信息与未来轨迹预测相结合能够生成最具说服力与有效性的解释。这些研究结果突出了上下文感知语言解释在增强辅助导航机器人透明度与构建用户信任方面的巨大潜力，为下一代无障碍人机协作与智能导盲系统的设计提供了重要的理论与实践指导。
Blind and visually impaired individuals face uncertainty when navigating unfamiliar areas. Whether a cane or a guide dog is used for navigation, this may prove to be challenging. To mitigate this challenge, we present the ContextAware Navigation Explanation framework that explains guide dog movements for obstacle avoidance and navigation using a large language model. This system integrates perceptual context with planned future trajectories to generate natural-language explanations of robot movement. We deploy the system on a Unitree Go2 platform in indoor navigation scenarios and evaluate how different explanation context configurations affect user trust and explanation satisfaction. Results show a strong positive relationship between explanation satisfaction and trust, and suggest that combining obstacle information with future trajectory leads to the most effective explanations. These findings highlight the potential of context-aware language explanations to improve transparency and trust in assistive robot navigation.
Predict Before You Step: Auditable Occupancy Forecasting for Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance under Sparse Guidance
先行预测：稀疏引导下动态避障的可审计占用预测
在稀疏航点引导下，足式机器人需要在面对局部且快速变化的激光雷达（LiDAR）观测时实现对移动障碍物的有效规避。然而，传统的局部避障策略往往缺乏对环境未来动态演化的前瞻性预测，在高速交会或瞬息万变的环境中难以从容应对复杂轨迹的动态障碍物，这对机器人的实时感知、状态预测与局部规控能力提出了严峻挑战。
为此，本文提出了 LOOP（Latent-recurrent Occupancy rollOut Policy，潜伏循环占用展开策略）——一种将稀疏航点引导与冻结的底层移动控制器以 50 Hz 高频紧密连接的本地避障策略。该方法的核心在于引入了一个循环预测器，它根据占用状态与自车速度历史（ego-velocity histories），利用学习得到的流（flow）与可见性门控（visibility gates）对当前地图进行空间变形（warping），从而预测未来 1 秒时间跨度内的占用情况。这些生成的预测地图随后通过地图衍生特征与几何风险估计来指导速度选择，为检查和替换预测结果提供了一个清晰直观的显式接口。
在同步交会的 Isaac Lab 仿真评估中，LOOP 在 2.5–3.2 m/s 的障碍物速度下取得了 57.1% 的正面交会成功率，超越了重新训练的反应式基线 8.2 个百分点；与无展开（rollout-free）的 BEV 策略相比，它在最高正面交会速度下表现出更优的跨越成功率以及更低的训练种子变异性。研究团队将该算法适配器成功部署在 Unitree Go2 真实硬件上，单步执行耗时仅为 14.5 毫秒，并在全部 16 次真实世界的交叉穿行试验中均实现了零碰撞通过，充分验证了其出色的实时部署可行性与鲁棒性。
Legged robots under sparse waypoint guidance must avoid moving obstacles using partial, rapidly changing LiDAR observations. We present LOOP (Latent-recurrent Occupancy rollOut Policy), a local avoidance policy that connects sparse waypoint guidance to a frozen locomotion controller at 50 Hz. From occupancy and ego-velocity histories, a recurrent predictor forecasts future occupancy over a 1 s horizon by warping the current map with learned flow and visibility gates. These maps guide velocity selection through map-derived features and geometric risk estimates, providing an explicit interface for inspecting and replacing predictions. In encounter-synchronised Isaac Lab evaluations, LOOP achieves 57.1% head-on success at obstacle speeds of 2.5-3.2 m/s, exceeding a retrained reactive baseline by 8.2 percentage points. Comparisons with a rollout-free BEV policy show smaller, scenario-dependent gains from the prediction branch, including improved crossing success and reduced variability across training seeds at the highest head-on speeds. The adapter runs onboard a Unitree Go2 in 14.5 ms per step and completes all 16 real-world crossing trials without collision, demonstrating deployment feasibility.
CAST: Alternating State-Value Targets and Expanded Policy Gradients for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
CAST：面向基于模型的强化学习的交替状态值目标与扩展策略梯度
模型基于强化学习（MBRL）通过学习环境模型来实现高效的动作选择，在机器人学中因其出色的样本效率而备受青睐。将学习到的模型与在线规划相结合可以进一步提升动作选择性能，因为规划器能够利用模型寻找优于单纯依赖学习策略的优质动作。然而，当前将学习策略与在线规划相结合的方法通常只去学习策略本身的价值，而未能充分利用更强大的规划器引导行为。
为此，本文提出了 CAST（Critic with Alternating State-value Target，交替状态价值目标的评论家方法）。该方法利用规划器引导的行为来改善价值学习，同时借助当前策略对价值估计进行正则化。CAST 用状态价值评论家（state-value critic）取代了动作-价值评论家，其训练目标结合了真实的规划器引导转换（transition）与当前策略下的虚拟转换。这种生成的价值函数对应于规划器引导行为与当前策略之间的一个交替过程，使其既能从更强大的规划器行为中获益，又能受到正在学习的策略的规范与正则化。
研究团队在 DeepMind Control 和 HumanoidBench 基准测试集上将 CAST 与多种最先进的方法进行了全面对比评估，并成功将其迁移至真实的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人硬件平台上，使其完成了高动态的倒立（dynamic handstand）动作，充分验证了该方法在处理复杂、高动态控制任务中的优越性能与强大鲁棒性。
Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) is a family of RL methods that learn a model of the environment and use it for action selection, making it well suited to robotics due to its sample efficiency. Combining learned models with online planning can further improve action selection, as the planner can exploit the model to find better actions than the learned policy alone. Recent methods combining learned policies with online planning typically learn the value of the policy rather than the stronger planner-guided behavior. We present CAST (Critic with Alternating State-value Target), which uses planner-guided behavior to improve value learning while regularizing the value estimate with the current policy. CAST replaces the action-value critic with a state-value critic, trained using a target that combines a real planner-guided transition and an imagined transition under the current policy. The resulting value function corresponds to an alternating process between planner-guided behavior and the current policy, allowing it to benefit from the stronger planner behavior while being regularised by the policy being learned. We evaluate CAST on the DeepMind Control and HumanoidBench Suites against several state-of-the-art methods, and demonstrate successful transfer to a physical Unitree Go2 quadruped performing a dynamic handstand.
SparseNav: Instruction-conditioned Sparse Semantic Perception for Training-Free Vision-Language Navigation
SparseNav：面向无需训练的视觉-语言导航的指令条件式稀疏语义感知
基于地图的视觉-语言导航（VLN）通常依赖持久的空间表征来连接语言理解与几何规划。然而，无选择地获取超越当前指令需求的语义会带来不必要的感知成本和无关标注，持续累积无关物体不仅会浪费计算资源，还会对视觉-语言模型（VLM）规划器所依赖的视觉-空间表征造成干扰与冗余。
为此，本文提出了 SparseNav——一个遵循“少即是多（less-is-more）”语义导航原则的无训练（training-free）框架。该框架持久维护一个轻量级的几何鸟瞰图（BEV）地图与稀疏的地标记忆，并通过活动子指令按需获取新语义，以智能决定哪些视觉内容值得进行基础定位（grounding）。具体而言，系统中的指令管理器首先跟踪导航进度并识别出当前激活的地标查询；随后，指令条件感知机制在查询地标可见且其度量位置能够指导下一步决策时，自动调用开放词汇分割（open-vocabulary segmentation）。最终，生成的稀疏地标记忆支持 VLM 在混合前沿与局部方向航点候选之间进行精准选择。
在没有任何额外训练的情况下，SparseNav 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 的 Val-Unseen 验证集上分别取得了 42.8% 和 40.7% 的成功率，受控消融实验也深入探讨了语义感知策略与各框架组件的具体贡献。研究团队进一步将 SparseNav 部署在搭载了 Intel RealSense D455 RGB-D 相机（用于几何建图与地标定位）和 Livox MID-360 LiDAR（用于定位）的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上，在没有预建地图的真实条件下，通过指令条件航点导航在多个室内环境中成功验证了该系统的强大泛化能力与实际有效性。
Map-based vision-language navigation (VLN) relies on persistent spatial representations to connect language understanding with geometric planning. However, acquiring semantics beyond the needs of the current instruction can introduce unnecessary perception cost and irrelevant annotations. Continuously accumulating unrelated objects may not only waste computation, but also clutter the visual-spatial representation consumed by the vision-language model (VLM) planner. To address this problem, we present SparseNav, a training-free framework that follows a less-is-more principle for semantic navigation. SparseNav persistently maintains a lightweight geometric bird's-eye-view (BEV) map and sparse landmark memory, acquiring new semantics on demand using the active sub-instruction to decide what is worth grounding. An instruction manager first tracks navigation progress and identifies the active landmark query. An instruction-conditioned perception mechanism then invokes open-vocabulary segmentation when the queried landmark is visible and its metric location can inform the next decision. The resulting landmark memory supports VLM selection among hybrid frontier and local directional waypoint candidates. Without any additional training, SparseNav achieves success rates of 42.8% on R2R-CE and 40.7% on RxR-CE, both on the Val-Unseen splits. Controlled ablations examine semantic perception strategies and the contributions of individual framework components. Furthermore, we successfully deployed SparseNav on a Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with an Intel RealSense D455 RGB-D camera for geometric mapping and landmark grounding and a Livox MID-360 LiDAR for localization, without a prebuilt map. We validated its effectiveness across multiple indoor environments using instruction-conditioned waypoint navigation.
AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory
AVALON：基于人工引导拓扑记忆的室内零样本导航
室内服务机器人经常会进入那些对机器人而言完全陌生、但其空间布局与任务约束对人类用户而言却早已熟悉的建筑物。针对这种“人类熟悉、机器人陌生”的挑战性场景，本文提出了 AVALON——一个围绕人类植入的分层空间内存、节点验证式拓扑执行以及任务触发且证据门控的人机内存协同更新机制所构建的拓扑导航框架。
在实际部署中，机器人无需任何现场预先通行记录或特定场地的训练，仅需提供一张平面图、位置线索（place clues）以及初始的拓扑-里程计对齐即可。系统利用视觉深度点目标导航（visual depth point-goal navigation），通过验证的节点到达情况来执行平移重新锚定（translational re-anchoring），且完全不依赖机器人自身构建的全局 SLAM 地图。此外，人机内存协同更新机制能够有机融合互补的信息源：人类操作员负责指定那些无法通过视觉直接观测到的任务约束并报告离线环境变动，而机器人则通过主动的现场验证来提供物理状态证据。任务相关性决定了人类报告的环境变动是否需要在主动任务执行期间接受机器人的现场验证，而实地采集的感知证据则对内存更新进行门控（gating），从而在人类指定的权限与机器人观测到的实际可通行性之间保持了清晰的边界。
研究团队在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上开展了广泛的实验。结果表明，搭载 X-NavDP 的 AVALON 仅用 46.4 秒便成功完成了 12.81 米的“十字路口到餐厅（Intersection-to-Dining）”导航任务（成功率 5/5 且无需任何预先建图），耗时比 DimOS-Go2（78.5 秒，成功率 4/5）减少了 40.9%，而纯策略（policy-only）的 X-NavDP 在所有 5 次运行中均宣告超时，充分证明了该拓扑导航框架在应对非结构化人类熟悉环境时的卓越优越性与鲁棒性。
Indoor service robots often enter unmapped buildings whose layouts and task constraints are already familiar to users. We address this human-familiar, robot-unseen setting with AVALON, a topological navigation framework organized around human-seeded layered spatial memory, node-verified topological execution, and task-triggered, evidence-gated human--robot memory co-updating. The robot has no prior on-site traversal or site-specific training. Deployment requires only a floor plan, place clues, and an initial topology-odometry alignment. Visual depth point-goal navigation leverages verified node arrivals to perform translational re-anchoring, without requiring a robot-constructed global SLAM map. Human--robot memory co-updating fuses complementary sources of information. Human operators specify task constraints that are unobservable via vision and report offline environmental modifications, whereas the robot provides physical-state evidence through active in-situ validation. Task relevance governs whether human-reported environmental changes undergo robot validation during the active mission. Field-collected perceptual evidence gates memory updates, maintaining an explicit separation between human-specified permissions and robot-observed traversability. Our experiments on a Unitree Go2 show that AVALON with X-NavDP completes a 12.81 m Intersection-to-Dining mission in 46.4 s (5/5) with no mapping, 40.9% less robot time than DimOS-Go2 (78.5 s, 4/5), while policy-only X-NavDP times out in all of the 5 runs. These demonstrate the superiority of the proposed topological navigation framework.
VAMPS: Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning
VAMPS：基于采样规划的视觉与运动策略
直接在物理系统上训练机器人策略往往面临数据收集成本高昂以及策略探索过程存在安全隐患的挑战。为此，本文推出了 VAMPS（Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning，基于采样的规划学习视觉与运动策略）框架。该框架巧妙利用模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制，在完全无需人工示范数据的条件下实现可复用机器人策略的高效训练，为解决具身智能中的数据瓶颈提供了一条新途径。
VAMPS 灵活支持两种核心训练模式。首先，针对单步本体感觉策略，系统在仿真环境中进行迭代运行：策略为 MPPI 提供温启动（warm-start），经精炼的轨迹不断反馈新的监督信号，并引入学习得到的终点价值与隐式 Q 学习（IQL）评论家共同指导策略更新，这种迭代精炼机制显著优于传统单次训练，并成功迁移至真实的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人上。其次，针对视觉运动策略，系统直接从真实机器人数据中学习，利用 MPPI 在 Flexiv Rizon 10S 机械臂上规划执行轨迹并记录多模态观测，同时采用带 Transformer 的动作分块（Action Chunking with Transformers, ACT）技术离线训练以缩短有效预测时域。
研究团队通过视觉运动抓取与放置（pick-and-place）以及力感知的白板擦除任务对该框架进行了全面验证；在白板擦除任务中，策略还能够额外观测到测得的 6 维力/力矩及目标法向力。这些研究结果充分证明，VAMPS 既能够通过“仿真训练加硬件迁移”的方式完成复杂控制，也可以直接从自主采集的真实机器人数据中高效学习到高性能的视觉与运动策略。
Learning robot policies directly on physical systems remains difficult because data collection is costly and policy exploration can be unsafe. We introduce Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning (VAMPS), a framework that uses Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control to train reusable policies without human demonstrations. VAMPS supports two training modes. For one-step proprioceptive policies, it operates iteratively in simulation: the policy warm-starts MPPI, and the refined trajectories provide new supervision as the policy changes. A learned terminal value improves short-horizon planning, while an Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) critic guides the policy update. Iterative refinement outperforms training once on frozen MPPI data, and we transfer the learned locomotion policy to a Unitree Go2. For visuomotor policies, VAMPS operates directly from real-robot data. MPPI uses task-specific state estimates to plan and execute trajectories while recording RGB and sensor observations on a Flexiv Rizon 10S. Action Chunking with Transformers predicts action chunks, reducing the effective prediction horizon, and is trained offline on this fixed dataset. We demonstrate visuomotor pick-and-place and force-aware whiteboard erasing. In the latter task, the policy additionally observes the measured 6-D wrench and desired normal force. These results show that VAMPS can learn policies either in simulation followed by hardware transfer or directly from autonomously collected real-robot data.
Have You Seen It Clearly? Uncertainty-Guided Belief Refinement for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
看清了吗？基于不确定性引导的信念精炼：用于零样本目标导航
零样本目标导航（Zero-Shot Object Navigation, ZSON）要求智能体在对测试类别或环境未经额外训练的情况下，在陌生环境中准确定位目标物体。近期的主流方法普遍利用大语言模型（LLM）与视觉-语言模型（VLM）来构建空间表征并指导探索，然而现有研究尚未充分解决两个核心问题：一是当前可用的感知证据是否足以支持具体的导航决策，二是新获取的证据如何动态改变已访问位置的搜索价值。
为此，本文提出了 RefBeliefMap——一个不确定性引导的建图框架，能够将目标位置信念（target-location belief）与空间及语义证据的不确定性进行明确区分。该框架通过在滑动记忆窗口内对单次观测内部的不确定性（intra-observation uncertainty）与多次观测间的不一致性（inter-observation disagreement）进行联合建模，精准评估两个证据通道的可靠性；当竞争前沿（competing frontiers）无法被充分解算时，不确定性估计将引导主动观测与语义推理，在做出导航承诺之前精炼支持目标位置信念的证据。在此基础上，研究团队推出了 RefBeliefNav 导航机制，根据目标寻找潜力、预期信息增益以及导航成本，联合评估未探索的前沿与历史航点，使得历史位置能够在新证据改变其搜索价值时被重新考量，从而实现了探索与重访的高效协调。
在 HM3D 和 MP3D 数据集上的评估实验表明，RefBeliefMap 与 RefBeliefNav 在受评的零样本基线方法中取得了最先进的性能表现（SOTA），消融实验进一步证实了各个核心模块的具体贡献；研究团队还在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上开展了真实世界实验，成功验证了该方法卓越的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移能力。
Zero-Shot Object Navigation (ZSON) requires an agent to locate target objects in unfamiliar environments without additional training for the test categories or environments. Recent approaches leverage large language models and vision-language models to construct spatial representations and guide exploration. However, whether the available evidence sufficiently supports a navigation choice, and how new evidence changes the search value of previously visited locations, remain insufficiently addressed. We propose RefBeliefMap, an uncertainty-guided mapping framework that distinguishes target-location belief from spatial and semantic evidence uncertainty. By jointly modeling intra-observation uncertainty and inter-observation disagreement over a sliding memory window, RefBeliefMap assesses the reliability of both evidence channels. When competing frontiers remain insufficiently resolved, these uncertainty estimates guide active observation and semantic reasoning to refine the evidence supporting target-location beliefs before navigation commitment. Building on the refined map, we introduce RefBeliefNav, which jointly evaluates unexplored frontiers and historical waypoints according to their target-finding potential, expected information gain, and navigation cost. This unified objective allows historical locations to be reconsidered as new evidence changes their search value, coordinating exploration and revisitation. Experiments on HM3D and MP3D demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated zero-shot baselines, with ablation studies examining the contributions of modules. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 quadruped robot further demonstrate the sim-to-real transferability of our method.
InsightMap: Structured Spatial Modeling for Embodied Multimodal Reasoning
InsightMap：面向具身多模态推理的结构化空间建模
语言引导导航（Language-guided navigation）要求智能体将局部观测与持久的空间参考进行关联，并理解动作如何改变这一空间表征。然而，如何在复杂环境中建立高效统一的空间记忆与多任务推理机制仍是一大挑战，传统方法往往难以在导航、视觉问答与三维定位之间实现有机的多模态融合。
为此，本文推出了 InsightMap——一个创新框架，它将俯视地图（top-down maps）同时用作显式空间记忆与动作条件预测目标。该框架将历史视角链接到带标签的地图位置，通过共享的多模态骨干网络联合学习导航动作预测与动作后地图生成，其中地图预测为系统提供了强有力的辅助训练监督。此外，系统集成了一个对齐的 RGB-D 数据管道，为导航、视觉问答、情境推理以及 3D 基础定位提供了一个通用的统一操作接口。
在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 的 Val-Unseen 验证集上，InsightMap 分别取得了 56.9% 和 54.9% 的成功率（SR），加入地图预测监督使 R2R-CE 的 SR 提升了 4.3、SPL 提升了 3.2 个百分点，并在多个静态空间基准任务中表现优异。研究团队进一步将 InsightMap 部署在 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上，在走廊、实验室和办公室等真实环境中展现出全面超越 NaVid 与 NaVILA 的卓越性能。
Language-guided navigation requires connecting partial observations to a persistent spatial reference and learning how actions change that representation. We introduce InsightMap, a framework that uses top-down maps as both explicit spatial memory and action-conditioned prediction targets. Historical views are linked to labeled map locations, and a shared multimodal backbone jointly learns navigation action prediction and post-action map generation. Map prediction provides auxiliary training supervision, while navigation inference decodes actions from the observed spatial context. An aligned RGB-D data pipeline supports a common interface for navigation, visual question answering, situated reasoning, and 3D grounding. On the validation-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, InsightMap achieves success rates (SR) of 56.9% and 54.9%, respectively. Adding map-prediction supervision improves R2R-CE SR by 4.3 and success weighted by path length (SPL) by 3.2 percentage points. On static spatial tasks, InsightMap achieves 103.7 CIDEr on ScanQA, 60.1% exact-match accuracy on SQA3D, and 53.1% grounding accuracy at 0.5 IoU on ScanRefer with detected object proposals. On Unitree Go2, it outperforms NaVid and NaVILA in hallway, lab, and office environments.
Reliability-Aware Sparse Route Memory for Round-Trip Vision-Language Navigation
面向往返式视觉-语言导航的、具备可靠性感知能力的稀疏路径记忆
视觉-语言导航（VLN）传统上多被评估为单向任务，然而在实际部署中，机器人往往需要在抵达目标后执行原路返回的操作。针对这一实际需求，研究人员开始聚焦于连续往返视觉-语言导航（continuous round-trip VLN），并深入诊断了机器人在方向可观测性、偏差恢复以及终止稳定性等方面面临的各类失效与挑战。
为此，本文提出了一种可靠性感知稀疏路径记忆机制（reliability-aware sparse route memory）。该机制将机器人执行的外出轨迹记录为有序的几何锚点，并通过结构化提示、动作级仲裁以及终端验证进行逆向查询，从而在复杂环境中有效保障了返程轨迹的精确跟踪。
研究团队基于 NaVILA 框架并在模拟的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上开展了成对返程测试。实验结果表明，该在线系统显著提升了返程成功率，清晰地揭示了信息质量、行为一致性与在线可靠性是制约长视野往返导航性能的三个独立关键边界。
Vision-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated as a one-way task, although deployed robots may need to return after reaching a goal. We study continuous round-trip VLN and diagnose failures in directional observability, deviation recovery, and termination stability. We propose a reliability-aware sparse route memory that records the executed Outbound trajectory as ordered geometric anchors and queries them in reverse through a structured hint, action-level arbitration, and terminal verification. On 50 reverse-paired episodes using NaVILA and a simulated Unitree Go2, language-only Return succeeds in 22.0% of episodes, while our online system reaches 55.1%. With exact route information, the same interfaces achieve 86.0%, showing that effective Return requires both accurate information and consistent action on that information. The remaining online gap arises mainly from geometric evidence that is too unreliable to authorise intervention. These results distinguish information quality, behavioural consistency, and online reliability as separate limits in long-horizon navigation.
Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation
将基础模型构建为物理世界智能体，推动了长时程导航的前沿发展
长视野物理世界智能体（Long-horizon physical-world agents）需要在针对远端目标进行复杂推理的同时，将控制决策稳健地锚定于可靠的闭环行为中。然而，现有的基础模型将这些能力割裂开来：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）擅长推断缺失信息并调整高层规划，但在重复的导航定位上表现脆弱且低效；而导航基础模型（NFMs）虽能稳健执行语义目标，却仅能作为受限的剧集（bounded episodes）运行，缺乏持久的任务级推理能力。
为此，本文推出了 NavMCP——一个将 VLM 推理智能体与 NFM 执行器紧密耦合的智能体脚手架框架（agentic scaffolding framework），专为长视野探索任务设计。该框架中，VLM 负责决定寻找何种证据、何处搜索以及何时停止，而 NFM 则将每个语义子目标精准打靶至闭环导航中；二者通过三大通道展开协同：意图通道将证据需求转化为导航调用，观测通道将路线展开转化为带有源头定位的轨迹证据，内存通道则跨调用不断累积发现、否定证据以及未解决的目标，在无需重新训练任何模型的前提下将孤立的导航动作转化为持久的具身交互。
在具身问答（Embodied Question Answering, EQA）基准测试中，NavMCP 在 HM-EQA、MT-HM3D 和 EXPRESS-Bench 上均取得了最先进的性能（SOTA），在匹配的智能体与执行器骨干网络下，其性能在 HM-EQA 上超越剧集式接口 14.9 个百分点。研究团队进一步将其部署在真实的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上，NavMCP 达到了 78.3% 的导航成功率，且随着任务视野（task horizon）的不断扩大，其相比最强基线的领先优势从 10 个百分点大幅扩大至 45 个百分点，充分展现了将互补基础模型通过脚手架机制整合为长视野物理世界智能体的巨大潜力。
Long-horizon physical-world agents must reason over distant goals while grounding decisions in reliable closed-loop behavior. Today's foundation models split these capabilities: vision-language models (VLMs) infer missing information and adapt high-level plans but remain brittle and inefficient at repeated navigation grounding, while navigation foundation models (NFMs) robustly execute semantic goals but operate as bounded episodes without persistent task-level reasoning. We introduce NavMCP, an agentic scaffolding framework that couples a VLM reasoning agent with an NFM executor for long-horizon exploration. The VLM decides what evidence to seek, where to search, and when to stop, while the NFM grounds each semantic sub-goal into closed-loop navigation. Three channels structure their collaboration: intent translates evidence needs into navigation calls, observation converts rollouts into source-grounded trajectory evidence, and memory accumulates findings, negative evidence, and unresolved goals across calls. This design turns isolated navigation rollouts into persistent embodied interaction without retraining either model. On Embodied Question Answering, NavMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on HM-EQA, MT-HM3D, and EXPRESS-Bench. Under matched agent and executor backbones, it outperforms an episodic interface by 14.9 percentage points on HM-EQA. On a Unitree Go2, NavMCP reaches 78.3% success, with its margin over the strongest baseline growing from 10 to 45 points as the task horizon increases. These results demonstrate the potential of scaffolding complementary foundation models into long-horizon physical-world agents.
Structure over Reasoning: Unified Zero-Shot Navigation with a Small Vision-Language Model
结构优于推理：基于小型视觉-语言模型的统一零样本导航
视觉-语言导航（VLN）正逐渐迈入真实感物理模拟场景，其中领先的零样本智能体通常将视觉-语言模型置于控制循环中来选择每一步的移动与停止。然而，机器人更倾向于使用小型模型，但其能力往往参差不齐：以 Qwen3-VL-4B 为例，它虽能判断单一视角是否酷似目标，但其路径推理处于随机水平、距离估计几乎保持常数、停止投票亦不可靠，直接用于端到端控制容易导致导航失效。
为此，本文提出了一种新型智能体架构：每一步向模型提出两个感知问题（哪个方向像目标以及当前视角是否支持停止）外加一个针对路径指引指令的门控前沿查询，并将这些回答视为“证据”而非直接动作。系统利用鸟瞰图上的路线盲语义场通过带温度更新累积方向得分，借助骨架图提供前沿与测地距离，并通过由轨迹一致性门控和预算强制返回组成的两阶段终止器将停止投票转化为终点决策。
在 VLNVerse 子集的统一安装与预算基准重测中，该智能体在两种粒度的平均成功率上均超越了全部四个零样本基线（尽管针对最强粗粒度基线的成对区间包含零）。消融实验表明终止机制是核心支配杠杆，且尝试赋予模型更多导航任务的十三次尝试均未建立可靠收益；研究团队最终在搭载离线推理的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人平台上成功部署并验证了该系统。
Vision-language navigation is moving into photorealistic, physically simulated scenes, where the leading zero-shot agents put a vision-language model in the control loop to choose every move and stop. Robots favour small models, whose abilities are uneven: Qwen3-VL-4B can judge whether a single view looks like the goal, but its route reasoning is at chance, its distance estimates nearly constant, its stop votes unreliable. Our agent therefore asks it two perceptual questions per step, which direction looks like the goal and whether the view justifies stopping, plus one gated frontier query on route-bearing instructions, and treats the answers as evidence, not actions: a route-blind semantic field over a bird's-eye map accumulates the directional scores through a tempered update, a skeleton graph supplies frontiers and geodesic distances, and a two-stage terminator turns stop votes into termini through a trail-consistency gate and a budget-forced return. With every baseline re-run in one installation at one budget, the agent exceeds all four zero-shot baselines of the VLNVerse subset in mean success on both granularities, though the paired interval against the strongest coarse-grained baseline includes zero. Termination is the dominant lever in ablation, thirteen attempts to give the model more of the navigation establish no reliable gain, and the agent runs on a Unitree Go2 quadruped with off-board inference.
MSR-SLAM: A Multi-Stage Map-Refinement Framework for Reliable LiDAR–Inertial SLAM in GPS-Denied Environments
MSR-SLAM：一种用于无GPS环境下可靠激光雷达-惯性SLAM的多阶段地图优化框架
激光雷达-惯性里程计（LiDAR–Inertial Odometry, LIO）在局部范围内能够保持极高精度，但在无 GPS 信号且结构重复的环境中会不可避免地累积全局漂移；此时用于消除漂移的回环检测（loop closures）极易发生误匹配，进而对构建的全局地图造成毁灭性污染。针对这一难题，如何设计出能够在复杂多变的环境中有效甄别真实回环并剔除伪回环的高鲁棒性 SLAM 系统，成为了具身智能与机器人自主导航领域的关键。
为此，本文提出了 MSR-SLAM——一个建立在既有 LIO 前端基础上的多阶段地图精炼框架（multi-stage map-refinement framework）。该框架首先通过基于深度学习的地方识别描述符检索候选回环，并对其进行几何验证；在离线批处理配置下，几何验证通过的回环约束会在完整序列采集完成后被引入姿态图优化（PGO）；而在在线配置下，几何验证通过的候选回环还需通过额外的准入阶段（admission stage），剔除那些会导致平移或旋转修正量超出预设限值的约束，随后再重建全局地图。
研究团队利用搭载 16 线激光雷达的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人，在室内、室外及地下等多种复杂场景进行了系统性的实测评估。实验结果表明，在无回环的隧道场景中，全部 310 个检索到的候选回环均在几何验证阶段被成功剔除，轨迹保持完好；而在 KITTI 00 序列的基准测试中，MSR-SLAM 将 RKO-LIO 的绝对轨迹误差（ATE RMSE）从 9.5525 米大幅降低至 4.9322 米（降幅达 48.4%），同时保持了短期的相对姿态误差不变，充分证明了该框架在复杂重复环境中保持全局一致性与鲁棒性的卓越性能。
LiDAR–inertial odometry can remain locally accurate while accumulating unbounded global drift, and in structurally repetitive GPS-denied environments, the loop closures intended to remove that drift may instead corrupt the map. This paper presents MSR-SLAM, a multi-stage map-refinement framework built on an existing LiDAR–inertial odometry front end. Loop candidates retrieved by a learned place-recognition descriptor are verified geometrically. In the offline batch configuration, geometrically verified loop constraints are incorporated into pose graph optimization after the complete sequence is available. In the online configuration, geometrically verified candidates pass through an additional admission stage that rejects constraints whose candidate-induced translational or rotational correction exceeds preset limits before they can affect the active pose graph. The global map is subsequently reconstructed from the optimized poses. The main real-robot evaluation comprised seven offline/online processing cases derived from five distinct recorded traversals in indoor, outdoor, and subterranean environments, using a Unitree Go2 quadruped carrying a 16-beam LiDAR. Additional live traversals were used separately for the online consistency analysis. In one online sequence, 14 of the 15 geometrically verified candidates were rejected at the admission stage; in a loop-free tunnel, all 310 retrieved candidates were rejected during geometric verification, and the trajectory was left unmodified. The offline failure case E4 combined excellent registration quality and large residual reduction with severe global distortion and no loop edge spanning 500 or more node indices, highlighting the need to assess loop-edge coverage alongside local fit. Three independent traversals of one environment produced geometric acceptance rates between 10.8% and 11.2%, with exactly one loop constraint admitted in each traversal. On KITTI Sequence 00, MSR-SLAM reduced the RKO-LIO ATE RMSE from 9.5525 m to 4.9322 m (48.4%) while leaving the short-term RPE essentially unchanged.
Teleoperated Quadruped Robot-Based SLAM LiDAR for Standardized Tree Stem Diameter Derivation in Spanish Mediterranean Savanna-like Woodlands: A Field Feasibility Study
基于遥控四足机器人的激光雷达SLAM技术：在西班牙地中海稀树草原型林地中标准化获取树干直径——一项实地可行性研究
地中海地海萨（Dehesa）林地需要对树木结构变化进行定期监测，但传统的胸径人工普查方式往往耗费大量劳动力。尽管移动式同时定位与建图（SLAM）激光雷达能够获取三维树木结构，但在开阔地形中不稳定的移动轨迹和不均匀的茎干覆盖往往会降低测量的可重复性，从而影响数据的准确性。
为此，本研究评估了由遥控四足机器人搭载 Hovermap ST 传感器沿标准化圆形轨迹采集点云的可行性，旨在获取适用于胸径（DBH）估计的高质量树干级点云数据。该研究于 2025 年在马哈达斯德铁塔尔（Majadas de Tiétar）开展了背包式调查，并于 2026 年在两个西班牙试验点进行了四足机器人搭载调查；研究人员通过在 1.3 米高度处截取水平切片，采用圆拟合、凸包剥离以及卡尔曼滤波重建等方法推导胸径，并将其与人工卡尺测量的参考值进行严格对比。
评估结果表明，在 186 个经卡尺校准的背包测量观测中，R² 值为 0.853–0.869，均方根误差为 5.22–6.11 厘米；在排除一个受分叉影响的观测后，29 个机器人测量观测的 R² 值提升至 0.930–0.943，林氏一致性相关系数达到 0.941–0.956，均方根误差则降至 3.17–3.84 厘米。由于机器人采集表现出更平衡的径向点分布和更少的重建误差，四足机器人搭载 SLAM 激光雷达展现出用于标准化一次性胸径普查的巨大潜力，不过在将其应用于多时相生长监测之前，仍有必要开展配对的同树可重复性研究。
Mediterranean Dehesa woodlands require monitoring of tree structural change, but conventional stem-diameter inventories are labor-intensive. Mobile simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) LiDAR can acquire three-dimensional tree structure, although inconsistent trajectories and uneven stem coverage may reduce measurement repeatability. This study evaluated whether a teleoperated quadruped carrying a Hovermap ST sensor along standardized circular trajectories could acquire stem-level point clouds suitable for diameter-at-breast-height (DBH) estimation in open Dehesa terrain. Backpack-mounted surveys were conducted in 2025 at Majadas de Tiétar, followed by quadruped-mounted surveys in 2026 at two Spanish sites. DBH was derived from horizontal slices at 1.3 m using Circle Fitting, Convex Hull Peeling, and Kalman-filter reconstruction, then compared with height-matched manual references. Backpack estimates for 186 caliper-referenced observations achieved R2 values of 0.853–0.869, Lin’s concordance coefficients of 0.787–0.833, and root-mean-square errors of 5.22–6.11 cm. After excluding one bifurcation-affected observation, 29 robot estimates achieved R2 values of 0.930–0.943, concordance coefficients of 0.941–0.956, and root-mean-square errors of 3.17–3.84 cm. Robot acquisitions showed more balanced radial point distributions and fewer reconstruction errors. However, dataset differences preclude controlled platform comparison. Quadruped-mounted SLAM LiDAR therefore shows promise for standardized one-time DBH inventories, while paired same-tree repeatability studies remain necessary before application to multitemporal growth monitoring.
ReCo: Response-Consistent Locomotion with Policy-Aware MPC for Legged Manipulation
ReCo：面向足式操作的、具备策略感知能力的响应一致性运动控制（基于模型预测控制）
连续的足式机器人操作（Legged manipulation）要求机器人在保持行走的同实现精确的末端执行器轨迹跟踪。将强化学习（RL）与模型预测控制（MPC）相结合非常适合这类任务：学习到的策略能够提供稳健的底层移动能力，而 MPC 则负责协调底盘与机械臂，以补偿运动过程中的跟踪误差。然而，MPC 只能补偿其能够预测到底盘运动，而传统学习策略的指令响应往往会随步态相位、接触状态以及负载变化而剧烈波动。
为此，本文提出了 ReCo 框架，这是一种将响应一致性 locomotion 与策略感知 MPC 相结合的足式操作方案。首先，响应塑形（Response shaping）技术通过训练使策略在随机化的动力学环境中能够以一致且可重复的方式响应指令；接着，基于辨识得到的闭环响应模型，MPC 能够联合规划底盘移动指令与机械臂运动，从而实现高精度的协同控制。
在仿真基准测试中，相较于各类指标中的最佳基线，ReCo 将末端位置与姿态的均方根误差（RMSE）分别显著降低了 28.7% 和 27.4%。真实世界的实验进一步验证了该系统在车载端实现底盘与机械臂协同的连续足式操作能力，展现出卓越的控制精度与鲁棒性。
Continuous legged manipulation requires accurate end-effector tracking while the base keeps walking. Combining reinforcement learning (RL) with model predictive control (MPC) suits this task: the learned policy provides robust locomotion, while MPC coordinates the base and arm to compensate for tracking errors. However, MPC can compensate only for base motion that it can predict, and a learned policy's command response varies with gait phase, contact, and payload. We present ReCo, a framework that couples response-consistent locomotion with policy-aware MPC for legged manipulation. Response shaping trains the policy to respond to commands consistently and repeatably across randomized dynamics. An identified closed-loop response model then lets MPC jointly plan locomotion commands and arm motion. On the simulation benchmark, ReCo reduces position and orientation root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 28.7% and 27.4% relative to the best baseline for each metric. Real-world experiments demonstrate onboard continuous legged manipulation with coordinated base and arm motion.
LEAP-CBF: A Safety Filter for Uncertain Systems with Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials
LEAP-CBF：一种基于“最小努力对抗势能”的不确定系统安全滤波器
在控制非线性动力系统时，控制障碍函数（CBF）是一种广受欢迎的安全过滤器。然而，当系统面临不确定性与外界干扰时，传统的鲁棒 CBF 变体往往构建困难且容易产生过度保守性，尤其是在受输入约束的高维系统中。为此，如何设计兼具高鲁棒性与低保守性的安全保证机制，成为了机器人与控制理论领域亟待解决的关键挑战。
为应对上述挑战，本文提出了 LEAP（Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials，最小努力对抗势能）——一种全新的安全证书，用于量化给定状态抵抗外界干扰的鲁棒性，其核心思想是通过衡量干扰导致系统失效所需的最小努力来评估安全边界。研究表明，LEAP 不仅是无干扰系统的一个标准 CBF，还可以据此构建出能够有效抵御累积努力受限干扰的安全过滤器。此外，作者提出了一种基于在线策略深度强化学习（on-policy deep reinforcement learning）的 LEAP 构建方法，从而实现了复杂环境下的自适应求解。
研究团队在多种受干扰和不确定性影响的多智能体仿真系统中对 LEAP 进行了广泛测试与评估。最后，通过在四足机器人与四旋翼飞行器上开展的真实硬件实验，充分验证了 LEAP 能够完美应对现实世界机器人系统中的各类未知干扰与动态不确定性，展现出极强的实用价值与泛化能力。
Control barrier functions (CBF) are a popular safety filter to ensure safety for nonlinear dynamical systems. However, when the system is subject to uncertainties and disturbances, this requires the use of robust variants of CBFs, which can be difficult to construct and can be overly conservative, especially for high-dimensional systems under input constraints. In this work, we propose a new approach to solve these challenges by introducing Least-Effort Adversarial Potentials (LEAP), a certificate that quantifies the robustness of a given state against disturbances in terms of the effort required by the disturbance to cause failure. We show that LEAP is a CBF for the undisturbed system, but can also be used to construct a safety filter that is robust to disturbances whose cumulative effort is bounded. We propose a method for constructing LEAPs with on-policy deep reinforcement learning. Next, we demonstrate LEAPs in simulation on a variety of multi-agent systems with disturbances and uncertainties. Finally, hardware experiments on a quadruped and quadrotors validate that LEAPs are well suited to tackle the disturbances and uncertainties from real-world robotic systems.
Better Situational Awareness in AR-HRC? A Comparative Study of Augmented Reality and Mobile Interfaces for Human-Robot Collaboration
在增强现实人机协作（AR-HRC）中能否获得更好的态势感知？——增强现实界面与移动端界面在人机协作中的对比研究
增强现实（AR）技术通过在场空间可视化为人机协作（HRC）提供了极大便利，然而在搜救等安全关键型场景中，空间可视化可能会重塑用户的视觉注意力，从而产生互相竞争的情境意识（SA）需求并潜在引入新的安全隐患。尽管以往研究表明 AR 有助于提升情境意识，但兼顾机器人与环境意识并涵盖多级 SA 的严谨评估仍然相对有限，亟需深入探究 AR 在复杂动态环境中的实际认知影响。
为此，研究团队通过一项包含 30 名参与者的被试间研究，系统对比了提供同等信息的定制 AR 界面与移动端基线界面。实验采用情境意识全局评估技术（SAGAT）跨全部三个层级测量了机器人与环境的情境意识，并结合同步眼动追踪技术深入剖析导致 SA 差异的底层注意力机制，从而全面揭示不同显示媒介对操作员认知负荷与注意力分配的具体影响。
研究结果表明，两种界面均实现了较高的可用性；然而，相比移动端基线，AR 仅提升了对机器人的感知级意识，但在更高层次的机器人意识或任意层级的环境意识上均未带来显著增益。视线分析揭示了其背后的认知机制：AR 虽将注意力从屏幕地图中解放出来，但这些注意力大多重新投入到随动视觉元素（conformal visuals）中，而非物理环境本身。这一发现强调，将眼睛从屏幕上解放并不等同于引导它们关注现实世界，这一关键区别是安全关键型 HRC 的 AR 界面设计必须重点规避和解决的问题。
Augmented reality (AR) facilitates human-robot collaboration (HRC) by enabling in-situ spatial visualizations of the robot and the joint task. However, in safety-critical HRC scenarios such as search-and-rescue, spatial visualizations may also reshape visual attention in ways that create competing situational awareness (SA) demands, potentially introducing new safety concerns. While prior AR-HRC work suggests potential benefits for SA, rigorous evaluations that jointly consider robot and environmental awareness across multiple levels of SA remain limited. We address this through a between-subjects study with 30 participants comparing custom AR and mobile interfaces presenting equivalent information, measuring robot and environmental SA with the Situation Awareness Global Assessment Technique (SAGAT) across all three levels, with concurrent eye tracking to identify the attentional mechanisms underlying any SA differences. Both interfaces achieved high usability; relative to the mobile baseline, AR improved perception-level awareness of the robot but yielded no gains in higher-level robot awareness or in environmental awareness at any level. Gaze analysis explained this: AR freed attention from the map, but that attention was re-invested in the conformal visuals rather than the physical environment. Freeing the eyes from a screen is not the same as directing them to the world, a distinction AR interfaces for safety-critical HRC must design around.
LiteNWM: Efficient Latent World Models for Onboard Visual Navigation in the Wild
LiteNWM：面向野外环境机载视觉导航的高效潜在世界模型
直接视觉导航策略能够高效生成轨迹，但通常无法显式评估其未来的潜在后果；尽管生成式导航世界模型能够通过视觉展开（visual rollouts）提供这种前瞻性视野，但在评估多个候选轨迹时往往伴随着高昂的计算成本，难以满足高频控制的实时性需求。
为此，本文提出了 LiteNWM（Latent Navigation World Model，潜伏导航世界模型）。该模型巧妙地在多个候选轨迹之间共享视觉编码，并能够联合预测其在多时间跨度下的动作条件未来表征，同时引入一个学习得到的评分器来对轨迹进行精准选择；这种设计不仅大幅降低了多路径评估的计算开销，还具备极强的迁移能力，评分器可在无需针对特定提议器进行重新训练的情况下直接适应不同系统。
在 RECON、SCAND 和 SACSoN 数据集的离线评估中，LiteNWM 相比 NoMaD+NWM-XL 将宏平均轨迹误差降低了 17.56%，并在 RTX 5090 上实现了高达 128 倍的端到端加速，同时成功将评分器无缝泛化至 MBRA。在未知室内与室外环境的真实机器人物理实验中，LiteNWM 将导航成功率从 43.3% 显著提升至 83.3%，充分验证了该模型在复杂现实场景中执行具身前瞻性规划与闭环导航的卓越可行性。
Direct visual navigation policies generate trajectories efficiently but do not explicitly evaluate their future consequences. Generative navigation world models provide this foresight through visual rollouts, which are costly when evaluating multiple candidates. We present LiteNWM, a latent navigation world model that shares visual encoding across candidates and jointly predicts their action-conditioned future representations at multiple horizons, while a learned scorer uses these predictions to select trajectories. In offline evaluations on RECON, SCAND, and SACSoN, LiteNWM reduces macro-averaged trajectory error by 17.56% relative to NoMaD+NWM-XL and achieves a 128.00-fold end-to-end speedup on an RTX 5090. The same evaluator transfers from NoMaD to MBRA without proposer-specific retraining, reducing MBRA's macro-averaged trajectory error by 16.2%. In real-robot experiments in unseen indoor and outdoor environments, LiteNWM improves navigation success from 43.3% to 83.3% relative to NoMaD. These results demonstrate that LiteNWM can be deployed for future-aware planning and closed-loop navigation on a physical robot.
JEPLO: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for LiDAR-Based Legged Locomotion
JEPLO：基于激光雷达的足式运动的联合嵌入预测学习
尽管激光雷达（LiDAR）在感知型足式机器人运动控制中的探索相对 RGB-D 传感较少，且现有基于 LiDAR 的方法往往依赖显式建图，但在复杂环境中高效获取精准环境表征并实现轻量化控制仍是一大挑战。为此，本文推出了 JEPLO（Joint-Embedding Predictive learning for legged LOcomotion）——一个面向足式机器人的单阶段、无建图（mapping-free）且基于 LiDAR 的感知型运动学习框架。
该框架的核心创新在于引入了本体-外感受联合嵌入预测世界模型（PE-JEPA），用于从原始 LiDAR 扫描等机载观测中学习预测性的自我中心地形表征；同时，通过提出的并发 JEPA 师生（CJTS）流水线，结合简洁的奖励函数设计，在仿真环境中利用深度强化学习训练出由 JEPA 潜在表征深度赋能的高性能运动策略。
凭借轻量级的机载计算，JEPLO 成功实现了从仿真到现实的高效迁移，使足式机器人在长楼梯、高箱子等多样化复杂地形中展现出卓越的全向穿行能力。各项评估与深度分析进一步证实，该框架在由遮挡、稀疏性和噪声引起的感知退化条件下，依然能够稳健保留任务相关的关键信息，展现出超越传统感知运动框架的强大鲁棒性。
Light detection and ranging (LiDAR) remains less explored than RGB-D sensing for perceptive legged locomotion, and existing LiDAR-based approaches often rely on explicit mapping. We present JEPLO (Joint-Embedding Predictive learning for legged LOcomotion), a single-stage learning framework for mapping-free, LiDAR-based perceptive locomotion for legged robots. We introduce a proprio-exteroceptive JEPA (PE-JEPA) world model to learn predictive egocentric terrain representations from onboard observations, including raw LiDAR scans. A concurrent JEPA-teacher-student (CJTS) pipeline is further proposed to train a locomotion policy informed by JEPA latent representations in simulation using deep reinforcement learning with a simple reward formulation. The framework achieves successful sim-to-real transfer, enabling omnidirectional traversal of diverse terrains, including long staircases and high boxes, with lightweight onboard computation. Evaluations demonstrate greater robustness than existing perceptive locomotion frameworks, particularly under degraded perception caused by occlusion, sparsity and noise. Further analysis validates JEPLO's ability to retain task-relevant information under these challenging conditions.
Load-Aware Quadruped Navigation with Online Contact-based Geometry Estimation
基于在线接触几何估计的负载感知四足机器人导航
在杂乱环境中携带物体进行自主导航对于四足机器人而言依然是一个极具挑战性的难题。与以往侧重于通过负载感知运动适应来维持步态稳定性的研究不同，现有的自主导航系统通常忽视了所携带物体几何形状的影响，普遍采用固定的足迹膨胀策略，从而导致导航规划过于保守。
为此，本文提出了一个两阶段的负载感知导航学习框架（two-phase load-aware navigation learning framework）。在第一阶段，该框架通过强化学习训练了 LOADNav 负载感知导航策略，使机器人能够根据所携物体的几何尺寸自主调整其轨迹和通行间隙行为；在第二阶段，研究人员通过模仿学习训练了 CoGE 在线几何预测器，能够通过偶发的接触事件实时估计未知的负载几何形状。
在具有不同大小和形状负载的复杂杂乱环境中开展的评估结果表明，该导航策略展现出了清晰的负载感知行为，且在线几何预测器能够精准利用偶尔的接触事件估测物体几何形态，动态精炼估计结果并相应调整导航行为。在完全不需要任何负载先验知识的前提下，该方法成功缩小了与几何感知策略之间的性能差距。
Navigating cluttered environments while carrying objects remains a challenging problem for quadruped robots. Compared with works that focused on load-aware locomotion adaptation to maintain gait stability, existing autonomous navigation systems generally ignore the influence of carried objects' geometries and use fixed footprint inflation, leading to overly conservative navigation. To fill this knowledge gap, we propose a two-phase load-aware navigation learning framework. In Phase 1, we train LOADNav, a load-aware navigation policy via reinforcement learning, enabling the robot to adapt its trajectory and clearance behavior according to the geometric size of the carried object. In Phase 2, we train CoGE, an online geometry predictor via imitation learning, which estimates unknown payload geometry from occasional contact events. We evaluate the framework in cluttered environments with loads of varying sizes and shapes. The results show that our navigation policy exhibits clear load-aware behaviors, and the online geometry predictor estimates object geometry from occasional contact events, refining its estimate and adapting the navigation behavior accordingly. Without requiring any prior knowledge of the payload, it narrows the gap to geometry-aware policies.
SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
SuperNav：一种适用于任意场景、执行各类任务的智能体导航系统
通用服务机器人需要能够在陌生环境中处理多样化人类请求的导航系统，从而将任务通用性与场景通用性有机结合。然而，现有的许多方法通常通过微调多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）来直接预测导航动作，这不仅使机器人的行为高度依赖于导航训练数据的覆盖范围，还严重限制了其对全新请求和未知环境的泛化能力。为此，本文的核心洞察在于让 MLLM 专注于解释请求、理解场景和做出高层决策，同时完整保留其通用大模型的底座能力，并将底层运动执行委托给专门的导航工具。
基于这一设计理念，本文推出了 SuperNav 框架，它为预训练 MLLM 配备了一个专用的智能体脚手架（agentic harness），且在设计上完全无需对 MLLM 进行针对导航的特定微调。该脚手架通过集成导航技能、用于物理交互的智能工具以及任务进度与上下文管理来全面支撑决策；同时，一个创新的统一视觉点接口（visual-point interface）将决策与运动紧密连接，允许模型直接在图像中指定目的地并根据实时执行反馈修正决策，从而在不同任务需求和复杂环境中实现持续稳定的自主导航。
在各项性能评估中，SuperNav 在实例级、多目标以及需求驱动的任务中全面超越了四个受评基线；而在 HM3D 数据集上的类别级评估以及在真实四足机器人平台上的成功部署，则进一步验证了该系统在多变现实环境中的卓越适用性与鲁棒性。
General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments.
A Field-Validated GNSS-Assisted Quadruped Robotic System for Remote Multi-Waypoint Radiation Inspection
在核设施运营、放射源管理、退役及应急响应等场景中，远程机器人辐射巡检能够有效减少人员的辐射暴露风险。然而，在传统的全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）与人工远程遥操作下，当机器人需要重复访问预注册的巡检位置时，往往会受到 GNSS 信号波动、离散更新、通信延迟以及操作员响应滞后等因素的严重干扰，从而影响最终接近精度、稳定航点确认以及任务执行的可重复性。
为此，本文开发了一种经野外实地验证的 GNSS 辅助四足机器人系统，有机集成了长距离遥操作、机载视频传输、航点管理、辐射传感、距离相关平移辅助及结构化任务日志。该系统通过引入 4 米进入半径、5 米离开半径、持续停留时间以及 GNSS 质量门控来联合实现稳健的航点确认，同时允许操作员随时保留对行进方向、避障、旋转及物理停止位置的主导控制权，从而在自动化辅助与人类灵活性之间建立起高效的协同机制。
研究团队通过静态 GNSS 特征分析、状态机边界测试、野外现场对比、多航点完整任务测试及通信链路测试对系统进行了全面评估。实验结果表明，距离相关平移辅助显著降低了平均 GNSS 确认距离，彻底消除了未开启辅助时出现的预确认距离重置现象，且系统在各项复杂任务中均成功实现了多航点的完整巡检与中断恢复，充分证明了该工作流能够有效支撑基于常规 GNSS 的高可靠、可重复远程辐射巡检。
Remote robotic radiation inspection can reduce personnel exposure during nuclear-facility operation, radioactive-source management, decommissioning, and emergency response. However, repeated multi-waypoint missions remain difficult when pre-registered inspection locations must be revisited under conventional global navigation satellite system (GNSS) and human teleoperation. GNSS fluctuations, discrete updates, communication delay, continued robot motion, and operator response can affect final approach, stable waypoint confirmation, and repeatable task execution. To address these issues, we developed a field-validated GNSS-assisted quadruped robotic system integrating long-range teleoperation, onboard video, waypoint management, radiation sensing, distance-dependent translational assistance, and structured mission logging. Waypoint confirmation combines a 4 m entry radius, a 5 m exit radius, continuous dwell, and GNSS quality gating, while the operator retains control over direction, obstacle avoidance, rotation, and the physical stopping location. Evaluation included static GNSS characterization, state-machine boundary tests, three paired ON/OFF field comparisons, four complete eight-waypoint missions, a five-distance communication-link test, and offline replay of 27 parameter combinations. Assistance reduced mean GNSS-reported confirmation distance by 1.569, 0.460, and 0.485 m in the three comparisons, and eliminated the pre-confirmation distance resets observed in the corresponding OFF runs. All four Site B missions completed eight of eight waypoints; checkpoint-based recovery supported interrupted tasks. Supplementary ICMP measurements quantified network RTT and packet loss at tested separations of approximately 100–800 m. These results show that the proposed workflow can support repeated remote radiation inspection with conventional GNSS.
Residual-gated generative additive joint-bias identification and uncertainty-weighted fault compensation for quadruped robots with scarce data
针对数据稀缺四足机器人的残差门控生成式加性联合偏差辨识与不确定性加权故障补偿
在真实四足机器人上重复进行执行器故障注入不仅成本高昂，还极易对电机或齿轮箱造成物理损伤，这使得在仅有稀缺序列数据的情况下进行持续的故障值识别变得极其困难。针对这一痛点，本研究聚焦于指令等效的加性关节偏差（command-equivalent additive joint bias）问题，旨在通过数据驱动与生成式方法实现高效、安全的故障估计与补偿，从而提升机器人在受损状态下的自主适应与生存能力。
为此，研究团队设计了一套严密的集成控制与识别框架：首先训练一个结合对抗与时间目标的时序生成器，并通过集成姿态积分、一阶关节运动学、扭矩极限及指令极限残差的聚合得分构建接受门来筛选合成窗口；接着，采用一个融合了稠密特征复用、时序卷积、双向循环特征与交叉注意力融合的异方差识别器（heteroscedastic identifier）来精准估计偏差及预测方差。最终，该估计值被转化为不确定性加权的补偿指令，并通过可行交集上的最终输出投影严格强制幅值和速率约束，确保了控制指令的安全平稳。
在控制器级仿真与户外真实机器人测试中，该方法展现出了卓越的性能。在参考正弦单关节评估中，该方法将识别均方根误差（RMSE）从确定性 DGTNet 的 0.1404 弧度降低至 0.1180 弧度，并在同腿及对角双关节等复杂复合故障测试中表现稳健；户外物理机器人测试表明，相比于未补偿的故障行走，该方法使平均均方根姿态误差显著降低了 54.8%，充分证明了其在保障复杂具身智能系统长期运行鲁棒性方面的强大实用价值。
Repeated actuator-fault injection on a physical quadruped is costly and can damage motors or gearboxes, which makes continuous fault-value identification difficult when only scarce sequences are available. This study targets command-equivalent additive joint bias. A temporal generator is trained with adversarial and temporal objectives, while an acceptance gate screens synthetic windows using an aggregate score of attitude-integration, first-order joint-kinematic, torque-limit, and command-limit residuals. A heteroscedastic identifier combines dense feature reuse, temporal convolution, bidirectional recurrent features, and cross-attention fusion to estimate the bias and predictive variance. The resulting estimate is converted into an uncertainty-weighted compensation command, with amplitude and rate constraints enforced by final-output projection over their feasible intersection. Controller-level simulations include four additive-bias profiles at the 12 actuated joints and representative same-leg and diagonal two-joint cases. In the reference sinusoidal single-calf-joint evaluation, the method reduces identification RMSE from 0.1404 rad for deterministic DGTNet to 0.1180 rad and reports an interval calibration error of 0.031. With matched controller protections, uncertainty weighting reduces mean recovery time from 0.764 to 0.743 s and RMS command variation from 0.00671 to 0.00651 rad. Across the four single-joint profile groups, the proposed RMSE ranges from 0.1194 to 0.1428 rad, compared with 0.1421 to 0.1696 rad for DGTNet. Same-leg and diagonal paired faults yield RMSE values of 0.1584 and 0.1510 rad and attitude-recovery rates of 74.6% and 77.4%, respectively. Outdoor physical-robot tests with eight runs per configuration show a 54.8% reduction in mean RMS attitude error relative to uncompensated faulty walking, with similar outcomes for constant and uncertainty-weighted confidence.
REDACT: Robust Perceptive Locomotion under Unseen Visual Corruption
REDACT：面对未见视觉干扰时的鲁棒感知运动能力
深度条件式运动策略在实现惊艳的敏捷运动方面表现出色，然而当观测数据落入其训练分布之外时，往往会产生不可预测的动作行为。遮挡、无效回报、传感器噪声以及视觉干扰物等因素都会导致实际部署时的观测偏离标定好的仿真深度；尽管合成传感器增强技术能够针对特定的退化情况进行优化，但它本身无法定义在训练中未曾建模的未知损坏类型下的系统行为。
为了填补训练阶段覆盖范围的空白，本文推出了 REDACT（Retaining Evidence Despite Artifacts for Continued Traversal，保留证据以持续穿行）框架。这是一个将改进的视觉编码器架构、持久特征掩码以及新颖的共识门控算法（consensus-gating algorithm）有机结合的师生学习框架，旨在能够在遭遇未建模的损坏时有效保留有用的深度信息。该门控算法仅利用干净观测上的近似共形校准（conformal calibration），完全不需要事先了解损坏类型；通过在干净的仿真深度数据上进行训练，REDACT 能够在未知的损坏下保持有效的视觉信息，从而支持比现有跑酷基线更高的穿行成功率。针对各种损坏系列的深度增强评估进一步表明，REDACT 在缺乏增强覆盖的场景下显著提升了鲁棒性；真实的野外试验证明了其能够零样本迁移至包含陌生场景内容的结构化环境与森林环境中。
Depth-conditioned locomotion policies have demonstrated impressive agile maneuvers, but can produce unpredictable actions when observations fall outside their training distribution. Occlusion, invalid returns, sensor noise, and visual distractors can shift deployment observations away from nominal simulated depth. While synthetic sensor augmentation targets specified degradations, it does not by itself define behavior under corruption families omitted from training. To address gaps in training-time coverage, we present REDACT (Retaining Evidence Despite Artifacts for Continued Traversal), a teacher–student framework combining an improved visual encoder architecture, persistent feature masking, and a novel consensus-gating algorithm to retain useful depth information under unmodeled corruption. The gate uses approximate conformal calibration on clean observations alone, requiring no prior knowledge of the corruption type. Trained on clean simulated depth, REDACT retains useful visual information under unseen corruption, supporting higher traversal success than existing parkour baselines. Evaluation of depth augmentation across corruption families further shows that REDACT improves robustness where augmentation coverage is missing. Real-world trials demonstrate zero-shot transfer to structured and forested environments with unfamiliar scene content.
Feeling Through the Load: Compliant Quadruped Locomotion under Payload Interactions
在负载交互下实现柔顺的四足运动
当四足机器人在人类环境中携带物体移动时，人类有时会直接与物体（即负载）进行交互而非直接触碰机器人本体。如果负载处于非约束状态，机器人如何在保持负载平衡与稳健步态的同时，准确区分人类有意施加的外界交互与负载自身的日常运动，并仅依靠机载测量推断并顺应这些交互，成为了具身智能领域亟待解决的新挑战。
为此，本文开发了一种全新的力感知运动框架，将负载交互视为塑造“机器人-负载”联合系统运动的指令。该方法创新性地将力感知运动控制与非约束负载的力估计过程进行了模块化解耦，有机结合了一个柔顺的负载携带策略与一个因果力估计器；其中，力估计器通过“估计器回路中的数据聚合与微调”进行训练，能够仅从机载测量数据中精准预测外部交互力。
仿真与真实世界实验结果表明，由此产生的控制器不仅能够维持高度稳定的负载携带运动，还能对外部交互表现出柔顺的顺应性，并有效利用推断出的力来支持人类引导的机器人轨迹调整。这一研究成果为多模态人机协同与具身操作开辟了新途径，显著提升了四足机器人在共享动态环境中的交互安全性与灵活性。
Quadruped robots are increasingly expected to carry objects while moving through human environments. But what happens when a person interacts directly with the payload rather than with the robot? If the payload is unrestrained, the robot must distinguish intentional external interactions from ordinary payload motion, while still keeping the load balanced and maintaining stable locomotion. How can a quadruped infer and compliantly respond to such interactions using only onboard measurements? In this work, we develop a force-aware locomotion framework that treats payload interactions as commands that shape the motion of the combined robot-payload system. Our approach separates the learning of force-aware locomotion and force estimation on an unrestrained payload. We combine a compliant load-carrying policy with a causal force estimator, trained through estimator-in-the-loop data aggregation and finetuning, to predict interactions from onboard robot measurements. Our simulations and real-world experiments show that the resulting controller can maintain stable payload-carrying locomotion, yield compliantly to external interactions, and use the inferred force to support human-guided changes in the robot’s trajectory.
GAUGE: Planner-Conditioned Active Calibration of Opaque Quadruped Velocity Interfaces
GAUGE：基于规划器条件的不透明四足机器人速度接口主动校准
商业四足机器人通常向用户公开平面速度指令，然而其底层运动控制器往往是黑盒且无法访问的，这导致指令速度与实际执行运动之间经常产生系统性偏差。虽然高层导航规划器在实际运行中通常只使用指令包络的一个结构化子集，但这种未知且时变的接口不匹配会严重削弱自主导航的轨迹跟踪精度与鲁棒性，因此亟需一种能够适应特定任务需求的高效自适应校准机制。
为此，本文提出了 GAUGE（Goal-Aware Uncertainty-Guided Exploration，目标感知不确定性引导探索） 框架，用于实现规划器条件下的黑盒四足机器人速度接口主动校准。该框架核心在于维护一个贝叶斯指令到运动模型（Bayesian command-to-motion model），并根据规划器诱导的指令分布下后验认知不确定性的预期减少量来智能选择受权试验；由此生成的后验能够全面支持基于验证的停止机制、有界逆补偿以及在检测到接口漂移后的任务相关重新校准。
在三种受控响应系列的严格评估中，相较于被动探索、D-最优以及任务无关的替代方案，GAUGE 以显著更少的试验次数便达成了任务导向的精度与不确定性联合标准；而在六个保留的 Isaac Sim 导航地图上的跨场景测试进一步表明，该框架在维持非劣效边界的同时完美匹敌了密集校准的性能，展现出极高的样本效率与在真实机器人系统中的强大泛化能力。
In this paper, we present a Goal-Aware Uncertainty-Guided Exploration (GAUGE) framework for planner-conditioned active calibration of opaque quadruped velocity interfaces. Commercial quadrupeds commonly expose planar-velocity commands, but the underlying locomotion controller remains inaccessible and can produce systematic discrepancies between commanded and realized motion. A navigation planner typically uses a structured subset of the command envelope. GAUGE maintains a Bayesian command-to-motion model and selects authorized trials according to their expected reduction of posterior epistemic uncertainty under the planner-induced command distribution. The resulting posterior supports validation-based stopping, bounded inverse compensation, and task-relevant recalibration after detected interface shifts. In three controlled response families, GAUGE reaches the joint criterion for task-facing accuracy and uncertainty with fewer trials than passive, D-optimal, and task-agnostic alternatives. Across six held-out Isaac Sim navigation maps, it meets the declared noninferiority margins against dense calibration.
AdaOcc: Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction for Embodied Tasks
AdaOcc：面向具身任务的自适应三维占用预测
具身智能任务需要准确、灵活且语义丰富的 3D 场景表征，而 3D 语义占用（3D semantic occupancy）通过同时编码几何占用与语义类别，能够对整体 3D 空间进行高效建模。然而，现有的占用预测方法往往难以满足实际部署中的多样化需求，例如动态适应不同的计算预算、传感器配置以及观测视角，这严重限制了其在真实世界具身系统中的泛化能力与灵活性。
为此，本文提出了针对具身场景量身定制的基于点的自适应 3D 占用预测方法——AdaOcc。该方法创新性地设计了自适应几何引导双分支编码器，能够无缝支持包含不同视角数量的 RGB 图像（结合估计深度图）或激光雷达扫描等异构传感器输入；同时，AdaOcc 通过渐进式查询学习策略训练稀疏语义点来表征占用区域，允许根据实际需求通过调整查询点数量和解码器层数来灵活调节计算预算，并引入了全新的包含损失（containment loss）来规范预测点精确落入有效占用区域内，从而实现了轻量级点基占用学习的高保真几何建模。
大量实验表明，AdaOcc 在 Occ-ScanNet 数据集上取得了全新的 SOTA（State-of-the-Art）性能，相比以往方法实现了显著的性能提升。此外，该框架展现出强大的实际适用性，能够作为真实世界具身系统中稳健且高效的自适应 3D 感知模块，为复杂动态环境下的机器人自主导航与交互提供坚实的技术支撑。
Embodied tasks demand accurate, flexible, and semantically rich 3D scene representations. 3D semantic occupancy is well suited to this requirement, as it can model holistic 3D spaces by encoding geometric occupancy along with semantic categories. However, existing occupancy prediction methods struggle to meet practical deployment requirements, such as adapting to varying computing budgets, sensor setups, and observation views. In this paper, we propose a point-based Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction method, called AdaOcc, tailored for embodied scenarios. To accommodate heterogeneous sensor inputs, AdaOcc uses an adaptive geometry-guided dual-branch encoder that can support RGB images in various numbers of views with (estimated) depth maps or LiDAR scans. AdaOcc represents occupied regions via sparse semantic points trained with a progressive query learning strategy, allowing the prediction computational budget to be flexibly adjusted through query point numbers and decoder layers. To facilitate high-fidelity geometric modeling for lightweight point-based occupancy learning, we further propose a novel containment loss that regularizes predicted points to reside within valid occupied regions. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art on Occ-ScanNet with considerable performance improvements over previous methods. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong practical applicability as an adaptive 3D perception module in real-world embodied systems.
Affordance-Conditioned Decision Making: Bridging the Semantic-Spatial Gap in Zero-Shot Cross-Floor Vision-and-Language Navigation
基于“可供性”条件约束的决策制定：弥合零样本跨楼层“视觉-语言导航”中的语义-空间鸿沟
视觉-语言导航（VLN）日益依赖通用的语义规划器，然而在空间受限的过渡区域（如楼梯、门道或狭窄通道），将正确的宏观意图转化为可靠的物理执行依然十分困难。仅仅到达这些过渡点并不能保证成功穿行，智能体必须能够识别可执行的示能位姿（affordance pose）并从累积的动作误差中恢复，这突显了高层语义意图与底层物理执行之间亟需弥合的关键鸿沟。
为此，本文提出了 PACE（Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution，偏好精炼的示能条件执行） 框架——一个旨在增强冻结的零样本语义规划器以实现可靠跨楼层导航的监督式局部执行模块。该模块将过渡相关的语义信息具象化为长视野、以智能体为中心的通行示能位姿，并将短视野的动作生成条件化至该空间目标上，从而将语义目标与物理执行紧密对齐；同时，研究团队通过基于 rollout 数据的失败感知偏好精炼（failure-aware preference refinement）对 PACE 进行后训练，利用对比正常或恢复行为与放大偏差行为的成对样本，显著增强了系统的闭环纠错能力。
通过将 PACE 集成到六个开源的零样本 VLN 导航器中，实验结果表明其在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 的跨楼层子集上实现了显著且稳定的性能提升，平均成功率分别从 16.35% 提升至 27.65% 以及从 4.76% 提升至 12.06%。真实世界的未见环境实验进一步验证了该系统的卓越适用性，充分彰显了可通行示能（traversable affordances）在桥接高层语义意图与可靠具身行为方面的巨大潜力。
Vision-and-language navigation increasingly relies on general-purpose semantic planners, yet translating correct high-level intent into reliable physical execution remains difficult in spatially constrained transitions. Reaching a staircase, doorway, or narrow passage does not ensure traversal; the agent must identify an executable affordance pose and recover from accumulated action errors. We propose PACE (Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution), a supervised local execution module that augments frozen zero-shot semantic planners for reliable cross-floor navigation. PACE grounds transition-related semantics into a long-horizon, agent-centric traversable affordance pose and conditions short-horizon action generation on this spatial target, thereby aligning semantic goals with physical execution. We further post-train PACE through failure-aware preference refinement using rollout-derived pairs that contrast normal or recovery behaviors with deviation-amplifying behaviors, thereby improving closed-loop correction. We integrate PACE into six open-source zero-shot VLN navigators and demonstrate consistent improvements on the cross-floor subsets of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, increasing the average success rate from 16.35% to 27.65% and from 4.76% to 12.06%, respectively. Real-world experiments further demonstrate PACE's applicability in unseen environments, highlighting the potential of traversable affordances to bridge semantic intent and reliable embodied behavior.
TACET: Context-Appropriate Acoustic-Social Navigation for Quadrupeds
TACET：适用于四足动物的情境适宜性声学-社会导航
四足机器人在进入医院、养老院和安静办公室等环境时，其主要由足地撞击产生的运动噪声不仅关乎物理通行，更是一个不可忽视的社会变量。然而，以往的社交导航方法往往将机器人视为声学同质体，而现有的安静运动方法只能将噪声降低到操作员指定的、缺乏上下文感知的固定水平，无法根据具体的社会场景动态调节声学表现，这严重限制了其在人类共享空间中的亲和力与实用性。
为此，本文提出了 TACET（context-appropriate acoustic-social navigation method，情境感知声学社交导航方法），一种能够从机器人第一人称视角推断社会情境并同时决定“去哪里”与“声音多大”的创新方案。该方法通过一个紧凑的行为令牌 (gait, speed, social_cost) 将缓慢的微调视觉-语言推理器与快速的反应式控制器紧密耦合；该令牌能够同时约束社会代价地图与安静运动策略，并利用结构化的视场外记忆（out-of-view memory）在人类离开摄像头视野后将其持续保留在推理器的上下文中。
在真实四足机器人上的实验表明，情境条件式运动在匹配速度下可将运动噪声降低高达 9.3 dBA；在各项评估场景中，完整的 TACET 方法将个人空间合规率稳固保持在 100% 的同时，将声学侵入性严格限制在较低水平（≤2.9 dBA），从而在复杂的现实动态环境中实现了空间合规性与声学舒适性的双重提升。
Quadruped robots entering hospitals, care homes, and quiet offices must be context-appropriate not only in where they move but in how loudly they move: a legged robot's locomotion noise, dominated by foot–ground impacts, is itself a social variable. Prior social navigation respects human space but treats the robot as acoustically uniform, while quiet-locomotion methods reduce noise to an operator-specified, context-blind level. We present TACET, a context-appropriate acoustic-social navigation method that infers social context from the robot's egocentric view and decides both where it walks and how loudly, coupling a slow fine-tuned vision-language reasoner to a fast reactive controller through a single compact behavior token, ⟨gait, speed, social_cost⟩. The same token conditions both a social costmap (where to go) and a quiet locomotion policy (how loudly to move), while a structured out-of-view memory keeps recently seen people in the reasoner's context after they leave the camera view. On a real quadruped, context-conditioned locomotion lowers locomotion noise by up to 9.3 dBA at matched speed, and across our scenarios the full method keeps personal-space compliance at 100% with low acoustic intrusion (≤2.9 dBA), jointly improving spatial and acoustic performance in the evaluated scenarios.
LAG-IO: Multi-IMU State Estimation for Legged Robots Using Factor Graphs
LAG-IO：基于因子图的足式机器人多IMU状态估计
足式机器人在外感受传感器不可靠的复杂环境中，鲁棒的本体感受状态估计至关重要。然而，传统的腿部里程计通常依赖于单个机载惯性测量单元（IMU）与腿部运动学通过扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）进行融合，这种方法在面对线性化误差和硬接触假设时显得脆弱，在发生打滑或动态交互时极易产生严重的累积漂移，难以满足高精度定位的需求。
为此，本文提出了 LAG-IO——一个基于因子图的多 IMU 状态估计框架，它在滑动窗口优化中紧密耦合了主躯干 IMU、多个腿部安装的 IMU 以及关节编码器的测量值。为了妥善处理非平稳的足地交互，该框架创新性地引入了一个基于核密度估计（KDE）的连续概率接触检测模块，能够自适应调整零速更新（ZUPT）因子的协方差；同时，通过精巧构建运动学相对位置因子，将独立的腿部惯性状态在结构上牢牢锚定至机器人的主躯干。
在跨越多种非结构化地形的四足机器人真实实验中，相较于现有基线，LAG-IO 实现了更高的平面轨迹精度，有效抑制了不可观测的垂直方向发散，并在遭遇不稳定接触时提供了更加平滑的轨迹过渡，同时保持了卓越的姿态可观测性，充分证明了该多 IMU 协同状态估计框架在复杂多变环境中的强大鲁棒性与应用潜力。
Robust proprioceptive state estimation is crucial for legged robots, particularly in challenging environments where exteroceptive sensors are unreliable. While traditional leg odometry typically relies on a single body-mounted inertial measurement unit (IMU) fused with leg kinematics via an extended Kalman filter (EKF), such methods are vulnerable to linearization errors and hard-contact assumptions, leading to severe drift during slippage or dynamic this http URL this paper, we propose LAG-IO, a factor graph-based multi-IMU state estimation framework that tightly couples measurements from a main body IMU, multiple leg-mounted IMUs, and joint encoders within a sliding-window optimization. To handle non-stationary foot-ground interactions, we introduce a continuous probabilistic contact detection module based on kernel density estimation (KDE), which adaptively scales the covariance of zero-velocity update (ZUPT) factors. Furthermore, kinematic relative position factors are formulated to structurally anchor the independent leg inertial states to the robot's main body.
