Experimental results on a quadruped robot across various unstructured terrains demonstrate that, compared to existing baselines, LAG-IO achieves higher planar trajectory accuracy, reduces unobservable vertical divergence, and provides smoother trajectory transitions during unstable contacts, while maintaining competitive attitude observability.
Seeing the Invisible: Physics-Guided Visual Prompting for Temperature- and Radiation-Aware VLA Navigation
洞察不可见之物：面向温度与辐射感知型 VLA 导航的物理引导式视觉提示方法
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为视觉-语言导航（VLN）的主流范式，然而在安全关键型设施中，诸如辐射或温度飙升等隐形风险无法通过 RGB 摄像头直接检测，若针对每种风险单独开发新编码器、收集新数据并重新训练模型，往往伴随着高昂的计算与时间成本。为此，如何在不改变冻结模型架构的前提下，赋予现有 VLA 模型高效感知并规避隐形环境风险的能力，成为了具身智能安全领域亟待突破的关键挑战。
为此，本文提出了 PG-VP（Physics-Guided Visual Prompting，物理引导视觉提示）——一个即插即用的多模态感知模块，它巧妙地重用了冻结的 VLA 模型原本就非常擅长的能力：避开可见障碍物。在检测到临近的辐射或热源时，PG-VP 会执行物理引导的风险评估以确定最佳避让方向，并在连续帧中动态叠加相应的虚拟障碍物（动态视觉提示），从而自然引导导航策略绕过这些隐形危险；该方法对所有危险类型均采用相同的虚拟障碍物模式，且在无风险时保持不渲染，确保了基座模型在常规情况下的原生行为不受影响。
在基于 OmniNav 与 R2R-CE、RxR-CE val-unseen 数据集的评估中，PG-VP 在 84.9% 和 83.2% 的情况下成功引导策略采取低风险动作，同时仅带来微小的导航成功率折损。在真实机器人面对实际热源与辐射源的部署测试中，PG-VP 在完全无需重新训练的情况下展现出卓越的隐形危险规避性能，使针对热源和辐射源的最差 10% 平均轨迹安全性分别显著提升了 63.45% 和 32.59%，充分证明了该模块在现实高危环境中的实用价值与鲁棒性。
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a major paradigm for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN). However, in safety-critical facilities, invisible risks such as radiation or temperature spikes cannot be detected by an RGB camera, and handling each risk is expensive, requiring a new encoder, new data, and model retraining. We propose Physics-Guided Visual Prompting (PG-VP), a plug-and-play multimodal perception module that instead reuses what a frozen VLA model already does well: avoiding visible obstacles. Given a proximal radiation or thermal source, PG-VP performs a physics-guided risk assessment to determine the avoidance direction and overlays a corresponding virtual obstacle that moves across consecutive frames (Dynamic Visual Prompting). The navigation policy then naturally detours around this invisible hazard. The identical virtual obstacle is used regardless of hazard type, so the visual prompting pattern remains fixed as sensors are added. When no hazard is detected, nothing is rendered, and the policy behaves exactly as it would without PG-VP. We evaluate PG-VP on OmniNav using the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, where it guides the policy toward intended low-risk actions in 84.9% and 83.2% of cases, at a cost of 6.8 and 7.9 percentage points in navigation success rate. We further test it with distinct scenarios on a real robot in the presence of actual thermal and radiation sources, all without any retraining. The real test shows that PG-VP effectively avoids these invisible hazards, improving worst-10% average trajectory safety by 63.45% and 32.59% against thermal and radiation sources, respectively.
Disturbance-aware adaptive compensation in hybrid force-position locomotion policy for legged robots
腿式机器人混合力-位置运动策略中的干扰感知自适应补偿
基于强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）的方法显著提升了足式机器人的运动性能。然而，将此类运动策略部署于真实环境中仍面临诸多挑战。在不确定环境下运行的机器人难以适应负载变化及外部扰动，进而导致运动性能显著下降。
针对上述问题，本文提出了一种新型混合力位控制运动策略（Hybrid Force-Position Locomotion Policy, HFPLP）学习框架。该框架将策略的动作空间定义为目标关节位置与前馈力矩的组合，使机器人能够对负载变化及外部扰动做出快速响应。此外，本文提出了一种扰动感知自适应补偿方法（Disturbance-Aware Adaptive Compensation, DAAC），该方法基于外部扰动估计，在力矩空间中生成补偿动作，从而增强机器人对动态环境变化的适应能力。
本文通过仿真测试和真实环境部署对所提出的方法进行了验证。实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在负载携带能力和抗扰动性能方面均表现出更优的效果。
Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based methods have significantly improved the locomotion performance of legged robots. However, these motion policies face significant challenges when deployed in the real world. Robots operating in uncertain environments struggle to adapt to payload variations and external disturbances, resulting in severe degradation of motion performance. In this work, we propose a novel Hybrid Force-Position Locomotion Policy (HFPLP) learning framework, where the action space of the policy is defined as a combination of target joint positions and feedforward torques, enabling the robot to respond rapidly to payload variations and external disturbances. In addition, the proposed Disturbance-Aware Adaptive Compensation (DAAC) provides compensation actions in the torque space based on external disturbance estimation, enhancing the robot’s adaptability to dynamic environmental changes. We validate our approach in both simulation and real-world deployment, demonstrating that it outperforms existing methods in carrying payloads and resisting disturbances.
Winning a Won Game: Strict Reach-Avoid-Stay Control Barrier Functions for High-Dimensional Black-Box Systems
在“必胜”局面中取胜：针对高维黑盒系统的严格“到达-避障-保持”型控制障碍函数
机器人在执行任务的过程中，必须始终避免安全失效，并确保任务完成后能够持续维持已取得的成果。严格可达-避障-保持（Strict Reach-Avoid-Stay, sRAS）对这一要求进行了形式化定义，即机器人需要安全地到达目标区域，并在首次进入该区域后无限期地停留于其中。针对具有有界不确定性的高维黑箱系统，本文提出了一种基于控制障碍函数（Control Barrier Function, CBF）的 sRAS Q 控制安全过滤器。
该方法将两种价值函数相结合：一种是保持价值函数（Stay Value），用于描述系统在目标子集中实现安全永久停留的能力；另一种是可达-避障价值函数（Reach-Avoid Value），用于描述系统在避开那些无法保证安全永久停留的目标状态的前提下，安全到达目标子集的能力。本文证明，这两种价值函数能够共同构成有效的鲁棒离散时间控制障碍函数（CBF），并进一步将其扩展为状态-动作 Q 函数，以实现运行时安全干预。在价值函数精确已知且满足零测度条件的情况下，该过滤器能够保证几乎所有可获胜初始状态的 sRAS 可行性，并确保系统在首次进入目标区域后始终处于安全状态，即使面对所有允许范围内的不确定性变化亦然。
为实现价值函数的可扩展近似，本文采用基于可达性分析的对抗强化学习方法，仅依赖黑箱交互数据，无需预先获知系统动力学模型、仿射结构、价值函数导数或人工设计的安全障碍函数，即可完成安全过滤器的构建与部署。本文通过仿真和实体硬件平台上的四足机器人跳跃越沟任务验证了所提出框架的有效性，实验表明，机器人能够成功跨越沟壑、安全着陆，并在着陆后持续保持安全状态。此外，在仿真的 F1TENTH 自动驾驶赛车竞赛中，实验进一步验证了该方法在安全超车和保持领先位置方面的能力。
Robots must complete their tasks and maintain the achieved outcomes while avoiding safety failures at all times. Strict reach-avoid-stay (sRAS) formalizes this requirement: safely reaching a target and remaining there indefinitely after first entry. We propose an sRAS Q-control barrier function (CBF) safety filter for high-dimensional black-box systems under bounded uncertainty. Our construction combines a stay value encoding safe permanent residence in a target subset with a reach-avoid value encoding safe reachability of this subset while avoiding target states from which safe permanent residence cannot be guaranteed. We prove that these values jointly yield a valid robust discrete-time CBF and lift them to state-action Q-functions for runtime intervention. For exact values and under a measure-zero condition, our filter preserves sRAS feasibility from almost every winnable initial state and keeps the system safely within the target after first entry, against all admissible uncertainty realizations. We adopt reachability-based adversarial reinforcement learning for scalable value approximation using only black-box interactions. Notably, neither synthesis nor deployment of our filter requires known dynamics, affine structure, value derivatives, or hand-designed barriers. We validate our framework in quadruped gap jumping in simulation and hardware, where the robot crosses the gap, lands safely, and remains safe afterward. Simulated F1TENTH races further demonstrate safe overtaking and lead retention.
ERM-Track: Disturbance-Aware and Reliability-Guided Multi-Object Tracking for Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) Under Dynamic Viewpoints
ERM-Track：动态视角下无人地面车辆（UGV）的干扰感知与可靠性引导的多目标跟踪
在无人地面车辆（Unmanned Ground Vehicles, UGVs）的动态视角下，平台自身运动所引起的图像扰动与真实目标运动相互耦合，容易导致轨迹预测偏移、目标关联错误，以及不可靠观测对身份信息造成持续性污染。针对上述问题，本文提出了一种具备扰动感知与可靠性引导能力的在线多目标跟踪框架——ERM-Track。
其中，I2DF-Mamba 采用因果双流 Mamba 编码器，融合 IMU、关节状态及历史轨迹信息，并预测针对特定轨迹的图像扰动分布。随后，将预测得到的扰动均值及不确定性从归一化/对数尺度的扰动坐标系显式映射至检测观测空间。在此基础上，CF-TUR 通过可靠观测与受污染观测的后验融合以及因果证据累积，对观测可靠性进行评估，并分别为运动状态和身份记忆生成具有界限约束的写入增益，从而实现对两类信息的独立更新与控制。
在额外标注的 CEAR 数据集上，本文使用包含 6488 帧的封闭留出测试集（sealed holdout set）对 ERM-Track 进行评估，取得了 64.34% 的 HOTA、66.28% 的 AssA 和 73.42% 的 IDF1，身份切换次数（Identity Switches, IDSW）为 28 次。采用三个随机种子的骨干网络替换实验表明，在所评估的因果编码器中，Mamba 取得了最高的平均 HOTA。事后采用等距回归校准（Isotonic Calibration）后，期望校准误差（Expected Calibration Error, ECE）由 0.4752 降至 0.0478，而跟踪性能指标仅发生轻微变化。在计算效率方面，完整流程在搭载 RTX 4080 的工作站上达到 69.50 FPS；在 Jetson Orin NX 上，平均端侧延迟约为 29 ms，对应的处理速率约为 34.5 FPS。
Image disturbances caused by platform ego-motion are coupled with true target motion under the dynamic viewpoints of unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs), resulting in trajectory-prediction drift, association mismatches, and persistent contamination of identity information by unreliable observations. This paper proposes ERM-Track, a disturbance-aware and reliability-guided online multi-object tracking framework. I2DF-Mamba uses a causal dual-stream Mamba encoder to integrate IMU, joint-state, and trajectory histories and predicts a trajectory-specific image-disturbance distribution. The predicted disturbance mean and uncertainty are mapped explicitly from normalized/log-scale disturbance coordinates to the detection-observation space. CF-TUR then estimates observation reliability through reliable–contaminated posterior fusion and causal evidence accumulation and generates separate bounded write gains for the motion state and identity memory. On the 6488-frame sealed holdout set of the additionally annotated CEAR data, ERM-Track obtains 64.34% HOTA, 66.28% AssA, and 73.42% IDF1, with 28 identity switches. Three-seed backbone replacement experiments show that Mamba provides the highest mean HOTA among the evaluated causal encoders. Post hoc isotonic calibration reduces ECE from 0.4752 to 0.0478, with only marginal changes in the tracking metrics. The complete pipeline reaches 69.50 FPS on an RTX 4080 workstation and an onboard mean latency of approximately 29 ms on a Jetson Orin NX, corresponding to a reciprocal processing rate of approximately 34.5 FPS.
Towards Reinforcement Learning for Space Robotics: Fast Training and Reliable Real-World Transfer
迈向空间机器人强化学习：快速训练与可靠的现实世界迁移
本研究展示了一种基于快速仿真的强化学习训练框架，可用于学习机器人控制策略。该框架对硬件资源的要求较低，且通过仿真学习获得的控制策略能够可靠地迁移至真实环境。基于该框架，研究表明，四足机器人仅需在一块消费级 GPU 上训练不到 20 分钟，即可学会可靠地通过多种真实世界地形，包括模拟月球环境的试验场地。
这些研究成果初步展现了强化学习在未来空间机器人系统研发中的重要潜力，表明强化学习有望成为提升空间机器人能力与鲁棒性的关键技术手段。
This work demonstrates the use of a fast simulation-based training framework to learn control policies using reinforcement learning. The hardware requirements are minimal and the simulation-learned policies transfer reliably to the real world. With this setup, we show that a quadruped robot can learn to traverse diverse real-world terrains reliably---including in a lunar-analog facility---after less than 20 minutes of training on a single consumer-grade GPU. These results provide a glimpse of a future where reinforcement learning is a crucial tool in developing more capable and robust space robotic systems.
HM3D-M3: A Benchmark for Multi-Agent, Multi-Modal, Multi-Object Goal Navigation
HM3D-M3：一项针对多智能体、多模态、多目标导航任务的基准测试
随着人工智能智能体（AI Agents）与机器人技术的快速发展，人类未来由机器人团队提供服务已成为一种可预见的发展趋势。此类机器人团队需要同时接收并执行多个目标任务，而人类可以根据实际需求，以不同形式指定任务，例如类别名称、图像或语音描述。目前，已有研究基准分别对多智能体、多模态及多目标导航进行了独立研究，但尚缺乏能够在同一任务场景中综合涵盖这三个方面的评估基准。为填补这一空白，本文提出了 HM3D-M3 基准测试框架。在该框架中，由 K 个智能体组成的机器人团队从逼真的室内场景中的不同位置出发，共同搜索一个无序的 M 个物体目标集合。每个目标均可通过开放词汇类别（Open-vocabulary Category）、实例图像（Instance Image）或实例描述（Instance Description）三种形式之一进行指定。
HM3D-M3 提供了 1,000 个验证任务，涵盖来自 379 个开放词汇类别的 3,926 个目标，以及 100,000 条用于训练的观测分配样本。此外，该基准还提出了两项团队层面的评估指标：目标级成功率（Goal-level Success Rate, SR）和基于任务完成时间归一化的路径效率指标（Makespan-normalized SPL）。在此基础上，本文进一步提出了两种基线方法：HiGA 是一种经过训练的分层目标分配器，构建于冻结的开放词汇导航策略之上；LaViRA-M3 则是一种无需训练的视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）智能体团队，通过共享地图和任务进度分析实现协同导航。
实验结果表明，经过适配的多机器人方法和零样本方法取得了 16%–27% 的成功率（SR），而本文提出的两种基线方法将成功率提升至 38%–41%，且各自展现出互补的优势和不同的失效模式。此外，本文还将 LaViRA-M3 部署于一支由三台异构机器人组成的团队中，进一步验证了该方法在真实多机器人协作场景中的应用能力。
Rapid progress in AI agents and robotics makes it a matter of the near future that humans are served by a team of robots. Such a team will receive several goals at once, each specified in whatever form is convenient for the human, such as a category name, a photo, or a spoken description. Existing benchmarks study multi-agent, multi-modal, and multi-object goal navigation in isolation, and a benchmark that places all three in one episode is missing. To fill this gap, we introduce HM3D-M3. A team of K agents starts at distributed locations in a photorealistic indoor scene and searches for an unordered set of M object goals, each given as an open-vocabulary category, an instance image, or an instance description. HM3D-M3 provides 1,000 validation episodes over 3,926 goals from 379 open-vocabulary categories, 100K observation-assignment training samples, and two team-level metrics, goal-level SR and makespan-normalized SPL. We further contribute two baselines. HiGA is a trained hierarchical goal assigner on top of a frozen open-vocabulary navigation policy, and LaViRA-M3 is a training-free team of VLM agents with shared mapping and progress analysis. Adapted multi-robot and zero-shot methods reach 16--27% SR, while our baselines reach 38--41% with complementary strengths and distinct failure modes. Furthermore, we deploy LaViRA-M3 on a heterogeneous three-robot team.
OpenHEART: Opening Heterogeneous Articulated Objects with a Legged Manipulator
OpenHEART：利用足式操作器开启各类铰接物体
腿足操作机器人兼具高机动性与多样化的操作能力。然而，与门、抽屉、柜体等异构铰接物体（articulated objects）进行鲁棒交互仍面临显著挑战：一方面，此类物体的铰接形式差异巨大；另一方面，腿足机器人本身具有复杂的动力学特性。现有的基于强化学习的方法通常依赖高维感知输入，因而存在采样效率低下的问题。
针对上述挑战，本文提出一种鲁棒且高采样效率的框架，用于驱动腿足操作机器人开启异构铰接物体。具体而言，本文提出基于采样的抽象特征提取方法（Sampling-based Abstracted Feature Extraction, SAFE），将把手与面板的几何信息编码为紧凑的低维表示，从而提升模型的跨域泛化能力；此外，本文引入铰接信息估计器（Articulation Information Estimator, ArtIEst），通过自适应地融合本体感知与外部感知信息，估计每一物体对应的开启方向与运动行程范围。
本文所提出的框架已在仿真环境与真实机器人系统中完成部署，实现了对多种异构铰接物体的操作任务验证。
Legged manipulators offer high mobility and versatile manipulation. However, robust interaction with heterogeneous articulated objects, such as doors, drawers, and cabinets, remains challenging because of the diverse articulation types of the objects and the complex dynamics of the legged robot. Existing reinforcement learning-based approaches often rely on high-dimensional sensory inputs, leading to sample inefficiency. In this paper, we propose a robust and sample-efficient framework for opening heterogeneous articulated objects with a legged manipulator. In particular, we propose Sampling-based Abstracted Feature Extraction (SAFE), which encodes handle and panel geometry into a compact low-dimensional representation, improving cross-domain generalization. Additionally, Articulation Information Estimator (ArtIEst) is introduced to adaptively mix proprioception with exteroception to estimate opening direction and range of motion for each object. The proposed framework was deployed to manipulate various heterogeneous articulated objects in simulation and real-world robot systems.
OptiGeo: Efficient Monocular Geometry for Embodied Perception in Optically Challenging Scenes
OptiGeo：针对光学复杂场景下具身感知的、高效单目几何方法
单目深度估计已展现出较强的开放域泛化能力，但在透明、反射与镜面环境中实现可靠的机器人部署仍然困难，因为深度传感器在这些场景中常产生缺失或偏置的深度信息。现有方法通常借助场景特定的预处理、辅助模块或事后微调来应对此类光学失效。这些设计在受限场景中虽然有效，却增加了架构冗余，并可能使通用几何模型过度特化于狭窄的光学场景。
本文将这一问题重新审视为基础模型训练中的局部失效模式，并识别出传感器诱导的监督偏置是关键瓶颈：在光学挑战性区域，模型从有偏的真实深度监督中继承了传感器失效模式。为此，本文提出OptiGeo——一种偏置感知的训练框架，利用干净几何教师与残差裁剪对齐来修复有偏的真实监督。本文将面向透明目标的渲染重新定义为干净光学几何的紧凑来源，而非大规模领域特定的微调数据集。仅需少量针对性渲染数据，OptiGeo即可学习透明物体与区域的几何结构，校正真实传感器无法可靠监督的局部几何畸变。
尽管仅有30M参数，OptiGeo在透明场景基准上显著优于300M规模的单目模型与十亿规模的多视图基线，同时在通用零样本深度与边界锐度方面保持竞争力。真实世界导航案例进一步验证了其作为高效感知模块在光学挑战性场景中的实用性。
Monocular depth estimation has achieved strong open-domain generalization, yet reliable robotic deployment remains difficult in transparent, reflective, and specular environments, where depth sensors often produce missing or biased depth. Existing methods often handle such optical failures with scene-specific preprocessing, auxiliary modules, or post-hoc fine-tuning. While effective in constrained settings, these designs increase architectural redundancy and can over-specialize general geometry models to narrow optical scenarios. We revisit this problem as a localized failure mode within base-model training and identify sensor-induced supervision bias as a key bottleneck: models inherit sensor failure patterns from biased real-depth supervision in optically challenging regions. We then introduce OptiGeo, a bias-aware training framework that rehabilitates biased real supervision using a clean-geometry teacher and residual-trimmed alignment. We redefine transparency-targeted rendering as a compact source of clean optical geometry, rather than a large domain-specific fine-tuning set. With only a small targeted rendering set, OptiGeo learns the geometric structure of transparent objects and regions, correcting local geometry distortions that real sensors cannot reliably supervise. Despite only 30M parameters, OptiGeo outperforms substantially larger 300M-scale monocular models and billion-scale multi-view baselines on transparent-scene benchmarks, while remaining competitive on general zero-shot depth and boundary sharpness. Real-world navigation cases further validate its practicality as an efficient perception module in optically challenging scenes.
Flexible locomotion learning with diffusion model predictive control
基于扩散模型预测控制的灵活运动学习
足式运动要求控制器兼具鲁棒性与适应性，同时需兼顾任务需求与安全约束。然而，无模型强化学习方法通常产生固定策略，在测试时难以适应新行为。相比之下，模型预测控制通过将不同目标与约束直接纳入优化过程，为灵活的行为合成提供了自然途径。但经典模型预测控制依赖精确的动力学模型，而此类模型在复杂环境中往往难以获取，且通常需要简化假设。
本文提出Diffusion-MPC，利用学习到的生成式扩散模型作为规划的近似动力学先验，通过基于奖励与约束的优化实现灵活的测试时适应。Diffusion-MPC联合预测未来状态与动作；在每个反向步骤中，该方法引入奖励规划并施加约束投影，从而生成既满足任务目标又处于物理极限内的轨迹。为获得超越模仿预训练的规划模型，本文提出一种面向扩散规划器的交互式训练算法：在环境中执行奖励与约束规划器，随后依据实际回报对采集的轨迹进行过滤与重加权，再更新去噪器。该设计实现了较强的测试时适应能力，使规划器无需重新训练即可适应新的奖励设定。本文在真实世界中验证了Diffusion-MPC，展现出优异的运动性能与灵活的适应能力。
Legged locomotion demands controllers that are both robust and adaptable, while remaining compatible with task and safety considerations. However, model-free reinforcement learning (RL) methods often yield a fixed policy that can be difficult to adapt to new behaviors at test time. In contrast, Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides a natural approach to flexible behavior synthesis by incorporating different objectives and constraints directly into its optimization process. However, classical MPC relies on accurate dynamics models, which are often difficult to obtain in complex environments and typically require simplifying assumptions. We present Diffusion-MPC, which leverages a learned generative diffusion model as an approximate dynamics prior for planning, enabling flexible test-time adaptation through reward and constraint based optimization. Diffusion-MPC jointly predicts future states and actions; at each reverse step, we incorporate reward planning and impose constraint projection, yielding trajectories that satisfy task objectives while remaining within physical limits. To obtain a planning model that adapts beyond imitation pretraining, we introduce an interactive training algorithm for diffusion based planner: we execute our reward-and-constraint planner in environment, then filter and reweight the collected trajectories by their realized returns before updating the denoiser. Our design enables strong test-time adaptability, allowing the planner to adjust to new reward specifications without retraining. We validate Diffusion-MPC on real world, demonstrating strong locomotion and flexible adaptation.
Bayesian Active Learning for Intent Disambiguation in Interactive Robot Planning
交互式机器人规划中用于意图消歧的贝叶斯主动学习
交互式机器人规划要求机器人从自然语言指令中推断并执行人类意图，而这些指令往往存在歧义、不完整或表述不充分的问题。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）为澄清提供了强大的接口，但依赖生成模型驱动多轮对话可能引入系统性失败。
本文提出一种贝叶斯框架，将澄清过程视为面向接地信号时序逻辑（STL）任务规范的一种主动学习问题。该方法利用LLMs初始化候选形式化规范，并将信息量丰富的对比转化为自然语言澄清问题，同时由贝叶斯优化维护对用户意图的不确定性估计，并选择能够最大化信息增益的查询。收敛后，推断得到的STL规范被传递给形式化规划器，以合成可验证的机器人轨迹。
在四个仿真与真实世界任务域中，该方法总体上实现了更高的任务满足度，且所需澄清轮次少于LLM基线，同时有助于较小模型缩小与较大推理模型之间的性能差距。
Interactive robot planning requires robots to infer and execute human intentions from natural language instructions that are often ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful interface for clarification, relying on the generative model to drive an multi-turn conversation can introduce systematic failures. We propose a Bayesian framework that treats clarification as an active learning problem over grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) task specifications. Our method uses LLMs to initialize candidate formal specifications and translate informative contrasts into natural-language clarification questions, while Bayesian optimization maintains uncertainty estimation over user intent and selects queries that maximize information gain. After convergence, the inferred STL specification is passed to a formal planner to synthesize a verifiable robot trajectory. Across four simulated and real-world task domains, our approach generally achieves higher task satisfaction and requires fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines, while helping smaller models close the performance gap against larger reasoning models.
NavAble: A Large-Scale Dataset and Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline for Blind Navigation
NavAble：用于盲人导航的大规模数据集及合成数据生成流程
对于支持盲人及低视力（Blind and Low-Vision, BLV）用户安全、独立出行的辅助导航技术而言，可靠识别无障碍通行关键物体（Accessibility-critical Objects），例如有声行人信号灯、门禁启动按钮和扶手等，是实现安全导航的重要前提。然而，现有大规模视觉数据集中对此类物体的覆盖不足，而少数包含相关类别的数据集也存在类别覆盖范围有限、标注不一致以及数据多样性不足等问题。针对这些问题，本文提出了 NavAble，一个涵盖 11 类无障碍通行关键物体的大规模数据集。该数据集整合了 41,000 张经过筛选的开源图像，以及 8,000 张新采集并经过密集标注的真实场景图像。
为进一步扩大数据规模并提升数据多样性，本文开发了一套合成数据生成流程，通过在 37 种不同环境中，以多样化的风格和视角渲染高保真 3D 资产，基于 565 个资产生成了 452,000 帧具有丰富真实标注信息的图像。该流程结合自动化网络图像爬取、基于视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）的数据筛选、基于 SAM 3D 的资产生成，以及便捷的相机轨迹配置，有效减少了人工工作量，并实现了传统人工采集方式难以达到的数据规模与多样性。
实验结果表明，在 NavAble 数据集上对现有分割模型进行微调后，模型能够实现可靠的无障碍物体分割，在独立留出测试集上取得了超过 80% 的平均交并比（mean Intersection over Union, mIoU）。此外，合成数据增强也表现出显著效果，与仅使用真实世界数据进行微调相比，最高可提升 3.5 个百分点的 mIoU。除基准测试外，研究还利用两台辅助移动机器人采集的第一人称视角数据进行了验证，结果表明，该方法能够提升真实导航场景中的感知可靠性。总体而言，NavAble 为盲人及低视力用户的导航感知研究建立了一个可扩展的数据基础，有效应对了该领域面临的数据稀缺问题以及仿真与真实机器人应用之间的具身差距（Embodiment Gap）。
Reliable recognition of accessibility-critical objects (e.g., audible pedestrian signals, door-activation buttons, and handrails) is essential for assistive navigation technologies that support safe, independent mobility for blind and low-vision (BLV) users. Yet these categories are underrepresented in existing large-scale vision datasets, and the few datasets that include them suffer from limited class coverage, inconsistent annotations, and poor diversity. We introduce NavAble, a large-scale dataset spanning 11 accessibility-critical object classes, combining 41K curated open-source images with 8K newly collected, densely annotated real-world images. To extend scale and diversity, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline that renders high-fidelity 3D assets across 37 environments under diverse styles and viewpoints, yielding 452K frames with rich ground-truth annotations from 565 assets. The pipeline minimizes manual effort by combining automated web image crawling, VLM-based filtering, SAM 3D-based asset generation, and convenient camera trajectory configuration, enabling large-scale data generation at a diversity unattainable through manual collection. Experiments show that fine-tuning existing segmentation models on the NavAble Dataset achieves reliable accessibility-object segmentation (>80% mIoU on our held-out test set). We also demonstrate the effectiveness of synthetic data augmentation, which yields up to +3.5 mIoU over real-world-only fine-tuning. Beyond benchmark evaluation, validation on egocentric data from two mobility-assistive robots demonstrates improved perception reliability in real-world navigation scenarios. Together, NavAble establishes a scalable foundation for BLV navigation perception, directly addressing the data scarcity and embodiment gaps.
Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions for Embodiment Capability Discovery
基于符号抽象的生成流：用于具身能力发现
实现复杂且具有长时间跨度的机器人行为仍然面临诸多挑战，因为任务能否成功执行取决于机器人自身物理能力所支持的技能。现有的训练任务分布通常依赖人工设计或通过大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）采样生成，其任务构建主要依据语义上的合理性，而非机器人特定形态与实际能力所决定的可执行性。这种不匹配可能导致训练任务难度过高、内容冗余，或忽略那些不易直观发现但实际上能够学习的行为。
针对上述问题，本文提出了一种名为符号抽象生成流（Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions, FOSA）的框架，通过学习具有物理基础的任务生成器，发掘与机器人自身形态及能力相适应的行为能力。FOSA 将抽象策略参数化为生成流网络（Generative Flow Network, GFlowNet），用于构建符号化任务骨架（Symbolic Task Skeletons）。随后，每个任务骨架都会被编译为一个仿真环境，并利用底层策略在该环境中的学习表现作为奖励信号，以优化抽象策略。
在多种异构机器人平台上的实验表明，FOSA 能够发现大量多样化且可执行的任务，这些任务均接近机器人通过实证评估所确定的能力边界（Empirical Capability Frontier）。进一步地，通过将所发现任务对应的策略蒸馏至单一语言条件策略（Language-conditioned Policy）中，FOSA 提升了机器人在未见过的复杂长时序任务中的执行表现。
Achieving complex, long-horizon robot behavior remains challenging because successful execution depends on skills grounded in a robot's physical affordances. Existing training-task distributions are often handcrafted or sampled from large language models (LLMs), relying on semantic plausibility rather than embodiment-specific feasibility. This mismatch can produce curricula that are too difficult, redundant, or blind to non-obvious but learnable behaviors. We propose Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions (FOSA), a framework for discovering embodiment-specific capabilities by learning a grounded task generator. FOSA parameterizes an abstract policy as a Generative Flow Network that constructs symbolic task skeletons. Each skeleton is compiled into a simulation environment, where low-level policy-learning performance provides the reward signal for the abstract policy. Across heterogeneous robot platforms, FOSA discovers diverse and executable tasks near the robot's empirical capability frontier. After distilling the discovered task policies into a single language-conditioned policy, FOSA improves performance on unseen complex and long-horizon tasks.
CLOSER: Evidence-Aware Active Visual Verification for Embodied Object-Goal Navigation
CLOSER：具身目标导向导航中基于证据感知的主动视觉验证
物体目标导航（Object-goal Navigation, ObjectNav）要求具身智能体在未知环境中寻找指定类别的物体实例，并在其附近停止。智能体通常依赖物体检测器识别候选目标，但由于只能获取有限的第一人称视角视频流，有时甚至仅能获得单帧图像，因此必须在线判断检测到的候选物体是否为真正的目标。现有检测器往往会对相似物体产生高置信度的误判，例如将沙发误识别为床，而一旦智能体因错误检测结果而停止，便会导致整个导航任务失败。此外，现有方法通常采用贪心策略接近候选目标，容易造成目标被遮挡或仅被部分观测的问题。
针对上述问题，本文提出了 CLOSER，一种具备证据感知能力的主动验证框架，将停止决策视为一个闭环证据获取过程，并将视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）的目标验证与主动感知相结合。CLOSER 首先对开源 VLM 进行微调，使其能够将跨帧跟踪的候选目标在不同视角下分别标记为目标、非目标或不确定。随后，利用基于嵌入表示的多样性筛选机制选择具有互补信息的视角，并通过轻量级网络融合各视角下的概率信息。如果融合后的判断结果仍存在不确定性，则采用扩散策略（Diffusion Policy），仅利用目标跟踪掩码（Tracked Mask）和深度信息，引导智能体逐步接近候选物体，直至获得明确的判断结果。该框架可在本地运行，并能够直接集成到现有 ObjectNav 系统中，无需对原有系统进行重新训练。
在 Gibson 和 Habitat-Matterport 3D 数据集上的实验结果表明，CLOSER 将平均任务成功率（Success Rate）提高了 3.6 个百分点，并将路径长度加权成功率（Success weighted by Path Length, SPL）提高了 2.0 个百分点。这些结果表明，在执行最终停止决策之前对目标证据进行充分验证，有助于提升具身导航系统的整体性能与可靠性。
Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) requires an embodied agent to find an instance of a specified category in an unseen environment and stop near it. The agent typically relies on an object detector but must judge online from a limited egocentric video stream, sometimes a single frame, whether a detected candidate is the target. Detectors often confidently mistake similar objects, such as a sofa for a bed, and stopping at a false positive fails the episode. Prevailing systems also approach candidates greedily, leaving them occluded or partially observed. We present CLOSER, an evidence-aware active verification framework that treats stopping as closed-loop evidence acquisition, coupling vision-language model (VLM) verification with active perception. CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM to label each view of a candidate tracked across frames as target, non-target, or uncertain, selects complementary views with an embedding-based diversity gate, and fuses their per-view probabilities with a lightweight network. If the fused judgment remains uncertain, a diffusion policy drives the agent toward the candidate using only the tracked mask and depth until the decision becomes decisive. CLOSER runs locally and plugs into existing ObjectNav systems without retraining them. On Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D, it raises average success rate by 3.6 points and success weighted by path length by 2.0 points, showing that verifying evidence before committing improves embodied navigation.
RecMorph: Topology-Guided Spatial Recurrence for Generalized Morphology Control
RecMorph：用于广义形态控制的拓扑引导空间递归机制
广义形态控制（Generalized Morphology Control）要求单一策略能够在具有不同物理功能的肢体之间转换信息、协调全身运动，并在身体规模增大时仍保持较高的计算效率。然而，现有的通信机制仅能部分满足这些要求。为此，本文提出RecMorph，一种拓扑引导的空间循环架构，通过循环序列计算，同时实现跨肢体通信与特征表示转换。该方法采用深度优先遍历（Depth-First Traversal），将运动学树转换为由机器人形态决定的序列，并沿该序列利用共享的双向状态转移机制，逐步转换各肢体的信息，随后进行动作解码。此外，通过残差信息保留、均方根归一化（RMS Normalization）以及输入相关的通道调制，增强重复空间变换过程的稳定性。在模型宽度和深度固定的条件下，该架构实现了与Token数量呈线性关系的计算复杂度。
在五项UNIMAL任务上的实验结果表明，在所评估的广义形态控制器中，RecMorph取得了最高的平均最终训练性能，并在FT任务上实现了最高的实测推理吞吐量。同时，该方法能够泛化至未见过的形态变化及最多包含30个肢体的机器人身体。进一步地，研究将具有代表性的广义形态控制器从UNIMAL基准测试迁移至包含四种平台的四足机器人场景。在正常摩擦和高摩擦条件下，RecMorph均取得了最高的宏平均性能；与专用多层感知机（MLP）相比，其在正常摩擦条件下的速度均方根误差（RMSE）降低了43.5%。
此外，在真实机器人实验中，同一个共享策略成功完成了Go1和Go2机器人的40次物理测试，且未发生跌倒。上述结果表明，拓扑引导的循环变换能够为广义形态控制提供一种有效且高效的通信机制，并且在从程序化生成的机器人形态迁移至真实物理机器人平台时，仍能保持良好的控制效果。
Generalized morphology control requires a single policy to transform information across limbs with different physical roles, coordinate whole-body motion, and remain efficient as body size grows. Existing communication mechanisms address these requirements only partially. We introduce RecMorph, a topology-guided spatial recurrent architecture that uses recurrent sequence computation to jointly perform cross-limb communication and representation transformation. A depth-first traversal converts the kinematic tree into a morphology-derived sequence, along which shared bidirectional transitions progressively transform limb information before action decoding. Residual preservation, RMS normalization, and input-dependent channel modulation stabilize this repeated spatial transformation, yielding linear token complexity at fixed model width and depth. Across five UNIMAL tasks, RecMorph achieves the strongest mean final training performance among the evaluated generalized morphology controllers and the highest measured inference throughput on FT, while generalizing to unseen variations and bodies with up to 30 limbs. We further migrate representative generalized controllers from UNIMAL benchmarks to a four-platform quadruped setting. RecMorph achieves the best macro-averaged performance under nominal and high friction, reduces nominal velocity RMSE by 43.5% relative to specialist MLPs, and one shared policy completes 40 physical Go1/Go2 trials without falls. These results show that topology-guided recurrent transformation provides an effective and efficient communication mechanism for Generalized Morphology Control and remains effective when transferred from procedural bodies to physical robot platforms.
TrackVLA++: Unleashing Reasoning and Memory Capabilities in VLA Models for Embodied Visual Tracking
TrackVLA++：释放具身视觉跟踪中 VLA 模型的推理与记忆能力
具身视觉跟踪（Embodied Visual Tracking，EVT）是一项基础能力，是陪伴机器人、引导机器人和服务助理等实际应用的重要支撑。在这些应用中，机器人需要持续跟踪移动目标。近年来，相关研究取得了显著进展，使机器人能够在复杂、非结构化场景中实现语言引导的目标跟踪。然而，现有方法缺乏明确的空间推理能力和有效的时间记忆机制，因此在目标遭受严重遮挡或场景中存在外观相似的干扰目标时，容易出现跟踪失败。
为解决上述问题，本文提出TrackVLA++，一种新型视觉-语言-动作（Vision–Language–Action，VLA）模型，通过两个核心模块增强具身视觉跟踪能力：空间推理机制和目标识别记忆模块（Target Identification Memory，TIM）。其中，空间推理模块引入了一种称为Polar-CoT的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）机制，用于推断目标的相对位置，并将其编码为紧凑的极坐标Token，以辅助动作预测。在空间先验信息的引导下，TIM采用门控更新策略，保留长时间范围内的目标记忆，从而确保时空一致性，并减少目标在长时间遮挡过程中丢失的情况。
大量实验表明，TrackVLA++在公开基准测试中取得了当前最优性能，涵盖自我中心视角（Egocentric）和多摄像头两种设置。在具有挑战性的EVT-Bench DT测试集上，与此前表现领先的方法相比，TrackVLA++的性能分别提升了5.1%和12%。此外，TrackVLA++展现出较强的零样本泛化能力，能够在动态及存在遮挡的真实场景中实现稳健的目标跟踪。
Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT) is a fundamental ability that underpins practical applications, such as companion robots, guidance robots and service assistants, where continuously following moving targets is essential. Recent advances have enabled language-guided tracking in complex and unstructured scenes. However, existing approaches lack explicit spatial reasoning and effective temporal memory, causing failures under severe occlusions or in the presence of similarlooking distractors. To address these challenges, we present TrackVLA++, a novel Vision–Language–Action (VLA) model that enhances embodied visual tracking with two key modules: a spatial reasoning mechanism and a Target Identification Memory (TIM). The reasoning module introduces a Chain-ofThought paradigm, termed Polar-CoT, which infers the target’s relative position and encodes it as a compact polar-coordinate token for action prediction. Guided by these spatial priors, the TIM employs a gated update strategy to preserve longhorizon target memory, ensuring spatiotemporal consistency and mitigating target loss during extended occlusions. Extensive experiments show that TrackVLA++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on public benchmarks across both egocentric and multi-camera settings. On the challenging EVT-Bench DT split, TrackVLA++ surpasses the previous leading approach by 5.1% and 12% respectively. Furthermore, TrackVLA++ exhibits strong zero-shot generalization, enabling robust realworld tracking in dynamic and occluded scenarios.
PanoVLN: Towards Effective Panoramic Vision-and-Language Navigation
PanoVLN：迈向高效的全景视觉-语言导航
近年来，视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models，VLMs）的发展推动了视觉语言导航（Vision-and-Language Navigation，VLN）技术的进步，使模型能够根据视觉观测和语言指令预测导航动作。本文研究基于全景观测的视觉语言导航，并提出PanoVLN。其核心思路是：更完整的视觉上下文有助于模型做出更合理的导航决策。例如，全景图像能够呈现透视相机视野范围之外的通道，使模型无需额外探索即可识别预期路线。然而，研究发现，仅将透视图像替换为全景图像，只能带来有限的性能提升。分析表明，要充分利用更广阔的视觉范围，需要同时改进动作预测、训练监督和视觉表征。
首先，更广阔的视野为更长时间范围的动作规划提供了支持。因此，PanoVLN使模型能够预测更长的动作序列，从而根据单张全景图像完成幅度更大的转向及后续移动。具体而言，研究提出置信度引导执行策略（Confidence-Guided Execution，CGE），动态确定在重新规划之前需要执行多少个预测动作。其次，更广阔的视野也带来了更加复杂的路线选择问题。为此，研究构建了包含频繁分岔点且指令明确的训练路线，为模型提供有针对性的路线选择监督。最后，全景导航不仅需要识别单个地标，还要求模型理解不同观察方向之间的空间关系。为此，PanoVLN融合RGB全景图像中的语义特征与几何特征，同时捕捉场景内容和空间布局，且不增加视觉Token的数量。
在采用4B参数骨干模型且仅使用RGB图像作为输入的条件下，PanoVLN在R2R-CE和RxR-CE两个数据集的Val-Unseen测试集上，成功率分别比此前的最先进方法（State of the Art，SOTA）提高了11.9%和8.7%。此外，四足机器人上的真实环境实验进一步表明，与此前的视觉语言导航方法相比，PanoVLN能够以更少的暂停次数实现更快的导航。
Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced vision-and-language navigation (VLN), enabling models to predict navigation actions from visual observations and language instructions. In this work, we explore VLN with panoramic observations and introduce PanoVLN. The motivation is straightforward: more complete visual context should enable better-informed navigation decisions. For example, a panorama can reveal a passage outside a perspective camera's field of view, allowing the model to identify the intended route without additional exploration. However, we find that simply replacing perspective images with panoramas yields only limited gains. Our diagnosis suggests that fully exploiting wider visibility requires modifications to action prediction, training supervision, and visual representation. First, wider visibility supports longer-horizon action planning. We make the model predict longer action sequences, enabling larger turns and subsequent movement from a single panorama. Specifically, we introduce a confidence-guided execution (CGE) strategy that dynamically determines how many predicted actions to execute before replanning. Second, wider visibility also brings more complex route choices. We therefore construct training routes with frequent branching points and clear instructions to provide targeted supervision for route selection. Third, panoramic navigation requires understanding spatial relationships across viewing directions, beyond recognizing individual landmarks. We combine semantic and geometric features from RGB panoramas to capture both scene content and spatial layout without adding visual tokens. With a 4B backbone and RGB-only input, PanoVLN surpasses the previous SOTA by 11.9% and 8.7% in success rate on R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen. Real-world experiments on a quadruped further demonstrate faster navigation with fewer pauses than prior VLN methods.
Local-Minimum Escaper: Programmatic Subgoal Generation for Robust Navigation in Unknown Environments
局部极小值跳出机制：在未知环境中实现稳健导航的程序化子目标生成方法
在未知且部分可观测的环境中实现无地图导航，仍然是移动机器人面临的一项挑战，尤其是在局部极小值导致机器人无法继续向目标移动的情况下。现有局部导航方法通常缺乏明确的局部极小值逃逸机制，而深度强化学习（Deep Reinforcement Learning，DRL）方法则通常通过奖励设计和策略优化，隐式地学习脱离局部极小值区域的恢复行为。
为解决这一问题，本文提出LME（Local-Minimum Escaper，局部极小值逃逸器），一种基于程序化方法的分层框架，通过显式生成子目标并进行推理，引导机器人脱离局部极小值区域。LME仅依赖局部观测信息，并采用具有可解释性的启发式准则筛选候选子目标，同时考虑周围障碍物的几何分布以及候选位置的安全性。随后，局部规划器生成指向所选子目标的底层运动指令。该设计使LME能够在统一框架下处理存在或不存在局部极小值的环境，同时不依赖特定的底层局部规划器，也无需额外训练。
在仿真环境和真实环境中开展的大量实验表明，LME能够实现稳健的导航性能，并泛化至具有挑战性的未见场景。此外，所生成的子目标还可用于引导不同的局部规划器，显著提升其脱离局部极小值区域的能力。该框架已成功部署于差速驱动机器人和四足机器人，进一步验证了其实际应用价值与通用性。
Mapless navigation in unknown and partially observable environments remains challenging for mobile robots, particularly when local minima prevent the robot from making progress toward its goal. Existing local navigation methods often lack an explicit mechanism for escaping such situations, while deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches typically learn recovery behaviors implicitly through reward design and policy optimization. In this work, we propose \textbf{LME} (Local-Minimum Escaper), a programmatic hierarchical framework that explicitly generates and reasons subgoals to guide robots out of local-minimum regions. LME operates solely on local observations and selects candidate subgoals using interpretable heuristic criteria that account for both surrounding obstacle geometry and candidate-location safety. A local planner then generates low-level motion commands toward the selected subgoal. This design enables LME to handle environments both with and without local minima within a unified framework, while remaining independent of the underlying local planner and requiring no additional training. Extensive experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that LME provides robust navigation performance and generalizes to challenging unseen scenarios. Furthermore, the generated subgoals can be used to guide different local planners, substantially improving their ability to escape local minima. Successful deployments on both differential-drive and quadruped robots further demonstrate the practical applicability and generality of the proposed framework.
NavHarness: Adaptive Goals for Agentic Vision-Language Navigation
NavHarness：具身视觉-语言导航中的自适应目标
视觉语言导航（Vision-Language Navigation，VLN）要求具身智能体根据语言指令和环境观测生成导航动作。通用多模态智能体为这一任务提供了良好的基础，但仅选择合理的局部动作，并不能确保实际执行过程始终符合预期路线，尤其是在长时序导航任务中。此外，随着交互历史不断累积，后续决策所需的输入信息量也随之增加，从而带来显著的推理开销。
为此，本文提出\method，一种智能体式视觉语言导航（Agentic VLN）框架，包含四个核心模块：用于为局部动作设定自适应目标的目标智能体（Goal Agent）、用于动态验证目标是否完成的验证智能体（Verify Agent）、用于多模态上下文压缩的记忆智能体（Memory Agent），以及负责执行自适应目标的视觉运动智能体（Visuomotor Agent）。具体而言，Goal Agent根据导航指令、当前环境观测和执行历史制定自适应目标；随后，Visuomotor Agent执行相应的导航动作以实现各个目标。同时，Verify Agent针对每个目标生成特定的验证问题，动态评估观测结果是否满足预期的完成条件。当目标完成得到验证后，该时刻便成为Memory Agent压缩相应多模态交互历史的边界，同时保留后续导航所需的信息。
研究在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上评估了导航性能，考察了该框架在三种不同模型骨干网络下的变体表现，并研究了执行过程中上下文信息的演变情况。在真实环境评估中，\method在8条具有挑战性的路线中，每条路线均重复测试3次，最终取得了83.3%的导航成功率，导航误差为1.51米。
Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires embodied agents to generate actions based on instructions and observations. General-purpose multimodal agents offer a promising basis for this task, but selecting plausible local actions does not ensure that execution remains consistent with the intended route, particularly in long-horizon tasks. Moreover, the accumulated interaction history increases the input required for subsequent decisions, resulting in a significant inference overhead. To this end, we introduce \method, an Agentic VLN framework that includes a Goal Agent that sets adaptive goals for local actions, a Verify Agent that dynamically verifies whether a goal has been completed, a Memory Agent for multimodal context compression, and a Visuomotor Agent to execute adaptive goals. Specifically, the Goal Agent formulates adaptive goals based on the instruction, current observation, and execution history. Then the Visuomotor Agent executes navigation actions to achieve each goal, while the Verify Agent uses a goal-specific verification question to dynamically assess whether the observed outcomes satisfy the intended completion condition. Verified goal completion then marks a boundary for the Memory Agent to compress the corresponding multimodal interaction history while preserving information needed for subsequent navigation. We evaluate navigation on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, examine framework variants across three model backbones, and study context evolution during execution. For Real-World evaluation, \method achieves 83.3\% success and 1.51\,m navigation error across eight challenging routes evaluated three times each.
CAIMAN: Causal Action Influence Detection for Sample-Efficient Loco-Manipulation
CAIMAN：用于样本高效移动操作的因果动作影响检测
赋予足式机器人执行非抓取式移动操作（Non-prehensile Loco-manipulation）的能力，对于提升其任务适应性和应用范围至关重要。然而，学习全身推动物体等行为，通常需要复杂的规划策略或大量针对特定任务设计的奖励塑形。为此，本文提出CAIMAN，一种实用的强化学习框架，旨在鼓励智能体主动获取对环境中其他实体的控制能力。CAIMAN将因果动作影响（Causal Action Influence）作为内在动机目标，使足式机器人即使在任务奖励稀疏的情况下，也能够高效地习得推动物体的技能。
该方法采用分层控制策略，将底层运动控制模块与高层策略相结合。其中，高层策略生成与任务相关的速度指令，并通过最大化内在奖励进行训练。为估计因果动作影响，研究通过结合运动学先验与训练过程中收集的数据，学习环境动力学模型。实验结果表明，CAIMAN在仿真环境中具有更高的样本效率，并能够适应多种不同场景；此外，该方法成功迁移至真实机器人系统，且无需进行额外的微调。
Enabling legged robots to perform non-prehensile loco-manipulation is crucial for enhancing their versatility. However, learning behaviors such as whole-body object pushing often necessitates sophisticated planning strategies or extensive task-specific reward shaping. In this work, we present CAIMAN, a practical reinforcement learning framework that encourages the agent to gain control over other entities in the environment. CAIMAN leverages causal action influence as an intrinsic motivation objective, allowing legged robots to efficiently acquire object pushing skills even under sparse task rewards. We employ a hierarchical control strategy, combining a low-level locomotion module with a high-level policy that generates task-relevant velocity commands and is trained to maximize the intrinsic reward. To estimate causal action influence, we learn the dynamics of the environment by integrating a kinematic prior with data collected during training. We empirically demonstrate CAIMAN’s superior sample efficiency and adaptability to diverse scenarios in simulation, as well as its successful transfer to real-world systems without further fine-tuning.
VP-EVT: Active Visibility Preservation for Embodied Visual Tracking
VP-EVT：具身视觉跟踪中的主动可见性保持
具身视觉跟踪（Embodied Visual Tracking，EVT）是智能机器人在人机协作中不可或缺的一项能力，要求智能体仅依靠自我中心视觉感知，在动态环境中持续跟随指定的目标人员。然而，动态场景中行人持续造成的遮挡，对现有EVT方法构成了重大挑战。由于缺乏主动保持目标可见性的机制，传统的被动跟踪方法在严重遮挡情况下往往会出现长时间的目标丢失。因此，本文提出VP-EVT框架，将目标可见性作为运动控制的明确优化目标，而非仅仅将其视为跟随行为的附带结果。
实现这一目标不仅需要理解哪些物体遮挡了目标，还需要分析机器人如何通过自身运动改变遮挡状态。为此，VP-EVT采用语言引导的感知方法，分别提取目标人员和其他行人的观测信息。当遮挡导致当前观测不完整时，VP-EVT结合视觉历史信息与机器人自身运动信息（Ego-motion），持续估计目标与行人之间的相对位置及运动状态。基于这些估计结果和当前的跟随路径点，VP-EVT预测继续执行跟随动作是否会导致遮挡持续存在。当预测风险较低时，系统保留原有的跟随运动；否则，循环控制器将更新后的状态估计与此前决策中的机动上下文相结合，协调视角调整动作以及后续恢复稳定跟随的过程。
此外，研究提出OccEVT-Bench，用于在闭环控制场景下评估持续遮挡问题，并收集专家示范数据用于模型训练。在该基准的Risk测试集上，与具有竞争力的基线方法相比，VP-EVT的成功率提高了121.4%，同时将可见性缺失程度（Visibility Deficit）和最长目标丢失持续时间分别降低了78.8%和74.4%。
Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT) is an essential capability for intelligent robots in human-robot collaboration, requiring an agent to follow a designated target person in dynamic environments relying solely on egocentric visual perception. However, persistent pedestrian occlusions in dynamic scenes pose critical challenges to existing EVT methods. Lacking proactive visibility preservation, reactive tracking methods frequently experience prolonged target loss under severe occlusions. Therefore, we propose VP-EVT, a framework that treats target visibility as an explicit objective of motion control rather than a by-product of following. Acting on this objective requires understanding both what obstructs the target and how robot motion can change that obstruction. VP-EVT therefore uses language-guided perception to extract separate target and pedestrian observations. When occlusion makes current observations incomplete, VP-EVT combines visual history with ego-motion to maintain estimates of their relative positions and motion. Using these estimates and the current following waypoints, VP-EVT predicts whether continued following will sustain the obstruction. When the predicted risk is low, the original following motion is retained; otherwise, a recurrent controller combines updated estimates with maneuver context from preceding decisions to coordinate viewpoint adjustment and the return to stable following. Moreover, we introduce OccEVT-Bench for closed-loop evaluation of persistent occlusion and collect expert demonstrations for training. On its Risk split, VP-EVT improves success rate by 121.4% relative to a competitive baseline and reduces visibility deficit and longest target-loss duration by 78.8% and 74.4%, respectively.
LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation for Quadruped Robots
大语言模型引导的四足机器人平面移动与操作
机器人导航通常假设机器人与目标之间存在一条可行且无碰撞的路径。然而，在包含可移动障碍物的复杂环境中，机器人可能需要通过与环境进行物理交互，主动创造可通行路径，才能到达目标。传统方法通常通过几何规则和针对特定任务设计的交互逻辑来实现此类行为，而现有基于学习的方法则往往通过对决策空间进行约束性抽象来构建规划问题，例如采用低维运动指令或预定义动作集合。与之不同，本文考虑更广泛的决策空间，使规划器能够联合选择合适的技能、必要时需要交互的目标物体，以及相应的几何目标位置。
研究将规划器设计为一种语言条件任务规划器，并使用基于合成数据的低秩适应（Low-Rank Adaptation，LoRA）进行微调。该规划器将自然语言任务描述和结构化场景表示作为输入，生成长度可变的参数化导航与操作动作序列，再由通过无模型强化学习（Model-free Reinforcement Learning，RL）训练的底层策略执行。在一种未纳入训练的任务结构中，该规划器在仿真实验的30条轨迹中，有24条成功恢复了所需的技能组合，其中12条成功完成了任务。
在底层控制方面，研究提出了一种端到端全身平面操作策略，专门用于物体推动任务。在仿真环境中，该策略的任务成功率达到93.3%，高于常用分层操作基线方法的83.5%，同时将任务完成时间缩短了60%以上。最后，在45次真实机器人硬件实验中，完整分层框架有44次成功选择了正确的技能组合，并在其中34次成功完成了端到端任务。
Robotic navigation typically assumes that a feasible collision-free route exists between the robot and its goal; however, in cluttered environments containing movable obstacles, reaching the goal may require physical interaction with the environment to create such a route. Classical solutions encode these behaviors through geometric rules and task-specific interaction logic, while existing learning-based approaches often formalize the planning problem through constrained abstractions of the decision space, such as low-dimensional motion commands or predefined action sets. We instead consider a broader decision space, in which the planner jointly selects the appropriate skill, the relevant object when applicable, and a geometric target. Our planner is formulated as a language-conditioned task planner, fine-tuned using LoRA on synthetic data, that maps natural-language task descriptions and a structured scene representation to variable-length sequences of parameterized navigation and manipulation actions, executed by low-level policies trained with model-free reinforcement learning (RL). On a task structure excluded from training, the planner recovers the required skill composition in 24/30 trajectories in simulation and completes 12/30. At the low level, we introduce an end-to-end whole-body planar manipulation policy specialized for object pushing. In simulation, the proposed policy achieves a 93.3% success rate compared with 83.5% for the commonly-used hierarchical manipulation baseline, while reducing task-completion time by more than 60%. Evaluation of the complete hierarchy over 45 hardware trials yields the correct skill composition in 44/45 trials and successful end-to-end task execution in 34/45 trials.
Training-Free Target-Aware Refinement of 3D Gaussian Language Map
无需训练、面向目标的 3D 高斯语言地图精细化
将视觉语言特征蒸馏到三维高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting，3DGS）中，可以构建一种语言地图（Language Map），使机器人能够通过任意文本进行场景查询。然而，在实际部署中，机器人通常需要可靠地定位一组由用户指定的目标物体，而现有蒸馏语言地图往往难以准确识别这些目标。同时，系统还必须保留对其他词语的开放词汇查询能力。
为解决这一问题，本文提出一种无需训练的目标感知语言地图优化方法，可直接应用于已经完成蒸馏的语言地图。该方法借助支持文本提示的分割模型，在检测到的目标区域内，将视觉嵌入与目标文本嵌入进行融合，通过凸组合实现目标先验信息的注入，其中组合系数决定先验信息的注入程度，而非目标区域则保持不变。由于过度注入先验信息可能覆盖原有的外观特征，并损害开放词汇查询能力，因此，研究针对每个目标寻找能够使其获得最高匹配结果的最小注入系数，并通过闭式解直接计算所有系数，无需调整额外的超参数。此外，研究还发现了先验信息注入在语言目标定位中的一种失效模式：文本嵌入之间存在共同分量，注入这些嵌入后，标准余弦相似度计算会失去对具体查询词的区分能力。为此，研究在相似度计算阶段引入中心化处理，以消除这一问题。
在三个基准测试上的实验结果表明，该优化方法能够持续提升开放词汇分割性能，在Replica数据集上的基础平均交并比（mean Intersection over Union，mIoU）约提升至原来的两倍，同时也比原始语言地图更可靠地定位语言指定的目标。此外，该方法能够以插件形式迁移至现成的基于场（Field-based）和基于物体（Object-level）的语言地图，并支持一项真实环境演示：四足机器人根据自然语言指令导航至指定目标。
Distilling vision-language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting yields a language map that can be queried with arbitrary text. In deployment, however, a small set of user-specified targets must be reliably located, which current distilled maps often miss, while open-vocabulary queryability for other words must remain intact. We propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Guided by a text-promptable segmenter, the visual embedding inside each detected target region is blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient sets the amount of injected prior, while non-target regions are left untouched. Injecting too much overwrites appearance cues and general queryability, so we seek, for each target, the smallest coefficient that still lets it win, and we obtain every coefficient in closed form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. We further identify a failure mode of injection in language-goal localization. Text embeddings share a common component, and injecting them makes the standard cosine read-out query-agnostic, which a centering step in the read-out removes. Across three benchmarks, the refinement consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation, roughly doubling the base mIoU on Replica, and localizes language goals more reliably than the base map. It also transfers as a plug-in to off-the-shelf field-based and object-level language maps and supports a real-world demonstration in which a legged robot navigates to natural-language goals.
Seek Before You Move: Evidence Seeking for Progress Grounding in Vision-Language Navigation
先探索，后移动：视觉语言导航中基于证据搜寻的进展锚定
视觉语言导航（Vision-Language Navigation，VLN）要求智能体根据长时序导航指令和不完整的自我中心视角观测，持续判断并确认当前任务的执行进度。现有基于视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model，VLM）的导航智能体通常仅根据当前可获得的观测进行推理，即使缺少与任务相关的关键证据，也可能仍然保持较高的决策置信度。例如，当指示下一次转弯的地标位于当前视野之外时，智能体可能仍然确信地继续向前移动，最终偏离预定路线。本文将这种失效模式称为进度近视（Progress Myopia），即智能体无法识别当前进度判断所依据的证据是否充分，却仍基于不足的信息继续执行动作。
为解决这一问题，本文提出SeekVLN，一种将语义进度推理与任务相关观测的主动获取相结合的证据驱动框架。SeekVLN采用两阶段训练策略。首先，研究提出未来引导的反向生成方法（Future-guided Reverse Generation，FRG），利用未来的专家动作，为离线专家轨迹补充额外视角及证据标注。通过对这些轨迹进行监督微调，使模型在无需额外专家交互的情况下，建立主动寻求证据和进行进度推理的先验能力。然而，仅通过模仿学习无法判断主动获取证据是否真正有助于后续导航。因此，研究进一步提出反事实对比策略优化方法（Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization，C2PO），用于强化学习微调。该方法从同一状态出发，将主动寻求证据的分支与直接导航的反事实分支进行比较，并利用对比奖励，根据后续导航收益为主动寻求证据的决策分配相应的奖励。
仿真实验结果表明，SeekVLN在多个导航基准测试中取得了当前最优性能。与基础模型相比，其在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上的导航成功率分别提高了12.7%和7.5%。仿真和真实环境中的评估结果均表明，SeekVLN能够表现出类似人类的主动证据获取行为，从而更加可靠地判断和确认导航进度。
Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to continuously ground task progress from long-horizon instructions and partial egocentric observations. Existing VLM-based navigation agents typically reason only over available observations and may remain confident even when task-relevant evidence is missing. For example, an agent may confidently proceed forward and get lost even though the landmark indicating the next turn lies outside its current field of view. We term this failure mode Progress Myopia: the agent fails to recognize unreliable progress grounding and continues acting on insufficient evidence. To address it, we propose SeekVLN, an evidence-seeking framework that couples semantic progress reasoning with active acquisition of task-relevant observations. SeekVLN is trained in two stages: First, Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) uses future expert actions to augment offline expert trajectories with supplementary views and evidence annotations. Supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories establishes a prior for evidence seeking and progress reasoning without additional expert interaction. However, imitation alone does not reveal whether seeking improves subsequent navigation. We therefore introduce Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) for reinforcement fine-tuning. By comparing each evidence-seeking branch with a counterfactual direct-navigation branch from the same state, C2PO uses a contrastive reward to assign credit to seeking decisions based on subsequent navigation benefit. Experiments on simulated benchmarks show that SeekVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving success rate by 12.7% and 7.5% over the base model on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. Both simulated and real-world evaluations exhibit human-like evidence-seeking behaviors for more reliable progress grounding.
PRISM: Bridging Multimodality and Real-Time Control in Multisensory Policies
PRISM：在多感官策略中架起多模态与实时控制之间的桥梁
机器人模仿学习需要策略能够捕捉多模态动作分布、以实时控制频率运行，并有效利用可用传感器信息。现有生成式方法，包括扩散模型（Diffusion）、流匹配（Flow Matching）和隐式最大似然估计（Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation，IMLE），仅能部分满足这些要求。
本文提出 PRISM，一种基于经过校准的批次全局 RS-IMLE 目标函数构建的单次前向推理多传感器策略。研究表明，RS-IMLE 的拒绝机制最初是为小样本图像生成设计的，但在策略学习所需的批次规模下会出现性能退化。为此，本文引入相应的校准方法，以恢复该机制的有效拒绝能力。PRISM 将用于处理 RGB 图像、深度、触觉、音频和本体感知信息的时序多传感器编码器，与采用线性注意力机制的 Performer 生成器相结合，并基于上述目标函数进行训练。
在真实世界实验中，PRISM 应用于 Unitree Go2 四足机器人搭载七自由度机械臂的移动操作任务，以及 UR5 机械臂的桌面操作任务。与扩散策略相比，PRISM 的任务成功率提高了 10–25 个百分点，同时能够维持 30–50 Hz 的闭环控制频率。在语言条件控制的 CALVIN ABCD 基准测试中，PRISM 相较于扩散方法的成功率提高约 31 个百分点，相较于流匹配方法提高约 24 个百分点，同时将轨迹急动度（Trajectory Jerk）降低了 20–70 倍。
Robotic imitation learning requires policies that capture multimodal action distributions, run at real-time control rates, and effectively exploit available sensors. Existing generative approaches, including diffusion, flow matching, and IMLE, satisfy these requirements only partially. We present PRISM, a single-pass multisensory policy built on a calibrated batch-global RS-IMLE objective. We show that the RS-IMLE rejection mechanism, originally designed for few-shot image synthesis, degenerates at policy-scale batch sizes, and introduce the calibration needed to restore effective rejection. PRISM couples a temporal multisensory encoder for RGB, depth, tactile, audio, and proprioceptive inputs with a linear-attention Performer generator trained under this objective. On real-world loco-manipulation with a Unitree Go2 and 7-DoF arm, and tabletop manipulation with a UR5, PRISM improves success over diffusion policies by 10–25 percentage points while sustaining 30–50 Hz closed-loop control. On language-conditioned CALVIN ABCD, PRISM improves success by approximately 31 percentage points over diffusion and approximately 24 percentage points over flow matching, while reducing trajectory jerk by 20×–70×.
Beyond Isolated Entities: Relation-Aware Multi-Entity Modeling for Unsupervised Video Anomaly Detection
超越孤立实体：面向无监督视频异常检测的、具备关系感知能力的多实体建模
面向巡逻机器人和监控系统的视频异常检测，需要识别熟悉实体之间的异常交互行为。现有基于像素重建和孤立实体建模的方法存在一定局限：当单个实体本身表现正常，但实体之间的空间关系或运动关系出现异常时，这些方法可能无法有效识别。
本文提出一种用于时序实体关系分析与一致性检验的交互中心网络（Interaction-Centric Network for Temporal Entity-Relation Analysis and Consistency Testing，INTERACT），用于无监督视频异常检测。首先，人员-物体外观-运动交互模块（Person-Object Appearance-Motion Interaction，POAMI）突破了传统孤立实体编码方式，在每一帧中联合建模人员与物体的外观、运动及空间构型，从而使生成的表征既能描述单个实体的状态，也能捕捉实体之间的关联上下文。在此基础上，目标几何引导的关系交互预测模块（Target Geometry-Guided Relational Interaction Prediction，TGRIP）利用历史关系记忆和目标帧的几何信息预测目标实体的交互状态，而无需进行显式身份跟踪。随后，运动-交互重建与对齐模块（Motion-Interaction Reconstruction and Alignment，MIRA）通过条件流重建和语义一致性检验评估预测结果，从而在预测误差之外提供互补的异常证据。
实验结果表明，INTERACT 达到了当前最先进的性能，在 ShanghaiTech 基准数据集上取得了 84.5% 的帧级 AUC。消融实验显示，移除跨实体注意力机制会导致最大的性能下降，验证了关系建模的必要性。INTERACT 在检测由人员与物体之间关系变化引起的异常方面表现尤为突出，同时在一般异常检测场景中也保持了具有竞争力的性能。
Video anomaly detection for patrol robots and surveillance systems must recognize abnormal interactions among familiar entities. Existing pixel-reconstruction and isolated-entity methods may fail when individual entities appear normal but their spatial or motion relations are abnormal. This work presents Interaction-Centric Network for Temporal Entity-Relation Analysis and Consistency Testing (INTERACT), a framework for unsupervised video anomaly detection. Person-Object Appearance-Motion Interaction (POAMI) moves beyond isolated-entity encoding by jointly modeling the appearance, motion, and spatial configurations of persons and objects in each frame. The resulting representations capture both individual entity states and their cross-entity context. Based on these representations, Target Geometry-Guided Relational Interaction Prediction (TGRIP) predicts target entity interaction states from historical relational memory and target-frame geometry without explicit identity tracking. Motion-Interaction Reconstruction and Alignment (MIRA) then evaluates these predictions through conditional flow reconstruction and semantic consistency checking, providing complementary anomaly evidence beyond prediction error alone. INTERACT achieves state-of-the-art performance, obtaining a frame-level AUC of 84.5% on the ShanghaiTech benchmark. Ablation studies show that removing cross-entity attention causes the largest performance drop, demonstrating the necessity of relational modeling. INTERACT is particularly effective for anomalies caused by changes in relations among people and objects, while maintaining competitive performance in general scenarios.
Revealing and Bridging the Physical Executability Gap in Vision-Language Navigation
揭示并弥合视觉-语言导航中的物理可执行性差距
连续视觉语言导航（Vision-and-Language Navigation，VLN）通常以目标到达成功率作为评估指标，并假设该指标能够反映智能体执行语言引导行为的能力。然而，本文指出这一假设可能并不成立：当前仿真器中较为宽松的接触模型可能掩盖物理上不可执行的动作，从而导致语义能力与具身执行之间出现物理可执行性差距。
为弥合这一差距，本文提出视觉-语义可通行性对齐框架（Visual-Semantic Traversability Alignment，VeSTA），旨在使 VLN 策略与物理上可执行的未来轨迹保持一致。本文将视觉-语义可通行性定义为：预测满足语义有效性、几何可行性和物理鲁棒性的指令条件轨迹的能力。VeSTA 通过两种互补机制解决这一对齐问题：一是提高轨迹生成过程中对可执行区域的覆盖能力；二是在多模态未来轨迹中进行风险感知选择。具体而言，轨迹相对组策略优化（Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization）利用严格接触反馈调整候选轨迹分布，使其向可执行区域倾斜；可通行性风险评估器（Traversability Risk Critic）则学习经过风险调整的标量效用，用于对候选未来轨迹进行逐一评估和选择。
在 R2R 和 RxR 数据集上的实验表明，现有 VLN 智能体的性能在很大程度上依赖于仿真器的接触语义。在严格接触条件下进行评估时，VeSTA 显著减少了由碰撞引起的任务失败，同时保持或提升了目标到达性能。此外，受控的真实世界机器人实验也表明，模型学习到的轨迹偏好能够迁移至仿真环境之外。
Continuous vision-and-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated by goal-reaching success, assuming it reflects an agent's ability to execute language-grounded behavior. We show that this assumption can fail: permissive contact models in current simulators may mask physically infeasible actions, creating a physical executability gap between semantic competence and embodied realization. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual-Semantic Traversability Alignment (VeSTA), a framework that aligns VLN policies with physically executable futures. We define visual-semantic traversability as the ability to predict instruction-conditioned trajectories that are semantically valid, geometrically feasible, and physically robust. VeSTA addresses this misalignment through two complementary mechanisms: improving executable support in trajectory generation and risk-aware selection among multimodal futures. Specifically, Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization uses strict-contact feedback to reshape the candidate distribution toward executable regions, while the Traversability Risk Critic learns a risk-adjusted scalar utility for candidate-wise future selection. Experiments on R2R and RxR reveal substantial dependence of existing VLN agents on simulator contact semantics. Under strict-contact evaluation, VeSTA substantially reduces collision-induced failures while preserving or improving goal-reaching performance, and controlled real-world robot experiments provide evidence that the learned preference transfers beyond simulation.
CoSMO Conformal Semantic Mapping for Open-World Safe Robot Navigation
CoSMO：面向开放世界安全机器人导航的共形语义建图
安全自主导航不仅需要实现几何层面的障碍物避让，还需要具备语义感知能力。不同类别的物体需要设置不同的安全距离，并且随着机器人探索新环境，相关风险物体的类别集合也可能不断扩展。视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models，VLMs）能够提供丰富的语义表征，有助于构建未知场景的语义地图，但其置信度分数通常缺乏良好的校准，因此原始预测结果难以直接用于安全关键型路径规划。保形预测（Conformal Prediction，CP）能够提供覆盖率保证，但现有方法通常假设标签集合固定且数据分布平稳，因而限制了其在开放世界环境中的应用。
为此，本文提出面向开放世界安全机器人导航的保形语义建图框架（Conformal Semantic Mapping for Open-World Safe Robot Navigation，CoSMO）。该框架将 VLM 的嵌入表征转换为经过校准的覆盖集合，并基于动态扩展的风险类别词汇表生成具备安全感知能力的障碍物膨胀区域，即使在数据分布发生偏移的情况下也能实现上述功能。
在 Matterport3D（MP3D）数据集上的实验表明，与仅基于几何信息的基线方法相比，CoSMO 将语义碰撞减少了 61.6%，同时即使在专家反馈存在延迟的情况下，仍能保持形式化覆盖率保证。在 Unitree Go2 机器人上开展的真实世界实验进一步验证了该方法在仿真环境之外的泛化能力：在检测器反馈延迟的条件下，其长期实测覆盖率达到 90.73%，高于 90% 的目标覆盖率。
Safe autonomous navigation requires not only geometric obstacle avoidance but also semantic awareness. Different object categories demand different safety clearances, and the set of relevant categories may expand as the robot explores novel environments. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich semantic representations for building maps of unknown scenes, yet their confidence scores are poorly calibrated, making raw predictions unreliable for safety-critical planning. Conformal prediction (CP) can provide coverage guarantees, but existing methods assume a fixed label set and stationary data, limiting their use in open-world settings. We propose Conformal Semantic Mapping for Open-World Safe Robot Navigation (CoSMO), a semantic safety mapping framework that transforms VLM embeddings into calibrated coverage sets and safety-aware obstacle dilations over a dynamically expanding hazard vocabulary, even under distribution shift. Experiments on the Matterport3D (MP3D) dataset show that CoSMO reduces semantic collisions by 61.6% relative to a geometry-only baseline, while maintaining formal coverage guarantees even under delayed expert feedback. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 robot further demonstrate generalization beyond simulation, achieving long-run empirical coverage of 90.73% against the 90% target under delayed detector feedback.
Turning Safety into Competence: Minimally Exploitable Robot Policies via Safety-Filtered Reinforcement Learning
将安全性转化为能力：通过安全过滤强化学习实现“难以被利用”的机器人策略
应用于竞争性任务的机器人必须在确保安全的前提下，灵活应对并战胜对手。现有方法（包括安全强化学习（Safe Reinforcement Learning，Safe RL））通常通过训练单一策略，同时实现任务成功和避免失败。这种耦合式学习方式可能增加训练难度，并使训练得到的策略容易受到蓄意攻击。
本文提出 Safety to Competence（S2C），一种分为两个阶段的强化学习框架，将安全策略构建与竞争性任务学习相分离。研究将竞争性交互建模为安全关键型马尔可夫博弈（Safety-Critical Markov Games），并证明：当所有参与者均遵循安全机动策略时，理想的安全过滤机制能够保持策略的不可利用性（Non-exploitability）。S2C 首先通过对抗强化学习训练鲁棒的安全过滤器，随后在任务策略训练阶段将其嵌入环境中，并在实际部署时保留同一过滤器，以确保安全约束持续生效。
在模拟的触地竞争游戏（Touchdown Games）中，与八种安全强化学习基线方法相比，S2C 取得了最高的胜率和 Elo 评分，同时实现了最低的可利用性。在与人类对手进行的硬件压力测试中，S2C 也展现出了良好的任务执行能力。
Robots deployed for competitive tasks must outmaneuver their opponents without sacrificing safety. Existing approaches, including safe reinforcement learning (RL), train a single policy to achieve task success and avoid failures simultaneously. This coupling can complicate training and leave the learned policy exploitable by deliberate attacks. We propose Safety to Competence (S2C), a two-stage RL framework that separates safety synthesis from competitive task learning. We formulate competitive interactions as safety-critical Markov games and prove that perfect filtering preserves policy non-exploitability when all players commit to safe maneuvers. S2C learns a robust safety filter via adversarial RL, embeds it in the environment during task policy training, and retains the same filter at deployment. In simulated touchdown games, S2C outperforms eight safe RL baselines, achieving the highest win rate and Elo rating, and the lowest exploitability. Hardware stress tests against a human opponent confirm S2C's competence.
Safe Multi-Robot Coordination via VLM–LLM Reasoning and Reachability Analysis
基于 VLM-LLM 推理与可达性分析的安全多机器人协同
异构机器对机器（Machine-to-Machine，M2M）机器人系统中的安全协同面临较大挑战，尤其是在机器人感知能力、环境认知水平及运动执行角色存在差异的情况下。本研究提出了一种集中式安全感知 M2M 框架，用于异构移动机器人系统中的协同目标导向导航。该系统由一台具备视觉感知能力的机器人和一台无摄像头的移动机器人组成，旨在引导两台机器人前往检测到的目标区域，例如可通行区域或开放门的方向，同时避开静态和动态障碍物，并防止机器人之间发生不安全交互。该框架的核心协作原则是共享感知：具备视觉感知能力的机器人通过中央服务器提供环境语义信息，使无摄像头机器人能够结合共享场景表示，以及自身的里程计、惯性测量单元（IMU）和状态反馈执行导航任务。
两台机器人均通过 MQTT 消息代理与服务器通信，并持续发布自身状态数据，其中具备视觉感知能力的机器人还会额外传输视觉观测信息。视觉语言模型（VLM）负责理解场景，并将提取的语义信息转换为保守的几何约束，包括障碍物区域、可通行区域、目标区域、安全通道和运动边界。大语言模型（LLM）则通过提出针对不同机器人的导航决策，为高层任务分配提供推理支持，而底层执行仍由确定性控制器负责。在发送任何指令之前，基于 Zonotope 的可达性分析引擎都会对候选动作进行验证，检查其是否满足障碍物避让、安全通道范围约束以及机器人间碰撞约束。只有符合上述基于可达性分析的安全条件的指令，才会获得批准并发送至相应机器人。
在无障碍路径和动态障碍物场景下开展的在线验证表明，该框架能够批准安全运动指令，并在必要时触发保守的重新规划或保持行为，同时严格区分语义推理与可执行控制。该框架整合了共享语义感知、基于消息代理的 M2M 通信、协同任务分配以及形式化可达性验证，为感知能力不对称的异构移动机器人提供了更安全的协同机制。
Safe coordination in heterogeneous machine-to-machine (M2M) robotic systems is difficult when robots differ in sensing capability, environmental awareness, and motion execution roles. This study presents a centralized safety aware M2M framework for cooperative goal-directed navigation in a heterogeneous mobile robot system composed of a vision-capable robot and a cameraless robotic vehicle. The objective is to guide the robots toward a detected goal region, such as a traversable target area or open door direction, while avoiding static and dynamic obstacles and preventing unsafe inter robot interactions. The central cooperation principle is shared perception: the vision-capable robot provides semantic environmental awareness through a centralized server, allowing the camera-less robot to act using this shared scene representation together with its own odometry, IMU, and state feedback. Both robots communicate with the server through an MQTT broker and continuously publish robot-state data, while the vision capable robot additionally transmits visual observations. A vision language model interprets the scene, and the extracted semantic information is converted into conservative geometric constraints, including obstacle regions, traversable areas, goal regions, safe corridors, and motion boundaries. A large language model supports high level task allocation reasoning by proposing robot specific navigation decisions, while deterministic controllers remain responsible for low-level execution. Before any command is issued, each candidate action is verified by a zonotope based reachability engine that checks obstacle avoidance, safe corridor containment, and inter-robot collision constraints. Only commands satisfying these reachability-based safety conditions are approved and transmitted to the corresponding robot. Online validation in clear-path and dynamic-obstacle scenarios demonstrates that the framework can approve safe motion, trigger conservative replanning or holding behavior, and preserve a strict separation between semantic reasoning and executable control. The proposed framework unifies shared semantic perception, broker-based M2M communication, cooperative task allocation, and formal reachability verification to support safer coordination of heterogeneous mobile robots with asymmetric sensing capabilities.
CollisionSplatting: Collision-Aware Motion Planning in 3DGS Scenes with Image-Conditioned Objectives and Adjustable Conservatism
CollisionSplatting：基于3DGS场景、以图像为条件的目标设定及可调节保守性的碰撞感知运动规划
将高密度视觉信息融入运动规划仍然面临挑战。几何规划器依赖经过抽象的场景表示，往往会丢失丰富的视觉信息；而基于学习的视觉模型通常缺乏几何可解释性，且计算效率较低。本文提出 CollisionSplatting，一种简单、模块化、基于概率思想并由 GPU 加速的距离度量方法，具有可调节的保守程度，可直接作用于标准三维高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting，3DGS）场景。
将该距离度量与基于学习的图像条件奖励函数相结合，可以通过统一考虑碰撞感知代价与图像空间目标，实现几何与视觉联合规划。研究将该度量方法集成至 GPU 加速的模型预测路径积分（Model Predictive Path Integral，MPPI）和快速探索随机树（Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree，RRT）规划器中。实验表明，与具有代表性的基线方法相比，该方法在碰撞分类性能方面达到相当或更优的水平，同时显著提高了碰撞检测吞吐量，并大幅降低了显存（VRAM）占用。
最后，研究通过真实环境中的视觉引导导航与操作任务，验证了该度量方法的有效性，表明三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）能够在丰富的感知信息与实时运动规划之间发挥实用的桥接作用。
Incorporating dense visual information into motion planning remains challenging, as geometric planners rely on abstracted scene representations that discard visual richness, while learned visual models often lack geometric interpretability and computational efficiency. This paper introduces CollisionSplatting, a simple, modular, GPU-accelerated, probability-inspired distance metric with tunable conservatism that operates directly on standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. When combined with learned image-conditioned reward functions, this metric enables joint geometric and visual planning by unifying collision-aware costs with image-space objectives. We integrate the metric into GPU-accelerated Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) and Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) planners, and show on-par or better collision-classification performance compared to representative baselines while achieving substantially higher collision-checking throughput and significantly lower VRAM usage. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our metric in real-world vision-guided navigation and manipulation tasks, highlighting 3DGS as a practical bridge between rich perception and real-time motion planning.
RoboMMT: Learning Stable Tracking of Modulated Expressive and Interactive Robot Motion
迈向路径创造型导航：基于具身交互的机器人导航
表达性机器人运动（expressive robot motion）能够提升人机交互中的自然度、有效性与感知好感度。然而，当部署于动态不稳定平台上时，表达性身体运动的响应式执行可能会使机器人达到其稳定性极限，尤其是在表达性与物理控制相解耦的情况下。为此，我们提出了 RoboMMT（机器人调制运动跟踪，Robot Modulated Motion Tracking）——一个将参数化表达性运动合成、基于物理的角色控制以及对空间交互目标的响应式自适应相结合的模块化控制架构。我们的方法在广泛的表达性域内训练了一个参考条件跟踪策略（reference-conditioned tracking policy），使其能够忠实地实现指令运动，同时维持动态稳定性。
目标响应性（goal reactivity）是通过训练轻量级的特定任务交互策略来实现的，该策略在保持稳定跟踪策略处于控制回路中的同时，调制参考生成器的空间目标吸引点（spatial goal-attraction point）。在四足机器人和两台人形机器人上的评估表明，所学得的跟踪器在整个调制域内均保持了稳定与精确，而未经该覆盖范围训练的跟踪器则失去了平衡、跟踪精度或两者兼失。
我们表明，在此基础上叠加闭环目标自适应能够实现交互式朝向与指向行为，同时维持稳定的执行和相当的参考跟踪忠实度。机器人学会了主动重新分配体重并采取纠偏步态（corrective steps）。通过在重度扰动下的四足机器人真实实验，展示了零样本仿真到真实（zero-shot sim-to-real）的迁移能力。
Expressive robot motion can improve naturalness, effectiveness, and perceived likability in human-robot interaction. When deployed on dynamically unstable platforms, however, reactive execution of expressive body motion may bring the robot to its stability limits, especially when expressivity is decoupled from physical control. In this paper, we present RoboMMT (Robot Modulated Motion Tracking), a modular control architecture that couples parameterized expressive motion synthesis, physics-based character control, and reactive adaptation to spatial interaction goals. Our approach trains a reference-conditioned tracking policy across a broad domain of expressivity, enabling it to faithfully realize the commanded motions while maintaining dynamic stability. Goal reactivity is achieved by training lightweight, task-specific interaction policies that modulate the reference generator's spatial goal-attraction point, with the stabilizing tracking policy kept in the loop. Evaluations on a quadruped and two humanoid robots show that the learned tracker remains stable and accurate across the entire modulation domain, whereas trackers trained without this coverage lose balance, tracking accuracy, or both. We show that layering closed-loop goal adaptation over this foundation enables interactive facing and pointing behaviors, while maintaining stable execution and comparable reference-tracking fidelity. The robot learns to proactively redistribute its weight and take corrective steps. Zero-shot sim-to-real transfer is demonstrated through real-robot experiments on a quadruped under heavy disturbances.
LEAP: Gradient Flow Augmented Lagrangian Trajectory Optimization for Contact Constrained Robots
LEAP：面向接触约束机器人的“梯度流增强拉格朗日”轨迹优化方法
为具足机器人和操作机器人生成动力学可行运动，需要求解一个大规模、非线性、非凸的最优控制问题（OCP），其中接触力螺旋（contact wrenches）不仅要在孤立瞬间，还必须在整个运动过程中满足摩擦锥约束。现有的求解器对初始猜测极为敏感，且随着关节数量的增加，其计算规模的可扩展性较差。为此，本文推出了 LEAP——该方法采用伪谱配置（pseudospectral collocation）对 OCP 进行转录，并利用 Powell-Hestenes-Rockafellar 增广拉格朗日函数的原始-对偶梯度流（primal-dual gradient flow）来计算解，而非采用传统的牛顿法或序列二次规划（SQP）求解。
由于该梯度流具有刚性（stiff），本文设计了一种带有高斯-牛顿度量（Gauss-Newton metric）、动量以及基于价值函数的步长控制器（merit-based step controller）的线性隐式积分器（linearly implicit integrator），以保持增广拉格朗日函数的单调性。在涵盖从平面跳跃机器人到 32 关节人形机器人的五个机器人平台的运动基准测试中，LEAP 是唯一能够成功求解所有测试问题的方法，在多个基准测试中实现了相比 Crocoddyl 和 Aligator 的显著加速，并以更小的计算预算生成了可跟踪的参考轨迹。
生成的轨迹已在高保真仿真器和实体硬件上通过轨迹跟踪得到了验证。代码将在本文最终被接受后予以开源。
Generating dynamically feasible motions for legged and manipulating robots requires solving a large, nonlinear, non-convex optimal control problem (OCP) in which contact wrenches must satisfy friction-cone constraints throughout the motion, not only at isolated instants. Existing solvers are sensitive to the initial guess and scale poorly with the number of joints. This paper introduces LEAP, which transcribes the OCP with pseudospectral collocation and, instead of a Newton or SQP solve, integrates a primal--dual gradient flow of a Powell--Hestenes--Rockafellar augmented Lagrangian to compute a solution. Because the flow is stiff, this paper designs a linearly implicit integrator with a Gauss--Newton metric, momentum, and a merit-based step controller that keeps the augmented Lagrangian monotone. Across locomotion benchmarks on five robot platforms, from planar hoppers to 32-joint humanoids, LEAP is the only method to solve every tested problem, achieves substantial speedups over Crocoddyl and Aligator on several benchmarks, and reaches trackable references at smaller compute budgets. The resulting trajectories are validated by tracking them in a high-fidelity simulator and on hardware. We will make the code public upon final acceptance of this paper.
OmniNav: Robust Long-Horizon Target Navigation in Dynamic Environments
OmniNav：动态环境中稳健的长程目标导航
长视距目标导航（Long-horizon target navigation）要求机器人在不断演化的观测、决策和物理交互过程中维持任务的持续执行。这需要具备三个耦合的能力：维护有效的场景记忆、在部分可观测性下修正目标信念（target beliefs），以及选择具有交互可行性的导航终点。然而，支撑每项能力的底层状态仅在条件上有效：当物体移动或消失时，场景表征会变得陈旧；不成功的搜索会改变对目标位置的信念；而几何上便利的终点对于操纵而言可能依然不可行。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 OmniNav——该方法将长视距导航构想为对耦合了场景有效性、目标信念和交互可行性的因式化任务状态后验（factorized task state posterior）进行持续推理。
在表征方面，OmniNav 增量式构建了一个可更新的三维物体场景记忆，从而防止陈旧的场景证据传播至后续决策中。在探索方面，它引入了一种证据感知贝叶斯信念修正机制（evidence-aware Bayesian belief-revision mechanism），该机制从语义上下文中推导依赖感知的区域先验，将不成功的搜索纳入负面证据中，并对其进行更新以用于后验引导的前沿选择（posterior-guided frontier selection）。在交互方面，OmniNav 将操纵可达性（manipulation reachability）和碰撞约束整合到导航终点选择中，并通过分层闭环恢复（hierarchical closed-loop recovery）传播执行反馈。
广泛的实验表明，在语义 ObjectNav 和细粒度实例导航基准测试中，OmniNav 实现了对比方法中的最高成功率，对目标重定位保持鲁棒性，并将真实世界的抓取放置成功率从开环基线的 53.3% 提升至 71.7%。
Long-horizon target navigation requires a robot to sustain task execution across evolving observations, decisions, and physical interactions. This requires three coupled capabilities: maintaining valid scene memory, revising target beliefs under partial observability, and selecting interaction-feasible navigation endpoints. However, the state underlying each capability is only conditionally valid: scene representations become stale when objects move or disappear, unsuccessful searches alter beliefs over target locations, and geometrically convenient endpoints may still be infeasible for manipulation. To address these challenges, we present OmniNav, which formulates long-horizon navigation as continual inference over a factorized task state posterior coupling scene validity, target belief, and interaction feasibility. For representation, OmniNav incrementally constructs an updatable 3D object scene memory, preventing stale scene evidence from propagating to subsequent decisions. For exploration, it introduces an evidence-aware Bayesian belief-revision mechanism that derives dependency-aware region priors from semantic context, incorporates unsuccessful searches as negative evidence, and updates them for posterior-guided frontier selection. For interaction, OmniNav incorporates manipulation reachability and collision constraints into navigation-endpoint selection and propagates execution feedback through hierarchical closed-loop recovery. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniNav achieves the highest success rates among the compared methods on semantic ObjectNav and fine-grained instance navigation benchmarks, remains robust to target relocation, and improves real-world pick-and-place success from 53.3% to 71.7% over an adapted open-loop baseline.
Damage-Aware Quadruped Locomotion: Zero-Shot Adaptation to Motor Failures via Pain-Inspired Reinforcement Learning
具备损伤感知能力的四足机器人运动：通过受“疼痛”启发的强化学习实现针对电机故障的零样本自适应
四足机器人期望能够在动态且非结构化的环境中可靠运行，而在这些环境中可能会发生意外的电机故障，从而严重降低移动性能。传统的容错控制方法通常依赖于显式的故障检测或手工设计的恢复策略，这限制了其响应能力与泛化能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种损伤感知自适应控制框架（damage-aware adaptive control framework），使四足机器人在突发电机故障下能够实现零样本（zero-shot）移动自适应。
其核心是一种受“疼痛”启发的强化学习范式（pain-inspired reinforcement learning paradigm），在该范式中，奖励（reward）显式地约束了策略行为，迫使机器人利用本体感知模块（ontology-sense module）提供的执行器健康状况线索，从而针对故障促进更安全、更具保护性的响应。为了提高鲁棒性，我们设计了一个故障概率课程（failure-probability curriculum），在训练过程中逐步增加电机故障发生的几率。在减弱电机（weakened-motor）和锁闭关节（locked-joint）故障下的评估表明，所生成的策略在所有评估的故障类别中均实现了比 SOTA（最先进）参考方法更低的速度跟踪误差。
在高保真 Isaac Gym 仿真器和真实四足硬件上进行的综合实验表明，我们的框架实现了鲁棒的、具备损伤感知的移动能力，标志着向具备弹性和可部署性的容错具足机器人迈出了一步。
Quadruped robots are expected to operate reliably in dynamic and unstructured environments, where unexpected motor failures may occur and severely degrade locomotion performance. Traditional fault-tolerant control methods typically rely on explicit fault detection or handcrafted recovery strategies, which limit their responsiveness and generalization.
In this work, we present a damage-aware adaptive control framework that enables quadruped robots to achieve zero-shot locomotion adaptation under sudden motor failures.
At its core lies a pain-inspired reinforcement learning paradigm in which the reward explicitly constrains policy behavior, forcing the robot to exploit actuator-health cues from the ontology-sense module, and thereby promoting safer, more protective responses to faults.
To improve robustness, we design a failure-probability curriculum that gradually increases the chance of motor failures during training. Evaluations under weakened-motor and locked-joint faults show that the resulting policy achieves lower velocity-tracking errors than SOTA reference across all evaluated fault categories.
Comprehensive experiments in both the high-fidelity Isaac Gym simulator and real quadruped hardware demonstrate that our framework achieves robust, damage-aware locomotion, marking a step toward resilient and deployable fault-tolerant legged robots.
